instructions: 面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用手握住电缆附件，手掌朝上。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将电缆附件卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并缓慢地将电缆附件放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing curl using a cable and an underhand grip. It keeps constant tension on the biceps.

name: 杠杆肩部推举 v. 2
instructions: 将杠杆机的座椅高度和靠背调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住机器的手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
向上和向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，但未锁定。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A machine shoulder press with a lever arm, pressing the handles overhead. It builds the shoulders and triceps.

name: 臀部上抬
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧，掌心朝下。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部。
在动作的最高点，挤压腹肌并暂停片刻。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A lying move where the hips lift off the floor as the knees come toward the chest. It trains the lower abs.

name: 屈膝卷腹
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，将膝盖靠近胸部，同时将上半身卷向膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低肩胛骨并将双腿伸展回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A crunch that pulls the knees toward the chest as the upper body curls up. It trains the abs.

name: 反向卷腹
instructions: 平躺，双臂沿着身体两侧伸展。
弯曲膝盖，将脚抬离地面，使大腿垂直于地板。
收缩腹肌，将臀部卷离地板，使膝盖靠近胸部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A crunch that curls the hips off the floor with the knees bent. It targets the lower abs.

name: 绳索反向卷腹
instructions: 将电缆连接到低滑轮上，然后面朝上躺在垫子上。
用双手握住电缆，并将双臂伸向天花板。
弯曲膝盖并抬起双腿，使大腿靠近胸部。
在保持上半身稳定的同时，将骨盆向胸部弯曲，将臀部抬离垫子。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A reverse crunch using a low cable, curling the hips off the mat. It trains the lower abs.

name: 绳索站姿卷腹(绳索把手)
instructions: 将一根绳子连接到胸部高度的缆绳机上。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
双手握住绳子并将其放在脑后，保持肘部弯曲。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前挤压躯干，使肘部靠近膝盖。
在卷腹的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing cable crunch with a rope held behind the head, curling the torso forward. It strengthens the abs.

name: 杠铃全蹲(用深蹲架)
instructions: Set the bar at upper chest height in a rack and step under it, resting it on your upper back.
Unrack and step back with your feet shoulder width apart.
Bend your hips and knees and squat down as deep as you comfortably can.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Set the safety pins just below your lowest depth.
description: A deep back squat performed in a power rack for safety. It builds strength across the legs and hips.

name: 绳索站姿髋伸展 v. 2
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and stand facing the stack.
Hold the frame for support.
Keep your core tight and kick the strapped leg back.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.
description: A cable kickback for the glutes with an ankle strap. This is a second version of the move.

name: 哑铃屈膝礼弓步蹲
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Bend both knees and lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Keep your chest up and hips square.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Repeat on the other side and alternate.
description: A lunge where you step back and across behind you, like a curtsey. It works the glutes and outer hips from a different angle.

name: 哑铃单腿深蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest or by your side.
Stand on one leg with the other lifted in front.
Sit your hips back and lower under control.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Press up to stand, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg squat holding a dumbbell. It builds leg strength and balance.

name: 史密斯机侧向踏阶
instructions: Place a bench beside you and set the bar across your upper back.
Stand with the bench at your side.
Step up sideways with the near foot.
Straighten your leg to lift your body.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch sides.
description: A sideways step up under the smith bar. It works the quads and glutes one leg at a time.

name: 史密斯机侧卧上提(髋部)
instructions: Lie on your side under the bar and set it at a comfortable height.
Place your top foot or leg against the bar.
Lift the leg up smoothly against the resistance.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side-lying lift using the smith machine for resistance. It targets the outer hip and glutes.

name: 史密斯机单腿硬拉
instructions: Stand holding the bar at hip height on a single leg.
Keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
Hinge forward, sliding the bar down your leg.
Keep your back flat and extend the free leg behind you.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg deadlift using the smith bar. It trains the hamstrings, glutes and balance.

name: 弹力带背部伸展
instructions: Anchor the band and secure it across your upper back.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Extend your torso up until your body is in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A back extension with band resistance. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.

name: 弹力带俯身划船 v. 2
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends in your hands.
Hinge forward with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.
description: A bent-over row with a band. It builds the muscles between your shoulder blades and the lats.

name: 弹力带俯身后侧平举 v. 3
english: band bent over rear lateral raise v. 3
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends in each hand.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Raise your arms out to the sides with slightly bent elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.
description: A bent-over raise to the sides with a band. It focuses on the rear delts.

name: 弹力带提踵
instructions: Sit or stand with the band looped under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly.
Press up onto your toes against the band.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
description: A calf raise with band resistance. It builds the calves and ankle strength.

name: 弹力带锤式弯举
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.
description: A hammer curl with a band. The neutral grip hits the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.

name: 弹力带髋伸展
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or anchor it low.
Stand tall and hold support.
Press one leg straight back against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs.
description: A band-resisted leg kick back. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 弹力带超级背伸
instructions: Secure the band over your shoulders and under your feet or anchor.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Rise until your torso is in line with your legs.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A hyperextension with band resistance. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.

name: 弹力带后踢
instructions: Stand on the band, hinge forward and hold the ends.
Keep your upper arms close to your sides.
Straighten your elbows, pushing your hands back.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Bend slowly to return.
description: A triceps kickback with a band. It isolates the back of the upper arm.

name: 弹力带跪姿下拉
instructions: Anchor the band high and kneel facing it.
Grab the ends with arms extended up.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control.
description: A kneeling pulldown with a band anchored overhead. It trains the lats and mid-back.

name: 弹力带跪姿后踢
instructions: Get on all fours with the band around one foot and in your hands.
Keep your core tight.
Kick the banded leg back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.
description: A kneeling glute kick against a band. It strengthens the glutes with a stable base.

name: 弹力带侧平举
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly under control.
Avoid shrugging.
description: A lateral raise with a band. It builds the side delts.

name: 弹力带低位飞鸟
instructions: Anchor the band low and stand with a staggered stance.
Hold the ends with arms slightly bent.
Sweep your arms up and together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly.
description: A fly where your arms sweep upward from low to high. It targets the upper chest.

name: 弹力带弓步蹲
instructions: Stand on the band with the ends held at your shoulders.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to return.
Alternate legs.
description: Lunges with band resistance. They build the quads and glutes with extra tension.

name: 弹力带仰卧抬腿抬髋
english: band lying leg and hip raise
instructions: Lie on your back with the band set around your feet or anchored.
Lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Curl your hips off the floor.
Lower slowly.
Keep your lower back controlled.
description: A lying raise lifting the legs and hips with a band. It works the lower abs.

name: 弹力带俯卧腿弯举
instructions: Lie face down with a band anchored to your ankles.
Keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstrings.
Lower slowly.
description: A leg curl while lying down using a band. It targets the hamstrings.

name: 弹力带仰卧抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with the band around your legs.
Keep your legs straight.
Raise one leg against the band.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides.
description: A lying leg raise against a band. It works the hip muscles.

name: 弹力带中位飞鸟
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand facing away.
Hold the ends with slightly bent elbows.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs.
Return slowly.
description: A chest fly with the band at mid-chest height. It works the pecs through a sweeping motion.

name: 弹力带俯卧撑
instructions: Loop the band across your upper back, holding the ends under your palms.
Set up in a high plank.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up against the band.
Keep your body in a straight line.
description: A push up with a band across your back for extra resistance. It strengthens the chest and triceps.

name: 弹力带反握弯举
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms down.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly.
Avoid swinging.
description: A curl with an overhand grip using a band. It builds the forearms and brachialis.

name: 弹力带单腿直腿硬拉
instructions: Stand on the band on one leg and hold the ends.
Keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
Hinge forward with a flat back and kick the free leg back.
Return by driving your hips forward.
Finish reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg stiff-leg deadlift with a band. It builds the hamstrings and balance.

name: 弹力带站姿肩外旋
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the end with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your body.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch arms.
description: An external rotation with a band. It strengthens the rotator cuff.

name: 弹力带站姿上斜推胸
instructions: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends at your chest.
Step into a staggered stance.
Press your hands up and forward.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly.
description: A standing press angled upward using a band. It targets the upper chest.

name: 弹力带站姿肩内旋
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the end with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm across toward your belly.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch arms.
description: An internal rotation with a band. It strengthens the rotator cuff.

name: 弹力带站姿伸腿
instructions: Anchor the band behind you and loop it around one ankle.
Hold support and lift the knee slightly.
Straighten your knee forward.
Squeeze your quad.
Bend slowly to return, then switch legs.
description: A leg extension while standing with a band around the ankle. It works the quads.

name: 弹力带站姿直腿抬高
instructions: Loop the band around your ankle and anchor it behind you.
Stand tall holding support.
Raise the straight leg forward.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch legs.
description: A straight-leg raise forward while standing with a band. It works the hip flexors and quads.

name: 弹力带直臂下拉
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and stand facing it.
Hold the ends with straight arms.
Pull your hands down toward your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly.
description: A pulldown with straight arms using a band. It isolates the lats.

name: 弹力带站姿划船
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the ends.
Step back to create tension.
Pull your elbows back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
description: A standing row with a band. It works the mid-back and lats.

name: 弹力带转体(由下至上)
instructions: Anchor the band low and hold it with both hands beside the anchor.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso, pulling the band diagonally up.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.
description: A diagonal twist with a band moving from low to high. It trains the obliques.

name: 弹力带直立划船
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band with feet hip-width apart and grip the ends with both hands.
Let your arms hang in front of your thighs with the band slightly taut.
Pull your hands up along your body, leading with the elbows, until they reach about chest height.
Pause briefly, then lower under control without letting the band snap back.
Keep your chest tall and your shoulders away from your ears.
description: Pull a band up along your body toward chest height. It works the shoulders and upper traps with gentle, joint-friendly resistance.

name: 弹力带直立肩外旋
instructions: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand sideways to it, holding the handle with the far hand.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm away from your belly, keeping the elbow pinned in place.
Pause when your hand points slightly outward, then return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: Rotate your forearm outward against a band while the elbow stays at your side. It strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles that steady the shoulder.

name: 杠杆踏步机
instructions: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles lightly for balance.
Push one pedal down while the other rises, keeping a smooth rhythm.
Stand tall and keep your knees pointing forward.
Continue at a comfortable pace for several minutes, adjusting resistance as needed.
Slow down gradually before stepping off.
description: Climb on a lever stepper machine at a steady pace. It raises your heart rate and works the legs and glutes.

name: 猫式
instructions: Start on all fours with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Exhale and press the floor away as you round your back toward the ceiling.
Tuck your chin toward your chest and draw your belly in.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Inhale and return to a neutral back.
description: Round your spine upward from hands and knees to stretch the back. A gentle way to loosen the spine and wake up the core.

name: 幻椅式 v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Bend your knees and sit your hips back and down as if lowering into a chair.
Reach your arms up beside your ears and lengthen your spine.
Sink a little deeper while keeping your weight in your heels.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then straighten your legs to stand.
description: A deeper version of chair pose where you sit lower with arms lifted. It builds leg strength and balance.

name: 幻椅式
instructions: Stand with feet together or hip-width apart.
Bend your knees and send your hips back, keeping your chest lifted.
Raise your arms overhead with palms facing each other.
Keep your knees over your ankles and your tailbone tucked slightly.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then stand up.
description: Sit back into an imaginary chair with arms overhead. It strengthens the thighs and glutes while challenging balance.

name: 婴儿式
instructions: Kneel on the floor with big toes touching and knees apart.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Fold forward and slide your arms out in front of you.
Rest your forehead on the floor and relax your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
description: Fold forward over your knees with arms extended on the floor. A restful stretch for the back, hips and shoulders.

name: 鹤禅式
instructions: Squat with feet together and place your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows slightly and rest your shins against the backs of your upper arms.
Shift your weight forward onto your hands and lift one foot, then the other.
Round your upper back, draw your belly in and gaze slightly ahead.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower your feet gently.
description: An arm balance where your knees rest on the backs of your upper arms and your feet lift. It builds wrist, arm and core strength.

name: 新月式
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and raise your arms overhead, palms joined.
Reach up through your fingertips and keep your hips level.
Lean your upper body slowly to one side in a gentle curve.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths without twisting forward or back.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.
description: Stand and arch sideways with arms overhead to lengthen one side of the body. It opens the ribs, sides and shoulders.

name: 默认姿势
instructions: Stand with feet about hip-width apart and weight even on both feet.
Let your arms hang naturally at your sides.
Lengthen your spine and gently draw your ribs down.
Relax your shoulders and look straight ahead.
Breathe calmly for a few breaths.
description: A relaxed, tall standing posture with arms by your sides. It is the neutral starting point for standing moves.

name: 下犬式
english: downward facing dog adho mukha svanasana
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands slightly ahead of shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Straighten your legs as far as comfortable and press your chest toward your thighs.
Spread your fingers and push the floor away.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
description: An inverted V shape that stretches the back of the legs and spine while loading the shoulders. A classic yoga staple.

name: 鱼式
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms at your sides, palms down.
Press your forearms into the floor and lift your chest.
Arch your upper back and lower the crown of your head lightly toward the floor.
Keep your legs relaxed and breathe deeply into the chest.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.
description: Lie on your back and lift your chest into a gentle arch. It opens the chest and front of the neck and shoulders.

name: 花环式
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down if you can.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Press your elbows against your inner knees and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
description: A deep squat with elbows pressing the knees apart and palms together. It stretches the hips, groin and ankles.

name: 半月式
instructions: Start in a wide-legged stance and turn one foot out.
Bend over that leg and place your hand on the floor or a block ahead of the foot.
Lift the back leg until it is parallel to the floor.
Open your chest and stack your hips, reaching the top arm up.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower and switch sides.
description: Balance on one leg with the torso and top leg extended sideways. It strengthens the standing leg and hips and tests your balance.

name: 手触脚式
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and fold forward with a long spine.
Slide your hands under your feet with palms up, toes on your fingers.
Pull gently to deepen the stretch while keeping your knees slightly soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
description: Fold forward and slide your hands under your feet. It stretches the hamstrings, calves and back.

name: 英雄式
instructions: Kneel with knees together and feet slightly wider than your hips.
Sit your hips down between your heels, using a block if needed.
Rest your hands on your thighs and lengthen your spine.
Relax your shoulders and breathe evenly.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, then come out slowly.
description: Kneel and sit between your feet, stretching the thighs and ankles. A grounded seat for breathing or meditation.

name: 腿向侧面
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg and let it open out to the side, keeping the other leg down.
Keep your hips squared and your lower back relaxed.
Hold the stretch gently, breathing steadily.
Return to the middle and repeat with the other leg.
description: Bring one leg out to the side to stretch the inner thigh. It improves hip mobility and flexibility.

name: 莲花坐
instructions: Sit tall with legs stretched out in front of you.
Bend one knee and place that foot high on the opposite thigh.
Bend the other knee and place that foot on top, if your hips allow it.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Breathe slowly for 30-60 seconds, then switch which leg goes on top.
description: Sit cross-legged with each foot resting on the opposite thigh. It opens the hips and encourages a calm, upright posture.

name: 扭转侧角式
english: revolved side angle pose parivrtta parsvakonasana
instructions: Step into a long lunge with the back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist your torso and hook the opposite elbow outside the front knee.
Press your palms together and look up or ahead.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.
description: A deep lunge with a twist and hands pressed together. It strengthens the legs and wrings out the spine.

name: 坐角式前屈
english: spread leg forward fold upavista konasana
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs spread as wide as is comfortable.
Flex your feet and keep your knees pointing up.
Walk your hands forward and fold from the hips.
Keep your spine long instead of rounding.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
description: Sit with legs wide and fold forward over them. It stretches the inner thighs and hamstrings.

name: 站姿前屈
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips and fold forward, keeping your knees slightly soft.
Let your hands rest on the floor or hold opposite elbows.
Relax your neck and let the weight of your head drop.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
description: Fold forward from standing and let the head hang. It lengthens the hamstrings and back.

name: 站姿分腿前屈
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Hinge forward at the hips with a long spine.
Lower your hands to the floor or your shins.
Relax your head and neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
description: Fold forward from a wide-legged stance to stretch the inner thighs and hamstrings.

name: 树式
instructions: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one foot.
Place the sole of the other foot on your inner calf or thigh, never on the knee.
Bring your palms together at your chest or raise them overhead.
Fix your eyes on one point to stay steady.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch legs.
description: Balance on one leg with the other foot resting on your inner thigh. It builds balance, focus and hip strength.

name: 三角式
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart and turn one foot out 90 degrees.
Raise your arms to shoulder height.
Reach toward the front foot, then lower that hand to your shin or the floor.
Extend the other arm up and look toward it.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.
description: From a wide stance, reach sideways over the front leg with arms in a line. It stretches the hamstrings, hips and sides.

name: 战士二式 v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet wide and turn your front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Turn your head to look over the front hand.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.
description: A wide lunge with arms stretched to the sides. It strengthens the legs and builds stamina.

name: 战士一式
instructions: Step one foot back into a long stance, with the back foot turned out slightly.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Square your hips toward the front.
Raise both arms overhead and lift your chest.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.
description: A lunge with arms raised overhead. It stretches the hip flexors and chest and strengthens the legs.

name: 宽腿前屈
english: wide legged forward bend prasarita padottanasana
instructions: Stand with feet about one leg-length apart and toes pointing slightly in.
Place your hands on your hips and hinge forward with a flat back.
Lower your hands to the floor under your shoulders.
Let your head hang long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
description: Fold forward with your feet far apart. It stretches the hamstrings and inner thighs and eases the back.

name: 杠铃硬拉(背面视角)
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart, bar over mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
description: The barbell deadlift shown from behind. It's a full posterior chain lift for the glutes, hamstrings and back.

name: 杠铃硬拉(正面视角)
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart, bar over mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
description: The barbell deadlift seen from the front. A strong lift for the glutes, hamstrings and back.

name: 弹力带交替二头弯举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，反手握住弹力带，手掌朝上。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，慢慢地将一只手臂向肩膀弯曲，在顶部挤压二头肌。
将手臂放回起始位置，然后用另一只手臂重复此动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。
description: A band curl alternating one arm at a time. It trains the biceps.

name: 弹力带交替V字起身
instructions: 平躺，双腿伸直，手臂伸过头顶，握住弹力带。
收紧腹肌，同时将双腿和上半身抬离地面，将双手伸向脚趾。
当你降低双腿和上半身时，交换双腿的位置，将一条腿交叉在另一条腿上。
重复该动作，每次重复时交替变换双腿的位置。
继续进行所需的重复次数。
description: A V-up with a band, alternating the leg position each rep. It trains the abs and hip flexors.

name: 弹力带辅助引体向上
instructions: 将弹力带固定在上拉杆或坚固的锚点上。
踏上弹力带，手掌背向自己，握住杠铃，双手之间的距离略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，保持核心收紧，肩膀向下并向后倾斜。
将肩胛骨挤压在一起并将肘部向下推向臀部，将身体向上拉向杠铃杆。
继续拉，直到下巴高于杠铃，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A pull-up with a band looped under the feet for assistance. It builds the lats and biceps while you work toward unassisted pull-ups.

name: 弹力带辅助腹轮前推
instructions: 跪在地板上，双手握住弹力带的手柄，手掌朝下。
将弹力带放在您面前的地面上，双手分开与肩同宽。
启动你的核心并缓慢地向前滚动轮子，在保持控制的同时尽可能地伸展你的身体。
在最远点暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将轮子向膝盖方向滚动，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An ab wheel rollout with a band to help bring you back. It trains the abs with a lighter load.

name: 弹力带自行车卷腹
instructions: 平躺，双手放在脑后，膝盖弯曲。
将脚抬离地面，将右膝盖靠近胸部，同时扭转躯干，将左肘靠近右膝盖。
伸直右腿，同时将左膝靠近胸部，并扭转躯干，使右肘靠近左膝。
继续交替扭转运动，就像踩自行车一样，同时在整个运动过程中保持核心参与。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bicycle crunch with a band, rotating the torso and alternating the knees. It trains the abs and obliques.

name: 弹力带提踵 v. 2
instructions: Sit or stand with the band looped under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly so the band is taut.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your ankles straight and avoid rolling out.
description: Rise onto your toes against band resistance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.

name: 弹力带窄握下拉
instructions: 将弹力带固定在较高的锚点上，例如上拉杆或坚固的横梁。
面向锚点站立，用反手抓住弹力带，双手与肩同宽。
后退一步，在弹力带上产生张力，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
当你将弹力带向下拉向胸部时，收紧你的核心并保持背部挺直，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开弹力带回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A close-grip pulldown with a band, pulling down toward the chest. It trains the lats and biceps.

name: 弹力带窄距俯卧撑
instructions: 将一条带子绕在你的上臂上，就在肘部上方。
采取俯卧撑姿势，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部降低到地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A push-up with a band around the upper arms to keep the elbows in. It trains the triceps and chest.

name: 弹力带集中弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双腿分开，双脚平放在地上。
用手握住带子的一端，用脚踩在另一端上，同时将脚放在同一侧。
稍微向前倾，将肘部放在大腿内侧，膝盖上方。
手掌朝上，慢慢地将手向肩膀弯曲，保持上臂静止。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A seated concentration curl with a band, with the elbow braced on the thigh. It isolates the biceps.

name: 弹力带前平举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝下。
保持双臂伸直，将弹力带举到身前，直到双臂与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将弹力带放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A front raise with a band, lifting straight arms to shoulder height. It trains the front delts.

name: 弹力带前举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝下。
保持手臂伸直，慢慢向前举起，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A front raise with a band, raising both arms forward. It builds the front shoulders.

name: 弹力带水平帕洛夫推举
instructions: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
垂直于锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
用双手抓住带子手柄并远离锚点以在带子中产生张力。
将双手放在胸前，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体。
调动你的核心并保持稳定的姿势。
将手臂伸直至前方，将弹力带推离身体。
保持伸展姿势几秒钟，专注于保持核心紧张。
慢慢地将双手放回胸前，抵抗弹力带的拉力。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A Pallof press with a band anchored to the side, pressing out and holding. It trains the core to resist rotation.

name: 弹力带俯身髋伸展
instructions: 将带子固定在脚踝高度的坚固锚点上。
背对锚点站立，双脚与肩同宽。
向后退一步，在弹力带上产生张力，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
铰接臀部并向前倾斜，保持脊柱中立。
将右腿向后伸直，在顶部挤压臀部。
将右腿放回原位，然后换左腿重复此动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
description: A bent-over hip extension with a band, kicking one leg back. It trains the glutes.

name: 弹力带折刀仰卧起坐
instructions: 平躺，双腿伸直，手臂伸过头顶，握住弹力带。
收紧腹肌，同时抬起双腿和上半身，将双手移向脚部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢放下双腿和上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A jackknife sit-up with a band, lifting legs and torso together. It trains the abs and hip flexors.

name: 弹力带仰卧髋外旋
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
Keep your feet together and your hips stacked.
Rotate the top knee upward, opening like a clamshell.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
Keep your pelvis still so the movement comes from the hip.
description: A side-lying clam-style move with a band around the knees that fires up the outer hip and glute muscles.

name: 弹力带跪姿单臂下拉
instructions: 将带子固定在头顶上方坚固的锚点上。
跪下，用一只手握住弹力带，手掌朝下。
将手臂完全伸过头顶，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
调动你的背阔肌，将弹力带拉向你的一侧，使你的肘部靠近你的胸腔。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A kneeling one-arm pulldown with a band, driving the elbow toward the ribs. It trains the lats.

name: 弹力带仰卧髋内旋
instructions: 仰卧，双腿伸直，将阻力带绕在脚上。
弯曲膝盖并将其靠近胸部，双脚并拢。
慢慢向外旋转膝盖，使膝盖彼此远离，同时保持双脚并拢。
旋转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A lying hip rotation with a band around the feet or legs, rotating the knees out and back. It works the glutes and hips.

name: 弹力带跪姿扭转卷腹
instructions: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
面向远离锚点的方向跪下，用双手握住弹力带，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体两侧。
收紧腹肌，慢慢地将躯干扭向一侧，将双手移向另一侧的臀部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A kneeling crunch with a twist using a band. It trains the abs and obliques.

name: 弹力带单臂过头二头弯举
english: band one arm overhead biceps curl
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带的一端放在脚下。
握住弹力带的另一端，手臂完全伸过头顶，手掌朝前。
保持上臂静止，将前臂向肩膀弯曲，挤压二头肌。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A standing one-arm curl with the arm held overhead against band tension. It trains the biceps.

name: 弹力带单臂单腿分腿蹲
english: band one arm single leg split squat
instructions: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将阻力带绕在脚踝上。
向前伸出一条腿，将脚尖放在长凳上或身后的一步上。
用一只手握住支撑物以保持平衡。
弯曲站立的腿，将身体降低到蹲姿，保持膝盖与脚趾在一条直线上。
推动脚后跟返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。
description: A single-leg split squat with a band, back foot raised. It trains the quads and glutes.

name: 弹力带单臂站姿低位划船
english: band one arm standing low row
instructions: 将带子固定在腰部高度的稳定锚点上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
用一只手握住弹力带，手掌朝内，然后后退以在弹力带中产生张力。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将带子拉向腰部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开弹力带回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A standing one-arm low row with a band. It trains the back and biceps.

name: 弹力带单臂扭转推胸
english: band one arm twisting chest press
instructions: 将带子固定在胸部高度的坚固锚点上。
站立，一侧面向锚点，用一只手抓住带子。
远离锚点以在带子中产生张力。
将双脚分开与肩同宽，并稍微弯曲膝盖。
将握住弹力带的手穿过身体，朝向对侧的肩膀。
在保持弹力带张力的同时，将手向前推离身体，伸展手臂。
慢慢回到起始位置并重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用另一只手重复练习。
description: A one-arm chest press with a band that adds a twist. It trains the chest and core.

name: 弹力带单臂扭转坐姿划船
english: band one arm twisting seated row
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
用一只手握住弹力带，并将手臂完全伸到身前。
保持背部挺直，弯曲肘部并将肩胛骨挤压在一起，将弹力带拉向身体。
同时，将躯干向拉动手臂的一侧扭转。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢释放弹力带的张力并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
description: A seated one-arm row with a band and a torso twist. It trains the back and obliques.

name: 弹力带穿腿拉
instructions: 将阻力带连接到地面上坚固的锚点上。
背对锚点站立，双脚与肩同宽。
向前迈一步，在弹力带中产生张力，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
铰接臀部并将臀部向后推，保持膝盖轻微弯曲。
降低躯干直到与地面平行，感觉腿筋被拉伸。
向前推动臀部并挤压臀部以返回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A hip hinge pulling a band through the legs. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 弹力带推式仰卧起坐
instructions: 将带子牢固地固定在稳定的锚点上。
平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
用双手握住弹力带，并将双臂伸向天花板。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A sit-up that pushes a band forward as you come up. It trains the abs.

name: 弹力带反向飞鸟
instructions: 将带子固定在胸部高度的固定物体上。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住弹力带放在身前。
保持手臂伸直并将其向两侧抬起，直到与地面平行。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢地将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A reverse fly with a band, opening the arms to the sides. It trains the rear delts and upper back.

name: 弹力带反握腕弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住弹力带，手掌朝下，然后将其缠绕在手指上。
将前臂放在大腿上，手腕悬在边缘上。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，挤压前臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手腕放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A reverse wrist curl with a band, lifting the back of the hands. It strengthens the forearms.

name: 弹力带坐姿髋外旋
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with a band looped around your knees or thighs.
Keep your feet planted and your back tall.
Push your knees apart against the band.
Hold briefly at the widest point.
Bring your knees back together slowly.
Keep your torso still and avoid leaning.
description: A seated hip rotation with a band for resistance, working the glutes and deep hip rotators.

name: 弹力带坐姿髋内旋
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
在大腿周围、膝盖上方放置一条阻力带。
保持膝盖弯曲 90 度，双脚分开与肩同宽。
收紧臀肌，慢慢向外旋转膝盖，克服弹力带的阻力。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated hip rotation against a band around the thighs. It works the glutes and hip muscles.

name: 弹力带肩部推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下。
手掌朝前握住弹力带，将双手举至肩高，肘部弯曲。
将弹力带压过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将阻力带降低至肩部高度。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A shoulder press with a band under the feet. It builds the shoulders and triceps.

name: 弹力带侧向三头肌伸展
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住弹力带，掌心朝下。
将手臂伸直至两侧，保持与地面平行。
慢慢弯曲肘部，将双手放在肩膀上，保持上臂不动。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A triceps extension with a band, extending the arms out to the sides. It works the triceps.

name: 弹力带单腿提踵
instructions: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将弹力带绕在左脚掌上。
如果需要，请抓住一个稳定的物体以保持平衡。
慢慢地将左脚跟抬离地面，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将左脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换右腿。
description: A single-leg calf raise with a band around the foot. It trains the calves.

name: 弹力带单腿反向提踵
english: band single leg reverse calf raise
instructions: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将弹力带放在脚掌周围。
抓住稳定的物体以保持平衡。
慢慢地将脚跟抬离地面，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一条腿。
description: A single-leg calf raise with a band, rising onto the ball of the foot. It trains the calves.

name: 弹力带坐地踝背屈
english: resistance band sitting floor ankle dorsi flexion
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and loop the band around the top of one foot.
Hold the band ends or anchor them so there is light tension.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Pause, then return slowly.
Complete all reps, then switch feet.
description: Pull your toes toward your shin against a band while seated. It strengthens the muscles at the front of the lower leg.

name: 弹力带单腿分腿蹲
instructions: 双脚分开站立，与臀部同宽，将阻力带绕在脚踝上。
右脚向前迈一大步，左脚向后退一小步。
弯曲膝盖并降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行，保持左膝盖略高于地面。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
description: A single-leg split squat with a band. It trains the quads and glutes.

name: 球辅助仰卧髋内收
english: ball assisted lying supine hip adduction
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a ball between your knees.
Rest your arms by your sides and keep your lower back relaxed.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
Keep your hips level throughout.
description: Squeeze a ball between your knees while lying on your back. It targets the inner thighs.

name: 弹力带仰卧直腿抬高
instructions: 平躺，双腿伸直，双脚并拢。
将带子放在脚弓周围，并用手握住带子的末端。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，直到它们垂直于地板。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A lying straight leg raise with a band held in the hands. It trains the abs and hip flexors.

name: 弹力带深蹲划船
instructions: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
双手握住弹力带手柄，手掌相对，双臂向前伸展。
弯曲膝盖并蹲下，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
从蹲姿开始，将弹力带手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A squat combined with a band row, pulling the handles as you stand. It works the legs and back.

name: 伸拇指时手指屈曲
instructions: Hold one hand out with your palm open.
Extend your thumb out to the side and keep it straight.
Curl your four fingers slowly toward your palm.
Open the fingers again.
Repeat 10-15 times, then switch hands.
Keep the movement smooth and pain free.
description: A small hand mobility drill where you curl your fingers while holding the thumb straight. It helps finger and thumb control.

name: 拇指外展
instructions: Rest your hand on a table with the palm facing up.
Keep your fingers relaxed and straight.
Slowly move your thumb away from your palm.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly to the start.
Do 10-15 reps, then switch hands.
description: A simple thumb movement where you lift the thumb away from the palm to improve hand mobility.

name: 哑铃腕旋后
instructions: Sit and rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench with the hand hanging free.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns up.
Pause at the top.
Rotate back slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms. Keep your elbow still.
description: Rotating a dumbbell so your palm turns up, working the muscles that twist the forearm.

name: 弹力带深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开站立，与肩同宽，弹力带放在膝盖上方。
保持挺胸、核心收紧，将臀部向后推，弯曲膝盖，形成下蹲姿势。
确保膝盖位于脚趾上方，并且重量位于脚后跟。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A squat with a band above the knees. It trains the glutes and thighs.

name: 哑铃站姿交替交叉举
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise one arm up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder, elbow slightly bent.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso steady and avoid swinging.
description: A raise where each dumbbell sweeps across the front of your body. It trains the front delts and upper chest.

name: 哑铃侧平板支撑 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your side, elbow under your shoulder, with a dumbbell in your top hand.
Lift your hips into a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the dumbbell either at your side or pointing to the ceiling.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower with control, then switch sides.
Keep your hips high and don't rotate.
description: A side plank with a dumbbell added, usually held in the top hand, to make the hold harder.

name: 哑铃仰卧地面挤压推举
instructions: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand, pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze the dumbbells against each other.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Press back up while still squeezing.
Keep your wrists straight and elbows tucked.
Lower slowly each rep.
description: A floor press with the dumbbells pressed together. The squeeze keeps your chest working throughout the lift.

name: 哑铃单臂z字推举
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight out and back tall.
Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in one hand.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps and switch arms.
Brace your abs and don't lean back.
description: A seated overhead press on the floor with legs straight, using one arm. It removes leg drive and challenges your trunk.

name: 哑铃悬垂抓举
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thighs, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body.
Punch it overhead and catch it with a straight arm.
Stand tall, then lower back to the hang.
Switch arms and keep the weight light enough to move fast.
description: A powerful one-arm lift where the dumbbell goes from hip height to overhead in one motion.

name: 面朝下雪天使
instructions: Lie face down with arms by your sides and legs together.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Sweep your arms out and overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back to the start in the same arc.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
description: Lying face down, you sweep your arms and legs like a snow angel. It works the muscles along your back.

name: 面朝上雪天使
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs together.
Press your lower back toward the floor.
Sweep your arms overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back together in the same arc.
Repeat at a steady pace.
Keep your abs braced and lower back flat.
description: Lying face up, you sweep arms and legs out like a snow angel. It trains the abs and keeps your shoulders mobile.

name: 杠铃分腿站姿RDL
instructions: Hold a barbell at your thighs and stand with one foot a step ahead of the other.
Put most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bar down your front leg.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstring.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A Romanian deadlift in a split stance, with most of the load on the front leg. It builds hamstrings and glutes and tests balance.

name: 绳索踏阶
instructions: Stand facing a box or bench with a cable handle in your hands.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through that heel to step up.
Stand tall on top of the box.
Step back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A step-up with cable resistance that adds load to the legs and hips.

name: 杠铃蝴蝶式z字推举
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs out in front and the bar at upper-chest height.
Take a wide grip and brace your abs.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your upper chest under control.
Keep your back tall and avoid arching.
Use a light weight at first.
description: A seated floor press overhead with a barbell and a wide hand position. It builds strong shoulders with a stable trunk.

name: 弹力带站姿卷腹
instructions: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
背对锚点站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用双手握住弹力带并将其举至胸前，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前挺胸，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在卷腹的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing crunch with a band, curling the torso forward. It trains the abs.

name: 超人式转俯卧撑
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor and hold briefly.
Lower and place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up into a push-up.
Lower your chest back to the floor.
Repeat, keeping your body straight.
description: A combo move where you lift into a superman on the floor, then press into a push-up.

name: 徒手窄距深蹲弓步
instructions: Stand with feet close together and hands on your hips or in front of you.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.
description: A lunge done with a narrow stance and no weight. It targets the quads and glutes while challenging balance.

name: 地雷杆哥萨克深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet wide, holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Shift to one side and bend that knee deeply.
Keep the other leg straight with the toes up.
Push through the bent leg to return to centre.
Shift to the other side.
Keep your chest tall and heel down on the working side.
description: A side-to-side deep squat holding a landmine end at your chest. It works the glutes, inner thighs and hip mobility.

name: 坐姿起跳
instructions: Sit on a sturdy box or bench with feet flat.
Lean slightly forward with arms ready.
Explode upward, swinging your arms.
Land softly on both feet with bent knees.
Sit back down and reset.
Repeat with a short pause each time.
description: An explosive jump that starts from a seated position on a box or chair, building power in the legs.

name: 杠铃静态弓步蹲
instructions: Place a barbell across your upper back.
Step into a split stance with one foot forward.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your chest tall and torso upright.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A lunge held in one place with a barbell on your back, so the feet stay put while you lower and rise.

name: 哑铃窄距深蹲弓步
instructions: Stand with feet close together, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.
description: A narrow-stance lunge holding a dumbbell in each hand to add load for the quads and glutes.

name: 地雷杆弹力带推举
instructions: Set up a landmine with a band attached and hold the end of the bar at your shoulder.
Stand with feet staggered and core braced.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it to your shoulder under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.
description: A landmine press with a band adding extra resistance on the way up.

name: 桌面桥开合跳
instructions: Sit with hands behind you, then lift hips into a tabletop with knees bent.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips high.
Hop your feet wide.
Hop them back together.
Keep going at a steady pace.
Keep your hips high and don't let them sag.
description: From a reverse tabletop, you hop your feet apart and together like a jumping jack. It works the glutes and legs.

name: 交替跪姿到半跪姿
instructions: Kneel upright with both knees on the floor.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneeling position.
Pause and keep your torso tall.
Step back to full kneeling.
Repeat with the other foot.
Move slowly and use your arms for balance if needed.
description: A floor-to-stand drill moving from kneeling to half kneeling, alternating sides. It builds hip mobility and control.

name: 弹力带后三角肌划船
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and hold the ends with arms extended.
Step back until the band is taut.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly without letting your shoulders round forward.
description: Pull a band toward you with elbows flared wide. It targets the rear delts and upper back.

name: 杠杆躯干旋转
instructions: Sit in the machine and secure your torso against the pads.
Grip the handles.
Rotate your torso to one side while keeping your hips still.
Pause at the end.
Return to centre and rotate the other way.
Go slowly and avoid momentum.
description: A machine rotation that trains the abs and obliques with controlled twisting.

name: 弹力带站姿扭转卷腹
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带绕在上背部，穿过胸前。
用手握住带子的末端，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体两侧。
收紧腹肌并将躯干向一侧扭转，将肘部移向另一侧的膝盖。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A standing twisting crunch with a band, bringing the elbow toward the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.

name: 弹力带踏阶
instructions: 将一条带子绕在大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
面向台阶或平台站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
用右脚踩上平台，用脚后跟推动。
将左腿伸到身后，保持伸直。
将左脚放回地面。
重复左脚踩上平台的动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
description: A step-up with a band around the thighs. It trains the glutes and quads.

name: 弹力带直腿硬拉
instructions: 双脚分开站立，与肩同宽，将弹力带绕在脚踝上。
用双手将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，铰接臀部，慢慢将上半身降低到地面。
当你降低时，将臀部向后推，并让膝盖稍微弯曲。
将弹力带降低至地面，感受腿筋的拉伸。
在底部暂停片刻，然后启动臀肌和腿筋，将上半身抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A stiff-leg deadlift with a band, hinging at the hips. It trains the hamstrings and glutes.

name: 杠铃核心深蹲
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Take a deep breath and brace your abs.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your torso tight and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Exhale at the top and reset your brace each rep.
description: A barbell squat focused on bracing your core hard through the lift. It builds leg strength and trunk stability.

name: 哑铃半跪姿雷神上举
instructions: Kneel in a half-kneeling position and hold a dumbbell near the outside of your back hip.
Brace your abs and keep your torso upright.
Lift the dumbbell diagonally up and across your body.
Finish with it above the opposite shoulder.
Lower along the same path.
Finish reps, then switch sides.
description: A diagonal lift from low to high while half kneeling, working the trunk, hips and shoulders together.

name: 哑铃站姿交叉高翻
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thigh, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up and across your body.
Catch it at the opposite shoulder.
Lower it back to the hang.
Finish reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm clean where the dumbbell travels across your body to the opposite shoulder.

name: 绳索单臂熊式飞鸟
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and stand with a staggered stance.
Grab the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Keep your elbow slightly bent and sweep your arm across your body.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish reps and switch arms.
description: A single-arm cable fly done in a braced, staggered stance, working the chest and keeping the trunk steady.

name: 哑铃后撤弓步蹲转单臂肩部推举
english: dumbbell rear lunge to single arm shoulders press
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at one shoulder and stand tall.
Step one leg back into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to stand up.
As you rise, press the dumbbell overhead.
Lower it to your shoulder and repeat.
Switch arms or legs each set.
description: A combo move: a rear lunge followed by a single-arm press as you stand. It works legs and shoulders together.

name: 负重杠铃片侧向起身深蹲
instructions: Hold a weight plate at your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest up and elbows in.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep the plate close to your body.
description: A squat holding a weight plate in front of your chest. The plate acts as a counterweight and helps keep your torso upright.

name: 弹力带直腿硬拉
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带绕在脚上。
双手握住弹力带，手掌朝向身体，手臂伸直。
收紧核心并保持膝盖轻微弯曲。
慢慢地以臀部为中心向前转动，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将弹力带降低至地面，同时保持双腿伸直。
在底部暂停片刻，然后挤压臀肌和腿筋，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A straight-leg deadlift with a band, hinging forward at the hips. It trains the lower back and hamstrings.

name: 杠铃高拉
instructions: Hold a barbell at mid-thigh with an overhand grip, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug hard.
Pull the bar up to chest height, elbows high.
Let the bar settle and lower it to the thighs.
Reset your stance.
Keep the bar close to your body.
description: An explosive pull taking the bar from the thighs to chest height. It builds power in the traps, hips and legs.

name: 杠铃悬垂高翻高拉
instructions: Hold a barbell just above the knees with an overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips and keep your back flat.
Explode up through the legs and shrug.
Pull the bar to chest height with high elbows.
Lower to the hang position.
Reset and repeat. Keep the bar close.
description: A high pull starting from the hang position above the knees, training explosive hip and shoulder power.

name: 药球过头抛
instructions: Stand holding a medicine ball overhead.
Reach back slightly and brace your abs.
Throw the ball forward powerfully.
Follow through with your arms.
Pick up the ball and reset.
Keep your back neutral.
description: An explosive throw of a medicine ball from behind the head forward. It builds power from hips to arms.

name: 药球向后过头抛
instructions: Stand holding a medicine ball in front of your thighs.
Squat down and swing the ball between your legs.
Drive up and extend your hips.
Throw the ball up and backward over your head.
Retrieve the ball and reset.
Keep your arms long and make sure the space behind you is clear.
description: A backward throw of a medicine ball over the head from a squat. It builds hip and back power.

name: 弹力带坐姿扭转
instructions: 坐在地上，双腿向前伸展，背部挺直。
将带子绕在腰上，并用双手握住两端。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将躯干扭向一侧，保持背部挺直，双脚着地。
扭转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复扭转到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A seated twist with a band around the waist. It trains the abs and obliques.

name: 杠铃粗杠反握弯举
instructions: Hold a fat barbell with an overhand grip.
Stand with elbows by your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your wrists straight.
description: A reverse curl with a thick bar, which challenges your grip and the forearm muscles even more.

name: 绳索坐姿单臂背阔肌划船
english: cable seated single arm lats focused row
instructions: Sit at the cable station with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Sit tall and let the arm extend with a slight stretch in the lat.
Pull your elbow down and back toward your hip, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze the lat for a moment, then slowly let the handle return.
Keep your torso still and shoulders down. Finish all reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm seated cable row that keeps the pull in the lats. Great for fixing side-to-side strength gaps.

name: 杠杆等长深蹲髋外展
instructions: Set the machine pads against the outsides of your knees.
Lower into a half squat and keep your chest up.
Press your knees outward against the pads.
Hold the position steadily for the target time.
Release and stand up slowly.
description: Hold a squat while pressing out against a machine pad. It trains the outer hips and glutes.

name: 负重杠铃片卢式上举
instructions: Stand tall holding a weight plate with both hands at thigh height.
Raise the plate out and up in a wide arc until it is about overhead.
Pause briefly, keeping your ribs down and core tight.
Lower the plate back along the same path with control.
Use a light plate and avoid leaning back.
description: A plate raise that sweeps the weight out and up in a U shape, working the shoulders and upper traps.

name: 杠铃下斜窄握推举
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and grab the bar with hands about shoulder width apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your lower chest with locked elbows.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping elbows tucked close.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows and use a spotter.
description: A close grip press on a decline bench that loads the triceps and lower chest together.

name: 史密斯机上斜窄握卧推
english: smith incline close grip bench press
instructions: Set an incline bench under the Smith bar and lie back with eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar slightly narrower than shoulder width and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your upper chest with elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades pulled back.
description: A close grip press on an incline bench using the guided Smith bar to hit the triceps and upper chest.

name: 哑铃半跪姿单臂高翻推举
english: dumbbell half kneeling single arm clean press
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the dumbbell on the floor by your front foot and grab it.
Pull the dumbbell up to your shoulder in one smooth motion, rotating your wrist.
Press it overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then to the floor with control.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: A half kneeling clean and press that trains the shoulder while the stance forces your core and hips to stay stable.

name: 药球过头砸地绕圈
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart holding a medicine ball overhead.
Circle the ball to one side and around as you start to bend your knees.
Slam the ball hard into the floor in front of you.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up, and reset overhead.
Alternate the circle direction every set and keep your core braced.
description: A medicine ball slam combined with a circular sweep, building power through the core, lats and shoulders.

name: 绳索侧向踏阶
instructions: Stand sideways to a box with the cable handle held at your chest.
Place the near foot on the box and press through that heel.
Step up until your leg is straight and stand tall on top.
Lower slowly back to the floor with control.
Do all reps on one side, then turn around and switch.
description: A sideways step up against cable tension that works the glutes and thighs and challenges balance.

name: 弹力带扭转过头推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下。
将弹力带手柄保持在与肩同高的位置，手掌朝前。
启动你的核心并将弹力带压过头顶，充分伸展你的手臂。
当你按压时，将你的躯干扭转到一侧，保持臀部稳定。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复按压和扭转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: An overhead press with a band, twisting the torso as you press. It trains the shoulders and core.

name: 绳索单侧踏阶
instructions: Face a box with the cable handle held at your chest or by your side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel and stand up straight on the box.
Lower your trailing foot back to the floor slowly.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A single leg step up with cable resistance that builds leg strength and balance one side at a time.

name: 站姿等长肩外旋(用毛巾)
english: standing isometric shoulder external rotation with towel
instructions: Stand next to a wall with a towel between the back of your hand and the wall.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Press your hand outward into the towel.
Hold the effort for 10 to 20 seconds.
Relax, then switch sides.
description: Press the back of your hand into a towel on a wall while standing. It trains the rotator cuff without moving the joint.

name: 弹力带反握下拉
instructions: 将弹力带固定在较高的锚点上，例如上拉杆或坚固的横梁。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住弹力带，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
将手臂完全伸过头顶，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
收紧背阔肌，将弹力带向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An underhand pulldown with a band, pulling toward the chest. It trains the lats and biceps.

name: 站姿等长二头肌保持
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and your elbows at your sides.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees with palms facing up.
Squeeze your fists and flex your biceps hard.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and elbows pinned, then rest and repeat.
description: A static curl hold where you keep the elbows bent and the biceps working without moving.

name: 坐姿等长腘绳肌弯举保持(健身球)
english: sitting isometric hamstring curl hold with exercise ball
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs out and the ball under your heels.
Lean back on your hands.
Press your heels into the ball and slide it in until knees bend.
Hold the position steadily.
Slowly extend your legs again.
description: Hold a ball under your heels in a curled position. It builds endurance in the back of the thighs.

name: 弹力带V字起身
instructions: 平躺，双腿伸直，手臂伸过头顶，握住弹力带。
收紧腹肌，同时将双腿和上半身抬离地面，双手伸向脚趾。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢放下双腿和上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A V-up with a band, lifting legs and torso together. It trains the abs and hip flexors.

name: 弹力带垂直帕洛夫推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带缠绕在胸部高度的坚固物体上。
用双手握住弹力带并远离锚点，在弹力带中产生张力。
使自己垂直于锚点，一侧面向弹力带。
将双臂伸直在身前，保持双手与胸同高。
收紧核心肌群，将弹力带压离胸部，充分伸展手臂。
保持该姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢将弹力带拉回到胸部。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A vertical Pallof press with a band, pressing at chest height and holding. It trains the core to resist rotation.

name: 弹力带腕弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上。
双手握住弹力带，手掌朝上，前臂放在大腿上。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，挤压前臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手腕放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A wrist curl with a band, curling the wrists upward. It strengthens the forearms.

name: 跳箱跳下双脚落地
instructions: Stand on a sturdy box with your toes near the edge.
Step off the box, do not jump.
Land on both feet at the same time with soft, bent knees.
Sink into a quarter squat to absorb the impact and hold the landing.
Step back up and repeat. Keep your knees in line with your toes.
description: A drop from a box with a soft two foot landing that trains landing control and leg power.

name: 徒手箱式深蹲
instructions: Place a box behind you and stand with feet a bit wider than shoulders.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower toward the box.
Lightly touch the box without dropping onto it.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
description: A squat that lightly touches a box behind you to teach depth, hip hinge and control.

name: 弹力带Y字上举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝内。
保持双臂伸直，将其向上举至两侧，与身体形成“Y”形。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢地将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A Y-raise with a band, lifting the arms into a Y shape. It trains the delts and upper back.

name: 弹力带耸肩
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下，用手握住两端。
保持手臂伸直并放松，让弹力带悬挂在大腿前面。
向上耸肩，尽可能高地举起弹力带，以启动斜方肌。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A shrug with a band, lifting the shoulders toward the ears. It trains the traps.

name: 哑铃上方波比跳
instructions: Stand beside a dumbbell lying on the floor.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor, jump your feet back and do a push up.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Jump up and sideways over the dumbbell, landing softly.
Turn and repeat in the other direction at a steady pace.
description: A burpee where you jump sideways over a dumbbell each rep, raising the heart rate and working the whole body.

name: 哑铃站姿前平举扭转
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a dumbbell in both hands at thigh level.
Raise the dumbbell in front of you to chest height.
Rotate your torso to one side, turning from the ribs while your hips face forward.
Rotate back to the center and lower the dumbbell with control.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the weight light.
description: A front raise combined with a torso twist, working the shoulders and the obliques together.

name: 弹力带交替分腿站姿帕洛夫推举
english: resistance band alternating split stance pallof press
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand sideways to it in a split stance.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the band straight out in front of you without letting your torso turn.
Hold for a second, then bring the hands back to your chest.
Switch which foot is forward on each set or rep and keep your hips square.
description: A Pallof press from a split stance that resists the band pull and trains anti-rotation strength.

name: 哑铃熊爬平板交替划船
instructions: Start on all fours with a dumbbell in each hand and knees hovering just off the floor.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it back to the floor with control.
Row with the other arm and keep alternating at a steady pace.
description: A row from a bear plank position that builds back strength while the core fights to stop hip rotation.

name: 哑铃上拉转桥式推举
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a dumbbell over your chest.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips into a bridge.
Lower the dumbbell back overhead in a pullover arc.
Pull it back over your chest and press it straight up.
Lower your hips with control and repeat, keeping your ribs down.
description: A glute bridge combined with a pullover and press, training the hips, chest and triceps in one flow.

name: 跳起侧向跳
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Jump straight up, swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly and immediately hop sideways to one side.
Land on both feet with soft knees and reset your balance.
Alternate the side of each hop and keep a steady rhythm.
description: A vertical jump followed by a hop to the side, building leg power and agility.

name: 站姿弯腰交替触脚尖
instructions: Stand tall with your feet wider than your hips and arms out to the sides.
Hinge forward and twist to reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return to standing with arms out.
Reach the other hand to the opposite foot.
Keep a flat back and move at a lively pace.
description: A quick standing toe touch where you reach to opposite feet in turn, warming up the hamstrings and midsection.

name: 负重杠铃片硬拉后撤弓步蹲转过头推举
english: weighted plate deadlift rear lunge with overhead press
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the plate toward your shins, then stand up.
Step one foot back into a reverse lunge as you press the plate overhead.
Return the foot and bring the plate back to your thighs.
Keep a flat back and repeat, alternating the lunging leg.
description: A plate flow that links a deadlift, a reverse lunge and an overhead press for a full body hit.

name: 地雷杆单臂借力推举
instructions: Stand facing the landmine end and hold it at your shoulder with one hand.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees.
Drive up with your legs and press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower the end back to your shoulder with control.
Keep your ribs down and brace your core. Finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm push press with a landmine, using leg drive to move the bar up and the shoulder to control it.

name: 时钟式高脚杯深蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and picture a clock on the floor around you.
Step to 12 o'clock and squat down with your chest up.
Stand up and return to the center.
Step to the next position on the clock and squat again.
Work your way around the clock with control and switch direction on the next set.
description: A goblet squat that steps around an imaginary clock, training the legs from several directions.

name: 壶铃侧向摆动
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulders and a kettlebell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing the bell up toward chest height, angled to one side.
Let it swing back down with a flat back.
Finish the reps on one side, then switch.
description: A kettlebell swing that travels to the side, adding rotation work for the obliques to the hip snap.

name: 波比跳转雪橇推
instructions: Stand behind a loaded sled and drop into a burpee, chest to the floor.
Jump up to your feet explosively.
Grab the sled handles with your arms extended and lean in.
Drive with short, powerful steps to push the sled for a set distance.
Return and repeat, keeping your back flat while pushing.
description: A conditioning move that pairs a burpee with a hard sled push for a tough full body effort.

name: 蝴蝶式后滚
instructions: Sit with the soles of your feet together and knees open.
Hold your feet or ankles.
Roll back slowly along your spine.
Roll forward to sit up again.
Repeat smoothly for 8 to 10 reps.
description: Rock back and forth on your spine with legs in a butterfly position. It massages the back and loosens the hips.

name: 杠铃半跪姿雷神上举
instructions: Kneel on one knee holding one end of a barbell in a landmine setup near your hip.
Brace your core and stay tall.
Lift the bar diagonally across your body and up toward the opposite shoulder.
Return the bar slowly to the start.
Keep your hips square. Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: A half kneeling barbell lift that sweeps the bar diagonally up, training the core to control rotation.

name: 哑铃肩部组合
instructions: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Do a set of lateral raises, then straight into front raises.
Move into a set of overhead presses without putting the weights down.
Lower the dumbbells under control and rest.
Keep the weights light and your torso still throughout.
description: A chained set of dumbbell shoulder moves done without rest, building shoulder strength and endurance.

name: 药球水平砸
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall or rebound surface holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Wind the ball slightly away from the target.
Rotate and throw the ball hard against the wall with both hands.
Catch it, reset your stance and go again.
Use your hips and keep your core tight. Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: An explosive sideways medicine ball slam that builds rotational power in the chest, core and shoulders.

name: 雪橇交替单腿离心推举
english: sled alternating single leg negative press
instructions: Sit in the sled with feet on the platform and release the safety.
Press the platform up with both legs and lock out gently.
Shift the load to one leg and lower it slowly for 3-4 seconds.
Press back up with both legs.
Alternate the lowering leg each rep and never let your lower back round.
description: A sled leg press done one leg at a time, with a slow lowering phase to build leg strength.

name: 哑铃交叉罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with a soft bend in the knees.
Push your hips back and lower the weights down your legs.
Reach one dumbbell across toward the opposite foot, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Alternate the crossing side each rep.
description: A Romanian deadlift where the dumbbells reach across the body, training the hamstrings and glutes.

name: 弹力带侧向卷腹
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and kneel or stand beside it.
Hold the band at your shoulder with the near hand.
Bend sideways toward your hip.
Return to upright under control.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: Crunch sideways against a band. It works the obliques.

name: 哑铃跪姿绕头旋转
instructions: Kneel tall holding a dumbbell by one end at chest level.
Circle the dumbbell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your ribs down and your hips still.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Do a few reps one way, then reverse direction.
description: A kneeling dumbbell halo that circles the weight around your head to warm up and mobilize the shoulders.

name: 弹力带站姿抬腿
instructions: Loop a band around your ankles or one ankle and anchor it.
Stand tall and hold a support if needed.
Lift one straight leg forward to hip height.
Lower slowly.
Complete reps, then switch legs.
description: Raise a leg forward against a band loop. It targets the hip flexors and front thigh.

name: 弹力带站姿后三角肌划船
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下。
双手握住弹力带手柄，手掌相对，双臂向前伸展。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将弹力带拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing rear delt row with a band, pulling the handles toward the chest. It trains the rear delts.

name: 弹力带直背直腿硬拉
english: band straight back stiff leg deadlift
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带绕在大腿上。
用双手将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲，铰接臀部并将弹力带降低到地面。
当你降低弹力带时，感受腿筋的拉伸。
启动臀肌和腿筋，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A stiff-leg deadlift with a band, hinging at the hips with a straight back. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 辅助单腿腿举
instructions: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking the knee.
Lower back with control.
Keep your hips on the seat. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A machine press done with one leg at a time, helping you build leg strength and fix imbalances.

name: 辅助站姿三头肌臂屈伸
instructions: Set the assistance and stand on the pad holding the handles.
Keep your elbows close and your chest up.
Lower your body by bending the elbows until they are at 90 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders and move smoothly.
description: A dip with machine assistance that lets you build triceps strength while handling less of your bodyweight.

name: 杠杆平行推胸
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height and sit back.
Grip the handles with your elbows slightly below shoulder level.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back against the pad.
description: A seated machine press with parallel handles, working the chest with a stable path.

name: 脚跟行走
instructions: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your toes and forefoot off the floor so you balance on your heels.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps.
Keep your toes pulled up the whole time.
Walk for 20-30 seconds, then rest.
description: Walking on your heels with the toes lifted, strengthening the shins and loosening the ankles.

name: 杠杆蝴蝶机夹胸
instructions: Sit on the pec deck with your back flat and the arms at chest level.
Place your forearms or hands on the pads with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze for a moment, then open slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
Keep your shoulders down and back.
description: A machine fly where the arms sweep together in front, isolating the chest.

name: 杠杆站姿髋伸展
instructions: Stand facing the machine and rest your hands on the support.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Push the leg back and slightly up by squeezing the glute.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright without arching your back. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A standing machine move that drives one leg back to work the glutes.

name: 杠杆交替二头弯举
instructions: Sit with your upper arms resting on the pad and grab the handles.
Curl one handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower it slowly while curling the other arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid swinging.
description: A machine curl done one arm at a time, so each biceps works independently.

name: 平板支撑跳入深蹲
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet forward, landing outside your hands in a wide squat.
Stand or hop up briefly if you like, then lower your hands.
Jump your feet back to the plank.
Keep a tight core and land softly.
description: A fast move from a plank to a squat jump position, raising the heart rate and training the legs and core.

name: 壶铃强力俄罗斯转体
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Rotate your torso to bring the bell beside one hip.
Rotate to the other side in a smooth motion.
Keep your chest lifted and feet raised for more challenge.
description: A seated Russian twist with a kettlebell, taking the weight side to side to work the obliques and abs.

name: 杠杆腰带保加利亚分腿蹲
instructions: Set up in the belt squat machine and place your back foot on the bench behind you.
Stand tall with the front foot far enough forward.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A split squat with your back foot raised, loaded through a belt machine to hit the quads and glutes.

name: 哑铃克罗克划船
instructions: Stand beside a bench with one hand and knee supported on it and hold a heavy dumbbell.
Let the weight hang with a stretch in the lat.
Row the dumbbell to your hip using controlled momentum.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your back flat. Finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: A heavy, high rep one-arm row with a little body momentum, great for lat and grip strength.

name: 杠杆三头肌伸展 v. 2
instructions: Sit and adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grab the handles with your elbows bent.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps for a second.
Return slowly without lifting your shoulders.
description: A seated machine extension that isolates the triceps through a stable path.

name: 哑铃鲍威尔侧举
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with the arm hanging in front of your body.
Raise the arm out and back in an arc until it is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Use a light weight and switch sides after your set.
description: A side-lying raise that targets the rear shoulder with a long range of motion.

name: 弹力带负重站姿旋前扭转弯举(掰手腕)
english: resistance band weighted standing pronation twist curl (arm wrestler)
instructions: Stand on a resistance band and hold the handle with your palm turned to the side.
Curl the handle up while rotating your wrist.
Finish with your palm facing you and the biceps squeezed.
Lower slowly and untwist back to the start.
Keep your elbow tucked. Finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: A curl that adds a forearm twist, mimicking arm wrestling to build the biceps and forearms.

name: 杠杆侧向髋外展
instructions: Stand next to the machine and place the outer side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Push your leg out to the side in a smooth motion.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A machine move that presses the leg out to the side, working the outer hips.

name: 超人式脉冲
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few inches.
Pulse them up and down in small movements.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lower and rest after your set.
description: Lie face down and lift arms and legs with small pulses. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.

name: 杠杆侧向髋内收
instructions: Stand next to the machine with the inner side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Pull your leg across your body, squeezing your inner thigh.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your hips level and avoid leaning. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A machine move that pulls the leg across the body, working the inner thighs.

name: 杠杆站姿抬腿
instructions: Stand facing the machine with your hands on the support.
Place the front of your thigh against the pad.
Raise your leg forward until the thigh is about parallel with the floor.
Lower slowly to the start.
Keep your torso tall. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A standing machine raise that lifts the leg forward to train the hip flexors and the front of the thigh.

name: 弹力带坐地胫骨前肌推
english: resistance band sitting floor tibialis press
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs out and loop a band around your foot, anchored in front.
Keep your leg straight and your heel on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shin against the band.
Hold briefly, then slowly release.
Do all reps on one foot, then switch.
description: A seated move that pulls the toes toward the shins against a band to strengthen the front of the lower leg.

name: 壶铃坐姿胫骨前肌推
instructions: Sit on a bench or box with a kettlebell hanging from the top of one foot.
Plant your heel on the floor.
Lift the toes up toward your shin to raise the kettlebell.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Use a light weight. Finish the reps, then switch feet.
description: A seated press that lifts a kettlebell on the top of the foot to strengthen the muscles at the front of the shin.

name: 杠杆站姿后踢
instructions: Stand facing the machine and hold the handles for support.
Place the back of your working leg against the pad.
Kick the leg back by squeezing the glute.
Pause at the top, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A standing machine kickback that squeezes the glutes as you press the leg behind you.

name: 杠杆椅式深蹲
instructions: Position yourself in the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Bend your knees and sit back and down.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
description: A machine squat performed with a chair-like support, a stable way to train the legs.

name: 负重沙袋硬拉
instructions: Stand over a sandbag with feet hip width apart.
Hinge at your hips, bend your knees and grip the bag.
Brace your core and drive through your feet to stand tall with the bag.
Push your hips back and lower the bag to the floor.
Keep your back flat throughout.
description: A deadlift with a sandbag, building hip and back strength with an awkward, grippy load.

name: 负重沙袋深蹲
instructions: Hold a sandbag in a bear hug against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat with your chest up.
