Drive through your heels to stand up.
Keep the bag tight to your body.
description: A squat holding a sandbag against the chest, training the legs and the core.

name: 负重沙袋上肩
instructions: Stand over a sandbag and grip it firmly with both hands.
Lift the bag, driving through your legs and hips.
Pull it to your lap, then heave it up onto one shoulder.
Lower it to the floor with control.
Alternate shoulders each rep.
description: A lift that heaves the sandbag from the floor up onto your shoulder, building power and total body strength.

name: 负重沙袋负重行走(扛肩)
instructions: Lift the sandbag onto your shoulders and hold it there.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady, controlled steps.
Keep your ribs stacked over your hips.
Carry for a set distance or time, then set the bag down carefully.
description: A walking carry with a sandbag across the shoulders, building posture and trunk strength.

name: 负重沙袋负重行走(熊抱)
instructions: Lift the sandbag and hug it against your chest.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady steps.
Keep your arms squeezing the bag tight.
Carry for a set distance or time, then lower the bag with care.
description: A walking carry with a sandbag held to the chest, taxing the core, arms and grip.

name: 负重沙袋军事推举
instructions: Hold a sandbag at your upper chest or shoulders.
Stand with feet hip width apart and brace your core.
Press the bag straight overhead.
Lock out the arms, then lower the bag with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.
description: A standing overhead press using a sandbag, which shifts as you push, so your shoulders and core must stay tight.

name: 负重沙袋划船
instructions: Stand over a sandbag, hinge forward and grab it with both hands.
Keep your back flat and knees slightly bent.
Row the bag toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly back to full arm extension.
description: A bent-over row with a sandbag, training the back and grip.

name: 杠杆全蹲
instructions: Step into the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Squat as deep as you comfortably can.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and knees over your toes.
description: A full range machine squat that builds the thighs and glutes with a guided path.

name: 杠杆手枪式深蹲
instructions: Step into the machine and put one foot on the platform with the other leg lifted or extended.
Brace your core and release the safety.
Lower slowly into a deep squat on one leg.
Press through your heel to stand.
Keep your knee in line with your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A single leg squat on a machine that supports balance while you load one leg through full depth.

name: 杠杆仰卧推胸(挂片式)
instructions: Lie back on the machine bench and grip the handles at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulders pulled back.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back on the pad throughout.
description: A plate-loaded press from a lying position, working the chest with a guided path.

name: 钢制重锤深蹲(负重)
instructions: Rest the mace on your shoulders and hold it with both hands.
Stand with feet about shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
description: A squat holding a steel mace across the shoulders or upper back. It builds leg strength and a braced trunk.

name: 钢制重锤绕头(负重)
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and hold the mace upright near your chest.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Circle the mace around your head in a smooth, controlled arc.
Keep your elbows close and your head still.
Do all reps, then reverse the direction.
description: Circle a steel mace around your head while standing tall. It trains shoulder control and stability under an awkward load.

name: 负重仰卧颈伸展
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on the back of your head.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Slowly lift your head until your neck is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and the motion smooth.
description: Lying face down, you lift your head against a light load. It strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck.

name: 沙袋过肩抛(负重)
instructions: Stand over the sandbag with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge down, grip the bag and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bag up the front of your body.
Extend fully and throw the bag back over your shoulder.
Reset and repeat, facing the same way.
description: Explosively hinge and heave a sandbag backwards over your shoulder. It trains hip power and full body force.

name: 负重仰卧颈屈曲
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on your forehead.
Hold the weight with a hand for control.
Slowly curl your head up, tucking your chin.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and avoid jerking.
description: Lying on your back, you lift your head against a light load. It strengthens the muscles at the front of the neck.

name: 绳索单臂低位划船(用绳)
english: cable single arm low row (with rope)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and sit facing the stack with your feet braced.
Hold the rope in one hand with your arm extended.
Pull your elbow back along your side, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Pause, then let the arm extend slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A one-armed seated row with a rope handle on a low pulley. It works the lats and upper back one side at a time.

name: 交替死悬
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder width apart.
Hang with your arms long and your body relaxed.
Shift your weight toward one hand, letting that side stretch.
Shift to the other side and keep alternating.
Hold the hang for 20-30 seconds in total.
description: Hang from a bar and shift your weight from side to side. It decompresses the shoulders and stretches the lats.

name: 双绳攀爬
instructions: Grab one rope in each hand and hang with arms long.
Pull up with one arm while you bend your elbow close to your body.
Reach higher with the other hand and pull again.
Keep your core tight and your legs steady.
Climb to a safe height, then lower under control.
description: Climb up using two ropes, pulling with your arms one hand over the other. It builds a strong pull and grip.

name: 杠铃片捏握
instructions: Pick up two smooth plates and stack them with the smooth sides facing out.
Pinch them together with your fingertips and thumb.
Stand tall with your arm hanging by your side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without letting the plates slip.
Switch hands and repeat.
description: Pinch a weight plate between your fingers and thumb and hold it. It builds finger and thumb grip strength.

name: 杠铃坐姿军事推举(深蹲架内)
english: barbell seated military press (inside squat cage)
instructions: Set a bench inside the cage and the bar at shoulder height.
Sit tall, grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack it.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are extended.
Lower it to your upper chest with control.
Keep your ribs down and your back against the pad.
description: A seated overhead press performed inside a squat cage so the rack gives you safe bar positions. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.

name: 绳索抬高划船
instructions: Set a cable handle at about head height and take a stable stance.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly with arms extended.
Pull toward your upper chest, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A cable row where the handle sits higher than usual, pulled toward your upper chest. It targets the upper back.

name: 椅上坐姿腘绳肌拉伸
english: seated hamstring stretch on a chair
instructions: Sit near the front edge of a chair.
Extend one leg straight with your heel on the floor and toes up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Switch legs and repeat.
description: A gentle seated stretch for the back of the thigh, done on a chair. It helps loosen tight hamstrings.

name: 椅上坐姿夹肩胛胸部拉伸
english: seated squeeze shoulder blades chest stretch on a chair
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Reach your hands behind you and clasp them or hold the chair back.
Pull your shoulder blades together and lift your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without arching your lower back.
Relax and repeat.
description: Sit on a chair and squeeze your shoulder blades together to open the chest. It eases tight pecs from desk posture.

name: 绳索窄握前高位下拉
english: cable close grip front lat pulldown
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a close grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and squeeze your lats.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A lat pulldown with a narrow grip, pulling the bar to your upper chest. It trains the lats and biceps.

name: 哑铃俯卧单臂后侧平举 v. 2
english: dumbbell lying one arm rear lateral raise v. 2
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with your arm hanging in front of you, slight bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up until it is about shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: Lying on your side on a bench, you raise a dumbbell out to the side. It isolates the rear shoulder.

name: 单腿后踢(凳子支撑)
instructions: Place your hands on a bench and step back into a hinged position.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up, squeezing your glute.
Lower without letting your hips rotate.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: Support yourself on a bench and kick one leg back and up. It works the glutes without any equipment.

name: 史密斯机提踵(垫块)
instructions: Place a block under the Smith bar and rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with the balls of your feet on the block.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
description: A standing calf raise under the Smith bar with the balls of your feet on a block. The block lets you stretch deeper.

name: 绳索反握窄距高位下拉
english: cable reverse narrow grip lat pulldown
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs.
Grab the bar with a narrow underhand grip.
Lean back a little and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Return slowly until your arms are fully extended.
description: A lat pulldown with an underhand, narrow grip. It uses the biceps more and works the lower lats.

name: 猫式拉伸
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Tuck your chin and round your back toward the ceiling.
Draw your belly button in and hold for a few breaths.
Return to a neutral spine.
Repeat slowly, holding the rounded position 15-20 seconds.
description: A gentle spinal stretch on hands and knees, rounding the back like a cat. It loosens the spine.

name: 站姿单腿髋部画圈(椅子支撑)
english: standing single leg hip swirl with chair support
instructions: Stand beside a chair and hold it for balance.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw slow, controlled circles with your leg.
Do half of the reps one way, then reverse the direction.
Switch legs and repeat.
description: Hold a chair and swirl one leg in circles. It loosens the hip joint and warms up the glutes.

name: 固定杆背部拉伸
instructions: Grip a fixed bar or post at about hip height.
Step back until your arms are straight.
Sink your hips back and let your chest drop.
Feel the stretch along your back and sides.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
description: Hold a fixed bar and sit your hips back to stretch your back and lats. It opens the upper body.

name: 跪姿髋屈肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze your back glute.
Shift your hips forward gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping your torso tall.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: A lunge-style stretch on one knee that lengthens the front of the hip. It helps with tightness from sitting.

name: 坐姿单腿屈膝
instructions: Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Slide one foot back under the chair, bending the knee.
Pause briefly at the end of the range.
Return the foot slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: Sitting down, you bend one knee by sliding your heel back. It is a gentle way to build knee mobility and hamstring control.

name: 坐姿单腿胫骨前肌推
instructions: Sit with one foot resting flat and the other leg crossed over it.
Hook the toes of the lower foot under your other foot for light resistance.
Lift the toes and forefoot up toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.
description: Press the top of your foot upward against resistance while seated. It strengthens the shin muscle.

name: 弹力带站姿单腿伸膝
english: resistance band standing single leg knee extension
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around one ankle or behind the knee.
Stand tall and hold on for balance if needed.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Pause with the leg extended.
Bend slowly back, then switch legs after your reps.
description: Standing on one leg with a band behind the knee, you straighten the other knee. It builds quad strength with gentle load.

name: 坐姿单腿伸膝
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Slowly straighten one knee to lift your foot.
Squeeze your thigh at the top for a second.
Lower the foot back to the floor with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: Seated on a chair, you straighten one knee to lift your foot. A gentle move that wakes up the thigh.

name: 坐姿单腿伸膝 v. 2
english: seated single leg knee extension v. 2
instructions: Sit tall on a chair, holding the seat edge for support.
Straighten one knee until the leg is level.
Hold for a second, tightening your thigh.
Lower slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A variation of the seated knee extension. It builds thigh strength with a small, controlled range.

name: 负重坐姿单腿伸膝 v. 2
english: weighted seated single leg knee extension v. 2
instructions: Strap a light ankle weight on and sit tall on a chair.
Hold the seat edge for support.
Straighten the knee until your leg is level.
Hold for a second and squeeze your thigh.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your reps.
description: A seated knee extension with a light weight on the ankle. It adds load to build thigh strength.

name: 弓步直腿小腿拉伸
instructions: Step into a lunge with hands on a wall or knee.
Keep the back leg straight with heel down.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch.
Keep your foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Lunge forward with the back leg straight to stretch the calf. It improves ankle mobility.

name: 仰卧屈膝胫骨前肌推
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Slide one foot under the other for light resistance.
Lift the toes of the lower foot toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.
description: Lying on your back with knees bent, you press your foot toward your shin. It targets the front of the lower leg.

name: 坐姿单腿抱膝屈膝
english: seated single leg hugging knee flexion
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Lift one knee and clasp your hands around the shin.
Gently pull the knee toward your chest and flex it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: Seated, you hug one knee toward your chest and bend it. It mobilizes the hip and knee gently.

name: 坐姿单腿抱膝屈膝(用毛巾)
english: seated single leg hugging knee flexion with towel
instructions: Sit tall on a chair and loop a towel around one shin.
Hold the towel ends with both hands.
Pull the knee gently toward your chest, bending it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: The same hugging knee flexion, using a towel around the shin to help. It adds a gentle assisted bend.

name: 跪姿屈膝(椅子支撑)
instructions: Hold the back of a chair and kneel on one knee on a soft surface.
Keep your torso upright.
Slowly sit back toward your heel to bend the knee.
Stay within a comfortable range.
Return to the start and switch sides after your reps.
description: Kneeling beside a chair for support, you gently bend the knee. It builds comfortable knee range of motion.

name: 站姿单腿小腿摇摆
instructions: Stand on one leg next to a wall for balance.
Rock your weight back onto your heel, lifting the toes.
Roll forward onto the ball of your foot.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: Balance on one leg and rock between heel and toes. It warms up the calf and ankle.

name: 站姿单腿集中提踵
english: standing single leg concentration calf raise
instructions: Stand on one leg and hold a wall or rail lightly.
Lower your heel slightly for a stretch.
Rise high onto your toes, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-legged calf raise performed slowly with full focus. It builds calf strength and ankle control.

name: 抬高单腿臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot raised on a bench or step.
Extend the other leg straight up.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg glute bridge with your feet raised. It strongly works the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 地面仰卧斯文推举
instructions: Lie on your back holding a plate between your palms at your chest.
Squeeze the plate firmly.
Press it straight up until your arms are extended.
Keep squeezing as you lower it back to your chest.
Repeat with steady control.
description: Press a plate out from your chest while lying on the floor, squeezing it with both hands. It targets the inner chest.

name: 深蹲灵活性练习
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders.
Squat down as deep as is comfortable.
Press your elbows against your knees and keep your chest up.
Rock gently side to side.
Stay for 20-30 seconds, then stand.
description: A deep squat hold with gentle movements. It opens up the hips and ankles.

name: 药球分腿站姿躯干扭转
english: medicine ball split stance torso twist
instructions: Stand in a split stance and hold a medicine ball at chest height.
Brace your core.
Rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips steady.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Complete all reps, then switch the front foot.
description: Rotate your torso side to side with a medicine ball in a split stance. It trains the trunk rotators.

name: 弹力带过头击打
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and hold the handles with both hands.
Stand with a staggered stance and your arms raised.
Pull the handles down and forward in a controlled hit.
Brace your core as you finish.
Return slowly and repeat.
description: Swing a resistance band from overhead down in front of you in a chopping motion. It builds powerful chest and core strength.

name: 平板支撑交替拍球
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with a ball in front of you.
Tighten your core and glutes.
Lift one hand and tap the ball.
Return the hand and tap with the other.
Keep your hips as still as possible.
description: From a plank, tap a ball with alternating hands. It challenges your core to stay stable.

name: 椅上坐姿颈屈曲到伸展
english: seated neck flexion to extension on chair
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Gently lift your head and look slightly upward.
Keep the motion smooth and pain free.
Repeat for several slow reps.
description: Seated, you slowly nod your head forward and back. It loosens the neck.

name: 椅上坐姿颈左右扭转
english: seated side to side neck twist on chair
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Turn to the other side.
Repeat for several slow reps.
description: Seated, you turn your head from side to side. It restores easy neck rotation.

name: 椅上坐姿颈左右侧屈
english: seated side to side neck bend on chair
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head so your ear moves toward one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Tilt toward the other shoulder.
Repeat for several slow reps.
description: Seated, you tilt your ear toward each shoulder. It eases side neck tightness.

name: 药球仰卧起坐砸地
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Sit up in one motion, bringing the ball forward.
Slam the ball down in front of your feet.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up.
Lie back with control and repeat.
description: Sit up while raising a medicine ball overhead and slam it down. It combines a crunch with power.

name: 哑铃全程前平举接住
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Raise it straight up in front of you to overhead.
Control it at the top and keep your core braced.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a moderate weight and avoid arching your back.
description: Raise a dumbbell in front of you all the way overhead and catch it with control. It trains the front shoulder.

name: 仰卧臀部拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom leg toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Pull a knee toward your chest while lying down. It releases the glutes.

name: 杠铃卧推接住
instructions: Lie on a bench with a spotter or safety pins set.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chest under control.
Stop it just above the chest and press up.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades pinched.
description: A bench press where you lower the bar and catch it quickly before pressing. It trains chest strength and control.

name: 壶铃单腿硬拉传递
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Hinge at the hips and reach the bell toward the floor.
Pass the bell to the other hand below your knee.
Stand back up using your glute and hamstring.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg deadlift where you pass a kettlebell from hand to hand. It trains balance and the hip hinge.

name: 壶铃同侧后撤弓步蹲高抬膝
english: kettlebell ipsilateral reverse lunge high knee
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Step back with the leg on the same side as the bell.
Lower into a lunge.
Drive up and lift that knee high as you stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A reverse lunge holding a kettlebell on the same side as the working leg, ending with a high knee. It trains balance and leg drive.

name: 膝碰箱小腿拉伸
instructions: Place a foot flat a short distance from a box or step.
Keep your heel down.
Push your knee forward to touch the box.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a calf stretch.
Switch legs and repeat.
description: Press one knee forward toward a box with your foot flat to stretch the calf. It improves ankle flexibility.

name: 坐姿足旋前旋后
instructions: Sit on a chair with one foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Roll the sole of your foot inward.
Roll it outward as far as is comfortable.
Keep the lower leg still.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.
description: Seated, you roll the foot inward and outward. It mobilizes the ankle and foot.

name: 90度对90度推举拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front, one to the side.
Sit tall.
Hinge forward over the front shin with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Sit in a 90-degree hip position and press forward to stretch the glutes and hips. It improves hip rotation.

name: 半跪姿躯干扭转
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Hold your arms crossed in front of your chest.
Rotate your upper body toward the front leg.
Return to the centre and keep your hips square.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: From a half-kneeling stance, rotate your torso. It opens the spine and warms up the trunk.

name: 站姿单臂胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a wall or door frame.
Place your forearm or hand on the wall at shoulder height.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms and repeat.
description: Place one arm against a wall and turn away to open the chest. It eases tight pecs.

name: 杠铃仰卧前平举
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a barbell at arm's length over your thighs.
Keep your arms straight with a soft elbow.
Raise the bar in an arc until it is above your chest.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a light weight and keep your back flat.
description: Lying on a bench, you raise a barbell from your thighs to above your chest. It builds the front shoulder.

name: 木棍仰卧前平举
instructions: Lie on your back holding a stick with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the stick overhead as far as is comfortable.
Return to your thighs slowly.
Keep your ribs down throughout.
description: Lying on your back, raise a light stick from your hips to overhead. It helps shoulder mobility.

name: 站姿股四头肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and hold something for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle.
Pull your heel toward your glute, knees together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.
description: Pull your heel toward your glute while standing to stretch the front of the thigh. It is a classic quad stretch.

name: 手走式背阔肌拉伸
instructions: Stand and hinge forward to place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out in front of you.
Sit your hips back and press your chest down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Walk your hands back in and stand up.
description: Walk your hands out and sit your hips back to stretch the lats. It opens the sides of the back.

name: 弹力带坐姿单腿抱膝屈膝
english: resistance band seated single leg hugging knee flexion
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with a band around one foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Pull the knee up and bend it toward your chest.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: Seated knee flexion with a band under your foot, hugging one knee. It adds resistance to the bend.

name: 半跪姿腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended, heel on the floor.
Keep your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.
description: From half kneeling, straighten the front leg and lean forward to stretch the hamstring. It lengthens the back of the thigh.

name: 上斜开合跳平板支撑
instructions: Place your hands on a bench in an incline plank.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Jump your feet wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and the pace steady.
description: A plank with hands on a raised surface, jumping your feet in and out like a jumping jack. It builds core and gets the heart rate up.

name: 弹力带侧向击打
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height beside you and hold the handle at your chest.
Stand tall in a stable stance with your core braced.
Press the handle forward and across your body in a quick controlled motion.
Return slowly to your chest without letting the band pull you around.
Keep your hips square throughout.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A standing band press that sweeps across the body from the side. It builds chest power and trains the trunk to resist rotation.

name: 药球上拉接住
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Pull the ball forward over your chest to throw it up toward a partner or wall.
Catch the ball with soft elbows as it returns.
Let it travel back overhead in a controlled arc.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Repeat at a steady rhythm.
description: A lying throw and catch that sends a medicine ball overhead and back. It trains explosive lat and core strength.

name: 绳索90度内旋接住
instructions: Set the cable at shoulder height and stand sideways to it.
Raise your upper arm out to the side with the elbow bent 90 degrees.
Let the cable pull your forearm back into external rotation.
Catch it, then rotate the forearm forward and down smoothly.
Keep your upper arm still and level.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.
description: A cable drill with the upper arm at shoulder height and elbow bent to 90 degrees. It trains the rotator cuff to catch and control a quick rotation.

name: 药球仰卧地面窄距推举接住
english: medicine ball lying floor close press catch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball above your chest.
Press the ball up quickly with your hands close together.
Catch it as it comes down with soft elbows.
Lower it to just above your chest.
Keep your back flat and ribs down.
Repeat for controlled, crisp reps.
description: A floor press throw with narrow hands. It builds explosive pushing power through the chest and triceps.

name: 杠铃臀推
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet hip-width apart and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and keep your chin tucked.
Lower your hips under control.
Repeat without arching your lower back.
description: A bench-supported bridge with a barbell across your hips. It is a go-to move for building strong glutes.

name: 杠铃单腿臀推
instructions: Set your upper back on a bench with a padded barbell over your hips.
Extend one leg or hold it bent in the air.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top without twisting.
Lower under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg version of the barbell hip thrust that demands more balance and glute strength on each side.

name: 负重单腿臀推
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench and place the weight on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg off the floor.
Push through your heel to raise your hips until your torso is level.
Pause and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly.
Complete the reps, then change legs.
description: A single-leg hip thrust with weight resting on your hips. It strengthens each glute separately and fixes side-to-side gaps.

name: 杠铃相扑深蹲
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet well wider than your shoulders.
Turn your toes out about 30 degrees.
Brace your core and sit down between your legs.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Descend to thigh level or lower, then push through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.
description: A wide-stance squat with a barbell on your back. It hits the glutes and inner thighs along with the quads.

name: 臀腿伸展机全程仰卧起坐
english: glute ham developer full sit up
instructions: Lock your feet in the machine and sit with your hips on the pad.
Lean back until your torso is in line with or just below your hips.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl up until your chest reaches your thighs.
Lower back slowly with a braced core.
Avoid yanking on your neck.
description: A full-range sit-up on a glute ham developer. The extended range makes the abs and hip flexors work through a long path.

name: 相扑深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
Hold your hands together at your chest.
Sit your hips down and back between your legs.
Keep your knees over your toes and chest upright.
Lower to thigh level.
Push through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.
description: A bodyweight squat in a wide stance with toes turned out. It targets the glutes and inner thighs.

name: 杠杆上斜俯卧划船
instructions: Lie chest-down on the incline pad and grab the handles.
Let your arms extend fully.
Pull the handles back, driving your elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your head neutral.
description: A chest-supported row on an incline lever machine. The support keeps your back steady so the upper back does the work.

name: 仰卧抬髋(稳定球)
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels resting on the stability ball.
Press your arms into the floor for support.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower your hips under control.
Keep the ball steady throughout.
description: A glute bridge with your feet or upper back on a stability ball. The unstable surface adds a balance challenge.

name: 弹力带爆发式俯卧撑
instructions: Loop the band across your upper back and hold the ends under your palms.
Set up in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest to the floor with control.
Push up hard so your hands briefly leave the floor.
Land softly with elbows slightly bent.
Keep your hips in line.
description: A push-up with a band across your back and a fast push at the top. It trains explosive chest and triceps power.

name: 弹力带站在波速球上单腿外展
english: band standing on bosu ball single leg abduction
instructions: Place a band around your ankles and stand on the bosu with one foot.
Hold your core tight and stay tall.
Lift your free leg out to the side against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Return slowly without leaning.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A standing hip abduction on a bosu ball against band tension. It works the outer hip and challenges your balance.

name: 普拉提器械仰卧踮脚伸膝
english: pilates machine lying knee extension on toes
instructions: Lie on the carriage with feet on the bar, on your toes.
Bend your knees with a neutral spine.
Press the carriage away until legs straighten.
Return under control.
Keep your hips still.
description: Straighten your knees on a reformer with feet on toes. It trains the front thighs.

name: 普拉提器械仰卧伸膝
instructions: Lie on the carriage with feet on the bar.
Bend your knees.
Press out until legs are straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your lower back stable.
description: Straighten your knees on a reformer with feet flat. It trains the front thighs.

name: 普拉提器械仰卧脚跟伸膝
english: pilates machine lying knee extension on heels
instructions: Lie on the carriage with heels on the bar.
Bend your knees.
Press out through the heels until straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your hips level.
description: Straighten your knees on a reformer pressing through the heels. It works the thighs.

name: 普拉提器械仰卧提踵
instructions: Lie on the carriage with legs straight, balls of feet on the bar.
Press your heels down.
Rise up onto your toes.
Return slowly.
Keep your knees locked softly.
description: Press the carriage with just your toes on a reformer. It builds calf strength.

name: 普拉提器械百次拍击
instructions: Lie on the carriage holding the straps.
Lift your head and legs.
Pump your arms in small movements.
Breathe in for five counts and out for five.
Continue for 100 pumps.
description: Pump your arms against the straps while holding your legs up. It builds core endurance.

name: 弹力带辅助单臂引体向上
english: resistance band assisted single arm pull up
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and place your foot or knee in it.
Hang with one hand on the bar and the other holding your wrist or the band.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving the elbow down.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control to a full hang.
Switch arms after each set.
description: A one-arm pull-up with a band under your foot or knee to reduce the load. It builds toward unassisted single-arm pulling.

name: 吊环弹力带辅助单臂引体向上
english: ring resistance band assisted single arm pull up
instructions: Hang a band from the rings or bar and place your foot in it.
Grip one ring with one hand and hold the other ring loosely or let it go.
Pull your chest toward the ring.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Repeat, then switch sides.
description: A band-assisted single-arm pull-up on gymnastic rings. The rings add instability and grip demand.

name: 吊环洛奇引体下拉
instructions: Hang from the rings with arms straight and shoulders engaged.
Pull your chest up toward the rings.
At the top, drive the rings down toward your hips.
Pause with your arms close to your sides.
Return to the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your core braced.
description: A ring pull-up variation where you pull up, then press down toward the hips. It builds pulling strength and shoulder control.

name: 吊环后翻
instructions: Hang from the rings with a firm grip.
Tuck your knees and lift your hips overhead.
Rotate backward, passing your legs between your arms.
Lower your feet toward the floor until you stretch your shoulders.
Pause, then reverse the motion with control.
Move slowly and stop if you feel pinching.
description: A gymnastic move where you rotate backward through the rings. It builds shoulder mobility and control.

name: 平板撑推举
instructions: Start in a deep planche lean with hands under your shoulders.
Protract your shoulders and squeeze your glutes.
Lean forward and lift your feet from the floor.
Press into the ground and hold the position.
Lower under control.
Warm up your wrists first.
description: An advanced gymnastics skill where you press from a lean into a planche shape. It builds shoulder strength and a strong core.

name: 肘支撑planche
instructions: Place your hands on the floor and tuck your elbows into your waist.
Lean forward over your hands.
Lift your feet off the floor one at a time.
Hold your body level with a tight core.
Keep your shoulders pressed forward.
Lower down after the hold.
description: A planche hold with your elbows tucked into your waist. It is an early step toward a full planche.

name: 绳索跪姿单臂水平划船
english: cable kneeling single arm horizontal row
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and kneel facing it.
Hold the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back along your side.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Extend the arm slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm cable row from a kneeling position. Kneeling removes leg drive so your back does the pulling.

name: 弹力带跪姿单臂水平划船
english: band kneeling single arm horizontal row
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and kneel facing it.
Hold the band with one hand and keep your torso upright.
Pull the elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade in.
Return slowly against the tension.
Switch arms after the set.
description: A one-arm band row from a kneeling position. It builds the lats and mid back with simple equipment.

name: 杠杆配重片坐姿上斜推胸
english: lever stack seated incline chest press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at upper-chest height.
Sit back with your feet flat and shoulder blades pinched.
Press the handles forward and up until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly to a stretch across your chest.
Keep your back against the pad.
description: A seated press on an incline lever machine with a weight stack. It emphasises the upper chest.

name: 绳索直臂下拉 v. 3
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley and grip the bar.
Hinge slightly forward.
Pull the bar down to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly.
description: Pull a cable down with straight arms. It isolates the lats.

name: 杠杆配重片坐姿上斜单臂推胸
english: lever stack seated incline single arm chest press
instructions: Sit on the machine and grab one handle at upper-chest height.
Brace your core to avoid twisting.
Press the handle forward and up.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your shoulder pulled back.
Do all reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm incline press on a lever machine. Working one side at a time evens out strength differences.

name: 杠杆配重片坐姿推胸
instructions: Set the seat so the handles are level with your mid chest.
Sit back and pull your shoulder blades together.
Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause without locking out.
Return slowly to a gentle chest stretch.
Keep your feet flat.
description: A seated machine press with a weight stack. It is a stable way to build the chest and triceps.

name: 杠杆配重片坐姿单臂推胸
english: lever stack seated single arm chest press
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and grip one handle.
Brace your core and keep your torso square.
Press the handle forward in a smooth line.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your shoulder down.
Do the reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm seated press on a lever machine. It builds the chest on each side and trains the core to resist twisting.

name: 壶铃深蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back while keeping your chest tall.
Lower until your thighs are parallel or lower.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
description: A squat holding a kettlebell at your chest. The weight in front helps you stay upright and use your legs.

name: 壶铃后背深蹲
instructions: Hold the kettlebell behind your neck on your upper back with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and sit down and back.
Lower to parallel while keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows pointing down.
description: A squat with a kettlebell held across your upper back. It loads the legs and challenges your trunk.

name: 地雷杆深蹲跳
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest.
Jump up explosively through your feet.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.
description: A squat holding a landmine bar at your chest, followed by a jump. It builds explosive leg power.

name: 负重背包行走
instructions: Put on a backpack and tighten the straps snug.
Stand tall with your shoulders back.
Walk at a steady pace on flat ground.
Take natural strides and breathe evenly.
Keep your core lightly braced.
Walk for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.
description: Walking with a loaded backpack to add resistance. It builds leg endurance and trunk strength.

name: 负重背包跑步
instructions: Strap a snug backpack with a modest load on your back.
Start with an easy jog on flat ground.
Keep your torso tall and your steps light.
Maintain a pace where you can breathe steadily.
Cut back the load if your form suffers.
Run for 10-20 minutes.
description: Running with a loaded backpack to raise the effort. It builds endurance and leg strength.

name: 绳索后踢 v. 3
instructions: Hinge forward and hold a handle with elbow bent.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend your arm back.
Squeeze the triceps.
Return slowly and switch sides.
description: Extend your arm back against cable resistance. It isolates the triceps.

name: 绳索转体 v. 3
instructions: Stand sideways to the pulley and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the stack.
Return slowly.
Switch sides.
description: Rotate your torso against a cable. It works the obliques.

name: 悬挂带手臂弯举
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Bend your elbows to pull yourself up.
Squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly.
description: Curl yourself toward the straps while leaning back. It works the biceps.

name: 悬挂带屈膝反向划船
instructions: Lie under the straps and grip the handles.
Bend your knees with feet flat.
Lift your hips and pull your chest toward the handles.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
description: Row yourself up under straps with knees bent. It builds the back.

name: 杠铃片仰卧卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Hold the plate on your chest.
Curl your shoulders up.
Pause and squeeze.
Lower slowly.
description: Crunch while holding a plate. It works the abs.

name: 悬挂带胸部臂屈伸
instructions: Support yourself on the straps with arms straight.
Lean slightly forward.
Lower until elbows reach 90 degrees.
Press back up.
Keep the straps steady.
description: Dip between straps. It works the chest and triceps.

name: 水中单车
instructions: Stand in chest-deep water, holding the pool edge.
Lift your knees alternately.
Pedal at a steady rhythm.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for several minutes.
description: Pedal your legs in the water as if cycling. It raises your heart rate with low impact.

name: 悬挂带推胸
instructions: Face away from the anchor and hold the handles at chest level.
Lean forward in a straight line.
Press your body away.
Squeeze the chest.
Return slowly.
description: Press yourself away from the straps. It works the chest.

name: 负重沙袋罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions: Hold a sandbag in front of your thighs with a firm grip.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the bag down your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your back flat.
description: A hip hinge with a sandbag held in front of your thighs. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.

name: L坐绳攀爬
instructions: Grip the rope and hang with your legs raised in front of you.
Keep your legs straight and together.
Pull with one hand over the other while staying in the L position.
Reach up and repeat.
Lower under control.
Stop if your legs drop.
description: A rope climb done with your legs held out in an L shape. It is a tough test for the lats, grip and abs.

name: 跳箱左右侧跳
english: side to side jump over stepbox
instructions: Stand beside a low box with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms.
Jump sideways over the box.
Land softly on both feet.
Jump back the other way at once.
Keep the pace fast but controlled.
description: A lateral jump back and forth over a step box. It builds agility and leg power.

name: 平衡板单腿平衡
instructions: Place a balance board on a flat floor next to a wall for safety.
Step on with one foot and find your centre.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Hold steady for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your hips level.
Switch legs.
description: A single-leg stand on a balance board. It trains ankle stability and control.

name: 平衡垫单腿平衡
instructions: Place the pad on a flat floor.
Step on with one foot and stand tall.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your eyes on a fixed point.
Switch legs.
description: A one-legged stand on a foam balance pad. It improves ankle stability and body control.

name: 悬垂交替抬膝
instructions: Hang from a bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Lower it slowly and lift the other knee.
Avoid swinging.
Alternate for the reps.
description: A hanging ab move where you lift one knee at a time. It strengthens the lower abs and hip flexors.

name: 撞头
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands behind your head.
Soften your knees.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Nod your head slightly and return to standing.
Move at a smooth pace.
Keep your neck relaxed.
description: A gentle bending drill that works the back and hips. The motion loosens your spine and posterior chain.

name: 穿臂跳箱
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Jump onto the box, driving your arms through.
Land softly with both feet.
Stand tall at the top.
Step down and reset.
description: A box jump with a swing-through arm action. It builds explosive power and coordination.

name: 仰卧单臂三头肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Raise one arm and bend the elbow, hand reaching behind your head.
Use your other hand to press the elbow gently toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your ribs down.
Switch arms.
description: A floor stretch for the back of your upper arm. Lying down lets you relax into it.

name: 悬挂带飞鸟
instructions: Face away from the anchor, hands at chest level.
Lean forward with arms together.
Open your arms wide.
Pull back together.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
description: Open your arms wide against the straps. It stretches and works the chest.

name: 木棍仰卧单臂三头肌拉伸
english: stick lying single arm triceps stretch
instructions: Lie on your back holding a stick in both hands.
Bend one arm and take that hand behind your head.
Use the other hand to push the stick and press that elbow down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Switch arms.
description: A triceps stretch on the floor using a stick to deepen the stretch. It opens the back of your upper arm and shoulder.

name: 弹力带站姿单臂三头肌拉伸
english: resistance band standing single arm triceps stretch
instructions: Stand tall and hold a band behind your back with one hand low.
Raise the other arm overhead and bend the elbow, holding the band.
Gently pull down with the lower hand.
Feel a stretch in the back of the upper arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms.
description: A standing triceps stretch with a band assisting. The band helps you ease into a deeper stretch.

name: 仰卧单臂从Y滑到T
english: lying single arm slide from y to t
instructions: Lie face down with your arms overhead in a Y.
Lift one arm slightly off the floor.
Slide it out and down into a T position.
Hold for a moment.
Slide it back to the Y.
Switch arms after each set.
description: A prone shoulder drill where one arm slides from a Y shape to a T shape. It wakes up the mid back and shoulder blades.

name: 跪姿跳箱
instructions: Kneel in front of a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and drive your hips forward.
Pop up from your knees onto your feet.
Jump onto the box in one motion.
Land softly and stand tall.
Step down and reset.
description: An explosive move that goes from kneeling straight into a box jump. It trains hip drive and power.

name: 弹力带坐姿单腿腘绳肌拉伸
english: resistance band seated single leg hamstring stretch
instructions: Sit tall with one leg extended and a band around that foot.
Hold the band ends in both hands.
Keep your leg straight and gently pull your toes toward you.
Hinge forward until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.
description: A seated hamstring stretch with a band around your foot. The band lets you control the pull.

name: 坐姿单腿半圆
instructions: Sit tall on the floor with hands behind you for support.
Lift one leg slightly with the knee straight.
Draw a half circle with your foot from one side to the other.
Keep your torso steady.
Repeat for the reps.
Switch legs.
description: A seated hip mobility drill where you sweep one leg in a half circle. It warms up the hips.

name: 弹力带坐姿单腿伸膝
english: resistance band seated single leg knee extension
instructions: Sit on a bench and secure a band around one ankle.
Anchor the other end behind you.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Squeeze the front of your thigh at the top.
Lower slowly.
Switch legs.
description: A seated knee extension against band tension. It isolates the quads one leg at a time.

name: 快速脚步进出跑
instructions: Stand tall with feet together.
Jog in place.
Quickly move your feet in and out.
Stay light on your toes.
Continue for the set time.
description: Run in place with feet moving in and out quickly. It boosts your heart rate.

name: 站姿单腿前后左右点地
english: standing single leg front back side to side toe tap
instructions: Stand on one leg.
Tap the other toe forward.
Tap to the side, then back.
Keep your balance.
Switch legs.
description: Tap your toes in different directions while balancing. It works hip stability.

name: 行走踢腿
instructions: Stand tall.
Step forward and kick the opposite leg up.
Alternate legs.
Swing your arms.
Continue for the set time.
description: Walk while kicking each leg up. It warms the legs.

name: 悬挂带前平举
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms down.
Keep your body straight.
Raise your arms overhead.
Pause.
Lower slowly.
description: Raise your body with arms in front using straps. It works the front delts.

name: 跪姿起身站立
instructions: Kneel with your torso upright.
Place one foot forward into a lunge.
Push through that foot to stand.
Bring your back foot to meet it.
Reverse the motion to return to kneeling.
Alternate the lead leg.
description: A smooth transition from kneeling to standing. It builds leg strength and control.

name: 小腿跳
instructions: Stand tall.
Keep knees nearly straight.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly.
Repeat quickly.
description: Jump using only your calves. It builds explosive lower legs.

name: 徒手杰斐逊弯举
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Tuck your chin and roll down one vertebra at a time.
Let your arms hang toward the floor.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
Reverse slowly to stand.
Move with control and keep the load light.
description: A slow forward bend that rolls through the spine one segment at a time. It builds back and hamstring mobility.

name: 弹力带坐姿抬膝
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with a band looped around your foot and anchored low.
Hold the seat edge and brace your core.
Lift one knee toward your chest against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the foot slowly with control.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
description: Seated knee raise against band tension. It works the hip flexors and lower abs.

name: 单腿小腿跳
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms relaxed.
Push through the ball of your foot and jump up using mainly your ankles.
Keep the knee nearly straight in the air.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Rebound right away into the next hop.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: Hopping on one leg using mostly the ankles. It builds calf power and springy ankles.

name: 单腿小腿跳(跳箱支撑)
english: single leg calf jump step box supported
instructions: Stand beside a step box and rest a hand lightly on it for balance.
Lift one foot off the floor.
Hop up using mostly your ankle and calf.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Keep the hops small and quick.
Switch legs after your set.
description: A single-leg calf hop with a step box nearby for balance. It trains ankle power with extra stability.

name: 小腿向前跳
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Push off the balls of your feet and hop forward a short distance.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Hop back or turn around and repeat.
Stay light and quick through the whole set.
description: Small forward hops driven by the calves. They build ankle stiffness and reactive power.

name: 小腿左右跳
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Spring off your toes and hop to one side.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop to the other side.
Keep your chest up and hips level.
Continue alternating for the set.
description: Quick lateral hops powered by the calves. They improve ankle strength and foot speed.

name: 药球滑冰跳
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Hop sideways onto one leg.
Land softly with a bent knee.
Pause briefly, then push off to the other side.
Keep your chest up.
Alternate for the reps.
description: A lateral hop from leg to leg while holding a medicine ball. It trains balance and side-to-side power.

name: 高抬膝行走
instructions: Stand tall with your arms relaxed.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Step forward and lower it to the floor.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep your torso upright.
Walk 10-20 steps per leg.
description: A walking warm-up where you lift each knee high. It primes the hips and legs.

name: 悬挂带腘绳肌跑者式
instructions: Lie on your back with both heels in the straps and lift your hips.
Press your arms into the floor for balance.
Curl one heel toward your glutes while the other leg extends.
Switch legs in a smooth running rhythm.
Keep your hips high and level.
Continue for the set.
description: A hamstring curl with heels in straps, alternating legs like running. It trains the hamstrings and core control.

name: 弹力带踮脚行走
instructions: Place a band around your forefeet or ankles.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Walk forward in small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
Keep your hips level.
Walk for 20-30 steps.
description: A walk on your toes with a band around your feet. It builds calf and ankle strength.

name: 弹力带踮脚侧向行走
instructions: Place a band around your ankles.
Rise onto your toes with knees slightly bent.
Step sideways in small steps.
Keep tension on the band.
Do not let your heels drop.
Walk one way, then back.
description: A sideways walk on your toes against band tension. It works calves, ankles and outer hips.

name: 踮脚侧向行走
instructions: Stand tall and rise onto your toes.
Bend your knees slightly.
Step sideways with small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
Keep your hips level.
Walk one way, then return.
description: A sideways walk on tiptoe. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.

name: 杠杆坐姿单腿弯举(挂片式)
english: lever seated single leg curl (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit on the machine and set the pad above your ankle.
Hold the handles and keep your back against the seat.
Curl one leg down and back.
Squeeze at the bottom.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg seated hamstring curl on a plate-loaded machine. It builds each hamstring separately.

name: 雪橇仰卧单腿深蹲
instructions: Lie back on the sled with one foot on the platform.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Bend your knee and lower the sled toward you.
Stop before your lower back lifts.
Push through your heel to extend the leg.
Do all reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg press-like squat on a sled while lying back. It builds leg strength with back support.

name: 悬挂带髋外展
instructions: Put one foot in a strap and stand tall on the other leg, holding the anchor for balance.
Brace your core.
Sweep the strapped leg out to the side.
Pause briefly at the end.
Bring it back under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: Standing leg raise to the side with one foot in a strap. It works the outer hip and stability muscles.

name: 悬挂带髋桥
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and knees bent.
Place your arms by your sides.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly without touching down.
Repeat for reps.
description: A glute bridge with heels in straps, which adds an instability challenge. It builds glutes and hamstrings.

name: 仰卧颈屈曲
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Relax your shoulders.
Tuck your chin and lift your head slightly off the floor.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
Keep the motion small and smooth.
description: Gentle chin tuck while lying on your back. It strengthens the front neck muscles.

name: 仰卧颈伸展
instructions: Lie face down with your forehead hanging near the edge of a bench or resting just off the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your head a few centimeters, keeping your chin slightly tucked.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Use small, controlled reps.
description: Lying face down, you lift the head slightly to train the back of the neck.

name: 悬挂带背部伸展
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and lie face down, hands behind your head or across your chest.
Brace your core.
Lift your chest by extending your back and hips.
Stop when your body forms a straight line.
Lower slowly.
Avoid overarching at the top.
description: Hip hinge back extension with feet in straps. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.

name: 悬挂带反向划船
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended and body straight.
Brace your abs and glutes.
Pull your chest toward your hands, driving elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control to full arm extension.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.
description: A bodyweight row hanging under straps. It builds the upper back and biceps.

name: 悬挂带折刀屈髋
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your hips high toward the ceiling.
Roll to an inverted V shape.
Lower back to plank slowly.
Keep your arms straight throughout.
description: From a plank with feet in straps, you pike the hips up. It hits the abs hard and challenges the shoulders.

name: 哑铃腕旋转
instructions: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh or a bench.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns down.
Pause, then rotate back.
Move slowly with control.
Switch arms.
description: A forearm drill where you rotate a dumbbell through your palm. It builds wrist and forearm control.

name: 四向单腿跳 v. 2
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop forward and land softly.
Hop back to the start, then out to the side and back.
Hop in the fourth direction.
Stick every landing.
Switch legs.
description: A balance hop on one leg in four directions. It trains power, balance and ankle stability.

name: 分腿站姿单腿提踵
english: split stance single leg calf raise
instructions: Stand in a split stance, front foot flat and back toes lightly touching the floor.
Keep most weight on the front leg.
Rise onto the ball of the front foot.
Pause at the top.
Lower the heel slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A calf raise in a split stance, with most work on the front leg. It trains the calf with balance support.

name: 悬挂带折刀
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull your knees toward your chest by rolling your hips up.
Pause briefly.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.
description: From a plank with feet in straps, you pull the knees toward the chest. It trains the abs and core control.

name: 弹力带站姿平衡屈腿髋外展
english: resistance band standing balance bent leg hip abduction
instructions: Place a band around your ankles or knees.
Balance on one leg with a soft knee.
Bend the other knee and lift it out to the side.
Keep your torso upright.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A standing hip abduction on one leg with a band. The bent working knee changes the angle.

name: 悬挂带腿弯举
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and legs extended.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high.
Extend your legs slowly.
Repeat for reps.
description: Hamstring curl with heels in straps while bridging. It works the hamstrings and glutes.

name: 悬挂带登山者
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs in a quick running rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Continue for the set.
description: Mountain climbers with feet in straps, which adds instability. It trains the core and conditioning.

name: 普拉提器械仰卧蛙腿与腿画圈
english: pilates machine lying frog and leg circle
instructions: Lie on the reformer with your feet in the straps or on the bar.
Bend your knees and open them out, heels together, in a frog shape.
Press your legs straight.
Circle them out, around and back together.
Reverse the circle direction after a few reps.
Keep your back steady on the pad.
description: Reformer leg work: frog press followed by circles. It trains the hips and inner thighs with control.

name: 普拉提器械仰卧跑步
instructions: Lie on the reformer with the balls of your feet on the bar.
Straighten both legs.
Lower one heel while bending the other knee.
Alternate smoothly.
Keep your pelvis still.
Maintain steady breathing.
description: Reformer footwork that alternates the legs like running. It trains the calves, quads and glutes.

name: 普拉提器械仰卧骨盆上抬
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet on the bar and knees bent.
Press your arms into the pad.
Lift your hips one vertebra at a time.
Hold at the top.
Roll down slowly.
Keep your ribs relaxed.
description: A reformer bridge that lifts the hips. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 普拉提器械侧向劈叉
instructions: Stand with one foot on the carriage and one on the platform.
Brace your core.
Slide the carriage out to widen your stance.
Pause.
Draw it back under control with your inner thighs.
Keep your hips square.
description: A reformer move where you open and close the legs sideways. It works the inner thighs and balance.

name: 普拉提器械俄式深蹲
instructions: Set your feet on the carriage and platform.
Stand tall and brace your core.
Bend your knees into a squat.
Keep your chest lifted and knees over toes.
Press back up to standing.
Move with the carriage smoothly.
description: A reformer squat variation that builds the legs. It focuses on controlled bending and straightening.

name: 普拉提器械俄式分腿
instructions: Place one foot on the carriage and one on the platform.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Slide the carriage back while lowering into a split squat.
Pause.
Press back to the start.
Switch sides after your set.
description: A reformer split stance with the carriage sliding. It works the legs, glutes and balance.

name: 普拉提器械长脊柱
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet against the shoulder rests.
Press your legs straight up.
Roll your hips off the pad.
Lift your hips over your shoulders.
Roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.
Avoid pressing on your neck.
description: A reformer roll-over that mobilises the spine. It stretches the back and works the abs.

name: 普拉提器械手臂画圈
instructions: Lie on your back holding the straps with arms up.
Bend your knees and brace your core.
Lower your arms out to the sides.
Circle them down and up in a smooth arc.
Reverse the direction after a few reps.
Keep your ribs down.
description: A reformer arm circle holding straps. It works the shoulders and the upper back.

name: 普拉提器械扩胸
instructions: Kneel facing the straps with your torso upright.
Hold the straps with straight arms.
Pull the straps back behind your body.
Turn your head gently to each side.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your chest lifted and ribs down.
description: A reformer move pulling the straps behind you. It opens the chest and works the upper back.

name: 普拉提器械过头
instructions: Sit or kneel on the carriage holding the straps overhead.
Brace your core.
Press the straps forward and down in a controlled arc.
Return to the overhead position.
Keep your spine tall.
Move smoothly with breath.
description: Reformer work with straps overhead. It trains the shoulders, abs and posture.

name: 杠铃杰斐逊弯举
instructions: Stand holding a very light barbell in front of your thighs.
Tuck your chin and roll down one segment at a time.
Let the bar hang close to your legs.
Go only as low as feels controlled.
Roll back up slowly.
Keep your knees soft.
description: A slow, loaded forward bend that rolls through the spine. Keep the barbell light and the motion smooth.

name: 哑铃卢式上举
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, elbows bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearms upward so the dumbbells point to the ceiling.
Pause, then lower back down the same path with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid shrugging.
description: A dumbbell raise that lifts the arms out and up in an L to U path. It builds shoulder strength and upper back control.

name: 站姿地面胫骨前肌上抬(扶墙)
english: standing floor tibialis raise wall supported
instructions: Stand with your back and hips against a wall, feet a little way out in front.
Keep your legs straight and your heels planted on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your toes slowly and repeat.
description: Standing with your back against a wall, you lift your toes off the floor. It strengthens the muscles on the front of the shin.

name: 悬挂带爆发拉
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull explosively with your arms and back.
Bring your chest toward your hands.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.
description: A powerful pull from a long position under the straps. It builds the lats and upper back.

name: 绳索背向侧踢腿
english: cable side leg kick from back
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to one ankle.
Stand side-on to the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Kick the working leg out and slightly behind you, keeping the knee mostly straight.
Pause, then return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Keep your torso still. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
description: A standing cable kick that sweeps the leg out and back. It works the outer hip and glutes.

name: 负重球反向背伸(臀腿伸展机)
english: weighted ball reverse hyperextension on ghd
instructions: Lie face down on the GHD with hips at the edge and a ball between your feet.
Hold the pad.
Lift your legs until they line up with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Do not swing.
description: Reverse hyper on a GHD, with a ball held between your feet. It trains glutes and hamstrings.

name: 徒手单腿硬拉(顶球)
english: bodyweight single leg deadlift against ball
instructions: Stand facing a wall with a ball between your hand and the wall.
Lift one foot slightly.
Hinge at the hip as the free leg extends back.
Keep your back flat.
Return to standing.
Switch legs after the set.
description: A single-leg hinge with a ball against the wall for balance. It trains hamstrings and balance.

name: 史密斯机坐姿单臂中立握肩部推举
english: smith seated single arm neutral grip shoulders press
instructions: Set a bench under the smith bar and sit upright with your back supported.
Hold the bar with one hand in a neutral grip and unhook it.
Press the bar overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower it slowly to around chin height.
Keep your torso steady. Finish all reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm seated press on the smith machine with a neutral grip. It trains the shoulder while the bar path stays guided.

name: 高箱踏阶
instructions: Stand facing a high box.
Place one foot fully on top.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Switch leading legs.
description: Stepping up onto a tall box. It builds the quads and glutes.

name: 哑铃单腿罗马尼亚硬拉(凳上)
english: dumbbell single leg romanian deadlift on bench
instructions: Hold dumbbells with your rear foot resting on a bench.
Keep your front knee soft.
Hinge forward at the hips.
Lower the weights along your leg.
Squeeze your glutes to stand up.
Switch legs after the set.
description: A single-leg Romanian deadlift with the rear foot on a bench. It targets hamstrings and glutes.

name: 杠杆俯身单臂背阔肌划船
english: lever bent over single arm lats focused row
instructions: Set the machine and lean forward from the hips with a flat back.
Grip the handle with one hand and let the arm reach forward.
Pull the elbow back and down toward your hip.
Squeeze your lat at the end of the pull.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.
description: A one-arm machine row done from a bent-over stance. It targets the lats with a strong squeeze.

name: 杠杆上斜俯卧中立握划船
english: lever incline prone neutral grip row
instructions: Lie face down on the incline pad with your chest supported.
Grip the neutral handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back past your torso, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment.
Let the handles return slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A chest-supported machine row on an incline with a neutral grip. It builds the mid back without loading the lower back.

name: 波速球深蹲
instructions: Stand on the Bosu with feet shoulder width apart.
Hold your arms forward.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Keep your chest lifted.
Stand tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
description: Squat standing on a Bosu ball. The unstable surface adds a balance challenge.

name: 波速球单腿深蹲
instructions: Stand on one foot on the Bosu.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower into a controlled squat.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Press back up.
Switch legs after the set.
description: A single-leg squat on a Bosu ball. It challenges the legs and balance.

name: 悬挂带穿腿拉
instructions: Face away from the anchor, holding the handles between your legs.
Step forward to create tension.
Hinge at the hips and let your hands pass between your legs.
Drive your hips forward.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your back flat.
description: A hip hinge with a strap held between your legs. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 弹力带臀桥行走
instructions: Lie on your back with a band above your knees and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Step your feet out and in sideways.
Keep the band tight.
Keep your hips high.
Lower after the set.
description: A glute bridge held with a band while stepping sideways. It targets glutes and outer hips.

name: 负重杠铃片卷腹(双手过头)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a plate with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor, reaching the plate upward.
Pause at the top and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without dropping your head back.
description: A crunch holding a weight plate overhead. The long lever makes your abs work harder.

name: 哑铃负重卷腹(双手过头)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold one dumbbell upright with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, driving the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A crunch with a dumbbell held overhead. The extra load and long lever challenge your abs.

name: 负重杠铃片45度侧弯
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree bench or hyperextension frame, side-on, feet secured.
Hold a plate against your chest.
Lower your torso sideways with control.
Bend back up until your body is in a straight line.
Avoid twisting. Finish your reps and switch sides.
description: A side bend holding a plate, done with the body at a 45 degree angle. It works the obliques.

name: 负重杠铃片卷腹(双手过头) v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet planted.
Hold a plate with straight arms overhead.
Crunch up, lifting your shoulder blades off the floor.
Keep your arms by your ears as you rise.
Lower back down slowly and repeat.
description: A second take on the overhead plate crunch. It trains the abs with a long, loaded lever.

name: 负重哑铃卷腹(双手过头) v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell at one end with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Crunch up and let the dumbbell travel in an arc toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.
description: A second version of the overhead dumbbell crunch. It builds ab strength with a loaded reach.

name: 悬挂带引体向上
instructions: Hang from the handles with arms extended.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up between the handles.
Lead with your elbows.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
description: A pull-up using suspension handles. It builds the lats and arms.

name: 跪姿增强式俯卧撑
instructions: Kneel in a push-up position with hands under shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.
description: An explosive push-up from the knees. It builds pressing power.

name: 弹力床踮脚跳
instructions: Stand on the elastic bed with feet together.
Rise onto your toes.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Stay quick and light.
Continue for the set.
description: Toe jumps on an elastic bed. It trains calves and ankle bounce.

name: 弹力带仰卧外展
instructions: Loop a band around both legs just above the knees and lie on your side.
Stack your hips and bend your knees slightly.
Lift the top knee or leg away from the bottom one against the band.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch sides.
description: A lying leg lift against a band that works the outer hip. Good for glute and hip stability.

name: 悬挂带反向飞鸟
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
Do not shrug.
description: A reverse fly using suspension handles. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: 哑铃单臂耸肩
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep your arm straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your shoulder straight up toward your ear.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch arms.
description: A one-arm shrug with a dumbbell. It builds the upper traps and grip.

name: 离心单臂引体向上
instructions: Get into the top position of a pull-up, with one hand on the bar and the other assisting or at rest.
Let go of any help and shift your weight onto the working arm.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can until your arm is straight.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Step back up to the top and repeat, then switch arms.
description: A slow lowering phase of a one-arm pull-up. It builds the strength needed for the full move.

name: 弹力带辅助单臂引体向上 v. 2
english: resistance band assisted single arm pull up v. 2
instructions: Hang a band from the bar and place a foot or knee in the loop.
Grip the bar with one hand and keep the other arm across your chest.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving your elbow down.
Pause at the top.
Lower under control. Finish your reps and switch arms.
description: A one-arm pull-up where a band takes some of your body weight. It helps you work toward an unassisted rep.

name: 腘绳肌桥 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, a bit further from your hips.
Press through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A bridge with heels planted that emphasises the back of the thighs. Good for the hamstrings and glutes.

name: 腘绳肌桥踢腿 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Straighten one leg out in front, keeping hips level.
Bring the foot back to the floor without dropping your hips.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.
description: A hamstring bridge with an added leg extension. It adds a balance challenge for hips and thighs.

name: 徒手分腿蹲保持
instructions: Step one foot far forward and the other back into a split stance.
Lower your hips until the front knee is bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Rise up and switch legs.
description: A held split stance that opens the front of the hip and loads the front thigh.

name: 徒手半分腿蹲保持
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended in front, heel on the floor.
Sit your hips back toward the rear heel.
Keep the front leg straight and your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.
description: A half split position that stretches the back of the front leg while you sit back on the rear leg.

name: 坐姿单腿足部画圈
instructions: Sit tall on a chair and lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your lower leg still.
Draw slow circles with your toes, as wide as is comfortable.
Do half your reps clockwise, then switch to counterclockwise.
Repeat on the other foot.
description: Seated ankle circles on one leg. They loosen the ankle and warm up the lower leg.

name: 坐姿双足画圈
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with both feet lifted off the floor.
Keep your knees still.
Circle both feet in the same direction, as wide as feels comfortable.
Reverse the direction after several turns.
Keep your breathing relaxed.
description: Circling both feet while seated. A simple way to mobilise the ankles.

name: 悬挂带前推
instructions: Kneel holding the handles close to your chest.
Brace your core.
Push your arms forward as you lean out.
Keep your back flat.
