Press up slowly, straightening your arms as far as is comfortable.
Keep your hips on the floor and relax your glutes.
Look forward and feel the stretch along your belly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower down.
description: A face-down stretch that lengthens the abdominals, similar to a cobra position.

name: 坐姿腹股沟拉伸
instructions: Sit tall on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet or ankles and let your knees fall out.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
Lean forward slightly from the hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe slowly.
description: A seated butterfly-style stretch for the inner thighs.

name: 45度单腿山羊挺身(手臂置于胸前)
english: 45 degree one leg hyperextension (arms in front of chest)
instructions: Set the pad under your hips and hook one foot under the roller, with the other leg lifted off.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise back up by squeezing your glute until your body is level, without overarching.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg back extension on a 45 degree bench that trains the glutes, hamstrings and lower back one side at a time.

name: 45度扭转山羊挺身
instructions: Position yourself on the bench with your ankles under the pads and your hips just off the edge.
Cross your arms over your chest and lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise your torso back up, squeezing your glutes.
At the top, rotate your upper body gently to one side, then return to center.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the movement slow and controlled.
description: A back extension on a 45 degree bench with a rotation at the top that adds work for the obliques and lower back.

name: 徒手绳索引体向上
instructions: Hang from two ropes with arms straight and legs together.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull yourself up until your hands reach chest or chin level.
Keep your elbows pointing down and close.
Lower under control to a full hang.
description: A pull-up done hanging from ropes, which adds a big grip challenge to the vertical pull.

name: 徒手绳索反向划船
instructions: Set ropes at about waist height and lie under them, holding the ends.
Keep your body straight from heels to head, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A horizontal row hanging under rope handles that works the back and grip.

name: 负重石头站姿过头爆发推举
english: weighted stone standing power overhead press
instructions: Lift the stone to your chest, hugging it close.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and brace your core.
Dip slightly and drive up through your legs.
Press the stone overhead to full lockout.
Lower it back to your chest with control.
description: A strongman-style overhead press with a heavy stone, using a small leg drive for power.

name: 增强式俯卧撑 v. 2
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Explode upward so your hands leave the ground.
Land softly with slightly bent elbows.
Reset your body line and repeat.
description: An explosive push-up variation where your hands leave the floor, building upper-body power.

name: 杠杆上斜胸部支撑反向飞鸟(挂片式)
english: lever incline chest supported reverse delt fly (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit with your chest against the incline pad and grab the handles.
Start with arms forward and slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Return slowly without letting the weight crash.
description: A chest-supported reverse fly on a plate-loaded lever machine that isolates the rear delts.

name: 辅助负重俯卧撑
instructions: Get into a plank with hands under your shoulders and load placed on your upper back.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up until your elbows are straight.
Use the assistance as needed to keep every rep clean.
description: A push-up with extra load and assistance so you can adjust difficulty while keeping good form.

name: 杠铃上斜宽反握卧推
english: barbell incline wide reverse grip bench press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar wide with palms facing you.
Unrack and hold the bar over your upper chest.
Lower it to the upper chest with elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up to lockout.
Use a spotter, as this grip is less stable.
description: An incline bench press with a wide underhand grip that emphasizes the upper chest.

name: 钻石俯卧撑(跪姿)
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your chest, thumbs and fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows close.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.
description: An easier knee version of the diamond push-up that targets the triceps with hands close together.

name: 哑铃前倾弓步蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward with one foot and lean your chest slightly forward with a flat back.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side before switching.
description: A lunge with a forward torso lean that shifts more of the load onto the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 哑铃上斜前平举
instructions: Lie face down or back on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Start with your arms hanging or in front of you.
Raise the weights forward to shoulder height with straight arms.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
description: A front raise performed lying on an incline bench to reduce swinging and isolate the front delts.

name: 史密斯机俯身划船(胸部支撑)
instructions: Set an incline bench under the bar and lie chest down on it.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A chest-supported row on the Smith machine that takes stress off the lower back.

name: 绳索坐姿上斜弯举
instructions: Set a bench to incline and place a low pulley behind you.
Sit back with your arms hanging and grab the handles.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders, keeping elbows back.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
description: A curl on an incline seat with cable resistance for a deep, constant-tension biceps stretch.

name: 绳索站姿单臂反握胸推
english: cable standing single arm supinated grip chest press
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle with a palm-up grip.
Stand facing away in a staggered stance.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Keep your torso still and resist twisting.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.
description: A standing one-arm press with a palm-up grip that works the chest and tests core stability.

name: 哑铃仰卧锤式推举 v. 2
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Start with the weights above your chest.
Lower them to the sides of your chest, elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.
description: A bench press with dumbbells held in a neutral grip that is easier on the shoulders.

name: 哑铃站姿单腿提踵
english: dumbbell standing single leg calf raise
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on one foot on a step.
Hold a wall or rail with your other hand for balance.
Lower your heel to a full stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg calf raise holding a dumbbell for a challenging calf workout.

name: 跳上台阶箱
instructions: Stand facing a step box with your feet hip width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively up onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on top, then step back down one foot at a time.
Reset and repeat, staying quick but controlled.
description: An explosive jump onto a low step box that builds power in the legs and trains soft, controlled landings.

name: 侧向跳
instructions: Stand on both feet with your knees slightly bent and your arms ready.
Push off and jump sideways, covering a comfortable distance.
Land softly on both feet with your knees tracking over your toes.
Immediately jump back to the starting side.
Keep your chest up and repeat for the planned reps or time.
description: A side-to-side jump that develops lateral power, balance and leg stability.

name: 手指爆发
instructions: Hold your hands out in front of you.
Close both hands into tight fists.
Open them fast, spreading your fingers as wide as possible.
Repeat quickly for 20-30 reps.
Keep your wrists relaxed.
description: A quick open-and-close finger drill that warms up the hands and forearms.

name: 爆发式悬垂深蹲
instructions: Hang from a bar with arms straight and knees slightly bent.
Lower into a deep squat position.
Explode upward through your legs.
Absorb the movement softly and return to the start.
Keep your core tight and repeat.
description: A squat jump while hanging from a bar that lets you focus on explosive leg drive.

name: 肩部内旋松动
instructions: Stand or sit tall with one elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm across your belly.
Move slowly through a comfortable range.
Return to the start and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.
description: A gentle shoulder mobility drill that trains internal rotation.

name: 坐姿桡神经松动
instructions: Sit tall with one arm down at your side, palm facing back.
Lower your shoulder slightly and rotate your arm inward.
Bend your wrist gently and tilt your head away.
Move slowly and stop at a mild pull, never pain.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.
description: A gentle seated nerve glide that moves the radial nerve along the arm.

name: 坐姿正中神经松动
instructions: Sit tall and lift one arm out to the side, palm up.
Extend your wrist and fingers backward.
Tilt your head slightly away from that arm.
Return slowly and repeat 8-10 times.
Stay within a mild stretch, then switch arms.
description: A gentle seated nerve glide for the median nerve running down the arm to the hand.

name: 坐姿尺神经松动
instructions: Sit tall with one arm out to the side.
Bend your elbow and bring your hand toward your face like a mask.
Tilt your head slightly away.
Straighten the arm back out, keeping it gentle.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.
description: A gentle seated nerve glide for the ulnar nerve on the inner side of the arm.

name: 杠铃错位站姿直腿硬拉
english: barbell staggered stance stiff legged deadlift
instructions: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs and place one foot slightly behind the other, mostly on the ball of the back foot.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips, sliding the bar down your legs with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Finish all reps, then switch the stance.
description: A stiff-leg deadlift with a staggered stance that loads the hamstrings and glutes while shifting weight to the front leg.

name: 交替打腿 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick alternating moves.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.
description: Small alternating leg kicks that burn the lower abs.

name: 平衡三点点地
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and your hands on your hips.
Tap the free foot out in front of you, then lightly out to the side.
Tap it behind you, keeping your torso upright.
Return to center and repeat the sequence under control.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.
description: A balance drill where you stand on one leg and tap the other foot to three points, training hip control and stability.

name: 单臂手指推球
english: single arm fingers press with ball
instructions: Hold a small ball in one palm.
Press down on it with your fingers.
Spread and squeeze with control, keeping your wrist neutral.
Hold the press for 2-3 seconds.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.
description: A hand-strengthening drill pressing the fingers into a ball.

name: 跪姿等长二头肌保持
instructions: Kneel upright with your elbows bent at about 90 degrees.
Hold your hands in front of you with palms up.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Squeeze your biceps and hold the position.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.
description: A static curl hold that builds biceps endurance.

name: 肩部外推松动
instructions: Stand tall with your elbow bent at your side.
Press your forearm outward away from your body.
Hold for a moment at the end of your comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.
description: A gentle shoulder mobility drill pressing outward to warm up the joint.

name: 单臂手指推球 v. 2
english: single arm fingers press with ball v. 2
instructions: Place a ball under one hand on a table or hold it in your palm.
Spread your fingers over the ball.
Press down and hold for 2-3 seconds.
Release with control.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.
description: A second version of the fingers-on-ball drill for forearm and hand strength.

name: 肩部后推松动
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Press one arm backward, keeping the elbow straight.
Move through a comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.
description: A shoulder mobility drill moving the arm backward to open the front of the shoulder.

name: 肩部外旋松动
instructions: Stand tall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your belly.
Keep your elbow tucked in.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.
description: A gentle shoulder mobility drill for external rotation.

name: 肩部前推松动
instructions: Stand tall with your elbows bent in front of you.
Press your arm forward until it is straight.
Keep your shoulder relaxed.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.
description: A shoulder mobility drill pressing the arm forward to warm up the joint.

name: 俯身后侧前举臂
english: bent over back to side to front arms raise
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and let your arms hang down.
Sweep both arms back behind your hips.
Swing them out wide to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue the arc forward until your arms point ahead of you, then reverse the path.
Keep your neck neutral and move smoothly for the planned reps.
description: A flowing bent-over arm sweep from back to side to front that warms up and strengthens the rear and side shoulders.

name: 哑铃俯身后侧前举臂
english: dumbbell bent over back to side to front arms raise
instructions: Hold light dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Start with your arms back by your hips.
Sweep the dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue forward in an arc, then reverse the path with control.
Use light weights and avoid swinging your torso.
description: A bent-over sweeping raise with light dumbbells that targets the rear and side delts through a long arc.

name: 仰卧同时交替直腿抬腿
english: lying simultaneous alternating straight leg raise
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips or at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Raise one leg while the other lowers toward the floor, keeping both straight.
Switch legs in a smooth scissor pattern without letting your back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.
description: A floor core move where both legs work together in an alternating pattern, challenging the lower abs and hip flexors.

name: 哑铃地面仰卧单臂直臂推举
english: dumbbell lying single straight arm press on floor
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and one dumbbell held above your chest.
Keep the other arm resting on the floor beside you.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight and the shoulder reaches forward.
Lower it back with control until your upper arm touches the floor.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm press from the floor with a straight arm that trains the chest and shoulder stabilisers.

name: 仰卧单腿股四头肌松动
instructions: Lie on your side or stomach with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle if needed.
Move the knee in and out of the bend in a slow, controlled rhythm.
Keep your hips level and stay within a comfortable range.
Repeat for 10-15 reps, then switch legs.
description: A lying quad mobilization that gently bends the knee to loosen the front of the thigh.

name: 仰卧直腿抬腿 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your core braced and your back from arching.
description: A lying leg raise that targets the lower abs and hip flexors while you keep your legs long.

name: 俯卧撑(跪姿)
instructions: Kneel on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
description: An easier push-up variation from the knees that builds chest, shoulder and arm strength.

name: 史密斯机跪姿后踢
instructions: Set the bar at a low height and kneel on all fours facing it, with the sole of one foot under the bar.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Press your foot up and back against the bar until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A glute kickback done kneeling with one foot pressing against a smith machine bar, a focused move for the glutes.

name: 负重反向划船
instructions: Set a bar at waist height and lie under it with extra weight on your torso.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulders.
Keep your body straight from heels to head.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.
description: An inverted row with extra weight placed on your body for added back challenge.

name: 交替直腿抬腿(波速球)
english: alternate straight leg raise (on bosu ball)
instructions: Lie back on a bosu ball with your lower back supported and your hands holding it lightly.
Brace your abs and extend both legs.
Raise one leg while keeping it straight.
Lower it and switch to the other leg.
Keep your torso steady and move with control.
description: A lying leg raise on a bosu ball that adds an unstable surface to challenge the lower abs and balance.

name: 哑铃单臂弯举加等长保持
english: dumbbell single arm curl with isometric hold
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell at your side, palm forward.
Curl the weight up until your elbow is bent to 90 degrees.
Hold that position for 2-3 seconds.
Finish the curl, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps and switch arms.
description: A one-arm curl that pauses at the halfway point to increase biceps tension.

name: 壶铃仰卧起坐
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a kettlebell at your chest.
Brace your core.
Curl up until your torso is upright.
Keep the kettlebell close to you.
Lower slowly back down.
description: A sit-up holding a kettlebell for extra resistance on the abs.

name: 悬垂L坐
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight in front until they are parallel to the floor.
Keep your toes pointed and your knees locked.
Avoid swinging.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower.
description: A hanging hold with legs straight out in front that challenges the abs and grip.

name: 肋木抬腿
instructions: Hang on a stall bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Raise your legs up in front of you.
Lift as high as you can without swinging.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A hanging leg raise performed on stall bars.

name: 史密斯机上台阶
instructions: Set the bar across your upper back and stand in front of a bench.
Place one foot on the bench.
Drive through that heel to stand up fully.
Step back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: A step-up with a Smith machine bar across your back for loaded leg work.

name: 负重扭转卷腹(凳上)
instructions: Lie back on a bench with your knees bent and a weight held on your chest.
Brace your abs and curl your upper body up.
Rotate your torso so one elbow moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly without letting go of tension.
Alternate sides each rep.
description: A weighted crunch with a rotation done on a bench that trains the abs and obliques.

name: 杠杆T杠窄握划船(挂片式)
english: lever t bar close grip row (plate loaded)
instructions: Stand on the platform with your chest supported.
Grab the close-grip handle with straight arms.
Pull the handle toward your torso, elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to full extension.
description: A plate-loaded T-bar row with a close grip for thick back work.

name: 负重V字卷腹(波速球)
instructions: Sit on a bosu ball and lean back slightly, holding a weight in front of you.
Lift your feet off the floor with your legs bent or straight.
Bring your chest and knees toward each other in a V shape.
Lower back with control, keeping your spine long.
Stay stable on the ball throughout.
description: A V-shaped crunch on a bosu ball with added weight, which challenges the abs and balance together.

name: 上斜扭转仰卧起坐 v. 2
instructions: Lie on an incline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up while rotating your torso to one side.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.
description: An incline sit-up with a twist to work the obliques as well as the abs.

name: 站姿髋屈肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and hold a wall or support for balance.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and push your hips gently forward.
Keep your knees close together and your chest upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A standing stretch for the front of the hip and thigh, useful after long periods of sitting.

name: 站姿半跪髋屈肌拉伸
english: standing half kneeling hip flexors stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a pad under your knee.
Keep your torso upright and tuck your pelvis under.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your core engaged.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A half-kneeling position that opens the front of the hip and the quad of the back leg.

name: 三头肌推举(头低于凳)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your head just past the end, holding a weight overhead.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your head.
Extend your arms to straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.
description: A triceps extension lying with your head off the bench edge for an extra stretch.

name: 铁十字平板支撑
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands under your shoulders.
Spread your arms and legs wide in an X shape.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
description: A plank variation with arms and legs spread wide to challenge the core.

name: 杠杆仰卧T杠划船
instructions: Lie chest-down on the pad and grab the handles.
Start with your arms straight.
Pull the handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower under control.
description: A chest-supported T-bar row lying on the machine pad.

name: 杠杆上斜锤式胸推
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at upper chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pinned to the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your wrists straight and your back against the pad.
description: Pressing on an incline chest machine with neutral hammer handles. It builds the upper chest and is gentle on the shoulders.

name: 仰卧椒盐卷饼拉伸
instructions: Lie on your side with your hips stacked and your bottom leg bent in front.
Bend the top knee and bring that foot back toward your glutes, holding it with your hand.
Gently roll your top knee back and open your chest toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: A lying twist that pulls one leg across and bends the other back, stretching the glutes, hips and thighs.

name: 哑铃交替二头弯举 v. 2
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbow by your side, curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it under control.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your torso to lift the weight.
description: Curling one dumbbell at a time while standing. A classic way to build the biceps with a steady rhythm.

name: 深蹲
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can while keeping your heels down and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
description: The basic bodyweight squat. It trains the thighs and glutes and teaches solid lower body mechanics.

name: 跳跃引体向上
instructions: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees and jump up, pulling your chin above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Reset on the floor and repeat.
description: A pull-up that uses a small jump to help you up, then a slow lowering phase. Good for building pulling strength.

name: 相扑硬拉高拉
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and grip the barbell between your legs with hands close together.
Keep your back flat and drive through your legs to stand up.
As the bar passes your hips, pull it up to chest height with your elbows high.
Lower the bar back along the same path.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout.
description: A wide-stance deadlift finished with an upright row. It works the thighs, glutes and shoulders in one smooth motion.

name: 借力推举
instructions: Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs and press the bar overhead.
Lock out with the bar over your mid foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.
description: An overhead press helped by a quick leg dip and drive. It lets you handle heavier loads for the shoulders and triceps.

name: 哑铃波比
instructions: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与肩同宽，每只手各拿一个哑铃。
将身体降低至蹲姿，将哑铃放在您面前的地面上。
将双脚踢回到俯卧撑位置，保持身体呈一条直线。
进行俯卧撑，弯曲肘部并将胸部降低到地面。
将脚向后跳向双手，以蹲姿着地。
爆发性地站起来，将哑铃从地上举起，放到肩膀上。
将哑铃举过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
将哑铃放回到肩膀上，然后重复整个序列，达到所需的重复次数。
description: A burpee with dumbbells that finishes with an overhead press. It builds strength and endurance.

name: 壶铃站姿弹弓(高级)
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart holding a kettlebell by the handle.
Pass it around your waist from one hand to the other behind your back.
Continue the circle to the front, keeping the movement smooth.
Keep your core tight and your hips still.
After several reps, reverse the direction.
description: Passing a kettlebell around your torso in quick circles. It challenges the core, grip and coordination.

name: 绳索水平帕洛夫推
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to the stack.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out until your arms are extended.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Bring it back to your chest and finish the set, then switch sides.
description: Pressing a cable straight out from your chest while resisting the pull to rotate. It trains anti-rotation core strength.

name: 绳索单臂内侧二头弯举
english: cable one arm inner biceps curl
instructions: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand facing the stack.
Hold the handle with one hand, palm up, and turn your elbow slightly out.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A single-arm cable curl with the elbow pointing slightly out to emphasise the inner biceps.

name: 绳索单臂高位下拉
instructions: Attach a handle to a high pulley and sit facing the stack.
Grab the handle with one hand and sit tall.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, driving your elbow toward your hip.
Pause, then let your arm rise slowly.
Complete your reps and switch sides.
description: A single-arm pulldown on a high cable. It lets each side of the lats work on its own.

name: 绳索单臂扭转坐姿划船
english: cable one arm twisting seated row
instructions: Sit at a low cable with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Start with your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Row the handle to your side while rotating your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back, then return slowly.
Do all reps, then change arms.
description: A seated one-arm cable row with a rotation of the torso. It trains the back and gives the core a twist.

name: 绳索穿腿拉
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the stack, holding the rope between your legs.
Step forward until the cable is taut and bend your knees slightly.
Push your hips back, letting the rope travel behind you.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
Keep your back flat throughout.
description: A hip hinge facing away from a low cable. It builds the glutes and hamstrings and teaches a good hinge.

name: 绳索转体(由下向上)
instructions: Set the cable pulley low and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle near your lower hip, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and keep your hips stable.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A diagonal cable rotation from low to high that trains the obliques and builds rotational strength.

name: 绳索转体(由上向下) v. 2
instructions: Set the cable pulley high and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle above your shoulder, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally down across your body.
Keep your hips steady and your core braced.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A diagonal cable rotation from high to low that trains the obliques and builds rotational strength.

name: 绳索扭转过头推举
instructions: Set a cable low and stand sideways, holding the handle at your shoulder.
Brace your core and turn slightly toward the cable.
Press the handle overhead while rotating your torso to face forward.
Lower the handle back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: An overhead cable press where you rotate your torso as you push. It works the shoulders and the core together.

name: 绳索扭转站姿高位划船
instructions: Set a cable at about head height and stand facing it with the handle in one hand.
Take a split stance and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle toward your upper chest, turning your torso as you go.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Complete the set and switch sides.
description: A standing cable row at a high angle with a torso twist. It hits the upper back and rear shoulders.

name: 绳索扭转站姿单臂胸推
english: cable twisting standing one arm chest press
instructions: Set the cable at chest height and stand sideways with the handle in your inside hand.
Take a stable stance and hold the handle at your chest.
Press the handle forward while rotating your torso toward the press.
Return to the start with control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
description: A standing single-arm cable press with a rotation. It trains the chest and the core's ability to resist and produce twist.

name: 绳索扭转站姿划船
instructions: Set a cable at mid height and stand facing it, holding the handle with one hand.
Stand in a stable stance with a slight lean back.
Pull the handle to your ribs and rotate your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A standing cable row where you turn your torso as you pull. It works the back with some added core rotation.

name: 绳索垂直帕洛夫推
instructions: Set a cable at a high or low position and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the handle straight up (or down) along a vertical line.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Return to your chest, finish the set, then switch sides.
description: A cable press performed upward or downward in a vertical line while holding the core still. It trains anti-rotation and shoulder stability.

name: 哑铃上斜30度反握卧推
english: dumbbell incline reverse grip 30 degrees bench press
instructions: Set a bench to about 30 degrees and lie back with dumbbells held palms facing you.
Start with the dumbbells at your chest.
Press them up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to your chest.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
description: A low-incline dumbbell press with palms facing you. The reverse grip puts extra focus on the upper chest.

name: 哑铃侧弓步蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand or one at your chest and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side and sit your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest upright.
Push through the bent leg to return to the middle.
Alternate sides or finish all reps on one side before switching.
description: A lateral lunge with dumbbells that trains the glutes, quads and inner thighs in the frontal plane.

name: 杠杆坐姿单腿提踵
english: lever seated one leg calf raise
instructions: Sit on the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Set the pad on your thigh and release the safety.
Lower your heel for a stretch.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause, lower slowly, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg seated calf raise on a machine. Working each leg alone helps balance strength and targets the soleus.

name: 杠杆提踵(卧推机)
instructions: Sit on the machine and place the balls of your feet on the lower platform or press plate.
Push to straighten your legs and release the safety.
Lower your heels as far as is comfortable.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Pause at the top and lower under control.
description: A calf raise done on a chest press style lever machine, using the seat and handles to load the calves.

name: 杠杆耸肩(卧推机)
instructions: Set the machine so the handles are at your sides and grip them firmly.
Stand or sit tall with your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top for a moment.
Lower your shoulders slowly without rolling them.
description: Shrugging with a lever press machine as the load. It builds the upper traps with a stable, guided path.

name: 辅助窄距反握引体向上
english: assisted close grip underhand chin up
instructions: Set the assistance weight and kneel or stand on the platform.
Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands close together.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Squeeze your back and biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A chin-up with machine assistance and a narrow underhand grip. It lets you build pulling strength with less bodyweight.

name: 反握反向背部划船
instructions: Set a bar at waist height and lie under it, gripping it with palms facing you.
Straighten your body from heels to head.
Pull your chest up to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.
description: A bodyweight row under a low bar with an underhand grip. It builds the back and biceps.

name: 史密斯机站姿肩部推举
instructions: Set the bar at shoulder height and stand under it with a shoulder width grip.
Unrack the bar and hold it at your collarbone.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders slowly.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
description: A standing overhead press on the Smith machine. The fixed bar path lets you focus on pushing.

name: 站姿杠铃片推举
instructions: Stand tall holding a plate at the sides with both hands at chest height.
Brace your core and keep your elbows slightly forward.
Press the plate overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it slowly to your chest.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching.
description: Pressing a weight plate overhead with both hands. A simple way to train the shoulders and arms.

name: EZ杠铃站姿过头推举
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar at your upper chest with a comfortable grip.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it slowly back to your chest.
Keep your head neutral and avoid leaning back.
description: An overhead press with an EZ bar. The angled grips can feel kinder on the wrists while you train the shoulders.

name: 绳索站姿单臂三头肌下压(正握)
english: cable standing one arm triceps pushdown (overhand grip)
instructions: Attach a handle to a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hold the handle with an overhand grip and tuck your elbow to your side.
Push down until your arm is fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps, then let the handle rise slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A single-arm pushdown with an overhand grip. It isolates one triceps at a time.

name: 哑铃站姿内侧二头弯举
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, elbows slightly out from your sides.
Curl the weights toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower them slowly to the start.
Keep your upper arms still.
description: A standing dumbbell curl with the elbows turned slightly out to emphasise the inner head of the biceps.

name: 绳索站姿背阔肌下压(绳索把手)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing it, hinging slightly forward.
Grab the rope with straight arms.
Push the rope down to your thighs, keeping your arms nearly straight.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the rope rise slowly to shoulder height.
description: A straight-arm pushdown with a rope on a high cable. It isolates the lats with almost no help from the arms.

name: 哑铃站姿交替垂直前平举
english: dumbbell standing alternate vertical front raises
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs with palms facing in.
Raise one dumbbell straight up to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your body.
description: Raising one dumbbell at a time in front of you with a neutral grip. It works the front shoulders.

name: 哑铃坐姿单臂肩部推举
english: dumbbell seated one arm shoulder press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell at your shoulder.
Brace your core.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A seated overhead press with one dumbbell. Working one arm at a time shows any imbalances.

name: 杠杆坐姿深蹲
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder width apart.
Push through your feet to extend your legs.
Lower slowly until your knees are comfortably bent.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
description: A squat on a seated lever machine with a supported torso. It loads the thighs and glutes with a guided path.

name: 哑铃上斜交替锤式弯举
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench holding dumbbells with palms facing in.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl one dumbbell up without twisting your wrist.
Lower it slowly and repeat with the other arm.
Keep your upper arms still.
description: Hammer curls on an incline bench, one arm at a time. The stretched position makes the biceps and brachialis work hard.

name: 杠铃片山羊挺身
instructions: Set the hyperextension bench so your hips are just past the pad.
Hold a weight plate against your chest and cross your arms over it.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and avoid overarching.
description: A back extension holding a plate at your chest. It strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.

name: 杠杆单臂坐姿划船(坐姿划船机)
english: lever one arm seated row (seated row machine)
instructions: Sit at the machine with your chest on the pad and grab one handle.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle toward your torso, driving your elbow back.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A single-arm row on a seated machine. It lets you load one side of the back at a time.

name: 哑铃单臂划船(架子支撑)
instructions: Place one hand on a rack or sturdy support and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand with your arm hanging.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm row with your free hand braced on a rack for support. It lets you pull heavy while keeping your back steady.

name: 杠杆划船(挂片式)
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad, then grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest against the pad.
Pull the handles toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a moment.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A plate-loaded machine row. The guided path lets you pull heavy with good back engagement.

name: 绳索坐姿划船(弯杆)
instructions: Sit at a low cable station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the bent bar with both hands.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, keeping your back straight.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms slowly without rounding forward.
description: A seated cable row using a bent bar. The angled bar suits many wrists while you train the back.

name: 鸟狗式
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Extend your right arm forward and left leg back.
Keep your hips level and your back flat.
Hold for a moment, then return.
Repeat on the other side and alternate.
description: From hands and knees, you extend opposite arm and leg. It builds core control and back stability.

name: 卷腹(波速球)
instructions: Sit on the bosu ball and lie back so it supports your lower back.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders up by contracting your abs.
Hold the top briefly.
Lower slowly and keep your feet planted.
description: A crunch on a bosu ball. The unstable surface asks more from your core.

name: 死虫式 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower your right arm and left leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides.
Move slowly and keep your back flat.
description: A lying core drill where arms and legs reach out while your back stays down. It trains core control.

name: 交替打腿 v. 3
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Continue for a set time and breathe steadily.
description: Small alternating leg kicks while lying down. They fire up the lower abs and hip flexors.

name: 仰卧抬腿并保持
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until they are vertical.
Lower them to just above the floor and hold for a couple of seconds.
Repeat without letting your back arch.
description: Raising your legs from the floor and holding them up. It targets the lower abs.

name: 空心支撑
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs a few inches off the ground.
Hold the shape and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.
description: A gymnastics-style hold with your shoulders and legs lifted. It builds deep core strength.

name: 俄罗斯转体(药球)
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Lift your feet slightly if you can.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap the ball by your hip.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest tall and move with control.
description: Rotating a medicine ball from side to side while seated. It works the obliques.

name: 半雨刷式(屈腿)
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides for support.
Lift your knees to 90 degrees.
Lower both knees to one side, stopping before the floor.
Bring them back to the middle and go to the other side.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
description: Lying on your back and swinging bent legs side to side. It trains the obliques and lower abs.

name: 雨刷式(直腿)
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Raise your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side with control.
Lift them back to the middle and lower to the other side.
Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
description: Swinging straight legs from side to side like windshield wipers. It is a tough one for the obliques and lower abs.

name: 负重卷腹(手置脑后)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a weight behind your head with your elbows out.
Curl your shoulders up, contracting your abs.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.
description: A crunch with a weight held behind your head. The extra load makes it harder on the abs.

name: 杠杆驴式提踵
instructions: 将杠杆机调节至适合您身体的高度。
面向机器定位，脚趾放在脚踏平台上，脚后跟悬在边缘。
将手放在手柄或支撑杆上以保持稳定性。
用脚掌收紧小腿并尽可能高地抬起脚后跟。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A donkey calf raise on a lever machine. It trains the calves.

name: 弹力带卧推
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
正手握住带子手柄，间距略宽于肩宽。
充分伸展双臂，将弹力带推离胸部。
慢慢将弹力带放回到胸部，保持肘部呈 90 度角。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bench press using resistance bands. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: 杠铃下斜仰卧上拉
instructions: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，头部低于臀部，双脚固定。
旋前握住杠铃（手掌背向自己），双手之间的距离略宽于肩宽。
将手臂伸至胸部上方，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
以弧线动作将杠铃降低到头后，感受胸部和肩膀的伸展。
暂停片刻，然后反向动作将杠铃恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A pullover on a decline bench with a barbell. It trains the chest and lats.

name: 杠铃反握下斜卧推
english: barbell reverse grip decline bench press
instructions: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定，头部低于臀部。
反握抓住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃，慢慢将其降低到胸部，保持肘部内收。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A reverse-grip bench press on a decline bench. It trains the lower chest and triceps.

name: 杠铃反握上斜卧推
english: barbell reverse grip incline bench press
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
反握抓住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃，慢慢将其降低到胸部，保持肘部内收。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A reverse-grip bench press on an incline bench. It trains the upper chest and triceps.

name: 杠铃宽反握卧推
english: barbell wide reverse grip bench press
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
反握宽握杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其直接放在胸部上方，双臂完全伸展。
将杠铃慢慢降低到胸部，保持肘部内收，手腕伸直。
当杠铃接触胸部时暂停片刻，然后将其推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A wide reverse-grip bench press. It trains the chest and triceps.

name: 头后胸部拉伸
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将手指交叉放在脑后，肘部朝外。
慢慢地将肩胛骨挤压在一起，并将胸部向前推。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒。
松开拉伸并根据需要重复。
description: A stretch with the hands behind the head, pulling the elbows back. It opens the chest and shoulders.

name: 绳索下斜单臂推举
instructions: 将拉线机调整至下降位置。
背对机器站立，用一只手抓住手柄。
将背部靠在下斜长凳上，手臂伸直在身前。
弯曲肘部，将手柄向胸部方向降低，同时保持上臂静止。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将手柄推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm cable press from a decline angle. It trains the chest and triceps.

name: 绳索下斜推举
instructions: 将拉线机调整至下降位置。
坐在面向缆绳机的下降长凳上。
正手握住手柄并将其置于胸部水平。
将双脚平放在地面上，并将背部牢牢靠在长凳上。
呼气并将手柄推离身体，充分伸展双臂。
动作结束时暂停片刻，挤压胸部肌肉。
吸气并慢慢地将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A decline cable press for the lower chest. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: 绳索单臂下斜飞鸟
english: cable one arm decline chest fly
instructions: 将 D 形手柄连接到低滑轮绳索机器上，并将长凳设置为下降角度。
躺在长凳上，头朝向机器，用右手抓住手柄。
将手臂伸直至胸部上方，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
控制动作，将手臂向一侧放低，直到手与肩膀在一条直线上。
暂停片刻，然后反转动作并将手臂恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后切换到左臂并重复练习。
description: A one-arm decline chest fly with a cable. It trains the lower chest.

name: 绳索单臂飞鸟(稳定球)
english: cable one arm fly on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住电缆手柄，并将手臂向一侧伸出，与地面平行。
保持肘部稍微弯曲，手掌朝前。
慢慢地将手臂放在身体上，挤压胸部肌肉。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A one-arm cable fly seated on an exercise ball. It trains the chest and core.

name: 绳索单臂上斜飞鸟(稳定球)
english: cable one arm incline fly on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部靠在倾斜的长凳上。
一只手握住电缆手柄，手臂伸展，手掌朝内。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，慢慢地将手臂向一侧放低，直到手与肩膀在一条直线上。
暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm incline cable fly on an exercise ball. It trains the upper chest.

name: 绳索单臂上斜推举
instructions: 将拉索机调整至低滑轮位置。
坐在倾斜的长凳上，背对缆绳机。
用一只手抓住手柄并将其举至肩膀高度。
将双脚牢牢放在地面上并保持稳定的位置。
向前和向上按下手柄，充分伸展手臂。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A one-arm incline cable press. It trains the upper chest and shoulders.

name: 绳索单臂上斜推举(稳定球)
english: cable one arm incline press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部靠在倾斜的长凳上。
一只手握住电缆手柄，将手臂呈 90 度角，肘部弯曲。
向前和向上按下电缆手柄，完全伸展手臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将拉索手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
description: A one-arm incline cable press on an exercise ball. It trains the upper chest and balance.

name: 绳索单臂推举(稳定球)
english: cable one arm press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住电缆手柄，将手臂置于胸部高度，肘部弯曲。
将另一只手放在臀部上以保持稳定。
向前按电缆手柄，完全伸展手臂。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm cable press on an exercise ball. It trains the chest and core.

name: 绳索推举(稳定球)
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖呈 90 度角。
将电缆手柄保持在胸部高度，手掌朝下，肘部弯曲。
收紧核心并向前按压缆索手柄，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，并将电缆手柄拉回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A cable chest press on an exercise ball. It trains the chest and challenges balance.

name: 绳索站姿直立夹胸
instructions: 站在缆绳机中间，双脚分开与肩同宽。
手掌朝下握住电缆手柄，手臂伸直至两侧。
保持双臂伸直，将双手放在身体前面，相互交叉。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置，保持双臂伸展。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Standing cable crossovers with the hands crossing in front. It trains the chest.

name: 绳索上胸夹胸
instructions: 将手柄连接到胸部高度的电缆上。
站在绳索机的中央，一只脚稍微在另一只脚前面。
手掌朝下抓住手柄，手臂向两侧伸展。
保持肘部轻微弯曲并启动核心肌群。
将电缆在胸前拉到一起，使它们相互交叉。
在运动的最高点挤压胸部肌肉。
慢慢地将电缆释放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Cable crossovers aimed at the upper chest. It trains the upper pecs.

name: 胸部及前肩拉伸
english: chest and front of shoulder stretch
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直至前方，与肩同高。
双臂交叉在身体前方，右臂放在左臂上方。
手指交叉并将手掌压在一起。
轻轻地将肩胛骨挤压在一起，然后将双手向前推，感觉胸部和肩膀前部有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后放松。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A stretch for the chest and the fronts of the shoulders with the hands clasped. It loosens the chest.

name: 稳定球胸部拉伸
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
双手握住健身球，并将双臂伸直至身前。
慢慢地将健身球移向胸部，感受胸部肌肉的拉伸。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A chest stretch using an exercise ball held out in front. It loosens the chest.

name: 击掌俯卧撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
弯曲肘部，将身体降低到地面，保持核心参与。
爆发性地推动手掌，将身体推离地面。
在半空中时，拍手，然后回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An explosive push-up with a clap in mid-air. It builds power in the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: 深度俯卧撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使胸部靠近地面，使胸部靠近地面。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A deep push-up with a longer range of motion. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: 落地俯卧撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
将胸部压向地面，保持肘部靠近身体。
当你的胸部刚好高于地面时，迅速将膝盖放在地上。
伸展双臂，将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A push-up that drops to the knees and presses back up. It trains the chest and triceps.

name: 哑铃下斜单臂飞鸟
instructions: 躺在斜凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，将其放在大腿上。
用大腿帮助举起哑铃，将其举至与肩同宽，手掌朝向躯干。
旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
吸气时，将哑铃慢慢降低到一侧，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
呼气并使用胸部肌肉将哑铃拉回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: Lying on a decline bench, you open one arm out to the side with a dumbbell and bring it back over your chest. It works the lower chest one side at a time.

name: 哑铃飞鸟(稳定球)
instructions: 坐在健身球上，每只手各握一个哑铃。
双脚向前走，身体向下滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
将双臂伸直至胸部上方，手掌相对。
稍微弯曲肘部，将手臂以宽弧线向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后反向运动并挤压胸部肌肉，同时将​​哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell fly done lying back on a stability ball. The unstable surface makes your core work while the chest does the opening and closing.

name: 哑铃上斜飞鸟(稳定球)
english: dumbbell incline fly on exercise ball
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在健身球上，向前滚动，直到上背部靠在倾斜的长凳上。
双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对，双臂伸至胸部上方。
将哑铃以宽弧线向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使哑铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Dumbbell fly with your upper back on an incline bench and your hips supported by a stability ball. It hits the upper chest and challenges balance.

name: 哑铃上斜单臂飞鸟
instructions: 将倾斜凳调整至 30-45 度角。
坐在长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，将其放在大腿上。
向后躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上。
握住哑铃，手臂伸直越过胸部。
将哑铃以宽弧线向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
当手臂与地面平行时暂停，然后反向运动，使哑铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A single-arm fly on an incline bench that targets the upper chest. Working one side at a time helps you spot and fix left-right differences.

name: 哑铃上斜单臂飞鸟(稳定球)
english: dumbbell incline one arm fly on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃。
双脚向前走，身体向下滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
握住哑铃，手臂伸直越过胸部，手掌朝内。
慢慢地将哑铃向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
当手臂与地面平行时暂停片刻。
启动胸部肌肉，将哑铃拉回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: One-arm incline fly with your back supported on a stability ball. The unstable base adds a core challenge to the upper chest stretch.

name: 哑铃上斜单臂推举
instructions: 坐在上斜凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，放在大腿上。
仰卧在长凳上，将哑铃置于与肩同高的位置，手掌朝前。
将哑铃向上并稍微向内推，充分伸展手臂。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
description: Press a single dumbbell up from shoulder height on an incline bench. It builds the upper chest and shoulders and evens out strength between sides.

name: 哑铃上斜单臂推举(稳定球)
english: dumbbell incline one arm press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃，双脚平放在地上。
慢慢地向前移动你的脚，滚动球，直到你的头、脖子和上背部得到球的支撑。
将哑铃握在与肩同高的位置，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
description: A one-arm dumbbell press done with your upper back on a stability ball. Your core has to stay tight to keep you steady while the chest presses.

name: 哑铃上斜推举(稳定球)
english: dumbbell incline press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
双脚慢慢向前移动，身体沿着球滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
将哑铃保持在与肩同高的位置，肘部弯曲并指向两侧。
向上推哑铃，充分伸展手臂。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A two-dumbbell press with your upper back on a stability ball. It trains the chest and shoulders while your core works to keep you balanced.

name: 哑铃仰卧上拉(稳定球)
english: dumbbell lying pullover on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，向前滚动，直到上背部靠在球上。
双手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，同时保持手臂伸直。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lying across a stability ball, you arc one dumbbell back over your head and return it. It stretches and works the chest and lats.

name: 哑铃单臂卧姿飞鸟
instructions: 坐在平坦的长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，将其放在大腿上方。
向后躺在长凳上，将哑铃压在大腿上。
用空着的那只手帮助将哑铃举至起始位置。
将哑铃握在肩膀正上方，手臂伸展，手掌朝内。
将哑铃以宽弧线向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
当手臂与地面平行时暂停，然后反向运动并将哑铃带回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂重复。
description: Flat bench fly with a single dumbbell. Lowering in a wide arc stretches one side of the chest, and bringing it back squeezes it.

name: 哑铃单臂胸部飞鸟(稳定球)
english: dumbbell one arm chest fly on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃，双脚平放在地上。
双脚向前走，滚动球，直到你的上背部受到球的支撑，并且你的头、脖子和肩膀离开球。
将手臂伸直，将哑铃举至胸部上方，手掌朝内。
慢慢地将哑铃向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
当手臂与地面平行时暂停片刻。
启动胸部肌肉，将哑铃拉回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm chest fly with your upper back on a stability ball. The wobbly base brings your core in while the chest does the work.

name: 哑铃单臂下斜胸推
english: dumbbell one arm decline chest press
instructions: 躺在下斜长凳上，一只手握住哑铃，放在胸前。
将双脚平放在地面上，并将背部压在长凳上。
伸展手臂，将哑铃推向天花板，充分伸展肘部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
description: Press a single dumbbell up from a decline bench. It focuses on the lower chest and lets you train each side separately.

name: 哑铃单臂飞鸟(稳定球)
english: dumbbell one arm fly on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃，双脚平放在地上。
双脚向前走，身体向下滚动，直到上背部靠在健身球上。
将手臂伸直，将哑铃举至胸部上方，手掌朝内。
慢慢地将哑铃向一侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使哑铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: One-arm dumbbell fly with your upper back on a stability ball. It stretches and shapes the chest while your core keeps you steady.

name: 哑铃单臂上斜胸推
english: dumbbell one arm incline chest press
instructions: 将上斜凳调整至 45 度角。
坐在长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住哑铃，正手握住，将其放在肩膀上。
将哑铃向上推离身体，完全伸展手臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
description: Press one dumbbell up on an incline bench to train the upper chest and front shoulder. Working one arm at a time helps balance both sides.

name: 哑铃单臂推举(稳定球)
english: dumbbell one arm press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
一只手握住哑铃，将其置于与肩同高的位置，肘部弯曲，手掌朝前。
慢慢向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展，同时保持核心收紧并在健身球上保持平衡。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
description: A single-arm dumbbell press done seated or lying on a stability ball. Balance and core control are part of every rep.

name: 哑铃单臂上拉(稳定球)
english: dumbbell one arm pullover on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
用一只手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，同时保持手臂伸直。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A pullover with one dumbbell while your upper back rests on a stability ball. It stretches the chest and lats and asks your core to stay braced.

name: 哑铃单腿飞鸟(稳定球)
english: dumbbell one leg fly on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将一只脚放在地面上，并将另一条腿伸直到您面前。
稍微向前倾，将手臂向两侧伸出，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
慢慢地将哑铃向两侧放低，感觉胸部有拉伸感。
在底部暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使哑铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。
description: A dumbbell fly on a stability ball with one leg lifted, which makes balance harder. It works the chest and trains core stability.

name: 哑铃推举(稳定球)
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，双手各握哑铃，放在大腿上。
慢慢地向前移动双脚，滚动健身球，直到下背部受到球的支撑并且膝盖呈 90 度角。
将哑铃举至肩高，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Press two dumbbells up while your upper back rests on a stability ball. A good way to train the chest with extra core and balance demand.

name: 哑铃上拉伸髋(稳定球)
english: dumbbell pullover hip extension on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地面上，哑铃放在大腿上。
慢慢地向前移动你的脚，将健身球沿着你的背部滚动，直到你的头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
双手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
将哑铃放在脑后，保持手臂伸直并保持控制。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
在保持双臂伸展的同时，将臀部抬离地面，挤压臀肌并启动核心肌群。
将臀部放低至起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell pullover on a stability ball combined with a hip lift. It trains the chest and lats while the glutes and core hold your body steady.

name: 哑铃上拉(稳定球)
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双手握住哑铃，置于胸前，双臂伸展。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，同时保持手臂伸直。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell pullover performed on a stability ball. The arc behind your head stretches the chest and lats and keeps your core busy.

name: 稳定球屈体俯卧撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手放在地板上，小腿放在稳定球上。
收紧核心肌群，将臀部抬向天花板，将球滚向双手。
保持双腿伸直，身体呈屈体姿势，形成倒V字形。
弯曲肘部，将上半身降低到地板上，保持头部与双手在一条直线上。
用手推动并伸展双臂以返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A pike push-up with your feet on a stability ball. It builds shoulders and chest and works your core to hold the ball steady.

name: 等长夹胸
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行，手掌相对。
尽可能用力挤压胸部肌肉，同时保持手臂伸直。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，专注于收缩胸部肌肉。
释放挤压并放松胸部肌肉。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Press your palms or arms together in front of your chest and hold the squeeze. A simple way to feel and train the chest with no equipment.

name: 壶铃单臂地板推举
instructions: 仰卧在地板上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住壶铃，手掌朝向脚部，手臂笔直向上伸向天花板。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将壶铃降低到胸部，保持上臂靠近身体。
当壶铃位于胸部正上方时暂停片刻，然后通过伸展肘部将壶铃推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
description: Lying on the floor, press a kettlebell straight up with one arm. The floor limits the range, which is gentle on the shoulder while building the chest and triceps.

name: 杠杆上斜胸推
instructions: 将杠杆机的座椅和靠背调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
向前推动手柄并使其远离身体，直到双臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢弯曲肘部，将手柄放回到胸部。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A machine press with the handles set on an incline path. It works the upper chest and front shoulders with a fixed, stable motion.

name: 杠杆下斜胸推
instructions: 将杠杆机的座椅高度和靠背调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
向前推动手柄并使其远离身体，直到双臂完全伸展。
慢慢地将手柄放回胸部，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将手柄推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A machine press that travels along a decline path. It focuses on the lower chest and triceps in a fixed, stable motion.

name: 器械内侧胸推
instructions: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，背部平放在垫子上。
正手握住手柄，肘部呈 90 度角。
向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，运动过程中呼气。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置，同时吸气。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated machine chest press where the handles bring your hands together. It emphasises the inner chest in a stable path.

name: 药球胸前传球
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将健身球保持在胸部水平。
向前伸展双臂，用力将药球推离胸部。
当你释放球时，用你的手臂和躯干将球从后脚转移到前脚。
当球从墙壁或伙伴身上反弹时接住球，并立即重复该动作。
继续进行所需的重复次数。
description: Throw a medicine ball forward from your chest with a quick push, then catch it and repeat. It builds explosive pushing power in the chest and arms.

name: 药球三点支撑胸推
english: medicine ball chest push from 3 point stance
instructions: 以三点姿势开始，一只手放在健身球上，另一只手放在地上。
伸展双腿并将身体摆成一条直线。
将胸部压向地面，同时保持背部挺直。
将药球推离身体，完全伸展手臂。
返回起始位置并重复所需的重复次数。
description: From a three point stance with one hand on a medicine ball, you push the ball away explosively. It trains the chest and arms with power and balance.

name: 药球连续胸推
english: medicine ball chest push multiple response
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将药球举至胸部水平。
向前伸展双臂，将药球推离胸部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将健身球放回胸前。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Push a medicine ball away from your chest and catch it again in a quick, repeated flow. It builds explosive chest and arm power.

name: 药球单次胸推
english: medicine ball chest push single response
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将健身球保持在胸部水平。
向前伸展双臂，将药球推离胸部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将健身球放回胸前。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Push a medicine ball away from your chest in one strong effort, reset, then go again. It trains explosive power in the chest and arms.

name: 增强式俯卧撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，保持身体呈一条直线。
爆发性地推离地面，利用胸部肌肉将上半身推离地面。
双手回到起始位置，轻轻落地。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A push-up that you drive explosively so your hands leave the floor. It builds fast pressing power in the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: 波速球俯卧撑
instructions: 将博苏球平放在地上，平面朝上。
将自己置于俯卧撑位置，双手放在博苏球的外边缘。
弯曲肘部，调动核心力量，将身体向博苏球方向降低。
伸展双臂，将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A push-up with your hands on a bosu ball. The unstable surface makes your chest, shoulders and core work harder to stay steady.

name: 史密斯机宽握卧推
instructions: 将史密斯机上的长凳调整到舒适的位置。
躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
宽握距抓住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其慢慢降低到胸部，保持肘部向两侧伸出。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bench press on a smith machine with a wide grip. The fixed bar path lets you focus on pressing, with extra work for the outer chest.

name: 史密斯机宽握下斜卧推
english: smith wide grip decline bench press
instructions: 将下斜凳调整至所需角度。
躺在长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
宽握距抓住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其慢慢降低到胸部，保持肘部朝外。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A smith machine bench press on a decline bench with a wide grip. It targets the lower chest along a guided bar path.

name: 负重落地俯卧撑
instructions: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
将胸部压向地面，保持肘部靠近身体。
一旦你的胸部刚好高于地面，爆发性地把自己推起来，将双手抬离地面。
当你向上推时，快速将双手移至两侧并稍微向前，让你的身体向地面落下。
将双手置于更宽的位置，然后立即再次将胸部降低到地面。
重复俯卧撑动作，下降并用双手抓住自己在较窄的位置。
继续在更宽和更窄的手位置之间交替，以达到所需的重复次数。
description: A weighted push-up variation where you drop and shift your hands between push-ups for extra load. It challenges the chest and triceps.

name: 宽距俯卧撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开比肩宽。
保持身体从头到脚呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，使其靠近身体两侧。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A push-up with your hands placed wider than your shoulders. It puts more emphasis on the chest and less on the triceps.

name: 药球跑动出手胸推
english: medicine ball chest push with run release
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将药球举至胸部水平。
右脚向前迈出一步，同时向前推动药球，充分伸展双臂。
当你向前推动球时，松开它并让它向前滚动。
快速向前跑，在球落地之前接住球。
接住球后，将其放回胸前，左脚向前重复该动作。
继续交替双腿并重复练习达到所需的重复次数。
description: Push a medicine ball forward from your chest, then sprint after it and catch it. It trains explosive chest power plus quick acceleration.

name: 杠杆单侧划船
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己面向机器。
正手握住手柄并保持背部挺直。
将手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A machine row where you pull each handle independently. It works the upper back and lets you even out strength differences between sides.

name: 稳定球背部伸展
instructions: 将稳定球放在地面上，面朝下躺在上面，臀部放在球上，双脚靠在墙壁或其他稳定的表面上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉在胸前。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身抬离球，伸展你的背部，直到你的身体从头部到脚后跟形成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lie face down over a stability ball and lift your chest to extend your back. It strengthens the lower back and glutes in a supported way.

name: 背部放松
instructions: Get into a comfortable resting position, such as kneeling with your torso folded forward.
Rest your arms in a relaxed position.
Let your back round and release.
Breathe slowly into your lower back.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.
description: A gentle resting position that lets the back relax and lengthen after training.

name: 杠铃屈臂上拉
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，头放在一端，双脚放在地板上。
握距与肩同宽，握住杠铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
将杠铃放在脑后，同时保持手臂稍微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后将杠铃举回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lying on a bench, move a barbell in an arc behind your head and back over your chest with soft elbows. It works the lats and chest.

name: 杠铃反握上斜凳划船
english: barbell reverse grip incline bench row
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，面向靠背，胸部靠在靠背上。
反握（手掌朝下）抓住杠铃，双手距离略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将杠铃拉向上腹部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢地将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A barbell row with an underhand grip, done chest down on an incline bench. The support removes momentum and targets the upper back and biceps.

name: 绳索上斜凳划船
instructions: 以 45 度角设置一个上斜凳，并将绳索手柄连接到低滑轮上。
坐在长凳上，面向电缆机，双脚平放在地板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住电缆手柄，并将双臂完全伸展到身前。
从臀部开始向前倾，同时保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
缩回肩胛骨并弯曲肘部，将电缆手柄拉向胸部。
在动作的最高点挤压背部肌肉，然后慢慢伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A cable row done on an incline bench so your torso is supported. It works the upper back and biceps without lower back strain.

name: 绳索旋掌划船
instructions: 将手柄连接到腰部高度的缆绳机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄，手掌朝下。
向后退一步，在绳索上产生张力，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将手柄拉向身体，同时将手掌旋转至向上。
在动作结束时将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A cable row where your palms rotate from facing down to facing up as you pull. It works the upper back, lats and biceps through a twisting path.

name: 绳索绳把交叉坐姿划船
instructions: 坐在划船机上，双脚平放在脚踏板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住缆绳，手掌相对。
稍微向后倾斜，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将缆绳拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated cable row using a rope so your hands can cross and finish wide. It works the upper back and lats with a longer range of motion.

name: 绳索绳把抬高坐姿划船
instructions: 坐在面向电缆机的高架座椅上。
正手握住缆绳手柄，手掌相对。
保持背部挺直并稍微向后倾斜，保持膝盖轻微弯曲。
通过缩回肩胛骨并挤压背部肌肉，将电缆拉向您的身体。
在完全收缩的位置暂停片刻。
慢慢释放压力并将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated cable row using a rope from an elevated seat position. It trains the upper back, lats and biceps with a neutral grip.

name: 绳索绳把伸展上斜凳划船
english: cable rope extension incline bench row
instructions: 以 45 度角设置上斜凳，并将绳索机连接到低滑轮上。
将绳索手柄连接到缆绳机上，然后坐在面向机器的倾斜长凳上。
正手抓住绳索把手，身体前倾，保持背部挺直。
充分伸展双臂，将绳子拉向上胸部，同时保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作结束时将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢释放张力并回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A rope cable row done chest down on an incline bench. The support keeps your torso still so the upper back does the pulling.

name: 绳索绳把坐姿划船
instructions: 坐在划船机上，双脚平放在脚踏板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住缆绳，手掌相对。
保持背部挺直，稍微向前倾斜，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
将缆绳拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated row with a rope attachment on a cable station. The neutral grip works the upper back, lats and biceps.

name: 绳索上部划船
instructions: 将直杆连接到胸部高度的缆绳机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，双手距离略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将杠铃拉向上胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢地将杠铃释放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A cable row with a straight bar pulled toward your upper chest. It targets the upper back and rear shoulders.

name: 绳索宽握颈后下拉
english: cable wide grip rear pulldown behind neck
instructions: 调整缆绳机，使下拉杆位于您头部上方的高度。
坐在座椅上，用宽的正手握法抓住下拉杆。
稍微向后倾斜时，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将杠铃向下拉至上胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃释放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A wide grip pulldown where the bar travels behind your neck. It works the lats and upper back but needs good shoulder mobility and control.

name: 反握引体向上
instructions: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌朝向自己，双手与肩同宽。
启动核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip and pull until your chin clears it. A classic builder of the lats and biceps.

name: 窄握反握引体向上
instructions: 抓住引体向上杆，手掌朝向自己，双手与肩同宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，双脚离开地面。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A chin-up with your hands close together on an underhand grip. It works the lats and puts extra load on the biceps.

name: 哑铃俯卧后三角肌划船
instructions: 脸朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝内。
将手臂伸直向下伸向地板，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
调动背部肌肉，将哑铃举向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lie face down on a bench and row two dumbbells up and out. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back without any body swing.

name: 哑铃旋掌俯身划船
english: dumbbell palm rotational bent over row
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
让你的手臂笔直下垂，手掌朝向身体。
收紧核心肌群，将哑铃拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
当你向上拉哑铃时，旋转手掌，使其背向身体。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，将手掌旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bent over dumbbell row where your palms rotate as you pull. It works the upper back, lats and biceps through a varied path.

name: 哑铃反握上斜凳单臂划船
english: dumbbell reverse grip incline bench one arm row
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
将哑铃放在长凳旁边的地板上。
面对长凳站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲腰部，将左膝和左手放在长凳上以获得支撑。
用右手反握（手掌朝下）拿起哑铃。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将哑铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作的最高点挤压背部肌肉。
以受控的方式将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用左臂重复练习。
description: A one-arm row with an underhand grip, supported on an incline bench. It works the upper back and biceps one side at a time.

name: 哑铃反握上斜凳双臂划船
english: dumbbell reverse grip incline bench two arm row
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，胸部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地上。
双手各握一个哑铃，反握。
身体前倾，双臂伸直下垂，完全伸展。
将哑铃拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A two-arm dumbbell row with an underhand grip, chest down on an incline bench. The support keeps you strict so the back and biceps work.

name: 稳定球交替举臂
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝内，双臂在身体两侧向下伸展。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将一只手臂向肩膀抬起，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。
description: Seated on a stability ball, you raise dumbbells one arm at a time. It trains the shoulders and upper back while your core keeps you balanced.

name: 稳定球背部伸展(手臂伸直)
english: exercise ball back extension with arms extended
instructions: 将稳定球放在地上，面朝下躺在上面，臀部放在球上，双脚靠在墙上以保持稳定。
将双臂伸直在身前，手掌朝下。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将上半身抬离球，保持背部挺直，颈部与脊柱成一直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lie face down on a stability ball with your arms reaching forward and lift your torso. It strengthens the lower back and glutes with extra leverage.

name: 稳定球背部伸展(手放脑后)
english: exercise ball back extension with hands behind head
instructions: 将稳定球放在地上，面朝下躺在上面，臀部放在球上。
将脚靠在墙壁或其他稳定的表面上以获得支撑。
双臂交叉于脑后，双手触碰后脑勺。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身抬离球，伸展你的背部，直到你的身体从头部到臀部形成一条直线。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A stability ball back extension with your hands behind your head. It strengthens the lower back, glutes and upper back.

name: 稳定球背部伸展(膝盖离地)
english: exercise ball back extension with knees off ground
instructions: 将稳定球放在地上，面朝下躺在上面，臀部放在球上，双脚靠在墙上以保持稳定。
将双手放在脑后或交叉在胸前。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身抬离球，伸展你的背部，直到你的身体从头部到脚后跟形成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A back extension on a stability ball with your legs braced so your knees stay off the ground. It works the lower back and glutes.

name: 稳定球背部伸展并旋转
english: exercise ball back extension with rotation
instructions: 首先，面朝下躺在稳定球上，臀部放在球上，双脚牢牢踩在地面上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身抬离球，伸展你的背部，直到你的身体从头部到脚后跟形成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将躯干旋转到一侧，保持臀部和腿部稳定。
返回中心并重复旋转到另一侧。
将上半身放低至起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。
description: A stability ball back extension where you add a twist at the top. It trains the lower back, glutes and obliques.

name: 稳定球背部拉伸
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet forward.
Lean back until your back rests over the ball.
Let your arms fall overhead and relax.
Breathe deeply and let your back open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
description: Draping your back over a stability ball to lengthen the spine and stretch the lats.

name: 稳定球拥抱
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
用双手握住稳定球，将其抱在靠近胸部的位置。
启动你的核心肌肉，慢慢向后倾斜，保持背部挺直，双脚踩在地上。
继续向后倾斜，直到感觉到背部肌肉伸展。
保持该姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Sit on a stability ball and lean back into it while hugging the ball. It gently opens up the back and stretches the spine.

name: 稳定球背阔肌拉伸
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，然后将手臂伸直至头顶。
慢慢地向另一侧倾斜，感受背阔肌的拉伸。
保持伸展动作 20-30 秒，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
description: Sit on a stability ball and reach one arm overhead as you lean to the other side. It stretches the lat and the side of your torso.

name: 稳定球下背部俯卧拉伸
english: exercise ball lower back prone stretch
instructions: Kneel by a stability ball and lay your torso over it.
Roll forward so your hips rest on the ball.
Let your arms and head hang down in a relaxed way.
Breathe slowly and let your lower back release.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
description: Lying face down over a stability ball to stretch the lower back.

name: 稳定球下背部拉伸(金字塔式)
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
慢慢地向前移动你的脚，将球沿着你的背部滚动，直到你的下背部靠在球上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身降低到地面，让你的下背部伸展到球上方。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lie back over a stability ball to open up and stretch the lower back. It is a gentle, supported way to ease tightness.

name: 稳定球侧卧背阔肌拉伸
english: exercise ball lying side lat stretch
instructions: 侧躺，双腿伸展，头部由稳定球支撑。
将上臂放在球上以保持稳定性。
将上臂举过头顶，让躯干稍微旋转。
感受身体一侧背阔肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后换边重复。
description: Lie on your side with a stability ball supporting you and reach overhead. It stretches the lat and the side of your torso.

name: 稳定球俯卧抬腿
instructions: 面朝下躺在垫子上，双腿伸展，脚趾放在稳定球上。
将双手放在地上，与肩同宽，锻炼核心肌肉。
保持双腿伸直，慢慢将它们抬离地面，用下背部和臀部将它们尽可能抬高。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lie face down with your toes on a stability ball and lift your legs. It works the lower back and glutes with a gentle range.

name: EZ杠反握俯身划船
english: ez bar reverse grip bent over row
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
反手握住 ez 杠铃，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，挺胸，直到躯干几乎与地板平行。
将 ez 杠铃拉向下胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将 ez 杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bent over row with an ez barbell and an underhand grip. It targets the upper back and lats with extra work for the biceps.

name: 壶铃双臂划船
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，双手各握一个壶铃，手掌朝向身体。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将壶铃拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将壶铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Hinge forward and row a kettlebell in each hand to your sides. It works the upper back and lats and trains grip strength.

name: 跪姿背阔肌拉伸
instructions: 跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽，脚趾向后。
将双臂伸过头顶，手指交叉。
保持背部挺直，慢慢向右侧倾斜，感受左侧背阔肌的拉伸。
保持伸展动作 20-30 秒，然后回到起始位置。
在左侧重复该拉伸动作，向左侧倾斜，感受右侧背阔肌的拉伸。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: Kneel and reach your arms overhead, then lean to one side. It stretches the lat and the side of your torso.

name: 杠杆单臂侧向宽握下拉
english: lever one arm lateral wide pulldown
instructions: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，完全伸展手臂，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
将手柄向下拉，穿过身体向对面的臀部方向拉，在动作底部挤压背阔肌。
慢慢地将手柄返回到起始位置，完全伸展手臂。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A one-arm pulldown on a lever machine that works the lats one side at a time. It helps even out strength between left and right.

name: 杠杆反握垂直划船
instructions: 调整座椅高度和踏板位置以确保正确对齐。
坐在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在踏板上。
反手握住手柄，手掌朝上。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手柄拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A machine row with an underhand grip and a vertical handle path. It works the upper back, lats and biceps.

name: 杠杆反向T杠划船
instructions: 调整杠杆机上的座椅高度和踏板位置。
坐在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在踏板上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手柄拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A reverse grip row on a t-bar style machine, chest supported. It builds the upper back and lats with a strict path.

name: 杠杆坐姿划船
instructions: 将座椅高度和脚踏板调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚放在脚踏板上。
正手握住手柄，距离与肩同宽。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢松开手柄并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated row on a lever machine with chest support. It works the upper back and lats with minimal lower back strain.

name: 杠杆T杠反握划船
instructions: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手柄拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A t-bar style machine row with a reverse grip and chest support. It works the upper back, lats and biceps.

name: 下背部卷曲
instructions: 平躺，双腿伸直，双臂放在身体两侧。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向上弯曲背部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lie face down and lift your chest off the floor in a curling motion. It strengthens the lower back with a gentle bodyweight movement.

name: 药球接球并过头抛
english: medicine ball catch and overhead throw
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住健身球，与胸部齐平。
稍微弯曲膝盖并启动核心。
将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直、挺胸。
爆发性伸展臀部和腿部，同时将药球扔过头顶。
在动作的最高点释放球并在下降的过程中接住它。
将身体放回蹲姿，然后重复所需的重复次数。
description: Squat down, then explode up and throw a medicine ball overhead and catch it again. It trains power through the hips, back and shoulders.

name: 药球过头砸球
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住药球举过头顶。
启动你的核心并保持背部挺直。
稍微弯曲膝盖，用力将药球摔到你面前的地面上。
当你击球时，用你的整个身体来产生力量，包括你的肩膀和核心。
接住球的弹跳并重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lift a medicine ball overhead and slam it into the floor with force. It builds full body power and trains the lats, core and shoulders.

name: 单臂靠墙
instructions: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将一只手臂伸直到身前，将手掌靠在墙上。
启动你的核心，身体向前倾斜，保持手臂伸直，背部平坦。
用手掌慢慢推向墙壁，激活背阔肌。
保持该姿势几秒钟，然后松开并用另一只手臂重复该动作。
description: Stand facing a wall and press one arm into it while you lean in. It switches on the lats and shoulder with no equipment.

name: 杠杆单臂侧向高位划船
english: lever one arm lateral high row
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己面向机器。
用一只手抓住手柄并保持背部挺直。
将手柄拉向身体，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在动作的最高点挤压背部肌肉。
慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A one-arm high row on a lever machine. It works the upper back and lats and lets you train each side on its own.

name: 单手悬垂
instructions: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it with one hand.
Lift your feet and hang with your arm straight.
Keep your shoulder active and your body still.
Hold for 10-20 seconds.
Lower yourself carefully and switch hands.
description: Hanging from a bar with just one hand. It builds grip strength and gives the shoulder a stretch.

name: 侧卧地面拉伸
instructions: 侧躺，双腿伸直，下臂伸直过头顶。
弯曲上面的膝盖，将脚放在下面的腿前面的地面上。
将上臂伸过头顶，抓住稳定的东西，例如墙壁或一件家具。
慢慢地将下面的腿抬离地面，保持伸直，直到感觉到身体一侧有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后慢慢将腿放下。
在另一侧重复。
description: Lie on your side and reach overhead to open up the side of your torso. It stretches the lats and the muscles between your ribs.

name: 史密斯机俯身划船
instructions: 将史密斯机设置为与臀部高度相同的杠铃。
面向杠铃站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
正手握住杠铃，双手距离略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃拉向下胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bent over row using a smith machine bar with an overhand grip. The fixed path helps you focus on the upper back and lats.

name: 史密斯机单臂划船
instructions: 将史密斯机杆的高度调整至腰部水平。
面对史密斯机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
用一只手正手握住杠铃，手掌朝下。
保持肘部靠近身体，将杠铃拉向腰部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
description: A one-arm row using a smith machine bar. It trains the upper back and lats one side at a time along a guided path.

name: 史密斯机反握俯身划船
english: smith reverse grip bent over row
instructions: 将史密斯机设置为与臀部高度相同的杠铃。
面向杠铃站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
将杠铃拉向下胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bent over row on a smith machine with an underhand grip. It works the upper back, lats and biceps along a guided path.

name: 狮身人面式
instructions: 面朝下躺在地上，前臂平放在地板上，肘部直接位于肩膀下方。
收紧核心肌群，将胸部抬离地面，将前臂和脚趾保持在地板上。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，确保颈部保持在中立位置。
慢慢地将胸部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms with your chest lifted. It gently extends the spine and opens the chest.

name: 脊柱拉伸
instructions: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将双手放在身后的地面上，手指指向身体。
启动你的核心并慢慢向后倾斜，保持背部挺直。
继续向后倾斜，直到感觉到脊柱被拉伸。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Sit with your legs out in front of you and lean back on your hands. It gives the spine and front of the torso a gentle stretch.

name: 站姿骨盆后倾
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双手放在臀部或垂在身体两侧。
