调动核心肌肉并向前倾斜骨盆，将下背部推向身后的墙壁。
保持该位置几秒钟，然后松开并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Stand and tilt your pelvis back and forth to move your lower back. It loosens the lower back and teaches pelvic control.

name: 上背部拉伸
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行。
手指交叉，手掌旋转远离身体。
慢慢地将手臂举过头顶，保持它们伸直并彼此平行。
当你举起手臂时，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，然后松开并重复。
description: Reach your arms forward and round your upper back to open up the space between your shoulder blades. It stretches the upper back.

name: 上犬式
instructions: 脸朝下躺在地板上，双腿伸到身后。
将双手放在下肋骨旁边的地板上，手指指向前方。
双手用力按在地板上，伸直手臂，将躯干和大腿抬离地面。
向后和向下转动肩膀，打开胸部，将目光转向天花板。
保持这个姿势几次呼吸，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A yoga pose where you lift your chest and thighs off the floor on straight arms. It opens the chest and strengthens the back.

name: 宽握颈后引体向上
instructions: 正手宽握抓住引体向上杆，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
调动背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A pull-up on a wide overhand grip, pulling to the back of your neck or upper chest. It targets the lats and upper back.

name: 踝关节绕环
instructions: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将一条腿抬离地面，并以圆周运动旋转脚踝。
在一个方向上转所需的圈数，然后切换到另一个方向。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
description: Sit and move your foot in slow circles from the ankle. It warms up the ankle joint and the muscles around the calf.

name: 弹力带双腿提踵(弹力带踩于双脚下) v. 2
english: band two legs calf raise - (band under both legs) v. 2
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，并将阻力带放在双脚下方。
用手握住带子的末端以保持稳定。
用小腿将脚跟抬离地面，尽可能高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing calf raise with a resistance band under both feet. It builds the calves and ankle strength with progressive tension.

name: 杠铃地面提踵
instructions: 将杠铃放在您面前的地板上。
站立，脚掌放在杠铃边缘，脚跟悬垂。
如果需要，请抓住一个稳定的物体以保持平衡。
尽可能高地抬高脚后跟，用小腿来抬起身体。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Stand with a barbell across your back and raise onto your toes from the floor. It works the calves, with the full range limited to flat ground.

name: 杠铃坐姿提踵
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地板上，杠铃放在大腿上。
将脚掌放在升高的平台上，例如木块或台阶。
尽可能降低脚后跟，感受小腿的拉伸。
尽可能高地抬高脚后跟，收缩小腿。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Seated calf raise with a barbell resting on your thighs. The bent knee shifts the work to the soleus muscle under the calf.

name: 杠铃站姿提踵
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
仅用脚趾将脚后跟抬离地面，尽可能高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Stand with a barbell on your upper back and rise onto your toes. It builds the calves and ankle strength.

name: 徒手站姿提踵
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾指向前方。
将手放在墙壁或稳定的表面上以保持平衡。
慢慢地将脚后跟抬离地面，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing calf raise using just your body weight. It strengthens the calves and ankles and needs no equipment.

name: 跳下箱并单腿稳定
english: box jump down with one leg stabilization
instructions: 站在盒子或平台前，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖，跳到盒子上，一只脚轻轻落地，另一只脚悬在盒子边缘。
将脚踩在盒子上，将自己稳定在盒子上，同时保持另一只脚离开地面。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，锻炼小腿肌肉以保持平衡。
将放在盒子上的脚慢慢放下，回到起始位置。
用另一条腿重复该练习。
description: Step off a box and land on both feet, then hold the landing on one leg. It builds landing control and strengthens the calves and ankle.

name: 绳索站姿提踵
instructions: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
握住电缆机手柄或将电缆脚踝带固定在脚踝上。
尽可能高地伸展脚踝，将脚后跟抬离地面。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing calf raise using a cable for resistance. It builds the calves with a steady pull through the whole movement.

name: 绳索站姿单腿提踵
english: cable standing one leg calf raise
instructions: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
抓住电缆机以获得支撑。
将一条腿抬离地面并用另一条腿保持平衡。
慢慢地将脚跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。
description: A one-leg standing calf raise using a cable for resistance. It trains each calf separately and helps balance.

name: 双手撑墙小腿拉伸
english: calf stretch with hands against wall
instructions: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将双手靠在墙上，与肩同高。
右脚向后退一步，保持脚后跟着地，腿伸直。
弯曲左膝并向前倾斜，保持后腿伸直，脚后跟着地。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
换腿并重复拉伸。
description: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it, one foot back with heel down. It stretches the calf of the back leg.

name: 绳子小腿拉伸
instructions: 面向墙壁或坚固物体站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
双手握住绳子的两端，将绳子的中间放在右脚掌周围。
左脚向后退一步，脚跟保持在地面上，腿伸直。
身体前倾，保持背部挺直，轻轻拉动绳子以伸展小腿。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后放松。
在另一条腿上重复。
description: A calf stretch where you use a rope to help pull your toes toward you. It stretches the calf and the back of the lower leg.

name: 哑铃坐姿提踵
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上，并将哑铃放在大腿上。
将脚掌放在升高的表面（例如台阶或木块）上，脚跟悬在边缘外。
握住哑铃以保持稳定。
尽可能高地抬高脚后跟，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Seated calf raise with a dumbbell resting on your knees. The bent knee focuses on the soleus beneath the calf.

name: 哑铃坐姿单腿提踵(锤式握)
english: dumbbell seated one leg calf raise - hammer grip
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上，并将哑铃放在大腿上。
将一只脚放在凸起的表面上，例如台阶或木块，脚跟悬在边缘之外。
用锤式握法握住哑铃，这意味着您的手掌相对，手指缠绕在手柄上。
保持核心收紧，背部挺直，通过脚掌推动，将脚后跟慢慢抬高，尽可能高。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一条腿。
description: A one-leg seated calf raise with a dumbbell held in a hammer grip. It trains the soleus under the calf one side at a time.

name: 哑铃坐姿单腿提踵(掌心向上)
english: dumbbell seated one leg calf raise - palm up
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住哑铃，将其放在大腿上方，掌心朝上。
将一条腿抬离地面并将其延伸到您面前，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
通过脚掌推动，尽可能高地抬起脚后跟。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。
description: A one-leg seated calf raise with a dumbbell held with your palm up. It works the soleus under the calf one side at a time.

name: 稳定球靠墙提踵
english: exercise ball on the wall calf raise
instructions: 背靠墙站立，将健身球放在下背部和墙壁之间。
双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾指向前方。
每只手握住一个哑铃，双臂伸向身体两侧。
将脚跟抬离地面，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Calf raises with a stability ball held between your back and a wall. It works the calves while the ball helps you stay balanced.

name: 哈克提踵
instructions: 将雪橇机调整至舒适的重量。
站在雪橇机上，脚趾放在平台上，脚后跟悬空。
握住手柄以保持稳定性。
通过推动脚掌将脚后跟尽可能抬高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A calf raise on a hack machine, pushing through the balls of your feet. It builds the calves under a supported load.

name: 哈克单腿提踵
instructions: 将雪橇机调整到合适的重量。
一脚站在雪橇机上，另一只脚离开地面。
握住手柄以保持稳定性。
尽可能高地抬高脚跟，用脚掌抬起身体。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
换腿并重复练习。
description: A one-leg calf raise on a hack machine. It lets you train each calf on its own under a supported load.

name: 杠杆坐姿深蹲提踵(腿举机)
english: lever seated squat calf raise on leg press machine
instructions: 调整压腿机的座椅，使双脚放在踏板上时膝盖稍微弯曲。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在踏板上，与肩同宽。
将脚趾和脚掌放在踏板上，使脚后跟远离边缘。
松开安全手柄，并通过伸展膝盖将踏板推离您。
一旦膝盖完全伸展，弯曲小腿，慢慢降低脚后跟。
在底部停顿片刻，然后通过伸展小腿将踏板向后推。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A calf raise performed on a leg press machine by pressing with your toes. It builds the calves with a stable, supported load.

name: 单腿驴式提踵
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾指向前方。
将双手放在稳定的表面上以获得支撑，例如墙壁或酒吧。
将一条腿抬离地面，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
使用小腿肌肉，尽可能高地抬高脚跟。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。
description: A one-leg donkey calf raise where you bend forward and rise onto your toes. It trains the calf with a deep stretch at the bottom.

name: 单腿地面提踵
instructions: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立，双手放在墙壁或坚固的物体上以保持平衡。
将一只脚抬离地面并用另一只脚保持平衡。
慢慢地将脚跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚掌上。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。
description: A one-leg calf raise on the floor with a hand on a wall for balance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.

name: 腓骨肌拉伸
instructions: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将绳子绕在脚掌上，并用手握住绳子的末端。
轻轻地将绳子拉向自己，弯曲脚并伸展小腿肌肉。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒。
释放绳子上的张力，然后在另一条腿上重复拉伸。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated stretch where you turn your foot to open the outer side of your lower leg. It targets the peroneal muscles beside the calf.

name: 胫骨后肌拉伸
instructions: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将绳子绕在脚掌上，并用手握住绳子的末端。
轻轻地将绳子拉向自己，弯曲脚并伸展小腿肌肉。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
释放绳子上的张力并放松脚。
在另一条腿上重复该拉伸动作。
description: A seated stretch that opens the inner side of the lower leg. It targets the posterior tibialis along your shin and ankle.

name: 坐姿小腿拉伸(男)
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳的边缘，双脚平放在地面上。
将一只腿伸直在身前，脚跟保持在地面上。
稍微向前倾，感受小腿肌肉的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
换腿并重复拉伸。
description: Sit on a chair and reach to pull your toes toward you. It stretches the calf and the back of the lower leg.

name: 滑车腿举机小腿推
english: sled calf press on leg press
instructions: 调整压腿机的座椅，使双脚踩在雪橇上时膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双脚与肩同宽放在雪橇上，脚趾指向前方。
松开安全手柄，并通过伸展膝盖和脚踝将雪橇推离您。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后弯曲膝盖和脚踝，慢慢将雪橇放回原处。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A calf press done on a leg press sled using only your toes. It builds the calves under a supported load.

name: 滑车腿举机单腿小腿推
english: sled one leg calf press on leg press
instructions: 调整压腿机的座椅，使双脚踩在雪橇上时膝盖稍微弯曲。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚放在雪橇上，与肩同宽。
将脚趾和脚掌放在雪橇上，保持脚跟离开。
伸展脚踝，保持膝盖稍微弯曲，将雪橇向前推。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后通过弯曲脚踝慢慢将雪橇放回原处。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A one-leg calf press on a leg press sled using only your toes. It trains each calf separately under a supported load.

name: 史密斯机单腿地面提踵
english: smith one leg floor calf raise
instructions: 将自己放在史密斯机杆下方的地板上，背对机器。
将脚掌放在凸起的表面上，例如举重板或杠铃块。
将史密斯机杆放在小腿上，就在脚踝上方。
用手握住横杆以保持稳定。
伸展脚踝，将脚后跟抬离地面，抬起身体。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢降低脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A one-leg calf raise lifting a smith machine bar from the floor. It works each calf on its own under a guided bar path.

name: 史密斯机反向提踵
instructions: 将史密斯机杆调整到略低于肩膀的高度。
面向杠铃站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，脚趾向前。
将脚掌放在台阶或平台的边缘，脚后跟悬空。
抓住横杆以获得支撑。
尽可能高地抬高脚跟，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A smith machine calf raise done with the bar in front of you. It targets the calves and the muscles around the shin.

name: 史密斯机坐姿单腿提踵
english: smith seated one leg calf raise
instructions: 坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚放在脚踏板上。
将一条腿放在脚踏板上，另一条腿离开脚踏板。
使用小腿肌肉，尽可能高地抬高脚跟。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。
description: A seated one-leg calf raise using a smith machine. The bent knee puts the focus on the soleus under the calf.

name: 史密斯机脚尖提升
instructions: 将史密斯机杆调整到一个高度，让您可以舒适地站立，双脚平放在地面上。
将自己置于杠铃下方，肩膀位于杠铃正下方，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将脚掌放在升高的平台或重量板上，脚后跟悬在边缘。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
在整个练习过程中启动你的核心并保持背部挺直。
慢慢地尽可能高地抬起脚后跟，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A smith machine toe raise where you rise onto the balls of your feet. It builds the calves and ankle strength.

name: 站姿小腿
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾指向前方。
将脚后跟抬离地面，尽可能高，用脚趾站立。
保持该姿势片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing calf raise where you lift your heels as high as you can. It builds the calf muscles.

name: 站姿小腿拉伸
instructions: 面朝墙壁或坚固物体站立，距离大约一臂远。
将手放在与肩同高的墙壁或物体上。
一只脚向后退一步，保持脚跟平放在地面上。
稍微弯曲前膝盖并向前倾斜，保持后腿伸直。
您应该感觉到小腿肌肉有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
在另一条腿上重复。
description: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back with the heel down. It stretches the calf of the back leg.

name: 地面凳上臂屈伸
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地板平行。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: With your hands on a bench behind you and your feet on the floor, you bend and straighten your elbows. It builds the triceps, chest and shoulders.

name: 深蹲侧踢
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Stand up and kick your right leg out to the side.
Return the foot to the floor and drop into the next squat.
Alternate sides each rep.
description: Squatting down and then kicking one leg out to the side. It trains the thighs and glutes.

name: 双杠上推(垂直杆)
instructions: 首先悬挂在垂直杆上，手掌背对自己，手臂完全伸展。
启动核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
当你站起来时，稍微向后倾斜，并将肘部移向身体两侧。
继续拉，直到胸部到达杠铃并且肘部完全弯曲。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A muscle-up on a vertical bar, pulling up and then pressing over the top. It trains the lats, chest and triceps in one flowing move.

name: L坐
instructions: Sit between two supports or on the floor and place your hands beside your hips.
Press down through your hands to lift your hips and legs off the floor.
Extend your legs straight in front of you.
Keep your shoulders pressed down and your core tight.
Hold for as long as you can with good form, then lower.
description: An isometric hold where your body is supported by your arms and your legs stay straight out in front, forming an L.

name: 颈部侧向拉伸
instructions: 站直或坐直，肩膀放松。
将头向一侧倾斜，将耳朵靠近肩膀。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒。
在另一侧重复。
每侧进行 2-4 组。
description: Gently tilt your head sideways to stretch the side of your neck. It eases tension in the neck and upper shoulder.

name: 背部拉伸
instructions: Stand or sit tall and clasp your hands in front of you.
Press your arms forward and round your upper back.
Let your head drop gently.
Breathe slowly into your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
description: A simple stretch to lengthen the back and ease tightness.

name: 背部胸肌拉伸
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行。
双臂交叉在身体前方，右臂放在左臂上方。
手指交叉，手掌旋转远离身体。
慢慢抬起手臂并远离身体，感觉背部和胸部有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，然后放松。
在另一侧重复。
description: A stretch for the chest and front of the shoulder with your arms reached behind you. It opens up the pecs and lats.

name: 仰卧腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Raise one leg and hold behind the thigh or calf.
Gently straighten the knee while pulling the leg toward you.
Keep your other leg flat and your back relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A simple lying hamstring stretch that eases tightness at the back of the thigh.

name: 双手撑墙小腿推拉伸
english: calf push stretch with hands against wall
instructions: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将双手靠在墙上，与肩同高。
一只脚向后退一步，脚跟保持在地面上，腿伸直。
稍微弯曲前膝盖并向前倾斜，感觉小腿有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
换腿并重复拉伸。
description: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it and push your heel down on the back leg. It stretches the calf of the back leg.

name: 弹力带抬髋
instructions: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将阻力带放在膝盖上方。
调动你的臀肌和核心肌肉。
将脚后跟压入地面，将臀部抬离地板，在顶部挤压臀部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lie on your back with a band around your thighs and lift your hips. It strengthens the glutes and the outer hips.

name: 杠铃臀桥
instructions: 首先平躺在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
将杠铃放在臀部上，用双手牢牢握住它。
锻炼臀部和核心肌肉，然后将臀部抬离地面，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压臀部。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lie on your back with a barbell across your hips and lift your hips high. It builds the glutes and the back of the thighs.

name: 杠铃侧弓步蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
右脚向一侧迈出一大步，保持左脚踩地。
弯曲右膝，将身体降低到弓步位置，保持左腿伸直。
用右脚推出并返回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，用左脚迈步。
description: With a barbell on your upper back, step to the side and sit into a lateral lunge. It works the glutes, inner thighs and quads.

name: 杠铃掌心向下腕弯举(凳上)
english: barbell palms down wrist curl over a bench
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，前臂放在大腿上，手掌朝下。
正手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
弯曲手腕，将杠铃降低到地面，保持前臂静止。
在底部停顿片刻，然后通过伸展手腕慢慢将杠铃举起。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Sit with your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms down, and curl a barbell up with your wrists. It strengthens the back of the forearms.

name: 杠铃掌心向上腕弯举(凳上)
english: barbell palms up wrist curl over a bench
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上。
将前臂放在长凳上，让手腕悬在长凳边缘。
保持前臂静止，呼气并尽可能向上弯曲手腕。
保持收缩位置短暂停顿，然后吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Sit with your forearms on a bench, palms up, and curl a barbell with your wrists. It strengthens the front of the forearms and grip.

name: 绳索单臂反握弯举
instructions: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
反手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝下。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，慢慢地将前臂向上卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A one-arm curl with a cable using an overhand grip. It works the forearms and the outer part of the biceps.

name: 哑铃单臂反握牧师凳弯举
english: dumbbell one arm reverse preacher curl
instructions: 坐在牧师凳上，胸部靠在垫子上，手臂伸出长凳边缘，反握哑铃。
慢慢降低哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
将哑铃向后弯向肩膀，保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点挤压二头肌，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: Rest your arm on a preacher bench and curl a dumbbell with an overhand grip. It targets the biceps and forearms with no body swing.

name: 哑铃单臂坐姿中立握腕弯举
english: dumbbell one arm seated neutral wrist curl
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，一手握住哑铃，掌心朝上。
将前臂放在大腿上，让手腕悬在边缘。
保持前臂静止，尽可能向上弯曲手腕。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手腕放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一只手。
description: Sit with your forearm supported and curl a dumbbell with your wrist in a neutral position. It strengthens the forearms and builds grip.

name: 稳定球单腿俯卧下肢旋转
english: exercise ball one leg prone lower body rotation
instructions: 面朝下躺在稳定球上，臀部放在球上，双腿伸直在身后。
将双手放在身前的地面上以获得支撑。
调动你的臀肌和核心肌肉来稳定你的身体。
慢慢地将一条腿抬离地面，保持笔直并与地板平行。
向外旋转腿部，远离身体，同时保持臀部和上半身稳定。
旋转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将腿放回起始位置。
用另一条腿重复旋转。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
description: Lie face down over a stability ball with one leg lifted and rotate it slightly. It strengthens the glutes and hips while your core balances.

name: 稳定球单腿斜向踢腿腘绳肌弯举
english: exercise ball one legged diagonal kick hamstring curl
instructions: 首先仰卧，双腿伸展，脚跟放在稳定球上。
将手臂放在身体两侧以保持稳定。
调动臀肌和核心肌肉，将臀部抬离地面，从肩膀到脚后跟形成一条直线。
弯曲右膝并将其靠近胸部，保持左腿伸展，脚部弯曲。
将右腿斜踢过身体，完全伸展并拉动腿筋。
慢慢地将右腿返回到起始位置，保持控制和稳定性。
用左腿重复该动作，交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball and curl one leg toward you while kicking diagonally. It works the hamstrings, glutes and core.

name: 抱膝贴胸
instructions: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
当你蹲下时，将膝盖抬向胸部，并用手臂抱住它们。
保持这个姿势一会儿，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Stand and pull one knee up to your chest with both hands. It stretches the glutes and loosens the hip and lower back.

name: 铁十字拉伸
instructions: 平躺，双臂向两侧伸展。
将双腿抬向天花板，保持伸直。
慢慢地将双腿降低到一侧，旨在用脚接触地板。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后将双腿恢复到起始位置。
在另一侧重复拉伸。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: Lie on your back with your arms out and cross one leg over your body toward the opposite hand. It stretches the glutes and lower back.

name: 跪姿跳跃深蹲
instructions: 首先跪在地上，双脚分开与臀部同宽，脚趾向前。
将杠铃放在上背部，将其放在肩膀上。
启动你的核心和臀部，然后爆发性地跳到空中，伸展你的臀部和膝盖。
跳跃时，用脚趾推动并充分伸展脚踝、膝盖和臀部。
轻轻地回到地面，弯曲膝盖以吸收冲击力。
立即进入下一个重复，重复跳蹲动作。
description: Start on your knees and explosively swing your arms to jump up onto your feet. It builds power in the glutes and hips.

name: 改良式俯卧撑至前臂
english: modified push up to lower arms
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
一旦肘部成 90 度角，将前臂放低至地面，将肘部保持在肩膀正下方。
暂停片刻，然后用手掌推动前臂，使其回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A modified push-up variation where you shift your weight toward your wrists. It strengthens the forearms, chest and shoulders.

name: 骨盆后倾至臀桥
instructions: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂放在身体两侧，手掌朝下。
调动你的臀肌和核心肌肉。
向上倾斜骨盆，将臀部抬离地面。
保持桥位置几秒钟。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lie on your back with your knees bent, tilt your pelvis, then lift into a bridge. It warms up the glutes, lower back and core.

name: 平凳反向山羊挺身
instructions: 脸朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，臀部位于边缘，双腿悬在长凳上。
抓住长凳以保持稳定。
保持双腿伸直，尽可能将它们抬向天花板。
在动作的最高点挤压臀部。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Lie face down with your hips at the end of a bench and swing your legs up behind you. It works the glutes and lower back.

name: 坐姿臀部拉伸
instructions: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
弯曲右膝，将右脚踝交叉在左大腿上。
将右手放在身后的地面上以获得支撑。
用左手轻轻按下右膝盖以加深伸展。
保持拉伸 30 秒到 1 分钟。
换边并重复。
description: Sit on the floor and cross one ankle over the opposite knee, then lean in. It stretches the glutes and the outer hip.

name: 滑车45度单腿腿举
instructions: 将雪橇机调整至 45 度角。
坐在雪橇机上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚放在踏板上。
将一只脚放在踏板上并伸展腿，将雪橇推离您。
慢慢弯曲膝盖，将雪橇放回起始位置。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
description: A one-leg press on a sled machine set at a 45 degree angle. It trains the glutes, quads and hamstrings one side at a time.

name: 史密斯机坐姿腕弯举
instructions: 坐在史密斯机前的长凳上，双脚平放在地面上。
反握抓住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
将前臂放在大腿上，让手腕悬垂。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，将杠铃拉向前臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Sit in front of a smith machine and curl the bar with your wrists. It strengthens the forearms and builds grip.

name: 直腿髋外侧外展
instructions: 侧躺，双腿伸直并叠放在一起。
将下臂放在头下方以获得支撑。
启动你的核心并尽可能高地抬起你的上腿，不要旋转你的臀部或向后倾斜。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: Lie on your side with your legs straight and lift the top leg. It works the outer hip and glute muscles that stabilise your pelvis.

name: 手腕绕环
instructions: 将双臂伸直在身前。
双手握拳。
以圆周运动旋转手腕，保持手臂静止。
继续手腕转圈达到所需的重复次数。
description: Hold your arms out and move your wrists in slow circles. It warms up the wrist joints and forearm muscles.

name: 宽握引体向上
instructions: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手之间的距离比肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将身体向上拉向杠铃，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
有控制地降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A pull-up on a wide overhand grip, pulling your chin above the bar. It targets the lats and upper back.

name: 胸部双杠臂屈伸(引体向上双杠架)
instructions: 将倾斜杆调整到您可以舒适地握住它们的高度。
站在杠铃之间，将双手放在每个杠铃上，距离略宽于肩宽。
跳起来并伸直双臂，将体重支撑在杠上。
弯曲膝盖并将脚踝交叉在身后。
弯曲肘部降低身体，保持胸部向上，肩膀向下。
继续降低，直到肩膀低于肘部或直到您感到胸部有拉伸感。
推动手掌并伸展肘部，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A chest dip done on a dip station with a forward lean. It works the lower chest, triceps and front shoulders.

name: 辅助站姿反握引体向上
instructions: 将机器调整至您所需的辅助级别。
站在脚踏板上，正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持挺胸、肩膀向后，收紧核心肌群，并稍微弯曲膝盖。
弯曲肘部并将肘部向身体两侧压低，将身体向上拉。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A chin-up done on an assisted machine that takes part of your body weight. It builds the lats and biceps while you work up to full chin-ups.

name: 辅助站姿引体向上
instructions: 将机器调整至您所需的体重和高度设置。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
启动你的背阔肌和二头肌，并将自己拉向手柄。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压背部肌肉。
慢慢地将自己放回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A pull-up done on an assisted machine that takes part of your body weight. It builds the lats and upper back while you work up to full pull-ups.

name: 史密斯机前蹲(高翻握法)
instructions: 将杠铃置于肩高的史密斯机上。
面向杠铃站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
后退一步，将杠铃放在前肩上，放在锁骨和三角肌上。
保持挺胸、背部挺直、核心收紧。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行或略低于地面。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A front squat on a smith machine with a clean grip. The bar path is guided so you can focus on the quads and glutes.

name: 史密斯机低杠深蹲
instructions: 将史密斯机与杠铃设置在一个高度，以便您可以将其舒适地放在上背部。
站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外转动。
走到杠铃下方，将其放在上背部上方，将其放在斜方肌上。
双手握住杠铃，距离略大于肩宽。
伸直双腿并从架子上退后，将杠铃松开。
深呼吸并支撑你的核心。
通过向后推臀部并弯曲膝盖来开始深蹲。
降低身体，直到大腿与地面平行或稍低于地面。
在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
通过脚后跟站起来，伸展臀部和膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A low bar squat on the smith machine, with the bar sitting lower on the back. It builds the glutes, quads and hamstrings along a fixed bar path.

name: 杠铃低杠深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，杠铃放在上背部。
保持挺胸，核心收紧，弯曲膝盖并向后推臀部，慢慢降低身体。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行或略低于地面。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A squat with the bar resting low across the rear delts, which leans you forward a bit more. It loads the glutes, hamstrings and lower back heavily.

name: 杠铃高杠深蹲
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在上背部，放在斜方肌上。
当你开始蹲下时，启动你的核心并保持胸部挺直，将臀部向后推并弯曲膝盖。
放低身体，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低到您能舒服的高度。
通过脚后跟站起来，伸展臀部和膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: The classic back squat with the bar sitting high on the traps and a more upright torso. It is a staple for quad and glute strength.

name: 哑铃手指弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，反手握住，将前臂放在大腿上，手掌朝上。
让哑铃向下滚动到指尖，然后弯曲手指将其卷起。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一只手。
description: Small dumbbell curls where the bar rolls down to your fingertips and back up. A simple way to build finger and forearm grip strength.

name: 壶铃坐姿双臂军事推举
english: kettlebell seated two arm military press
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
每只手握住一个壶铃，与肩同高，手掌朝前。
完全伸展双臂，将壶铃压过头顶。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将壶铃放回肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated overhead press with a kettlebell in each hand. It trains the shoulders and triceps while the seat keeps your legs out of the lift.

name: 杠杆无握耸肩 v. 2
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在垫子上。
正手握住手柄或杆，保持手臂伸直。
保持背部挺直，将肩膀尽可能高地抬向耳朵。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A shrug on a lever machine without handles to grip, so the lift comes from the traps alone. Version 2 of the machine drawing.

name: 平板支撑抬臂
instructions: Get into a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward without letting your hips rotate.
Place it back down with control and lift the other.
Keep your neck neutral and alternate arms for the planned reps.
description: A plank where you lift one arm at a time, training core stability and anti-rotation strength.

name: 哑铃凳外单臂反握腕弯举
english: dumbbell over bench one arm reverse wrist curl
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，一手握住哑铃，掌心朝下。
将前臂放在长凳上，手腕悬在长凳边缘。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，将哑铃拉向前臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
description: A one-arm reverse wrist curl with your forearm resting over a bench. It strengthens the wrist extensors on the top of the forearm.

name: 双杠支撑保持
instructions: Grip the parallel bars and press yourself up with straight arms.
Lean slightly forward and lock your shoulders down.
Hold the position with your body still.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Hold for 15-30 seconds and step down.
description: Holding the top of a dip on parallel bars. It builds the triceps and shoulder stability.

name: 哑铃仰卧正握马耳他保持
english: dumbbell lying pronated grip maltese hold
instructions: Lie face up with a dumbbell in each hand, palms down.
Lift your arms out to the sides at about hip level.
Keep your arms straight and your body tight.
Hold the position without letting the weights drop.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower carefully.
description: Holding dumbbells out to the sides in a lying Maltese position. It is an advanced hold for the shoulders and chest.

name: 哑铃屈臂上拉保持
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
Lower it behind your head with your elbows bent.
Stop where you feel a stretch in your chest and lats.
Hold the position with your core tight.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lift it back up.
description: Holding a dumbbell over your chest with bent arms in a pullover position. It keeps the chest and lats under tension.

name: 哑铃RDL拉伸
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells along your legs.
Stop when you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Hold the position with a flat back.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then stand up.
description: Holding the bottom of a Romanian deadlift with dumbbells. It loads the hamstrings in their stretched position.

name: 杠铃泽奇深蹲保持
instructions: Place the barbell in the crooks of your elbows.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and your core tight.
Hold the bottom position steadily.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then stand up.
description: Holding the bottom of a Zercher squat with the bar in your elbows. It challenges the legs and core.

name: 杠杆小腿拉伸(挂片式)
instructions: Set up on the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform with the heel free.
Keep your knee straight and stand tall.
Let the heel sink down until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.
Switch legs and repeat.
description: A calf stretch on a plate-loaded lever machine, using the platform to push the heel down and lengthen the lower leg.

name: 杠铃上拉保持
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a light barbell above your chest with arms nearly straight.
Lower the bar back over your head until you feel a deep stretch in your lats.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down and your elbows softly bent.
Hold the position for 15-30 seconds without letting the bar drift.
Return the bar over your chest with control and set it down safely.
description: Hold a barbell overhead behind you while lying on a bench. It builds lat and chest control in the stretched position.

name: 哑铃上斜30度飞鸟保持
instructions: Set a bench to about 30 degrees and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Open your arms wide with soft elbows until the dumbbells are level with your chest.
Keep your shoulder blades pinned back and down.
Hold the stretched position for 15-30 seconds without sagging.
Bring the weights back together over your chest and set them down carefully.
description: A static hold at the bottom of an incline flye. It teaches chest tension and builds control in the stretched position.

name: 哑铃平凳飞鸟保持
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Open your arms wide with soft elbows until the dumbbells are level with your chest.
Keep your shoulder blades pinned back and your feet planted.
Hold the position for 15-30 seconds without letting the weights drop.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest and set them down carefully.
description: A static hold at the bottom of a flat flye. It builds chest tension and control in the stretched position.

name: 杠杆坐姿臂屈伸
instructions: 调整座椅高度，使双脚平放在地面上，膝盖呈 90 度角。
手掌朝下，抓住杠杆机的手柄，双臂完全伸展。
弯曲肘部，慢慢降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated dip on a lever machine that mimics the dip motion with guided support. It targets the triceps and also works the chest and front delts.

name: 杠杆坐姿卷腹
instructions: 坐在杠杆机上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
抓住手柄或将手放在侧垫上以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌并慢慢向后倾斜，让垫子随着您一起移动。
一旦你的上半身呈 45 度角，收缩腹肌并向前卷腹，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated machine crunch where you curl your torso toward your hips against resistance. It trains the abs with a controlled, fixed path.

name: 杠杆坐姿转体
instructions: Sit on the machine, adjust the pads and place your arms or hands as designed.
Sit tall with your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to one side with a smooth, controlled turn.
Pause briefly, then return to the centre without letting the weight stack slam.
Repeat to the other side and keep alternating.
description: A seated machine twist that trains the trunk rotators and abs against a controlled load.

name: 杠杆坐姿肩部推举
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles start near shoulder height and sit with your back on the pad.
Grip the handles and brace your core.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height and repeat.
description: A machine overhead press that builds the shoulders and triceps with a fixed, stable path.

name: 杠杆胸推 v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Sit back with your shoulder blades against the pad and feet flat.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Pause, then return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your wrists straight and your back on the pad throughout.
description: A machine chest press with a lever arm that guides the push. It builds the chest and triceps.

name: 杠铃站姿窄握军事推举
english: barbell standing close grip military press
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，双手距离略小于肩宽。
将杠铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部靠近身体。
将杠铃推过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
将杠铃降低回肩部高度。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing barbell overhead press with a narrow grip. It hits the front delts and triceps and asks your core to keep you steady.

name: 杠铃站姿宽握军事推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握杠铃，握距略宽于肩。
将杠铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部稍微位于杠铃前方。
将杠铃推过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
将杠铃降低回肩部高度，然后重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing barbell overhead press with a wide grip, which shifts more work to the shoulders. Keep your ribs down and your core tight.

name: EZ杠铃坐姿弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
反手握住 ez 杠铃，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
将上臂放在大腿上，让 ez 杠铃垂在您面前。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向上卷曲至肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并缓慢地将 ez 杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Seated curls with an EZ bar, which is gentler on the wrists. A good way to build the biceps without swinging your body.

name: 哑铃罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，以臀部为铰链，将哑铃向地面降低，让膝盖稍微弯曲。
降低哑铃，直到感觉到腿筋拉伸，然后推动脚后跟并收紧臀肌，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A hip hinge with dumbbells that lowers them down the legs while your back stays flat. It trains the hamstrings and glutes.

name: 行走弓步蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右腿向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
保持躯干直立，前膝与脚踝对齐。
右脚蹬地，左脚向前，左腿呈弓步姿势。
继续交替双腿向前行走，保持受控且稳定的步伐。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Stepping forward into one lunge after another, moving across the room. It works the quads and glutes and challenges balance.

name: 杠铃全蹲(背面视角)
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在上背部，将其放在斜方肌或三角肌后束上。
当你开始降低身体时，启动你的核心并保持胸部挺直。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，向后和向下推臀部，就像坐在椅子上一样。
降低身体，直到大腿与地面平行或稍低于地面。
保持膝盖与脚趾对齐，并将重量放在脚后跟上。
通过脚后跟站起来，伸展臀部和膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A full-depth barbell squat shown from behind. It builds the quads, glutes and core and is a great check of back and knee alignment.

name: 杠铃全蹲(侧面视角)
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在上背部，将其放在斜方肌或三角肌后束上。
当你开始降低身体时，启动你的核心并保持胸部挺直。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，向后和向下推臀部，就像坐在椅子上一样。
降低身体，直到大腿与地面平行或稍低于地面。
保持膝盖与脚趾对齐，并将重量放在脚后跟上。
通过脚后跟站起来，伸展臀部和膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A full-depth barbell squat shown from the side. It builds the quads, glutes and core and shows your depth and back angle clearly.

name: 滑车45度腿举(侧面视角)
instructions: 调整雪橇机的座椅，使双脚放在踏板上时膝盖呈90度角。
坐在雪橇机上，背部平放在靠背上，双脚与肩同宽放在踏板上。
握住座椅两侧的把手以保持稳定性。
推动脚踏板以伸展双腿，将其完全伸直。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢弯曲膝盖，将踏板放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A leg press on a 45 degree sled, shown from the side. It loads the quads and glutes with your back supported.

name: 滑车45度腿举(背面视角)
instructions: 调整雪橇机的座椅，使膝盖成45度角。
坐在雪橇机上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚与肩同宽放在踏板上。
握住座椅两侧的把手以保持稳定性。
伸展双腿，将脚踏板推离身体，脚后跟保持在脚踏板上。
在完全伸展的位置暂停片刻。
慢慢弯曲膝盖，将踏板放回到身体的方向，控制动作。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A leg press on a 45 degree sled, shown from behind. It loads the quads and glutes with your back supported.

name: 45度山羊挺身(手臂置于胸前)(侧面视角)
english: 45 degree hyperextension (arms in front of chest) (side pov)
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the roller.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body straight.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise back up until your body is in line, without overarching.
Move slowly and squeeze your glutes at the top.
description: A back extension on a 45 degree bench viewed from the side, targeting the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.

name: 扭转抬髋
instructions: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧以获得支撑。
收紧臀部并将臀部抬离地面，从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在保持臀部抬起的同时，将下半身扭转到右侧，使膝盖靠近地面。
返回起始位置并向左侧重复扭转。
继续交替扭转所需的重复次数。
description: Lying on your back, you lift your hips and add a gentle twist. It wakes up the glutes and obliques.

name: 前臂俯卧撑
instructions: 从平板支撑位置开始，前臂放在地面上，肘部位于肩膀正下方。
调动你的核心力量，让你的身体从头到脚保持在一条直线上。
弯曲肘部，使胸部靠近地面，使胸部靠近地面。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A push-up with your forearms on the floor instead of your hands. It is tough on the triceps and the core.

name: 螃蟹转体触脚尖
instructions: 首先坐在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
将双手放在身后，手指指向脚部，并将臀部抬离地面。
将一条腿伸直到您面前，同时将另一只手伸向脚趾。
返回起始位置并在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: From a crab position you twist and reach one hand to the opposite foot. It works the abs and obliques and gets the shoulders moving.

name: 侧向侧平板支撑(屈腿)
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder and your knees bent.
Stack your hips and shoulders in a line.
Lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from knee to head.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
Hold for the planned time, then switch sides.
description: An easier side plank with the bottom knee bent, building oblique and hip stability.

name: 侧向侧平板支撑
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder and your legs straight.
Stack your feet or stagger them for balance.
Lift your hips to form a straight line from head to feet.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
Hold for the planned time, then switch sides.
description: A classic side plank that trains the obliques and hip stabilisers.

name: 尺蠖爬行
instructions: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
腰部向前弯曲，双手放在身前的地面上。
双手向前移动，直到处于高位平板支撑位置，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
暂停片刻，然后将双手移回双脚，尽可能保持双腿伸直。
一旦你的手到达你的脚，站回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: You walk your hands out from standing into a plank and walk them back. It warms up the hamstrings, shoulders and core in one go.

name: 向前跳
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
向后摆动手臂以获得动力。
爆发性地向前跳跃，伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝。
脚掌轻轻落地，然后立即进入下一个跳跃。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight jump forward with a soft landing. It builds explosive power in the quads and glutes.

name: 向后跳
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖，向后跳跃，用双脚蹬地。
脚掌轻轻着地，弯曲膝盖以吸收冲击力。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight jump backward with a soft landing. It builds explosive power in the quads and trains control.

name: 单腿深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
向前伸出一条腿，使其离开地面。
弯曲站立的腿并降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸、背部挺直。
推动脚后跟返回到起始位置。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
description: A squat on a single leg that challenges strength and balance. It targets the glutes and quads on one side at a time.

name: 开合跳平板支撑
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Jump your feet apart, then jump them back together.
Keep your upper body steady and your hips from rising.
Continue at a steady pace for the planned time.
description: A plank where your feet jump in and out like a jumping jack, combining core stability with cardio.

name: 杠杆上斜胸推 v. 2
instructions: 将杠杆机上的座椅高度和靠背角度调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
向前推动手柄并远离身体，直到手臂完全伸展，但不要锁定肘部。
在完全伸展的位置暂停片刻，然后慢慢弯曲肘部并将手柄放回胸部。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A lever machine chest press with an inclined path, version 2. It builds the upper chest, front delts and triceps.

name: 背后二头肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and reach both arms behind your back.
Straighten your elbows and turn your palms down or clasp your hands.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body until you feel a stretch in the biceps.
Keep your chest open and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.
description: A stretch that opens the front of the arm and chest by reaching the arms behind you.

name: 弓式瑜伽姿势
instructions: Lie on your stomach with your arms along your sides.
Bend your knees and reach back to hold your ankles.
Lift your chest and kick your feet gently into your hands to raise your thighs.
Keep your gaze forward and breathe steadily.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then release slowly and rest on the mat.
description: A yoga backbend where you lie on your belly and hold your ankles. It stretches the thighs, chest and front of the hips.

name: 眼镜蛇式瑜伽姿势
instructions: Lie on your stomach with your palms under your shoulders and legs extended.
Press the tops of your feet into the floor.
Lift your chest by straightening your arms partway, keeping your hips down.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears and your neck long.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.
description: A gentle yoga backbend that opens the chest and stretches the front of the abs while strengthening the back.

name: 莲花坐瑜伽姿势
instructions: Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended.
Bring one foot onto the opposite thigh, then the other foot on top of the other thigh.
Only go as far as your hips allow, and never force your knees.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with calm breathing, then switch the leg order next time.
description: A seated yoga posture with both feet resting on opposite thighs. It opens the hips and needs good flexibility.

name: 蝗虫式瑜伽姿势(钢铁人式)
instructions: Lie face down with your arms along your sides and palms facing up.
Press your pelvis into the floor and engage your glutes.
Lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor together.
Look slightly forward and keep your neck long.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower slowly and rest.
description: A yoga pose on your belly where you lift legs and chest at once. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.

name: 犁式瑜伽姿势
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Lift your legs and hips up and over, supporting your lower back with your hands if needed.
Lower your toes toward the floor behind your head.
Keep your neck relaxed and do not turn your head.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.
description: An inverted yoga pose where the legs are lowered behind the head. It stretches the spine, shoulders and hamstrings.

name: 俯卧撑(用俯卧撑支架)
instructions: Place the handles shoulder-width apart and grip them in a plank position.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest until it is between the handles, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.
description: A push-up on handles that lets you go a little deeper and keeps the wrists neutral. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: 肩倒立瑜伽姿势
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your legs overhead, supporting your lower back with your hands.
Walk your hands up toward your shoulder blades.
Raise your legs straight up so your body forms a line over your shoulders.
Keep your neck long and still, and do not turn your head.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.
description: An inverted yoga pose balanced on the shoulders. It builds shoulder and core control and stretches the neck-side muscles.

name: 背后肩部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your hands gently away from your body until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest open and avoid arching your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly.
description: A simple stretch that opens the front of the shoulders and chest by clasping the hands behind you.

name: 西西里深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
如果需要，请抓住一个稳定的物体以保持平衡。
弯曲膝盖并向后倾斜，慢慢降低身体，保持躯干直立。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行或尽可能舒适地下降。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A squat where your knees travel far forward as you lean back. It isolates the quads with only your body weight.

name: 站姿提踵(台阶上)
instructions: 站在台阶或坚固平台的边缘，脚后跟悬垂，脚趾放在台阶上。
如果需要，抓住栏杆或墙壁以保持平衡。
慢慢地尽可能高地抬起脚后跟，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A calf raise with your heels hanging off a stair step for extra range. It trains the calves through a deep stretch.

name: 仰卧脊柱扭转瑜伽姿势
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Guide that knee across your body toward the floor on the opposite side.
Keep both shoulders on the floor and turn your head the other way if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A relaxing lying twist that mobilises the spine and stretches the hips and sides of the trunk.

name: 三头肌臂屈伸拉伸
instructions: Stand or sit tall and raise one arm overhead.
Bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head.
Use your other hand to gently press the elbow back and down.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
description: A stretch for the back of the upper arm, taken with the elbow bent overhead.

name: 轮式瑜伽姿势
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat near your hips.
Place your palms beside your head with fingers pointing toward your shoulders.
Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips and then your head.
Straighten your arms as far as comfortable and keep your thighs parallel.
Hold for 5-15 seconds, then lower slowly with your chin tucked.
description: A deep yoga backbend with hands and feet on the floor and the body arched upward. It opens the chest and strengthens the back.

name: 蝴蝶式瑜伽姿势
instructions: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
弯曲膝盖，将脚底并拢，让膝盖向两侧倾斜。
用手抓住脚踝或脚。
坐直并拉长脊柱。
轻轻地将膝盖压向地板，感觉大腿内侧有拉伸感。
保持这个姿势几个呼吸。
要放松，请慢慢抬起膝盖并伸展双腿。
description: A seated pose with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out. It opens the inner thighs and hips.

name: 侧腹卷腹 v. 2
instructions: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，将躯干旋转到一侧。
暂停片刻，然后将肩胛骨放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: An oblique crunch where you curl up and to the side, version 2. It trains the side abs.

name: 大锤
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住大锤。
启动你的核心并保持背部挺直。
使用核心和上半身的力量，将大锤向下挥向地面。
当你向下挥杆时，转动臀部并将力量传递到锤子上。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Swinging a sledgehammer down onto a tire in a controlled arc. It trains the abs and obliques and also the shoulders and grip.

name: 杠铃反向弹力带卧推
instructions: Set up on a bench with bands anchored to the rack and attached to the bar.
Lie back with your eyes under the bar and your shoulder blades pinched.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Press the bar back up to straight arms, feeling the band resistance change.
Keep your feet planted and your wrists stacked over your elbows.
description: A bench press with bands that lighten the load at the bottom and add heavier tension near the top. It builds pressing strength.

name: 弹力带下斜仰卧起坐
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and hold the other end at your chest.
Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Curl your torso up toward your knees, keeping tension on the band.
Pause at the top without pulling on your neck.
Lower back down slowly under control.
description: A decline sit-up with a band adding resistance. It trains the abs through a long range.

name: 弹力带颈后肩部推举
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends at the back of your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your head forward.
Press your hands straight up until your arms are extended.
Lower slowly back behind your head to shoulder level.
Only use this variation if your shoulders move comfortably in that position.
description: A band-resisted overhead press from behind the neck. It trains the shoulders and triceps with rising tension.

name: 弹力带直立划船(踩于双脚下)
instructions: Stand with both feet on the middle of the band and hold the ends in front of your thighs.
Keep your chest up and your core tight.
Pull your hands up along your body until they reach chest height, elbows leading.
Pause briefly without shrugging too high.
Lower slowly back down.
description: An upright row where the band is held under both feet. It builds the shoulders and upper traps.

name: 弹力带侧平板支撑划船(与搭档)
english: band side plank row with partner
instructions: Get into a side plank on one forearm, with a partner holding the band in front of you.
Grip the band with your top hand and keep your hips lifted.
Row your hand back toward your ribs, squeezing the shoulder blade.
Return slowly without letting your hips drop.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side plank with a rowing motion against a band held by a partner. It trains the lats and trunk stability.

name: 弹力带下压
instructions: Anchor the band high and hold the ends with your elbows at your sides.
Stand tall with a slight forward lean.
Push your hands down until your arms are straight.
Pause and squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly while keeping your elbows pinned to your sides.
description: A band version of the triceps pushdown that isolates the back of the arm.

name: 弹力带拉开
instructions: Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height with your arms straight.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly with control.
description: A simple band move pulling the arms apart in front of you. It strengthens the upper back and rear shoulders and helps posture.

name: 弹力带仰卧臂屈伸
instructions: Anchor the band behind your head and lie on your back holding the ends.
Start with your arms straight above your chest.
Bend only your elbows to lower your hands toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back up against the band.
Keep your upper arms still throughout.
description: A lying triceps extension using a band for resistance. It isolates the back of the upper arm.

name: 弹力带提踵 v. 3
instructions: Secure the band under your feet or around your shoulders as set up.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower slowly until your heels are back on the floor.
description: A calf raise using a band for resistance. It builds calf strength and ankle control.

name: 弹力带EZ杠铃窄握弯举
english: band ez barbell close grip curl
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the EZ bar with a close grip, palms up.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your chest tall.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top without swinging.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A close-grip curl on an EZ bar with a band adding tension near the top. It targets the biceps.

name: 弹力带屈髋
instructions: Attach a band to a low anchor and loop it around one ankle.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Lift the knee forward and up toward hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Finish your reps and switch legs.
description: A standing hip flexion with a band around the foot or leg. It trains the hip flexors and quads.

name: 弹力带侧平举 v. 2
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to your sides.
description: A band lateral raise that builds the sides of the shoulders.

name: 杠铃凳上深蹲(加链条)
instructions: Set a bench behind you and load the bar with chains.
Place the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit back and down until you touch the bench lightly.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand, feeling the chains add weight.
description: A barbell squat to a bench with chains adding load as you stand. It builds leg and hip strength and teaches consistent depth.

name: 交叉反向弓步蹲
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step one foot back and across behind your other leg.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Push through the front foot to stand, then repeat or switch sides.
description: A reverse lunge where the back leg steps behind and across the line of the front leg. It trains glutes, thighs and balance.

name: 腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，将重心转移到右腿上。
保持背部挺直，臀部慢慢向前弯曲，双手伸向右脚。
保持伸展动作 20-30 秒，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
description: A stretch for the back of the thigh. You reach toward your toes with a long spine and feel the hamstrings lengthen.

name: 四点跪姿股四头肌拉伸
instructions: 从四肢着地开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，膝盖直接放在臀部下方。
将一条腿向后伸直，保持膝盖弯曲和脚弯曲。
慢慢地将臀部降低到地面，感觉股四头肌的伸展。
保持这个姿势20-30秒。
换腿并在另一侧重复拉伸。
description: On all fours you pull one foot toward your glutes to stretch the front of the thigh. It eases tight quads.

name: 弹力带早安式
instructions: Stand on the band and loop it behind your neck across your shoulders.
Keep your knees softly bent and your back flat.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
description: A hip hinge with a band across your shoulders. It strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.

name: 杠铃四分之一深蹲
instructions: Rest the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Bend your knees and hips a short way, about a quarter of the full depth.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.
description: A short-range squat that goes only a quarter of the way down. It lets you handle heavier loads and builds leg strength.

name: 杠铃高翻硬拉
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and grip just outside your knees.
Set a flat back, chest up and shoulders over the bar.
Push the floor away to lift the bar, keeping it close to your legs.
Stand tall with hips and knees fully extended.
Lower the bar back down with control along the same path.
description: A deadlift performed with a clean-style setup and path. It trains the pulling position used in the clean.

name: 杠铃架上高翻
instructions: Set the bar on blocks and grip it just outside your knees with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a full squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
description: A clean started from blocks at about knee height. It trains the explosive pull and the catch without the first pull from the floor.

name: 杠铃高翻拉
instructions: Set up over the bar with a flat back and a grip just outside your knees.
Lift the bar past your knees, keeping it close.
Extend your hips and knees explosively and shrug.
Let your elbows rise high, but do not catch the bar.
Lower the bar with control and reset.
description: The explosive pull of a clean, finished with a shrug and without the catch. It builds power and bar speed.

name: 杠铃下斜凳弓步蹲
instructions: Place the bar on your upper back and rest one foot behind you on a decline bench.
Step the front foot out to set a stable stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, torso upright.
Drive through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A split squat with the back foot on a decline bench and a barbell on your back. It builds single-leg strength.

name: 史密斯机早安式(从销钉位)
instructions: Set the bar on the pins at upper-chest height and duck under it.
Stand tall with the bar on your upper back and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back, keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is near parallel with the floor.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then return the bar to the pins when done.
description: A good morning on the Smith machine starting from the pins. It builds the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.

name: 杠铃悬垂高翻
instructions: Stand holding the bar at mid-thigh with a grip just outside your legs and a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
description: A clean that starts from the hang at the thighs. It trains the explosive hip drive and the catch.

name: 杠铃膝下悬垂高翻
english: barbell hang clean below the knees
instructions: Hold the bar just below your knees with a flat back and your shoulders over the bar.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
description: A hang clean started from below the knees. It lengthens the pull for more power.

name: 杠铃悬垂抓举
instructions: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with a wide snatch grip and a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead with locked arms in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
description: A snatch that starts from the hang at the thighs. It trains the explosive pull and catching the bar overhead.

name: 杠铃膝下悬垂抓举
english: barbell hang snatch below the knees
instructions: Hold the bar just below your knees with a wide grip and a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead with locked arms in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
description: A hang snatch started from below the knees. It lengthens the pull for more power.

name: 杠铃抬升抓举平衡
instructions: Rest the bar on your upper back and take a wide snatch grip.
Dip and drive up explosively, pushing the bar off your shoulders.
Drop quickly into a squat while pressing the bar overhead.
Catch it with locked arms over your mid-foot.
Stand up with control and return the bar to your back.
description: A snatch drill where you dip, drive and drop under a bar on your back into an overhead squat. It builds speed and overhead stability.

name: 杠铃挺举下蹲
instructions: Rack the bar on your front shoulders and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Keep your torso upright and your core tight.
Dip a short way by bending your knees straight down.
Drive up explosively through your whole foot.
Settle back to standing and reset.
description: The dip and drive part of the jerk, practised with a barbell on the shoulders. It trains a vertical dip and strong leg drive.

name: 杠铃肌肉抓举
instructions: Hold the bar at the hips with a wide grip, shoulders over the bar.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull the bar up high with your elbows, turn it over and press to locked arms overhead without squatting.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
description: A snatch lifted overhead with straight arms and no re-bend of the knees. It trains the upper pull and arm turnover.

name: 杠铃奥林匹克深蹲
instructions: Place the bar high on your upper back and set your feet about shoulder-width.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit straight down as deep as you can with heels flat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.
description: A deep, upright high-bar squat in the weightlifting style. It builds leg strength and mobility.

name: 杠铃架上力量高翻
instructions: Set the bar on blocks and grip it just outside your knees with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull and catch the bar on your front shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
description: A clean caught above parallel, started from blocks. It builds explosive power.

name: 杠铃力量挺举
instructions: Rack the bar on your front shoulders with elbows slightly forward.
Dip a short way with your torso upright.
Drive up explosively and punch the bar overhead.
Dip under slightly and catch it with locked arms.
Stand tall, then lower the bar to your shoulders with control.
description: An explosive overhead lift where you dip, drive and catch the bar with locked arms in a quarter squat.

name: 杠铃力量抓举
instructions: Hold the bar at your shins with a wide grip, flat back and chest up.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under and catch the bar overhead with locked arms in a quarter squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
description: A snatch caught overhead above parallel. It builds explosive power and speed.

name: 杠铃架上力量抓举
instructions: Set the bar on blocks and take a wide grip with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under and catch the bar overhead with locked arms in a quarter squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
description: A power snatch started from blocks. It trains the explosive pull and the overhead catch.

name: 杠铃罗马尼亚硬拉(垫高站立)
instructions: Stand on a low platform holding the bar at your thighs.
Keep your knees soft and your back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Lower as far as you can with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
description: A Romanian deadlift standing on a small platform for extra range. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.

name: 杠铃抓举
instructions: Grip the bar wide, with it over your mid-foot, flat back and chest up.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead in a full squat, then stand up.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
description: The full snatch, lifting the bar from the floor to overhead in one motion and catching it in a deep squat.

name: 杠铃抓举平衡
instructions: Rest the bar on your upper back and take a wide snatch grip.
Dip a short way and drive up.
Drop into a squat while pressing the bar overhead.
Catch it with locked arms and your chest up.
Stand up with control and return the bar to your back.
description: A drill where you drop under a bar on your back into an overhead squat. It builds overhead stability and speed.

name: 杠铃抓举硬拉
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and take a wide snatch grip.
Set your back flat and chest up.
Push the floor away to lift the bar, keeping it close.
Stand tall with your hips and knees extended.
Lower the bar with control along the same path.
description: A deadlift with a wide snatch grip. It strengthens the pulling position used in the snatch.

name: 杠铃架上抓举
instructions: Set the bar on blocks and take a wide grip with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under the bar and catch it overhead in a full squat, then stand up.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
description: A snatch started from blocks. It trains the pull and the deep overhead catch.

name: 杠铃分腿高翻
instructions: Grip the bar just outside your legs with a flat back, shoulders over the bar.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Split your feet front and back and catch the bar on your front shoulders.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.
description: A clean caught in a split stance instead of a squat. It trains the explosive pull and the catch.

name: 杠铃分腿挺举
instructions: Rack the bar on your front shoulders with elbows slightly forward.
Dip a short way with your torso upright.
Drive up explosively and press the bar overhead.
Split your feet front and back and catch with locked arms.
Bring your feet back together and lower the bar with control.
description: An overhead lift where you dip, drive and catch the bar with locked arms in a split stance.

name: 杠铃分腿跳
instructions: Rest a light bar on your upper back and take a split stance.
Lower into a shallow lunge.
Jump explosively and switch your legs in the air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance.
Keep your torso upright and continue alternating.
description: A jump with a barbell on the back where you switch the front and back leg in the air. It builds leg power.

name: 杠铃深蹲至肩部推举
instructions: Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly forward and feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up.
Drive up through your heels and use that momentum to press the bar overhead.
Lock out the press with the bar over your mid-foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Keep your core braced the whole time and avoid arching your lower back.
description: A squat that flows straight into an overhead press. It trains legs and shoulders together in one fluid rep.

name: 杠铃深蹲至直立划船(大腿位)
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Push your hips back and squat down, letting the bar slide down to your knees.
Drive up through your heels to stand tall.
As you rise, pull the bar up close to your body until your elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower the bar under control and go straight into the next squat.
description: Squat down with the bar hanging in front of you, then stand and pull it up to chest height. Works thighs, glutes and upper back in one move.

name: 杠铃凳上直腿硬拉
english: barbell stiff leg deadlift on bench
instructions: Stand on a sturdy bench holding a barbell at thigh level, feet hip-width apart.
Keep your knees almost straight and push your hips back.
Lower the bar toward your toes with a flat back as far as your hamstrings allow.
Pause briefly, then squeeze your glutes to stand back up.
Keep the bar close to your legs and stay in control throughout.
description: A stiff-legged deadlift performed while standing on a bench, giving you extra range of motion. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings and lower back.

name: 杠铃直腿硬拉
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Keep your back flat and your chest proud the whole way.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.
description: The classic stiff-legged deadlift, hinging at the hips with nearly straight knees. A great builder for hamstrings, glutes and the lower back.

name: 杠铃宽站距直腿硬拉
english: barbell wide stance stiff leg deadlift
instructions: Take a wide stance, toes slightly out, with the barbell held in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees nearly straight and push your hips back.
Lower the bar between your legs while keeping your back flat.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in the hamstrings and inner thighs.
Squeeze your glutes to rise back to standing.
description: A stiff-legged deadlift with a wide stance that brings in the inner thighs and glutes. It also keeps the hamstrings under a deep stretch.

name: 杠铃全泽奇深蹲
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
将杠铃放在肘部的弯曲处，双手握住杠铃以保持稳定。
当你将臀部向后降低到蹲姿时，启动你的核心并保持胸部抬起。
保持膝盖与脚趾对齐，并将重量放在脚后跟上。
降低直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
通过脚跟发力站起来，在动作的最高点挤压臀部。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A squat with the bar held in the crooks of your elbows at full depth. It hits the quads, glutes and upper back.

name: 徒手靠墙静蹲
instructions: Lean your back against a wall with your feet about a step in front of you.
Slide down until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your back flat on the wall.
Press through your heels to slide back up.
Repeat for the planned number of reps.
description: A squat with your back against a wall, which keeps your torso upright and takes pressure off the lower back. Good for building leg endurance.

name: 绳索站姿腿弯举
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it around one ankle.
Stand facing the machine and hold on for balance, with the working leg slightly behind you.
Bend your knee and curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top without swinging your torso.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: Standing on one leg, you curl the other against a low cable. It isolates the hamstrings one side at a time.

name: 椅上伸腿拉伸
instructions: 坐在椅子边缘，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
将一只腿伸直在身前，脚跟保持在地面上。
稍微向前倾，感受股四头肌的拉伸。
保持这个姿势20-30秒。
换腿并重复拉伸。
description: Using a chair for support, you extend one leg to stretch the thigh and hip. It loosens up the quads.

name: 双腿后踢臀
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Jump up off both feet.
Kick both heels up toward your glutes while you are in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with slightly bent knees.
Go straight into the next jump at a steady rhythm.
description: A bouncy jump where both heels flick up toward your glutes. It gets your heart rate up and warms up the hamstrings.

name: 哑铃凳上单腿深蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand a step in front of a bench, facing away from it.
Rest the top of one foot on the bench behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor by bending your front leg.
Keep your front knee over your toes and your chest up.
Push through your front heel to stand, then switch legs after your reps.
description: A single-leg squat with the other foot resting on a bench behind you, holding dumbbells. It hammers the quads and glutes and challenges balance.

name: 哑铃下斜凳弓步蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing away from a decline bench.
Place the top of one foot on the bench behind you.
Lower your hips straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your front foot to rise, then switch legs after your reps.
description: A rear-foot-elevated lunge using a decline bench and dumbbells. The raised back foot shifts the load onto the front leg.

name: 哑铃跳跃深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Explode upward and jump as high as you can.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink straight into the next squat.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking your toes.
description: An explosive squat jump holding light dumbbells at your sides. It builds power in the legs and gets the heart pumping.

name: 哑铃侧弓步蹲加二头弯举
english: dumbbell lateral lunge with bicep curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Take a big step to the side and sit back into that hip, keeping the other leg straight.
Curl both dumbbells up as you lower into the lunge.
Push off your bent leg to return to the middle while lowering the weights.
Alternate sides or finish all reps on one side before switching.
description: A side lunge combined with a biceps curl. It works the legs and arms together and also loosens the inner thighs.

name: 哑铃分腿跳
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step into a lunge position.
Lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Explode upward and swap your leg positions in the air.
Land softly in a lunge with the opposite leg forward.
Keep your torso upright and move fluidly from rep to rep.
description: A jumping lunge where you switch legs in the air while holding dumbbells. It builds explosive leg power.

name: 哑铃深蹲 v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go until your thighs are parallel to the floor or a bit lower.
Keep your chest up and your heels planted.
Press through your feet to stand back up.
description: A simple squat holding a dumbbell in each hand. It is a solid all-round leg builder that is easy to load.

name: 哑铃凳上直腿硬拉
english: dumbbell stiff leg deadlift on bench
instructions: Stand on a sturdy bench holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees nearly straight and push your hips back.
Lower the dumbbells down your legs and below the bench level with a flat back.
Pause when you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
description: A stiff-legged deadlift with dumbbells while standing on a bench for extra depth. It targets the hamstrings and lower back.

name: 哑铃行走弓步蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand tall.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push off your back foot and step through into a lunge with the other leg.
Continue walking forward, alternating legs.
description: Lunges done on the move with dumbbells in your hands. A great move for leg strength, glutes and coordination.

name: 哑铃靠墙静蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lean your back against a wall.
Walk your feet forward so your knees stay over your ankles when you squat.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat against the wall.
Press through your heels to slide back up.
description: A wall squat made harder by holding dumbbells. It keeps your back supported while loading the legs.

name: 稳定球髋屈肌拉伸
instructions: 将稳定球放在地上并跪在其前面。
将右脚放在稳定球上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将左腿伸到身后，保持伸直。
身体前倾，将臀部推向稳定球，直到感觉到右髋屈肌有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后换边重复。
description: You kneel with a stability ball for support and push the hips forward. It stretches the hip flexors at the front of the hip.

name: 稳定球坐姿腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
慢慢地向前滚动球，双脚向外走，直到上背部靠在球上，双腿在身前伸直。
将双手放在臀部上以获得支撑。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将上半身降低到地面，保持背部挺直，胸部抬起。
当您感觉到腿筋拉伸时停止，并保持该姿势 20-30 秒。
通过推动脚后跟并使用腿筋将自己拉回来，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Seated on a stability ball with one leg extended, you lean forward to stretch the back of the thigh.

name: 稳定球坐姿股四头肌拉伸
instructions: Sit on the edge of a stability ball with your torso upright.
Hold on to something steady for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glutes, holding your ankle.
Keep your knees close together and your hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A gentle quad stretch using a stability ball for support. It opens up the front of the thigh.

name: 稳定球靠墙深蹲
instructions: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Walk your feet forward about a step and stand shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and let the ball roll down your back as you squat.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Press through your heels to rise back up.
description: A squat with a stability ball between your back and the wall. The ball keeps the movement smooth and supports your back.

name: 前后抬腿
instructions: Stand tall next to a wall or support and hold on with one hand.
Swing your outside leg forward with a straight knee.
Swing it back behind you, squeezing your glute.
Keep your torso upright and avoid arching your lower back.
Do all reps on one side, then turn around and switch legs.
description: A standing leg swing forward and backward, loosening the hips. A nice warm-up for the hips and hamstrings.

name: 中级髋屈肌与股四头肌拉伸
english: intermediate hip flexor and quad stretch
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
抓住一个稳定的物体作为支撑。
弯曲右膝，将右脚移向臀部，用右手抓住绳子。
慢慢地将右脚拉向臀部，感受右股四头肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开拉伸并在左侧重复。
description: A deeper stretch for the hip flexors and quads, using a rope or strap to pull the foot toward you.

name: 壶铃停顿高翻
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet hip-width apart and hinge down to grab the handle.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Rotate your hand around the handle and catch the bell at your shoulder.
Lower it back to the floor under control and reset before the next rep.
description: A clean that starts from a dead stop on the floor each rep, with no swing. It builds explosive hip drive and pulling power.

name: 壶铃单臂过头深蹲(大腿位)
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and lock out your elbow.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and keep your ribs down.
Squat down with your chest up while keeping the bell stable over your shoulder.
Go as low as you can with good control.
Drive up through your heels, then switch arms after your reps.
description: A squat while holding a kettlebell locked out overhead with one arm. It trains leg strength together with shoulder stability and core control.

name: 壶铃开掌高翻
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge down and grab the handle with one hand.
Hike the bell back, then drive your hips forward to pull it up.
Keep your hand open and guide the bell to rest at your shoulder.
Lower it back with control and repeat, then switch sides.
description: A kettlebell clean where your palm stays open and you catch the bell on your forearm. It teaches a smooth hip-driven pull.

name: 壶铃单臂摆动
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders and hold a kettlebell with one hand.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and let the bell float up to chest height.
Keep your arm relaxed and your back flat.
Let the bell fall back and hinge again, then switch hands after your reps.
description: A one-armed kettlebell swing driven by the hips. It builds the posterior chain and conditioning.

name: 壶铃单腿硬拉
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward at the hip and extend your free leg straight back.
Lower the bell toward the floor while keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is about parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glute to return upright, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg hip hinge holding a kettlebell. It trains the hamstrings and glutes and challenges your balance.

name: 团身跳
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively and tuck both knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs again before landing.
Land softly on bent knees and reset before the next jump.
description: An explosive vertical jump where you pull your knees into your chest at the top. Great for power and conditioning.

name: 杠杆单腿腿屈伸
instructions: Sit on the machine and adjust the pad so it rests on your lower shin.
Set one foot under the pad and keep the other foot on the floor or footrest.
Extend your working leg until it is almost straight.
Squeeze your quad at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A machine leg extension done one leg at a time. It isolates the quads and helps even out strength between sides.

name: 杠杆坐姿单腿宽距深蹲
english: lever seated one leg wide squat
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place one foot wide on the platform and keep the other leg off the load.
Lower by bending your working knee as far as is comfortable.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up, then switch legs after your reps.
description: A seated machine squat using one leg in a wide stance. It loads the quads, glutes and inner thighs with back support.

name: 杠杆坐姿单腿深蹲
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place one foot on the platform at about shoulder width.
Lower under control by bending your knee.
Keep your heel flat and your knee in line with your toes.
Press back up, then switch legs after your reps.
description: A seated machine squat done on one leg. It lets you load each leg separately with good support.

name: 杠杆坐姿宽距深蹲
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Set both feet wide on the platform with toes slightly out.
Lower by bending your knees until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your knees pointing in the same direction as your toes.
Press through your heels to stand back up.
description: A seated machine squat with a wide stance. It puts extra emphasis on the glutes and inner thighs.

name: 滑车45度窄站距腿举
instructions: Sit in the sled with your back flat against the pad and feet close together on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the sled by bending your knees toward your chest.
Stop before your lower back lifts off the pad.
Press through your heels to extend your legs without locking the knees.
description: A 45 degree sled leg press with feet close together. The narrow stance puts the focus on the quads.

name: 抬腿腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: 平躺，双腿伸展。
弯曲一侧膝盖，将其靠近胸部，握住大腿或小腿。
尽可能伸直腿，同时保持腿抬高。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
description: Lying on your back with one leg raised, you draw it toward you to stretch the hamstring.

name: 仰卧髋屈肌
instructions: Lie on your back near the edge of a bench or bed.
Hug one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang off the edge with the knee relaxed.
Keep your lower back pressed down and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A lying stretch that opens the front of the hip. Handy after long periods of sitting.

name: 单腿四分之一深蹲
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Extend your arms in front for balance.
Bend your knee and sink down about a quarter of the way.
Keep your knee in line with your toes and your chest up.
Stand back up, then switch legs after your reps.
description: A shallow single-leg squat that is easy on the knees. It builds balance and leg strength.

name: 滑车单腿哈克深蹲
instructions: Position yourself in the hack squat sled with your back and shoulders against the pads.
Place one foot in the middle of the platform and keep the other foot off.
Release the safety and lower by bending your working knee.
Go as deep as you can with control.
Press up through your heel, then switch legs after your reps.
description: A hack squat on the sled using one leg at a time. It isolates each quad and glute with solid back support.

name: 囚徒深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place your hands behind your head.
Pull your elbows back and keep your chest up.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
description: A bodyweight squat with your hands behind your head. It keeps your chest open and builds leg strength.

name: 徒手后撤弓步蹲
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel planted.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side first.
description: A lunge where you step back instead of forward. It is gentler on the knees and focuses on the glutes.

name: 仰卧大脚趾式(用绳子)
english: reclining big toe pose with rope
instructions: 仰卧，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
将绳子绕在右脚掌上，并用手握住绳子的末端。
慢慢地将右腿抬向胸部，保持膝盖伸直，脚弯曲。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢将腿放回起始位置。
左腿重复上述动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
description: Lying on your back, you hold your big toe with a rope and raise the leg straight. It stretches the hamstrings.

name: 滑车反向哈克深蹲
instructions: Face the pad of the hack squat sled with your chest against it and feet on the platform.
Hold the handles and release the safety.
Lower by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest pressed against the pad.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
description: A hack squat done facing the pad on the sled. It puts more load on the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 火箭跳
