instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while swinging your arms back.
Explode upward and reach both arms overhead as you jump.
Extend your whole body like a rocket.
Land softly on bent knees and reset before the next jump.
description: A deep squat followed by a big vertical jump with your arms reaching up. It builds explosive leg power.

name: 跑者拉伸
instructions: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，保持左脚踩地。
弯曲右膝，降低身体，保持左腿伸直。
将双手放在右大腿上以获得支撑。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后换边重复。
description: A lunge position stretch for the hips, thighs and hamstrings, often used by runners to loosen up.

name: 杠杆坐姿单腿弯举
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and adjust the leg pad above your heel.
Place one leg under the pad and rest the other foot on the footrest.
Curl your heel down and back as far as you can.
Squeeze your hamstring at the bottom.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.
description: A seated hamstring curl on a machine with one leg at a time. It isolates each hamstring.

name: 坐姿广角式序列
instructions: 坐在地上，双腿大角度伸展。
弯曲你的脚并锻炼你的股四头肌。
将双手放在身后的地面上以获得支撑。
保持背部挺直，从臀部向前倾。
继续向前倾斜，直到感觉到腿筋被拉伸。
保持这个姿势几个呼吸。
慢慢释放拉伸并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated sequence with legs wide that stretches the inner thighs and hamstrings. Move slowly with the breath.

name: 跳箱左右移动
instructions: Stand next to a low box or step on one side.
Place the foot closest to it on top.
Hop across, landing the other foot on the box as the first foot goes down.
Keep your steps light and quick.
Continue shuffling side to side at a steady pace.
description: A quick-footed drill where you hop side to side over a box. It builds agility, lower leg stamina and conditioning.

name: 单腿后踢臀
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other foot lifted.
Hop lightly on your standing foot.
Kick your free heel toward your glutes each hop.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: A hopping drill where you flick one heel up to your glutes. It warms up the hamstrings and raises your heart rate.

name: 杠杆俯卧单腿弯举
instructions: Lie face down on the machine and place one leg under the pad above your heel.
Hold the handles and keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heel up toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your reps.
description: A lying hamstring curl on a machine using one leg at a time. It helps balance strength between legs.

name: 单腿蹬地
instructions: Stand in front of a low step with one foot planted on it.
Lean slightly forward and keep your core tight.
Push off the step explosively with that leg and drive your opposite knee up.
Land softly on the same foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: An explosive single-leg push off the floor or a step. It builds leg drive useful for running and jumping.

name: 单腿跨步跳
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Push off and leap forward as far as you can.
Land on the opposite leg and absorb the impact with a soft knee.
Hold the landing for a moment to stay balanced.
Repeat, alternating legs or staying on one side.
description: A bounding jump from one leg to the other leg. It develops power and single-leg control.

name: 坐姿深蹲
instructions: Stand in front of a chair or bench with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and lower yourself toward the seat.
Lightly touch the seat without relaxing completely.
Keep your chest up and your knees over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand back up.
description: A squat down to a seat and back up. The chair gives you a depth target and builds confidence.

name: 史密斯机弗兰肯斯坦深蹲
instructions: Set the bar at upper chest height and rest it on your front shoulders.
Extend your arms straight forward, like a zombie, to keep the bar in place.
Unrack the bar and step into a stable stance.
Squat down with your chest up and your torso upright.
Drive through your heels to stand and rerack when finished.
description: A front-loaded squat on the smith machine with your arms stretched straight in front. It strongly challenges the quads and upper back posture.

name: 史密斯机前蹲
instructions: Set the bar at shoulder height and rest it on the front of your shoulders with elbows up.
Unrack it and step your feet slightly forward.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows high and your chest up.
Press through your heels to stand and rerack when done.
description: A front squat with the bar guided by the smith machine. It trains the quads with an upright torso.

name: 史密斯机深蹲至凳
instructions: Place a bench behind you under the smith bar.
Rest the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
Sit your hips back and lower until you touch the bench lightly.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and rerack when finished.
description: A smith machine squat down to a bench behind you. The bench gives a consistent depth target.

name: 史密斯机直腿硬拉
instructions: Stand close to the smith bar with feet hip-width apart and grip the bar overhand.
Unrack it and keep your knees nearly straight.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
description: A stiff-legged deadlift using the smith machine bar. The fixed path lets you focus on feeling the hamstrings work.

name: 史密斯机泽奇深蹲
instructions: Set the bar at waist height and hook your elbows under it with your arms crossed.
Unrack and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while keeping your chest up and the bar close to your body.
Go until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your heels to stand and rerack when done.
description: A squat holding the bar in the crooks of your elbows on the smith machine. It trains the legs while taxing the core and upper back.

name: 站姿腘绳肌与小腿拉伸(用拉伸带)
english: standing hamstring and calf stretch with strap
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
用双手握住带子并将其放在脚掌周围。
保持腿伸直，从臀部慢慢向前倾斜，保持背部挺直。
感受腿筋和小腿肌肉的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
放松拉伸并用另一条腿重复。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Standing with a strap around your foot, you pull your toes toward you to stretch the hamstring and calf.

name: 立定跳远
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart at a clear starting line.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Swing your arms forward and jump as far as you can.
Land on both feet with your knees bent to absorb the impact.
Reset and repeat.
description: A jump for distance from a standing start. It builds explosive power in the hips and legs.

name: 站姿直腿腘绳肌收缩放松(稳定球)
english: standing straight leg hamstring contract relax on exercise ball
instructions: Stand and rest one heel on a stability ball in front of you with your knee straight.
Hinge forward at the hips until you feel a stretch in the back of the thigh.
Gently press your heel into the ball for about 5 seconds, then relax.
Lean a little deeper into the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A hamstring stretch with the heel on a stability ball, using a contract and relax method. It helps you ease deeper into the stretch.

name: 横向上台阶
instructions: Stand sideways next to a bench or step.
Place the inside foot fully on top.
Drive through that heel and step up until your leg is straight.
Bring your other foot up to meet it.
Step back down with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A step-up performed side-on to the bench. It works the glutes and quads while challenging your balance.

name: 负重稳定球靠墙深蹲
instructions: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Hold your weight at chest level or at your sides.
Step your feet forward and squat as the ball rolls down your back.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Press through your heels to rise back up.
description: A wall squat with a stability ball behind you while holding extra weight. It adds load to a back-supported squat.

name: 世界上最伟大的拉伸
instructions: 从弓步位置开始，右脚向前，左脚向后。
将双手放在右脚两侧的地面上。
将左膝降低到地面并伸展右腿，保持右脚平放在地面上。
向右旋转你的躯干，将你的右臂伸向天花板。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后回到起始位置。
换边并重复拉伸，左脚向前。
description: A flowing lunge with a twist and reach that opens the hips, hamstrings and upper back. A favorite warm-up move.

name: 绳索三头肌下压(曲杆)
instructions: Attach an SZ bar to a high pulley and grip it with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Pin your elbows to your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the bar rise slowly until your forearms are just above parallel.
description: A cable pushdown using an SZ bar, a staple for building the back of the arm.

name: 绳索反握三头肌下压(曲杆)
english: cable reverse grip triceps pushdown (sz bar)
instructions: Attach an SZ bar to a high pulley and grip it palms up with hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Return slowly without letting your elbows drift forward.
description: A triceps pushdown with an underhand grip on an SZ bar. The reverse grip shifts the feel slightly and works the forearms too.

name: 绳索二头弯举(曲杆)
instructions: Attach an SZ bar to a low pulley and grip it with an underhand grip.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and avoid swinging your body.
description: A standing cable curl with an SZ bar. The cable keeps constant tension on the biceps.

name: 绳索站姿反握弯举(曲杆)
instructions: Attach an SZ bar to a low pulley and grip it overhand with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Stand tall with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl the bar up while keeping your wrists straight.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your torso still.
description: A standing curl with an overhand grip on a cable SZ bar. It targets the brachialis and forearms.

name: 绳索单臂侧向三头肌下压
english: cable one arm side triceps pushdown
instructions: Attach a handle to a high pulley and stand sideways to the machine.
Grip the handle with the arm closest to the stack and keep your elbow at your side.
Push the handle down until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-armed cable pushdown done from the side. It isolates each triceps and lets you focus on form.

name: 杠铃背后手指弯举
instructions: Stand holding a barbell behind your back with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Let the bar roll down to your fingertips.
Curl your fingers closed and lift the bar back into your palms.
Curl your wrists up a little at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.
description: A forearm exercise where you hold the bar behind your back and roll it down to your fingertips. It builds grip and forearm strength.

name: 哑铃背后手指弯举
instructions: Stand tall with a light dumbbell held in one hand behind your back.
Let the dumbbell roll down until it rests on your fingertips.
Close your fingers and curl the weight back into your palm.
Keep your wrist still and your arm close to your body.
Lower under control and repeat, then switch hands.
description: Holding a dumbbell behind your back, you roll it down to your fingertips and curl it back up. It builds finger and forearm flexor strength and grip.

name: 游泳者髋部
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and your legs straight.
Lift your chest slightly and brace your glutes.
Raise one arm and the opposite leg a few inches.
Switch sides in a controlled flutter.
Keep your neck neutral and breathe steadily.
description: A prone floor move where opposite arm and leg lift in alternation, training the back and glutes.

name: 杠杆牧师凳弯举 v. 2
instructions: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，上臂放在垫子上，胸部靠在支撑物上。
反手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持上臂静止，呼气，同时将手柄向肩膀卷曲，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将手柄放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A preacher curl on a lever machine, version 2. The pad locks your upper arms in place so the biceps do the work.

name: 杠杆锤式握牧师凳弯举
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在杠杆机上。
将你的上臂放在讲道垫上，确保你的胸部压在上面。
用锤子握把抓住手柄（手掌相对）。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将手柄卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A preacher curl on a lever machine with a neutral hammer grip. It hits the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.

name: 杠杆反握牧师凳弯举
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在杠杆机上。
反手握住手柄，手掌朝上。
将上臂放在牧师垫上，确保肘部完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将手柄卷向肩膀。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将手柄放回起始位置，充分伸展肘部。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A preacher curl on a lever machine with an overhand grip. It shifts work to the forearms and brachialis.

name: 哑铃下斜单臂锤式推举
english: dumbbell decline one arm hammer press
instructions: 躺在下斜长凳上，一只手握住哑铃，放在胸前。
将手臂伸直向上，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
将哑铃向肩膀方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
将哑铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm press on a decline bench with a neutral grip. It targets the triceps and the lower chest.

name: 哑铃上斜锤式推举(稳定球)
english: dumbbell incline hammer press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
双脚向前走，身体沿着球滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
将哑铃保持在与肩同高的位置，肘部弯曲并指向两侧。
将哑铃向上并稍微向内推，保持手掌相对。
充分伸展双臂，在动作的最高点挤压三头肌。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A neutral-grip press on an incline bench set on an exercise ball. The ball adds an unstable challenge for the triceps.

name: 哑铃上斜单臂锤式推举
english: dumbbell incline one arm hammer press
instructions: 坐在上斜凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，放在大腿上。
向后靠在长凳上，用大腿帮助将哑铃举至肩膀高度。
旋转手腕，使手掌朝内，朝向身体。
将哑铃向上推离身体，完全伸展手臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm neutral-grip press on an incline bench. It trains the triceps and upper chest on one side at a time.

name: 哑铃上斜单臂锤式推举(稳定球)
english: dumbbell incline one arm hammer press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃。
双脚向前走，身体向下滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
握住哑铃，手掌朝内，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
将哑铃向上推向天花板，伸直手臂。
将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm hammer press on an incline with an exercise ball. It works the triceps and adds a balance challenge.

name: 哑铃单臂锤式推举(稳定球)
english: dumbbell one arm hammer press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，掌心向内，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
将另一只手放在臀部上以保持稳定。
向上推哑铃，充分伸展手臂。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm neutral-grip press while lying on an exercise ball. It trains the triceps while the core keeps you stable.

name: 哑铃单臂反握推举
english: dumbbell one arm reverse grip press
instructions: 坐在平坦的长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将双脚平放在地面上，并保持背部挺直。
将哑铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部靠近身体。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
description: A one-arm dumbbell press with your palm facing you. It shifts focus to the upper chest and biceps.

name: 哑铃掌心向内上斜卧推
english: dumbbell palms in incline bench press
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地上。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握握，手掌朝内。
将手臂伸直至胸部上方，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
将哑铃慢慢向肩膀方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将哑铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An incline bench press with palms facing in. It trains the triceps and the front delts with a shoulder-friendly grip.

name: 哑铃反向卧推
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握住，手掌朝向脚部。
将手臂伸直向上伸向天花板，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
慢慢地将哑铃降低到胸部，让肘部向两侧张开。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将哑铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bench press with a reverse grip using dumbbells. It targets the upper chest and the triceps.

name: 史密斯机下斜窄握卧推
english: smith machine decline close grip bench press
instructions: 将史密斯机上的长凳调整至下降位置。
躺在长凳上，双脚牢牢踩在地上。
紧紧握住杠铃，握距略窄于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其缓慢降低至胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃位于胸部正上方时，暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A close grip bench press on a decline bench in the smith machine. It builds the triceps and lower chest.

name: 史密斯机反向下斜窄握卧推
english: smith machine reverse decline close grip bench press
instructions: 将史密斯机调整至下降位置。
躺在长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
紧紧握住杠铃，握距略窄于肩宽。
松开杠铃，慢慢将其降低到胸部，保持肘部内收。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A reverse grip, close grip decline bench press in the smith machine. It works the chest and triceps.

name: EZ杠铃窄握牧师凳弯举
english: ez barbell close grip preacher curl
instructions: 坐在牧师弯举凳上，将上臂放在垫子上，反手握住 ez 杠铃。
将三头肌放在垫子上，充分伸展手臂，保持背部挺直。
慢慢地将杠铃向肩膀弯曲，收缩二头肌。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A preacher curl with an EZ bar and a close grip. It emphasizes the outer biceps.

name: EZ杠铃蜘蛛弯举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上。
将上臂放在牧师凳或稳定球上，让肘部下垂。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A spider curl with an EZ bar, lying chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the biceps with no swing.

name: 杠铃站姿宽握二头弯举
english: barbell standing wide grip biceps curl
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，反握握住杠铃，双手分开比肩宽。
保持背部挺直，肘部靠近躯干。
呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀，保持上臂静止。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing barbell curl with a wide grip. It puts more load on the inner biceps.

name: 绳索窄握弯举
instructions: 将直杆连接到低滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将杠铃向上卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A cable curl with a close grip. It keeps constant tension on the biceps.

name: 绳索集中弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
用手握住电缆手柄，并将肘部靠在大腿内侧。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将电缆手柄向肩膀卷曲，同时收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后吸气并慢慢将拉索手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A concentration curl using a cable. The elbow stays braced so the biceps do the work.

name: 绳索拖曳弯举
instructions: 面向缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用手握住电缆附件，手掌朝上，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并通过收缩二头肌将电缆附件卷曲至肩膀。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将电缆附件放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A cable curl where you drag the handle up along your body. It trains the biceps with the elbows pulled back.

name: 绳索单臂牧师凳弯举
instructions: 调整绳索机，使牧师弯举垫处于胸部高度。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用手握住电缆手柄，并将上臂靠在牧师弯举垫上。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
慢慢地将电缆手柄卷向肩膀，保持上臂靠在垫子上。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
慢慢地将电缆手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
交换手臂并重复练习。
description: A one-arm preacher curl on a cable. The pad blocks swinging, so the biceps take the load.

name: 绳索仰卧二头弯举
instructions: 将直杆连接到低滑轮电缆机上。
面朝上躺在平坦的长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
充分伸展双臂，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A biceps curl lying on your back with a cable. It keeps tension constant through the whole motion.

name: 绳索单臂反握牧师凳弯举
english: cable one arm reverse preacher curl
instructions: 调整拉索机，使滑轮处于最低位置。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用反手抓住电缆手柄，并将上臂靠在牧师凳垫上。
在整个练习过程中保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与其中。
慢慢地将前臂向二头肌方向卷曲，保持上臂固定在垫子上。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
慢慢地将电缆手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
交换手臂并重复练习。
description: A one-arm reverse grip preacher curl on a cable. It works the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.

name: 绳索过头弯举
instructions: 将直杆连接到高滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将杠铃向下卷向前额，保持上臂静止。
在动作底部暂停片刻，挤压二头肌。
吸气，慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A curl with the cable set high so the arms are lifted overhead. It trains the biceps through a short range.

name: 绳索过头弯举(稳定球)
english: cable overhead curl on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，用反手握住电缆手柄。
将手臂完全伸过头顶，保持肘部靠近耳朵。
慢慢地将电缆朝前额卷曲，保持上臂静止。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An overhead cable curl while sitting on an exercise ball. The ball adds core demand to the biceps work.

name: 绳索下拉二头弯举
instructions: 在最高设置下将直杆连接到电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气，慢慢将杠铃向大腿方向卷曲，保持手腕伸直。
在动作底部暂停片刻，挤压二头肌。
吸气，慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A curl at a high pulley that begins with a pulldown. It builds the biceps and also the lats.

name: 绳索绳把锤式牧师凳弯举
instructions: 将绳索附件连接到低滑轮缆绳机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
以中立握法（手掌相对）抓住绳子。
将上臂靠在牧师凳垫上，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
保持上臂静止，呼气并通过收缩二头肌将绳子卷向肩膀。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将绳子放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A hammer grip preacher curl with a rope on a cable. It targets the brachialis and the biceps.

name: 绳索绳把单臂锤式牧师凳弯举
english: cable rope one arm hammer preacher curl
instructions: 将绳索手柄连接到低滑轮电缆机器上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住绳索手柄，手掌朝上。
将上臂靠在牧师凳垫上，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在整个练习过程中保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与其中。
慢慢地将绳索手柄卷向肩膀，保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点挤压二头肌，然后慢慢将绳柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm hammer preacher curl with a rope on a cable. It targets the brachialis and the biceps on one side.

name: 绳索坐姿弯举
instructions: 坐在缆绳机上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
反手抓住电缆附件，手掌朝上，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将电缆附件卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将电缆附件放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated cable biceps curl. The seat keeps you steady so the biceps do the lifting.

name: 绳索坐姿单臂集中弯举
english: cable seated one arm concentration curl
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地板上，背部挺直。
用一只手握住电缆手柄，并将肘部放在大腿内侧、膝盖上方。
呼气时，保持上臂静止并将电缆手柄向肩膀卷曲。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气时慢慢将电缆手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A seated one-arm concentration curl using a cable. It isolates the biceps on one side at a time.

name: 绳索坐姿过头弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，面向电缆机，双脚平放在地面上。
用手握住电缆附件，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
保持上臂不动，肘部靠近身体两侧。
呼气并将电缆附件卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将电缆附件放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated curl at a high cable stack with your arms overhead. It stresses the biceps in a different way.

name: 绳索深蹲弯举
instructions: 将电缆手柄连接到电缆机器上的最低设置。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝上，手臂完全伸展。
将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，膝盖位于脚趾后面。
当你蹲下时，将电缆手柄卷向肩膀，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在弯举的顶部暂停片刻，挤压二头肌。
慢慢地将电缆手柄放回起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A curl you perform in a squat position with a cable. The legs hold you low while the biceps curl.

name: 绳索上斜凳双臂弯举
english: cable two arm curl on incline bench
instructions: 坐在倾斜的长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地面上。
反手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝上，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将手柄向肩膀弯曲，同时收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将手柄放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A two-arm cable curl on an incline bench. The incline puts the biceps in a stretched position.

name: 哑铃交替锤式牧师凳弯举
instructions: 坐在牧师凳上，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌面向躯干，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，在弯举哑铃时呼气，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复建议的重复次数。
description: Alternating hammer curls on a preacher bench. It builds the brachialis and the biceps with strict form.

name: 哑铃交替牧师凳弯举
instructions: 坐在牧师凳上，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝上。
将上臂放在牧师凳的垫子上，让手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯曲右手的哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续弯举哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
暂停片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用左臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。
description: Alternating dumbbell curls on a preacher bench. It builds the biceps with no momentum.

name: 哑铃坐姿交替锤式弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干，手臂向下伸展。
保持背部挺直，肘部靠近躯干。
呼气，将右手的哑铃向肩膀弯曲，保持上臂静止。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
暂停片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用左臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。
description: Alternating hammer curls while seated. The neutral grip trains the brachialis and forearms.

name: 哑铃交替二头弯举(单腿抬起,稳定球)
english: dumbbell alternating bicep curl with leg raised on exercise ball
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将健身球放在身后，并将一只脚放在上面，保持平衡。
双臂完全伸展，肘部靠近身体两侧，将一只哑铃向肩膀弯曲，同时保持上臂静止。
将哑铃放回起始位置，然后用另一只手臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。
description: Alternating dumbbell curls with one leg lifted while sitting on an exercise ball. It trains the biceps and challenges balance.

name: 哑铃坐姿交替二头弯举(稳定球)
english: dumbbell alternating seated bicep curl on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举一只哑铃，同时旋转前臂，直到手掌面向肩膀。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复弯举动作。
继续交替卷发达到所需的重复次数。
description: Alternating dumbbell curls seated on an exercise ball. It trains the biceps while the core keeps you upright.

name: 哑铃二头弯举弓步蹲(保龄球动作)
english: dumbbell bicep curl lunge with bowling motion
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
右脚向前迈出一步，弯曲右膝，将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你向前弓步时，将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，保持肘部靠近身体。
在弓步底部，将躯干向右旋转，就像打保龄球一样。
反转动作，右脚向后退一步，回到起始位置，同时放下哑铃。
重复弓步和弯举动作，这次将躯干向左旋转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A lunge combined with a bicep curl in a bowling-style motion. It trains the biceps, glutes and legs together.

name: 哑铃二头弯举(稳定球,单腿抬起)
english: dumbbell bicep curl on exercise ball with leg raised
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
慢慢地将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
在进行二头肌弯举时，将一条腿抬离地面，并在整个练习过程中将其保持在空中。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。
description: A dumbbell curl on an exercise ball with one leg raised. It trains the biceps while testing balance.

name: 哑铃二头弯举(鹤立式站姿)
english: dumbbell bicep curl with stork stance
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将一条腿伸到身后，用脚趾保持平衡。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。
description: A dumbbell curl while balancing on one leg in a stork stance. It trains the biceps and balance.

name: 哑铃反向二头弯举
instructions: 站直，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝下，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell curl using an overhand grip. It trains the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.

name: 哑铃二头弯举深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
保持背部挺直，肘部靠近身体两侧，呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A squat combined with a dumbbell curl. It works the legs and biceps in one move.

name: 哑铃二头弯举V字坐(波速球)
english: dumbbell biceps curl v sit on bosu ball
instructions: 坐在博苏球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂在身体两侧完全向下伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell biceps curl while sitting on a bosu ball with your legs in a V. It trains the biceps and the core.

name: 哑铃交叉锤式弯举 v. 2
english: dumbbell cross body hammer curl v. 2
instructions: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌，使哑铃尽可能靠近另一侧的肩膀。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A hammer curl across the body toward the opposite shoulder, version 2. It hits the brachialis and biceps.

name: 哑铃弓步蹲加二头弯举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。你的右膝应该弯曲成 90 度角，左膝应该悬停在地面上方。
当你向前弓步时，同时将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，保持肘部靠近身体。
在弓步底部停顿片刻，然后通过右脚跟推动回到起始位置，将哑铃放回身体两侧。
在另一侧重复弓步和二头肌弯举，左脚向前迈出。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A lunge paired with a bicep curl. It trains the biceps, quads and glutes together.

name: 哑铃锤式弯举(稳定球)
english: dumbbell hammer curl on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A hammer curl while sitting on an exercise ball. It trains the brachialis, biceps and core.

name: 哑铃跪姿二头弯举(稳定球)
english: dumbbell kneeling bicep curl exercise ball
instructions: 跪在地板上，面前放一个健身球。
将肘部放在健身球上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝上。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell curl while kneeling on an exercise ball. It trains the biceps and demands balance.

name: 哑铃仰卧二头弯举
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，背部和头部得到支撑，双脚平放在地面上。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝上，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell curl lying on your back. It isolates the biceps with your upper arms supported.

name: 哑铃仰卧宽距弯举
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝上，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell curl lying down with the arms wide. It emphasizes the inner biceps.

name: 哑铃单臂锤式牧师凳弯举
english: dumbbell one arm hammer preacher curl
instructions: 坐在牧师凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，上臂放在垫子上。
以中立握法握住哑铃（手掌朝向身体）。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm hammer curl over a preacher bench. It builds the brachialis and biceps without swinging.

name: 哑铃高位弯举
instructions: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
保持上臂静止，将哑铃尽可能高地卷起，同时收缩二头肌。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell curl lifted high toward the shoulder. It trains the peak of the biceps contraction.

name: 哑铃单臂俯卧弯举
instructions: 脸朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，一只手握住哑铃，掌心朝下。
完全伸展你的手臂，让它垂直垂向地板。
保持上臂静止，通过收缩二头肌将哑铃向上卷曲至肩膀。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm curl lying chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the biceps on one side.

name: 哑铃单臂俯卧锤式弯举
english: dumbbell one arm prone hammer curl
instructions: 面朝下躺在平坦的长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，手掌面向身体，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，收缩二头肌。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm hammer curl lying chest down on a bench. It trains the brachialis and biceps.

name: 哑铃单臂反握蜘蛛弯举
english: dumbbell one arm reverse spider curl
instructions: 站直，一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝下，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，将哑铃向肩膀方向卷曲。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm reverse spider curl, with an overhand grip over a bench. It works the forearms and brachialis.

name: 哑铃单臂坐姿二头弯举(稳定球)
english: dumbbell one arm seated bicep curl on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝上，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，通过收缩二头肌将哑铃向肩膀弯曲。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm seated dumbbell curl on an exercise ball. It trains the biceps and your balance.

name: 哑铃单臂坐姿锤式弯举
english: dumbbell one arm seated hammer curl
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
一只手握住哑铃，保持中立握姿（手掌相对）。
将肘部放在大腿内侧、膝盖上方。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm seated hammer curl. It trains the brachialis and biceps on one side at a time.

name: 哑铃单臂站姿弯举
instructions: 站直，一手握哑铃，手掌朝前，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并向上弯曲重量，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A standing one-arm dumbbell curl. It builds the biceps on one side at a time.

name: 哑铃单臂站姿锤式弯举
english: dumbbell one arm standing hammer curl
instructions: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干。
保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing one-arm hammer curl. It trains the brachialis and biceps with a neutral grip.

name: 哑铃单臂佐特曼牧师凳弯举
english: dumbbell one arm zottman preacher curl
instructions: 坐在牧师弯举凳上，单手握哑铃，反握。
将上臂放在牧师凳垫上，让手臂完全伸展。
将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，保持上臂静止。
在卷曲的顶部，旋转手腕，使手掌朝上。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，同时将手腕旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm Zottman curl over a preacher bench: curl up palm up, turn the palm down to lower. It works biceps and forearms.

name: 哑铃牧师凳弯举(稳定球上)
english: dumbbell preacher curl over exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，反握，将肘部放在健身球上。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A preacher curl with the arm supported over an exercise ball. It trains the biceps with some balance demand.

name: 哑铃俯卧上斜锤式弯举
instructions: 将长凳调整至 45 度倾斜。
脸朝下躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
让你的手臂垂直垂向地板，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A hammer curl lying chest down on an incline bench. It trains the brachialis and biceps.

name: 哑铃反握蜘蛛弯举
instructions: 站直，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A reverse spider curl with both dumbbells, chest down on a bench. It trains the forearms and brachialis.

name: 哑铃坐姿交替锤式弯举(稳定球)
english: dumbbell seated alternate hammer curl on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将一只哑铃向上弯向肩膀，同时保持手掌朝向身体。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。
description: Alternating hammer curls while seated on an exercise ball. It trains the brachialis, biceps and core.

name: 哑铃坐姿二头弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心朝上。
保持背部挺直，肘部靠近躯干。
呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell biceps curl performed seated. It keeps your legs out of the movement.

name: 哑铃坐姿锤式弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干，手臂伸直向下。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A hammer curl seated on a bench. It trains the brachialis and the forearms.

name: 哑铃单臂坐姿二头弯举(稳定球,单腿抬起)
english: dumbbell seated one arm bicep curl on exercise ball with leg raised
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝上，手臂完全伸展。
将另一只手放在臀部上以保持稳定。
慢慢地将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
交换手臂并重复练习。
description: A one-arm curl seated on an exercise ball with one leg raised. It trains the biceps and balance.

name: 哑铃站姿单臂弯举(上斜凳上方)
english: dumbbell standing one arm curl over incline bench
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃。
将另一只手放在倾斜的长凳上以获得支撑。
保持上臂静止，通过收缩二头肌将哑铃向肩膀弯曲。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A standing one-arm curl with your chest over an incline bench. It isolates the biceps.

name: 哑铃双臂坐姿锤式弯举(稳定球)
english: dumbbell two arm seated hammer curl on exercise ball
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Plant your feet wide for balance and keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders without turning your wrists.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full arm extension.
Keep your chest tall and avoid swinging your torso.
description: Seated on a stability ball, you curl two dumbbells with palms facing each other. It hits the biceps and brachialis while the ball asks your core to stay steady.

name: EZ杠坐姿窄握集中弯举
english: ez bar seated close grip concentration curl
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上，反手握住 EZ 杠铃。
将肘部放在大腿内侧、膝盖上方。
将杠铃向上弯向肩膀，同时保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点挤压二头肌，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated close grip concentration curl using an EZ bar. It isolates the biceps with strict form.

name: 史密斯机二头弯举
instructions: 将史密斯机杆的高度调整到腰部水平。
面对史密斯机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
反手握住杠铃，双手间距略大于肩宽。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将杠铃向上卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A biceps curl in the smith machine. The fixed bar path makes it easy to focus on the biceps.

name: 哑铃上台阶单腿平衡加二头弯举
english: dumbbell step up single leg balance with bicep curl
instructions: 站在台阶或平台前，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将右脚放在台阶上，确保整个脚与表面接触。
启动核心并推动右脚跟，将身体抬起到台阶上，将左膝抬向胸部。
在动作的最高点，弯曲肘部并将哑铃拉向肩膀，进行二头肌弯举。
将哑铃放回原处，同时将左脚放回地面。
在另一侧重复该动作，左脚向上并弯举哑铃。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A single leg step up combined with a bicep curl. It trains the biceps, glutes and balance.

name: 深蹲至过头伸展
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
当你从深蹲中站起来时，将手臂伸过头顶，伸向天花板。
放下手臂并弯曲膝盖再次蹲下，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A squat followed by reaching your arms overhead. It trains the quads and glutes and opens up the shoulders.

name: 深蹲至过头伸展并转体
english: squat to overhead reach with twist
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
当你从深蹲中站起来时，将手臂举过头顶并将躯干扭转到一侧。
返回起始位置并重复下蹲，这次将躯干扭转到另一侧。
每次深蹲重复时继续交替进行。
description: A squat with an overhead reach and a twist. It trains the legs and mobilizes the torso.

name: 后撤上步至过头伸展
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，双臂放在身体两侧。
右脚向后退一步，用脚掌着地。
弯曲左膝并将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你降低弓步时，同时将手臂举过头顶。
在弓步底部暂停片刻，然后通过推动左脚跟并将右脚向前拉回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复该动作，左脚向后退一步并弯曲右膝盖。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A step back with an overhead reach. It warms up the hips and core and stretches the front of the body.

name: 弓步蹲加转体
instructions: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你弓步时，将你的躯干向右扭转，将你的左肘拉向你的右膝盖。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，左脚向前迈出，并将躯干向左扭转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A lunge with a torso twist. It works the legs and the obliques.

name: 徒手推拉
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，保持身体伸直。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
从俯卧撑位置开始，弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向地面，保持身体伸直。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight movement of pushing and pulling against your own resistance. It trains the chest and arms.

name: 矢状面弓步蹲加药球过头推举
english: sagittal plane lunge with overhead medicine ball press
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at chest height and stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press the ball overhead as you rise.
Lower the ball and step back to the start.
Alternate legs for the planned reps.
description: A forward lunge combined with an overhead medicine ball press that links leg strength with shoulder work.

name: 药球单腿硬拉
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at your chest and stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower the ball toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to return to standing.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg hip hinge holding a medicine ball that trains the hamstrings, glutes and balance.

name: 哑铃过头侧弓步蹲
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands or one hand and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side and sit back into the hips.
Keep your chest tall and your arm locked out overhead.
Push through the bent leg to return to the middle.
Alternate sides for the planned reps.
description: A side lunge with a dumbbell held overhead that trains the legs and core stability.

name: 稳定球单腿深蹲
instructions: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Lift one foot and balance on the other leg.
Lower into a squat while the ball rolls down the wall.
Press through your heel to stand back up.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg squat with a stability ball between your back and a wall for support, building one-sided leg strength.

name: 横断面哑铃弓步蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall.
Step diagonally back or across your body into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are bent, keeping your chest upright.
Push through the front foot to return to the start.
Alternate sides for the planned reps.
description: A lunge that steps diagonally or rotates, loading the legs from a different angle.

name: 药球反向劈柴深蹲
english: medicine ball reverse wood chop squat
instructions: Hold a medicine ball overhead to one side and stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down while chopping the ball diagonally across your body.
Rotate your torso and bring the ball toward the opposite knee.
Stand up as you return the ball overhead.
Alternate sides each set.
description: A squat combined with a diagonal chop from high to low, working legs and core together.

name: 向前单脚跳
instructions: Stand on both feet with your knees slightly bent.
Swing your arms and hop forward a short distance.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Reset your posture and hop again.
Keep your hops controlled and your chest tall.
description: Short, springy hops forward that build leg power, elasticity and coordination.

name: 药球旋转抛球
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall holding a medicine ball at your hip.
Rotate away from the wall and load your back hip.
Explosively rotate and throw the ball into the wall.
Catch it on the rebound and repeat.
Switch sides after the planned reps.
description: A powerful rotational throw that trains the core, hips and shoulders to work together.

name: 哑铃借力推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高。
稍微弯曲膝盖，身体下沉，然后爆发性伸展双腿，将哑铃压过头顶。
在动作的最高点锁定手臂，然后将哑铃放回肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An overhead dumbbell press that uses a small leg dip and drive for momentum. It builds the shoulders and triceps.

name: 药球窄距俯卧撑
english: medicine ball close grip push up
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手放在健身球上，距离与肩同宽。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
推回起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A close grip push-up with your hands on a medicine ball. It hits the triceps and challenges stability.

name: 单腿触脚
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach down toward your foot or the floor.
Keep your back flat and your free leg extended behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing your glute.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg balance drill where you reach down to touch the floor or foot, training hip control and stability.

name: 单腿横向屈体
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach across your body.
Rotate your torso slightly as you reach.
Return to standing with control.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg bend with a twist that trains balance and mobility through the hips and torso.

name: 药球单腿劈柴
english: medicine ball single leg wood chop
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a medicine ball overhead to one side.
Chop the ball diagonally down across your body.
Rotate your torso and pivot your standing foot.
Return the ball overhead with control.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
description: A wood chop done on one leg that adds a balance challenge to the core rotation.

name: 波速球深蹲
instructions: 将博苏球平放在地上。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将自己放在博苏球的顶部。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸，将体重放在脚后跟上。
降低身体直到大腿与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A squat on a bosu ball. It trains the quads and glutes and tests balance.

name: 稳定球前平板支撑
instructions: Kneel behind a stability ball and place your forearms on it.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your neck neutral and your hips from sagging or rising.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then lower to the floor.
description: A forearm plank with your elbows on a stability ball. The wobbly surface makes your abs and shoulders work harder to hold a straight line.

name: 稳定球俯卧转体
instructions: 首先，面朝下躺在稳定球上，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾接触地面。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
启动核心肌肉，慢慢将上半身抬离球，保持背部挺直。
将躯干旋转到一侧，使肩膀靠近臀部。在整个运动过程中保持臀部和腿部稳定。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复旋转到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A twisting motion lying face down on a stability ball. It trains the abs and obliques.

name: 辅助仰卧小腿拉伸
instructions: 仰卧，双腿伸展。
弯曲一侧膝盖，将脚平放在地上。
用手或毛巾轻轻地将脚趾拉向身体，感受小腿的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开拉伸并在另一条腿上重复。
description: A partner-assisted stretch lying on your back for the calves. It lengthens the lower leg.

name: 辅助仰卧臀部拉伸
instructions: 仰卧，双腿伸展。
弯曲右膝盖，将右脚踝放在左大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
用双手抓住左大腿，轻轻地将其拉向胸部。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开并在另一侧重复。
description: A partner-assisted stretch lying down for the glutes. It eases the hips.

name: 辅助仰卧臀肌与梨状肌拉伸
english: assisted lying gluteus and piriformis stretch
instructions: 仰卧，双腿伸展。
弯曲右膝盖，将右脚踝放在左大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
用双手抓住左大腿，轻轻地将其拉向胸部。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开拉伸并在另一侧重复。
description: A partner-assisted stretch lying down for the glutes and piriformis. It releases deep hip tension.

name: 辅助斜向臀小肌与臀中肌拉伸
english: assisted oblique glute minimus and medius stretch
instructions: Lie on your back or side while your partner supports your top leg.
Have your partner gently guide the leg across your body while you stay relaxed.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: A partner-assisted stretch for the outer hip and side of the trunk. It eases tightness in the small gluteal muscles and obliques.

name: 辅助侧卧内收肌拉伸
instructions: 侧躺，双腿伸直并叠放在一起。
稍微弯曲下面的腿以保持稳定。
将上脚放在稳定的表面上，例如长凳或台阶上。
保持上腿伸直，慢慢将其降低到地面，感觉大腿内侧有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
返回起始位置并在另一侧重复。
description: A partner-assisted stretch lying on your side for the inner thigh. It lengthens the adductors.

name: 辅助俯卧股四头肌拉伸
instructions: 脸朝下躺在地上，双腿伸直。
弯曲左膝，用左手向后抓住左脚或脚踝。
轻轻地将左脚拉向臀肌，感受左股四头肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后放松。
右腿重复上述动作。
description: A partner-assisted stretch lying face down for the quads. It lengthens the front of the thigh.

name: 辅助俯卧股直肌拉伸
instructions: 脸朝下躺在地上，双腿伸直。
弯曲右膝，用右手向后伸抓住右脚或脚踝。
轻轻地将右脚或脚踝拉向臀部，感受右大腿前部的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开并在另一侧重复。
description: A partner-assisted stretch lying face down for the rectus femoris. It lengthens the front of the hip and thigh.

name: 辅助腹斜肌与背阔肌拉伸(稳定球)
english: assisted oblique and latissimus dorsi stretch on stability ball
instructions: Lie sideways over a stability ball with your hips supported and one arm reaching overhead.
Let your partner gently guide your reaching arm further while you roll slightly over the ball.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Draped over a stability ball with a partner helping, you lengthen the side of your trunk and your lats. It opens up the whole flank.

name: 辅助坐姿胸大肌拉伸(稳定球)
english: assisted seated pectoralis major stretch with stability ball
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
双手握住稳定球，并将双臂伸直至身前。
慢慢地将稳定球降低到胸部，感受胸肌的拉伸。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated chest stretch with help from a stability ball. It opens up the pectoralis major.

name: 绳索深蹲划船(绳索把手)
instructions: 将绳子连接到腰部高度的缆绳机上。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
正手握住绳子，双手与肩同宽。
收紧核心并将绳子拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
保持肘部靠近身体并继续拉，直到双手到达胸部。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开绳子，并将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A squat combined with a cable row, using a rope. It trains the lats and legs together.

name: 杠铃坐姿窄握颈后三头肌伸展
english: barbell seated close grip behind neck triceps extension
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
紧紧抓住颈后的杠铃，手掌朝前。
保持肘部靠近头部，慢慢将杠铃放低至脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated barbell triceps extension behind the neck with a close grip. It isolates the triceps.

name: 杠铃上斜窄握卧推
english: barbell incline close grip bench press
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
紧紧握住杠铃，握距略窄于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其缓慢降低至胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A close grip bench press on an incline. It targets the triceps and the upper chest.

name: 杠铃仰卧脑后三头肌伸展
english: barbell lying back of the head tricep extension
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
正手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A lying barbell triceps extension that lowers the bar behind your head. It stretches and builds the triceps.

name: 杠铃反握仰卧臂屈伸
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
反握握住杠铃，手掌朝向脸部，双手与肩同宽。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，保持肘部内收和手腕伸直。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到前额，保持上臂静止。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A skullcrusher with a reverse grip. It targets the triceps with a different wrist angle.

name: 绳索高位滑轮过头三头肌伸展
english: cable high pulley overhead tricep extension
instructions: 将绳子连接到高滑轮上，背对机器站立。
双手抓住绳子，并将双臂伸过头顶。
保持肘部靠近头部，上臂保持静止。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将绳子降低到头后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A triceps extension at a high pulley, with the cable overhead. It targets the long head of the triceps.

name: 绳索单臂三头肌下压
instructions: 面向缆绳机站立，并在胸部高度处安装直杆附件。
正手握住杠铃，然后后退以在绳索上产生张力。
将双脚分开与肩同宽，并稍微弯曲膝盖。
在整个练习过程中保持背部挺直并保持核心参与。
首先，手臂完全伸展并垂直于地板。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向下推，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后吸气，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm triceps pushdown on a cable. It isolates the triceps on one side at a time.

name: 绳索绳把高位滑轮过头三头肌伸展
english: cable rope high pulley overhead tricep extension
instructions: 将绳子连接到高滑轮上并相应地调整重量。
背对滑轮机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
双手抓住绳子，掌心朝下，双手举过头顶。
保持上臂靠近头部并垂直于地板。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将绳子降低到头后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An overhead triceps extension using a rope on a high pulley. It trains the long head of the triceps.

name: 绳索绳把上斜三头肌伸展
instructions: 将绳子连接到高滑轮上，并将倾斜长凳调整到舒适的角度。
背对滑轮站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手抓住绳子，并将双臂伸直过头顶。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近头部，上臂保持静止。
弯曲肘部，直到前臂接触二头肌，将绳子降低到头后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An incline triceps extension with a rope on a cable. It stretches and builds the triceps.

name: 绳索绳把地面仰卧三头肌伸展
english: cable rope lying on floor tricep extension
instructions: 将绳子连接到缆绳机上并将其设置到最低位置。
面朝上躺在地板上，头朝向电缆机。
双手握住绳子，掌心相对，双臂伸直向上伸向天花板。
保持上臂静止，慢慢地将绳子放低到前额，弯曲肘部。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A triceps extension with a rope while lying on the floor. It isolates the triceps.

name: 绳索站姿反握单臂过头三头肌伸展
english: cable standing reverse grip one arm overhead tricep extension
instructions: 背对缆绳机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用手握住电缆手柄，并将手臂伸过头顶，保持肘部靠近头部。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将电缆手柄降低到脑后。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A standing one-arm overhead triceps extension with a reverse grip. It trains the triceps, long head included.

name: 绳索双臂三头肌后踢
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝内，手臂弯曲成 90 度角。
保持上臂静止，向后伸展前臂，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A two-arm triceps kickback with cables. It gives constant tension to the triceps.

name: 哑铃仰卧交替伸展
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
将一个哑铃朝头部方向放下，肘部弯曲，同时保持另一只手臂伸展。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述动作，交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: Alternating dumbbell triceps extensions while lying down. It isolates each arm in turn.

name: 哑铃坐姿俯身交替后踢
english: dumbbell seated bent over alternate kickback
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝内。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直并与地面平行。
将一只手臂向后伸直，保持靠近身体，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。
description: Alternating triceps kickbacks, seated and bent over. It isolates the triceps with a squeeze at the top.

name: 哑铃窄握推举
instructions: 坐在平坦的长凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
用你的大腿帮助举起哑铃，一次举起一个哑铃，这样你就可以将它们保持在与肩同宽的位置。
一旦与肩同宽，向前旋转手腕，使手掌背向自己。这将是您的起始位置。
当你吸气时，慢慢地将哑铃降低到你的身边，直到它们与你的胸部齐平。
呼气时，用三头肌将哑铃举回到起始位置。确保只使用三头肌，不要使用前臂或二头肌来帮助举起哑铃。
在收缩位置第二次暂停后，重复该动作达到规定的重复次数。
description: A close grip dumbbell press. It builds the triceps along with the chest.

name: 哑铃前弓步蹲三头肌伸展
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将手臂伸直过头顶，保持肘部靠近耳朵。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂回到起始位置。
重复该动作达到所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。
description: A forward lunge combined with a triceps extension. It trains the triceps and legs.

name: 哑铃上斜双臂伸展
instructions: 坐在上斜凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
慢慢地躺在长凳上，保持哑铃靠近胸部。
完全躺下后，将手臂伸向天花板，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A two-arm dumbbell triceps extension on an incline bench. It stretches and builds the triceps.

name: 哑铃后踢(稳定球)
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内，手臂弯曲成 90 度角。
将手臂向后伸直，在动作的最高点挤压三头肌。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Triceps kickbacks on an exercise ball. It isolates the triceps and adds core demand.

name: 哑铃仰卧单臂伸展
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，手臂完全伸展到胸部上方。
以受控的方式将哑铃降低到前额，保持上臂静止。
在动作底部短暂暂停，然后将手臂伸展回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A single-arm dumbbell triceps extension lying down. It isolates one triceps at a time.

name: 哑铃单臂法式推举(稳定球)
english: dumbbell one arm french press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，手掌朝上，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
将手臂伸向天花板，保持肘部不动。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm French press on an exercise ball. It trains the triceps and tests balance.

name: 哑铃坐姿俯身三头肌伸展
english: dumbbell seated bent over triceps extension
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，每只手各握一个哑铃。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，头部抬起。
将手臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近头部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Bent-over dumbbell extension that isolates the triceps while you sit and hinge forward. Great for building the back of the upper arm.

name: 哑铃坐姿反握单臂过头三头肌伸展
english: dumbbell seated reverse grip one arm overhead tricep extension
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
反手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至头顶。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃降低到头后，保持上臂静止。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm overhead extension done seated with an underhand grip on the dumbbell. It works the triceps through a long, stretched range.

name: 哑铃站姿交替三头肌后踢
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
双臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近身体。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述动作，每次重复时交替进行。
description: Standing kickbacks done one arm at a time with a hinged torso. Trains the triceps with a strong squeeze at full extension.

name: 哑铃站姿俯身单臂三头肌伸展
english: dumbbell standing bent over one arm triceps extension
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直并与地面平行。
将手臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近身体。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A single-arm triceps extension performed bent over with the upper arm pinned to your side. Builds triceps strength and control.

name: 哑铃站姿俯身双臂三头肌伸展
english: dumbbell standing bent over two arm triceps extension
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近身体。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Both arms extend dumbbells backward at once from a hinged position. A simple way to load the triceps from the back of the arm.

name: 哑铃三头肌后踢(鹤立式站姿)
english: dumbbell tricep kickback with stork stance
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，右手握住哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将右肘举至身体一侧，保持弯曲 90 度角。
将右臂向后伸直，挤压三头肌。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A triceps kickback done in a stork stance, balancing on one leg. Adds a balance challenge to the usual triceps isolation.

name: 哑铃扭转卧推
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握握，手掌背向自己。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
将哑铃向胸部方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
放下哑铃时，扭转手腕，使手掌在动作底部面向自己。
在底部暂停片刻，然后通过将哑铃推回到起始位置来反转动作。
当你向上推哑铃时，将手腕扭转回起始位置，手掌背向自己。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell bench press with a wrist twist through the rep. Works chest and triceps while adding a rotating element.

name: 稳定球臂屈伸
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将双手放在臀部旁边的球上，手指指向前方。
启动你的三头肌并用力推动你的身体，将你的身体抬离球，伸直你的手臂。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低，使其靠近身体两侧。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight dip using a stability ball as the support. The unstable surface makes your triceps and shoulders work harder to stay steady.

name: 稳定球坐姿三头肌拉伸
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至头顶上方。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃放在脑后，保持上臂靠近耳朵。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后回到起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。
description: A seated overhead stretch for the back of the upper arm, done on a stability ball. Helps loosen tight triceps and shoulders.

name: 稳定球仰卧三头肌伸展
instructions: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
双手握住哑铃，双臂伸直向天花板方向伸展。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，保持肘部靠近耳朵。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell triceps extension done on an exercise ball, lowering the weight behind your head. Targets the triceps and challenges your balance.

name: EZ杠法式推举(稳定球)
english: ez bar french press on exercise ball
instructions: 坐在健身球上，正手握住 EZ 杠铃。
向上伸展双臂，保持肘部靠近头部。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A french press with an EZ bar while seated on an exercise ball. Builds triceps strength and asks your core to keep you stable.

name: EZ杠仰卧窄握脑后三头肌伸展
english: ez bar lying close grip triceps extension behind head
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
紧紧握住 ez 杠铃，手掌朝上，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A lying close-grip extension with an EZ bar, lowering the bar behind your head. Puts strong focus on the long head of the triceps.

name: EZ杠站姿法式推举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃。
将杠铃举过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
保持上臂靠近头部，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing overhead EZ bar extension, bending only at the elbows. Builds triceps size and strength.

name: 药球仰卧胸前抛
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
双手握住药球，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
将健身球降低到胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
爆发性地将药球向上推，充分伸展双臂并将球扔得尽可能高。
接住药球并重复所需的重复次数。
description: An explosive chest throw with a medicine ball while lying on your back. Develops fast pressing power in the triceps and chest.

name: 杠铃销钉位推举
instructions: 将杠铃放在与胸部同高的力量架上。
面向杠铃站立，将自己置于杠铃下方，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其保持在胸部正上方，双臂完全伸展。
将杠铃向胸部方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A barbell press from pins set in a rack, starting from a dead stop. Builds pressing strength through the triceps and chest.

name: 史密斯机上斜三头肌伸展
instructions: 调整史密斯机的座椅，使杠铃处于肩部高度。
坐在长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地上。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
充分伸展双臂，将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其保持在胸部正上方。
慢慢地将杠铃降低到前额，保持肘部靠近头部。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An incline smith machine extension that lowers the bar toward your forehead. Guided path lets you focus on the triceps.

name: 三凳臂屈伸
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部并降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bench dip with hands on the bench edge and body hanging off the front. A classic bodyweight move for the triceps.

name: 负重三凳臂屈伸
instructions: 坐在长凳边缘，双手抓住边缘，手指指向前方。
双脚向前走，将臀部滑离长凳，并用手臂支撑体重。
弯曲肘部降低身体，使背部靠近长凳。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bench dip with extra weight added for more resistance. Builds triceps and front shoulder strength once bodyweight gets easy.

name: 负重三头肌臂屈伸
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住臀部旁边的边缘。
将你的屁股从长凳前面滑下来，双腿在你面前伸展。
保持背部靠近长凳，肘部稍微弯曲。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地板平行。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A weighted dip off a bench or chair with legs extended. Loads the triceps harder than the bodyweight version.

name: 杠铃单腿硬拉
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，正手握住杠铃在大腿前面。
将重心转移到左脚上，并将右脚稍微抬离地面。
臀部向前转动，保持背部挺直，右腿向后伸展以保持平衡。
将杠铃向地面降低，使其靠近身体，左腿稍微弯曲。
在底部暂停片刻，然后启动臀肌和腿筋，将躯干抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A one-leg hip hinge holding a barbell. Trains the glutes and hamstrings while challenging balance and core stability.

name: 哑铃单腿硬拉
instructions: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立，右手握住哑铃。
将体重转移到左腿上，并将右脚稍微抬离地面。
保持背部挺直，臀部向前转动，将哑铃放低至地面。
同时，将右腿伸直在身后，保持左膝轻微弯曲。
降低哑铃，直到躯干和右腿与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后收紧臀肌和腿筋，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A one-leg hip hinge holding a dumbbell. Works the glutes and hamstrings and improves balance.

name: 辅助仰卧起坐
instructions: 坐在长凳边缘或让某人按住你的脚。
平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A sit-up with your feet held down by a partner or anchor. Trains the abs through a full curling motion.

name: 单腿深蹲(手枪式)男
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂在身前伸展。
将右脚抬离地面并向前伸展。
弯曲左膝并将臀部向后推，慢慢降低身体。
降低身体时，保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低直到左大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动左脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。
description: A deep single-leg squat with the other leg held out in front. Builds leg strength, balance and mobility.

name: 哑铃高脚杯深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住哑铃垂直放在胸前。
保持胸部挺直，核心收紧，通过向后推臀部并弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A squat holding one dumbbell at your chest. Trains the quads and glutes while keeping your torso upright.

name: 悬垂斜向抬膝
instructions: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
收紧核心并将膝盖抬向胸部，同时将躯干扭转到一侧。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复上述步骤，向相反方向扭转躯干。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A hanging knee raise with a twist to each side. Targets the obliques and abs, and challenges your grip.

name: 辅助单腿深蹲(手枪式)
instructions: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it with one or both hands.
Lift one leg out in front of you and balance on the other.
Sit your hips back and bend your knee, lowering as far as you can control.
Keep your heel down and your knee tracking over your toes.
Press through your foot to stand, using the support only as needed, then switch legs.
description: A pistol squat where you hold onto a support to help with balance. It builds single-leg strength and control on the way to an unassisted pistol.

name: 肩宽握引体向上
instructions: 握距与肩同宽，抓住引体向上杆，手掌背向自己。
双臂完全伸展，自由悬挂。
启动背部肌肉，将身体向上拉向杠铃，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A pull-up with hands about shoulder-width apart. Builds the lats, upper back and biceps.

name: 悬垂抬腿抬髋
instructions: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，收紧核心并抬起双腿，直到大腿与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A hanging raise where you lift your legs and curl your hips up. Strengthens the lower abs and hip flexors.

name: 哑铃直立划船(背面视角)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
让哑铃悬挂在大腿前面，双臂完全伸展，手掌面向身体。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，呼气，将哑铃笔直向上举至下巴，用肘部引导。
继续举起哑铃，直到哑铃与肩同高，肘部指向两侧。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing upright row with dumbbells, pulling the weights up toward your chin. Trains the shoulders and traps.

name: 自助反向腿弯举
instructions: 面朝下躺在腿弯举机上，双腿伸展，脚踝钩在带衬垫的杠杆下。
将双手放在机器的侧手柄上以获得支撑。
保持上半身静止，呼气并尽可能向上弯曲双腿。
挤压腿筋时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气时慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight leg curl on a lying leg curl station. Works the hamstrings with a controlled curl and slow lowering.

name: 高双杠负重三头肌臂屈伸
english: weighted triceps dip on high parallel bars
instructions: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双手握住杠，双臂完全伸展。
弯曲肘部并降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后用手掌推直手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dip between two high parallel bars with extra weight attached. Builds triceps, chest and shoulder strength.

name: 徒手侧卧二头弯举
instructions: 侧躺，双腿伸直，用手臂支撑头部。
将上臂靠在身体两侧，弯曲肘部，将前臂卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将前臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight curl performed while lying on your side. A gentle way to train the biceps without equipment.

name: 腿上集中弯举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双腿分开，双脚平放在地上。
一只手握住哑铃，将肘部放在大腿内侧，膝盖上方。
手掌朝上，将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，同时保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点挤压二头肌，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A seated curl with your elbow braced on your inner thigh. Isolates the biceps and cuts out swinging.

name: 徒手跪姿三头肌伸展
instructions: 跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在身前的地面上，与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿伸直在身后，用脚趾和双手保持平衡，从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将上半身向地面降低，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A kneeling bodyweight triceps press with elbows kept tight to your sides. Builds triceps strength without equipment.

name: 抬肘反向俯卧撑
instructions: 首先，脸朝下躺在地上，双腿伸展，双手直接放在肩膀下方。
收紧核心并用手掌按压，将上半身抬离地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压上背部肌肉。
慢慢地将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A floor push-up variation that lifts the upper body with elbows close to your sides. Works the upper back and posture muscles.

name: 毛巾单臂划船
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖微曲，单手握住毛巾。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
完全伸展手臂，让毛巾挂在您面前。
将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将毛巾放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm row using a towel while hinged forward. Trains the upper back and builds grip strength.

name: 侧桥髋外展
instructions: 侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
用前臂支撑自己，将肘部保持在肩膀正下方。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
在保持核心肌群参与的同时，尽可能高地抬起上面的那条腿，但不要旋转臀部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后将腿放下。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A side bridge with a top leg lift. Works the outer hips and glutes plus the core.

name: 侧平板支撑髋内收
instructions: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
用前臂支撑自己，将肘部保持在肩膀正下方。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
在保持侧平板支撑位置的同时，将上面的腿抬向天花板，保持笔直。
慢慢地将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A side plank with a top leg raise. Challenges the inner and outer thighs while keeping the core braced.

name: 仰卧单直腿伸髋
english: lying single straight leg hip extension
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Tighten your abs and glutes.
Raise one straight leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower under control and repeat, then switch legs.
description: Lying face down, you lift one straight leg off the floor. It strengthens your glutes and hamstrings with a gentle load on the lower back.

name: 过头胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and interlace your fingers, then raise your arms overhead.
Press your arms slightly back and lift your chest without arching your lower back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Reaching both arms overhead and back opens the front of your chest and shoulders. It is an easy stretch to undo hunched posture.

name: 辅助站姿胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides and your hands at shoulder height or slightly lower.
Have your partner hold your wrists and slowly pull your arms back until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: A partner draws your arms back while you stand, opening up your chest. It is a deeper stretch than you can usually reach alone.

name: 辅助坐姿胸部拉伸
instructions: Sit upright on a bench or chair with your hands behind your head or arms out wide.
Have your partner stand behind you and gently draw your elbows or wrists back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Seated with a partner pulling your arms back, you stretch your chest and the front of your shoulders. Sitting keeps your trunk stable.

name: 屈臂胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand beside a wall or doorframe and place your forearm on it with your elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Step forward and turn your body away until you feel the stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Pressing a bent arm against a wall or frame stretches the chest and front shoulder. Changing the arm height shifts which part you feel.

name: 墙角胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall corner and place a forearm on each wall at about shoulder height.
Step one foot forward and lean your chest into the corner until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Using a wall corner to lean into, you stretch both sides of the chest at once. The corner lets you control the depth easily.

name: 反向胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back with straight arms.
Lift your hands up and away from your body while opening your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Clasping your hands behind your back and lifting them stretches the chest and front of the shoulders. It is a classic posture reset.

name: 站姿胸部拉伸(用训练肋木)
english: standing chest stretch (with training wall bars)
instructions: Stand beside wall bars and grip a bar at about shoulder height with one hand.
Slowly turn your body away from the bars until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Holding a wall bar and turning away from it stretches your chest and shoulder. The bars let you pick the exact height that suits you.

name: 辅助向后拉背部胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your arms extended behind you at hip to shoulder height.
Have your partner hold your wrists and gently pull your arms back and slightly up.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: A partner pulls your arms backward to deepen the chest stretch. It works well when you want more range than you get alone.

name: 跪姿胸部拉伸
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench or chair and rest your forearms or hands on it.
Sit your hips back and let your chest drop toward the floor until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Kneeling with your arms reaching forward onto a support lets your chest sink down. It stretches the chest and shoulders.

name: 辅助躯干屈曲胸部拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand with your hands clasped behind your head and your elbows wide.
Have your partner pull your elbows back as you gently tilt your trunk forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: With a partner helping you lean the trunk forward, you stretch your chest and front shoulders. It gives a controlled, deeper opening.

name: 直臂向后胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and reach both straight arms behind you.
Lift your arms slightly and open your chest without leaning back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Reaching straight arms backward opens your chest and the front of your shoulders. Simple, quick and good between sets or after a desk session.

name: 过头直臂拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and raise both straight arms overhead with your palms facing forward.
Reach up and slightly back, keeping your ribs down and your core lightly braced.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Straight arms overhead lengthen the chest, shoulders and sides of your back. A simple full-reach stretch.

name: 辅助仰卧直臂拉伸(胸部)
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms stretched out straight to the sides or overhead.
Have your partner gently press your wrists or arms down toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Lying down with your arms out, a partner gently presses your arms toward the floor. It stretches the chest and the front of the shoulders.

name: 辅助俯卧拉臂胸部拉伸
english: assisted pulling arms in prone position chest stretch
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides and your forehead resting on the floor.
Have your partner hold your wrists and slowly lift your arms up and back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Lying face down, your partner lifts your arms back to open your chest. A deep, controlled chest and shoulder stretch.

name: 斜方肌与颈部拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall and hold the edge of the seat or a hand behind your back to anchor one shoulder down.
Tilt your head toward the opposite shoulder until you feel a stretch along your neck.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Tilting your head to the side while anchoring the opposite shoulder stretches the upper traps and the side of the neck.

name: 环绕肩部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height.
Hook it with your other forearm and pull it gently closer to your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Wrapping one arm across your body and hooking it with the other stretches the back of the shoulder and upper back.

name: 交叉肩部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and bring one straight arm across your chest.
Use your other hand to hold it just above the elbow and draw it closer to you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Pulling one arm across your chest stretches the rear shoulder. It is a staple warm-up and cooldown stretch.

name: 向前伸展上背部拉伸
instructions: Stand or sit and clasp your hands or hold a support in front of you at chest height.
Round your upper back and push your hands forward while dropping your head between your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Reaching forward with rounded shoulders opens up the space between your shoulder blades. It helps relieve a tight upper back.

name: 伸展上背部拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and reach both arms forward at chest height.
Round your upper back and spread your shoulder blades apart as you reach farther.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Reaching your arms out as you round your upper back stretches the muscles between and around your shoulder blades.

name: 站姿上举背部旋转拉伸
english: standing reach up back rotation stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and reach one arm overhead.
Rotate your upper body gently away from the raised arm and reach up and over.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Reaching one arm up and rotating your trunk stretches the lats and the muscles around your spine. It also gives your mid back some rotation.

name: 上举背部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and reach both arms overhead with your palms facing each other.
Reach up and lean slightly back, keeping your lower back relaxed and your ribs down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Reaching both arms up and slightly back lengthens the lats and upper back. A simple stretch to open your sides.

name: 仰卧全身拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead and your legs straight.
Reach your fingertips up and your toes down, as if you want to get taller.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Lying flat and reaching long through your arms and legs gives your whole body a gentle stretch. A nice reset after training.

name: 双手悬挂背部拉伸(用肋木)
english: two handed hang back stretch (with training wall bars)
instructions: Grip a wall bar overhead with both hands and walk your feet out slightly.
Let your body hang and sink your hips back, relaxing your upper back and shoulders.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Hanging from wall bars with both hands lets gravity stretch your lats and decompress your back. Great after heavy pulling days.

name: 绳索悬吊背部拉伸
instructions: Hold the cable attachment or handles with both hands at about chest height.
Lean back with straight arms and sit your hips back until you feel your back lengthen.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Holding a cable attachment, you lean back and let your weight stretch your lats and back. Good for opening up the upper body.

name: 单臂背阔肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and hold a pole or frame with one hand above head height.
Lean away from the arm and sit your hips slightly back to feel a stretch along your side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Reaching one arm overhead and leaning to the side stretches a single lat. Good for finding tight spots on each side.

name: 侧向背阔肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and raise one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side from the raised arm, reaching over without twisting.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Bending sideways with an arm overhead lengthens the lat and the side of your trunk. A quick stretch for the flanks.

name: 坐姿下躯干伸肌拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor or a bench with your knees slightly bent and your feet flat.
Round your back and fold your chest toward your thighs, letting your arms hang down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Seated and folding forward, you stretch the muscles along your lower back. A gentle way to ease lower back tightness.

name: 坐姿下躯干伸肌侧屈肌拉伸
english: seated lower trunk extensor lateral flexor stretch
instructions: Sit tall on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Fold forward and reach your hands toward one foot, letting your trunk bend slightly to that side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Seated, you fold forward and sideways to stretch both the lower back and the side of your trunk. It targets one side at a time.

name: 坐姿俯身背部拉伸
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat and your knees apart.
Bend forward from your hips and let your head and arms hang between your knees.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Sitting and bending over lets your upper body hang to stretch your whole back. A relaxed stretch to release tension.

name: 坐姿侧伸拉伸
instructions: Sit tall with your legs crossed or your feet flat and place one hand on the floor beside you.
Reach your other arm up and over your head toward the side, lengthening along your flank.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Seated, reaching over to the side stretches your lats and obliques. It is easy on the hips and good for desk breaks.

name: 盘腿坐姿前伸拉伸
english: sitting cross legged reach forward stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and your back tall.
Walk your hands forward along the floor and fold from your hips until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Sitting cross-legged and reaching forward opens your lower back and hips. It is a calm stretch that suits cooldowns.

name: 后倚下躯干伸肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Draw both knees toward your chest and hold them with your hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Lying on your back and pulling your knees in stretches your lower back and hips. A soothing option after long periods of sitting.

name: 坐姿并脚前伸拉伸
english: sitting feet together reach forward stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out.
Hold your feet and fold forward from your hips, keeping your spine long.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Sitting with your soles together and reaching forward stretches your back and inner thighs. A gentle hip and back opener.

name: 仰卧膝碰胸拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands while the other leg stays flat.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Pulling one knee toward your chest while lying down stretches your glutes and lower back. A classic, easy hip release.

name: 站姿膝碰胸拉伸
instructions: Stand tall, using a wall for balance if needed.
Lift one knee and pull it gently toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Standing on one leg and hugging the other knee to your chest stretches your glutes and tests your balance. A good warm-up move.

name: 跪姿背部旋转拉伸
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Kneeling on all fours and rotating through your trunk mobilises and stretches your mid back. Slow and controlled works best.

name: 站姿背部旋转拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at chest height.
Rotate your upper body to one side, keeping your hips facing forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Rotating through your trunk while standing stretches your back and obliques. It is a quick way to loosen up your torso.

name: 肘屈肌拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with your palm facing up.
Use your other hand to gently press the fingers down and back until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
