description: Extending your arm and turning the palm outward stretches the muscles that bend your elbow. It targets the biceps and brachialis.

name: 前臂旋前肌拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight and palm down.
Use your other hand to rotate the palm outward until you feel a stretch along your forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Rotating your forearm outward stretches the muscles that turn the palm down. Handy for anyone who types or lifts a lot.

name: 手臂垂直伸展拉伸
english: extension of arms in vertical stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your arms raised straight overhead.
Press your arms back slightly and reach long through your fingertips.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Arms stretched out vertically open up the front of the arm and shoulder. It lengthens the biceps and chest.

name: 支撑物上手臂拉伸
instructions: Place your hands or forearms on a bench or other stable support behind you.
Lower your body slightly and lean away until you feel a stretch in the front of your arms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Resting your arms on a support and sinking down stretches the biceps and front of the shoulders. The support does part of the work for you.

name: 旋后握杆悬吊拉伸
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Let your body hang with your arms straight, relaxing your shoulders downward.
Take as much weight through your legs as you need to stay comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Hanging from a bar with palms facing you stretches the biceps and forearms. Let your body weight do the lengthening.

name: 滑轮机旋后悬吊拉伸
english: suspension in pulley machine in supination stretch
instructions: Hold a pulley handle with an underhand grip and your arm straight.
Lean your body weight back gently until you feel a stretch in the biceps and forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Hanging lightly from a pulley handle with palms up stretches the biceps and forearm. The pulley lets you control how much weight you load.

name: EZ杠牧师凳手臂拉伸
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and rest your upper arms on the pad, holding an EZ bar.
Let the bar lower under control until your arms are fully extended, using a light load.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Resting your arms on a preacher bench while holding an EZ bar lets the arms extend fully, stretching the biceps.

name: 肘伸展及前臂旋后旋前拉伸
english: elbow extension and supination pronation forearm stretch
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight.
Slowly rotate your palm up and down and let your other hand add gentle pressure at each end.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Straightening your elbow and rotating your forearm stretches the muscles on both sides of the lower arm.

name: 腕尺偏肌和伸肌拉伸
english: wrist ulnar deviator and extensor stretch
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
description: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist extensors with ulnar deviation, easing tightness after gripping or typing.

name: 腕桡偏肌和伸肌拉伸
english: wrist radial deviator and extensor stretch
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point down.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Use the other hand to apply light pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
description: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist extensors with radial deviation.

name: 腕桡偏肌和屈肌拉伸
english: wrist radial deviator and flexor stretch
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the thumb side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
description: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist flexors with radial deviation.

name: 腕尺偏肌和屈肌拉伸
english: wrist ulnar deviator and flexor stretch
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Gently tilt the hand toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
description: A forearm stretch that targets the wrist flexors with ulnar deviation.

name: 手指屈肌拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing up or out.
Use your other hand to gently pull your fingers and palm back toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Pulling your fingers back stretches the muscles on the palm side of your forearm. Great after grip-heavy training or typing.

name: 手指伸肌拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing down and your wrist relaxed.
Use your other hand to gently press your fingers and hand down toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Bending your fingers down stretches the muscles on the back of your forearm. Handy to loosen up after lots of gripping.

name: 向下够取三头肌拉伸
instructions: Raise one arm overhead, bend the elbow and drop your hand behind your head.
Use your other hand to press your elbow gently back and down.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Reaching your hand down your upper back stretches the triceps and the back of the shoulder. A common warm-up and cooldown stretch.

name: 靠墙三头肌拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a wall and place your bent elbow on it above head height.
Lean your body forward and down until you feel the stretch along the back of your upper arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Leaning into a wall with your elbow bent overhead stretches the triceps. The wall gives a steady anchor.

name: 肘伸肌肘肌拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm forward and bend the elbow fully with your palm down.
Use your other hand to press your forearm toward your upper arm, then rotate it gently.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: A forearm and elbow stretch for the small muscle at the back of the elbow along with the triceps. Useful after pressing or typing.

name: 颈部旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to one side, then to the other, as far as is comfortable.
Keep your chin level and avoid pushing into any pain.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Turning your head slowly from side to side stretches the muscles around the neck. It is a gentle way to ease stiffness.

name: 颈部斜向屈曲拉伸
instructions: Sit tall and gently turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Drop your chin diagonally toward your chest, using your hand for light added pressure.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Tilting your head diagonally forward stretches the back and side of the neck. It targets the muscle running from the neck to the shoulder blade.

name: 颈部伸展拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head back to look up at the ceiling, keeping your jaw relaxed.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
description: Tilting your head back stretches the front of the neck. Go slowly and stay within a comfortable range.

name: 颈部前伸拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Keep your eyes level and slide your chin and head straight forward.
Stop when you feel a stretch at the back of the neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Draw your head back to neutral and relax.
description: A gentle stretch that glides the head forward to open the back of the neck and the base of the skull.

name: 坐姿颈部屈曲拉伸
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your hands resting in your lap.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Let the weight of your head do the work, without forcing it.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Lift your head back to neutral slowly.
description: Seated chin-to-chest stretch for the muscles along the back of the neck.

name: 颈部前屈拉伸
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your shoulders down.
Place both hands lightly behind your head.
Let your elbows drop forward and ease your head toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Release your hands and return to neutral.
description: Bends the neck forward to lengthen the muscles at the back of the neck and upper shoulders.

name: 颈伸肌拉伸
instructions: Sit tall with your back straight.
Tuck your chin toward your chest.
Rest one hand on the back of your head and add very light pressure down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Remove your hand and lift your head slowly.
description: Lengthens the extensor muscles at the back of the neck by tucking the chin down.

name: 颈伸肌及旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Rest a hand on the back of your head and ease your nose toward your armpit.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Combines forward bending with a turn of the head to stretch the back and side of the neck.

name: 颈屈肌拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your chin and slowly tilt your head back.
Keep the movement small and comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Return your head to neutral.
description: Tilts the head back to stretch the muscles at the front of the neck.

name: 颈屈肌及旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Turn your head slightly to one side.
Tilt your chin up and back until you feel a stretch along the front of your neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Stretches the front and side of the neck by combining a head tilt back with a turn.

name: 仰卧颈伸肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Clasp your hands behind your head.
Gently lift your head and ease your chin toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Lower your head back down slowly.
description: Lets gravity help stretch the back of the neck while you lie on your back.

name: 仰卧颈部伸展拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your head near the edge of a bench or bed, shoulders supported.
Slowly let your head relax backward past the edge.
Support it with your hands if it feels heavy.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Use your hands to lift your head back up carefully.
description: Stretches the front of the neck by letting the head drop back from the edge of a bench or bed.

name: 辅助颈部旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Turn your head to one side as far as is comfortable.
Place one hand on your chin and the other on the back of your head.
Add light pressure to deepen the turn.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: A hand-assisted head turn that stretches the muscles at the side of the neck.

name: 颈部伸展及侧倾拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Tilt your head back slightly.
Lower one ear toward the same shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Tilts the head back and to the side to stretch the front and side of the neck.

name: 下斜屈膝反向卷腹
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge above your head.
Bring your knees up and bend them.
Curl your hips off the bench, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Lower back down slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement controlled throughout.
description: Reverse crunch on a decline bench that curls the hips toward the chest and trains the lower abs.

name: 小腿静态拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and your heel on the floor.
Keep your back leg straight and lean toward the wall.
Press your back heel down until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your hips square and your toes pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A static calf stretch that lengthens the lower leg muscles and the Achilles area.

name: 腕屈肌拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep your elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Feel the stretch along the inner forearm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
description: A simple forearm stretch for the wrist flexors, helpful after gripping or typing.

name: 上斜借力推举
instructions: Set an incline bench and hold the bar at your upper chest.
Dip slightly through your legs to start momentum.
Drive the bar up while pressing with your arms.
Lock out above your chest, then lower under control.
Keep your core braced and your lower back from arching.
description: An incline press with a small leg drive that lets you move heavier loads and trains the upper chest and shoulders.

name: 抬腿抬髋
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Curl your hips up off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips, then your legs, with control.
Keep your movement smooth and avoid swinging.
description: A lying leg raise finished with a hip lift that targets the lower abs.

name: 微屈膝抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips.
Bend your knees slightly and lift your feet off the floor.
Raise your legs until they are above your hips.
Lower slowly without letting your back arch.
Keep your core tight throughout.
description: A leg raise with slightly bent knees, a gentler version for the lower abs.

name: 抬腿抬髋抬头
english: leg raise hip lift with head up
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Push your hips a little off the floor, lifting your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips and legs slowly with control.
description: Lying leg raise finished with a hip lift while the head stays raised, working the whole abdominal wall.

name: 杠杆仰卧抬腿(屈膝)
instructions: Lie back on the machine and grip the handles.
Bend your knees and place your legs under the pads.
Curl your knees up toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly until you feel tension, then repeat.
description: Machine-based lying leg raise with bent knees that loads the lower abs and hip flexors.

name: 杠杆全腹卷腹
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your chest against the pad.
Hold the handles and set your feet firmly.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Pause at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without letting the weight drop.
description: Seated machine crunch that works the abs through a full range, loading the crunch with plates.

name: 杠杆下斜仰卧起坐
instructions: Lie back on the decline seat and hook your feet under the pads.
Cross your arms or hold the handles.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower back slowly under control.
description: Decline sit-up on a lever machine that adds resistance for stronger abdominal work.

name: 绳索跪姿三头肌伸展 v. 2
instructions: Attach a rope or bar to a high pulley and kneel facing away.
Hold it overhead with your elbows bent behind your head.
Keep your upper arms still and straighten your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at full extension.
Return slowly to the start.
description: Kneeling cable extension that isolates the triceps by pushing the handle down from head height.

name: 山羊挺身 v. 2
instructions: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body straight.
Bend forward at the hips with a flat back.
Lift your torso until it forms a straight line with your legs.
Do not overarch at the top, then lower with control.
description: Back extension on a bench that strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.

name: 绳索多功能V形杆弯举
english: cable curl with multipurpose v bar
instructions: Attach a multipurpose V bar to a low pulley and grip it with palms up.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without letting your elbows drift.
description: Standing cable curl using a V bar, giving constant tension on the biceps.

name: 杠杆绳索肩部推举
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Sit back with your feet flat and grip the handles.
Press upward until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
description: Seated machine press that builds the shoulders and triceps along a guided path.

name: 杠杆绳索后下拉
instructions: Adjust the seat and grip the handles overhead.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down, driving your elbows toward your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom.
Return slowly to full stretch.
description: Machine pulldown behind the line of the body that trains the lats and upper back.

name: 加强下斜仰卧起坐
instructions: Set a decline bench to a steep angle and hook your feet under the pads.
Lie back and cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly back down.
description: A steeper decline sit-up that increases the load on the abs.

name: 双杠架锤式握引体向上
english: hammer grip pull up on dip cage
instructions: Grab the neutral grip handles with your palms facing each other.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull your chest toward the handles by driving your elbows down.
Pause with your chin above the bars.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
description: Pull-up with palms facing each other on the dip cage handles, hitting the lats and arms.

name: 双杠架宽握引体向上
english: wide grip pull up on dip cage
instructions: Grab the wide handles with your palms facing forward.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down and back.
Pause when your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
description: Wide-grip pull-up performed on the dip cage that emphasises the lats.

name: 杠杆坐姿髋内收 v. 2
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Place your legs against the pads, set wide.
Squeeze your legs together smoothly.
Pause for a moment when they meet.
Open slowly back to the start.
description: Seated machine move that squeezes the legs together to train the inner thighs.

name: 杠铃低杠深蹲(用深蹲架)
instructions: Set the bar in the rack and place it on your rear delts, below the traps.
Step back and set your feet shoulder width.
Lean forward slightly and sit your hips back and down.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.
description: Squat with the bar low on the back, taken from a rack, that works the glutes, thighs and back.

name: 杠杆坐姿髋外展 v. 2
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and your legs inside the pads.
Hold the handles for stability.
Push your legs apart smoothly.
Pause at the widest point.
Return slowly without letting the weights crash.
description: Seated machine move that pushes the legs outward to train the outer hips.

name: 杠杆高位下拉(挂片式)
instructions: Adjust the seat and grip the handles overhead.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull down until the handles reach chest level.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to full stretch.
description: Plate-loaded machine pulldown that trains the lats and upper back.

name: 杠杆三头肌臂屈伸(挂片式)
instructions: Sit upright and grip the handles beside you.
Set your elbows tight to your sides.
Press down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.
description: Seated plate-loaded dip machine that builds the triceps.

name: 杠杆牧师凳弯举(挂片式)
instructions: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms up.
Curl up until your biceps are fully contracted.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
description: Plate-loaded preacher curl that isolates the biceps with the arms supported.

name: 杠杆腿屈伸(挂片式)
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and your shins behind the roller.
Hold the handles.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
description: Plate-loaded leg extension that isolates the front of the thighs.

name: 杠杆交替腿屈伸(挂片式)
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and your shins behind the rollers.
Hold the handles.
Extend one leg until it is straight.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other leg and keep alternating.
description: One leg at a time on a plate-loaded extension machine, evening out strength between the legs.

name: 杠杆深蹲(挂片式)
instructions: Step under the shoulder pads and set your feet shoulder width.
Release the safeties and stand tall.
Sit down and back until your thighs are parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
description: Plate-loaded squat machine that lets you load the legs with a supported back.

name: 杠杆侧平举(挂片式)
instructions: Adjust the seat and place your arms against the pads.
Sit upright.
Raise your arms out to the sides until about shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.
description: Plate-loaded machine raise that targets the side of the shoulders.

name: 站姿髋外展内收肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your feet wider than hip width.
Shift your weight onto one leg and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight, foot flat.
Push your hip out until you feel a stretch in the inner thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Standing stretch that pushes the hip out to the side to lengthen the inner thigh.

name: 站姿交叉腿外展肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall, next to a wall if you need balance.
Cross one leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the side of your back leg.
Feel the stretch along the outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Cross one leg behind the other to stretch the outer hip and thigh.

name: 站姿抬腿搭放髋部拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a bench or step.
Place one heel on it with the knee slightly bent.
Keep your chest tall and hinge forward at the hips.
Feel the stretch in the hip and glute.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Rest one leg on a raised surface and lean in to stretch the hips.

name: 倾身外展肌拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a wall and lean on it with one hand.
Cross your outer leg behind the inner one.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Keep both feet flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Leaning stretch for the outer hip and thigh.

name: 站姿腿置下方外展肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall near a support.
Pass one leg behind and under the other.
Push your hips gently to the side of the back leg.
Keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Tuck one leg under the other in standing to stretch the outer hip.

name: 仰卧外展肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bring one knee up and across your body.
Use the opposite hand to ease it toward the floor.
Keep your shoulders flat on the ground.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Floor stretch that pulls one leg across the body to open the outer hip.

name: 健身球仰卧外展肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a stability ball.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Roll the ball gently to bring your legs toward your chest.
Feel the stretch in the outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Lying stretch using a stability ball for support while opening the outer hip.

name: 仰卧悬腿外展肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench.
Cross one leg over your body and let it hang off the side.
Keep your shoulders flat.
Let gravity lower the leg slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Lie on a bench and let one leg hang across for a gravity-assisted hip stretch.

name: 站姿脚尖上翘跟腱拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward.
Place the ball of the forward foot against the wall, heel on the floor.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Feel the stretch in the calf and Achilles.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Stretches the calf and Achilles by lifting the toes against a wall.

name: 单脚脚跟下落跟腱拉伸
instructions: Stand on a step with the ball of one foot on the edge.
Hold a rail for balance.
Lower your heel slowly below the step.
Keep the knee straight for the calf, then slightly bent for the soleus.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Lets one heel drop off a step to stretch the Achilles and calf.

name: 站姿脚跟后踩跟腱拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Classic lunge-style calf stretch with the back heel kept down.

name: 站姿跟腱拉伸
instructions: Stand near a wall or support.
Step one foot back with the heel down.
Slightly bend the back knee to target the lower Achilles.
Keep your back foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Simple standing stretch for the Achilles tendon and calf.

name: 坐姿拉脚尖跟腱拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight.
Loop a towel around the ball of your foot or grip your toes.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Keep your knee straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Seated stretch where you pull the toes toward you.

name: 蹲姿脚跟后踩跟腱拉伸
instructions: Crouch down with your hands on the floor for balance.
Extend one leg back with the heel down.
Press the heel toward the floor.
Keep your chest lifted.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Low crouch stretch with one heel pushed back to lengthen the Achilles.

name: 脚趾深蹲拉伸
instructions: Kneel on a mat with your toes tucked under.
Sit back onto your heels slowly.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Ease off if the stretch is too sharp.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Release and shake out your feet.
description: Kneeling on the toes to stretch the feet and front of the ankles.

name: 跪姿脚跟下压跟腱拉伸
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Lean forward, keeping your front heel on the floor.
Press your front knee over your toes.
Feel the stretch behind the ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Kneeling stretch with the heel pressed down to lengthen the Achilles.

name: 深蹲跟腱拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sink into a deep squat with your heels down.
Hold on to a support if needed.
Gently shift your weight forward over your toes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Stand up slowly.
description: Deep squat hold that opens the ankles and calves.

name: 站姿宽膝内收肌拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing slightly out.
Bend your knees and place your hands on your thighs.
Shift your weight from side to side, sinking into the stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your back flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds on each side.
description: A standing wide-stance stretch for the inner thighs.

name: 站姿髋部旋转拉伸
instructions: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit your hips back as if sitting into a chair.
Feel the stretch in the hip of the crossed leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Rotates the hip in standing to stretch the glutes and deep hip muscles.

name: 站姿抬腿髋内收肌拉伸
english: standing raised leg hip adductor stretch
instructions: Stand tall and place one foot on a bench or raised surface to the side.
Keep your standing leg straight and your toes forward.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg side until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest upright and your hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A standing stretch with one leg raised on a support that opens the inner thigh.

name: 站姿腿上抬内收肌拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a bench or low support.
Place one foot on it with the leg out to the side.
Keep your hips square.
Shift your weight toward the raised leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Stretch for the inner thigh with one leg raised and out to the side.

name: 跪姿伸腿内收肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your knees under your hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the foot flat.
Sit your hips back toward the opposite heel.
Keep your back straight and your extended leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A kneeling stretch with one leg extended to the side to open the inner thigh and groin.

name: 侧弓步内收肌拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat.
Keep your chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: A wide side lunge that stretches the inner thigh of the straight leg.

name: 站姿屈膝髋内收肌拉伸
english: standing bent knee hip adductor stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet wide.
Bend one knee and lower into that side.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push the bent knee gently out with your hand.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Standing stretch with a bent knee that opens the inner thigh and hip.

name: 跪姿俯身内收肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel on a mat, then lower your chest and forearms to the floor.
Slide your knees wide apart and sink your hips back toward your heels until you feel the inner thighs stretch.
Keep your breathing slow and stay relaxed, without bouncing.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A floor stretch that opens up the inner thighs while you rest face down on your forearms.

name: 坐姿宽腿内收肌拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide.
Keep your knees pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long spine.
Walk your hands forward until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Come up slowly.
description: Seated straddle that stretches the inner thighs.

name: 髋外展前屈拉伸
english: hip abduction with flexion in front stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you.
Place the other leg to the side.
Lean your torso forward over the front shin.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Brings the leg forward and out to open the outer hip.

name: 站姿宽腿内收肌拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart, toes pointing slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight, and feel the inner thigh stretch.
Keep your chest up and the straight leg's foot flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A standing side lunge position that lengthens the inner thighs.

name: 仰卧靠墙拉伸
english: lying leaning against the wall stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest your legs straight up the wall.
Let your legs fall slowly out to the sides.
Relax and let gravity do the work.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Bring your legs together to finish.
description: Lie with your legs resting on a wall and let them fall open to stretch the inner thighs.

name: 单腿外展屈曲拉伸
english: abduction of one leg flexion stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend one knee, let it fall out to the side and, if needed, ease it down with your hand until the inner thigh stretches.
Keep your lower back and the opposite hip flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: Lying on your back, you open one leg out to the side to stretch the inner thigh and groin.

name: 辅助仰卧内收肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Have your partner lift one leg slightly and move it out to the side.
Keep your hips level.
Tell your partner to stop at a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Partner-assisted stretch for the inner thighs.

name: 站姿脚尖下压腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Stand with one heel on the floor in front of you.
Point your toes down.
Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back.
Keep the front leg nearly straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Stretches the back of the thigh with the toes lowered.

name: 站姿脚尖上翘腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and step one foot forward, resting the heel on the floor with the toes pulled up.
Keep the front leg straight and the back knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Keep your chest open and avoid rounding your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Standing stretch with one heel on the floor and toes pulled up, lengthening the back of the thigh and calf.

name: 站姿抬腿腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a low support and place one heel on it with the leg straight.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your toes pointing up and your standing knee soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: Rest one heel on a raised surface and lean forward to stretch the back of the thigh.

name: 抬腿膝屈肌拉伸
instructions: Place one heel on a low bench or step in front of you with the leg straight.
Stand tall with the standing knee soft.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat, until you feel a stretch behind the raised thigh.
Keep your toes pointing up and breathe slowly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A hamstring stretch with one leg raised onto a support, easing tension in the back of the thigh.

name: 站姿高抬腿屈膝腘绳肌拉伸
english: standing high leg bent knee hamstring stretch
instructions: Stand tall and place one heel on a high support with the knee slightly bent.
Lean your chest toward your thigh with a flat back until you feel the stretch behind the thigh.
Straighten the knee a little more as you get looser.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A hamstring stretch with the foot raised high and the knee slightly bent for a deeper but friendlier pull.

name: 跪姿脚尖上翘腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel on one knee and extend the other leg in front, heel on the floor and toes pulled up.
Place your hands on the floor or the front thigh for support.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a pull behind the extended leg.
Keep the extended knee straight but not locked.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Kneeling on one knee with the other leg extended and toes up to stretch the hamstring and calf.

name: 坐姿膝屈肌和髋内收肌拉伸
english: seated knee flexor and hip adductor stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide and knees straight.
Sit tall with your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips, walking your hands out in front of you.
Stop when you feel a stretch along the inner thighs and backs of the legs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly, then sit back up.
description: Seated wide leg stretch that opens the inner thighs while lengthening the hamstrings.

name: 坐姿膝屈肌拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach toward your toes with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your knee straight but not locked, and avoid rounding your back too much.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A seated reach toward the toes that lengthens the hamstrings.

name: 站姿向下够取腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Hinge at the hips and reach your hands down toward your shins or toes until you feel the back of the thighs stretch.
Let your head and neck hang relaxed and keep a slight bend in the knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A standing forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and calves.

name: 站姿交叉腿向下够取腘绳肌拉伸
english: standing reach down hamstring crossed legs stretch
instructions: Stand tall and cross one foot over the other.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach toward the floor until the back of the thighs stretch.
Keep both legs fairly straight and let your head hang relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A standing forward fold with the legs crossed, which shifts the stretch to the back of the rear leg.

name: 坐姿髋外旋肌和髋伸肌拉伸
english: seated hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch
instructions: Sit upright on the floor or a chair and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Gently press the raised knee down and lean your chest forward with a long back until the buttock stretches.
Keep your spine long instead of collapsing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A seated figure four style stretch for the buttocks and deep hip rotators.

name: 坐姿对侧腿从后方髋部拉伸
english: seated hip stretch with opposite leg from behind
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front of you and the other leg bent behind.
Lean your chest forward over the front shin until you feel the stretch deep in the hip and buttock.
Keep both sit bones as level as you can.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A seated hip stretch with one leg folded in front and the other tucked behind you.

name: 跖屈拉伸
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you as far as is comfortable.
Gently press the top of the foot with your hand for a little extra stretch.
Keep the movement slow and avoid forcing the ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Pointing the foot downward to stretch the front of the ankle and shin.

name: 斜卧膝屈肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg toward the ceiling, holding behind the thigh or calf.
Keep the knee as straight as is comfortable and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently draw the leg toward you until you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Lying on your back, you lift one straight leg to stretch the hamstring with the lower back supported.

name: 斜卧膝屈肌拉伸(用毛巾)
english: recumbent knee flexor stretch with towel
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a towel around the ball of one foot.
Raise that leg toward the ceiling, holding both ends of the towel.
Keep the knee nearly straight and the other leg flat on the floor.
Gently pull the towel until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A lying hamstring stretch where a towel around the foot lets you pull the leg closer without strain.

name: 辅助仰卧腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and relax completely.
Have a partner lift one leg by the heel, keeping the knee straight.
Tell your partner to stop when you feel a pull behind the thigh.
Keep your other leg and lower back flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A partner lifts your straight leg to deepen a relaxed hamstring stretch.

name: 站姿脚尖上翘小腿拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall or step and place the ball of one foot against it with the heel on the floor.
Keep the leg straight.
Lean your hips gently toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Keep your heel down and your back tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Standing with the toes lifted against a surface to stretch the calf.

name: 单脚脚跟下落小腿拉伸
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step with the ball of one foot on it and hold a rail for balance.
Slowly lower that heel below the step until you feel the calf stretch.
Keep the knee straight to hit the calf, then bend it slightly to reach deeper into the soleus.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: Dropping one heel off a step to stretch the calf through a full range.

name: 跖屈肌和足外翻肌拉伸
english: plantar flexor and foot everter stretch
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly outward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and outer ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A seated ankle stretch that lengthens the calf and the outer side of the lower leg.

name: 跖屈肌和足内翻肌拉伸
english: plantar flexor and foot inverter stretch
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly inward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and inner ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A seated ankle stretch that lengthens the front of the lower leg and the inner side of the ankle.

name: 肋木胫骨屈曲拉伸
english: tibial flexion stretch on wall bar
instructions: Stand facing the wall bars and place the front of one foot against a low bar.
Lean your body forward and press your heel toward the floor until the lower leg stretches.
Hold the bars with your hands to stay balanced.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A stretch using a wall bar to flex the ankle and lengthen the muscles of the lower leg.

name: 半屈膝胫骨拉伸
english: tibial stretch with semi flexed knee
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and the toes pressed against the wall or floor.
Bend the knee of the stretching leg slightly.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch low in the calf.
Keep the heel on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A bent-knee stretch that targets the lower calf and the muscles around the shin.

name: 蹲姿脚跟后踩小腿拉伸
instructions: Crouch down with your feet flat and hands on the floor for balance.
Shift one heel backward and press it toward the floor.
Keep the other leg bent and supporting your weight.
Feel the stretch in the calf of the pressing leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A deep crouch with the heels pressed back to stretch the calves and Achilles area.

name: 髋膝屈曲深蹲拉伸
english: hip and knee flexion squatting stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders and toes turned slightly out.
Sink down into a deep squat and press your elbows against your inner knees to open the hips.
Keep your heels on the floor and your chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A deep squat hold that opens the hips and loosens the knees and ankles.

name: 辅助仰卧位髋部拉伸
english: assisted lying hip stretch in supine position
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and relax.
Have a partner bring one knee slowly toward your chest.
Tell them to stop when you feel a stretch in the hip and buttock.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A partner guides your bent knee toward your chest to stretch the hips and glutes while you stay relaxed.

name: 坐姿屈膝旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat on the floor.
Cross the bent leg over the straight one, and rotate your torso toward the raised knee, hugging it with the opposite arm.
Sit tall and twist from the middle of your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A seated twist with one knee raised that stretches the hip and buttock.

name: 坐姿屈膝伸展旋转拉伸
english: seated knee up extended rotation stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg extended and the other knee bent and crossed over it.
Rotate your torso toward the bent knee, using the opposite elbow to guide it, until the hip stretches.
Keep your spine long and look over your back shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A seated twist with the raised knee and the back leg extended, giving the hip a longer stretch.

name: 仰卧交叉膝上拉拉伸
english: lying cross over knee pull up stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the knee of the lower leg or behind the thigh and pull it up toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Lying on your back and drawing a crossed knee up toward the opposite shoulder to stretch the glutes and hips.

name: 仰卧交叉膝下拉拉伸
english: lying cross over knee pull down stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Use your hand to guide the crossed knee gently down and across your body.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Lying on your back and guiding a crossed knee down across the body to stretch the outer hip and glutes.

name: 坐姿屈膝抱胸臀部拉伸
english: seated bent knee to chest buttock stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs out in front.
Bend one knee, hold it with both hands and gently pull it toward your chest.
Keep your back tall and avoid rounding it as you pull.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: Pulling a bent knee toward your chest to stretch the buttock muscles.

name: 坐姿微屈腿髋部拉伸
english: seated hip stretch with slightly bent leg
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg slightly bent in front of you and the other leg folded comfortably.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the hip and buttock stretch.
Keep the knee of the front leg soft throughout.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A relaxed seated hip stretch with the front leg slightly bent, easy on the knee.

name: 斜卧髋外旋肌和髋伸肌拉伸
english: recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and bend both knees.
Bring one knee toward your chest and turn it slightly outward.
Hold the shin and ankle and draw the leg closer.
Keep your lower back resting on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A lying stretch for the deep hip rotators and glutes, pulling the knee toward the chest.

name: 坐姿脚拉向胸臀部拉伸
english: sitting foot to chest buttocks stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back tall and legs extended.
Bend one knee and hold the foot and shin.
Pull the foot gently toward your chest while keeping your spine upright.
Feel the stretch deep in the buttock and hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A seated stretch pulling the foot toward the chest to open the hips and buttocks.

name: 站姿髋内收拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and cross one leg behind the other, feet close together.
Lean your torso away from the back leg and push the hip out slightly until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: Crossing one leg behind the other and leaning aside to stretch the outer hip.

name: 站姿髂胫束拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a wall or support and cross your outer leg behind the other.
Lean your hips toward the wall and reach the outer arm overhead until the outside of the hip and thigh stretches.
Keep your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A standing side lean that stretches the iliotibial band along the outside of the thigh.

name: 鸽式髋部拉伸
instructions: Start on hands and knees and slide one knee forward behind your wrist.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Lower your hips toward the floor and keep your chest tall.
Fold forward over the front leg for a deeper stretch if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A yoga-style hip opener with one shin folded in front, stretching the glutes and the hip flexors of the back leg.

name: 髋外旋肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee and pull the lower thigh toward your chest until the buttock stretches.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A floor stretch for the deep hip rotators and buttock muscles.

name: 站姿收腿髋部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall, holding a wall or support for balance.
Lift one knee and hold the shin and ankle with both hands.
Pull the leg gently toward your chest and slightly across the body.
Keep your standing leg soft and your back straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A standing stretch drawing one knee up and in to open the hip and glutes.

name: 站姿髋外侧拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a wall and cross one leg behind the other.
Push your hips sideways toward the wall.
Lean your upper body away from the hips until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Keep both feet flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A standing side stretch that lengthens the outer hip and thigh.

name: 坐姿髋部旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and both feet flat.
Let both knees drop to one side and rotate your torso the opposite way until you feel the hip stretch.
Keep your hands behind you for support.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A seated rotation that works the hip through a twisting stretch.

name: 站姿髋屈肌拉伸
instructions: Stand and step one foot forward and the other back into a staggered stance.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A standing lunge-style stretch for the front of the hip and thigh.

name: 坐姿单腿外侧拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor and bend one leg so the foot rests against the opposite thigh.
Lean your chest forward over the bent leg while pressing the knee toward the floor until the hip stretches.
Keep your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A seated stretch that opens one hip by turning the leg outward.

name: 辅助单腿伸展
instructions: Lie on your back and relax.
Have a partner support one leg and gently extend it.
Let the partner move the leg only to a mild stretch.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A partner-assisted leg movement that gently stretches the hip and thigh.

name: 扶持单腿站姿髋屈肌和膝伸肌拉伸
english: supported one leg standing hip flexor and knee extensor stretch
instructions: Stand tall holding a wall or chair for support.
Bend one knee and hold the ankle behind you.
Pull the heel toward your glutes and push the hip slightly forward.
Keep your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A supported standing quad stretch that also opens the front of the hip.

name: 箱上股四头肌拉伸
instructions: Stand facing away from a box or bench and place the top of one foot on it behind you.
Stand tall on the front leg with a soft knee.
Tuck your pelvis and lower the hips slightly until you feel a stretch in the front of the thigh.
Hold a support for balance if needed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A quad stretch with the back foot resting on a box or bench, opening the front of the thigh.

name: 单腿后仰股四头肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel on both knees, then lift one foot out in front so that the other leg is folded.
Place your hands behind you on the floor.
Lean back slowly until you feel a stretch in the front of the folded thigh.
Keep your hips lifted and avoid sagging into the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Kneeling with one leg folded and leaning back to stretch the quadriceps.

name: 双腿后仰股四头肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel and sit back so your hips rest on your heels.
Place your hands on the floor behind you.
Lean back slowly and lift the hips slightly until you feel a stretch in the front of both thighs.
Stop if you feel any pinch in the knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then come back up slowly.
description: Sitting back on your heels and leaning back to stretch both quadriceps at once.

name: 站姿小腿胫骨拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and hold a wall for balance.
Place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with the toes curled under.
Gently press the foot down by bending the standing knee.
Feel the stretch along the front of the shin and ankle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Standing with the top of the foot on the floor to stretch the muscles at the front of the shin.

name: 站姿脚趾伸肌拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a support and place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with the toes curled under.
Gently bend your standing knee and press the toes down until you feel the stretch on top of the foot and shin.
Keep the pressure light and controlled.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: Pressing the tops of the toes against the floor to stretch the front of the foot and shin.

name: 抬脚胫骨拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a wall and lift one foot behind you onto a low support with the top of the foot down.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg soft.
Press your hips forward gently until you feel the shin stretch.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A stretch with the foot raised on a support, easing the shin and top of the ankle.

name: 双膝跪姿胫骨拉伸
instructions: Kneel on a mat with your feet pointing straight back and the tops of the feet on the floor.
Slowly sit back toward your heels until you feel the shins and ankles stretch.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you to control the pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: Kneeling and sitting back onto your heels to stretch the front of the shins and ankles.

name: 蹲姿脚趾拉伸
instructions: Crouch down with your heels lifted and toes tucked under.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you for support.
Slowly sit back toward your heels until you feel the toes and soles stretch.
Ease off if the stretch is too sharp.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.
description: A deep squat on the balls of the feet that stretches the toes and the bottom of the feet.

name: 坐姿脚趾伸肌拉伸
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Gently curl the toes and foot downward until you feel a stretch on the top.
Keep the motion gentle.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A seated stretch for the muscles that lift the toes, using your hand to point the toes downward.

name: 坐姿脚趾伸肌和足外翻肌拉伸
english: seated toe extensor and foot everter stretch
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Curl the toes down and turn the sole gently outward.
Feel the stretch along the top and outer edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Seated stretch combining pointing the toes down with a turn of the sole outward.

name: 坐姿脚趾伸肌和足内翻肌拉伸
english: seated toe extensor and foot inverter stretch
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Curl the toes down and turn the sole gently inward.
Feel the stretch along the top and inner edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Seated stretch combining pointing the toes down with a turn of the sole inward.

name: 坐姿脚趾屈肌拉伸
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Gently pull the toes back toward your shin.
Feel the stretch along the sole of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A seated stretch pulling the toes back to lengthen the bottom of the foot.

name: 坐姿脚趾屈肌和足外翻肌拉伸
english: seated toe flexor and foot everter stretch
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Pull the toes back toward your shin and turn the sole gently outward.
Feel the stretch along the sole and inner edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Seated stretch pulling the toes back while turning the sole outward.

name: 坐姿脚趾屈肌和足内翻肌拉伸
english: seated toe flexor and foot inverter stretch
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Pull the toes back toward your shin and turn the sole gently inward.
Feel the stretch along the sole and outer edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Seated stretch pulling the toes back while turning the sole inward.

name: 站姿脚趾屈肌拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place the toes of one foot on it with the heel on the floor.
Lean forward gently until you feel the stretch along the bottom of the foot and into the calf.
Keep your heel firmly on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: Pulling the toes back against a wall to stretch the sole of the foot and the calf.

name: 踝关节活动拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward, toes a few inches from it.
Keep your front heel on the floor.
Bend the front knee and glide it toward the wall.
Return and repeat slowly for 10-15 reps, then switch feet.
description: A gentle rocking stretch that improves ankle movement and loosens the calf.

name: 站直肩部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift them gently away from your body.
Keep your chest open and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
description: A tall standing stretch that opens the shoulders and chest.

name: 反向肩部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift your hands up and away from your body until the shoulders and chest stretch.
Keep your chest open and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: Clasping your hands behind your back and lifting them to open the front of the shoulders.

name: 凳上坐姿肩部拉伸
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands behind you on it, fingers pointing back.
Walk your hips slightly forward off the bench.
Lower your hips gently until you feel a stretch at the front of the shoulders.
Keep your back close to the bench and shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rise up.
description: A seated stretch that opens the front of the shoulders using a bench.

name: 辅助坐姿反向肩部拉伸
instructions: Sit tall and put your arms behind you, palms facing down.
Have a partner stand behind and hold your wrists or forearms.
Ask them to lift your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower slowly.
description: A partner gently draws your arms back to stretch the front of the shoulders.

name: 站姿反向肩部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lift your hands slightly away from your body.
Keep your chest up and avoid arching your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.
description: Standing with your hands clasped behind you to open the front of the shoulders.

name: 坐姿肩屈肌下压肌回缩肌拉伸
english: seated shoulder flexor depressor retractor stretch
instructions: Sit tall on a chair or bench.
Place your hands behind you on the seat, fingers pointing back.
Press your shoulders down and back, opening your chest.
Lean slightly forward until you feel the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.
description: A seated stretch that lengthens the shoulder and chest by pressing the arms back and down.

name: 单臂肩屈肌拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a wall or post and place one hand on it behind you with the arm straight.
Slowly turn your body away until you feel the front of the shoulder stretch.
Keep the arm straight and the shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: Stretching one arm back and down to lengthen the front of the shoulder.

name: 背后手臂内收拉伸
english: adduction of arm in back stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall.
Reach one arm behind your back.
Grab that wrist with the other hand and gently pull it across your body.
Keep your shoulders level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Reaching one arm behind your back and pulling it across to stretch the shoulder.

name: 肩伸肌内收肌和回缩肌拉伸
english: shoulder extensor adductor and retractor stretch
instructions: Stand tall and extend one arm behind you.
Reach across to grab it with the other hand.
Draw the arm gently back and across the body.
Keep your chest open and your shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A stretch for the back of the shoulder and the muscles between the shoulder blades.

name: 肩内收肌上提肌和前伸肌拉伸
english: shoulder adductor elevator and protractor stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Use the opposite hand to press the arm toward you until the shoulder and upper back stretch.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A cross body stretch that loosens the back of the shoulder and the muscles between the shoulder blades.

name: 胸前交叉肩部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm straight across your chest.
Use your other forearm to press the arm gently toward your body.
Keep the shoulder relaxed and down.
Feel the stretch in the back of the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A classic cross-body stretch for the back of the shoulder.

name: 屈臂肩部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest with the elbow bent.
Hold the elbow with your other hand.
Gently pull the elbow toward the opposite shoulder.
Keep your shoulders level and your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A cross-body shoulder stretch with the elbow bent, easing the back of the shoulder.

name: 旋转肩部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and bend one elbow to 90 degrees at your side.
Slowly rotate your forearm outward or inward, using the other hand to assist, until you feel the shoulder stretch.
Keep your elbow tucked in close to your body.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A gentle rotation stretch for the shoulder joint.

name: 上举肩部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one or both arms overhead and up as high as you can, then press them slightly backward.
Do not arch your lower back as you reach.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: Reaching overhead to stretch the shoulders and the sides of the upper body.

name: 肩袖拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your body at chest height.
Hold the arm just above the elbow with the other hand and draw it in until the back of the shoulder stretches.
Keep the shoulder blade down and relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A stretch aimed at the small stabilizing muscles around the shoulder joint.

name: 肘外展旋转肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and lift one elbow out to the side, hand behind your head.
Hold the elbow with your other hand.
Gently press the elbow back and slightly down.
Feel the stretch in the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A stretch for the rotator cuff with the elbow lifted out to the side.

name: 手臂上举旋转肌拉伸
instructions: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow, palm resting on your upper back.
Use your other hand to hold the elbow.
Gently press the elbow back and down.
Keep your ribs down and chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: An overhead stretch for the rotator cuff and back of the arm.

name: 手臂下垂旋转肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and place one arm behind your back, bent at the elbow.
Hold the wrist with the other hand.
Gently draw the hand away from your body and slightly up.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A stretch for the rotator cuff with the arm held low behind the body.

name: 跪姿单臂体前交叉拉伸
english: kneeling one arm cross body stretch
instructions: Kneel on a mat and slide one arm across the floor in front of you, palm down.
Sink your chest toward the floor and keep reaching until the shoulder and upper back stretch.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A kneeling stretch where you reach one arm across the body to open the back of the shoulder.

name: 平行杠下沉拉伸
instructions: Stand between parallel bars and grip them at hip height.
Walk back slightly, letting your arms straighten.
Lower your chest toward the floor and press your head between your arms.
Feel the stretch in the lats and shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then walk forward to release.
description: A hanging stretch between parallel bars that opens the shoulders and lengthens the lats.

name: 肩外旋拉伸
instructions: Stand next to a doorframe and bend your elbow to 90 degrees with your forearm on the frame.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm until you feel the front of the shoulder stretch.
Keep your elbow level with your shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A stretch that eases the shoulder into outward rotation.

name: 肩内旋拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and place one hand behind your lower back with the elbow bent.
Use the other hand or a towel to gently draw the hand up your back until the back of the shoulder stretches.
Keep your shoulders level and do not twist.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A stretch that eases the shoulder into inward rotation.

name: 滑车全程哈克深蹲
instructions: Set your shoulders under the pads and your feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Unlock the safety and straighten your legs.
Lower your hips slowly until your thighs are below parallel.
Keep your back flat against the pad and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your whole foot to stand back up.
description: A hack squat on a sled machine through a full range of motion, loading the quads and glutes.

name: 单腿臀推
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and one foot flat on the floor.
Extend the other leg or hold it up.
Drive through the heel to lift your hips until your body is flat.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg hip thrust that works the glutes hard and challenges balance and hip stability.

name: 臀推
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet flat, hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A glute-focused bridge with the upper back on a bench, lifting the hips to build strong glutes.

name: 肩内收肌前伸肌和上提肌拉伸
english: shoulder adductor protractor and elevator stretch
instructions: Stand tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Hold it with the other arm just above the elbow.
Gently pull while rounding the upper back slightly forward.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A stretch for the back of the shoulder and the muscles along the upper back.

name: 背后毛巾肩部拉伸
english: shoulder stretch with towel behind the back
instructions: Hold a towel in one hand and raise that arm overhead, bending the elbow.
Reach the other hand up from behind your back and grab the towel.
Gently pull the towel down with the lower hand.
Keep your head upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Using a towel behind the back to ease the shoulders into a deeper stretch.

name: 手指拉伸
instructions: Hold one arm out in front of you with the elbow straight.
Use the other hand to gently pull the fingers back until you feel a stretch in the palm and forearm.
Keep the fingers straight and relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A simple stretch that opens the fingers and forearm muscles, useful after typing or gripping.

name: 掌心向外前臂拉伸
instructions: Stand or sit tall and interlace your fingers.
Turn your palms outward and straighten your arms in front of you.
Push your hands gently away until you feel the stretch in the forearms.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.
description: Clasped hands pressed forward with the palms facing out to stretch the forearms.

name: 手指向下前臂拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm facing down.
Bend the wrist so the fingers point toward the floor.
Use your other hand to press the back of the hand gently toward you.
Keep your elbow straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A stretch for the top of the forearm with the fingers pointing down.

name: 靠墙屈肌拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place one palm on it with the fingers pointing down.
Keep your arm straight.
Slowly turn your body away until you feel the stretch in the forearm.
Keep your fingers flat on the wall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Pressing the palm against a wall to stretch the forearm flexors.

name: 坐姿腕尺偏肌和屈肌拉伸
english: seated wrist ulnar deviator and flexor stretch
instructions: Sit tall and extend one arm forward with the palm facing up.
Use the other hand to bend the wrist back and tilt it toward the thumb side until the forearm stretches.
Keep the elbow straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A seated wrist stretch for the inner forearm and the little finger side of the wrist.

name: 拇指拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm with the palm facing up.
Use your other hand to hold the thumb.
Gently pull the thumb back and away from the palm.
Stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A gentle stretch for the thumb and the muscles at its base.

name: 手指伸展拉伸
instructions: Extend one arm in front with the palm facing up.
Use your other hand to hold the fingers.
Gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep your elbow straight and the wrist relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A stretch that bends the fingers back to lengthen the palm side of the forearm.

name: 手指屈曲拉伸
instructions: Hold one arm out in front of you with the palm facing down.
Use your other hand to press the fingers of the extended hand gently downward.
Keep the elbow of the extended arm straight and the shoulders relaxed.
Stop at a mild pull, never at pain.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other hand.
description: Gently bends the fingers down to stretch the tight tissue on the top of the hand and fingers. Handy after typing or gripping work.

name: 手指分开拉伸
instructions: Hold one hand up in front of you with the palm facing you.
Spread your fingers as far apart as feels comfortable.
If you want more stretch, press between the fingers with your other hand.
Keep the wrist straight and the shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax the hand and switch sides.
description: Spreads the fingers wide apart to open up the hand and loosen the small muscles between the fingers.

name: 伸肘手内收拉伸
english: adduction hand with elbow extended stretch
instructions: Stand tall and extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight.
Turn the palm so the thumb points up.
Grab the hand with your other hand and tilt it gently toward the little finger side.
Keep the elbow locked and the shoulder down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other arm.
description: Tilts the hand sideways at the wrist with a straight elbow to stretch the forearm muscles along the outer edge of the arm.

name: 斜卧髋外旋肌和髋伸肌拉伸(交叉腿)
english: recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch (crossed leg)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, then pull the legs toward your chest until the buttock stretches.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A reclined figure four stretch for the buttocks and deep hip muscles.

name: 坐姿股四头肌拉伸
instructions: Sit sideways on a bench or sturdy seat with one leg hanging off the side.
Bend the hanging knee and bring the heel back toward your glutes.
Hold the foot or ankle with your hand and gently pull the heel closer.
Keep your torso upright and your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.
description: Stretches the front of the thigh from a seated position by folding one leg back while the other stays supported.

name: 前交叉胫骨拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Point the toes of the back foot against the floor and gently bend the knee until the shin and ankle stretch.
Hold a wall or chair for balance.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: Crossing one foot in front and pressing the toes down to stretch the front of the shin.

name: 坐姿拉脚尖小腿拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach forward and grab the toes or the ball of the foot of that leg.
Gently pull the toes toward your shin while keeping the knee straight.
Sit tall and avoid rounding your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.
description: Pulls the toes back toward the shin while sitting, giving the calf and the back of the lower leg a gentle stretch.

name: 指间分开拉伸
instructions: Sit comfortably and bring one foot up to rest on the opposite knee.
Hold the foot with your hand.
Slide your fingers between the toes and gently spread them apart.
Keep the movement slow and easy.
Hold the spread for 15-20 seconds.
Release and switch feet.
description: Spreads the toes apart to wake up and loosen the small muscles of the foot.

name: 倾身脚跟后踩跟腱拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back and keep that heel on the floor.
Bend both knees slightly and lean forward until you feel a pull low in the back calf.
Keep the back heel flat and the toes pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.
description: Targets the lower calf and Achilles tendon area by leaning into a wall with the back heel pressed down and the knee bent.

name: 下躯干屈肌拉伸
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
