Press up through your hands and let your hips sink toward the floor until the lower abdomen stretches.
Keep your hips on the floor and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A backbend style stretch that lengthens the front of the abdomen and hips.

name: 猫式拉伸 v. 2
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Tuck your chin and tilt the pelvis as you push the floor away.
Round your back up toward the ceiling like a cat.
Hold the rounded position for a few seconds.
Return slowly to the neutral starting position.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps.
description: Rounds the spine upward from all fours to loosen the back and gently engage the abs. A classic mobility move for stiff backs.

name: 牛式拉伸
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and let your belly drop toward the floor.
Lift your chest and tailbone while looking slightly forward.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for a couple of seconds, then return to neutral.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps.
description: Lets the belly sink and the chest lift from all fours to stretch the front of the trunk and mobilise the spine.

name: 站姿后仰腹部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Gently lean back and push your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch across the stomach.
Keep your movement small and avoid cranking your lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A standing lean back that stretches the abdominal wall.

name: 跪姿腹部拉伸
instructions: Kneel with your knees hip width apart and place your hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lean back until the abdominal muscles stretch.
Tuck your chin a little and avoid dropping your head back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A kneeling backbend that opens the front of the torso.

name: 站姿腹部旋转拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Place your hands on your hips or hold them out to the sides.
Keep the hips facing forward and turn your upper body slowly to one side.
Look over your shoulder and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the front and rotate to the other side.
description: Rotates the upper body from a standing position to stretch the abs and obliques and loosen the trunk.

name: 腹部旋转拉伸
instructions: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms or hands.
Keep your hips on the floor and lift your chest.
Slowly turn your head and shoulders toward one side.
Stay relaxed and avoid pushing into pain in the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.
description: Combines a gentle lift of the chest with a twist to stretch the stomach muscles and the sides of the trunk.

name: 背部支撑髋伸展
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your arms by your sides for support.
Push through your heels and lift the hips until the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without arching the lower back.
Lower the hips back down with control.
Repeat for 10-12 reps.
description: Lifts the hips while the upper back is supported, teaching the glutes to extend the hip through a full range.

name: 站姿下躯干侧屈肌拉伸
english: standing lower trunk lateral flexor stretch
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Place one hand on your hip and reach the other arm overhead.
Push the hips slightly to the side opposite your reach.
Bend sideways from the waist without leaning forward or back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to upright and switch sides.
description: Bends the lower trunk sideways from a standing position to stretch the muscles along the flank and low back.

name: 坐姿下躯干侧屈肌拉伸
english: seated lower trunk lateral flexor stretch
instructions: Sit tall on the floor or a chair with your legs crossed or feet flat.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side of the waist stretch.
Keep both hips grounded and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A seated side bend that lengthens the muscles along the side of the waist.

name: 跪姿髋伸展
instructions: Kneel on a soft surface with knees hip-width apart and thighs upright.
Place your hands on your hips or the back of your pelvis.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Keep your ribs down and avoid over-arching your lower back.
Hold for a moment, then return to the start.
Repeat for 8-12 reps.
description: Opens the front of the hips from a kneeling position by pushing the pelvis forward, which also wakes up the glutes.

name: 仰卧膝部滚动拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent.
Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
Slowly lower both knees to one side.
Turn your head the other way if it feels comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Bring the knees back to centre and roll to the other side.
description: Rolls the knees to one side while lying on your back to twist the lower spine and loosen the hips and sides.

name: 站姿体侧拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways away from it until you feel the side stretch.
Keep your chest open and your hips level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A standing side bend for the sides of the waist and ribs.

name: 坐姿体侧拉伸
instructions: Sit tall with your legs crossed or feet flat on the floor.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways away from it, placing the other hand on the floor for support.
Keep both sit bones grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A seated side bend that stretches the sides of the waist and the lats.

name: 站姿侧拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead with the palm facing inward.
Lean your torso sideways away from the raised arm.
Keep both hips level and your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright and repeat on the other side.
description: Reaches an arm overhead and leans to the side to lengthen the flank, lats and obliques.

name: 站姿持棍侧拉伸
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a stick with both hands overhead.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lean your torso slowly to one side without twisting.
Keep your hips steady and your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to upright and lean to the other side.
description: Uses a stick held overhead to guide a deeper side bend, stretching the flank and the lats.

name: 卧姿侧弯
instructions: Lie on your back with legs together and arms stretched overhead.
Slide both feet and both hands to the same side so the body forms a gentle arc.
Keep your hips and shoulders on the floor.
Breathe slowly and relax into the curve.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and bend to the other side.
description: Curves the body sideways while lying down, which stretches the flank without any need to balance.

name: 辅助侧弯
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and one arm overhead.
Have your partner stand behind you with a hand on your hip and a hand on your raised arm.
Lean sideways as your partner gently guides the movement.
Tell your partner to stop at a mild pull.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright and switch sides.
description: A partner helps guide a sideways bend of the trunk, making it easier to relax into the stretch along the flank.

name: 辅助腹斜肌拉伸
instructions: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead while your partner steadies your hips.
Lean away from the raised arm while your partner gently guides your arm.
Keep your chest open and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Come back to upright and switch sides.
description: With help from a partner, this stretch lengthens the oblique muscles on the side of the trunk through a slow bend or twist.

name: 跪姿地面侧弯
english: lateral bend on floor by kneeling
instructions: Kneel on a mat and extend one arm sideways along the floor.
Walk your hands to one side and sink your hips the other way until the side of the waist stretches.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A kneeling side bend where you reach along the floor to stretch the side of the waist.

name: 仰卧地面侧向拉伸
english: lateral stretch on floor lying down
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead.
Shift your feet and your upper body to one side to form a gentle banana curve until the opposite side stretches.
Keep both shoulders and hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
description: A lying side stretch that gently lengthens one side of the body.

name: 负重罗马椅抬腿
instructions: Position yourself on a captain's chair with your forearms on the pads and back against the backrest.
Hold the weight securely between your feet or on your ankles.
Brace your core and raise your knees or legs up toward your chest.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A captain's chair leg raise with added weight, building lower ab and hip flexor strength.

name: 负重下斜卷腹
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hook your feet under the pads.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your upper body up by contracting the abs.
Pause briefly at the top without pulling on your neck.
Lower back down with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A decline bench crunch with a weight held at the chest, adding resistance for the abs.

name: 农夫行走
instructions: 站直，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体两侧。
保持背部挺直，肩膀向后。
向前迈出小步，控制住，保持直立姿势。
继续步行所需的距离或时间。
最后，停止行走并小心地将哑铃降低到身体两侧。
description: A loaded carry holding a dumbbell in each hand while walking tall. Builds grip, core and total-body strength.

name: 负重前平板支撑
instructions: 首先脸朝下躺在地板上。
将前臂放在地面上，肘部直接位于肩膀下方。
将双腿伸直在身后，脚趾着地。
启动你的核心并将你的身体抬离地面，用前臂和脚趾保持平衡。
保持身体从头部到脚跟呈一条直线。
保持此位置所需的时间。
将身体放低至起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A forearm plank held with extra weight on your back. Builds core strength and stability.

name: 哑铃古巴推举 v. 2
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝下。
保持核心收紧，背部挺直，将哑铃垂直推过头顶，直到手臂完全伸展。
旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
将哑铃放回至肩膀高度，将手腕旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A cuban press variation with dumbbells that mixes a press and a wrist rotation. Works the shoulders and rotator cuff.

name: 哑铃阿诺德推举
instructions: 坐在有背部支撑的长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝向身体，肘部弯曲。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展，手掌朝前。
抬起时旋转手腕，使手掌在动作的最高点朝前。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated dumbbell press that rotates the palms from facing you to facing forward as you lift. Hits all three heads of the shoulder.

name: 固定自行车骑行 v. 3
instructions: 调整座椅高度和位置以确保正确对齐。
将脚放在踏板上，并用带子（如果有）将其固定。
以舒适的速度开始踩踏板。
保持稳定的节奏并根据需要增加阻力。
调动核心肌肉以保持稳定性和正确的姿势。
继续踩踏板达到所需的锻炼时间。
逐渐减小阻力并减速，然后完全停止。
锻炼后伸展双腿并放松。
description: Steady pedalling on a stationary bike at a pace that suits you. Builds endurance and leg conditioning.

name: 手摇车
instructions: 将座椅高度和车把位置调整至舒适的水平。
坐在测力计上，背部挺直，双脚放在踏板上。
双手抓住手柄，并将手臂呈 90 度角。
开始用手踩踏板，以受控的动作推拉手柄。
继续踩踏所需的持续时间或重复次数。
description: Cranking pedals with your hands on an upper body ergometer. Gets your heart rate up using the arms and shoulders.

name: 步行波浪机
instructions: Step onto the machine and hold the handles lightly.
Start moving your legs in a smooth walking rhythm.
Keep your posture tall and your core lightly braced.
Pick a pace that lets you breathe steadily.
Keep going for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.
Slow down for the last minute before stepping off.
description: A low-impact cardio machine session that works the legs in a smooth walking motion to raise your heart rate.

name: 椭圆机步行
instructions: 将椭圆机的阻力水平和倾斜度调整到您想要的设置。
踩上机器的踏板并轻轻握住手柄。
首先用脚向下压，然后将手柄拉向身体。
继续这个动作，交替推和拉，以模拟行走或跑步动作。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的步伐并保持核心参与。
继续进行有氧运动所需的持续时间。
下车前逐渐降低机器的强度和速度。
description: Smooth walking-style motion on an elliptical cross trainer. Low-impact cardio that builds endurance.

name: 滑雪测功仪
instructions: 将座椅高度和脚踏板调整到舒适的位置。
正手握住手柄，手掌朝下。
坐直，双脚平放在脚踏板上。
将手臂伸直在身前，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
收紧三头肌并将手柄向下推向大腿。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Pulling the handles of a ski ergometer down in a rhythmic stroke. Works the arms, back and core while raising your heart rate.

name: 哑铃站姿环绕
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
将手臂伸直至两侧，与肩同高，手掌朝下。
保持手臂伸直，慢慢地以圆周运动旋转手臂，将哑铃放在身体前面，然后举过头顶。
继续圆周运动，将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Dumbbell circles around the body with straight arms, going out to the side and overhead. Works the shoulders through a wide range.

name: 绳索坐姿推胸
instructions: 将座椅高度和电缆手柄调整至舒适的位置。
坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住电缆手柄，与肩同高。
向前推动手柄并使其远离身体，充分伸展双臂。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated cable press pushing the handles away from your chest. Builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: 杠杆臀推
instructions: Sit on the machine with your upper back against the pad and the belt across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip width apart.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
Lower with control and repeat, keeping your chin tucked.
description: A machine version of the hip thrust that loads the glutes with a fixed path of motion.

name: 杠杆臀推(用弹力带)
english: lever hip thrust with resistance band
instructions: Sit on the machine with your upper back on the pad and a band around your thighs above the knees.
Place your feet flat and push your knees gently out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, keeping the knees pressed out.
description: A machine hip thrust with a band around the thighs, adding hip abductor work to the glute drive.

name: 杠杆单腿臀推
instructions: Sit on the machine with your upper back on the pad and the belt across your hips.
Plant one foot flat and lift the other leg off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel and raise your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glute at the top, keeping your hips level.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one sided machine hip thrust that hits each glute on its own and challenges hip stability.

name: 弹力带屈腿后踢(跪姿)
instructions: Anchor the band low and loop it around one foot, then get on all fours.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Press the foot with the bent knee up toward the ceiling against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A kneeling kickback with a band that isolates the glutes by pressing the bent leg up and back.

name: 弹力带蚌式开合
instructions: Lie on your side with a loop band just above your knees and knees bent.
Stack your hips and keep your feet together.
Open the top knee away from the bottom one like a clam.
Keep your pelvis still and do not roll backward.
Lower the knee slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.
description: A side-lying clam with a band around the thighs that strengthens the outer hip and glutes.

name: 弹力带外旋
instructions: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the hand farther from the anchor.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: Rotates the arm outward against band tension to strengthen the small muscles that stabilise the shoulder.

name: 弹力带前平板支撑后踢腿
english: resistance band front plank with kicked leg
instructions: Place a band around your feet or ankles and get into a forearm or high plank.
Brace your core so your body forms a straight line.
Kick one leg back and up against the band without shifting your hips.
Return the leg with control.
Alternate legs, keeping your hips level throughout.
description: A plank hold while one leg kicks back against a band, working the glutes and core together.

name: 弹力带全蹲
instructions: Stand on the band with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the handles at your shoulders.
Keep your chest up and your core braced.
Sit your hips back and down into a full squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes and heels on the floor.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.
description: A deep squat with a band for added resistance, training the thighs and glutes.

name: 弹力带臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and a band around your thighs just above the knees.
Place your feet flat, hip width apart.
Push your knees gently out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower slowly and repeat.
description: A floor bridge with a band around the thighs to keep the glutes working hard.

name: 弹力带跪姿侧平板支撑
instructions: Wrap a band around your thighs and lie on one side with your knees bent.
Place your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from knees to head.
Push your top knee gently out against the band.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A side plank from the knees with a band, training the sides of the waist and the hips with less load than a full plank.

name: 弹力带仰卧抬腿
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and lie on your side with your legs straight.
Rest your head on your arm and keep your hips stacked.
Raise the top leg against the band without rolling backward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side lying leg raise against a band that works the outer hip and glutes.

name: 弹力带单腿直腿臀桥
english: resistance band one leg glute bridge with straight leg
instructions: Lie on your back with a band around your thighs and one knee bent, foot flat.
Extend the other leg straight, in line with your thigh.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Keep your hips level and squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single leg bridge with a band and the free leg held straight, demanding strong glutes and a level pelvis.

name: 弹力带单腿臀桥
english: resistance band one leg glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with a loop band above your knees and knees bent.
Lift one foot off the floor and extend that leg.
Drive through the other heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glutes at the top and keep the hips level.
Lower with control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg glute bridge with a band added, making your glutes and hamstrings work harder on each side.

name: 弹力带单腿后踢
instructions: Loop a band around your ankles or anchor it and loop it around one foot.
Stand holding a support, or get on all fours, with your core braced.
Kick one leg back against the band, keeping the knee straight.
Squeeze your glute and avoid arching your lower back.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A standing or all fours kickback with a band that targets the glutes one leg at a time.

name: 弹力带平板支撑踏步
instructions: Place a loop band around your thighs or ankles and get into a forearm or high plank.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one knee toward your chest against the band.
Return it quietly and lift the other knee.
Keep your hips from rocking side to side.
Alternate for the planned time or reps.
description: Marching the knees while holding a plank with a band around the legs, which challenges the core and hips together.

name: 弹力带反向挺身
instructions: Lie face down over a bench or box with a band anchored near your feet.
Hold the bench edge and loop the band around your ankles.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Avoid swinging or arching the lower back.
Lower the legs slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: Swings the legs up behind you against a band to train the glutes and the muscles along the lower back.

name: 弹力带侧平板支撑
instructions: Place a band around your thighs and lie on one side with your legs straight.
Put your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Press your top leg gently up against the band.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A side plank with a band around the legs to fire up the hips and the sides of the waist.

name: 弹力带侧向行走
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and stand with your feet hip width apart.
Bend your knees slightly into a quarter squat.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Take 10-15 steps one way, then walk back the other way.
description: A lateral band walk that strengthens the outer hips and glutes.

name: 弹力带仰卧臀桥踏步
english: resistance band supine hip bridge march
instructions: Lie on your back with a band around your thighs and your knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one foot off the floor, drawing the knee toward your chest.
Lower it and lift the other foot, keeping your hips level.
Continue alternating at a steady pace, then lower your hips.
description: A glute bridge held while you march your knees one at a time against a band, testing hip stability.

name: EZ杠铃下斜三头肌伸展
instructions: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，头低于脚，双脚固定。
正手握住 ez 杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
充分伸展双臂，保持肘部靠近头部。
将杠铃慢慢降低到前额，弯曲肘部。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A decline EZ bar triceps extension lowering the bar toward your forehead. Builds triceps strength.

name: 杠铃反握窄距卧推
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
反握抓住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其直接放在胸部上方，双臂完全伸展。
慢慢地将杠铃向胸部降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃位于胸部正上方时，暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A close-grip bench press using a reverse (underhand) grip. Emphasises the triceps and upper chest.

name: 哑铃坐姿三头肌伸展
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手握住哑铃，双臂伸直举过头顶。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃放在脑后，保持上臂靠近耳朵。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated overhead extension with one dumbbell held in both hands. Builds the back of the upper arms.

name: 双哑铃坐姿三头肌伸展
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手握住哑铃，正握，将其举过头顶。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃放在脑后，保持上臂靠近耳朵。
伸展双臂，将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated overhead extension with one dumbbell held in both hands. Builds the back of the upper arms.

name: 椭圆机步行
instructions: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Start walking forward in a smooth rhythm.
Stand tall and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Set a resistance and pace you can keep up while breathing steadily.
Continue for 15-45 minutes.
Slow down for a minute before you step off.
description: A steady, low-impact walk on the elliptical that builds endurance and works the legs without pounding the joints.

name: 斜躺自行车步行
instructions: Sit on the recumbent bike and adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at full extension.
Place your feet on the pedals and hold the handles.
Pedal at an easy, walking-like pace.
Keep your back against the backrest and breathe steadily.
Continue for 15-30 minutes.
Cool down by slowing the pedalling gradually.
description: A relaxed walking-style pedal motion on a recumbent bike that builds leg endurance with the back well supported.

name: 跑步机跑步
instructions: Step onto the belt and clip the safety key to your clothing.
Start at a walk and raise the speed gradually to a comfortable jog.
Keep your chest tall and your arms swinging loosely at your sides.
Land softly under your hips and keep your steps quick.
Run for 10-30 minutes at a pace where you can still breathe steadily.
Slow to a walk for a few minutes to cool down.
description: Running at a steady pace on a treadmill to build endurance and burn energy.

name: 杠杆三头肌伸展 v. 3
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your upper arms on the pad.
Grip the handles with your elbows bent.
Press down by straightening your elbows.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without lifting your shoulders.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A machine-based triceps extension that lets you load the back of the arm with a steady, guided path.

name: 滚轴臀推
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball and your arms by your sides.
Brace your core and press your heels into the ball.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a second.
Lower your hips slowly without letting the ball drift away.
Repeat for the planned reps, keeping the ball steady.
description: A hip thrust done by rolling a ball under your body, which trains the glutes and challenges your balance.

name: 滚轴髋部拉伸
instructions: 首先坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将滚轮放在臀部下方、膝盖上方。
向后倾斜，双手放在身后的地面上以获得支撑。
收紧臀部，慢慢向前滚动滚轮，弯曲膝盖并将其拉向胸部。
动作结束时暂停片刻，感受臀部的拉伸。
慢慢地将滚轮滚回起始位置，伸展双腿。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A roller-assisted hip opener for the glutes. Helps loosen tight hips with a controlled rolling motion.

name: 滚轴坐姿肩屈肌下压肌回缩肌
english: roller seated shoulder flexor depresor retractor
instructions: 坐在平坦的表面上，双腿在身前伸展。
双手握住滚轮，掌心朝下，将其放在大腿上。
稍微向前倾，将滚轮滚离身体，将手臂伸直在身前。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将滚轮向身体方向滚动，弯曲手臂，将滚轮拉回到大腿处。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated roller drill that rolls forward and back to work shoulder control. Helps with shoulder mobility and posture.

name: 滚轴人体锯
instructions: 从平板支撑位置开始，前臂放在滚轴上，身体呈一条直线。
启动你的核心并缓慢向前滚动滚轮，在保持控制的同时尽可能地伸展你的身体。
在最远点暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将滚轮滚回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A plank with forearms on a roller, rolling forward and back like a saw. Challenges the abs and core.

name: 滚轴髋部背阔肌拉伸
instructions: 首先跪在地上，将滚轮放在臀部下方。
将双手放在滚轮上以获得支撑。
慢慢地向前滚动滚轮，伸展臀部并伸展臀部。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后滚回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A kneeling roller stretch that opens the hips and glutes. Helps release tension around the hips.

name: 滚轴反向卷腹
instructions: 平躺，双臂伸直过头顶，双腿伸直在身前。
将滚筒放在双脚之间，并用脚趾抓住它。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，将膝盖向胸部弯曲，将滚轮向身体方向滚动。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置，将滚轮滚离身体。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A reverse crunch where you roll a roller toward you with your feet. Trains the lower abs.

name: 滚轴侧向背阔肌拉伸
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住滚轮放在身体前方。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
向前伸展双臂，将滚轮向脚部方向滚动，感受背阔肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸几秒钟，然后慢慢地将滚轮滚动回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A roller stretch that reaches forward to lengthen the sides of your back. Helps loosen the lats.

name: 滚轴背部拉伸
instructions: 首先坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将滚轮垂直于您的身体放置，位于臀部下方。
慢慢向后滚动你的身体，让滚轮向上移动你的背部。
继续滚动，直到滚轮到达您的上背部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢滚回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Rolling your back over a roller to loosen it up. Helps ease stiffness along the spine.

name: 滚轴坐姿单腿肩屈肌下压肌回缩肌
english: roller seated single leg shoulder flexor depresor retractor
instructions: 坐在平坦的表面上，双腿在身前伸展。
双手握住滚轮，掌心朝下，将其放在大腿上。
稍微向后倾斜并锻炼核心肌肉。
将滚轮抬高至肩部高度，保持手臂伸直。
慢慢地将滚轮放回到大腿处。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated single-leg roller drill for shoulder control. Helps with shoulder mobility and posture.

name: 滑车45度腿举
instructions: Sit in the seat with your back and head flat against the pad.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the sled until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your lower back pressed into the pad as you descend.
Push through your whole foot to extend your legs without locking your knees.
Lower under control and repeat.
description: A leg press on a 45 degree sled that loads the thighs and hips while your back stays supported.

name: 哑铃站姿侧平举
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and brace your core.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and avoid shrugging.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to the start and repeat.
description: Raising dumbbells out to your sides to build the middle part of the shoulders.

name: 绳索三头肌下压(V形杆)
instructions: Attach a V bar to a high pulley and stand facing the stack.
Grip the bar with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment at the bottom.
Let the bar rise until your forearms are just past parallel.
Keep your upper arms still throughout the set.
description: A cable pushdown with a V bar that isolates the back of the upper arm.

name: 步行
instructions: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your gaze ahead.
Start walking with a natural stride.
Swing your arms gently opposite to your legs.
Land softly on your heel and roll through to the toes.
Keep a pace that lets you breathe comfortably.
Walk for 20-60 minutes.
description: Plain walking at an easy to brisk pace, a simple way to build endurance and stay active.

name: 跑步机步行
instructions: Step onto the belt and hold the rails while you start at a slow speed.
Increase to a comfortable walking pace.
Let go of the rails and swing your arms naturally.
Keep your head up and your steps even.
Add some incline if you want more challenge.
Walk for 20-45 minutes and slow down before stepping off.
description: Walking on a treadmill lets you control speed and incline for steady, low-impact cardio.

name: 杠杆坐姿划船 v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad, then sit with your chest against the pad.
Grip the handles with arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your torso by driving the elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight again.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A plate-loaded seated row that trains the upper back and lats through a guided pulling path.

name: 杠杆背部伸展 v. 2
instructions: Adjust the machine and sit with your back against the pad.
Cross your arms or hold the handles as the machine allows.
Push back by extending at the hips and lower back.
Stop when your torso is in a neutral, tall position.
Return slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A machine back extension that strengthens the muscles along the lower back with support from the pad.

name: 杠杆坐姿腿举
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your back flat against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Push through your heels until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees.
Bend your knees slowly to return.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A seated machine leg press that drives the legs forward to build thigh and glute strength with back support.

name: 杠杆坐姿卷腹(手扶垫)
instructions: Sit on the machine and adjust the seat so your hands reach the pad.
Place your hands on the pads and brace your feet.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Pause briefly at the bottom.
Return slowly to the upright start.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A seated machine crunch where the hands press on a pad, working the abs against steady resistance.

name: 腹轮卷腹
instructions: Kneel on a mat and hold the ab wheel with both hands in front of your knees.
Round your lower back slightly and brace your abs.
Roll forward a short distance while keeping your hips stable.
Pull the wheel back toward your knees by curling your ribs toward your hips.
Exhale as you crunch and avoid arching your back.
Repeat with smooth control.
description: A crunch done with an ab wheel that works the abdominal wall through a compact range.

name: 左勾拳 拳击
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
左手举起以保护脸部，右手握住下巴。
旋转臀部并以左脚为轴心，同时以出拳动作向前伸展左臂。
扭转你的躯干并调动你的核心肌肉以产生出拳的力量。
将手臂拉回到起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。
description: A boxing left hook thrown with a hip and torso rotation. Builds rotational power and conditioning.

name: 拳击刺拳
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your lead foot forward and hands up by your chin.
Extend your lead hand straight toward the target.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down as it lands.
Keep your chin tucked and your rear hand guarding.
Snap the hand back to the guard quickly.
Repeat, then switch stance if you want.
description: A quick straight punch with the lead hand, used to build speed, shoulder endurance and timing.

name: 拳击右直拳
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Push off the back foot and rotate your hips and shoulders.
Throw your rear hand straight toward the target.
Keep your lead hand up to protect your chin.
Pull the hand back along the same line.
Return to your stance and repeat.
description: A powerful straight punch with the rear hand, driven by a turn of the hips and back foot.

name: 拳击右上勾拳
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your knees slightly and dip your right side.
Drive up through your legs as you rotate your hips.
Throw your right fist upward with the palm facing you.
Keep your left hand guarding your chin.
Return to stance and repeat.
description: A rising punch with the right hand aimed upward, using leg drive and a hip turn.

name: 拳击左上勾拳
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your knees slightly and dip your left side.
Drive up through your legs as you rotate your hips.
Throw your left fist upward with the palm facing you.
Keep your right hand guarding your chin.
Return to stance and repeat.
description: A rising punch with the left hand, thrown upward from the hips and legs.

name: 杠杆仰卧卷腹
instructions: Lie back on the machine and place your hands or arms as indicated.
Hook your feet or grip the handles for stability.
Curl your torso up by contracting your abs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A machine crunch performed lying back, letting you load the abs while the lower back stays supported.

name: 杠杆推胸 v. 4
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pulled together.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Do not lock your elbows.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A plate-loaded chest press that trains the pecs and triceps along a guided path.

name: 杠杆下斜推胸 v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with elbows bent.
Press forward and slightly downward until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your shoulders down and your chest up.
Return slowly under control.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A decline-angle machine press that emphasises the lower part of the chest.

name: 固定自行车骑行 v. 4
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at the bottom of the stroke.
Hold the handles and sit tall.
Start pedalling at an easy pace to warm up.
Raise the speed to a brisk rhythm you can sustain.
Keep your upper body relaxed.
Continue for 10-30 minutes, then slow down to cool off.
description: A stationary bike session at a brisk pace, similar to running in effort, to build heart and leg endurance.

name: 杠杆颈部伸展(挂片式)
instructions: Set the weight light and adjust the pad to rest on the back of your head.
Sit tall and bring your chin slightly down.
Press your head back against the pad slowly.
Move only through a comfortable range.
Return slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.
description: A plate-loaded machine movement that strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck.

name: 杠杆颈部左侧屈(挂片式)
english: lever neck left side flexion (plate loaded)
instructions: Set the weight light and position the pad against the left side of your head.
Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the left against the resistance.
Keep the movement small and smooth.
Return slowly to the centre.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.
description: A plate-loaded neck exercise that bends the head sideways to the left to strengthen the side neck muscles.

name: 杠杆颈部右侧屈(挂片式)
english: lever neck right side flexion (plate loaded)
instructions: Set the weight light and position the pad against the right side of your head.
Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the right against the resistance.
Keep the movement small and smooth.
Return slowly to the centre.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.
description: A plate-loaded neck exercise that bends the head sideways to the right to strengthen the side neck muscles.

name: 杠杆仰卧上拉
instructions: 将杠杆机的座椅和手柄调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，并用正手握住手柄。
保持手臂稍微弯曲，核心肌群参与。
慢慢地将手柄拉向胸部，挤压背阔肌。
在收缩高峰时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A machine pullover that sweeps the handles toward you. Works the lats with a long range of motion.

name: 杠杆髋伸展 v. 2
instructions: 调整机器以适合您的身体，然后坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上。
将脚放在脚踏板上并握住手柄以保持稳定。
启动臀肌和腿筋，然后推动脚踏板以伸展臀部并向后抬起双腿。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A machine hip extension that drives your leg back against resistance. Targets the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 杠杆交替腿举
instructions: 将杠杆机的座椅和脚踏平台调整到您想要的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚放在脚踏板上。
将手放在机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
将一只脚推到脚平台上，伸展腿直到几乎完全伸直。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢弯曲腿，回到起始位置。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
description: A machine leg press done one leg at a time, alternating. Builds the quads and glutes.

name: 杠杆握力器
instructions: 调整座椅高度并握住杠杆机的手柄。
保持背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
呼气并挤压手柄，收缩前臂。
保持收缩一秒钟，然后慢慢释放并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A machine gripper where you squeeze the handles closed. Strengthens the forearms and grip.

name: 杠杆小腿推举
instructions: 调整杠杆机的座椅，使肩膀与杠杆垫对齐。
将脚趾放在杠杆垫上，脚跟悬在边缘上。
抓住手柄或侧面支撑以保持稳定性。
伸展脚踝，收缩小腿肌肉，将杠杆垫向下推。
在动作的底部停顿片刻。
让脚后跟重新抬起，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A machine calf press pushing the pad with your toes. Builds the calf muscles.

name: 哑铃保加利亚分腿蹲
instructions: Stand a stride length in front of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg squat with the back foot raised, building leg strength and balance.

name: 绳索宽握高位下拉
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Control the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Avoid swinging your torso.
description: A pulldown with a wide grip that builds the broad muscles of the upper back.

name: 哑铃后三角肌平举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将手臂向两侧举起，肘部保持轻微弯曲，直到与地板平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bent-over dumbbell raise to the sides. Trains the rear delts and upper back.

name: 哑铃站姿佐特曼牧师凳弯举
instructions: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将上臂靠在牧师凳上，并保持肘部稍微弯曲。
将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，同时保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点，旋转手腕，使手掌朝下。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，同时将手腕旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing zottman curl against a preacher bench, curling up then turning your palms down to lower. Works the biceps and forearms.

name: 哑铃佐特曼牧师凳弯举
instructions: 坐在牧师凳上，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝上，肘部放在垫子上。
将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，保持上臂静止，手掌朝上。
在弯举的顶部，旋转手腕，使手掌朝下。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，同时将手腕旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated zottman curl on a preacher bench, curling up then turning your palms down to lower. Works the biceps and forearms.

name: 稳定球滚动
instructions: Kneel in front of a stability ball and place your forearms on it.
Brace your abs and keep your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Roll the ball forward by extending your arms and body.
Stop when you feel your core working hard without your back sagging.
Pull the ball back by squeezing your abs.
Repeat slowly.
description: Rolling a ball forward with your forearms to challenge the abs and core stability.

name: 稳定球卷腹(全幅度手放脑后)
english: stability ball crunch (full range hands behind head)
instructions: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前弯曲上半身，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A full-range crunch on a stability ball with hands behind your head. Works the abs through a longer range.

name: 凳上反向划船
instructions: 设置一张长凳，其高度应让您的身体可以自由地悬挂在其下方。
面朝上躺在地上，头朝向长凳。
向上伸手，正手握住长凳，握距略宽于肩宽。
调整身体位置，使脚后跟着地，手臂完全伸展。
当你将胸部拉向长凳时，启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight row hanging beneath a bench or bar, pulling your chest up. Trains the upper back and biceps.

name: 屈膝反向划船
instructions: 在腰部高度设置一根横杆，然后躺在其下方。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
调整身体位置，使脚后跟着地，身体伸直。
将肩胛骨挤压在一起，将胸部向上拉向杠铃。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight row beneath a bar with knees bent to make it easier. Builds the upper back and biceps.

name: 后勾踢
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Shift your weight onto the lead foot.
Lift the rear knee and extend the leg across the target.
Hook the heel around in an arc.
Bring the leg back under control.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.
description: A martial arts kick with the back leg that swings in an arc to strike with the heel, training hip mobility and control.

name: 前勾踢
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift the lead knee and point it forward.
Extend the leg and hook the heel across the target.
Keep your supporting foot grounded and your core tight.
Bring the leg back under control.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.
description: A hooking kick with the lead leg that swings the heel across the target, building balance and hip control.

name: 前踢裆
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee in front of you.
Snap the lower leg forward and low.
Keep your torso upright and balanced.
Pull the leg back quickly.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch legs.
description: A straight forward kick aimed low with the toes or the instep, practising speed and hip flexor power.

name: 后劈腿
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Swing your rear leg straight up in front of you.
Reach the top with the leg extended.
Bring the heel sharply down.
Keep your supporting leg slightly bent and balanced.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.
description: A kick with the back leg that rises high and then drops down like an axe, training flexibility and control.

name: 前弹踢
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee toward your chest.
Snap your lower leg forward to the target.
Pull the leg back quickly along the same line.
Keep your supporting foot grounded.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch legs.
description: A quick forward kick that snaps out from the knee, building leg speed and balance.

name: 旋转勾踢
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Turn your head and shoulders to look behind you.
Spin on the ball of your supporting foot.
Swing your kicking leg around and hook the heel across the target.
Land in a balanced stance.
Repeat, then switch sides.
description: A spinning kick where you turn your body and sweep the heel in a hook around the target. Great for balance and coordination.

name: 侧踢
instructions: Stand sideways in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee toward your chest.
Extend the leg sideways and push the heel to the target.
Keep your supporting foot turned slightly away.
Pull the leg back and set it down.
Repeat, then switch legs.
description: A kick that thrusts the heel out to the side, using hip strength and balance.

name: 回旋踢
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Pivot on your supporting foot and turn the hip over.
Lift the knee and swing the leg in an arc across the target.
Extend the lower leg at the end.
Pull the leg back and return to stance.
Repeat, then switch legs.
description: A kick that swings in an arc to hit with the shin or instep, powered by a hip turn.

name: 脚跟推踢
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift the knee and point the toes up.
Push your heel straight forward, leaning back slightly.
Keep your supporting foot grounded.
Bring the leg back and set it down.
Repeat, then switch legs.
description: A pushing front kick that drives the heel forward to create distance, working hips and quads.

name: 旋转后踢
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Turn your head and shoulders to look behind you.
Pivot on your supporting foot.
Kick your leg straight back with the heel leading.
Keep your torso leaning slightly forward for balance.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.
description: A kick where you turn your back to the target and thrust the heel straight back, building rotation and balance.

name: 踏步机步行
instructions: 将步进机调整到舒适的水平。
走上机器，将双手放在扶手上以获得支撑。
开始行走时，将一只脚放在台阶上，然后将另一只脚放在台阶上，双腿交替。
保持直立姿势并锻炼核心肌肉。
继续步行所需的时间或距离。
当您对锻炼感到更加舒适时，逐渐增加强度或速度。
完成练习后记得冷静下来并伸展身体。
description: Stepping on a stepmill at a steady pace. A tough, low-impact cardio workout for legs and glutes.

name: 仰卧肘碰膝
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，将右肘靠近左膝盖。
同时，将右腿伸直并抬离地面。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复该动作，这次将左肘移向右膝盖并伸展左腿。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A floor crunch that brings elbow to opposite knee. Works the abs and obliques.

name: 杠杆仰卧卷腹 v. 2
instructions: Lie back on the machine and set your feet or hands as the machine requires.
Grip the handles lightly and set your lower back against the pad.
Curl your ribs toward your hips to crunch up.
Exhale and squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weight stack rest.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A machine crunch performed lying back, targeting the abdominal muscles with adjustable resistance.

name: 杠杆旋转提踵
instructions: 调整座椅高度，使膝盖稍微弯曲，双脚平放在踏板上。
将脚趾放在踏板上，脚跟悬在踏板边缘。
抓住机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
用脚掌推动，尽可能高地抬高脚后跟。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated rotary calf raise on a machine. Builds the calf muscles.

name: 哑铃坐姿屈臂侧平举
english: dumbbell seated bent arm lateral raise
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体，手臂弯曲成 90 度角。
保持肘部弯曲，将手臂向两侧抬起，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated lateral raise with bent elbows. Targets the side delts with a shorter lever.

name: 杠杆肩部推举 v. 3
instructions: 将杠杆机的座椅高度和靠背调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住机器的手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
向上和向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，但未锁定。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A machine shoulder press, pushing the handles overhead. Builds shoulder and triceps strength.

name: 哑铃站姿内侧二头肌弯举 v. 2
english: dumbbell standing inner biceps curl v. 2
instructions: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干。
保持肘部靠近躯干，并旋转手掌，直到手掌朝前。
保持上臂不动，弯曲哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气时慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复建议的重复次数。
description: A standing biceps curl with the palms turning to face forward as you lift. Works the biceps and brachialis.

name: 双哑铃相扑深蹲
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes pointing out.
Hold one or two dumbbells with both hands in front of you.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to stand.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
description: A wide stance squat holding dumbbells that emphasises the glutes and inner thighs.

name: 绳索直腿穿腿拉(用绳)
english: cable straight legs pull through (with rope)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from the stack.
Reach through your legs and grab the rope, then step forward to add tension.
Keep your legs nearly straight and hinge forward at the hips.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall while the rope passes between your legs.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Hinge back with control and repeat.
description: A cable hinge with straight legs that trains the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 哑铃旋前转中立握划船
english: dumbbell pronated to neutral grip row
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding dumbbells with an overhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight below your shoulders.
Row the weights toward your hips while rotating your palms to face each other.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the dumbbells slowly while turning your palms back down.
Keep your torso still.
description: A dumbbell row that begins with an overhand grip and turns to a neutral grip, working the back and arms.

name: 哑铃旋前握划船
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang with palms facing your legs.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs.
Keep your elbows close to your body and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Avoid jerking with your torso.
description: A bent-over row with an overhand grip, building the muscles of the mid and upper back.

name: 哑铃反握划船(女)
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握握，手掌朝向身体。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
让你的手臂伸直垂下，完全伸展，肘部稍微弯曲。
将哑铃拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bent-over dumbbell row using an underhand grip. Trains the upper back and biceps.

name: 健身球窄距俯卧撑
instructions: 将稳定球放在地面上，将自己置于俯卧撑位置，双手放在球上，距离略窄于肩宽。
调动你的核心力量，让你的身体从头到脚保持在一条直线上。
弯曲肘部，使胸部靠近球，使胸部靠近球。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A close-hand push-up with hands on a stability ball. Hits the triceps and chest while the ball challenges your balance.

name: 脊柱扭转
instructions: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
弯曲膝盖，将双脚平放在地面上，距离与臀部同宽。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向右扭转躯干，将右肘拉向左膝盖。
扭转结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
向左侧重复扭转，将左肘拉向右膝盖。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A seated torso rotation, twisting side to side. Loosens the spine and works the obliques.

name: 绳索全幅度高位下拉
english: cable lat pulldown full range of motion
instructions: 坐在高位下拉机上，膝盖位于护垫下方。
正手握住电缆杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
稍微向后倾斜，挺胸，保持下背部轻微的拱形。
将杠铃向下拉至上胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开杠铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A cable lat pulldown using the full range of motion. Builds the lats and upper back.

name: 椭圆交叉训练机骑行
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在自行车交叉训练机上。
将脚放在踏板上并抓住车把。
开始以平稳且受控的动作踩踏。
保持稳定的步伐并根据需要增加阻力。
继续踩踏您的有氧运动所需的持续时间。
description: Pedalling a cycle cross trainer with arms and legs moving together. Steady, low-impact cardio.

name: 悬垂直腿甩臂
instructions: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，双腿伸直向下。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，直到它们与地面平行。
在顶部保持片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A hanging straight-leg raise. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors and challenges your grip.

name: 滑车仰卧小腿推举
instructions: 将雪橇机调整至舒适的重量。
坐在雪橇机上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚放在平台上。
将脚趾和脚掌放在平台边缘，脚跟悬空。
伸展脚踝，将平台推离您，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
继续用力，直到小腿完全收缩。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将平台放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A calf press on a sled machine while lying back. Builds the calf muscles.

name: 杠杆坐姿小腿推举
instructions: 调整机器的座椅，使您的肩膀与杠杆垫对齐。
将脚趾放在平台的下部，并将膝盖放在杠杆垫下方。
抓住座椅两侧的把手以保持稳定性。
伸展脚踝，将杠杆垫压下，尽可能高地抬起脚后跟。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated machine calf press. Builds the calf muscles.

name: 杠铃卧推前臂(动作检查)
english: barbell chest bench press forearms (form check)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your forearms vertical when the bar is at your chest.
Lower the bar with control to the mid-chest.
Press it up to straight arms without flaring the elbows.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A bench press form check that shows how the forearms should line up under the bar for a safe and strong press.

name: 哑铃飞鸟手臂(动作检查)
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop when you feel a gentle stretch across the chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A chest fly form check that shows how to keep a soft elbow bend and a wide, smooth arc through the movement.

name: 卧推臀部(动作检查)
instructions: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips stay planted on the pad and never lift off.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for keeping your butt on the bench during a chest press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 卧推握距(动作检查)
english: chest bench press grip width (form check)
instructions: Lie on the bench and grip the bar at a moderate width.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your forearms are vertical at the bottom, with hands just wider than the shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for choosing the right grip width on the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 卧推肩部(动作检查)
instructions: Lie on the bench and pinch your shoulder blades together before unracking.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your shoulder blades stay pulled back and down against the bench.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for shoulder position during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 卧推手臂(动作检查)
instructions: Lie on the bench and unrack the bar over your shoulders.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your arms move in a controlled line and the bar tracks over the lower chest.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for arm path during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 卧推手肘(动作检查)
instructions: Lie on the bench with the bar unracked above your chest.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your elbows sit at roughly 45 degrees from the torso instead of flaring wide.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for elbow position during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 俯身划船背部(动作检查)
instructions: Hold the bar and hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your spine stays long and flat, not rounded.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for back position during a bent over row, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 卷腹背部(动作检查)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands by your head.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your lower back stays gently on the floor while only the upper back curls up.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for back position during a crunch, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 滑车哈克深蹲腿部(动作检查)
instructions: Set your back and shoulders against the pads and place your feet on the platform.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees track over your toes and your feet sit flat on the platform.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for leg position on the hack squat sled, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 凳上臂屈伸背部手臂(动作检查)
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench, grip it beside your hips and slide your butt off.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays close to the bench and your elbows point straight behind you.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for back and arm position in bench dips, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 前平板支撑臀部(动作检查)
instructions: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you with your toes on the floor.
Lift your body into a straight line from head to heels.
Avoid pushing your butt up or letting your hips sag.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to keep the line.
Hold for 20-40 seconds and breathe steadily.
description: A front plank form check that compares a raised butt with a straight body line.

name: 牧师凳弯举手腕(动作检查)
instructions: Sit at the preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your wrists stay neutral and straight rather than bending back or curling in.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for wrist position during a preacher curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 侧平板支撑臀部(动作检查)
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor and elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips off the floor.
Make a straight line from your head to your feet.
Avoid letting your butt stick out or your hips drop.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to stay level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A side plank form check that compares a piked butt with a straight body line.

name: 俯卧撑起始姿势(动作检查)
instructions: Set your hands on the floor under your shoulders and extend your legs back.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your body forms one straight line from head to heels with hands under the shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for the starting position of a push-up, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 俯卧撑结束姿势(动作检查)
instructions: Start in a high plank and lower yourself under control.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your chest nearly touches the floor, elbows angled back, and hips stay in line.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for the bottom position of a push-up, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 二头肌弯举手臂身体(动作检查)
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms forward.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your elbows stay pinned at your sides and your torso does not swing.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for arm and body position during a biceps curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 集中弯举手臂(动作检查)
instructions: Sit on a bench, lean forward and brace your elbow against your inner thigh.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your upper arm rests against the inner thigh and only the forearm moves.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for arm position during a concentration curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 硬拉背部(动作检查)
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, hinge down and grip it just outside your legs.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays neutral and braced from the floor to lockout.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for back position during a deadlift, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 悬垂屈膝甩臂
english: arm slingers hanging bent knee legs
instructions: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
收紧核心并将膝盖抬向胸部，尽可能靠近肘部。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A hanging knee raise bringing knees toward your elbows. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors.

name: 硬拉髋部(动作检查)
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and set your hips at a mid height before gripping.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips start above the knees and rise together with your shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for hip position during a deadlift, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 平板支撑臀部(动作检查)
instructions: Set your forearms on the floor with elbows under the shoulders and legs extended.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your butt stays level with your shoulders, not piked up or sagging down.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for hip position in a plank, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 杠铃深蹲膝盖结束姿势(动作检查)
english: barbell squat knees end position (form check)
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and descend into a full squat.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees push out over your toes and do not cave inward.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for knee position at the bottom of a barbell squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 深蹲膝盖中间姿势(动作检查)
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and begin to squat.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees keep tracking in line with your toes on the way up and down.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for knee position midway through a squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 杠铃深蹲髋部(动作检查)
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and squat down to depth.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips and chest rise together, without the hips shooting up first.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for hip position during a barbell squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 深蹲背部(动作检查)
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back, brace your core and squat down.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays flat and braced without rounding at the bottom.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
description: A side-by-side form check for back position during a squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.

name: 高平行杠宽握胸部臂屈伸
english: wide-grip chest dip on high parallel bars
instructions: 将自己置于双杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体悬浮在空中。
稍微向前倾，弯曲肘部降低身体，直到胸部位于杠铃上方。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A wide-grip dip on high parallel bars, leaning forward. Targets the chest and shoulders.

name: 辅助宽握胸部臂屈伸(跪姿)
instructions: 将机器调整到您想要的高度，并将膝盖固定在垫子上。
宽握手柄并保持肘部稍微弯曲。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地板平行。
伸展双臂，将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A machine-assisted wide-grip dip with your knees on a pad. Lets you train the chest with less bodyweight.

name: 双哑铃直臂上拉 v. 2
instructions: Lie on a bench with your upper back supported and hold a dumbbell over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight with a slight bend in the elbows.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until you feel a stretch.
Keep your ribs down and your hips stable.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest using your lats.
Repeat with control.
description: A pullover with straight arms that stretches and works the lats and chest.

name: 哑铃台阶后弓步
instructions: Stand on a low step with a dumbbell in each hand.
Step one foot back and off the step.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A reverse lunge from a raised step that works the legs and glutes with a deeper range.

name: 分腿蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
一只脚向前迈出一步，并将其放在另一只脚前面约两英尺处。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，保持背部挺直。
继续降低，直到前大腿与地面平行，后膝盖悬停在地面上方。
暂停片刻，然后推动前脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。
description: A bodyweight split squat with a long stance. Builds the quads and glutes one leg at a time.

name: 负重俄罗斯转体 v. 2
instructions: 坐在地上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
用双手将重物放在胸前。
稍微向后倾斜以锻炼核心肌肉。
将躯干向右扭转，将重量移至身体右侧。
暂停片刻，然后将躯干向左扭转，将重量移向身体的左侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A weighted russian twist, rotating a weight side to side while leaning back. Works the abs and obliques.

name: 扶持单腿深蹲
instructions: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it lightly with one hand.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor in front of you.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg squat using a support for balance, building strength in each leg.

name: 哑铃单臂肩部推举 v. 3
english: dumbbell one arm shoulder press v. 3
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height with your palm facing forward.
Stand or sit tall and brace your core.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Avoid leaning to the side.
Lower the dumbbell slowly back to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm overhead press that builds the shoulders and challenges your core.

name: 哑铃单臂俯身划船
english: dumbbell one arm bent over row
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, one hand on a bench or knee for support.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand with your arm hanging straight.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping your elbow close.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm row in a bent-over position that works the back and arm.

name: 地面挺身
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended or by your head.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat without forcing a big arch.
description: A floor-based back extension that strengthens the glutes and lower back.

name: 空气自行车 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the planned reps or time.
description: A bicycle crunch variation that trains the abs and obliques through alternating twists.

name: 绳索仰卧二头肌弯举 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor facing the cable stack and hold the bar or handle with palms up.
Keep your upper arms still and pinned to the floor.
Curl the handle toward your shoulders, squeezing the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your back flat and avoid lifting your shoulders as you curl.
description: Lying on your back with a cable pulling from the floor, you curl the handle toward your shoulders to isolate the biceps under steady tension.

name: 哑铃斯科特推举
instructions: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将哑铃举至肩部高度，肘部弯曲，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated dumbbell press from shoulder height. Builds the shoulders and triceps.

name: 窄距俯卧撑(跪姿)
instructions: 首先双手和膝盖着地，双手与肩同宽，膝盖与臀部同宽。
弯曲肘部，将上身压向地面，使其靠近身体两侧。
当你的胸部刚好高于地面时，暂停片刻。
推动手掌以伸直手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A close-grip push-up done on your knees. An easier way to train the triceps and chest.

name: 绳索坐姿转体
instructions: 坐在缆绳机上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手握住电缆手柄，并将双臂伸直至身前。
保持核心参与，慢慢地将躯干旋转到一侧，将电缆拉过身体。
在动作范围结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢旋转回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A seated cable twist, rotating the torso against resistance. Works the obliques and core.

name: 反向腿弯举(引体向上绳索机)
english: inverse leg curl (on pull-up cable machine)
instructions: 调整缆绳机，使踝带处于最低设置。
面朝下躺在长凳上，双腿伸展，脚踝带固定在脚上。
握住长凳的把手以保持稳定。
弯曲膝盖，将双腿向臀部弯曲，挤压腿筋。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight inverse leg curl using a pull-up cable machine setup. Targets the hamstrings.

name: 哑铃二头肌弯举(用手臂塑形板)
instructions: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing dumbbell curl with an arm blaster to keep your upper arms still. Isolates the biceps.

name: 哑铃锤式弯举(用手臂塑形板)
instructions: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干。
保持肘部靠近躯干，并旋转手掌，直到手掌朝前。
这将是您的起始位置。
现在，保持上臂不动，呼气并卷曲哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
然后，吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复建议的重复次数。
description: A standing hammer curl with an arm blaster to prevent swinging. Targets the biceps and brachialis.

name: 哑铃交替二头肌弯举(用手臂塑形板)
english: dumbbell alternate biceps curl (with arm blaster)
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将手臂冲击波放在上臂上，确保牢固贴合。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将一只哑铃向上弯向肩膀，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。
description: An alternating dumbbell curl with an arm blaster. Keeps your upper arms fixed so the biceps do the work.

name: EZ杠二头肌弯举(用手臂塑形板)
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住 ez 杠铃，手掌朝上。
将上臂靠在手臂冲击波上，在整个练习过程中保持静止。
保持肘部靠近身体，呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An EZ bar curl with an arm blaster. Isolates the biceps with a comfortable wrist angle.

name: 绳索三头肌下压(V形杆)(用手臂塑形板)
instructions: 在最高设置下将 V 形杆附件连接到电缆机上。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住 V 形杆，手掌朝下，双手与肩同宽。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
收紧三头肌并呼气，同时向下推 V 形杆，直到手臂完全伸展。
在动作的底部暂停片刻，挤压你的三头肌。
吸气，同时缓慢地将 V 形杆返回到起始位置，保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A cable pushdown with a v-bar and an arm blaster. Isolates the triceps.

name: 绳索反握三头肌下压(曲杆)(用手臂塑形板)
english: cable reverse grip triceps pushdown (sz-bar) (with arm blaster)
instructions: 在最高设置下将直杆连接到电缆机上。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
启动你的三头肌，慢慢地向下推杠铃，直到你的手臂完全伸展。
在底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A reverse grip cable pushdown with an arm blaster. Targets the triceps with a different hand angle.

name: 杠铃二头肌弯举(用手臂塑形板)
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上。
将上臂靠在手臂冲击波上，保持肘部靠近躯干。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A barbell curl with an arm blaster. Keeps your elbows still so the biceps do the work.

name: 负重仰卧颈部伸展(用头带)
english: weighted lying neck extension (with head harness)
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and the weighted harness fitted.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Raise your head slowly until your face looks forward.
Pause, then lower back under control.
Use a light weight and smooth reps, never jerking the neck.
description: Lying face down with a harness on your head, you lift against added weight to strengthen the muscles at the back of the neck.

name: 负重仰卧颈部屈曲(用头带)
english: weighted lying neck flexion (with head harness)
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench with your head past the edge and the harness fitted.
Let your head hang back slightly in a comfortable range.
Curl your chin toward your chest slowly.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower under control and keep the weight light with smooth reps.
description: Lying on your back with a weighted head harness, you lift your chin toward your chest to train the neck flexors.

name: 负重站姿颈部伸展(用头带)
english: weighted standing neck extension (with head harness)
instructions: Fit the head harness with a light weight hanging in front.
Stand and hinge forward, resting your hands on your thighs.
Let your chin drop toward your chest.
Lift your head until your gaze is forward.
Lower slowly and keep the movement small and controlled.
description: Standing and bent forward with a weighted harness, you raise your head against the load to build the back of the neck.

name: 绳索坐姿颈部伸展(用头带)
english: cable seated neck extension (with head harness)
instructions: Fit the head harness and sit facing the cable with it attached at head height.
Start with your head tipped slightly forward.
Pull your head back until it is upright.
Pause, then return slowly against the cable.
Keep the load light and your shoulders relaxed.
description: Seated with a harness attached to a cable, you pull your head back against steady resistance to train the neck extensors.

name: 绳索坐姿颈部屈曲(用头带)
english: cable seated neck flexion (with head harness)
instructions: Fit the head harness and sit facing away from the cable, attached at head height.
Start with your head tilted slightly back.
Bring your chin toward your chest.
Pause, then return slowly in control.
Keep the load light and your shoulders relaxed.
description: Seated with a harness attached to a cable behind you, you tuck your chin forward to train the neck flexors.

name: 杠铃宽握拖曳弯举
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with a wide underhand grip.
Keep your elbows pointing back and the bar close to your body.
Drag the bar up your torso by pulling your elbows behind you.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso upright.
description: A curl where the bar drags up your torso with a wide grip, targeting the biceps.

name: 杠铃站姿集中弯举
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一手握住杠铃，掌心朝上。
将另一只手放在大腿上以获得支撑。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将重量向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将重量放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。
description: A one-arm barbell curl while standing, with the other hand resting on your thigh. Isolates the biceps.

name: 哑铃单臂倾斜侧平举
english: dumbbell single arm leaning lateral raise
instructions: Hold a support with one hand and lean your body away.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand by your side.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Lower slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A lateral raise done while leaning away from a support for a greater range on the side delt.

name: 弹力带鸭子步
instructions: Place a loop band around your thighs or knees.
Lower into a half squat with your chest up.
Step sideways or forward with a wide stride.
Keep tension on the band and your knees out.
Bring your other foot in, staying low.
Walk for the planned distance, then return.
description: A low squat walk with a band around the legs that fires up the glutes and hips.

name: 弹力带屈腿侧踢(跪姿)
english: resistance band bent leg side kick (kneeling)
instructions: Kneel on all fours with a band around your thighs.
Keep your core braced and your back flat.
Lift one bent leg out to the side against the band.
Pause when your thigh is about hip height.
Lower slowly without twisting your torso.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A kneeling side kick with a band that targets the glutes and outer hips.

name: 弹力带抬腿
instructions: Place a loop band around your ankles or thighs.
Get on all fours or stand with support.
Lift one leg back or out against the band.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A leg lift against band tension that trains the glutes and hips.

name: 弹力带空气自行车
instructions: Lie on your back with a band looped around your feet.
Hold the ends with your hands or place them by your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Pedal your legs while twisting your elbow toward the opposite knee.
Keep your lower back flat.
Continue for the planned reps.
description: A bicycle crunch with a band adding resistance to the leg movement.

name: 弹力带地面挺身
instructions: Lie face down and anchor a band under your hands or around your upper back.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest slightly off the floor.
Keep your neck neutral.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat without overarching.
description: A floor back extension with band resistance for the lower back and glutes.

name: 弹力带弓步
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso tall.
Push through your front heel to return.
Alternate legs for the planned reps.
description: A lunge with band resistance that works the legs and glutes.

name: 弹力带提踵
