instructions: Sit or stand with the band under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly.
Press up onto your toes against the band.
Pause at the top and squeeze your calves.
Lower your heels slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A calf raise with a band that builds lower leg strength.

name: 蛙式卷腹
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A crunch that curls your upper body up with your knees bent. Works the abs.

name: 哑铃相扑深蹲(站在两个凳上)
instructions: Place a bench under each foot with a wide stance.
Hold a dumbbell in front of you with both hands.
Sit your hips down between the benches.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hips.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up throughout.
description: A wide squat with feet on benches that extends the range of motion for the glutes and inner thighs.

name: EZ杠窄距卧推
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
紧握杠铃，双手与肩同宽，掌心向前。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其直接放在胸部上方，双臂完全伸展。
慢慢地将杠铃降低到胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A close-grip bench press with an EZ bar. Targets the triceps with less wrist strain.

name: 绳索地面坐姿转体
instructions: Sit on the floor facing a low cable and hold the handle.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet if you can.
Rotate your torso from side to side.
Keep your arms steady and your core tight.
Move slowly without jerking.
Continue for the planned reps.
description: A seated rotation with a cable that trains the obliques and core.

name: 药球抛墙
instructions: Stand facing a wall holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up powerfully and throw the ball to a target on the wall.
Catch the ball as it returns.
Flow straight into the next squat.
Keep a steady rhythm.
description: A squat-to-throw movement with a medicine ball that conditions the whole body.

name: 翻轮胎
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，面向轮胎。
弯曲膝盖并以臀部为铰链，降低至蹲姿。
向下伸手，用双手抓住轮胎的底部边缘，手指朝向您。
调动你的臀部和腿部肌肉，并爆发性地推动你的腿，将轮胎抬离地面。
当轮胎翻转时，用上半身的力量引导轮胎并保持控制。
轮胎完全翻转后，迅速后退并重置姿势。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: Flipping a heavy tire end over end by driving through your legs. Builds full-body power, especially glutes and legs.

name: 侧卧蚌式开合
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet stacked, head on your arm.
Keep your hips stacked and your core lightly braced.
Lift the top knee while keeping your feet together.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
description: Lying on your side with knees bent, you open the top knee like a clam to strengthen the outer hip and glutes.

name: 直杠胸部臂屈伸
instructions: 手掌朝下，双臂完全伸展，抓住双杠。
弯曲膝盖并交叉脚踝。
弯曲手臂，降低身体，直到肩膀低于肘部。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A chest dip on a bar, leaning forward and crossing your ankles. Targets the chest and triceps.

name: 弹力带触脚尖
instructions: Lie on your back with a band around your feet.
Lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Hold the band ends and reach toward your toes.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Lower with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A crunch variation where you reach up to your toes with band tension.

name: 绳索蒂博多皮划艇划船
instructions: 将电缆手柄连接到低滑轮上，面向机器坐着，双脚平放在地板上。
用右手抓住手柄，完全伸展手臂，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
从臀部开始向前倾斜，保持背部挺直并收紧腹肌。
缩回肩胛骨并弯曲肘部，将手柄拉向躯干，保持手臂靠近身体。
在动作的最高点挤压背部肌肉，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边并用左臂执行。
description: A one-arm cable row with a rotating kayak-style pull. Trains the lats and upper back.

name: 弹力带开合跳
instructions: Stand with a loop band around your thighs or ankles.
Keep your knees soft and your core tight.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Push against the band as you land.
Jump back to the start with your arms down.
Keep a steady rhythm.
description: A jumping jack with a band that raises your heart rate and adds a challenge to the hips and shoulders.

name: 桥式登山跑(交叉)
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
启动你的核心并将右脚抬离地面，将右膝移向左肘。
将右脚放回到起始位置，然后将左脚朝向右肘重复该动作。
继续交替两侧，以受控的速度移动。
保持臀部水平，避免臀部抬得太高或下垂得太低。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的呼吸模式。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A plank-position mountain climber driving knee across the body. Works the abs and obliques, and raises your heart rate.

name: 哑铃侧向上台阶
instructions: Stand beside a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place your near foot on the bench.
Drive through that heel to step up onto the bench.
Bring your other foot up to balance.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side-on step up with dumbbells that builds the legs and glutes.

name: 健身球蛙式卷腹
instructions: Lie back on a stability ball with your lower back supported.
Place the soles of your feet together with your knees out.
Place your hands lightly by your head.
Crunch up while pulling your knees toward your chest.
Squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A crunch on a stability ball with the legs in a frog position to hit the lower abs.

name: 哑铃俯卧地面后三角肌平举
english: dumbbell lying on floor rear delt raise
instructions: 脸朝下躺在地板上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直在身前，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
调动肩部肌肉，将手臂向上并向两侧抬起，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A rear delt raise performed lying face down on the floor. Targets the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: 双腿地面臀桥
english: glute bridge two legs on floor
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Place your arms by your sides.
Push through your heels to lift your hips.
Make a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A floor bridge with both feet down that strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 凳上单腿臀桥
english: glute bridge one leg on bench
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot on a bench and the other leg extended.
Brace your core.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg bridge with a foot on a bench that targets the glutes harder.

name: 地面单腿臀桥(直腿)
english: glute bridge one leg on floor (straight leg)
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight up.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Push through your planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg bridge with the free leg straight, working the glutes and core.

name: 地面单腿臀桥(屈膝)
english: glute bridge one leg on floor (bent knee)
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot on the floor and the other knee pulled up.
Place your arms by your sides.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your pelvis level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg bridge with the free knee bent toward your chest.

name: 哑铃锤式弯举 v. 3
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows close to your torso.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Keep your wrists straight.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A curl with a neutral grip that works the biceps and forearms.

name: 哑铃后三角肌飞鸟
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding dumbbells below your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to the start.
Keep your neck neutral.
description: A bent-over fly that targets the rear of the shoulders.

name: 哑铃上斜后飞鸟
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest on the pad.
description: A chest-supported rear fly on an incline bench that isolates the rear shoulders.

name: 杠铃反握上斜划船
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight.
Row the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad.
description: A chest-supported row with an underhand grip that works the lats and upper back.

name: 哑铃反握上斜划船
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight.
Row the dumbbells toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad.
description: A chest-supported dumbbell row with an underhand grip for the lats and upper back.

name: 绳索前平举 v. 2
instructions: Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding the handle in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Avoid leaning back.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A cable raise to the front that works the front of the shoulders.

name: 下斜扭转仰卧起坐
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Sit up while rotating your torso to one side.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides each rep.
description: A sit up on a decline bench with a twist to work the abs and obliques.

name: 振动板站姿
instructions: Step onto the vibrating plate with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Hold your posture tall and your core braced.
Keep your weight balanced over your feet.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.
Step off carefully.
description: A standing hold on a vibrating platform that engages the legs and core.

name: 振动板平板支撑
instructions: Place your forearms or hands on the vibrating plate.
Extend your legs behind you.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Come down carefully.
description: A plank held on a vibrating platform that adds challenge to your core.

name: 振动板弓步
instructions: Place one foot on the vibrating plate and step the other back.
Lower into a lunge with your torso upright.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Hold the bottom briefly.
Push up to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A lunge with the front foot on a vibrating plate for added stability work.

name: 绳索宽握颈后下拉 v. 2
english: cable wide grip rear pulldown behind neck v. 2
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs secured.
Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Lean forward slightly and pull the bar down behind your head to the base of your neck.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Control the bar back up.
Move gently and keep your neck neutral.
description: A wide pulldown to the back of the neck that works the lats and upper back.

name: 弹力带臀桥 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with a loop band around your thighs.
Bend your knees with feet flat.
Push your knees out against the band.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A glute bridge with a band around the thighs that adds hip activation.

name: 凳上全蹲
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and lower until you touch the bench.
Pause briefly without relaxing.
Push through your heels to stand.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A deep squat down to a bench that builds the legs and hips.

name: 侧向跳上凳
instructions: Stand beside a sturdy bench.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up and sideways onto the bench.
Land softly with your knees bent.
Step down carefully.
Repeat, alternating sides.
description: A side-on jump onto a bench that builds explosive leg power.

name: 侧向跳步上台阶
instructions: Stand beside a low step.
Place your near foot on the step.
Drive up with a small jump.
Land softly on the step.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side-on step with a jump that trains power in the legs.

name: 动力雪橇拉划
instructions: Attach a rope or handles to a loaded sled.
Hold the rope with your knees slightly bent.
Pull the sled toward you with a rowing motion.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Keep your back flat.
Repeat for the planned distance.
description: A row performed while pulling a loaded sled for back and grip strength.

name: 药球上开合平板支撑
instructions: Place your hands on a medicine ball in a plank.
Brace your abs and keep your body straight.
Jump your feet wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level.
Continue for the planned reps.
description: A plank with jumping jack feet on a medicine ball, challenging core stability.

name: 哑铃屈臂上拉(屈膝)
english: dumbbell bent arm pullover with knees bent
instructions: Lie back on a bench or the floor with knees bent and feet flat, holding one dumbbell over your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and lock that angle.
Lower the dumbbell back over your head in a slow arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pull the weight back over your chest along the same arc.
Keep your ribs down and your lower back from arching.
description: A lying pullover with a bent elbow that stretches and works the chest, with help from the lats and triceps.

name: 坐姿梨状肌拉伸
instructions: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
弯曲右膝，将右脚放在左膝外侧。
将左肘放在右膝外侧，轻轻地将躯干向右扭转。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后换边重复。
description: A seated stretch for the piriformis and glute muscles. Helps loosen tight hips.

name: 哥萨克深蹲
instructions: Stand with your feet much wider than shoulder width and toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, sitting your hips down and back.
Keep the other leg straight with the heel down and toes up.
Push through the bent leg to slide back to the centre.
Repeat on the other side and keep your chest tall.
description: A wide side-to-side squat where you sink onto one leg while the other stays straight. It builds leg strength and hip mobility.

name: 屈腿画圈踢(跪姿)
instructions: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg out to the side with the knee bent.
Draw slow circles in the air with your knee.
Keep your hips level and your spine still.
Switch direction, then repeat on the other leg.
description: A kneeling Pilates move where one bent leg draws circles in the air. It works the glutes and hips while the core keeps you steady.

name: 摇摆蛙式拉伸
instructions: 首先跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在身前的地面上以获得支撑。
慢慢向前倾，将重心转移到双手上，并将双腿伸到身后。
当你将臀部向后推向天花板时，保持背部挺直并收紧臀部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，感受臀部的拉伸。
弯曲膝盖并降低臀部，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A rocking frog stretch that opens the hips and inner thighs. Helps loosen the glutes and groin.

name: 翻滚至V字坐
instructions: Sit with knees bent and arms reaching forward.
Roll back, lifting your legs up and over toward your head.
Roll forward with control and extend your legs.
Land in a balanced V sit, with arms reaching toward your feet.
Move smoothly and use your abs to drive the motion.
description: You roll back over your shoulders and then roll forward into a V sit, working the abs and building control.

name: 哑铃仰卧三头肌伸展 v. 2
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing in.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the triceps.
Straighten your arms back to the start.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling.
description: A classic lying extension that isolates the triceps by bending only at the elbows.

name: 杠杆水平单腿举
instructions: 调整机器座椅，使双脚放在踏板上时膝盖呈 90 度角。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚与肩同宽放在踏板上。
将手放在机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
伸展腿，使背部紧靠靠背，将踏板推离身体。
在完全伸展位置暂停片刻，然后慢慢弯曲腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。
description: A horizontal machine leg press done one leg at a time. Builds the glutes and quads.

name: 跳绳
instructions: 双手握住跳绳的手柄，掌心向内。
站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将绳子甩过头顶，当绳子靠近你的脚时跳过它。
轻轻地用脚掌着地，当绳子再次绕回时重复跳跃。
继续跳跃所需的持续时间或重复次数。
description: Skipping over a rope at a steady pace. Classic cardio that builds endurance and coordination.

name: 绳索V形杆高位下拉
instructions: 坐在电缆下拉机上，用正手抓住 V 形杆附件。
调整护膝，使大腿固定在其下方。
保持背部挺直并稍微向后倾斜。
将 V 形杆向下拉至上胸部，同时保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作底部挤压背部肌肉。
慢慢地将 v 形杆返回到起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。
description: A lat pulldown with a v-bar attachment. Builds the lats and upper back.

name: 绳索单臂二头肌弯举 v. 2
english: cable one arm biceps curl v. 2
instructions: Stand facing the cable with the handle at low height and grip it with one hand, palm up.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder and squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly until the arm is nearly straight.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm curl using a cable for constant tension, great for working each biceps on its own.

name: 椭圆机滑雪
instructions: Step onto the elliptical and hold the handles.
Start striding in a smooth, ski-like rhythm, swinging your arms with your legs.
Stay upright and keep your core engaged.
Hold a steady pace for your chosen time.
Slow down gradually to finish.
description: A ski-style stride on the elliptical that keeps your heart rate up and works the whole body.

name: 杠杆上斜推胸(挂片式)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your upper chest.
Sit back and grip the handles with feet flat on the floor.
Press forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Squeeze the chest, then return slowly.
Keep your back against the pad and your shoulders down.
description: A plate-loaded machine press on an incline that targets the upper chest and the front of the shoulders.

name: 杠杆牧师凳弯举(挂片式) v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad.
Grip the handles with palms up.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.
Do not lift your elbows off the pad or let the weight drop.
description: A plate-loaded preacher machine curl that isolates the biceps with your upper arms supported.

name: 绳索V形杆坐姿划船
english: cable seated row with v bar
instructions: Sit at the cable row station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grip the V bar and sit tall with arms extended.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and avoid rocking.
description: A seated cable row with a V-shaped grip that trains the mid back and lats.

name: 杠杆高位划船(挂片式) v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can grip the handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest on the pad.
Pull the handles down and back, driving the elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and keep your shoulders down.
description: A plate-loaded high row machine that pulls from above to train the lats and upper back.

name: 杠杆高位划船(挂片式) v. 3
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can grip the handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest on the pad.
Pull the handles down and back, driving the elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and keep your shoulders down.
description: A plate-loaded high row machine that pulls from above to train the lats and upper back.

name: 杠杆坐姿划船(挂片式)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest.
Sit with your chest against the pad and grip the handles.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Keep your torso tight against the pad.
description: A plate-loaded seated row machine with a chest pad that builds the mid back and lats.

name: 杠杆宽握下拉
instructions: Adjust the seat and thigh pad, then grip the wide handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, leading with the elbows.
Squeeze the lats, then let the handles rise slowly.
Avoid leaning far back or using momentum.
description: A machine pulldown with a wide grip that targets the lats for a broad back.

name: 杠杆坐姿提踵(挂片式) v. 2
english: lever seated calf raise (plate loaded) v. 2
instructions: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pad over your thighs.
Release the safety and lower your heels for a stretch.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze the calves.
Lower slowly to full stretch.
description: A seated plate-loaded calf raise that focuses on the soleus under the calf.

name: 史密斯机窄握划船 v. 2
instructions: Set the bar at knee height and grip it with hands close together.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs, keeping elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower the bar under control to full arm extension.
description: A bent-over row on the smith machine with a narrow grip, working the lats and mid back.

name: 杠铃反握腕弯举 v. 2
instructions: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms down, holding a barbell.
Let your wrists drop so the bar hangs down.
Extend your wrists to raise the bar as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your forearms still.
description: A wrist curl with an overhand grip that builds the muscles on top of the forearm.

name: 绳索单臂前平举
instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable pulley with the handle in one hand.
Keep your arm nearly straight and raise it forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A single-arm front raise with constant cable tension, training the front of the shoulder.

name: 哑铃单臂侧平举 v. 2
english: dumbbell one arm lateral raise v. 2
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep a soft bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
description: A one-sided raise out to the side that builds the middle part of the shoulder.

name: 哑铃地面仰卧旋前
instructions: 平躺在地板上，脸朝下，双臂伸直在身前，每只手各握一个哑铃。
旋转手掌，使其朝下朝向地板。
保持手臂伸直，收缩前臂将哑铃提离地板。
继续举起，直到前臂完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
保持一会儿，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A lying dumbbell forearm pronation on the floor. Works the forearm muscles.

name: 哑铃地面仰卧旋后
instructions: 仰卧在地板上，双腿伸直，双臂放在身体两侧，每只手各握一个哑铃。
将手掌旋转至向上，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
慢慢地将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，挤压前臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A lying dumbbell forearm supination on the floor. Works the forearm muscles.

name: 大力士抬圆木
instructions: Stand over the log with feet shoulder width apart and grip it with a firm hold.
Lift it to your lap with a flat back and drive the hips forward.
Rack it on your chest with elbows high.
Dip your knees, then drive up and press the log overhead.
Lock out, then lower with control.
Start light and keep your core braced.
description: Lifting a heavy log from the ground to overhead, building full-body strength and power.

name: 大力士掰腕
instructions: Sit facing a partner with feet against theirs and both hands on a stick.
Brace your core.
Pull the stick toward you with a strong grip.
Resist your partner while keeping your back straight.
Keep the effort steady and control the end of each pull.
description: A grip and pull contest with a stick, building grip strength and total body tension.

name: 大力士拉绳交替
instructions: Face the load with the rope in both hands and feet set wide.
Lean back slightly with a braced core.
Pull the rope with one arm and then the other.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Reach and pull smoothly while keeping your back flat.
description: A heavy rope pull where you move hand over hand, training pulling strength and grip.

name: 大力士拉卡车
instructions: Stand facing away from the truck with the rope held across your body.
Lean forward and dig your feet in.
Take short, powerful steps driving through the legs.
Keep your core braced and the rope close.
Pull the full distance, then rest.
description: Pulling a heavy truck with a rope over a distance, building leg drive and grip.

name: 大力士鸭子步
instructions: Hold the weight in front of you and lower into a deep squat.
Keep your chest up.
Take small steps while staying low.
Keep your core braced and your knees tracking over your toes.
Walk the full distance, then stand and rest.
description: A low squat-walk holding a load, building leg endurance and hip strength.

name: 大力士沙袋行走
instructions: Lift the sandbag off the floor and hug it against your chest.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward at a steady pace with short steps.
Keep your posture upright and do not lean back.
Set the bag down under control at the end.
description: Carrying a heavy sandbag over a set distance to train grip, back and core.

name: 大力士铁块推举
instructions: Lift the block to your shoulders and set your feet hip width apart.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the block overhead until your arms lock out.
Pause at the top.
Lower it back to your shoulders under control.
description: An overhead press using a heavy iron block, building shoulder and arm strength.

name: 大力士冰岛十字
instructions: Pick up a weight in each hand and stand tall.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Hold them there with a braced core.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid shrugging.
Hold as long as you can, then lower under control.
description: A hold with a heavy weight in each hand, arms held out to the sides, building shoulder and grip endurance.

name: 大力士扛木行走
instructions: Lift the timber onto your shoulder and balance it.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk with short, steady steps.
Keep the load balanced and avoid leaning to one side.
Set it down under control, then switch shoulders.
description: Carrying a heavy timber on your shoulder, training full-body strength and stability.

name: 大力士柯南之环
instructions: Pick up the load and hold it against your body.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Walk in a circle with steady steps.
Stay balanced and avoid leaning away.
Set the load down under control when you finish.
description: A heavy walk in a circle holding a load, building grip, back and leg strength.

name: 大力士十字架支撑
instructions: Pick up a weight in each hand and stand tall.
Raise your arms out to the sides until level with your shoulders.
Hold the position with a braced core.
Keep your shoulders down and wrists straight.
Hold as long as you can, then lower with control.
description: Holding weights out to your sides at shoulder height, building shoulder endurance.

name: 大力士前举支撑
instructions: Pick up the weights and stand tall.
Raise your arms forward to shoulder height.
Hold with a braced core.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid leaning back.
Hold as long as you can, then lower with control.
description: Holding a load out in front of your body, building shoulder and core endurance.

name: 大力士维京推举
instructions: Stand inside the frame and grab the handles.
Lift the handles to shoulder height and set your feet.
Brace your core and press overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower back to shoulder height under control.
description: An overhead press with a heavy viking-press frame, building shoulders and triceps.

name: 大力士平台深蹲
instructions: Stand with the platform loaded on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over toes.
Drive back up through your heels.
Stand tall and lock out at the top.
description: A squat while holding a heavy platform, building leg strength and trunk stability.

name: 大力士装载
instructions: Stand over the first object with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge at the hips and grip it with a flat back.
Lift it by driving through the hips.
Carry it to the platform and load it.
Return, repeat with the next object, and keep your core braced.
description: Lifting heavy objects onto a platform in sequence, building full-body strength.

name: 大力士罩石
instructions: Straddle the stone and squat down to hug it.
Lift it to your lap by driving the hips forward.
Roll the stone up your chest.
Extend your hips to land it on the platform.
Lower the stone under control and reset.
description: Lifting a heavy stone to a platform, building power through the hips and back.

name: 大力士手推车
instructions: Grip the wheelbarrow handles and lift them with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Push forward with strong steps.
Keep your arms straight and your body in line.
Set it down under control at the end.
description: Pushing a loaded wheelbarrow over a distance, building leg drive and grip.

name: 大力士阿特拉斯石
instructions: Straddle the stone and squat down to wrap your arms around it.
Lift it to your lap by driving the hips forward.
Roll the stone up your chest.
Extend your hips to load it on the platform.
Lower it back to the floor under control and reset.
description: Lifting heavy round stones onto a platform, a classic test of full-body strength.

name: 大力士力量阶梯
instructions: Pick up the load and hold it against your chest.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Climb the stairs one step at a time.
Push through your whole foot and keep your chest up.
Set the load down under control at the top.
description: Carrying a heavy load up a flight of stairs, building leg power and grip.

name: 大力士赫拉克勒斯支撑
instructions: Pick up the weights and stand tall.
Hold your arms out to your sides.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders down.
Hold the position as long as you can.
Lower under control when done.
description: Holding two heavy weights, arms out, for time to build grip and shoulder endurance.

name: 大力士盾牌行走
instructions: Lift the shield and hold it in front of you.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward at a steady pace.
Keep your posture upright.
Set it down under control when you finish.
description: Carrying a heavy shield-like load over a distance, training core and back strength.

name: 大力士前胸深蹲
instructions: Hold the load tight against your chest with your elbows up.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down keeping your chest tall.
Drive up through your heels.
Lock out the hips at the top.
description: A front squat with a heavy load hugged to the chest, building quads and trunk strength.

name: 大力士硬拉
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over mid foot.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your knees, chest up and back flat.
Brace your core and push the floor away, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Stand tall by driving your hips forward, then lower the bar under control.
description: A heavy deadlift in strongman style, pulling a loaded bar from the floor to a full stand. Builds total posterior chain and grip strength.

name: 大力士翻轮胎
instructions: Stand close to the tire and squat down, getting your fingers under its edge.
Press your chest against the tire with a flat back and hips low.
Explode up with your legs and hips, lifting the tire as you rise.
Shove the tire over with your hands and shoulders, then step in and reset for the next flip.
description: Flipping a large tire end over end by driving up from a deep hinge. A full body power move that hits legs, back and chest.

name: 大力士举重过高
instructions: Hold the weight with both hands low in front of you, feet shoulder width apart.
Swing it back between your legs while hinging at the hips.
Drive your hips and legs up hard and swing the weight up and overhead.
Release it over the bar, then step back and reset for the next throw.
description: Throwing a heavy weight up and over a high bar. It is an explosive power move that trains hips, back and shoulders together.

name: 大力士哑铃单臂挺举
english: strongman dumbbell one arm clean and jerk
instructions: Stand over a dumbbell with feet shoulder width apart and grab it with one hand.
Pull it explosively to your shoulder with a hip drive, dipping slightly under it.
Dip your knees, then drive up and press the dumbbell overhead to a locked arm.
Lower it back to the shoulder and then the floor with control, then switch arms.
description: A one arm dumbbell clean followed by a jerk overhead. Trains explosive power from the legs through the shoulder.

name: 大力士阿波罗杠铃轴
instructions: Stand over the thick axle with feet shoulder width apart and grip it firmly.
Pull it up the thighs with a flat back and clean it to your chest.
Dip and drive with your legs, pressing the axle overhead until your arms lock.
Bring it back down to your chest and then the floor with control.
description: Lifting a thick axle bar from the floor to overhead. The fat grip makes it a brutal test for hands, forearms and shoulders.

name: 大力士杠铃农夫行走
instructions: Stand inside the loaded bar and grip the handle, then lift it to hang at your sides.
Keep your chest tall, shoulders back and core braced.
Walk forward with short, quick steps for a set distance.
Stop, lower the weights to the floor with a flat back, and rest.
description: Walking while carrying a heavy loaded bar at your sides. Builds grip strength, upper back and trunk stability.

name: 大力士轭行走
instructions: Step under the yoke so it rests across your upper back and grip the frame.
Brace your core and stand up to lift it off the supports.
Walk forward in quick, controlled steps, keeping your torso upright.
At the end, lower the yoke back onto the supports with care.
description: Carrying a heavy yoke frame across your upper back and walking with it. Strengthens the legs, trunk and traps.

name: 杠杆反握高位下拉
instructions: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，膝盖位于垫子下方，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
坐直，挺胸，肩膀向后，保持下背部轻微的拱形。
将手柄向下拉向胸部，用肘部引导并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A reverse grip lat pulldown on a machine. Builds the lats and biceps.

name: 站姿髋伸展(直腿)
instructions: Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Keep your standing knee slightly soft.
Lift one straight leg back behind you without arching your lower back.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower with control and switch legs after your reps.
description: A standing kickback with a straight leg that targets the glutes.

name: 哑铃地面仰卧三头肌伸展
english: dumbbell lying triceps extension on floor
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Keep upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weights toward your head.
Stop just before the weights touch the floor.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing up.
description: A floor version of the lying triceps extension, where the floor limits how far you lower the weight.

name: 宽距俯卧撑(靠墙)
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it, wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body leans in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Push back to the start.
Keep your hips in line with your shoulders.
description: A beginner-friendly standing push-up against a wall with a wide hand position to emphasise the chest.

name: EZ杠站姿宽握二头肌弯举
english: ez-barbell standing wide grip biceps curl
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，反手握住杠铃，双手分开比肩宽。
在整个运动过程中，保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
收缩二头肌，将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing EZ bar curl with a wide grip. Emphasises the biceps.

name: 杠杆臀推(用踏箱) v. 2
instructions: Sit in the machine with your feet on the step box and the pad across your hips.
Brace your core and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.
description: A machine hip thrust with the feet raised on a step box, for a deeper glute contraction.

name: 杠杆臀推 v. 2
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat.
Secure the hip pad over your lap.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control without letting the weight crash.
description: A machine hip thrust that loads the glutes in a controlled path.

name: 绳索站姿臀推
instructions: Attach a belt or strap to a low cable and stand facing away from the stack.
Hold the cable at your hips with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge slightly, then thrust your hips forward.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Return slowly and keep your ribs down.
description: A standing hip thrust against cable resistance, training hip extension and the glutes.

name: 史密斯机反向挺身
instructions: Lie face down over a bench with your hips at the edge and legs hanging.
Hook your heels under the smith bar if it is set low.
Lift your legs by extending the hips until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
description: A reverse hyperextension on the smith machine that works the glutes and hamstrings with support from the lower back.

name: 杠杆外展深蹲
instructions: Set the machine and step in with the pads on your shoulders.
Squat down with control, keeping your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Push your knees slightly outward as you rise.
Keep your core braced.
description: A machine squat that adds an outward leg push to work the outer hips and glutes.

name: 杠杆内收推举
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads between or around your legs as set.
Brace your core.
Thrust your hips up while squeezing your legs inward.
Hold the squeeze briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
description: A machine hip thrust that squeezes the legs inward, training the inner thighs and glutes.

name: 杠杆跪姿反向挺身
instructions: Kneel on the machine pad and hold the handles.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Press the leg back and up until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly and switch legs.
description: A kneeling machine kickback that extends the hip and works the glutes.

name: 杠杆辅助腿举
instructions: Sit in the machine and place your feet on the platform about shoulder width apart.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform by bending your knees until they reach about 90 degrees.
Push through your heels to extend the legs.
Do not lock your knees fully.
description: A machine leg press with assistance, building the thighs and glutes with a controlled path.

name: 哑铃单腿硬拉(靠墙支撑)
english: dumbbell single leg deadlift with wall support
instructions: Stand near a wall, holding a dumbbell and resting one hand on it for balance.
Lift one leg behind you.
Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbell down your standing leg.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glute to stand tall, then switch legs.
description: A one-legged deadlift where a wall helps you balance while the hamstrings and glutes do the work.

name: 壶铃哑铃相扑深蹲(站在踏箱)
english: kettlebell dumbbell sumo squat off stepbox
instructions: Stand on a step box in a wide stance with toes out.
Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell in front of you.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest up.
Lower as far as comfortable.
Push through your feet to stand.
description: A sumo squat from a raised step box, adding range of motion for deeper work on the glutes and inner thighs.

name: 分腿蹲 v. 2
instructions: Stand in a long stride with one foot forward and one back.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front heel to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A static lunge-style squat that trains the legs one at a time with balance and control.

name: 壶铃弹力带低位全蹲
english: kettlebell resistance band full squat from deficit
instructions: Stand on a low platform, band under your feet and a kettlebell at your chest.
Sit down into the deepest squat you can control.
Keep your heels flat and chest up.
Push through your feet to stand.
Keep tension in the band all the way up.
description: A deep squat from a raised platform with a band for added resistance, training the legs and glutes.

name: 负重臀推
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the weight across your hips.
Plant your feet flat and bend your knees.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A hip thrust with added weight for building strong glutes.

name: 绳索髋外展(脚尖朝外)
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold a support for balance.
Turn your toes out slightly.
Lift the working leg out to the side.
Return slowly, then switch legs.
description: A cable leg raise to the side with the toes turned out, targeting the outer hip.

name: 绳索髋外展(脚尖朝内)
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold a support for balance.
Turn your toes inward slightly.
Lift the working leg out to the side.
Return slowly, then switch legs.
description: A cable leg raise to the side with the toes turned in, shifting the work toward the outer glute.

name: 蛙式臀推
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your heels near your hips.
Drive through the feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A hip thrust with the soles of the feet together and knees out, which shifts work to the glutes and inner thighs.

name: 绳索起立
instructions: Hold the cable handle at your chest and sit back into a deep squat.
Keep your chest tall.
Push through your heels to stand fully.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.
description: Rising from a low squat against cable tension to train the glutes and legs.

name: 弹力带臀推
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the band over your hips, anchored at both sides.
Plant your feet flat.
Drive your hips up against the band.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
description: A hip thrust with a resistance band over the hips, adding load that increases toward the top.

name: 踝背屈
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit with one leg out and your heel resting on the floor.
Pull your toes and the top of your foot toward your shin as far as is comfortable.
Pause briefly, then lower the foot back down slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Pulling the toes up toward the shin, working the front of the lower leg. A simple way to keep the ankle moving well.

name: 踝跖屈
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit with one leg out and your foot relaxed.
Point your toes down and away from you, as if pressing a gas pedal.
Pause briefly at the end, then return to the neutral position.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Pointing the foot away from the shin, engaging the calf. Good for warming up and mobilising the ankle.

name: 肘伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your upper arm still with the elbow bent.
Straighten the arm slowly until it is almost fully extended.
Pause briefly, keeping the shoulder relaxed and the upper arm fixed.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Straightening the elbow from a bent position, which works the back of the upper arm and keeps the joint moving.

name: 肘屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Start with your arm straight down at your side, palm forward.
Bend the elbow to bring your hand up toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly, then lower back down slowly without swinging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Bending the elbow to bring the hand toward the shoulder, working the front of the upper arm.

name: 前臂旋前
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing up.
Rotate your forearm so your palm turns down to face the floor.
Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Rotating the forearm so the palm turns down. Helps forearm control and wrist mobility.

name: 前臂旋后
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so your palm turns up to face the ceiling.
Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Rotating the forearm so the palm turns up. Helps forearm control and wrist mobility.

name: 髋外展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other leg straight out to the side, toes pointing forward.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without leaning your torso.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Lifting the leg out to the side away from the body, working the outer hip and glutes.

name: 髋内收
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other leg slightly out to the side.
Bring it back in and across the front of the standing leg, then pause.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Bringing the leg inward across the body, working the inner thigh.

name: 髋伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Swing the other leg straight back, keeping your knee mostly straight.
Squeeze the glute at the top, avoiding any arching of your lower back.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Moving the leg back behind the body, which works the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 髋屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other knee up in front of you toward hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without rounding your back.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Lifting the thigh forward and up, working the hip flexors and front of the thigh.

name: 髋外旋
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg inward, which rotates the hip outward.
Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Rotating the thigh outward at the hip, working the deep hip rotators and glutes.

name: 髋内旋
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg outward, which rotates the hip inward.
Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Rotating the thigh inward at the hip, working the muscles that turn the leg in.

name: 膝伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair with your feet off the floor.
Straighten one knee until the leg is almost fully extended.
Squeeze your thigh at the top, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Straightening the knee, which works the front of the thigh.

name: 膝屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Bend the other knee to bring your heel up toward your glutes.
Keep your thighs side by side, pause, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Bending the knee to bring the heel toward the glutes, working the back of the thigh.

name: 肩外展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Raise one arm out to the side up to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly without shrugging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Raising the arm out to the side, working the side of the shoulder.

name: 肩内收
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm raised out to the side at shoulder height.
Pull the arm down toward your side with control.
Keep your torso still and finish with the arm next to your body.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Bringing the arm down toward the body from the side, working the lats and chest.

name: 肩伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm straight down at your side.
Swing the arm back behind you, keeping it straight.
Avoid leaning forward, pause, then return to the start.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Moving the arm back behind the body, working the lats and rear shoulder.

name: 肩屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides, palms facing in.
Raise one arm forward and up to about shoulder height or higher.
Keep your ribs down, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Raising the arm forward and up in front of the body, working the front of the shoulder.

name: 肩外旋
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm outward, keeping the elbow tucked against your side.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Rotating the upper arm outward, which works the rotator cuff muscles at the back of the shoulder.

name: 肩内旋
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm inward across your stomach, keeping the elbow tucked in.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Rotating the upper arm inward, working the muscles that turn the shoulder in.

name: 肩水平外展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm held out in front at shoulder height.
Sweep the arm out and back in a horizontal arc as far as is comfortable.
Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Moving the arm backward in a horizontal arc, working the rear delts and upper back.

name: 肩水平内收
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm held out to the side at shoulder height.
Sweep the arm forward and across your body in a horizontal arc.
Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Moving the arm forward and across the body in a horizontal arc, working the chest.

name: 肩水平伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm held in front at shoulder height.
Pull the arm back and out to the side, keeping it level.
Squeeze your shoulder blade lightly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Drawing the arm back in a horizontal plane, working the rear shoulder and upper back.

name: 肩水平屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm held out to the side at shoulder height.
Bring the arm forward in front of your chest, keeping it level.
Pause briefly, then return slowly to the side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Bringing the arm forward in a horizontal plane, working the chest and front shoulder.

name: 脊柱(腰椎)伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Lean back gently, arching your lower back within a comfortable range.
Pause briefly, then return upright.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Gently arching the lower back backward, working the muscles along the spine.

name: 脊柱(腰椎)屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and knees slightly soft.
Round your lower back forward and tuck your chin and pelvis in.
Pause briefly, then return upright.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Curling the lower back forward, working the abs and mobilising the lumbar spine.

name: 脊柱(腰椎)侧屈
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms at your sides.
Slide one hand down the outside of your leg as you bend sideways.
Keep your hips level, return to upright, then bend to the other side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Bending the trunk sideways, working the obliques and mobilising the spine.

name: 脊柱(腰椎)旋转
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side while keeping the hips facing forward.
Return to center, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Twisting the trunk to each side, working the obliques and mobilising the spine.

name: 腕内收
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, thumb up.
Tilt your hand down toward the little finger side.
Pause briefly, then return to neutral under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Tilting the wrist toward the little finger side, working the forearm muscles that guide the wrist.

name: 腕伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, palm down.
Raise your hand upward by bending the wrist back.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Lifting the back of the hand up, working the top of the forearm.

name: 腕屈曲
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, palm up.
Curl your hand upward by bending the wrist toward your forearm.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.
description: Curling the hand toward the forearm, working the underside of the forearm.

name: 平板支撑跳
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and core tight.
Move at a steady pace.
description: A jumping plank drill that raises your heart rate and challenges the core.

name: 平板支撑行走上撑
instructions: Start in a forearm plank.
Place one hand and then the other on the floor to rise to a high plank.
Lower one forearm and then the other back down.
Keep your hips steady.
Alternate the leading arm each rep.
description: Moving between a forearm and a high plank, building core and arm endurance.

name: 哑铃上台阶弓步
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Step one foot onto the box and drive up until you stand on it.
Step the same foot back down behind you into a lunge.
Push back up to the start, keeping your torso upright.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch sides.
description: A step up that flows into a lunge while holding dumbbells. Builds single leg strength and balance.

name: 哑铃上台阶弓步
instructions: 站在台阶或平台前，每只手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体两侧。
将右脚放在台阶上，确保整个脚都踩在台阶上。
推动右脚跟，将身体抬起到台阶上，同时将左脚抬起。
双脚踩在台阶上后，将左脚放回起始位置，并将右脚保持在台阶上。
重复该动作，每次交替使用哪只脚。
继续进行所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell step-up that finishes with a lunge motion. Builds the quads and glutes.

name: 杠铃深蹲跳后撤弓步 v. 2
english: barbell squat jump step rear lunge v. 2
instructions: Rest the barbell across your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down, then jump up lightly and land softly.
Step one foot back into a rear lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep, keeping your chest tall.
description: A barbell squat, a small jump and a step back into a rear lunge. A demanding combo for leg strength and power.

name: 杠铃深蹲跳后撤弓步
english: barbell squat jump step rear lunge
instructions: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
向上爆炸，尽可能高地跳离地面。
双脚轻轻落地，然后立即单腿向后退一步，形成反向弓步。
降低身体，直到大腿前侧与地面平行，保持背部挺直。
推动前脚跟以返回到起始位置。
在另一条腿上重复跳跃和弓步序列。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
description: A barbell squat jump followed by a rear lunge. Builds explosive leg power.

name: 杠铃坐姿交替抬腿
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，将杠铃放在大腿上。
保持双腿伸直，将一条腿尽可能高地抬起，同时将另一条腿放在地上。
将抬起的腿放回原位，然后换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
description: A seated alternate leg raise holding a barbell across the thighs. Works the abs and hip flexors.

name: 杠铃坐姿交替抬腿(女)
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，将杠铃放在大腿上。
将双手放在长凳两侧以获得支撑。
保持双腿伸直，将一条腿尽可能抬高，同时保持与地面平行。
将腿放回原位，然后换另一条腿重复此动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
description: A seated alternate leg raise with a barbell across the thighs and hands on the bench. Works the abs and hip flexors.

name: 扭转抬腿(女)
instructions: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
弯曲膝盖，将双腿抬离地面，将它们拉向胸部。
当你抬起双腿时，将臀部扭向一侧，将膝盖移向另一侧的肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次将臀部扭到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A lying leg raise with a hip twist. Works the abs and obliques.

name: 扭转抬腿
instructions: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
将双手放在臀部下方以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
当你抬起双腿时，将臀部扭向一侧，将双腿拉向对面的肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次将臀部扭到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A lying leg raise with a hip twist and hands under the glutes. Works the abs and obliques.

name: 哑铃扶持深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃放在身体两侧。
保持挺胸，核心收紧，弯曲膝盖并向后推臀部，慢慢降低身体。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell squat done with a support for balance. Builds the quads and glutes.

name: 哑铃扶持深蹲 v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the other hand on a stable support.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.
Switch the dumbbell hand halfway through if needed.
description: A dumbbell squat with a hand on a support for balance. Lets you focus on a deep, steady squat pattern.

name: 哑铃单腿硬拉(踏箱支撑)
english: dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support
instructions: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立，右手握住哑铃。
将左脚放在身后的台阶或高架表面上。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，髋部向前转动，将哑铃放低至地面。
当你放下哑铃时，同时将左腿抬起到身后，从头到脚跟保持一条直线。
降低哑铃，直到感觉到右腿筋拉伸，然后回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A single leg dumbbell deadlift with the rear foot supported on a step box. Works the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 哑铃单腿硬拉(踏箱支撑) v. 2
english: dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell and rest the toes of one foot on a step box behind you.
Soften the front knee and hinge at the hips, lowering the dumbbell along your leg.
Keep your back flat and go as far as your hamstring allows.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.
description: A one leg deadlift with the rear foot resting on a step box for balance. Works hamstrings and glutes with less wobble.

name: 哑铃相扑穿腿拉 v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell with both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell back between your legs.
Keep your back flat and chest up.
Drive your hips forward and stand tall, swinging the dumbbell to hip height.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
description: A wide stance hinge where a dumbbell swings between the legs. Trains glutes, inner thighs and hamstrings.

name: 哑铃相扑穿腿拉
instructions: 站立，双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾朝外。
双手握住哑铃置于身体前方，双臂伸展。
弯曲膝盖，将臀部放低至下蹲位置，保持背部挺直。
将哑铃放在两腿之间，保持手臂伸直。
通过脚后跟发力，向前伸展臀部，将哑铃向上拉至身体前方。
在动作的最高点挤压臀部，然后将哑铃放回双腿之间。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A sumo-stance dumbbell pull through between the legs. Trains the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 杠铃分腿蹲 v. 3
instructions: Rest the barbell across your upper back and step into a split stance.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Press through your front foot to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
description: A split squat with a barbell on your back, a second variation. Builds single leg strength and balance.

name: 杠铃分腿蹲 v. 2
instructions: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
右脚向前迈出一大步，保持躯干直立。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
左腿向前重复此动作，达到所需的重复次数。
description: A barbell split squat with a long stance. Builds the quads and glutes one leg at a time.

name: 杠铃扭腿推举
instructions: Hold a barbell at your shoulders with feet shoulder width apart.
Step one foot out and rotate your hips and torso with it, bending into a rotated lunge.
Drive back up and press the bar overhead as you stand.
Lower the bar to your shoulders.
Alternate sides on each rep.
description: A combined move where a leg rotation pairs with an overhead press with a barbell. Trains legs, trunk and shoulders together.

name: 哑铃上台阶分腿蹲
instructions: 站在长凳或台阶前，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将右脚放在长凳或台阶上，确保整个脚与表面接触。
走到长凳上或用右脚踩上，用脚跟推动身体抬起。
当你向上迈步时，同时将左膝抬向胸部。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢将左脚放回地面，同时将右脚放在长凳或台阶上。
将左脚放在长凳或台阶上，重复该动作。
继续交替左右脚，达到所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell step-up combined with a knee drive. Builds the quads and glutes.

name: 单臂扭转高翻推举
english: one arm twisted clean and press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a weight in one hand low in front of you.
Pull it up to your shoulder with a hip drive and a slight turn of the body.
Turn your feet and hips back to face forward as you dip your knees.
Press the weight overhead until your arm locks.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.
description: A one arm clean with a body twist followed by a press overhead. Builds power and coordination from hips to shoulder.

name: V字起落(稳定球)
instructions: Lie on your back holding the stability ball overhead with straight arms.
Lift your arms and legs up together, curling into a V.
Pass the ball from your hands to your feet.
Lower back down slowly, holding the ball between your feet.
Repeat, passing the ball back to your hands.
description: A V up where you pass a stability ball between hands and feet. Works the abs and builds control.

name: 战绳侧举
instructions: Stand in a slight squat holding a rope end in each hand.
Keep your core braced and elbows soft.
Raise both arms out to the sides to about shoulder height in a quick, controlled motion.
Lower and repeat at a steady fast pace.
Work in intervals of 20-30 seconds.
description: Raising battling ropes out to the side with a fast, wave-making motion. Boosts shoulder endurance and heart rate.

name: 动力雪橇后撤弓步
instructions: Hold the sled handles and stand tall with your feet together.
Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.
description: A rear lunge while pushing or holding a power sled. Builds leg strength with extra resistance.

name: 凳上派克俯卧撑
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips raised in an inverted V.
Keep your legs straight and your core braced.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees to your body.
description: A pike push up with your feet raised on a bench, shifting more load to the shoulders. A bodyweight alternative to the overhead press.

name: 吊带负重反向划船
instructions: Hold the suspension handles and lean back with your body in a straight line, with weight on your torso.
Keep your arms straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.
description: An inverted row on suspension straps with added weight on your body. Builds the back and biceps.

name: 绳索窄距椅上起立
instructions: Sit on a chair holding the cable handle at your chest.
Keep your feet close together.
Lean forward slightly.
Push through your heels to stand.
Lower back under control.
description: A weighted sit-to-stand with a narrow stance and cable resistance.

name: 绳索踏箱直腿硬拉
english: cable stiff leg deadlift from stepbox
instructions: Stand on a step box facing a low cable and hold the handle.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Hinge at the hips and lower the handle.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.
description: A straight-leg hinge from a raised box for a longer range on the hamstrings.

name: 绳索踏箱后撤弓步
instructions: Stand on a step box facing a cable and hold the handle.
Step one leg back and down to lunge.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front foot to return.
Switch legs after your reps.
description: A reverse lunge from a step box with cable tension, training the glutes and legs.

name: 自行车
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your legs and curl your shoulders up.
Extend one leg while bringing the opposite elbow toward the other knee.
Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
description: A pedalling leg movement lying on your back that works the abs and hip flexors.

name: 抬胸转体
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and lower.
Alternate sides.
description: A curl up with a twist that trains the abs and obliques.

name: 控制平衡
instructions: Lie on your back and roll your legs overhead.
Hold one ankle with both hands.
Extend the other leg out above you.
Switch legs with control.
Roll down slowly.
description: A challenging Pilates move where you balance on your shoulders while switching legs, building control and core strength.

name: 开瓶器
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs raised up.
Lift your hips slightly and swing your legs across to one side.
Circle them down and around.
Bring them back up to the start.
Reverse the direction.
description: A Pilates move where the legs trace circles overhead, training the obliques and lower abs.

name: 螃蟹式
instructions: Sit with your legs crossed and hold your feet.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Cross your legs the other way.
Roll back up.
Keep your movement smooth.
description: A rolling Pilates move in a seated crab shape that works the core and spine mobility.

name: 双腿伸展
instructions: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders up.
Hug your knees to your chest.
Reach your arms overhead while extending your legs.
Circle your arms and draw your knees back in.
Keep your lower back down.
description: A core-driven move where arms and legs stretch out together and then draw back in.

name: 地面挺身 v. 2
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lengthen your neck.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.
description: A face-down back lift that strengthens the spine and glutes.

name: 扭髋手臂支撑
instructions: Sit with your hands behind you and legs lifted.
Keep your chest open.
Rotate your hips to one side.
Circle your legs back to the centre.
Switch sides.
description: A seated twist with the legs lifted, working the obliques and core.

name: 百次拍击
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your head and shoulders.
Raise your legs to a tabletop or extend them.
Pump your arms up and down in small beats.
Breathe in for five beats and out for five.
Aim for one hundred beats.
description: The classic Pilates warm-up where you pump your arms while holding your legs up, building abdominal endurance.

name: 侧向拉腿
instructions: Start in a side plank on one hand.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift your top leg.
Hold briefly.
Lower and switch sides.
description: A side-plank style Pilates move where one leg lifts, challenging the obliques and shoulders.

name: 拉腿
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Brace your core.
Lift one leg a few inches.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips level.
description: A plank-based Pilates move where you lift one leg at a time, training core stability.

name: 抬腿(屈膝)
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Bend your knees.
Raise your legs until your thighs are vertical.
Lower slowly without arching.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
description: A lying leg raise with bent knees that makes it easier to focus on the lower abs.

name: 仰卧双腿踢
instructions: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your back.
Kick both heels toward your glutes.
Lift your chest and extend your arms back.
Lower down.
Repeat smoothly.
description: A face-down Pilates move that opens the chest and strengthens the back.

name: 侧卧抬腿
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked.
Support your head with your arm.
Lift your top leg.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side-lying leg lift that works the outer hip.

name: 仰卧拉颈
instructions: Lie on your back with hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Roll up to sit.
Reach forward.
Roll down with control.
description: A roll up from lying with your hands behind your head, training the abs.

name: 仰卧单腿画圈
instructions: Lie on your back with one leg extended up.
Keep your pelvis still.
Draw small circles with that leg.
Reverse direction.
Switch legs.
description: A hip mobility move where one leg draws circles in the air.

name: 仰卧单腿踢
instructions: Lie face down and prop yourself on your forearms.
Keep your chest lifted.
Kick one heel toward your glute twice.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips down.
description: A face-down move kicking one heel toward the glute while the chest stays lifted.

name: 开腿摇椅
instructions: Sit and hold your ankles with your legs in a V.
Balance on your tailbone.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll up to balance again.
Keep your back rounded.
description: A balance and rolling move with the legs open in a V shape.

name: 摇摆
instructions: Lie face down and reach back to hold your ankles.
Lift your chest and legs.
Rock forward and back.
Keep your movement smooth.
Lower down to finish.
description: A rocking move on the stomach that stretches the front and strengthens the back.

name: 卷起 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and curl your head and chest up.
Roll up one vertebra at a time.
Reach over your legs.
Roll back down slowly.
description: A slow roll up from lying to sitting, training abdominal control and spine flexibility.

name: 向后翻滚
instructions: Sit with your knees tucked and hold your shins.
Round your back.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll back up to balance.
Keep your chin tucked.
description: A rolling move that massages the spine and trains abdominal control.

name: 翻转
instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised.
Roll your legs overhead.
Open them to hip width.
Roll down slowly.
Keep your arms pressing down.
description: A controlled move where the legs travel overhead and back, challenging the abs.

name: 锯式
instructions: Sit with legs wide and arms out.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Reach your hand past your opposite foot.
Return to centre.
Switch sides.
description: A seated twist that reaches toward the opposite foot, training the obliques and stretching the back of the legs.

name: 剪刀腿
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips lifted and hands supporting them.
Raise your legs up.
Lower one leg while the other stays up.
Switch legs.
Keep the movement steady.
description: A leg-switching move lying on your back, building lower abdominal strength.

name: 肩桥
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Extend one leg up.
Lower it and switch legs.
Roll down slowly.
description: A bridge that lifts the hips and adds a leg raise, working the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 侧弯
instructions: Sit tall on your side with your bottom hand pressed into the mat and your legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a long diagonal line.
Reach your top arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting arm.
Lift back up to the long line while keeping your hips high.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.
description: A Pilates side bend from a seated or side-supported position that works the obliques and the sides of the trunk.

name: 侧向扭转
instructions: Set up in a side support with one hand on the mat and your feet stacked.
Lift your hips and reach your top arm to the ceiling.
Thread the top arm under your body as you rotate your torso.
Open back up and reach to the ceiling again.
Keep your hips lifted throughout, then switch sides.
description: A Pilates twist from a side-supported position that trains the obliques and shoulder stability.

name: 脊柱扭转 v. 2
instructions: Sit tall with your legs extended and arms reaching out to the sides.
Flex your feet and grow tall through the crown of your head.
Twist your torso to one side, pulsing gently for a small extra turn.
Return to center without sagging in the chest.
Twist to the other side and repeat.
description: A seated Pilates twist that mobilises the spine and strengthens the obliques.

name: 天鹅俯冲
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs together.
Press up into a swan, lifting your chest off the mat.
Let your arms float forward as you rock your chest and legs up.
Rock back and forth in a smooth, controlled rhythm.
Keep your neck long and your abs gently drawn in.
description: A rocking Pilates move on your belly that builds back extensor strength and control.

name: 游泳式
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead and legs long.
Lift your arms, chest and legs slightly off the mat.
Flutter opposite arm and leg up and down in a quick, small rhythm.
Keep your abs drawn in and your neck long.
Continue for 20-30 seconds, then rest.
description: A prone Pilates exercise with alternating arm and leg flutters that trains the back and glutes.

name: 挑战式
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms overhead.
Roll up while lifting your legs to form a V shape.
Reach your arms parallel to your legs and balance on your sit bones.
Hold briefly with a flat, strong back.
Roll down slowly with control and repeat.
description: A classic Pilates V-sit that challenges abdominal strength and balance.

name: 单腿伸展(屈膝) v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders off the mat.
Pull one knee toward your chest, with hands on that shin.
Extend the other leg long at a low angle.
Switch legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your lower back anchored to the mat.
description: A Pilates ab move with alternating knee pulls that builds core endurance and coordination.

name: 脊柱前伸 v. 2
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Draw your belly in and flex your feet.
Curl forward one vertebra at a time, reaching over an imaginary ball.
Hold for a breath at the bottom.
Roll back up to tall sitting and repeat.
description: A seated Pilates stretch that rounds the spine forward to lengthen the back and hamstrings.

name: 前支撑拉腿
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels.
Lift one leg a few inches without shifting your hips.
Lower it and repeat on the other leg.
Keep your abs tight and your neck long.
description: A Pilates plank variation with a leg lift that builds core and shoulder stability.

name: 跪姿侧踢
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the opposite leg extended to the side.
Place your bottom hand on the mat and keep the top hand light behind your head.
Kick the top leg forward, then sweep it back with control.
Keep your torso steady and tall.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
description: A kneeling Pilates side kick that works the outer hip and core stability.

name: 回旋镖
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended and crossed at the ankles.
Roll back and lift your legs overhead, then switch the cross.
Roll up to a teaser with your legs lifted.
Hold your hands behind you and then reach forward over your legs.
Move smoothly, using your abs to control each roll.
description: An advanced Pilates sequence of rolling and balancing that tests core control.

name: 海豹式
instructions: Sit balanced on your tailbone with knees open and hands inside your ankles.
Tuck your chin and round your back into a ball.
Roll back to your shoulders and clap your feet together.
Roll up to the balance position and clap again.
Keep the roll smooth and avoid rolling onto your neck.
description: A rolling Pilates exercise that massages the spine and builds ab control.

name: 俯卧撑起天鹅式
instructions: Lie face down with hands beside your chest and legs together.
Press your pubic bone into the mat and engage your glutes.
Press through your hands to lift your chest.
Keep your neck long and shoulders away from your ears.
Lower slowly with control and repeat.
description: A Pilates back extension on your belly that lifts the chest and strengthens the spine.

name: 美人鱼式
instructions: Sit with your legs folded to one side in a comfortable position.
Place one hand on the mat beside you.
Reach the other arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting hand.
Hold for a breath, feeling the side stretch.
Return to tall sitting and switch sides.
description: A seated Pilates side stretch that opens the sides of the torso and ribs.

name: 四点支撑游泳式
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Flutter them in small, quick pulses.
Keep your spine neutral and your hips level.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: A quadruped Pilates move with opposite arm and leg lifts for back stability.

name: 绳索悬垂抬腿
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with the cable attached to your ankles.
Keep your arms straight and your body steady.
Raise your legs up in front of you toward hip height or higher.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
description: A hanging leg raise with cable resistance at your feet. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors.

name: 海星卷腹(进阶)
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs spread wide.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Crunch up, bringing your arms and legs toward the center.
Slowly open back out to the starfish shape.
Keep your movements controlled and repeat.
