description: A wide-limb crunch that works the abs while your arms and legs open and close like a starfish.

name: 前平板支撑到俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Place one hand on the floor and press up, then the other.
Reach a high plank with straight arms.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm each rep and keep your hips level.
description: A move that moves from forearm plank to full push-up position, training the chest, arms and core.

name: 交替打腿(手放臀下抬头)
english: flutter kicks (hands under hips head up)
instructions: Lie on your back with hands tucked under your hips.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Raise both legs a few inches above the ground.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating pulses.
Keep your lower back pressed down and breathe steadily.
description: Fast alternating leg lifts with your head raised that fire up the lower abs.

name: 剪刀腿(初级)
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Lift both legs a little off the floor.
Open them wide, then cross one over the other.
Alternate which leg is on top with each rep.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
description: A beginner floor exercise crossing the legs like scissors to train the lower abs.

name: 前平板支撑抬臂
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one arm forward without letting your hips twist.
Return it and lift the other arm.
Alternate in a slow, controlled rhythm.
description: A plank where one arm lifts at a time, challenging core stability and anti-rotation.

name: 前平板支撑抬臂(俯卧撑姿势)
english: front plank with arm lift (push up position)
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Set your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and reach it forward without twisting your hips.
Place it down and switch arms.
Keep your core braced throughout.
description: A high plank where you lift one arm at a time, training anti-rotation core strength.

name: 前平板支撑抬臂抬腿(俯卧撑姿势)
english: front plank with arm and leg lift (push up position)
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold them in line with your body for a moment.
Lower them back to the floor with control.
Switch to the other arm and leg and repeat.
description: A high plank holding the opposite arm and leg in the air, which tests balance and core strength.

name: 侧平板支撑(初级)
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your hips and knees.
Press into your forearm to lift your hips off the floor.
Hold a straight line from knees to head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A bent-knee side plank that builds oblique and hip strength for beginners.

name: EZ杠站姿牧师凳弯举
instructions: Stand facing a preacher pad and hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Rest your upper arms on the pad with the arms extended.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until the arms are almost straight.
description: A preacher style curl performed standing at an angled pad. Isolates the biceps with strict form.

name: 动力雪橇二头肌弯举
instructions: Stand facing the sled and grip the handle or strap with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders, moving the sled.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your torso still.
description: A biceps curl using a power sled as the resistance. Adds a unique load for arm strength.

name: 动力雪橇后撤弓步划船
instructions: Hold the sled handles with arms extended and feet together.
Step back into a rear lunge, lowering your back knee.
As you rise, row the handles toward your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return to standing and extend your arms.
Alternate legs on each rep.
description: A rear lunge combined with a row using a power sled. Works legs and back together.

name: 动力雪橇后撤弓步 v. 2
instructions: Hold the sled handles and stand tall with feet together.
Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.
description: A rear lunge using a power sled for resistance. Builds glute and thigh strength.

name: 动力雪橇后蝙蝠翼
instructions: Hold the sled handles and hinge slightly at the hips.
Keep your back flat and knees soft.
Pull the handles back and out to the sides like wings.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
description: A movement with a power sled where you pull the handles out and back like wings. Works the hamstrings, back and rear shoulders.

name: 动力雪橇后飞鸟
instructions: Hold the sled handles with arms out in front and hinge slightly at the hips.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly.
description: A rear fly done with a power sled for resistance. Works the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: 动力雪橇后拖
instructions: Face the sled, holding its handles or straps with a slight lean back.
Keep your chest up and core braced.
Walk backward in steady steps, pulling the sled with you.
Keep your knees soft and drive through your legs.
Cover a set distance, then rest.
description: Walking backward while dragging a power sled. Great for quads and conditioning with low joint stress.

name: 动力雪橇倒退推
instructions: Stand behind the sled with your back to it and grip the handles.
Brace your core and lean slightly into the load.
Walk forward in powerful steps, pushing the sled.
Keep your stride steady and breathing controlled.
Cover a set distance, then rest.
description: Pushing a power sled while walking backward. Builds quad strength and conditioning.

name: 动力雪橇抗旋转前行
english: power sled anti rotation forward walk
instructions: Set a light load and stand side-on to the pull, gripping the handle at chest height.
Brace your abs and keep your hips and shoulders square.
Walk forward in controlled steps without letting the torso twist.
Walk the set distance, then reset and repeat.
Switch sides and do the same distance.
description: Walking a loaded sled forward while resisting twist from a side-on pull or hold. It builds hip and trunk stability under load.

name: 动力雪橇高拉
instructions: Stand facing the sled and hold the handles or rope with arms long.
Hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and pull the handles up toward your chest, elbows high.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower under control and repeat.
description: A pull from low to chest height on a sled, using hip drive. It trains the shoulders and upper back with a bit of power.

name: 哑铃单侧负重行走
instructions: Pick up one dumbbell with a tall, braced posture and hold it at your side.
Keep your shoulders level and your ribs stacked over your hips.
Walk with steady steps without leaning toward the weight.
Cover the set distance, then put the weight down safely.
Switch hands and repeat.
description: Carrying one heavy dumbbell at your side like a suitcase. It challenges your grip and forces your trunk to resist leaning.

name: 哑铃高低负重行走
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with a locked, stable arm and the other at your side.
Stand tall with your ribs down and abs braced.
Walk with steady steps and keep the top arm stacked over your shoulder.
Walk the set distance, then lower the weights carefully.
Swap positions and repeat.
description: A walking carry with one dumbbell overhead and one at your side. The mismatch trains shoulder stability and trunk control.

name: 六角杠农夫行走
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar and hinge down to grip the handles.
Stand up with a flat back, shoulders back and chest tall.
Walk with short, quick steps, keeping the bar still.
Cover the set distance without leaning or shrugging.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.
description: Carrying a loaded trap bar at your sides while walking. It works grip, traps and the whole trunk together.

name: 哑铃过头负重行走
instructions: Press a dumbbell overhead and lock out your elbow with the biceps near your ear.
Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
Walk with steady steps without letting the arm drift forward.
Cover the set distance, then lower the weight with control.
Switch arms and repeat.
description: Walking with a dumbbell held overhead. It builds shoulder stability and a strong, braced trunk.

name: 杠铃过头负重行走
instructions: Press the barbell overhead with a grip just outside shoulder width.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.
Walk with small, steady steps, keeping the bar over your mid-foot.
Cover the set distance without arching your back.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and set it down safely.
description: Walking while holding a barbell locked out overhead. It trains shoulder stability and whole-body bracing.

name: 杠铃泽奇负重行走
instructions: Set the bar in your elbow crooks, hugging it tight to your chest.
Stand tall with your chest up and your abs braced.
Walk with controlled steps while keeping the bar close.
Cover the set distance without rounding forward.
Lower the bar to the rack or floor carefully.
description: Carrying a barbell in the crooks of your elbows. It loads the legs, upper back and trunk in a tough front-loaded position.

name: 壶铃高脚杯负重行走
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns close to your chest, elbows tucked.
Stand tall with your ribs down and abs braced.
Walk with steady steps without leaning back.
Cover the set distance, keeping the bell high and still.
Set the kettlebell down with a flat back.
description: Walking while hugging a kettlebell at chest height. It trains posture, the trunk and the upper back.

name: 哑铃农夫行走
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand tall.
Pull your shoulders back and down and brace your abs.
Walk with quick, controlled steps without swinging the weights.
Cover the set distance, then lower the dumbbells safely.
description: Walking while holding a heavy dumbbell in each hand. It builds grip strength, traps and overall posture.

name: 杠铃单侧负重行走
instructions: Stand with the barbell at your side and grip it near its center of balance.
Lift it while keeping your torso tall and level.
Walk with steady steps and resist tilting toward the weight.
Cover the set distance, then lower the bar carefully.
Switch hands and repeat.
description: Carrying a barbell off to one side with a single-handed grip. It trains your trunk to resist leaning and builds grip.

name: 史密斯机六角推举
instructions: Lie on a bench under the Smith bar and hold a weight plate between your palms if you like.
Unrack the bar with a close grip and hold it over your chest.
Squeeze your hands inward as you lower the bar to your mid chest.
Press back up while still squeezing.
Rerack the bar when done.
description: A press with the weights squeezed together, done on a Smith machine. The squeeze keeps tension on the chest throughout.

name: 徒手单腿硬拉(手臂和腿伸直)
english: single leg bodyweight deadlift with arm and leg extended
instructions: Stand on one leg with arms reaching forward.
Soften your standing knee slightly.
Hinge at the hips as your free leg lifts behind you.
Keep your back flat and body in a long line.
Return to standing and repeat, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg hinge with your arms extended that trains hamstrings, glutes and balance.

name: 派克俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips into an inverted V.
Keep your arms and back straight.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.
description: A push-up with hips lifted high so you press more overhead. It builds shoulder strength using only your body weight.

name: 徒手站姿二头肌弯举
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one hand under the wrist of your other hand to give resistance.
Curl the working hand toward your shoulder while the other hand pushes down.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: A curl done with your own body resistance, such as pushing one hand against the other. It is a simple way to train the biceps without equipment.

name: 绳索侧卧侧平举
instructions: Lie on your side next to a low cable pulley and grab the handle with your top hand.
Keep your arm straight with a slight bend in the elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side until it is near shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: A lateral raise performed while lying on your side with a cable. Lying down keeps constant tension on the side delt.

name: 哑铃单腿上台阶
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a box or bench.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to stand up tall.
Lower back down under control without bouncing off the floor foot.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: Stepping up onto a bench with one leg while holding dumbbells. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.

name: X形弹力带侧向行走
instructions: Cross the band into an X and place it around your feet or lower legs, holding the ends as needed.
Stand in a quarter squat with your chest up.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting your feet touch.
Walk the set distance, then return the other way.
description: Stepping sideways against a band anchored in an X pattern. It fires up the hips and outer glutes.

name: 壶铃跪姿单臂倒握推举
english: kettlebell kneeling one arm bottoms up press
instructions: Kneel on both knees and hold a kettlebell bottoms up at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle tight and keep your wrist straight.
Press the bell straight overhead.
Lower slowly to your shoulder, keeping the bell balanced.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: Pressing a kettlebell held upside down from a kneeling position. The unstable load demands shoulder control and grip.

name: 杠铃过头耸肩
instructions: Hold a barbell locked out overhead with a wide grip.
Keep your arms straight and your ribs down.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without bending your elbows.
description: A shrug done with the barbell locked out overhead. It targets the traps and helps with overhead stability.

name: 跪姿战绳
instructions: Kneel in front of the anchored ropes and hold an end in each hand.
Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
Raise and lower your arms alternately to create waves.
Keep the waves quick and steady.
Work for a set time, then rest.
description: Making waves with heavy ropes while kneeling. It raises your heart rate and burns the shoulders and arms.

name: 弹力带拉开(旋后90度)
instructions: Hold a band in front of you at chest height with palms up and elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows tucked near your sides.
Rotate your forearms outward, pulling the band apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together briefly.
Return slowly and repeat.
description: A band pull-apart with palms facing up and elbows bent at 90 degrees. It targets the rear delts and external shoulder rotation.

name: 背靠墙肩屈曲
instructions: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall.
Keep your arms at your sides with elbows straight.
Raise your arms forward and up overhead as far as you can without arching your back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: Raising your arms overhead while your back stays against a wall. It improves shoulder mobility and posture.

name: 壶铃跪姿单臂肩部推举
english: kettlebell kneeling one arm shoulder press
instructions: Kneel on both knees with a kettlebell racked at your shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm kettlebell press from a kneeling position. Kneeling takes the legs out of it and challenges your trunk.

name: 战绳后撤弓步
instructions: Stand holding the ends of the battle ropes, feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back into a lunge while making a wave with the ropes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs, keeping the rope waves going.
Work for a set time, then rest.
description: Alternating rear lunges while making waves with heavy ropes. It combines leg work with a hard cardio effort.

name: 壶铃半跪姿肩部推举
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a kettlebell racked at your shoulder.
Brace your abs and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Press the bell straight overhead.
Lower it back under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: A one-arm kettlebell press from a half-kneeling stance. The position teaches hip stability while you press.

name: 半跪姿pvc管胸肌活动拉伸
english: half kneeling pvc pec mobilization stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee and grip a pipe or stick with one hand while the other arm reaches out.
Place the working forearm against a wall or post.
Gently rotate your torso away until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.
description: A chest opener using a PVC pipe from a half-kneeling position. It loosens tight pecs and the front of the shoulder.

name: 摇摆踝部拉伸
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the front foot flat on the floor.
Keep your front heel down.
Rock your front knee forward over your toes until you feel a stretch.
Rock back and forth slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.
description: Rocking forward over a bent knee to open the ankle and calf. It helps ankle mobility for squats and walking.

name: 稳定球圆背滚动
instructions: Kneel in front of a stability ball with forearms on top.
Round your back slightly and tuck your pelvis.
Roll the ball forward by extending your arms.
Pull it back using your abs.
Keep your hips from sagging and move slowly.
description: A rollout on a stability ball with a rounded back that trains the abs hard.

name: 弹力带上肢抗阻死虫式
english: band upper body resistance dead bug
instructions: Lie on your back holding a band overhead and bring your knees up at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping band tension.
Return to the start and switch sides.
Keep your ribs down and move slowly.
description: A dead bug with a band resisting your arms. It adds shoulder and trunk demand to a classic core drill.

name: 壶铃绕头旋转
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at chest height.
Stand tall with your abs braced.
Circle the bell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your hips and ribs still.
Finish the reps, then reverse direction.
description: Circling a kettlebell around your head, also called a halo. It loosens the shoulders and warms up the upper back.

name: 俯卧单臂斜方肌上举
instructions: Lie face down with one arm hanging or reaching overhead, thumb up.
Keep your forehead down and neck relaxed.
Lift your arm in a Y shape by squeezing your shoulder blade down and back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: A raise lying face down on a bench or floor with one arm. It targets the lower and middle traps and shoulder blade control.

name: 前臂靠墙滑动
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your forearms on it, elbows at shoulder height.
Lean in slightly and keep your abs braced.
Slide your forearms up the wall as you reach upward.
Pause at the top without arching your back.
Slide back down and repeat.
description: Sliding your forearms up a wall to wake up the shoulder blade muscles. It improves overhead movement.

name: 壶铃斜向推举
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder and stand tall.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bell up and slightly out to the side in a diagonal path.
Lock out your arm without leaning back.
Lower under control, finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: A kettlebell press at an angle between a front and a side raise path. It suits natural shoulder movement and builds pressing strength.

name: 弹力带蜘蛛爬
instructions: Place a band around your thighs and start in a push-up position.
Brace your core.
Bring one knee toward the same-side elbow while crawling forward.
Alternate sides while keeping the band under tension.
Crawl the set distance, then rest.
description: A spider crawl performed with a band around your legs. The band adds hip effort to a classic core and shoulder crawl.

name: 海豹俯卧撑
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs straight.
Push your upper body up with your arms like a seal.
Keep your hips on the floor and your core tight.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat for smooth, controlled reps.
description: A push-up where your hands lift off the floor and reach out at the top. It builds chest and back strength together.

name: 背靠墙肩胛滑动
instructions: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your elbows bent at your sides.
Press your forearms and head lightly into the wall.
Slide your arms up the wall while keeping your shoulder blades down.
Stop before your back arches.
Slide down slowly and repeat.
description: Sliding your shoulder blades along a wall to improve their control. It helps shoulder blade mobility and posture.

name: 单臂肩胛俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a plank with one hand on the floor, the other behind your back or on your hip.
Keep your elbow locked straight.
Let your chest sink slightly between your shoulder blades.
Push the floor away to round your upper back slightly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: A small push-up movement with one arm that moves only the shoulder blades. It builds control of the serratus anterior.

name: 滚压小腿前侧泡沫轴放松
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place the roller under the front of your shin.
Support yourself with your hands on the floor.
Roll slowly up and down the shin muscle.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch legs and keep the pressure comfortable.
description: Rolling the front of the lower leg on a foam roller. It can loosen the muscles beside your shin.

name: 滚压胸肌泡沫轴放松
instructions: Lie face down and place the roller under one side of your chest.
Extend that arm out to the side.
Roll slowly side to side and up and down.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable.
description: Rolling the chest on a foam roller. It can loosen tight pecs before pressing or after desk work.

name: 滚压背阔肌泡沫轴放松
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your armpit area and your arm extended.
Support yourself with your lower arm and legs.
Roll slowly along your side toward the ribs.
Pause on tight spots for a few seconds.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable.
description: Rolling the side of your back on a foam roller. It can loosen tight lats before overhead work.

name: 杠杆腰带深蹲
instructions: Step into the belt and stand on the platforms with the belt snug on your hips.
Stand tall and brace your abs.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Push through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
description: A squat on a machine where the weight hangs from a belt at your hips. It loads the legs without stressing your spine.

name: 杠杆水平腿举
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back flat against the pad and feet on the platform.
Set your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Press the platform away until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees.
Lower slowly until your knees are bent about 90 degrees and repeat.
description: A leg press on a horizontal lever machine. It builds the quads and glutes with back support.

name: 史密斯机跪姿后踢(与搭档)
instructions: Get on all fours and place the sole of one foot on the Smith bar, with your partner steadying you if needed.
Brace your core.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A kneeling glute kick using a Smith machine with a partner helping. It works the glutes with a steady guided path.

name: 绳索站姿反握弯举(直杆)
english: cable standing reverse grip curl (straight bar)
instructions: Stand facing a low cable with a straight bar in an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A standing curl with an overhand grip on a straight cable bar. It targets the forearms and brachialis.

name: 哑铃高脚杯分腿蹲(前脚垫高)
english: dumbbell goblet split squat front foot elevated
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and place your front foot on a low platform.
Place your back foot behind you on the floor.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A goblet split squat with the front foot on a raised platform. The extra height deepens the range for the quads and glutes.

name: 哑铃分腿蹲(前脚垫高)
english: dumbbell split squat front foot elevated
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a low platform.
Step your back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor with your torso upright.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A split squat holding dumbbells at your sides with the front foot raised. It deepens the range for the quads and glutes.

name: 哑铃分腿蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and take a long stance, one foot forward.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A stationary lunge with dumbbells at your sides. It strengthens one leg at a time, mainly the quads and glutes.

name: 平板支撑俯卧撑划船
instructions: Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet wide.
Do a push-up, keeping your body straight.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it and row the other side.
Repeat the sequence with control.
description: A plank sequence combining a push-up and a row. It trains the chest, back and core in one flowing move.

name: 杠杆坐姿锤式握肩部推举
english: lever seated hammer grip shoulder press
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to shoulder height and repeat.
description: A seated machine shoulder press with a neutral hammer grip. It trains the delts with a joint-friendly hand position.

name: 罗马椅直腿抬腿
instructions: 坐在船长椅上，背部靠在靠背上，前臂放在扶手垫上。
保持上半身稳定，背部挺直。
收紧腹肌并将双腿抬起到身前，保持伸直。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面平行或达到您可以舒适地达到的高度。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A straight leg raise on a captain's chair, lifting your legs in front of you. Works the abs and hip flexors.

name: 杠铃臀桥(手放杠上)
instructions: Sit on the floor with a barbell over your hips, padded if needed.
Roll back, set your feet, and hold the bar with both hands.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A glute bridge with the barbell resting on your hips and your hands on the bar. It builds the glutes and hamstrings with load.

name: 哑铃前蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, elbows forward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.
description: A squat with dumbbells held at your shoulders. The front load keeps your chest upright and challenges the quads and core.

name: 哑铃推举深蹲
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your heels and press the dumbbells overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower the weights to your shoulders and go straight into the next rep.
description: A front squat that flows into an overhead press. It is a hard whole-body move that raises your heart rate.

name: 哑铃推举深蹲 v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.
description: A squat into overhead press with dumbbells that works the legs and shoulders in one flow.

name: 弹力带推举深蹲
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press your hands overhead in one motion.
Lock out your arms at the top.
Lower your hands to your shoulders and repeat.
description: A squat into an overhead press using a band for resistance. It trains the legs, shoulders and heart in one move.

name: 侧弓步
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step wide to one side.
Bend that knee and sit your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Alternate sides.
description: Stepping out to the side into a deep lunge. It works the quads and glutes while opening the inner thighs.

name: 杠杆单臂推胸(挂片式)
english: lever one arm chest press (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and grip one handle.
Set your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handle forward until your arm is nearly straight.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: A single-arm chest press on a plate-loaded machine. It lets each side work on its own.

name: 地雷管深蹲推举
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up and press the bar away until your arms are straight.
Lower the bar to your chest and repeat.
description: A squat that flows into a press with a landmine bar. It works legs and shoulders in one smooth motion.

name: 肘撑上下动态平板支撑
english: elbow up and down dynamic plank
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with your body in a straight line.
Place one hand on the floor and press up to a high plank.
Place the other hand down.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm and keep your hips still.
description: Moving between a forearm plank and a high plank, one arm at a time. It builds the core and shoulders under constant tension.

name: 哑铃反向划船
instructions: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet wide.
Brace your core.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it with control.
Repeat on the other side.
description: A row from a plank position with dumbbells. It builds the back while your core fights rotation.

name: 哑铃交替地面推举
instructions: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand and knees bent.
Press both dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower one dumbbell until your upper arm touches the floor.
Press it back up and lower the other side.
Keep alternating.
description: A floor press where you press one dumbbell at a time. It trains the chest and triceps with a limited range for the shoulders.

name: 单腿深蹲至箱
instructions: Stand in front of a box with one leg extended forward.
Brace your core and reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit back and down slowly on the standing leg until you touch the box.
Drive through your heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg squat down to a box. The box gives you a target for depth as you build strength.

name: 负重锤式握法双杠架引体向上
english: weighted hammer grip pull up on dip cage
instructions: Attach a belt or vest with weight and grip the neutral handles of the cage.
Hang with your arms straight and your core braced.
Pull your chest up until your chin passes the handles.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to a full hang and repeat.
description: A weighted pull-up with a neutral hammer grip on a dip cage. It builds the lats and arms with extra load.

name: 负重窄握反手引体向上(双杠架)
english: weighted close grip chin-up on dip cage
instructions: 站在俯卧撑前面，用反握抓住双杠，双手与肩同宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，双脚离开地面，身体伸直。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
继续拉，直到下巴高于杠铃，然后暂停片刻。
慢慢地将身体放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A weighted close-grip chin-up on a dip cage. Builds the lats, biceps and upper back.

name: 深蹲灵活性练习
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width.
Sink into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows gently against your knees.
Rock side to side and sit tall.
Spend 30-45 seconds there, then stand up.
description: A deep squat hold and rock that opens the hips and ankles.

name: 深蹲灵活性组合练习
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width and toes turned out slightly.
Sink into a deep squat and keep your heels on the floor.
Press your elbows against your knees to open the hips and hold for a moment.
Shift gently from side to side, then rock forward and back.
Stand up tall and repeat the flow for 6-8 rounds.
Keep your chest lifted and your back long throughout.
description: A short flow of deep squat positions that opens up the hips, knees and ankles. Good as a warm-up before leg work.

name: 杠铃行走小腿激活
instructions: Rest a light barbell across your upper back and hold it with both hands.
Stand tall with your core braced and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Walk forward in small, controlled steps without letting your heels drop.
Keep your ankles steady and your hips level.
Walk 10-15 metres, rest, then repeat for a few rounds.
Use a light load so you can stay high on your toes.
description: Walking on the balls of your feet with a barbell on your back to wake up the calves before heavy lower body training.

name: 滚球坐姿单腿肩部屈伸收缩
english: rollball seated single leg shoulder flexor depressor retractor
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball with your feet on the floor.
Lift one foot slightly off the ground and hold your balance.
Raise your arms forward, then press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades back and together without arching your back.
Return slowly to the start and complete your reps.
Switch legs and repeat on the other side.
description: A seated shoulder control drill on a ball with one leg lifted. It challenges balance while you raise, lower and pull back the shoulder blades.

name: 杠铃小腿自我按摩
instructions: Sit on the floor with one calf resting on a barbell.
Support yourself with your hands behind you.
Roll your calf slowly back and forth over the bar.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths.
Switch to the other leg.
description: A self-massage for the calves using a barbell to roll over tight spots.

name: 壶铃高脚杯深蹲灵活性练习
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns against your chest.
Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes slightly out.
Squat down as deep as you comfortably can with your chest up.
Use your elbows to push your knees out and pause at the bottom.
Rock gently side to side to open the hips.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
description: A goblet squat held low with a kettlebell as a counterweight, used to loosen the hips and ankles.

name: 小腿前侧自我泡沫轴放松
instructions: Kneel on a mat with the foam roller under your shins.
Support yourself with your hands in front.
Shift your weight to roll along the front of your lower leg.
Move slowly and pause on tight spots.
Roll for 30-60 seconds per leg.
description: A foam roller technique for the front of the lower leg that eases tightness.

name: 弹力带单臂肩上推举
instructions: Stand on the band with your feet hip width apart and hold the other end at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the hand straight overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower under control back to your shoulder.
Complete your reps without leaning sideways.
Switch arms and repeat.
description: A one-arm overhead press against a band. It trains the shoulders and makes your core resist twisting.

name: 弹力带辅助引体向上 v. 3
instructions: Loop a band over the pull-up bar and place a foot or knee in it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Hang with your arms long and your shoulders engaged.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Use a thinner band as you get stronger.
description: A pull-up where a band under your foot or knee takes some of your weight, so you can build up to full reps.

name: 坐姿踝部拉伸
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you so the top of the foot lengthens.
Slowly circle or press the foot until you feel a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
Release and switch legs.
Repeat 2-3 times on each side.
description: A gentle seated stretch for the front of the ankle and shin that eases stiffness after sitting or training.

name: 弹力带站姿后侧跟腱拉伸
english: resistance band standing back achilles stretch
instructions: Loop a resistance band around the front of the foot of your back leg.
Hold the band ends in your hands and stand tall.
Step that leg back with the heel on the floor.
Pull the band gently so your toes move toward your shin.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your back leg fairly straight.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: A calf and Achilles stretch with a band that gently pulls the toes toward you while the leg is behind you.

name: 弹力带站姿前侧跟腱拉伸
english: resistance band standing forward achilles stretch
instructions: Loop a resistance band around the ball of your front foot.
Hold the band ends and stand tall.
Place the front heel on the floor with the toes lifted.
Pull the band so your toes draw toward you and lean slightly forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with a comfortable stretch.
Switch feet and repeat.
description: A standing calf stretch with a band around the forward foot, pulling the toes back to lengthen the Achilles area.

name: 深蹲膝盖位置
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Brace your core and lift your chest.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower into a squat.
Push your knees out so they follow the line of your toes.
Go down as deep as feels controlled.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.
description: A bodyweight squat focused on where your knees travel, helping you learn to track them over your toes.

name: 单臂俯卧撑(跪姿)
instructions: Kneel and place one hand under your shoulder, with the other arm behind your back.
Spread your knees a bit wider for balance.
Keep a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Press back up without twisting your hips.
Switch arms and repeat.
description: A one-arm push-up from the knees, a stepping stone toward the full single-arm version. It builds chest and trunk strength.

name: 快走
instructions: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Start walking at a pace faster than a stroll.
Swing your arms naturally with elbows bent.
Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
Keep breathing steadily and stay able to talk.
Walk for 20-45 minutes.
description: A fast-paced walk that lifts your heart rate without the impact of running. Easy on the joints and good for steady fitness.

name: 弹力带坐姿髋外展
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
将阻力带缠绕在大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
将双手放在椅子或长凳的两侧以获得支撑。
启动外展肌（大腿外侧肌肉），并克服弹力带的阻力，慢慢将膝盖分开。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢将膝盖放回一起。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated hip abduction pushing your knees apart against a resistance band. Works the outer hips and glutes.

name: 弹力带腿屈伸
instructions: 将阻力带固定在坚固的锚点上，并将其固定在脚踝上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
保持核心参与并保持上半身稳定，将腿伸直到身前。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。
description: A leg extension with a resistance band around your ankle. Builds the quads.

name: 上楼梯
instructions: Stand at the bottom of a staircase, standing tall.
Step up with one foot, placing your whole foot on the step.
Press through your heel and bring the other foot up.
Keep your torso upright and swing your arms naturally.
Continue at a steady pace and alternate the leading leg.
description: Stepping up stairs at a steady pace to train the legs and raise your heart rate.

name: EZ杠仰卧屈臂上拉
english: ez bar lying bent arms pullover
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，头放在一端，双脚放在地板上。
旋前握住 EZ 杠铃（手掌背向您），双手与肩同宽。
将手臂伸直至胸部上方，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
以弧线动作将杠铃降低到头后，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后通过反向弧线运动将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A lying EZ bar pullover with slightly bent arms. Works the lats and chest.

name: 上斜肩胛俯卧撑
instructions: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
将双手放在长凳上，距离略比肩宽。
将双脚放在地面上，距离与臀部同宽。
将胸部向长凳方向降低，保持肘部内收。
当你降低时，缩回肩胛骨，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An incline push-up where you retract your shoulder blades. Strengthens the serratus anterior and upper back.

name: 肩胛臂屈伸
instructions: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂在身前伸展。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
弯曲肘部并缩回肩胛骨来降低身体，就像你试图在它们之间挤一支铅笔一样。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力，伸展肘部，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A scapular dip, moving the shoulder blades while your arms stay straight. Strengthens the traps and shoulder stabilisers.

name: 地面低位臀桥
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂放在身体两侧，手掌朝下。
启动臀肌和核心肌群，然后将臀部抬离地面，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压臀部。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A low glute bridge on the floor, lifting your hips. Works the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 卷腹起身
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A curl-up lifting your shoulders off the floor. Works the abs.

name: 杠铃潘德勒划船
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃拉向上腹部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将杠铃降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A pendlay row from the floor, pulling the barbell to your upper abdomen. Builds the upper back and lats.

name: 站姿提踵
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Hold a wall for balance if needed.
description: A bodyweight calf raise that builds lower-leg strength and ankle stability.

name: 凳上引体向上
instructions: 将自己置于与胸部同高的横杆或坚固的水平表面下方。
正手握住杠铃或杠铃表面，握距略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
将肩胛骨挤压在一起并弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向杠铃或地面。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杆或表面上方。
有控制地降低自己回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight bench pull-up variation hanging beneath a bar. Works the lats and biceps.

name: 肩胛俯卧撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
将胸部压向地面，保持肘部靠近身体。
当你下降时，将肩胛骨挤压在一起并将胸部向前推。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A scapular push-up, protracting and retracting the shoulder blades. Strengthens the serratus anterior and upper back.

name: 弹力带仰卧髋内旋 v. 2
english: band lying hip internal rotation v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with a band around your lower leg anchored to the side.
Bend your knees with your feet on the floor.
Rotate your lower leg outward against the band, turning the hip inward.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps and switch legs.
description: Lying hip internal rotation against a band to build control through the hip.

name: 杠铃分腿蹲
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step one foot forward.
Stand with a long stride and your torso upright.
Bend both knees and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front heel down and your front knee over your foot.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A split-stance squat with a barbell on your back. It works each leg on its own and builds strength and balance.

name: 屈腿后踢(跪姿)
instructions: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent at 90 degrees.
Push the sole of your foot toward the ceiling and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: From all fours, you drive one bent knee up toward the ceiling. It targets the glutes without any equipment.

name: 屈腿侧踢(跪姿)
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Keep your knee bent at about 90 degrees.
Lift the bent leg out to the side to hip height.
Squeeze your outer hip at the top without rotating your torso.
Lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: From all fours, you lift one bent leg out to the side. It works the outer hip and glutes.

name: 后踢腿跑
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Jog on the spot or move forward slowly.
Kick each heel up toward your glute.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your knees pointing down.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.
description: A running drill where your heels flick up toward your glutes. It warms up the hamstrings and raises your heart rate.

name: 龙门架直杆高位头上三头肌伸展
english: cable bar high pulley overhead tricep extension
instructions: Attach a bar to a high pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows pointing forward.
Step forward and stagger your feet.
Extend your arms to press the bar overhead.
Lower slowly back and keep your elbows in place.
description: A cable overhead extension from a high pulley that isolates the triceps.

name: 龙门架髋外展 v. 2
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to your outer ankle.
Stand sideways to the machine and hold a support.
Keep your torso upright and your standing leg slightly bent.
Lift the cuffed leg out to the side.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.
description: Standing hip abduction against a low cable that trains the outer hip and glutes.

name: 龙门架站姿二头弯举(绳索)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold an end in each hand.
Stand tall with elbows by your sides.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower under control without swinging.
description: A standing cable curl with a rope for constant tension on the biceps.

name: 哑铃窄握推举 v. 2
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand pressed together over your chest.
Keep your palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells to your chest with your elbows tucked.
Press back up while keeping the weights touching.
Keep your wrists straight.
description: A press with dumbbells held close together that shifts the work toward the triceps and inner chest.

name: 哑铃坐姿弯举 v. 2
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang by your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top and keep elbows pinned.
Lower slowly to full extension.
description: A seated curl that keeps the body steady while the biceps do the work.

name: 哑铃单臂牧师椅弯举
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arm on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until nearly straight, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm curl braced on a preacher pad for strict biceps isolation.

name: 肘触膝扭转
instructions: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee up and across your body.
Twist your torso to meet the knee with the opposite elbow.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your chest lifted and breathe evenly.
description: A standing move where you twist to bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It raises your pulse and works the sides of your waist.

name: 蛙跳
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and sink into a deep squat.
Place your fingertips on the floor between your feet.
Jump forward and up, swinging your arms.
Land softly back in the squat.
Reset and hop again right away.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
description: Explosive hops from a deep squat, like a frog. They build leg power and get your heart pumping.

name: 高抬腿跳步
instructions: Stand tall and relaxed.
Skip forward, driving one knee up high.
Hop lightly on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each knee.
Alternate legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your chest up and land softly.
description: A bouncy skip with high knee lifts. It warms up the legs and raises your heart rate.

name: 高抬膝深蹲
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet to stand.
Lift one knee toward your chest as you reach the top.
Lower the foot and go back into the squat.
Alternate knees on each rep.
description: A squat followed by a high knee drive as you stand. It combines leg strength with a cardio push.

name: 开合跳
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet apart as you swing your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start position.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.
description: The classic jump where your arms and legs swing out and back. A simple full-body warm-up that raises your heart rate fast.

name: 侧向跳跃
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Push off hard to leap sideways.
Land on the opposite foot and bend to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second to stay balanced.
Bound back the other way.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your toes.
description: A sideways leap from one leg to the other. It builds lateral power and balance.

name: 杠杆交替窄握坐姿划船(挂片式)
english: lever alternating narrow grip seated row (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the narrow handles.
Pull one handle back, driving your elbow behind you.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly and pull with the other arm.
Alternate sides and keep your torso still.
description: A plate-loaded seated row with a narrow grip, one arm at a time for balanced back strength.

name: 杠杆窄握坐姿划船(挂片式)
english: lever narrow grip seated row (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit with your chest against the pad and take the narrow handles.
Pull both handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly with control.
description: A plate-loaded machine row with a narrow grip for the lats and mid back.

name: 增强式开合跳
instructions: Stand with your feet together.
Jump your feet wide and land in a quarter squat.
Swing your arms out as you land.
Jump your feet back together.
Land softly each time.
Keep a quick, controlled pace.
description: A jumping jack with a squat landing. The extra depth makes it harder on the legs and your heart.

name: 滑冰步
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Leap sideways to the other leg.
Land softly and sweep the back leg behind you.
Swing your arms across your body for balance.
Immediately bound back the other way.
Keep your hips low and your chest forward.
description: A side-to-side leap like a speed skater. It trains leg power, balance and stamina.

name: 史密斯机臀推
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Pad the bar and roll it into the crease of your hips.
Plant your feet hip width apart and unrack the bar.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A hip thrust with the bar on a Smith machine, giving a steady path to load the glutes.

name: 分腿开合跳
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Jump one foot forward and the other back as you swing opposite arms.
Land softly with soft knees.
Jump again and switch legs.
Keep your torso upright.
Continue at a steady pace for 30-45 seconds.
description: A jumping move where your legs split front and back while your arms swing. It's a light, fast cardio burst.

name: 直腿后踢(跪姿)
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Extend one leg straight back.
Lift it to hip height and squeeze your glute.
Lower without letting your back arch.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: From all fours, you extend one straight leg back and up. It isolates the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 弹力带固定背后反握下拉
instructions: 将带子固定在头顶上方坚固的锚点上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
反手握住弹力带，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
后退一步，在弹力带上产生张力，保持手臂完全伸展。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将弹力带向下拉向胸部，用肘部引导。
在动作的底部暂停片刻，感受背阔肌的收缩。
慢慢释放带子的张力并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A band pulldown with an underhand grip from an overhead anchor. Builds the lats and biceps.

name: 弹力带固定背后窄握下拉
english: band fixed back close grip pulldown
instructions: 将弹力带固定在您上方的固定点上，例如上拉杆或坚固的横梁。
坐在面向乐队的长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
紧紧握住弹力带，手掌朝向您。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将弹力带向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的底部暂停片刻，感受背阔肌的收缩。
慢慢地将弹力带释放回起始位置，在整个运动过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A band pulldown with a close grip from an overhead anchor. Builds the lats and biceps.

name: 便盆式深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低身体，就像坐在椅子上一样。
在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低自己，直到大腿与地面平行或尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight squat done as a deep, comfortable squat. Works the legs, glutes and core.

name: 扶持站姿提踵
instructions: Stand holding a wall or rail for balance.
Place your feet hip-width apart.
Rise up on your toes as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower slowly.
description: A calf raise holding on for balance, so you can focus on the calves.

name: 弹力带坐姿挺背划船
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and a band around your feet.
Hold the ends with your arms straight.
Sit tall with a flat back.
Pull the band toward your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
description: A seated row with a band and a straight back that trains the lats and mid back.

name: 弹力带坐姿肩上推举
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
双手握住阻力带，手掌朝前，将其拉至肩部水平。
将弹力带压过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将弹力带降低至肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated shoulder press using a resistance band. Builds the shoulders and triceps.

name: 弹力带坐姿二头弯举
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
反手握住阻力带，手掌朝上，手臂向下伸展到身体两侧。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将阻力带向上卷向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢降低阻力带回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated biceps curl using a resistance band. Builds the biceps.

name: 弹力带坐姿胸推
instructions: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
每只手握住阻力带手柄，手掌朝下，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
向前伸展双臂，将阻力带推离胸部。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated chest press using a resistance band. Builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: 弹力带足外旋
instructions: Sit with one leg out and a band looped around the forefoot.
Anchor the other end to a fixed point on the inside.
Keep your heel still on the floor.
Turn your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.
description: A seated ankle drill where you turn the foot outward against a band. It strengthens the outer ankle muscles.

name: 弹力带足跖屈
instructions: Sit with your leg straight and a band looped around the ball of your foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Point your toes away from you against the band.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.
description: Pointing the foot against a band to strengthen the calf and ankle.

name: 弹力带足外翻
instructions: Sit with your leg extended and a band around your forefoot.
Anchor the band on the inside of your foot.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.
description: Turning the sole of the foot outward against a band to train the muscles on the outer side of the ankle.

name: 弹力带足内翻
instructions: Sit with your leg extended and a band around your forefoot.
Anchor the band on the outside of your foot.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot inward against the band.
Return slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch feet.
description: Turning the sole of the foot inward against a band to train the muscles on the inner side of the ankle.

name: 肩胛后缩前伸
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your arms forward at shoulder height.
Pull your shoulder blades together behind you.
Hold for a moment.
Then push your hands forward and let the blades spread apart.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Keep your neck relaxed and your ribs down.
description: A shoulder blade drill where you pull the blades together and then spread them apart. It improves control of the scapulae.

name: 肩胛上提下沉
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your arms at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Hold for a second.
Press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Move slowly through the full range.
Keep your arms relaxed and your head still.
description: A drill where you shrug your shoulders up and then press them down. It builds control of the shoulder blades.

name: 扶持便盆式深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
抓住稳定的支撑物，例如椅子或墙壁，以保持平衡。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
在整个动作过程中保持挺胸、背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A deep squat done holding a support for balance. Works the glutes and legs.

name: 鸟狗式 v. 2
instructions: Start on all fours with a neutral spine.
Extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching your back.
Pause for a moment.
Return and switch sides.
description: A floor stability move reaching opposite arm and leg to train the back and core.

name: 史密斯机相扑深蹲
instructions: 将杠铃置于臀部高度的史密斯机上。
站立，双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾朝外。
将自己置于杠铃下方，将其放在上背部和肩膀上。
当你将身体降低到蹲姿时，收紧核心并保持挺胸，将臀部向后推并弯曲膝盖。
放低身体，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低到您能舒服的高度。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A sumo squat on a smith machine. Targets the glutes, inner thighs and quads.

name: 弹力带坐姿挺背划船
english: resistance band seated straight back row
instructions: 坐在地板上，双腿伸展，将阻力带绕在脚上。
双手握住阻力带的两端，手掌相对。
保持背部挺直，稍微向后倾斜，锻炼核心肌群。
将阻力带拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated straight-back row using a resistance band. Builds the upper back and lats.

name: 加强俯卧撑
instructions: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
一旦你的胸部刚好高于地面，用力推动你的手臂，伸展你的手臂并抬起你的上半身。
在动作的最高点，将上背部推向天花板，从而伸展肩胛骨。
暂停片刻，然后通过缩回肩胛骨并将身体放回起始位置来反转动作。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A push-up finished with an extra shove that spreads the shoulder blades at the top. It trains the chest and the serratus muscles that stabilise the shoulder blades.

name: 骨盆后倾
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧。
收紧腹肌，向上倾斜骨盆，将下背部压入地面。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，专注于收缩腹肌。
释放倾斜并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A small rocking movement of the pelvis while lying on your back. It wakes up the abs and teaches you to control the position of your lower back.

name: 收下巴
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place a finger on your chin if it helps.
Draw your chin straight back as if making a double chin.
Keep your head level without tilting.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.
description: Drawing your chin straight back to line up your head over your shoulders. It's a simple neck posture exercise.

name: 辅助收下巴
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your eyes level.
Place two fingers on your chin.
Gently guide your chin straight back.
Keep your head level and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 3-5 seconds.
Release and repeat 8-10 times.
description: A chin tuck with light help from your hand to guide the movement and feel the right position.

name: 侧踢波比跳
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Drop your hands to the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up, then jump your feet back in.
Stand up and kick one leg out to the side.
Land and go straight into the next rep.
Alternate kicking sides.
description: A burpee that finishes with a side kick. It's a tough full-body conditioning move.

name: 自重站姿窄握单臂划船
english: bodyweight standing close-grip one arm row
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，一只手握住哑铃，握姿中立。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将哑铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A standing, bent-over one arm row with a close grip, working the muscles between and around the shoulder blades. A light handheld weight keeps the pull honest.

name: 自重站姿窄握划船
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将双臂伸直在身前，紧紧抓住杆或手柄。
将杠铃或手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bent-over standing row with a close grip, pulling the hands toward your body. It builds the upper back and the muscles that squeeze the shoulder blades together.

name: 自重站姿单臂划船(用毛巾)
english: bodyweight standing one arm row (with towel)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖微曲，单手握住毛巾。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将毛巾放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。
description: A standing one arm row using a towel as the handle, pulled toward the chest. It trains the upper back with very little equipment.

name: 自重站姿单臂划船
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，一手握住哑铃。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
让哑铃垂直悬挂在您面前，手臂完全伸展。
将哑铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A standing one arm row from a hip hinge, pulling a weight toward your chest one side at a time. Good for the upper back and lats.

name: 自重站姿划船(用毛巾)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住毛巾放在身前。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing row done with both hands on a towel, pulling toward your chest. It trains the upper back and shoulder blade squeeze with no gear.

name: 自重站姿划船
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杆或手柄，手掌朝下。
保持背部挺直，核心参与。
将杠铃或手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻。
慢慢释放并伸展双臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing, bent-over row pulling a bar or handles toward your body with an overhand grip. It builds the upper back and the muscles that retract the shoulder blades.

name: 自重蹲姿划船(用毛巾)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，手掌朝下，将毛巾放在身前。
弯曲膝盖，将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
当你下蹲时，同时将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在深蹲底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置，同时伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A squat combined with a towel row, so legs and upper back work together. You pull the towel toward your chest as you sink down.

name: 自重蹲姿划船
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，伸直手臂抓住坚固的物体或悬挂训练器。
将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直，膝盖位于脚趾后面。
从蹲姿开始，将身体向上拉向物体或悬挂训练器，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A squat paired with a pulling motion on a sturdy anchor or suspension trainer. It trains the legs and upper back in one flowing movement.

name: 拳击右勾拳
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your hands up.
Bend your right elbow to about 90 degrees.
Pivot on your back foot and rotate your hips and torso.
Swing your fist in an arc to your target.
Snap back to guard position.
Keep your chin tucked and your left hand up.
description: A right-handed hook punch thrown in a boxing stance. It trains rotation and power from the hips.

name: 杠铃卧推(膝盖成90度)
instructions: Lie on a bench and lift your feet with your knees bent to 90 degrees.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Unrack and hold it over your chest.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with control.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.
description: A bench press with your feet up and your knees bent to 90 degrees. This keeps your lower back flat and your trunk working.

name: 哑铃飞鸟(膝盖成90度)
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lift your feet so your knees are bent to 90 degrees.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out wide until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.
Move slowly and keep your back flat.
description: A dumbbell fly with your feet lifted and knees at 90 degrees. It stretches the chest and keeps your back flat.

name: 哑铃直臂上拉(膝盖成90度)
english: dumbbell straight arm pullover (knees at 90 degrees)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your feet up and knees at 90 degrees.
Hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your ribs down and your back flat.
description: A straight-arm pullover with knees bent to 90 degrees on a bench. It works the chest and lats and keeps the trunk braced.

name: 稳定球反向背伸(凳上)
english: stability ball reverse hyperextension (off a bench)
instructions: Lie face down with your hips over the ball and hands on the floor.
Hold the bench or the ball for stability.
Lift your legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.
description: A reverse hyperextension over a ball at the edge of a bench for glutes and lower back.

name: 上斜反向背伸
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with hips at the edge.
Hold the sides of the bench.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A reverse hyperextension on an incline bench that trains the glutes and lower back.

name: 自重蛙式臀推
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped open.
Bring your heels close to your hips.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower and repeat in quick pumps.
description: A glute bridge with the soles of your feet together, taking glute work to the next level.

name: 负重蛙式臀推
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees open.
Rest a weight on your hips.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower and repeat.
description: A frog-style glute bridge with extra weight on your hips for stronger glutes.

name: 杠铃悬垂高翻(膝下) v. 2
english: barbell hang clean below the knees v. 2
instructions: Stand with the bar hanging below your knees in an overhand grip.
Hinge back with a flat back and shoulders over the bar.
Drive your hips forward and jump explosively.
Shrug and pull your elbows high.
Drop under the bar and catch it on your shoulders.
Stand tall, then lower the bar under control.
description: A clean started with the bar hanging below the knees. It builds explosive hip power.

name: 杠铃深蹲(悬挂弹力带技术)
instructions: Set up the bar with bands hanging kettlebells or weights from each end.
Rest the bar across your upper back and step out.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a braced core.
Drive up through your feet.
Use a lighter load and move slowly.
description: A barbell squat with bands hanging weights from the bar. The wobble forces you to stay stable.

name: 杠铃卧推(悬挂弹力带技术)
english: barbell bench press (with hanging band technique)
instructions: Hang weights from each end of the bar with bands.
Lie on the bench and unrack the bar.
Hold it over your chest.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid chest.
Press up and keep the bar steady.
Use a lighter load than a normal bench press.
description: A bench press with bands hanging weights from the bar. The shaky load trains control and stability.

name: 杠铃军事推举(悬挂弹力带技术)
english: barbell military press (with hanging band technique)
instructions: Hang weights from each end of the bar with bands.
Hold the bar at your shoulders and stand tall.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight overhead.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulders.
Use a lighter load and keep the bar steady.
description: An overhead press with bands hanging weights from the bar. The unstable load trains control in the shoulders.

name: 壶铃高脚杯深蹲跳
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and go into the next squat.
description: A goblet squat that finishes with an explosive jump for leg power.

name: 哑铃直臂上拉(悬挂弹力带技术)
english: dumbbell straight arm pullover (with hanging band technique)
instructions: Hang a weight from the dumbbell with a band.
Lie on a bench and hold it above your chest with straight arms.
Lower it in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest slowly.
Keep your ribs down and your core tight.
Use a light load to stay controlled.
description: A straight-arm pullover with weights hung from the dumbbell by a band. The swing makes your shoulders and trunk work harder.

name: 臀腿抬升
instructions: 调整臀肌提升机以适合您的身体。
将自己面朝下放在机器上，固定脚踝。
将双手放在胸前或交叉在胸前。
调动腿筋和臀肌，将上半身抬向天花板。
继续抬起，直到身体从头部到脚后跟成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A hamstring exercise where you lift your torso from a face-down position on a glute-ham bench. It strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.

name: 弗兰肯斯坦深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂伸直将杠铃举在身体前方。
保持背部挺直，弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A front-loaded barbell squat held out in front of the body with straight arms. It hits the glutes and quads and demands a tall, braced torso.

name: 杠杆仰卧双腿屈单腿还原腿弯举
instructions: 调整机器以适合您的身体，然后坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上。
将双腿放在脚踝上方的杠杆垫上。
抓住机器两侧的手柄以提供支撑。
保持上半身不动，呼气并将双腿向上弯曲至臀部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢降低双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A lying machine leg curl that starts with both legs and finishes with one. It targets the hamstrings with a controlled, heavier lowering phase.

name: 快速小步跑
instructions: Stand tall with your knees slightly bent.
Run on the spot as fast as you can with small steps.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms.
Keep your chest up.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.
description: Running on the spot with very fast, small steps. It's a classic warm-up and speed drill.

name: 高抬腿踏步跑
instructions: Stand tall and relaxed.
Move forward in a bouncy trot.
Lift each knee up with a springy step.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Swing your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.
description: A light, springy trot with high knees, like a pony. It's a fun cardio warm-up.

name: 之字形跳
instructions: Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Hop forward and to one side.
Land softly on both feet.
Hop forward and to the other side.
Keep your hops light and quick.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.
description: Hopping diagonally forward in a zigzag pattern. It trains agility and lower leg power.

name: 跳步
instructions: Stand tall and relaxed.
Step forward and hop on the same foot.
Switch and hop on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each step.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.
description: A simple skipping step with a hop on each foot. A playful way to warm up and lift your heart rate.

name: 杠杆俯身V型把手划船
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己面向机器。
正手握住 V 形杆，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将 V 形杆拉向腹部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢释放重量回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A machine row done in a bent-over stance with a v-bar handle. It builds the upper back and lats by pulling the handle toward your abdomen.

name: 四分之一仰卧起坐
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A short-range sit-up where you curl only partway up. It keeps tension on the abs and is easier on the lower back than a full sit-up.

name: 半程仰卧起坐(男)
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A sit-up that stops at roughly half height, keeping constant tension on the abs. A gentle way to train the midsection.

name: 抱头半程仰卧起坐(男)
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A half sit-up with the hands held behind the head, like a prisoner. It trains the abs through a short, controlled range.

name: 双臂过头全程仰卧起坐(男)
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂伸过头顶，保持伸直。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲直到躯干直立。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A full sit-up with the arms stretched overhead, which makes the lever longer and the move harder. It trains the abs and hip flexors.

name: 跪姿俯卧撑(男)
instructions: 首先跪在地上，双手与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，使身体从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，保持核心靠近身体两侧，将身体压向地面。
继续降低，直到胸部刚好高于地面，然后伸直手臂，将其推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A beginner-friendly push-up with the knees on the floor. It builds chest, shoulder and triceps strength with less load than a standard push-up.

name: 基础触脚尖(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸向脚趾，尽可能保持双腿伸直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A simple standing forward fold to reach your toes. It loosens the hamstrings and lower back and gets the hips moving.

name: 左右触脚尖(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向右弯曲，将右手伸向右脚，同时保持左手向一侧延伸。
返回起始位置，然后腰部向左弯曲，将左手伸向左脚，同时保持右手向侧面延伸。
重复左右弯曲动作达到所需的重复次数。
description: A standing side bend where each hand slides down toward the same-side foot in turn. It mobilises the trunk and trains the obliques.

name: 双臂展开绕圈触脚尖(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
保持双腿伸直，腰部向前弯曲，右手向下伸向脚趾。
当你向下伸展时，同时将左腿在身后伸直，保持平衡。
返回起始位置，重复该动作，左手伸向脚趾，右腿在身后抬起。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A standing toe touch with a circular path and a leg lifting behind you. It loosens the hamstrings and challenges balance.

name: 反手交扣绕圈触脚尖(男)
english: hands reversed clasped circular toe touch (male)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸，并在腿后将它们握在一起。
慢慢地将双手举过头顶，做圆周运动，保持双腿伸直。
继续圆周运动，直到双手触及脚趾。
反转动作并将双手放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A toe touch with the hands clasped in reverse and moved in a circle. It opens the hamstrings and back while warming up the hips.

name: 击胸俯卧撑(男)
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
当你降低身体时，用右手拍打胸部。
将自己推回到起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次用左手敲击胸部。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A push-up where one hand taps the chest at the bottom of each rep, alternating sides. It adds a stability challenge to the chest and triceps.

name: 改良印度式俯卧撑(男)
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将身体向地面降低，弯曲肘部并保持核心参与。
当你降低身体时，将你的重心向后转移，并将臀部向上抬向天花板，与你的身体形成一个倒V形。
继续降低身体，直到胸部刚好高于地面，然后反向运动，将臀部向下推，并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A modified hindu push-up that flows from a pike through a low dive to a lifted chest. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps while opening up the spine.

name: 双手交扣绕圈触脚尖(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手合十放在胸前。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将双手向脚趾方向以打圈的方式降低，尽量伸得尽可能远，但不要用力。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing toe touch with the hands clasped and moved in a circular path. It stretches the hamstrings and warms up the hips and back.

name: 剪刀跳(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
跳离地面，同时将右腿交叉到左腿前面。
落地时，快速换腿，将左腿交叉在右腿前面。
继续交替双腿并尽可能快地跳跃。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A quick jumping drill where the legs cross in front of each other in the air. It raises your heart rate and builds light, springy legs.

name: 跨步跳(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性向上跳跃，伸展双腿和手臂。
在空中时，将双腿分开，并将双臂向两侧伸出。
双脚分开与肩同宽，轻轻落地，弯曲膝盖以吸收冲击力。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A jump from a squat that ends with the legs spread wide, like a jumping jack with a squat start. It raises the heart rate and trains the legs.

name: 半蹲(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
保持挺胸，将体重放在脚后跟上。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A shallow squat that bends the knees only partway. It is a gentle leg exercise good for warming up or high rep sets.

name: 半蹲跳(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性跳跃，伸展臀部和膝盖，同时摆动手臂以获得动力。
脚掌轻轻落地，然后立即进入下一个重复动作。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A shallow squat followed by a jump, with the arms swinging for momentum. It trains the leg power and gets the heart rate up.

name: 星形跳(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
稍微弯曲膝盖并爆发性地跳起来。
跳跃时，张开双腿，将手臂向两侧伸展，与身体形成星形。
膝盖轻轻弯曲，脚掌轻轻着地。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A jump where arms and legs spread wide like a star at the top. It is a full-body cardio move that raises your pulse fast.

name: 开合跳(男)
instructions: 双脚并拢站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
跳起来，分开双脚，将手臂举过头顶。
当你落地时，迅速跳回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A jumping jack, hopping the feet apart while the arms go overhead and back again. A classic warm-up and cardio move.

name: 地面T字上举
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor.
Turn your thumbs up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms.
Pause for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: Lying face down, you lift your arms out to the sides into a T. It strengthens the mid and upper back.

name: 俯卧眼镜蛇式掌心置于大腿下
instructions: Lie face down with your palms under your thighs.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the ground using your back muscles.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.
description: A face-down hold where you lift your chest with your palms tucked under your thighs. It builds lower back and upper back endurance.

name: 游泳打腿
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, fast alternations.
Keep your neck long.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.
description: Lying face down, you flutter your legs like a swimmer. It works the lower back and glutes.

name: 俯卧背伸
instructions: Lie face down with your hands beside your head.
Keep your legs straight and your feet on the floor.
Lift your chest using your lower back.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
description: A face-down lift of your chest off the floor. It strengthens the lower back muscles.

name: 俯卧背伸并推起
instructions: Lie face down with your hands near your shoulders.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Press your arms forward in front of you.
Pull them back to your shoulders.
Lower your chest slowly.
Keep your neck long throughout.
description: A lying back extension where you also press your arms forward at the top. It adds shoulder work to a back extension.

name: 俯卧眼镜蛇式双手交扣
instructions: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your lower back.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Reach your hands toward your feet.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.
description: A face-down hold with your hands clasped behind you. It trains the back extensors and opens the chest.

name: 双脚触脚尖(男)
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手向下伸向脚趾，保持双腿伸直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing forward bend reaching both hands toward the toes. It loosens the hamstrings and lower back.

name: 龙门架站姿后三角肌水平划船(绳索)
english: cable standing rear delt horizontal row (with rope)
instructions: Attach a rope to a cable at chest height.
Hold the ends and step back.
Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Pull the rope toward your face with your elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your rear shoulders.
Return slowly.
description: A standing cable row with a rope that pulls the elbows wide. It targets the rear delts.

name: 龙门架坐姿反握划船
instructions: Sit at a cable row with your feet braced.
Grip the handle with your palms facing up.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly without rounding your back.
description: A seated cable row with an underhand grip that brings the biceps and lats into play.

name: 海特哑铃飞鸟
instructions: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，肘部稍微弯曲。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，以宽弧线将哑铃向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后反转动作，将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A flat-bench dumbbell fly done with a wide arc and a stretch across the chest. It isolates the pecs.

name: 龙门架辅助反向腿弯举
instructions: 调整缆绳机，使脚踝附件处于最低设置。
面朝下躺在长凳上，双腿伸直，将脚踝固定装置固定在脚踝上。
握住长凳的把手以保持稳定。
保持上半身静止，呼气，弯曲膝盖，将双腿向臀肌方向卷起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的腿筋。
吸气并慢慢降低双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A cable-resisted leg curl from a face-down position. It isolates the hamstrings with smooth, constant tension.

name: 弹力带跪姿臀推(女)
english: resistance band hip thrusts on knees (female)
instructions: 首先跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽，双脚弯曲。
将阻力带缠绕在大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
将双手放在臀部或向前伸展以保持平衡。
调动你的臀肌和核心肌肉。
当你将膝盖抬离地面时，向前推动臀部并挤压臀部，伸展臀部直到大腿与地面平行。
保持该姿势片刻，然后慢慢将膝盖放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A kneeling hip thrust against a resistance band around the thighs. It trains the glutes with a hip extension.

name: 地雷杆侧平举
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，将其放在肩膀前面。
保持核心收紧并保持背部挺直，将杠铃向上举起并远离身体，将其提升至肩膀高度。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A raise done with a barbell anchored in a landmine setup, lifting out and up to shoulder height. It works the shoulders with a smooth arc.

name: 跪姿平板支撑
instructions: Kneel and place your forearms on the floor under your shoulders.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line from your knees to your head.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower and rest.
description: A plank held on the knees. It's an easier version that builds core strength.

name: 跪姿平板支撑拍肩(男)
instructions: 从跪姿开始，双手放在地上，与肩同宽。
