将双腿伸到身后，用脚趾支撑，将身体抬起成平板支撑姿势。
保持核心参与并保持臀部稳定，将一只手抬离地面并拍打另一侧的肩膀。
将手放回地面并用另一只手重复此操作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A kneeling plank where you tap the opposite shoulder with one hand at a time. It trains the abs and shoulder stability.

name: 健身球靠墙提踵(两膝间夹网球)
english: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between knees)
instructions: 背靠墙站立，将健身球放在下背部和墙壁之间。
将双脚分开与肩同宽，并稍微位于您的前方。
每只手握住一个哑铃，双臂伸向身体两侧。
将网球放在膝盖之间。
将脚后跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing calf raise with your back on an exercise ball against a wall, dumbbells in hand, and a ball squeezed between the knees. It trains the calves and inner thighs.

name: 健身球靠墙提踵(两踝间夹网球)
english: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between ankles)
instructions: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
在墙壁和下背部之间放置一个健身球。
每只手握住一个哑铃，双臂伸向身体两侧。
将网球放在脚踝之间。
将脚后跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚趾上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing calf raise with your back on an exercise ball against a wall, dumbbells in hand, and a ball squeezed between the ankles. It trains the calves.

name: 仰卧下背拉伸(屈膝)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your lower back relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.
description: A gentle lying stretch that draws the knee toward your chest to ease the lower back.

name: 仰卧下背拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back.
Pull both knees toward your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
description: A lying stretch hugging both knees toward your chest to release the lower back.

name: 腹部拉伸
instructions: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press up, lifting your chest.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Look straight ahead and relax.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
description: A stretch lengthening the front of the trunk and the abs.

name: 脚和踝部左右拉伸
english: feet and ankles side to side stretch
instructions: Sit with your legs extended.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Roll your feet slowly to the outside.
Then roll them inward.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.
description: A seated stretch moving the feet side to side to loosen the ankles.

name: 前触脚尖
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward and reach toward your toes.
Let your head hang relaxed.
Rise slowly.
Repeat at a steady pace.
description: A standing movement reaching down to touch your toes for a warm-up of the hamstrings and back.

name: 双手前触脚尖
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart.
Hinge forward with both arms reaching down.
Touch the floor or your toes.
Rise slowly.
Repeat for the set.
description: A wider standing toe touch that reaches down with both hands to warm up the legs and back.

name: 侧触脚尖
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Keep your other arm extended behind you.
Rise and switch sides.
Alternate at an easy pace.
description: A standing toe touch with a sideways reach to warm up the obliques and hamstrings.

name: 侧向双手前触脚尖
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart.
Turn your torso slightly to one side.
Reach both hands to the foot on that side.
Rise, then turn to the other side.
Repeat at a steady pace.
description: A wide-stance toe touch reaching both hands toward one side to loosen the trunk and legs.

name: 站姿侧弯
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead.
Bend sideways, reaching over to the other side.
Return to upright.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: A standing side bend that loosens the trunk and works the obliques.

name: 站姿双侧弯
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Clasp your hands overhead.
Bend to one side, keeping your hips still.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.
description: A standing side bend with both arms overhead for a longer reach through the trunk.

name: 站姿双侧弯(屈臂)
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with elbows out.
Bend to one side without twisting.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.
description: A standing side bend with your elbows bent that loosens the sides of the trunk.

name: 站姿单臂绕环
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm out to the side.
Make slow circles, gradually larger.
Reverse the direction.
Switch arms.
description: One-arm circles to warm up the shoulder joint.

name: 站姿双臂绕环
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend both arms out to the sides.
Make slow circles forward.
Then reverse direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
description: Big arm circles with both arms to warm up the shoulders.

name: 站姿交替单臂绕环
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms hanging at your sides.
Swing one arm forward, up and back in a large smooth circle.
As that arm finishes, start the same circle with the other arm.
Keep your ribs down and your neck relaxed.
Continue alternating for 20-30 seconds, then reverse the direction.
description: Big alternating arm circles that warm up the shoulder joints and loosen the upper back before pressing or pulling work.

name: 站姿甩臂
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out in front at chest height.
Fling both arms wide open to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Swing them back across your body, letting one arm cross over the other.
Keep the motion loose and controlled, without arching your back.
Repeat for 15-20 swings.
description: Open and close your arms in a relaxed fling to loosen the chest and shoulders. Handy as a quick warm-up.

name: 仰卧全程抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips or by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your legs straight and do not let your back arch.
description: Raise both straight legs from the floor to work the lower abs and hip flexors.

name: 侧平板支撑抬腿
instructions: Lie on your side and prop yourself up on one forearm with elbow under the shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise your top leg to about hip height, toes pointing forward.
Lower it a little without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: Hold a side plank and lift the top leg to work the outer hips and the side of your trunk.

name: 跪姿俯卧撑至婴儿式
english: kneeling push up to child pose
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to the start.
Push your hips back onto your heels and reach your arms forward into child pose.
Return to the start and repeat.
description: A knee push-up that ends by sitting your hips back into child pose, building the chest and giving the back a stretch.

name: 肘撑俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with body in a straight line.
Press up onto one hand, then the other, into a high plank.
Lower back down to your forearms one arm at a time.
Keep your hips steady and avoid rocking side to side.
Alternate which arm leads each rep.
description: Move between a forearm plank and a high plank, one arm at a time, to train the core and shoulders.

name: 仰卧侧向抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and legs raised straight up.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Lower both legs toward one side, stopping just above the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Repeat to the other side and keep alternating.
description: Lower your legs to the side from a raised position to hit the lower abs and obliques.

name: 跑跳结合
instructions: Stand tall with feet under your hips.
Run on the spot at a steady pace, pumping your arms.
Every few steps, hop off one foot and land softly.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds at a pace you can hold.
description: Run in place and add a hop to lift the heart rate and wake up the legs.

name: 跑步加开合跳
instructions: Stand tall and start jogging on the spot.
After a few steps, jump your feet wide while raising your arms overhead.
Jump your feet back together and lower the arms.
Resume running and repeat the pattern.
Keep your landings soft and keep going for 30-60 seconds.
description: Run in place and throw in a jumping jack every few steps for a full-body cardio burst.

name: 跑步加半蹲
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Jog on the spot for a few steps.
Pause into a shallow knee bend, hips back and chest up.
Stand tall and go straight back into running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.
description: Alternate running in place with a shallow knee bend to keep the heart rate up while the legs work.

name: 跑步加半蹲跳
instructions: Stand tall and run on the spot for a few steps.
Drop into a half squat with your chest up.
Jump up, swinging your arms.
Land softly with bent knees and go back to running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.
description: Combine running in place with a half squat jump for a cardio drill that also trains the legs.

name: 脚放凳上地面卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a bench, knees bent at about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by squeezing your abs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat without pulling on your neck.
description: A crunch with the calves resting on a bench, which keeps the hips bent and focuses the work on the abs.

name: 脚放凳上地面扭转卷腹
english: floor twisting crunch feet on bench
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up and rotate so one shoulder moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides on each rep.
description: A crunch with a rotation, with the legs on a bench, to train the abs and the obliques.

name: 史密斯机全蹲
instructions: 将杠铃置于肩高的史密斯机上。
站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
走到杠铃下方，将其放在上背部上方，放在斜方肌上。
双手握住杠铃，距离略大于肩宽。
松开杠铃并后退一步，保持稳定的姿势。
保持胸部挺直，核心参与，通过将臀部向后推并弯曲膝盖来开始深蹲。
降低你的身体，直到你的大腿与地面平行，或者在你的灵活性允许的范围内尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后用脚后跟恢复到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A full-depth back squat on the smith machine, where the fixed bar path gives extra stability. It trains the glutes, quads and thighs.

name: 负重脚放凳上地面卷腹
english: weighted floor crunch feet on bench
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abs.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A loaded crunch with the calves on a bench, for stronger abs once bodyweight crunches feel easy.

name: 负重脚放凳上地面扭转卷腹
english: weighted floor twisting crunch feet on bench
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a light weight against your chest with both hands.
Curl up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides each rep.
description: A loaded twisting crunch with the legs on a bench, building the abs and obliques.

name: 负重肌肉上拉
instructions: 首先悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
启动核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
当你到达动作的最高点时，改变你的握力，使你的手掌朝向你。
继续拉起自己，直到胸部到达杠铃，然后暂停片刻。
慢慢地将自己放回到起始位置，在整个运动过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A muscle up with added weight, pulling from a hang up and over the bar into a dip position. It is an advanced move for lats, chest and triceps.

name: 肘撑臂屈伸
instructions: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住臀部旁边的边缘。
将臀部向前滑离长凳，伸直双腿，保持脚后跟着地。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bench dip variation that bends the elbows to lower the hips. It trains the triceps and the front of the shoulders.

name: 韩式臂屈伸
instructions: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双臂伸展并支撑体重。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A deep dip variation performed on parallel bars with a different hand and body position. It trains the chest and triceps.

name: 不可能臂屈伸
instructions: 将自己定位在两个双杠之间，双臂完全伸展，身体悬浮在空中。
弯曲膝盖并交叉脚踝。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An advanced dip on parallel bars with the legs crossed or lifted. It trains the triceps and chest through a tough range.

name: 负重单手引体向上
instructions: 正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，手臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部并挤压背部肌肉，调动核心力量，将身体拉向杠铃杆。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
有控制地降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An advanced one arm pull-up with added weight. It builds the lats and biceps and needs great pulling strength.

name: 斯塔尔德推举
instructions: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂伸过头顶。
稍微弯曲膝盖并启动核心。
将身体降低至蹲姿，同时保持手臂伸过头顶。
当你蹲下时，将手臂向下压向地面，锻炼三头肌。
在深蹲底部停顿片刻，然后用脚后跟站起来，同时将手臂举过头顶。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A gymnastics press where you shift your weight over the hands and lift the body up with straight arms. It trains the triceps and shoulders.

name: 电梯式撑起
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双手放在臀部或交叉放在胸前。
保持背部挺直，腰部慢慢向前弯曲，将上半身向地面降低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢抬起上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight hinge forward and back up again with the hands on the hips. It works the upper back and the muscles along the spine.

name: 弓步引体向上
instructions: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，握距略宽于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
当你站起来时，弯曲一只手臂并将肘部移向身体一侧，同时保持另一只手臂伸直。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方并且弯曲的手臂完全弯曲。
有控制地放低自己，伸直弯曲的手臂并在另一侧重复该动作。
每次重复时交替进行。
description: A wide pull-up where you pull toward one hand while the other arm stays straight. It builds lat strength on the way to the one arm pull-up.

name: 弓步俯卧撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
将一只手臂伸直至一侧，与地面平行。
弯曲肘部降低身体，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
推回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复上述步骤，将另一只手臂伸出到一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A wide push-up that shifts the weight to one arm while the other arm stays straight. It trains the chest and triceps on the way to one arm push-ups.

name: 前水平举次数
instructions: 正手握住引体向上杆，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
保持身体挺直，抬起双腿直至与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，目标是 10-20 秒。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A rep-based version of the front lever, pulling the body in a horizontal line from a bar. It trains the lats, upper back and core.

name: 前水平举
instructions: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，双手与肩同宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲膝盖并将其向胸部靠拢。
同时，抬起双腿并将其伸直在您面前，保持身体与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持此位置，以达到完全前杆位置。
要释放，请慢慢降低双腿并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A gymnastics hold with the body straight and parallel to the ground while hanging from a bar. It trains the abs, lats and upper back.

name: 后水平举
instructions: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，双手分开的距离略大于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲膝盖并将其向胸部靠拢。
慢慢抬起双腿，保持伸直，直到身体与地面平行。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A gymnastics hold hanging from a bar with the body horizontal and facing down. It trains the upper back, shoulders and core.

name: 分腿俯撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，双脚分开。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的重心向前移动，将你的肩膀放在你的手上。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A planche hold with the legs spread wide, which makes the lever shorter. It trains the shoulders, chest and core.

name: 全俯撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
启动你的核心并缓慢地将你的重心向前移动，将你的脚抬离地面。
继续向前移动体重，直到身体与地面平行，并用双手保持平衡。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，保持身体线条笔直。
慢慢地将双脚放回地面，然后回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A gymnastics hold where the body is parallel to the floor and balanced on the hands. It builds extreme strength in the shoulders, chest and core.

name: 倾斜俯撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，身体伸直。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的重心向前移动，让你的肩膀越过你的手。
向前倾时，保持肘部稍微弯曲，身体伸直。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A leaning plank where the shoulders move forward past the hands. It trains the shoulders, wrists and core on the way to the planche.

name: 蛙式俯撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，双脚并拢。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部挺直。
当你降低身体时，将双脚抬离地面，并将膝盖靠近胸部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后向后伸展双腿，并将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A planche hold with the knees tucked in toward the arms. It builds shoulder, chest and wrist strength as a stepping stone to the full planche.

name: 倒立
instructions: 找到一个有足够空间的空地来进行倒立。
将双手放在地上，与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿向上踢向墙壁，用核心和肩膀保持平衡。
处于倒立位置后，用三头肌来支撑体重。
只要能保持平衡，就保持倒立。
下降时，慢慢将双腿放回地面。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A balance hold on the hands with the body upside down, usually against a wall to start. It trains the shoulders, triceps and core.

name: 人体旗
instructions: 首先，双手握住一根垂直杆，手掌相对，双臂完全伸展。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
利用核心和上半身的力量，抬起双腿，直到它们与地面平行。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势，保持身体线条笔直。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A gymnastics hold where you grip a vertical pole and hold your body out to the side. It trains the obliques, shoulders and lats.

name: 剥猫式
instructions: 首先，将双臂完全伸展，身体放松地悬挂在杆上。
收紧核心并抬起双腿，使膝盖靠近胸部。
继续将双腿举过头顶，让身体穿过手臂。
一旦双腿完全伸过头顶，就开始将它们放回起始位置。
当你降低双腿时，让你的身体通过手臂向后移动，直到你再次完全伸展手臂悬挂。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A ring or bar move where you tuck up, pass the legs through the arms and then roll over the bar. It trains the back and shoulder mobility.

name: 杠铃推举深蹲
instructions: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，与肩同高。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低至蹲姿。
当你到达深蹲底部时，爆发性地通过脚后跟站起来，同时将杠铃压过头顶。
当你回到深蹲位置时，将杠铃降低到肩膀高度。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A front squat followed by an overhead press in one fluid movement with a barbell. It trains the legs, shoulders and heart rate.

name: 大力士芬戈尔手指
instructions: Set up the implement in front of you.
Grip it firmly with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift it using your legs and hips.
Hold it steady for a moment.
Lower it under control.
description: A strongman grip challenge based on the legend of Fingal's fingers. It tests hand and forearm strength.

name: 大力士酒桶抛掷
instructions: Stand with feet wide and the keg between your legs, gripping it low with both hands.
Hinge at the hips, keep your chest up and your back flat.
Drive your hips forward hard and pull the keg up your body.
Extend fully and throw the keg up and back over the bar.
Reset, step back to the start and repeat with control.
description: An explosive strongman lift where you heave a heavy keg up and over a bar behind you. It builds hip power and total body drive.

name: 杠铃负重硬拉
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over your mid foot.
Hinge down, grip the bar just outside your legs and brace your core.
Push the floor away and keep the bar close as you stand up.
Lock out with hips and knees extended and shoulders back.
Lower the bar along your legs with a flat back to the floor.
description: A classic deadlift lifting a loaded barbell from the floor to hip height. It trains the whole posterior chain and your grip.

name: 杠铃负重胸前深蹲
instructions: Rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high and hands steadying it.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and brace your core.
Sit down between your hips, keeping your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your whole foot and keep your elbows up the whole way.
description: A squat with the barbell racked across the front of your shoulders. The front load keeps you upright and hits the quads hard.

name: 杠铃负重卧推
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack it over your chest.
Lower the bar under control to your mid chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet planted throughout.
description: The standard flat bench press with a loaded barbell, the staple lift for chest size and pressing strength.

name: 杠铃前蹲(从垫块)
instructions: Set the bar on the blocks or rack at front shoulder height.
Step in, rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Lift it off and stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest until your thighs pass parallel.
Stand back up by driving through your feet, then re-rack the bar.
description: A front squat started from a rack or blocks height, so you begin the rep with the bar already set. It builds quad and trunk strength.

name: 负重肌肉上拉(单杠)
instructions: 首先悬挂在引体向上杆上，手掌背向自己，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
弯曲肘部，将胸部拉向杠铃杆，保持身体挺直。
当你的胸部到达杠铃时，用手向下推并将肘部向后推，将身体提升到杠铃上方。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A weighted muscle up performed with the added load on a bar. An advanced pull and dip that trains the lats, chest and triceps.

name: 负重直杠臂屈伸
instructions: 将自己置于双杠之间，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A weighted dip on a straight bar or parallel bars. It builds the chest, triceps and shoulders with added resistance.

name: 分腿马耳他十字
instructions: 首先，悬挂在一对环上，双臂完全伸展，身体呈一条直线。
双腿分开，形成跨坐姿势。
启动你的核心并慢慢降低你的身体，直到你的手臂与地面平行。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A ring hold with the arms out and the legs straddled. It builds the chest and shoulders and is a stepping stone toward the full maltese.

name: 全马耳他十字
instructions: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，双臂伸直至两侧。
慢慢向前倾斜，保持手臂伸直，直到上半身与地面平行。
启动你的核心并保持这个姿势几秒钟。
通过双脚推动并站起来，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: An advanced gymnastics hold on rings with the arms out wide and the body straight. It demands huge strength in the chest, shoulders and core.

name: 杠铃举重组合
instructions: Load a light to moderate barbell and stand over it with feet hip width apart.
Perform the first lift of your chosen sequence, such as a deadlift.
Move straight into the next lift without setting the bar down.
Keep each rep crisp with a braced core and a flat back.
Finish all lifts for one round, then lower the bar and rest before repeating.
description: A flowing series of barbell lifts done back to back without putting the bar down. It works your whole body and your conditioning.

name: 大力士翻车
instructions: Squat low at the edge of the vehicle with a flat back and hands underneath.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Drive hard through your legs and lift the edge to hip height.
Shift your hands and push up and over with your legs and arms.
Let it roll over fully, then step back and reset for the next flip.
description: A strongman event where you lift one side of a heavy vehicle and flip it over. It takes full body strength and leg drive.

name: 360度大回环
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直在身前，与地面平行。
启动你的核心并以圆周运动摆动你的手臂，同时旋转你的躯干。
继续圆周运动，摆动手臂并旋转躯干，达到所需的重复次数。
记住在整个练习过程中保持呼吸。
description: A rotating movement that swings the arms and torso in a full circle. It gets the heart rate up and loosens the trunk.

name: 哑铃躺地锤式推举
english: dumbbell lying on floor hammer press
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Start with your upper arms resting on the floor.
Press the dumbbells straight up over your chest.
Pause briefly at the top without locking out hard.
Lower slowly until your triceps touch the floor and repeat.
description: A floor press with palms facing each other, which is kind to your shoulders. It trains the chest and triceps through a short range.

name: 哑铃锤式握法上斜凳双臂划船
english: dumbbell hammer grip incline bench two arm row
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row both dumbbells toward your hips, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension and repeat.
description: A chest supported row on an incline bench with a neutral grip. It targets the mid back with little strain on your lower back.

name: 弹力带后束飞鸟
instructions: Hold the band in both hands in front of you with arms straight.
Stand tall with a soft knee bend and your core tight.
Pull your hands apart and out to the sides at shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap back.
description: A band version of the reverse fly that works the back of your shoulders and upper back, handy for posture.

name: 壶铃硬拉
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grab the handle with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet and stand tall, squeezing your glutes.
Hinge back down to set the kettlebell on the floor and repeat.
description: A beginner friendly deadlift with a kettlebell between your feet. It teaches the hip hinge and builds glutes and hamstrings.

name: 壶铃半程土耳其起立
instructions: Lie on your back with a kettlebell pressed up in one hand and the same side knee bent.
Keep your eyes on the bell and your arm vertical.
Roll onto the opposite elbow, then onto your hand.
Come up to a tall seated position with your arm still locked overhead.
Reverse the steps slowly to lie back down, then switch sides.
description: The first half of a turkish get up, moving from lying to a seated position with the kettlebell overhead. It builds shoulder stability and core strength.

name: 弹力带交替上斜胸推并转体
english: band alternate incline chest press with twist
instructions: Anchor a band low behind you and hold the handles at chest height.
Stand in a split stance with your core braced.
Press one hand up and forward while rotating your torso slightly.
Return under control and press with the other arm.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides for the full set.
description: An alternating band press angled upward, with a torso twist added to bring in your core. It works the upper chest and trunk together.

name: 弹力带交替低位划船并转体
english: band alternate low row with twist
instructions: Anchor a band in front of you at low height and hold both handles.
Stand in a staggered stance with arms extended.
Pull one handle back toward your hip while rotating your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
description: An alternating band row with a rotation, training your back and the muscles that twist your trunk.

name: 弹力带交替高位下拉并转体
english: band alternate lat pulldown with twist
instructions: Anchor a band high in front of you and hold both handles with arms overhead.
Stand tall in a staggered stance.
Pull one handle down toward your ribs while rotating your torso.
Keep your elbow tucked and shoulder down.
Return slowly and switch to the other arm.
description: A standing band pulldown done one arm at a time with a trunk twist. It trains your lats and adds core work.

name: 全俯撑俯卧撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
收紧核心肌群，将身体放低至地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
当你降低身体高度时，身体向前倾斜，双脚离开地面，用双手保持平衡。
继续降低身体，直到胸部略高于地面。
用手推动并伸展双臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
在整个运动过程中，从头部到脚后跟保持一条直线。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A push-up from the planche position with the feet off the ground. It is an elite bodyweight move for the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: 杠铃组合直腿硬拉翻举上步
english: barbell complex stiff leg deadlift clean step
instructions: Stand holding a light barbell with an overhand grip at thigh height.
Lower the bar down your legs with soft knees and a flat back.
Stand up, then pull the bar explosively and catch it on your shoulders.
Take a controlled step forward with the bar racked.
Step back, lower the bar and begin the next round.
description: A barbell complex that links a stiff leg deadlift into a clean and then a step. It builds posterior chain power and rhythm.

name: 罗马椅仰卧起坐
instructions: Sit on the roman chair with your feet locked under the pads.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back slightly.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your thighs.
Pause at the top and keep your neck relaxed.
Lower back slowly under control and repeat.
description: A sit up on a roman chair that gives you a big range of motion for your abs and hip flexors.

name: 屈膝抬腿斜向卷腹
english: oblique crunches with bent knee leg lift
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your head and knees bent.
Lift your shoulders and knees at the same time.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.
Alternate sides through the set.
description: A side crunch combined with a bent knee lift. It trains the obliques and lower abs together.

name: 直腿抬腿斜向卷腹
english: oblique crunches with straight leg lift
instructions: Lie on your back with legs raised straight and hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate to bring one elbow toward the opposite hip.
Keep your legs steady and low back pressed down.
Return slowly and alternate sides.
description: A twisting crunch with your legs lifted straight, making your core work harder through the lever.

name: 负重稳定球卷腹(全程)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Hold a weight against your chest.
Let your torso drape back over the ball for a full stretch.
Curl up until your upper back clears the ball.
Lower slowly back into the stretch and repeat.
description: A crunch over a stability ball while holding a weight, using the ball for a longer range of motion in your abs.

name: 哑铃单臂宽握卧推
english: dumbbell one arm wide grip bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench with one dumbbell held over your chest.
Place your free arm on your stomach or out to the side.
Lower the dumbbell with elbow flared out until you feel a chest stretch.
Press it back up over your chest.
Keep your torso square, then switch arms after the set.
description: A one arm dumbbell bench press with a wide elbow path, stressing the chest while your core resists rotation.

name: 哑铃单臂地面飞鸟
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in one hand over your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Open your arm out to the side until your upper arm touches the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbell back above you.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
description: A one arm fly lying on the floor, a safe way to stretch and load the chest with a limited range.

name: 哑铃臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.
description: A loaded hip bridge that targets your glutes. Resting a dumbbell on your hips adds resistance.

name: 哑铃V字起
instructions: Lie flat with legs straight and a dumbbell held in both hands overhead.
Brace your core.
Lift your arms and legs together, forming a V shape.
Touch the dumbbell near your shins.
Lower back down slowly without dropping your legs.
description: A v up while holding a dumbbell, raising your arms and legs together to challenge the abs.

name: 哑铃侧桥
instructions: Lie on one side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Hold a dumbbell on your top hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds without sagging.
Lower, then repeat on the other side.
description: A side plank with a dumbbell held on your hip or raised overhead. It trains the obliques and lateral stability.

name: 哑铃单腿直腿硬拉
instructions: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand or both hands.
Keep a soft bend in your standing knee.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower the dumbbell toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to stand back up, then switch legs.
description: A single leg hinge holding a dumbbell, which trains your hamstrings, glutes and balance.

name: 哑铃单臂弓步
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs and switch the dumbbell hand halfway.
description: A lunge holding a dumbbell in one hand. The uneven load makes your core work to keep you balanced.

name: 哑铃直腿硬拉 v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees slightly bent and back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
description: A hip hinge with nearly straight legs holding dumbbells. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings and glutes.

name: 哑铃弓步 v. 2
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and torso upright.
Push back to the start and switch legs.
description: A dumbbell lunge variation for leg strength and balance, working quads and glutes.

name: 龙门架Y字上举
instructions: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand, arms crossed in front.
Stand tall with a slight lean forward.
Raise both arms up and out into a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and shoulders down.
Lower slowly to the start.
description: A cable raise that moves your arms into a Y shape, building the shoulders and the muscles that stabilise your shoulder blades.

name: 杠杆侧平举 v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivots.
Sit tall and place your arms against the pads.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weights rest.
description: A machine lateral raise that isolates the side delts with smooth, guided resistance.

name: 杠杆夹胸
instructions: Set the seat height and grip the handles with a slight elbow bend.
Sit tall with your back against the pad.
Sweep your arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the center.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.
description: A machine crossover that brings your arms together across the body, isolating the chest.

name: 弹簧握力器腕弯举
instructions: Sit with a forearm resting on your thigh or a bench, palm up.
Hold the hand spring in that hand.
Squeeze the handles together by curling your wrist and fingers.
Hold briefly at full squeeze.
Release slowly, finish your reps, then switch hands.
description: A wrist curl using a hand grip spring, strengthening your forearms and grip.

name: 哑铃弯举推举
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl both weights up to shoulder height without swinging.
Rotate your wrists slightly and press the weights overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then back down to your sides.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
description: Curl the dumbbells and keep going into an overhead press, training the arms and shoulders in one smooth rep.

name: 上斜拍肩
instructions: Place your hands on a bench or box and extend into a plank position.
Spread your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Keep your hips level and body in a straight line.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
description: A plank on an incline where you tap each shoulder, building core and shoulder stability.

name: 龙门架前蹲
instructions: Set the cable low and hold the handle at your chest.
Step back to create tension and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down and back into a squat with your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
Drive up through your heels.
description: A squat with a cable held at your chest, keeping you upright while the quads and glutes work.

name: 龙门架侧弓步
instructions: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand sideways to the stack.
Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip.
Keep the other leg straight and feet flat.
Push off your bent leg to return to center.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.
description: A sideways lunge against cable tension, training glutes, inner thighs and side to side strength.

name: 龙门架弓步
instructions: Hold a cable handle at chest height and step away from the stack.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front heel down.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.
description: A lunge with cable resistance, building leg strength with a constant load.

name: 龙门架跪姿穿拉
instructions: Kneel facing away from a low cable with a rope held between your legs.
Sit your hips back with a flat back.
Let the rope pull your hands back between your knees.
Drive your hips forward to a tall kneeling position.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and repeat.
description: A kneeling hip hinge with a cable pulled between your legs. It teaches the hinge and trains glutes with little spinal load.

name: 龙门架单臂高位头上三头肌伸展
english: cable one arm high pulley overhead tricep extension
instructions: Face away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with one hand.
Stand in a split stance with your elbow pointing up.
Extend your arm forward and up until it is straight.
Keep your upper arm still.
Return slowly and switch arms after the set.
description: A single arm overhead extension on a high pulley that stretches and loads the long head of the triceps.

name: 龙门架前蹲 v. 2
instructions: Set the cable low and hold the handle against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a deep squat, chest tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels back to standing.
description: A second take on the cable front squat, holding the handle at your chest to stay upright and hit the quads.

name: 龙门架侧弓步 v. 2
instructions: Hold a cable handle at chest height, standing sideways to the stack.
Step wide to the side and bend that knee.
Push your hips back and keep your chest up.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A second variation of the cable side lunge for the glutes and inner thighs.

name: 龙门架前弓步
instructions: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand facing away from the stack.
Take a big step forward.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee stable over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.
description: A forward stepping lunge with cable tension, working quads and glutes.

name: 龙门架坐地绳索划船
english: cable seated on floor row with rope
instructions: Sit on the floor facing a low cable with legs extended and the rope in your hands.
Sit tall with a straight back.
Pull the rope toward your lower chest, spreading your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly and repeat.
description: A floor seated cable row using a rope, which lets you pull the hands apart and squeeze the mid back.

name: 龙门架地面平行握高位下拉
english: cable parallel grip lat pulldown on floor
instructions: Kneel or sit on the floor under a high cable with a parallel grip handle.
Sit tall and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back.
Return slowly to full arm extension.
description: A lat pulldown done from the floor with a neutral grip, focusing on the lats.

name: 龙门架站姿胸推
instructions: Set the cables at chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly with control.
description: A standing press with cables that trains the chest while your core keeps you steady.

name: 熊爬
instructions: 从四肢着地开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，膝盖直接放在臀部下方。
将膝盖稍微抬离地面，保持背部平坦并收紧核心。
同时向前移动右手和左脚，然后是左手和右脚。
继续向前爬行，手脚交替动作。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的节奏并保持核心紧张。
继续所需的距离或时间。
description: A crawl on hands and feet with the knees hovering off the floor. It works the shoulders, core and legs together.

name: 滑冰跳
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖，向右跳，右脚着地。
落地时，将左腿摆动到右腿后面，并用左脚趾敲击地面。
立即向左侧跳跃，左脚着地。
落地时，将右腿摆动到左腿后面，并用右脚趾敲击地面。
继续交替两侧，跳跃并用每条腿敲击地面。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A side-to-side hop that mimics a speed skater, landing on one foot at a time. It builds leg power and balance.

name: 龙门架仰卧窄推
instructions: Lie on a bench with the cable behind your head and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Start with arms bent over your chest.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A close grip press lying down with a cable, putting emphasis on the triceps.

name: 龙门架站姿窄推
instructions: Set the cable at chest height and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Stand in a split stance, core tight.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.
Return slowly to the start.
description: A standing close grip cable press that focuses on the triceps.

name: 龙门架坐姿窄推
instructions: Sit on a bench facing away from a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your back against the pad.
Return slowly and repeat.
description: A seated close grip cable press for the triceps with a stable base.

name: 夏威夷深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips down and back into a deep squat.
Pause at the bottom without rounding your back.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
description: A deep bodyweight squat variation that builds leg strength and hip mobility.

name: 虾式深蹲
instructions: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee, holding that foot behind you.
Reach your free arm forward for balance.
Lower slowly until the back knee lightly touches the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg squat with the back foot held behind you, demanding strong quads and good balance.

name: 滑冰深蹲
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent and the foot lifted behind you.
Swing your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Lightly tap the back knee near the floor.
Stand up through the front foot, then switch legs after your reps.
description: A single-leg squat with the free leg swept behind, like a speed skater, for leg strength and balance.

name: 哑铃摆荡
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold one dumbbell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let your arms stay relaxed.
Guide it back down and hinge into the next rep.
description: A hip driven swing using a dumbbell, building power in your glutes and hamstrings.

name: 战绳交替甩臂深蹲
instructions: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit into a squat position.
Whip the ropes up and down with alternating arms.
Keep your chest tall and your knees stable.
Continue for a set time at a steady pace.
description: Squatting while whipping the battle ropes with alternating arms. It raises your heart rate and works legs and shoulders.

name: 战绳交替甩臂跳跃深蹲
english: battling ropes alternate arms jump squat
instructions: Hold the rope ends and stand in a squat position.
Start waving the ropes with alternating arms.
Jump up explosively and land softly.
Go straight into the next squat.
Keep going for a set time and rest when needed.
description: A high energy move combining a jump squat with alternating rope waves. It builds power and conditioning.

name: 战绳左右甩臂
english: battling ropes side to side arms
instructions: Hold the rope ends in an athletic stance with knees bent.
Swing both ropes to one side.
Swing them across to the other side in a flowing motion.
Rotate through your torso a little.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set time.
description: Swinging the ropes from side to side to condition your shoulders and trunk.

name: 战绳交替甩臂侧弓步
english: battling ropes alternate arms side lunge
instructions: Hold the rope ends and stand with feet together.
Step wide to one side and sit into a side lunge.
Whip the ropes alternately with your arms.
Push back to the middle.
Alternate sides and keep the waves going.
description: Side lunges while whipping the ropes alternately, working legs, shoulders and heart.

name: 战绳向内绕圈
instructions: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn inward.
Keep the circles even and large.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Continue for a set time then rest.
description: Drawing circles with the ropes toward each other. It builds shoulder endurance.

name: 战绳向外绕圈
instructions: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn outward.
Keep the movement smooth and even.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for a set time.
description: Drawing outward circles with the ropes, training shoulders and conditioning.

name: 战绳飞鸟
instructions: Stand with knees bent, a rope end in each hand and arms in front.
Sweep your arms out wide and slightly up.
Bring them back together in front of you.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for a set time.
description: Sweeping the ropes out and in like a fly, hitting the shoulders and upper body.

name: 战绳开合跳
instructions: Hold the rope ends with feet together.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms and making waves.
Jump back to the start.
Keep your landings soft.
Keep a steady pace for the set time.
description: A jumping jack with rope waves added, so arms and legs both work hard.

name: 战绳俄罗斯转体
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold the rope ends in front of you.
Twist your torso to one side and swing the ropes.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted and continue for the set time.
description: A seated twist where you swing the ropes side to side. It trains the obliques and conditioning.

name: 战绳分腿跳
instructions: Hold the rope ends and stand in a split stance.
Start making waves with your arms.
Jump and switch legs in mid air.
Land softly in a lunge.
Keep switching for the set time.
description: Jumping lunges while waving the ropes, a demanding mix of power and cardio.

name: 战绳高波浪
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and a rope end in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise both arms overhead and slam the ropes down.
Repeat quickly to make big waves.
Keep your core braced for the set time.
description: Big overhead wave style rope slams that fire up the shoulders and heart.

name: 战绳低波浪
instructions: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand in a quarter squat.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Whip the ropes down and up so waves travel low along the floor.
Keep the waves even and your hips stable.
Work for 20-30 seconds at a hard pace.
Rest, then repeat for several rounds.
description: Alternating or double low waves with heavy ropes that spike your heart rate and work the shoulders, arms and core.

name: 桌下反向划船
instructions: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Extend your legs with heels on the floor and body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.
description: Pull your chest up to the underside of a sturdy table to train the back and arms using your own weight.

name: 桌下屈膝反向划船
english: inverted row bent knee under table
instructions: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Bend your knees and plant your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from knees to shoulders.
Pull your chest to the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: An easier inverted row with bent knees, pulling up to a sturdy table to build back strength.

name: 屈体俯卧撑(凳上) v. 2
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips piked high.
Walk your hands back until your body forms an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.
description: A pike push-up with your feet on a bench, loading the shoulders more than a flat push-up does.

name: 战绳力量砸绳
instructions: Hold a rope end in each hand and stand in an athletic stance.
Raise both ropes overhead while rising onto your toes.
Slam them down hard while dropping into a squat.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Reset and repeat at a steady, powerful pace.
Work in bursts of 15-30 seconds.
description: An explosive overhead rope slam that builds conditioning and power through the whole body.

name: 杠杆坐姿腿举 v. 2
instructions: Sit on the machine and set your back firmly against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety and lower the weight until your knees bend to about 90 degrees.
Press through your whole foot to extend your legs.
Stop just short of locking your knees.
Lower under control and repeat.
description: A seated machine press that loads the thighs and glutes with a stable path.

name: 杠杆坐姿腿屈伸 v. 2
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Hook your lower shins under the roller and align your knees with the pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Avoid swinging or lifting your hips.
description: A machine isolation move for the front of the thighs.

name: 椅间臂屈伸
instructions: Place two sturdy chairs facing each other and brace them against a wall.
Grip the seats, lift your body and straighten your arms.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows pointing back and your chest up.
Press up to straight arms.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.
description: Bodyweight dips using two sturdy chairs, working the triceps and chest.

name: 椅间反向划船
instructions: Set a sturdy bar or table edge between two stable chairs and lie under it.
Grip the support with straight arms and your body in a plank line.
Pull your chest toward the support.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.
description: A bodyweight row under a sturdy support between two chairs for the upper back and arms.

name: 椅子辅助仰卧起坐
instructions: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a chair seat, knees bent.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Do not pull on your neck.
description: A sit-up with your feet or legs supported on a chair to focus on the abs.

name: 椅子支撑下沉式提踵
english: calf raise from deficit with chair supported
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step edge, holding a chair for balance.
Let your heels drop below the step to stretch your calves.
Rise as high onto your toes as you can.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly into the deep stretch.
Keep your knees almost straight.
description: A calf raise from a raised step with a chair for balance, giving a deeper stretch and fuller range.

name: 俯身扭转
instructions: Stand with feet wide and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Extend your arms out to the sides.
Rotate your torso and reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return through the middle and twist to the other side.
Move with control and keep your hips square.
Do 10-12 reps per side.
description: A standing bent-over rotation that mobilizes the spine and works the obliques.

name: 下沉式窄距深蹲
instructions: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your feet close together.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down, keeping your knees over your toes.
Go as deep as comfortable with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Stand tall without locking out hard.
description: A close-stance squat with your heels raised on a small step to emphasize the quads.

name: 地面仰卧抬腿抬髋
english: lying leg hip raise on floor
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides or holding something behind your head.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Lift your hips off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly.
Lower your legs without arching your back.
Keep movements smooth, not swinging.
description: A floor leg raise that lifts the hips off the ground for a stronger lower-abs contraction.

name: 臀部行进
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Raise one knee toward your chest without letting your hips drop.
Place that foot down and lift the other.
Keep squeezing your glutes the whole time.
Continue alternating for 10-20 marches.
description: A hip-bridge hold with alternating knee lifts that trains glutes and pelvic stability.

name: 地面毛巾滑动腿弯举
english: sliding leg curl on floor with towel
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your hips.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Move slowly to stay in control.
description: A hamstring curl where your heels slide on a towel over a smooth floor.

name: 髋部屈伸拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Extend the leg again and press it down to the floor.
Repeat on the other leg.
Breathe slowly and stay relaxed.
description: A gentle hip stretch that moves through flexion and extension to loosen the hips and glutes.

name: 哑铃全程摆荡
instructions: Hold one dumbbell with both hands and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge back and swing the weight between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing the dumbbell overhead.
Let it fall back and hinge again.
Keep your back flat and your arms loose.
Control the dumbbell at all times.
description: A hip-driven swing with a dumbbell, taking the weight from between the legs to overhead.

name: 哑铃前置弓步
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push back to the start.
Alternate legs for each rep.
description: A lunge with dumbbells held at your shoulders, which challenges your legs and trunk.

name: 杠铃前置弓步
instructions: Rest the barbell on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your chest tall and your core braced.
Push through the front foot to return.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side.
description: A lunge with the barbell in the front rack, emphasizing quads and an upright torso.

name: 哑铃翻举推举
instructions: Stand over two dumbbells and grip them with a flat back.
Pull the weights up explosively and catch them at your shoulders.
Dip slightly and drive them overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower to your shoulders, then to the floor with control.
Keep the weights close to your body.
description: A dumbbell clean followed by an overhead press for total-body power.

name: 屈体俯卧撑(凳间)
instructions: Put your feet on one bench and your hands on the floor or a second bench.
Raise your hips into a pike.
Lower your head between your hands.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
description: A pike push-up with your feet on one bench and your hands between benches for extra depth.

name: 屈体俯卧撑(椅间)
instructions: Set two sturdy chairs shoulder-width apart and grip them.
Walk your feet back and lift your hips into a pike.
Bend your elbows to lower your head between the chairs.
Keep your back flat and elbows slightly in.
Press back up.
Make sure the chairs are stable.
description: A pike push-up with your hands on two chairs so your head can drop lower.

name: 站姿Y字上举
instructions: Stand tall with arms by your sides, thumbs pointing up.
Raise both arms diagonally overhead to form a Y.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Keep your neck long and avoid shrugging.
description: Raise your arms into a Y shape to strengthen the lower traps and shoulder stabilisers.

name: 站姿T字上举
instructions: Stand tall with arms in front of you at chest height.
Open your arms out to the sides into a T.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.
description: Lift your arms out to the sides into a T shape to train the upper back and rear shoulders.

name: 站姿W字上举
instructions: Stand tall with elbows bent and hands in front of your chest.
Pull your elbows back and down, forming a W.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and rotate your hands outward.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly and repeat.
description: Pull your elbows back into a W shape to strengthen the mid-back and rotator cuff.

name: 站姿下身旋转
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your hips and knees soft.
Hold your hands in front of your waist.
Rotate your hips and trunk to one side.
Return through the centre and rotate to the other side.
Move smoothly for 10-15 reps per side.
description: A standing trunk rotation at lower body level to loosen the hips and waist.

name: 站姿上身旋转
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped in front of your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body to one side as far as is comfortable.
Return through the centre and rotate the other way.
Keep it smooth for 10-15 reps per side.
description: A standing rotation of the upper body that mobilises the thoracic spine and warms up the waist.

name: 站姿菲尔普斯
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing both arms forward and up in big arcs.
Swing them back down past your hips behind you.
Keep the movement loose and rhythmic.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.
description: Swim-style arm swings that loosen the shoulders and chest as a warm-up.

name: 站姿拧毛巾
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side while your hands twist across.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Keep your hips mostly facing forward.
Continue for 10-15 reps per side.
description: Twist your torso with arms wrapped as if wringing a towel, mobilising the waist and shoulders.

name: 站姿髋部绕环
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Push your hips out to one side, then forward, back and around.
Draw a large smooth circle.
Keep your shoulders still.
Do 10 circles, then reverse direction.
description: Circle your hips to loosen the hip joints and warm up the glutes.

name: 仰卧夹臀
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips slightly.
Hold the squeeze for 2 seconds.
Lower your hips without relaxing completely.
Repeat for 12-15 reps.
description: Squeeze your glutes while lying down to activate them before heavier lower body work.

name: 仰卧肩部划扫
instructions: Lie on your back with arms straight out to the sides.
Sweep both arms up in an arc toward overhead.
Keep your arms as close to the floor as you comfortably can.
Return along the same path.
Move slowly for 10-12 reps.
description: Slide your arms along the floor in a wide arc to mobilise the shoulders.

name: 仰卧上身旋转
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms stretched in front of you.
Keep your knees stacked.
Lift the top arm and open it across to the other side, following it with your eyes.
Return the arm to the start.
Do 10 reps, then switch sides.
description: Rotate your upper body while lying down to loosen the mid-back.

name: 辅助反向腿弯举
instructions: Kneel with your ankles secured and your torso upright.
Use the assistance as needed.
Lean forward slowly, resisting with your hamstrings.
Lower as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings and hands if needed.
Keep your hips extended.
description: A supported nordic-style curl where assistance lets you control the lowering for the hamstrings.

name: 站姿肩部绕环
instructions: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your shoulders up and roll them back in a large circle.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Do 10 circles, then reverse the direction.
description: Circle your shoulders to loosen the joint and ease tension in the upper back.

name: 跪姿单臂伸展滚动抬起
english: kneeling one arm reach roll lift
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Reach one arm forward along the floor.
Roll that arm up and across, rotating your chest.
Lift it toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
Return and repeat, then switch arms.
description: A kneeling drill where one arm reaches, rolls and lifts to open the upper back and shoulders.

name: L型引体向上
instructions: 正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
收紧背阔肌和二头肌，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A pull-up with the legs held out straight in an L shape. It trains the lats, biceps and core.

name: 地面L型支撑
instructions: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
将双手放在臀部旁边的地板上，手指指向前方。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
尝试使双腿与地面平行，与身体形成“L”形。
尽可能长时间地保持这个姿势。
慢慢地将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated hold on the floor, hands beside the hips, with the legs lifted straight out. It trains the abs, hip flexors and triceps.

name: 地面V型支撑
instructions: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
稍微向后倾斜，将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
同时，将上半身抬离地面，并将手臂伸向腿部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢降低上半身和双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated hold with both the legs and the upper body lifted into a V shape. It trains the abs, hip flexors and balance.

name: 药球卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a medicine ball on your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chin off your chest.
Breathe out as you crunch up.
description: A crunch holding a medicine ball to add resistance for the abs.

name: 哑铃前平举 v. 3
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Brace your core and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the weights in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.
description: Lift dumbbells in front of you to work the front of the shoulders.

name: 游泳打腿 v. 2(男)
instructions: 脸朝下躺在垫子上，双臂伸过头顶。
启动核心肌群，同时将胸部和腿部抬离地面。
以扑动的动作上下踢腿，就像在游泳一样。
继续踢所需的重复次数。
将胸部和双腿放低至起始位置。
description: A face-down flutter kick, lifting the chest and legs off the floor and kicking in a swimming motion. It trains the glutes and lower back.

name: 单腿臀桥(直腿)
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat.
Extend the other leg straight.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Keep your pelvis level.
Lower with control.
Switch legs after your set.
description: A one-leg hip bridge with the other leg held straight, strongly working glutes and hamstrings.

name: 超人式
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor together.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back.
Hold for 1-2 seconds.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.
description: A floor extension that lifts arms and legs to strengthen the lower back.

name: 下斜抬腿抬髋
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hold the top edge.
Bring your legs up over your hips.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips first.
Lower your legs with control.
Avoid swinging.
description: A leg raise on a decline bench, finishing with a hip lift for the lower abs.

name: 药球向后抛
instructions: Stand with a medicine ball held between your legs.
Squat slightly, then explode up.
Swing the ball up and back over your head.
Release it behind you at full extension.
Retrieve the ball.
Reset your stance and repeat.
description: An explosive overhead throw behind you that trains the hips and posterior chain.

name: 分腿跳上箱
instructions: Stand in a lunge position facing a box.
Swing your arms and jump up.
Land with both feet softly on the box.
Stand tall.
Step down carefully.
Switch your front leg and repeat.
description: A jump from a split stance onto a box, building leg power.

name: 坐姿颈部屈伸
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lower your chin gently toward your chest.
Hold for a moment.
Slowly lift your head and look up slightly.
Move through a comfortable range only.
Repeat 8-10 times smoothly.
description: A seated neck mobility drill moving the head forward and back.

name: 药球站姿过头抛
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding the ball overhead.
Arch back slightly.
Throw the ball forward and down with force.
Follow through with your arms.
Pick up the ball.
Reset and repeat.
description: An explosive overhead throw with a medicine ball, working the upper body and trunk.

name: 地面椅子臂屈伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with hands on a chair behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Keep elbows pointing back.
Press up.
Brace the chair against a wall.
description: A seated dip with your hands on a chair behind you.

name: 椅子上台阶
instructions: Face a sturdy chair.
Place one foot fully on the seat.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Do all reps on one leg, then switch.
description: A step-up onto a sturdy chair, a simple single-leg exercise.

name: 哑铃侧弓步 v. 3
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push off to return to center.
Alternate sides.
description: A side lunge with dumbbells that works the thighs and inner thighs.

name: 哑铃俄罗斯转体
instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted.
Move with control.
description: A seated rotation with a dumbbell for the obliques.

name: 哑铃斯文德推举
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell upright between your palms.
Hold it at chest level.
Squeeze your palms together.
Press the weight straight out.
Return to your chest.
Keep the squeeze all the time.
description: A plate-style squeeze press using a dumbbell held between your palms.

name: 哑铃超人式
instructions: Lie face down holding light dumbbells with arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral.
description: A loaded superman hold with dumbbells for the lower back and glutes.

name: 波比跳加俯卧撑
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back to a plank.
Do a push-up.
Jump your feet in and leap up.
Repeat at a steady pace.
description: A burpee that includes a full push-up for conditioning.

name: 侧劈叉
instructions: Sit or stand with your legs as wide as comfortable.
Keep your toes pointing up or forward.
Lower slowly into the split.
Keep your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Come out gently.
description: A wide-leg stretch for the inner thighs and groin.

name: 脉冲上抬
instructions: Lie on your back with legs pointing to the ceiling.
Place your hands by your sides.
Lift your hips slightly with a small pulse.
Lower and repeat.
Keep movement small.
Do 15-20 pulses.
description: Small upward pulses with your legs raised, targeting the lower abs.

name: 侧平板支撑髋内收(屈膝)
instructions: Set up in a side plank with the bottom knee bent.
Keep your body straight.
Lift your hips.
Raise the bottom leg toward the top leg.
Lower with control.
Switch sides.
description: A side plank with the top leg lifting inward, working the inner thighs and obliques.

name: 弓步热身(一)
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.
description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 1 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.

instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.

description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 7 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.

name: 前侧腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Place one heel forward on the floor with the toes up.
Keep that leg straight.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Feel the stretch behind your thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.
description: A simple stretch for the back of the thigh.

name: 下犬式
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Keep your arms straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower down gently.
description: A classic yoga pose that stretches the back of the legs and shoulders.

name: 前弓步(男)
instructions: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，双手放在臀部。
右脚向前迈出一大步，将身体降低到弓步位置。
将右膝盖弯曲约 90 度，保持膝盖与脚踝对齐。
用右脚推出并返回到起始位置。
用左腿重复上述动作，交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight lunge stepping forward and pushing back, alternating legs. It builds the glutes, quads and balance.

name: 战士式
instructions: Take a long stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Raise your arms.
Keep your back leg straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.
description: A standing yoga pose that builds strength and stretches the hips.

name: 仰卧屈腿髋部拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your other leg relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.
description: A lying hip stretch pulling the knee in toward the chest.

name: 站姿平衡髋外侧拉伸
instructions: Stand tall near a support.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Sit back slightly.
Feel the stretch in your outer hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.
description: A standing stretch for the outer hip that also challenges balance.

name: 仰卧屈腿髋部拉伸(双手过头)
english: lying leg tuck hip stretch with overhead hands
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your arms reaching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.
description: A lying knee-tuck stretch with arms extended overhead for a longer line.

name: 仰卧屈腿髋背部拉伸
english: lying leg tuck hip back stretch
instructions: Lie on your back.
Hug both knees toward your chest.
Rock gently if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax your shoulders.
Release slowly.
description: A lying tuck stretch easing the hips and lower back.

name: 仰卧屈腿髋部扭转拉伸
english: lying leg tuck hip twist stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and pull your knees in.
Drop both knees to one side.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the center.
Switch sides.
description: A lying stretch with a spinal twist to open the hips and back.

name: 仰卧屈腿髋背部向右拉伸
english: lying leg tuck hip back to right stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the right.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.
description: A lying tuck stretch with the knees guided to the right.

name: 仰卧屈腿髋部向左扭转拉伸
english: lying leg tuck hip twist to left stretch
instructions: Lie on your back and tuck your knees.
Lower your knees to the left.
Keep both shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly.
Return to center.
description: A lying tuck stretch with the knees guided to the left.

name: 交替触脚跟侧踢深蹲
english: alternate heel touch side kick squat
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Squat down.
Stand and kick one leg to the side.
Touch the heel with your hand.
Squat again.
Alternate sides.
description: A squat that adds a side kick and a heel touch for legs and coordination.

name: 交替短跑式弓步
instructions: Stand tall.
Step back into a deep lunge.
Drive your arms like a sprinter.
Push back to standing.
Alternate legs.
Keep your torso upright.
description: A lunge with a sprint-style arm drive and alternating legs.

name: 分腿短跑式低弓步
instructions: Step into a long lunge.
Lower your back knee near the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Hold the low position briefly.
Push up.
Switch legs.
description: A low lunge hold in a sprinter stance for the legs and hips.

name: 分腿短跑式高弓步
instructions: Stand tall and step one foot well back into a staggered stance.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, back heel lifted.
Swing the arm opposite the front leg forward and the other arm back, like sprinting.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to rise, then repeat all reps.
Switch legs and do the same number.
description: A high lunge with the arms driving like a sprinter's. It builds leg strength, balance and hip stability.

name: 环绕世界超人式保持
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and down toward your hips in a wide arc.
Sweep them back overhead along the same path.
Keep your neck neutral and legs lifted throughout.
Lower down with control after your set.
description: A face-down superman hold with the arms sweeping in a circle. It strengthens the glutes, lower back and rear shoulders.

name: 肘触膝仰卧起坐
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl up and rotate your torso, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your back to the floor with control.
Repeat on the other side, alternating.
Avoid pulling on your neck.
description: A sit-up that finishes by driving one elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.

name: 椅间屈膝反向划船
english: inverted row with bent knee between chairs
instructions: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar overhand, arms straight, knees bent and feet flat.
Keep your body in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest up toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.
description: A home row where you hang under a bar or broom handle set across two chairs, knees bent to make it easier. It trains the back and biceps.

name: 椅间屈膝反向下巴弯举
english: inverted chin curl with bent knee between chairs
instructions: Place a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar underhand, arms straight, knees bent.
Keep your hips up and body in a line.
Curl yourself up by bending the elbows, keeping them close.
Lower with control until the arms are straight.
Check the chairs are stable before each set.
description: An underhand-grip hang under a bar between two chairs, curling your body up with the biceps. Bent knees keep it manageable.

name: 椅间屈膝引体向上
english: pull up with bent knee between chairs
instructions: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs, high enough to sit under.
Sit or lie beneath it and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your knees bent with feet on the floor for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Use your legs as little as you can.
description: A beginner-friendly pull-up built from a bar across two chairs, with the feet on the floor and knees bent. It builds lats and arm pulling strength.

name: 眼镜蛇俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows tucked.
Press up and keep going, letting your hips sink forward.
Lift your chest and look slightly up, like a cobra.
Return to the plank by lifting your hips back.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
description: A push-up that flows into a cobra-style chest opening at the top. It trains the chest and arms and works the back and spine.

name: 跪姿眼镜蛇俯卧撑
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place your hands under your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows close.
Press up and let your hips sink forward, lifting your chest into a cobra.
Shift your hips back to the start.
Repeat smoothly.
description: A kneeling version of the cobra push-up that is easier on the arms and core. It works the chest and gently extends the spine.

name: 下斜跪姿箱上俯卧撑
english: decline kneeling push up on box
instructions: Place a sturdy box in front of you and kneel on the floor.
Put your hands on the box edge, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Form a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the box with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging.
description: A kneeling push-up with the hands on a box, so the body slopes downward. It's an easier push-up that still stresses the chest and shoulders.

name: 靠墙下斜俯卧撑
instructions: Place your hands on the floor and walk your feet up a wall behind you.
Set your hands under your shoulders in a straight body line.
Lower your chest toward the floor with elbows tucked.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Walk your feet down to finish.
description: A push-up with the feet up the wall and hands on the floor. The raised feet put more load on the upper chest and shoulders.

name: 跪姿旋转俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a kneeling push-up position, hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press up and rotate your torso, lifting one arm toward the ceiling.
Look at your raised hand for a moment.
Bring the hand back down and lower for the next rep.
Alternate sides each rep.
description: A kneeling push-up that ends with a rotation and one arm reaching up. It trains the chest and trunk control.

name: 单腿低箱深蹲
instructions: Stand in front of a low box or bench on one leg.
Extend the other leg forward and raise your arms for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg squat down to a low box, giving you a target depth. It builds single-leg strength and balance.

name: 单腿触脚跟深蹲
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other foot slightly off the floor.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee to squat down.
Reach down toward the heel of your standing foot.
Keep your chest as tall as you can.
Push through your foot to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg squat where you reach down to touch the heel of the working foot. It challenges balance and leg strength.

name: 仰卧地面屈膝划船
english: lying floor row with bent knee
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a secure anchor, such as a towel around a sturdy post, with arms straight.
Pull your body toward your hands by driving the elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your hips on or near the floor.
description: A row done lying on the floor, pulling against an anchored handle or towel, with knees bent. It works the back and biceps with no equipment.

name: 仰卧直腿踏步
instructions: Lie on your back, arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Raise one straight leg toward the ceiling.
Lower it as you raise the other leg.
Keep alternating in a slow, steady march.
Keep your back from arching.
description: Alternating straight-leg raises while lying on your back, like a slow march. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.

name: 地面毛巾滑动下拉
instructions: Kneel or lie face down with your hands on towels on a smooth floor.
Start with your arms extended overhead.
Press down and pull your arms back toward your hips, sliding the towels.
Squeeze your lats at the end.
Slide the hands back overhead with control.
Keep your core braced.
description: Slide your hands along the floor on a towel, from overhead down toward your sides. It teaches a pulldown pattern for the lats.

name: 地面毛巾滑动桥式弯举
english: sliding floor bridge curl on towel
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Lower your hips to finish the set.
description: A glute bridge with the heels on towels, sliding the feet in and out. It strongly works the hamstrings and glutes.

name: 自我辅助反向上拉
instructions: Set a sturdy bar at hip height or lower and hang beneath it with an overhand grip.
Keep your feet on the floor to help as needed.
Pull your chest toward the bar and let your hips rise.
Continue to rotate your torso up and over the bar toward your hands, as your range allows.
Reverse slowly back to the start.
Use your legs only as needed.
description: A pullover-style move hanging under a bar, with the legs helping a bit. It builds the lats and shoulder strength.

name: 全蹲灵活性练习
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders, toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down.
Press your elbows against your inner knees with hands together.
Shift gently side to side and hold the bottom.
