Keep your chest lifted.
Stand up slowly.
description: A deep squat hold with gentle movement to open the hips, ankles and lower back.

name: 前平板支撑抬腿
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift one leg a few inches without rotating your hips.
Lower it and lift the other leg.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
description: A forearm plank with alternating leg lifts. It builds core stability and glute strength.

name: 前后摆腿
instructions: Stand tall beside a wall or support and hold it for balance.
Shift your weight onto the inside leg.
Swing the outside leg forward and back in a controlled arc.
Keep your torso upright.
Increase the range gradually.
Switch legs after your reps.
description: A dynamic warm-up swinging one leg forward and back. It loosens the hips and hamstrings.

name: 肘触膝侧平板支撑卷腹
english: elbow to knee side plank crunch
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm, top hand behind your head.
Lift your hips so your body is in line.
Bring your top elbow and knee together in a crunch.
Extend back to the side plank.
Keep your hips lifted throughout.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side plank where you crunch the top elbow toward the knee. It targets the obliques and core.

name: 站姿平衡股四头肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes with knees together.
Keep your hips tucked and your chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.
description: A standing quad stretch with balance. It lengthens the front of the thigh and hips.

name: 骆驼式
instructions: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Lean back and reach for your heels if comfortable.
Let your head relax back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing evenly.
Come up slowly, leading with your chest.
description: A kneeling backbend that opens the chest, abs and front of the hips.

name: 门框自重划船
instructions: Stand in a doorway and grip both sides of the frame firmly.
Lean back with arms straight and feet close to the frame.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the frame, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.
Use a sturdy frame and a non-slip grip.
description: A row done by holding both sides of a doorframe and leaning back. It trains the back and arms.

name: 自我辅助反向腿弯举 v. 2
english: self assisted inverse leg curl v. 2
instructions: Kneel with your ankles anchored under something stable.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your torso forward slowly, using your hamstrings to resist.
Catch yourself with your hands near the floor.
Push off lightly and use your hamstrings to return.
Keep your hips extended.
description: A bodyweight Nordic-style leg curl where you lower yourself and use your hands to help back up. It builds strong hamstrings.

name: 弹力带坐姿单腿弯举
english: resistance band seated single leg curl
instructions: Sit on the floor with a band anchored in front and looped around one foot.
Extend your leg with a slight tension on the band.
Curl your heel toward your glutes, pulling against the band.
Squeeze the hamstring briefly.
Return with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: A seated leg curl with a band around the foot. It isolates the hamstrings.

name: 地面坐姿开合抬腿
english: seated in out leg raise on floor
instructions: Sit on the floor, hands behind you for support.
Lean back slightly with legs extended and lifted.
Pull your knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs back out without touching the floor.
Keep your back long and your core tight.
Breathe steadily.
description: A seated leg tuck, with legs pulled in then extended out. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.

name: 地面蛙式卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Pull your knees in while reaching your hands toward your shins.
Squeeze your abs.
Extend back out without resting on the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
description: A floor ab move where knees and arms come together in a frog-like crunch. It works the abs.

name: 弹力带鸟狗式
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a band looped under one hand and around the opposite foot.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend that arm forward and the opposite leg back against the band.
Pause, then return under control.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
description: A bird dog with a band for extra resistance, training the lower back, glutes and core stability.

name: 弹力带上身死虫式
english: resistance band upper body dead bug
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent over your hips, holding a band in both hands above your chest.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Pull one hand overhead while stretching the band.
Bring it back and alternate.
Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Move slowly.
description: A dead bug with a band held in the hands, pulling it as the arms move. It builds core stability.

name: 弹力带背后肩部拉伸
english: resistance band shoulder stretch behind the back
instructions: Stand tall holding a band behind your back with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and your hands wide.
Lift your hands away from your back gently.
Keep your chest open and your ribs down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
description: A shoulder and chest stretch holding a band behind the back. It opens the front of the shoulders.

name: 单腿地面毛巾滑动桥式弯举
english: single leg sliding floor bridge curl on towel
instructions: Lie on your back with one heel on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift the other leg straight up.
Raise your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heel away until the leg is nearly straight.
Pull the heel back toward your glutes.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg bridge curl with the heel on a towel. It's a tougher hamstring and glute exercise.

name: 地面斜向V字起
instructions: Lie on one side with legs together and an arm extended overhead.
Lift your legs and upper body at the same time.
Reach your top hand toward your feet.
Lower with control, not resting.
Keep your movement smooth.
Do your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side-lying V-up that targets the obliques.

name: 肩部后弯拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Lift your arms up behind you and open your chest.
Tilt back slightly if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
description: A gentle backbend stretch that opens the shoulders and chest.

name: 脊柱后弯拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands on your lower back.
Squeeze your glutes and push your hips forward.
Lean back gently, lifting your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright slowly.
description: A gentle backbend that stretches the spine, hips and abs.

name: 弹力带坐姿腿屈伸
instructions: Sit on a chair with a band anchored behind and looped around one ankle.
Start with your knee bent to 90 degrees.
Extend your leg until it is straight.
Squeeze the quad at the top.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: A seated leg extension with a loop band around the ankle. It isolates the quadriceps.

name: 壶铃单腿臀桥上拉
english: kettlebell single leg glute bridge pullover
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot flat, other leg raised.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Lower the kettlebell back overhead in an arc.
Bring it back up as you hold the bridge.
Lower your hips, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg glute bridge with a kettlebell pullover, working glutes and lats.

name: 双腿凳上臀桥(男)
english: glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
instructions: 坐在长凳边缘，背靠着长凳，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在臀部旁边的长凳上以获得支撑。
收紧臀肌和腿筋，然后将臀部抬离长凳，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight glute bridge with the shoulders on a bench and both feet on the floor. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 弹力带水平帕洛夫推举加弹力带深蹲
english: band horizontal pallof press with resistance band squat
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on, holding it at your chest.
Squat down, keeping your torso tall.
Stand and press the band straight out in front.
Resist the band trying to rotate you.
Bring your hands back to your chest.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A squat combined with a Pallof press. It builds leg strength with anti-rotation core work.

name: 地雷杆跪姿单臂肩上推举
english: landmine kneeling one arm shoulder press
instructions: Kneel facing the end of a landmine barbell.
Hold the end at shoulder height with one hand.
Keep your core tight and torso upright.
Press the end up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower with control.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.
description: A kneeling single-arm press with a landmine. It trains the shoulders and builds core stability.

name: 跪姿胸椎灵活性练习
instructions: Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow toward the opposite arm.
Open up and rotate toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes.
Do your reps, then switch sides.
description: A kneeling rotation drill for upper back mobility.

name: 下犬式触脚尖
instructions: Start in a downward facing dog, hips high.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Reach one hand back to touch the opposite foot.
Return the hand and switch sides.
Keep your hips high.
Move slowly with steady breathing.
description: A downward dog with alternating hand-to-toe taps. It stretches the hamstrings and calves.

name: 下犬式脊柱灵活性练习
instructions: Start in a downward facing dog.
Bend one knee, then the other, pedaling gently.
Shift your hips side to side.
Let your spine twist a little.
Keep your hands pressed into the floor.
Breathe slowly.
description: A downward dog flowing with gentle spine movement. It loosens the back and hamstrings.

name: 地雷杆站起高抬膝
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at your chest.
Stand from a squat, driving through your legs.
Raise one knee high as you stand.
Lower the foot and squat again.
Keep the barbell close to your chest.
Alternate legs each rep.
description: A landmine move combining a stand-up with a high knee drive. It trains the legs and core.

name: 杠铃弹力带深蹲
instructions: Set the bands on the rack and barbell.
Rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your heels.
Brace your core throughout.
description: A barbell squat with bands attached to increase tension at the top.

name: 交替出拳
instructions: Stand with a staggered stance and fists up.
Punch forward with one arm, rotating your torso slightly.
Pull it back as you punch with the other.
Keep your core tight.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.
description: Alternating punches at a steady pace to raise the heart rate.

name: 拳击手滑步
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft.
Shift your weight from foot to foot.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your hands up like a guard.
Keep it light and quick for 30-60 seconds.
Rest briefly and repeat.
description: A light-footed shuffle used by boxers to keep the heart rate up.

name: 股四头肌
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低身体，就像坐在椅子上一样。
保持挺胸、背部挺直。
降低身体直到大腿与地面平行。
推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A bodyweight squat variation focused on the front of the thighs. It trains the quads and glutes.

name: 自重站姿脉冲提踵
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a support for balance.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet.
Pulse up and down in small movements.
Keep your knees straight.
Lower fully when you finish.
Keep the movement controlled.
description: A standing calf raise with small pulses at the top. It builds calf endurance.

name: 自重脉冲深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until thighs are parallel.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Keep your weight on your heels.
Stand up fully to finish.
description: A squat held at the bottom with small pulses. It burns the quads and glutes.

name: 三椅间抬高反向划船
instructions: Set a bar across two stable chairs and place a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it overhand.
Put your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.
description: A harder inverted row with the feet elevated on a third chair. It builds the back and arms.

name: 三椅间抬高反手握反向划船
english: elevated inverted underhand grip row between 3 chairs
instructions: Set a bar across two stable chairs and a third chair at your feet.
Lie under the bar and grip it underhand.
Place your heels on the third chair.
Pull your chest to the bar with elbows close.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your body straight.
description: An inverted row with an underhand grip and elevated feet. It emphasises the lats and biceps.

name: 椅间反手握反向划船
english: inverted underhand grip row between chairs
instructions: Set a bar across two stable chairs.
Lie under it and grip underhand.
Keep your legs straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body in a line.
description: An inverted row with an underhand grip on a bar between two chairs.

name: 仰卧胸椎灵活性拉伸
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms in front.
Lift your top arm and open it toward the other side.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the start.
Switch sides.
description: A lying rotation stretch for the upper back.

name: 跪姿胸椎灵活性拉伸
instructions: Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to start.
Switch sides.
description: A kneeling thoracic rotation stretch.

name: 哑铃上斜Y字上举
instructions: 将上斜凳摆成 45 度角，坐在上面，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内。
稍微向前倾，让手臂伸直垂下，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
将手臂向两侧抬起并呈 Y 形，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell raise on an incline bench, lifting the arms into a Y shape. It trains the lower traps and upper back.

name: 哑铃上斜T字上举
instructions: 将上斜凳摆成 45 度角，坐在上面，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内。
向前倾斜，让手臂笔直向下垂，垂直于地板。
保持手臂伸直，将它们向两侧举起，直到与地板平行，与身体形成“T”形。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell raise on an incline bench, lifting the arms into a T shape. It trains the rear delts and upper back.

name: 自重落地跳深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性地跳起来，伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝。
在半空中时，快速将双脚并拢。
脚掌轻轻着地，然后立即回到蹲姿。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A squat that ends with an explosive jump, bringing the feet together in the air. It builds leg power and cardio.

name: 自重上斜侧平板支撑
instructions: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
将前臂放在肩膀正下方的地面上，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
启动你的核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头到脚形成一条直线。
保持此位置所需的时间。
将臀部放回到地面，然后在另一侧重复。
description: A side plank held on an incline, resting on the forearm with the body in a straight line. It trains the obliques and core.

name: 哑铃上斜交替推举
instructions: 坐在上斜凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
向后靠在长凳上，用大腿帮助将哑铃举至肩高，手掌朝前。
到达肩膀高度后，旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
用胸部和肩膀将哑铃向上推，充分伸展手臂。
将哑铃放回起始位置，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
重复所需的重复次数，交替手臂。
description: A dumbbell press on an incline bench, with the arms alternating. It trains the upper chest and shoulders.

name: 哑铃坐姿交替肩推
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内，将哑铃举至肩高。
将一个哑铃举过头顶，同时将另一个哑铃保持在与肩同高的位置。
将举起的哑铃放回肩高，同时将另一个哑铃推过头顶。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。
description: A seated dumbbell shoulder press with the arms alternating. It trains the delts and triceps.

name: 哑铃坐姿二头弯举至肩上推举
english: dumbbell seated biceps curl to shoulder press
instructions: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
前臂垂直后，旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
将哑铃推过头顶，直到手臂完全伸展。
通过反向运动将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated dumbbell curl that flows straight into an overhead press. It trains the biceps and shoulders in one rep.

name: 哑铃单臂过头负重行走
instructions: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，一手握住哑铃。
将哑铃举过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
向前行走时，启动核心肌群并保持背部挺直，将哑铃举过头顶。
继续步行所需的距离或时间。
交换双手并重复练习。
description: A one-handed overhead carry, walking while holding a dumbbell above your head. It trains the shoulders, core and balance.

name: 椅间坐姿引体向上
instructions: Set a bar across two sturdy chairs.
Sit on the floor beneath it and grip the bar.
Keep your legs bent for light help.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower with control.
Use your legs as little as possible.
description: A seated pull-up using a bar between two chairs, with the legs assisting.

name: 侧向折返跑
instructions: Stand with knees bent in an athletic stance.
Shuffle to one side in quick steps.
Touch the floor or change direction.
Shuffle back the other way.
Keep your chest up.
Keep up the pace for 30-60 seconds.
description: A lateral shuttle run at speed to raise the heart rate.

name: 快速小步跑 v. 2
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
首先快速上下移动双脚，就像原地跑步一样。
保持动作快速而轻盈，重点放在脚掌上。
继续所需的持续时间或重复次数。
description: A quick on-the-spot footwork drill with fast, light steps. It raises the heart rate and builds foot speed.

name: 旋转俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press up and rotate, reaching one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the hand to the floor.
Lower again for the next rep.
Alternate sides.
description: A push-up with a rotation and arm reach at the top. It works the chest and trunk.

name: 瓶装锤式弯举
instructions: Hold a filled bottle in each hand with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl the bottles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid swinging.
description: A hammer curl with water bottles as light weights. It trains the biceps and forearms.

name: 爆发式推离
instructions: Stand facing a wall and lean in with arms extended.
Push away from the wall forcefully.
Retract your shoulder blades as you reach back.
Return to the wall with control.
Keep your core tight.
Reset between reps.
description: An explosive push away from a wall or support to train the upper back.

name: 高抬腿跑
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Run in place, driving your knees up toward waist height.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest tall.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.
description: A running-in-place move with high knees. It raises the heart rate.

name: 跪姿宽距俯卧撑
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place your hands wider than your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Do not let your hips sag.
description: A kneeling push-up with the hands wider apart. It puts more emphasis on the chest.

name: 毛巾仰卧二头弯举
instructions: Lie on your back and hold a towel in both hands, arms extended.
Pull the towel taut and curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms still and your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to the start.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: Lie on your back and curl a towel held in both hands toward your chest, using your own resistance to work the biceps.

name: 毛巾超人式划船
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead, holding a towel taut.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull the towel down toward your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Extend your arms forward again with control.
Keep your neck neutral and repeat.
description: Lie face down with a towel held taut overhead, lift your chest and pull the towel toward you, training the upper back and spine.

name: 哑铃站姿交替锤式弯举加推举
english: dumbbell standing alternate hammer curl and press
instructions: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持肘部靠近躯干，背部挺直。
呼气，将右手的哑铃向肩膀弯曲，保持上臂静止。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用左手重复卷发动作。
左手完成弯举后，呼气，将右手的哑铃压过头顶。
完全伸展手臂并在顶部保持片刻。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
用左手重复按压。
继续交替进行弯举和推举，达到所需的重复次数。
description: A standing dumbbell sequence that alternates hammer curls with overhead presses. It trains the biceps and shoulders.

name: 臀桥行进
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
收紧臀部并将臀部抬离地面，从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在保持臀部抬起的同时，将一只脚抬离地面，并将膝盖靠近胸部。
将脚放回地面，然后用另一条腿重复该动作。
继续交替双腿进行行进动作，同时保持桥式姿势。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A glute bridge held at the top while you alternate marching the knees. It trains the glutes and core stability.

name: 杠铃双腿凳上臀桥(男)
english: barbell glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
instructions: 首先坐在长凳边缘，上背部靠在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上，与臀部同宽。
将杠铃放在臀部上，用双手牢牢握住它。
锻炼臀肌和核心肌肉，然后用脚后跟将臀部抬离长凳，形成从膝盖到肩膀的一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压臀部。
慢慢地将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A barbell glute bridge with your upper back on a bench and a bar across the hips. It builds the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 龙门架单臂下拉
instructions: 将单个手柄连接到高滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄并完全伸展手臂。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将手柄向一侧拉，同时保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作底部暂停片刻，挤压背阔肌。
慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用另一只手臂重复练习。
description: A one arm cable pulldown from a high pulley, pulling the handle down to your side. It trains the lats.

name: 坐姿肩部屈伸收缩拉伸(屈膝)
english: seated shoulder flexor depressor retractor stretch (bent knee)
instructions: Sit on the floor with one knee bent and the other leg comfortable.
Place your hands behind you on the floor, fingers pointing away.
Slowly slide your hips forward while keeping your chest tall.
Feel the stretch in the front of your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.
description: A seated stretch that opens the front of the shoulder and lengthens the muscles that lift and pull the arm.

name: 桥式瑜伽拉伸
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat near your hips.
Place your hands beside your head, palms down, fingers toward your shoulders.
Press through hands and feet to lift your hips and chest.
Straighten your arms as far as is comfortable and relax your neck.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.
description: A deep backbend where you press up from the floor, opening the chest and hips and strengthening the back of the body.

name: 滚动上背
instructions: Sit with a foam roller behind your upper back and lie back onto it.
Cross your arms over your chest and lift your hips.
Roll slowly between your shoulder blades and mid back.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths.
Avoid rolling your lower back and continue for about a minute.
description: Roll your upper back over a foam roller to loosen tight spots and improve thoracic mobility.

name: 滚动仰卧髋外旋与髋伸肌拉伸(交叉腿)
english: roll recumbent hip external rotator and hip extensor stretch (crossed leg)
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom thigh toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.
description: Lying on your back with one ankle crossed over the other knee, pull the legs in to stretch the glutes and deep hip rotators.

name: 球滚梨状肌放松
instructions: Sit on the floor and place a ball under one buttock.
Cross that ankle over the opposite knee for more access.
Shift your weight to find a tender spot and stay there.
Breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds, then roll gently.
Switch sides.
description: Use a small ball under the buttock to ease tension in the piriformis and deep hip muscles.

name: 球滚胸肌放松
instructions: Place a ball between your chest and a wall, just below the collarbone.
Lean in until you feel pressure on the chest muscle.
Roll slowly in small circles or up and down.
Hold on tender spots for a few breaths.
Switch sides after about 30-60 seconds.
description: Pin a ball between your chest and a wall to release tight pectoral muscles.

name: 球滚上斜方肌放松
instructions: Stand with your back to a wall and place a ball on top of one shoulder.
Lean into the wall to press the ball into the muscle.
Move slowly by bending your knees.
Pause on tender spots and breathe.
Switch to the other shoulder.
description: Roll a ball against a wall under the top of your shoulder to relieve tight upper trapezius muscles.

name: 壶铃全程摆荡
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, kettlebell on the floor in front.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with both hands.
Hike the bell back, then drive your hips forward to swing it overhead.
Let it fall back between your legs while hinging again.
Keep your back flat and repeat in a smooth rhythm.
description: An explosive hip hinge that swings the kettlebell overhead, training the glutes, hamstrings and shoulders.

name: 壶铃严格推举
instructions: Hold the kettlebell at shoulder height in the rack position.
Stand tall with glutes and abs tight.
Press the bell straight overhead until your arm is locked out.
Lower it back to the shoulder under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A standing overhead press with a kettlebell and no leg drive, focused on shoulder strength.

name: 壶铃索茨推举
instructions: Hold kettlebells in the rack position and sink into a deep squat.
Keep your chest up and heels flat.
Press the bells overhead while staying in the squat.
Lower them back to the shoulders with control.
Stand up and repeat once the set is done.
description: Press kettlebells overhead from the bottom of a deep squat to challenge shoulder stability and hip mobility.

name: 壶铃前弓步
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs for the set.
description: A lunge stepping forward while holding a kettlebell, working the thighs and glutes.

name: 壶铃后弓步
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and torso tall.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Alternate legs for the set.
description: A reverse lunge holding a kettlebell, friendly on the knees while building glutes and thighs.

name: 壶铃农夫行走
instructions: Stand between two kettlebells and pick them up with a flat back.
Stand tall with shoulders back and arms straight.
Walk with short, controlled steps.
Keep your core braced and avoid leaning.
Set the weights down carefully after the distance.
description: Walk while holding heavy kettlebells at your sides to build grip, posture and total body stability.

name: 壶铃弓步翻举推举
instructions: Start standing with a kettlebell hanging in one hand.
Step back into a lunge while cleaning the bell to your shoulder.
Rise from the lunge and press the bell overhead.
Lower the bell to the shoulder, then to your side.
Alternate legs and switch hands after the set.
description: Combine a lunge with a kettlebell clean and overhead press for a full body strength move.

name: 壶铃弹弓
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and hold the kettlebell in one hand.
Pass it behind your back to the other hand.
Bring it around your waist to the front.
Keep your hips square and core tight.
Repeat in the same direction, then reverse.
description: Pass a kettlebell around your waist in a circle to build core control and coordination.

name: 壶铃地面深蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and squat down.
Sit back and roll onto your back, keeping the bell close.
Use momentum to roll forward onto your feet.
Stand up out of the squat.
Keep a tight grip and repeat smoothly.
description: Roll back onto the floor holding a kettlebell from a squat, then roll up into a squat again.

name: 壶铃深度俯卧撑
instructions: Place two kettlebells shoulder width apart and grip the handles.
Set up in a straight plank position.
Lower your chest below your hands with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.
description: A push-up with hands on kettlebell handles to lower the chest deeper than the floor allows.

name: 弓步抬腿
instructions: Stand tall and step one leg forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Press up and lift the rear leg behind or beside you.
Hold briefly with your core tight.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides.
description: A lunge followed by lifting the back leg, working the glutes and balance.

name: 弓步跳
instructions: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
右脚蹬地，跳到空中，在空中改变脚的位置。
左脚向前轻柔落地，并立即将身体降低至弓步位置。
继续在弓步和跳跃之间交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A lunge followed by a jump where the legs switch in mid-air. It builds leg power and raises your heart rate.

name: 单腿桥式屈髋
english: single leg bridge with hip flexion
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Press through the other foot to raise your hips.
Keep your hips level and avoid arching.
Lower slowly and switch sides after the set.
description: A one-legged glute bridge with the other knee drawn up, building glute strength and pelvic control.

name: 侧桥摆臂摆腿
english: side bridge with arm leg swing
instructions: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise the top leg and arm.
Swing them toward each other under control.
Keep your hips high, then switch sides.
description: A side plank with the top arm and leg swinging, challenging the obliques and balance.

name: 单腿硬拉提膝
english: single leg deadlift with knee lift
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hinge forward as the other leg extends behind you.
Return to upright by squeezing the glute.
Drive the free knee up toward your chest.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg hip hinge that ends with a knee drive, training balance, hamstrings and glutes.

name: 剪刀腿(进阶)
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands under your hips.
Lift your head, shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Cross one leg over the other in a scissor motion.
Alternate sides in a controlled rhythm.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
description: Hold both legs low and cross them repeatedly like scissors, working the lower abs.

name: 负重单腿抬起
instructions: Wear ankle weights and get on hands and knees or lie face down.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Raise the weighted leg without swinging.
Pause at the top and squeeze.
Lower slowly and switch legs.
description: Lift one leg while loaded with ankle weight, targeting the glutes and hip extensors.

name: 原地快速摆臂
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and knees soft.
Swing both arms across your chest and open wide.
Keep your torso upright and relaxed.
Increase speed gradually.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.
description: Swing your arms quickly while standing to warm up the shoulders and raise your heart rate.

name: 原地快速小跑
instructions: Stand tall with arms bent at your sides.
Lift your knees and run lightly on the spot.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms with each step.
Keep the pace for 30-60 seconds or longer.
description: Trot in place at a quick pace to warm up and get your heart rate up.

name: 交替地面仰卧抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise one leg to about 90 degrees.
Lower it slowly and lift the other leg.
Alternate without arching your back.
description: Raise one leg at a time while lying on the floor, working the lower abs.

name: 弹力带扭转
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and hold the handle with both hands.
Stand sideways with arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the anchor.
Return under control.
Finish reps, then switch sides.
description: A standing rotation against band resistance for the obliques and core.

name: 杠铃深蹲
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
description: The classic barbell squat that builds strength in the thighs and hips.

name: 腿屈伸卷腹(稳定球)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up as you extend one leg.
Lower slowly and bend the knee.
Alternate legs for the set.
description: A crunch on a stability ball combined with extending the legs for a deep ab workout.

name: 雪橇45度窄站距腿举
english: sled 45 degrees narrow stance leg press
instructions: Sit in the sled with your back flat on the pad and feet close together on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the sled until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Press through your feet to extend your legs without locking your knees.
Keep your hips on the seat.
description: A 45 degree sled leg press with feet close together to emphasise the quads.

name: 雪橇45度宽站距腿举
english: sled 45 degrees wide stance leg press
instructions: Sit in the sled with your back flat on the pad and feet wide on the platform, toes slightly out.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the sled with your knees tracking over your toes.
Press back up without locking your knees.
Keep your hips on the seat.
description: A 45 degree sled leg press with a wide foot position that brings in the inner thighs and glutes.

name: 扭转卷腹(直臂)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms straight up.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to reach one side.
Return to center and twist the other way.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
description: A crunch with a twist and arms extended to work the abs and obliques.

name: V字起
instructions: Lie flat with arms extended overhead.
Raise legs and torso at the same time.
Reach your hands toward your toes.
Lower with control without touching the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
description: Lift your legs and torso together to form a V, a demanding core move.

name: 垂直抬腿(双杠) v. 3
english: vertical leg raise (on parallel bars) v. 3
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders down.
Let your legs hang together.
Raise your legs in front of you until they are about parallel to the floor or higher.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep your torso still.
description: Support yourself on parallel bars and lift your legs to train the lower abs and hip flexors.

name: 站姿腘绳肌和背部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with a long spine.
Let your arms hang toward the floor.
Keep your knees soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.
description: Fold forward from standing to lengthen the hamstrings and lower back.

name: 坐姿相扑灵活性拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs spread wide.
Keep your back straight and toes pointing up.
Lean forward from the hips.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Stay for 20-30 seconds, then return slowly.
description: Sit with legs wide and lean forward to open the inner thighs and hips.

name: 坐姿相扑向右扭转拉伸
instructions: Sit with legs spread wide and back tall.
Rotate your torso to the right.
Reach both hands toward your right foot.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.
description: From a wide seated position, twist toward the right leg to stretch the inner thigh and torso.

name: 坐姿相扑向左扭转拉伸
instructions: Sit with legs spread wide and back tall.
Rotate your torso to the left.
Reach both hands toward your left foot.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.
description: From a wide seated position, twist toward the left leg to stretch the inner thigh and torso.

name: 坐姿相扑双臂上举灵活性拉伸
english: sitting sumo with arms up mobility stretch
instructions: Sit with legs spread wide and back straight.
Raise both arms overhead.
Lean forward slowly from the hips.
Keep your arms extended and your chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then sit tall.
description: A wide seated stretch with arms overhead to open the hips, inner thighs and shoulders.

name: 哑铃对侧前弓步
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
右脚向前迈出一步，保持背部挺直并启动核心。
弯曲双膝降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
左腿重复上述动作。
交替腿进行所需的重复次数。
description: A dumbbell lunge stepping forward with the opposite arm movement. It trains the glutes, quads and balance.

name: 靠墙高抬腿
instructions: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在墙上以获得支撑。
启动你的核心并将右膝抬向胸部，同时将左脚保持在地面上。
快速换腿，将左膝抬向胸部，然后将右脚放低。
继续交替双腿进行跑步动作，将膝盖尽可能抬高。
在整个练习过程中保持快节奏并保持上半身稳定。
重复所需的持续时间或重复次数。
description: A high-knee run in place with the hands on a wall for support. It raises the heart rate and trains the hip flexors.

name: 滚轮跑
instructions: 从平板支撑位置开始，双手放在方向盘上，身体伸直。
启动你的核心并通过伸展双臂开始向前滚动轮子。
继续滚动，直到身体完全伸展并且手臂举过头顶。
使用你的核心和手臂将轮子拉回你的身体，从而扭转运动。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A fast running motion while holding on to a wheel. It raises your heart rate and challenges the core and shoulders.

name: 推进跑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开与肩同宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部压向地面，保持身体伸直。
用手推动以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
快速将一个膝盖靠近胸部，然后快速切换并将另一只膝盖靠近胸部。
继续尽可能快地交替膝盖，同时保持良好的姿势。
继续所需的持续时间或重复次数。
description: A push-up that flows into fast alternating knee drives in the plank position. It raises the heart rate and trains the chest and core.

name: 屈膝仰卧扭转(男)
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将手臂向两侧伸展，与身体垂直。
保持膝盖并拢，慢慢地将它们降低到一侧，旨在用膝盖接触地面。
暂停片刻，然后启动核心并慢慢将膝盖抬回到起始位置。
到另一侧重复该动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A lying twist with the knees bent, lowering them to each side. It loosens the lower back and hips.

name: 触膝卷腹
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，并将右手伸向左膝盖。
返回起始位置并重复，这次将左手伸向右膝盖。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A crunch where the opposite hand reaches toward the knee on each rep. It trains the abs and obliques.

name: 负重跪姿上步摆荡
instructions: 从跪姿开始，膝盖分开与臀部同宽，背部挺直。
每只手各握一个重物，双臂在身前笔直向下伸展。
启动你的核心肌群，将重物向上举过头顶，保持手臂伸直。
将重量放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。
description: A kneeling step combined with a weighted swing. It trains the shoulders and core.

name: 负重拉伸弓步
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，保持背部挺直。
弯曲膝盖降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
左腿重复上述动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
description: A weighted lunge into a deep stretch for the hips. It trains the glutes and quads while opening up the hip flexors.

name: 负重哥萨克深蹲(男)
instructions: 站立时双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾稍微向外。
用双手将重物放在胸前。
将您的体重转移到一侧，并通过弯曲您转移一侧的膝盖来降低身体，同时保持另一条腿伸直。
尽可能降低身体高度，同时保持平衡并挺胸。
推动弯曲腿的脚跟以返回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，双腿之间交替。
description: A weighted side-to-side squat, shifting weight deeply over one leg with the other straight. It trains the glutes, quads and adductors.

name: 负重弓步摆荡
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个重物。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你向前冲时，向前和向上摆动重物，保持手臂伸直。
用右脚推出并返回到起始位置，将重物向下摆动。
用左脚重复上述动作，并继续交替双腿，完成所需的重复次数。
description: A weighted lunge with an arm swing as you step forward. It trains the glutes, quads and shoulders.

name: 单腿桥式伸腿
english: single leg bridge with outstretched leg
instructions: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将一条腿伸直在您面前。
收紧臀部并将臀部抬离地面，从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部保持片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿。
description: A single leg glute bridge with the other leg held straight out. It trains the glutes and hamstrings and tests the core.

name: 跳箱
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder width apart.
Swing your arms back and dip your hips.
Jump up and land softly on top of the box.
Stand fully upright.
Step down carefully and reset.
description: An explosive jump onto a box that builds leg power.

name: 哑铃罗马尼亚硬拉死亡行进
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand tall.
Hinge at the hips on one leg as you step forward.
Keep your back flat and raise the rear leg.
Stand tall and step into the next rep.
Alternate legs as you move forward.
description: Walk forward doing Romanian deadlifts with dumbbells, a balance and hamstring challenge.

name: 六角杠分腿罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions: Stand inside a trap bar with one foot slightly behind.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Lower the bar along your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Finish reps, then switch the stance.
description: A Romanian deadlift in a staggered stance using a trap bar for hamstring and glute strength.

name: 弹力带辅助短跑跑步
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around your waist.
Lean forward into a sprint position.
Drive your knees and pump your arms.
Stay light on your feet.
Repeat for short bursts.
description: A sprinting drill with band assistance to practice fast leg turnover.

name: 杠铃架上俯卧划船
instructions: Set a barbell on a rack at a height you can reach lying down.
Lie under it and grip the bar overhand.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to full extension.
description: Lie under a barbell on a rack and pull your chest up to it for the back muscles.

name: 高抬膝行走弓步
instructions: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立。
将右膝尽可能高地抬向胸部，同时用左腿保持平衡。
右脚向前迈出一步，身体降低成弓步姿势，双膝弯曲成 90 度角。
用右脚推出，并将左膝抬向胸部。
左脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
继续交替双腿并向前冲刺，保持核心参与并保持稳定的步伐。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A walking lunge with a high knee between each step. It raises your heart rate and trains the legs.

name: 小步幅跑
instructions: 找一个空地或跑步机来进行锻炼。
站直，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
开始原地慢跑，抬起膝盖并挥动手臂。
几秒钟后，开始小步前进，保持快速的步伐。
继续小步跑所需的时间或距离。
description: A run with short, quick strides. It raises the heart rate and builds foot speed.

name: 静态姿势仰卧靠垫
english: static position lying back with pad
instructions: Place a pad on the floor or bench.
Lie on your back with your head supported.
Keep your spine neutral.
Relax your arms at your sides.
Hold the position and breathe.
description: Hold a lying position on your back with a pad as a reference for setup and posture.

name: 静态姿势坐姿靠垫
english: static position seated back with pad
instructions: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press your back gently into the pad.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold the position and breathe.
description: Sit with your back against a pad to hold a proper seated posture.

name: 静态姿势站立
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your knees soft.
Stack ribs over hips and shoulders back.
Let your arms hang.
Hold and breathe steadily.
description: Hold a tall standing posture as a reference position.

name: 静态姿势俯卧
instructions: Lie face down on a mat.
Extend your legs and rest your forehead down.
Keep your arms alongside your body.
Keep your hips relaxed.
Hold and breathe.
description: Hold a face-down position to practice setting up for prone exercises.

name: 静态姿势坐姿靠背
instructions: Sit tall with feet flat on the floor.
Keep your back straight.
Place your hands on your thighs.
Relax your shoulders.
Hold and breathe.
description: Hold an upright seated posture with no pad.

name: 屈体转眼镜蛇俯卧撑
instructions: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
收紧核心肌群，将臀部抬向天花板，与身体形成倒V字形。
弯曲肘部，使上半身靠近地面，使上半身靠近地面。
当你下降时，将你的重心向前移动，并通过伸直手臂并抬起胸部来过渡到眼镜蛇姿势。
通过弯曲肘部并将胸部放回到地面来扭转运动。
双手用力推回到倒V字形。
通过将臀部放回地面继续运动，回到起始俯卧撑位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A push-up flow that moves from pike position down and through to a cobra. It trains the shoulders, chest and spine mobility.

name: 反向平板支撑抬腿
instructions: 坐在地上，双腿向前伸展，双手放在身后的地面上，手指指向脚部。
双手用力，将臀部抬离地面，进入反向平板支撑位置。
启动你的核心并将一条腿抬离地面，将其笔直向上伸向天花板。
保持一会儿，然后将腿放下。
换另一条腿重复上述步骤。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
description: A reverse plank where you lift one leg at a time. It trains the abs, glutes and the back of the body.

name: 哑铃侧平板支撑后束飞鸟
english: dumbbell side plank with rear fly
instructions: 首先侧躺，双腿伸展并叠放在一起。
将前臂放在肩膀正下方的地面上，保持肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
用你的上手握住哑铃，手臂垂直向下伸向地面。
收紧核心并将臀部抬离地面，从头部到脚后跟形成一条直线。
在保持侧平板支撑位置的同时，将哑铃向天花板方向举起，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A dumbbell side plank with a reverse fly. It trains the rear delts, upper back and obliques.

name: 力量点平板支撑
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
启动你的核心并挤压你的臀肌以保持稳定的位置。
将身体放低到前臂上，一次一只手臂，从头到脚保持一条直线。
保持这个姿势所需的时间，保持核心肌群和臀肌的参与。
要返回到起始位置，请推动前臂并将身体抬回到高位平板支撑位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A plank where you shift from your hands to your forearms and back, one arm at a time. It trains the abs and shoulders.

name: 坡度跑步机行走
instructions: 将跑步机的倾斜度调整到您想要的强度。
站在跑步机上，双脚分开与肩同宽。
开始以舒适的步伐行走，确保保持正确的姿势。
在整个练习过程中，调动核心肌肉并保持背部挺直。
继续在倾斜跑步机上行走，完成有氧运动所需的时间。
逐渐降低跑步机的坡度和速度，使其冷却后再停止。
description: A walk on a treadmill with an incline, which makes the glutes and calves work harder. A steady, low impact cardio option.

name: 侧卧髋内收(男)
instructions: 侧躺，双腿伸直并叠放在一起。
将下臂放在头下方以获得支撑。
启动内收肌并尽可能高地抬起上面的腿，但不要旋转臀部或向后倾斜。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
description: A side-lying leg exercise that targets the inner thighs. It trains the adductors and hip stability.

name: 哑铃躺地胸推
english: dumbbell lying on floor chest press
instructions: Lie on the floor holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your wrists straight.
description: A dumbbell press performed lying on the floor, which limits the range of motion and is easy on the shoulders.

name: 站姿弓步拉弓
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双臂伸直至前方，与肩同高，与地面平行。
将躯干向右旋转，保持双臂伸展，背部挺直。
旋转时，向前伸展右臂，向后伸展左臂，模仿拉弓弦的动作。
保持该姿势片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复该动作，这次将躯干向左旋转，左臂向前伸展，右臂向后伸展。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。
description: A standing movement that rotates the torso and draws one arm back like pulling a bow. It mobilises the upper back and shoulders.

name: 负重下斜仰卧起坐
instructions: 平躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
将双手放在脑后或放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离长凳，向前卷曲，直到躯干垂直于地面。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A weighted sit-up on a decline bench. It trains the abs through a long range.

name: 滑雪步
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖并保持背部挺直。
跳到右侧，右脚着地，同时将左腿摆动到右腿后面。
立即向左侧跳，左脚着地，同时将右腿摆动到左腿后面。
继续从一侧到另一侧交替跳跃，模仿滑雪动作。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A side-to-side hopping drill that imitates a skier. It raises the heart rate and builds leg stamina.

name: 前后步
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，弯曲膝盖，将身体降低到弓步位置。
用右脚蹬地，然后回到起始位置。
用左脚重复该动作，每一步交替双腿。
继续来回走动，保持稳定的步伐。
重复所需的持续时间或重复次数。
description: A stepping drill moving forward and back with the legs alternating. It raises the heart rate and warms up the legs.

name: 站姿(姿势检查)正面
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your knees soft and hips level.
Stack your shoulders over your hips.
Look straight ahead.
Compare yourself to the correct posture.
description: A front-view form check showing a correct standing posture.

name: 站姿(姿势检查)侧面
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your ears over your shoulders and hips.
Keep a natural curve in your lower back.
Relax your arms.
Compare yourself to the correct posture.
description: A side-view form check showing a correct standing posture.

name: 左右跳绳
instructions: Hold the rope handles and stand tall.
Swing the rope overhead.
Hop side to side over the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.
description: Jump rope while hopping side to side to raise your heart rate and improve agility.

name: 跳步跳绳
instructions: Hold the rope handles and swing the rope overhead.
Skip over the rope, alternating feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Continue at a steady pace.
description: Jump rope with an alternating skip step for a lighter, rhythmic cardio workout.

name: 高抬腿跳绳
instructions: Hold the rope handles and swing the rope overhead.
Run over the rope.
Lift your knees to hip height.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your torso upright.
description: Jump rope while driving your knees high for a hard cardio effort.

name: 高跳跳绳
instructions: Hold the rope handles and stand tall.
Swing the rope overhead.
Jump higher than usual.
Land softly with bent knees.
Keep your rhythm.
description: Jump rope with higher jumps to add power and intensity.

name: 双臂抱胸仰卧起坐
instructions: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
双臂交叉于胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，靠近膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A sit-up with the arms crossed on the chest. It trains the abs and hip flexors.

name: 壶铃正手握摆荡
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and grip the handle with an overhand grip.
Hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back and hinge again, keeping your back flat.
description: A kettlebell swing with an overhand grip that builds explosive hip power and a strong posterior chain.

name: 哑铃夹紧卧推
instructions: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze them together throughout.
Lower them to your chest.
Press back up.
Keep your feet planted.
description: A bench press with dumbbells pressed together to keep constant tension in the chest.

name: 哑铃上斜交替二头弯举
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging down.
Curl one dumbbell up with the palm facing up.
Lower it slowly.
Curl the other arm.
Keep your upper arms still.
description: Curl dumbbells one at a time while lying back on an incline bench to stretch and work the biceps.

name: 哑铃高脚杯屈膝礼弓步
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step one leg behind and across the other.
Lower until both knees bend.
Press through the front leg to return.
Alternate legs for the set.
description: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and step behind and across into a curtsey lunge.

name: 哑铃外旋
instructions: Lie on your side with a dumbbell in the top hand and elbow bent.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Rotate your forearm upward.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after the set.
description: A light external rotation for the rotator cuff.

name: 哑铃胸部支撑侧平举
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.
description: Lateral raises with your chest on an incline bench to remove cheating and isolate the delts.

name: 哑铃跪姿保持至站起
instructions: Kneel on both knees holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneel.
Drive through that foot to stand.
Lower back into the kneeling position.
Alternate lead legs.
description: Move from a kneeling position to standing while holding a dumbbell.

name: 哑铃拖曳弯举
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Pull your elbows back slightly and curl the weights up, keeping them close to your body.
Squeeze your biceps at the top without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso still and avoid swinging.
description: A curl where the dumbbells travel up close to your torso, dragging along your body. It keeps tension on the biceps and limits shoulder swing.

name: 哑铃坐姿反握二头弯举
english: dumbbell seated reverse grip biceps curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down, arms hanging at your sides.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and curl the weights up.
Stop when your forearms are near vertical and your wrists stay straight.
Lower the dumbbells slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Use a lighter weight than a normal curl.
description: A seated curl with an overhand grip that hits the forearms and brachialis hard along with the biceps.

name: 哑铃坐姿单臂前平举
english: dumbbell seated one arm front raise
instructions: Sit upright on a bench holding a dumbbell in one hand, arm down at your thigh.
Raise the dumbbell straight in front of you to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower it slowly back to your thigh.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A seated single-arm raise that targets the front of the shoulder without leg drive helping out.

name: 哑铃健身球坐姿肩上推举
english: dumbbell seated on exercise ball shoulder press
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet wide and a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and sit tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them back to shoulder height with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.
description: An overhead press on a stability ball. The unstable seat makes your core work along with the shoulders.

name: 哑铃高脚杯分腿蹲
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest and step into a split stance.
Keep your torso tall and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Stop when your front thigh is about parallel to the ground.
Push through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A split squat holding one dumbbell at your chest. Great for working each leg on its own while the front load keeps you upright.

name: 哑铃高脚杯箱式深蹲
instructions: Place a box or bench behind you and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Push your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knees in line with your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand up without rocking.
description: A goblet squat that touches a box behind you, teaching depth control and sitting back into your hips.

name: 哑铃凳上支撑外旋
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench with a light dumbbell in your top hand, elbow bent 90 degrees at your side.
Keep your elbow tucked against your ribs.
Rotate your forearm upward, lifting the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A light rotation exercise lying on a bench that strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles around the shoulder.

name: 哑铃上斜交替反向飞鸟
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Raise one arm out to the side with a soft elbow until it is level with your shoulder.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then lower slowly.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your neck relaxed and avoid swinging.
description: A chest-supported reverse fly done one arm at a time, aimed at the rear delts and upper back.

name: 哑铃交替卧推(高位起始)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and press both dumbbells up above your chest.
Keep one arm locked out and lower the other dumbbell to chest level.
Press it back up to the top.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating each rep.
Keep your feet planted and your back flat on the bench.
description: A dumbbell bench press where you press one arm at a time, starting with both weights held high. It challenges chest strength and stability.

name: 哑铃俯身交替后三角肌飞鸟
english: dumbbell bent over alternate rear delt fly
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, a dumbbell in each hand hanging down.
Raise one arm out to the side to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso still and your neck neutral.
description: A bent-over fly performed one arm at a time to target the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: 龙门架跪姿后三角肌划船(绳索)(男)
english: cable kneeling rear delt row (with rope) (male)
instructions: 将绳索手柄连接到低电缆滑轮上，面向机器跪下。
以中立握法（手掌相对）抓住绳子，并将双臂完全伸展到身前。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，通过收缩肩胛骨将绳子拉向身体。
在动作结束时将肩胛骨挤压在一起并保持短暂的停顿。
慢慢释放张力并回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A kneeling cable row with a rope that targets the rear delts. It trains the shoulders and upper back.

name: 尺蠖爬行 v. 2
instructions: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
腰部向前弯曲，双手放在身前的地面上。
双手向前移动，直到处于高位平板支撑位置，身体从头到脚成一条直线。
保持双腿伸直，将脚移向双手，将臀部抬向天花板。
继续向前移动双手，重复该动作达到所需的重复次数。
description: An inchworm walk-out, walking the hands forward into a plank and the feet back in. It stretches the hamstrings and trains the core and shoulders.

name: 拍肩
instructions: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
启动你的核心并将右手抬离地面，伸手拍打你的左肩。
将右手放回地面，然后用左手轻拍右肩，重复此操作。
继续交替轻拍肩膀，同时保持臀部和躯干稳定。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A high plank where you tap the opposite shoulder with each hand. It trains the abs and builds shoulder stability.

name: 团身跳 v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms up.
Jump as high as you can and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Reset briefly and repeat.
description: An explosive jump where you pull your knees toward your chest in the air. It builds power and gets your heart rate up quickly.

name: 高抬腿冲刺
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Start running in place, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your chest up.
Go hard for 20 to 30 seconds, then rest.
description: Running in place at full speed with your knees driving high. A quick way to raise your heart rate and warm up your legs.

name: 前脉冲弓步双手过头
english: forward pulse lunge with hands overhead
instructions: Stand tall and raise both arms straight overhead.
Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Pulse up and down a few inches in the low position.
Push back to standing.
Switch legs and repeat.
description: A forward lunge held in the bottom position where you pulse up and down with your arms overhead. It burns the legs and challenges balance.

name: 青蛙跳爬
instructions: Start in a deep squat with your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Hop your feet to the outside of your hands.
Stand up or jump up from the squat.
Repeat at a steady quick pace.
description: A fast floor drill where you hop your feet out and in from a squat to a plank. It works your legs, core and heart at once.

name: 双次跳跃深蹲
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat and explode into a jump.
Land softly and immediately jump a second time.
Land with bent knees and sink back into the squat.
Keep your chest up and repeat.
description: A squat followed by two quick jumps in a row. It builds explosive leg power and stamina.

name: 深蹲伸腿
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Kick your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Stand up and repeat at a steady pace.
description: A burpee without the push-up and jump. You drop to a plank and spring back to your feet for a steady conditioning move.

name: 深蹲团身跳
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat with your arms back.
Explode upward and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly with bent knees.
Sink straight into the next squat and repeat.
description: A squat that explodes into a tuck jump. It trains explosive leg power and fast landings.

name: 哑铃推举深蹲(大腿)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.
description: A squat combined with an overhead press. The legs drive the movement while the shoulders finish the press.

name: 有氧弓步
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips or swinging with the movement.
Step forward and lower into a lunge.
Push off the front foot and return to standing.
Switch legs and keep a quick rhythm.
Keep your torso upright throughout.
description: Lunges done at a brisk pace to lift your heart rate while working the legs.

name: 哑铃过头深蹲
instructions: Press two dumbbells overhead with your arms straight.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a squat while keeping the weights above your head.
Keep your chest up and ribs down.
Stand back up, driving through your heels.
description: A squat with dumbbells held locked out overhead. It builds leg strength and demands strong shoulders and core.

name: 哑铃分腿蹲前脚抬高(波速球)
english: dumbbell split squat front foot elevated with bosu ball
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a bosu ball, back foot behind you.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through your front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A split squat with the front foot on a bosu ball for a deeper range and extra balance work.

name: 单腿上台阶 v. 2
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench.
Place one foot fully on it.
Drive through that heel to stand tall on the box.
Lower slowly back down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: Step up onto a box or bench with one leg to build single-leg strength.

name: 站姿单腿提踵(扶持)
english: standing single leg calf raise with support
instructions: Stand on one foot and hold a wall or rail for balance.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your foot.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly below flat if you can do so comfortably.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: Raise your heel on one leg while holding a support for balance, building the calf.

name: 哑铃站姿单腿提踵 v. 2
english: dumbbell standing single leg calf raise v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg, lightly touching a wall for balance.
Rise up onto the ball of your foot as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heel slowly below the start if possible.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-legged calf raise holding a dumbbell for extra load. It builds calf strength and ankle balance.

name: 单腿站立
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Lift one foot off the floor and bend the knee slightly.
Keep your hips level and eyes on a fixed point.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.
description: A simple balance hold on one leg that trains stability in the ankle, hip and core.

name: 波速球单腿站立
english: single leg stand on bosu ball
instructions: Place a bosu ball dome-up in front of you.
Step onto it with one foot near the center.
Lift your other foot and hold it off the ground.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A balance hold on one leg on an unstable bosu ball. It challenges the ankle and hip stabilisers.

name: 分腿蹲加翻滚
instructions: Start in a split stance with your torso upright.
Lower into a split squat until the front thigh is parallel.
Sit back and roll onto your back with control.
Roll up and return to the split stance.
Stand and repeat, then switch legs.
description: A split squat paired with a backward roll to challenge your control and leg strength.

name: 分腿侧蹲加翻滚
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes forward.
Shift your weight to one side and squat on that leg, keeping the other leg straight.
Roll back with control and roll up again.
Push back to the centre.
Alternate sides.
description: A lateral squat done from a split position, followed by a roll, for leg strength and coordination.

name: 龙门架站姿高位交叉三头肌伸展
english: cable standing high cross triceps extension
instructions: Set a cable to a high position and hold the handle with one hand.
Stand facing the machine with your elbow bent and tucked.
Press the handle down and across your body until your arm is straight.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm cable pushdown from a high pulley, crossing the body to isolate the triceps.

name: 楼梯跳
instructions: Stand at the bottom of a staircase with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up onto a step, landing softly with both feet.
Step back down carefully.
Reset and repeat.
description: Explosive jumps up a flight of stairs that build leg power and speed.

name: 杠铃俯身宽握划船
english: barbell bent over wide grip row
instructions: Hold a barbell with a wide overhand grip and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let the bar hang at arm length below your chest.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest, flaring your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar with control.
description: A bent-over row with a wide overhand grip that emphasises the upper back and rear delts.

name: 杠铃上斜俯卧后三角肌上举
english: barbell incline lying rear delt raise
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell hanging below you.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the bar by lifting your elbows out and back.
Squeeze your rear delts at the top.
Lower the barbell slowly.
description: A chest-supported raise with a barbell that isolates the rear shoulders.

name: 杠铃屈膝礼弓步
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand tall.
Step one leg back and across behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Alternate sides or finish one side first.
description: A lunge where you step diagonally behind you with a barbell on your back. It works the glutes and outer hips.

name: 杠铃地面胸推
instructions: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and a barbell set above your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press the bar back up to full extension.
description: A barbell press from the floor. The floor limits the range and takes pressure off your shoulders.

name: 杠铃过头弓步
instructions: Press a barbell overhead and hold it with straight arms.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push off your front foot back to standing.
Alternate legs and keep the bar steady.
description: A lunge performed with a barbell held locked out overhead. It builds leg strength and demands shoulder and core stability.

name: 杠铃坐姿前平举
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an overhand grip, resting on your thighs.
Raise the bar straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower it slowly to your thighs.
Keep your back straight and avoid swinging.
description: A seated front raise with a barbell that trains the front delts without using leg drive.

name: 杠铃凳上前蹲
instructions: Place a bench behind you and rest the bar across your front shoulders.
Keep your elbows high and your chest up.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Avoid rocking or collapsing onto the bench.
description: A front squat to a bench behind you, which helps with depth control and keeps the load in front.

name: 杠铃前置上台阶
instructions: Rack a barbell across your front shoulders and stand facing a box.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to step up and stand tall.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A step up with a barbell racked on your front shoulders, which keeps your torso upright and works the quads.

name: 杠铃稳定球胸推
english: barbell chest press on stability ball
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your upper back rests on it.
Keep your hips up and take the barbell above your chest.
Lower the bar to your chest.
Press it back up to full extension.
Keep your core tight and feet planted.
description: A barbell press with your upper back on a stability ball, which adds a core and balance challenge.

name: 杠铃背后耸肩
instructions: Stand holding a barbell behind your back with straight arms.
Keep your chest up and shoulders relaxed.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.
description: A shrug with the bar held behind your thighs, which shifts the load slightly to the mid traps.

name: 杠铃相扑罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with a wide stance and toes turned out.
Push your hips back, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
description: A romanian deadlift in a wide stance, hitting the hamstrings, glutes and inner thighs.

name: 壶铃高脚杯屈膝礼弓步
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest and stand tall.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A curtsey lunge holding a kettlebell at your chest. It targets the glutes and outer hips.

name: 壶铃直腿硬拉
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bell along your legs.
Keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
description: A stiff-legged deadlift with a kettlebell that stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.

name: 壶铃后撤步单腿硬拉
instructions: Hold a kettlebell and stand with one foot slightly behind, toes on the ground as a kickstand.
Hinge at the hips over your front leg.
Lower the bell toward the floor with a flat back.
Drive through your front heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg deadlift with the back foot lightly touching the floor for support, so you can focus on the working leg.

name: 壶铃上拉(三个月姿势)
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell with both hands above your chest.
Keep your arms slightly bent.
Lower the bell back over your head in an arc.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your lats.
Pull it back over your chest.
description: A lying pullover with a kettlebell that stretches and works the lats and chest.

name: 壶铃站姿底朝上单臂肩上推举
english: kettlebell standing bottoms up one arm shoulder press
instructions: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle and brace your core.
Press the bell straight overhead, keeping it balanced.
Lower it back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm overhead press holding the kettlebell upside down, which demands wrist and shoulder control.

name: 壶铃坐姿单臂军事推举
english: kettlebell seated one arm military press
instructions: Sit on a bench with a kettlebell held at your shoulder.
Sit tall with your core braced.
Press the bell straight overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A seated overhead press with one kettlebell, which removes leg drive and keeps the work on the shoulder.

name: 壶铃单臂卧推
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell above your chest.
Keep your wrist straight and your feet planted.
Lower the bell to the side of your chest.
Press it back up to full extension.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A bench press with one kettlebell at a time, adding stability demand for the shoulder and core.

name: 壶铃底朝上单臂卧推
english: kettlebell bottom up one arm bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell upside down above your chest.
Squeeze the handle and keep your wrist stacked.
Lower the bell slowly toward your chest.
Press it back up while keeping it balanced.
Use a light weight and switch arms after your reps.
description: A bench press holding the kettlebell upside down, which forces tight control of the shoulder and wrist.

name: 壶铃侧平举
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A lateral raise using a kettlebell, which trains the side delts.

name: 毛巾侧平举
instructions: Hold a towel with both hands and stand on its middle with one foot, or pull its ends apart.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep tension on the towel throughout.
description: A no-equipment side raise using a towel for resistance, so you can train the delts at home.

name: 地面毛巾滑动腿弯举 v. 2
english: sliding leg curl on floor with towel v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips off the ground.
Slide your heels toward your butt, curling your legs.
Slowly slide them back out.
Keep your hips high throughout.
description: A bodyweight hamstring curl where your heels slide on a towel across the floor.

name: 椅子保加利亚分腿蹲
instructions: Stand facing away from a chair and rest the top of one foot on it.
Step your front foot forward so it is stable.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg squat with your rear foot resting on a chair, which builds strength and balance.

name: 床单后三角肌飞鸟
english: rear delt fly with bed sheet
instructions: Hold a bed sheet taut in both hands in front of you.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Pull your hands apart, opening your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and keep tension on the sheet.
description: A no-equipment fly that uses a bed sheet pulled apart to work the rear shoulders.

name: 床单头上三头肌伸展
english: overhead triceps extension with bed sheet
instructions: Hold a bed sheet with both hands behind your head, one hand pulling up, one down.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Press your top hand overhead against the resistance.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then swap hand positions.
description: A home triceps exercise that uses a bed sheet as resistance.

name: 床单后三角肌划船
english: rear delt row with bed sheet
instructions: Loop a bed sheet around a sturdy anchor and hold the ends.
Lean back with your arms straight.
Pull your hands toward your chest, elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
description: A rowing pattern that uses a bed sheet anchored around a door handle or post to work the upper back.

name: 床单辅助单腿深蹲
english: assisted pistol squat with bed sheet
instructions: Hold the ends of a bed sheet anchored to a door or post.
Stand on one leg with the other leg extended forward.
Sit down on your standing leg, using the sheet as support.
Lower as far as you can control.
Push up to stand and switch legs after your reps.
description: A single-leg squat where you hold a bed sheet anchored to something sturdy for assistance.

name: 床单二头弯举
instructions: Hold a bed sheet with both hands, one arm pulling down, the other curling up.
Keep your elbow at your side.
Curl the working hand toward your shoulder against the resistance.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A bicep curl using a bed sheet and your own opposing arm for resistance.

name: 床单反向划船
instructions: Anchor a bed sheet securely and hold both ends.
Lean back with your body straight.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly.
description: A bodyweight row using a bed sheet looped around a sturdy anchor, such as a closed door.

name: 前平板支撑侧跳
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Hop both feet a short way to one side.
Hop them back to the other side.
Keep your shoulders stable and your hips low.
description: Hop your feet side to side from a high plank for a core and cardio challenge.

name: 反向俯卧撑
instructions: Sit on the floor and place your hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your hips.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows and lower your hips.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your elbows pointing back.
description: A pushup where your hands are behind you, working the triceps hard.

name: 毛巾仰卧双腿二头弯举
english: lying double legs biceps curl with towel
instructions: Lie on your back and wrap a towel around both feet, holding the ends.
Lift your legs slightly and press them against the towel.
Curl the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Lower slowly.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
description: A lying curl where you pull a towel wrapped around your feet with your hands, so your legs provide resistance.

name: 弹力带高位飞鸟
instructions: Anchor a band high and hold one end in each hand, facing away.
Step forward and lean slightly.
Bring your hands together in front of your waist with a soft elbow.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly.
description: A band chest fly from a high anchor, pulling downward to work the lower chest.

name: 杠杆站姿胸推
instructions: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住手柄，并将双手置于胸部水平。
向前推动手柄，直到手臂完全伸展，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将手柄拉回到胸部，在整个动作过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A standing chest press on a lever machine, pressing the handles forward. It builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: 杠杆坐姿早安式体前屈
instructions: 调整座椅高度，使臀部略高于膝盖。
坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在脚踏板上。
抓住把手或座椅侧面以保持稳定性。
保持背部挺直，从臀部开始慢慢向前倾斜，直到上半身与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后通过推动臀肌和腿筋慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A seated good morning on a lever machine, hinging forward at the hips and back up. It trains the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.

name: 杠杆坐姿卷腹 v. 2
instructions: 坐在杠杆机上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
将手放在把手上或座椅两侧以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前挺胸，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压腹肌。
慢慢回到起始位置，让背部稍微弯曲。
重复所需的重复次数。
description: A second take on the seated machine crunch, curling forward against resistance. It trains the abs.

name: 哑铃坐姿交替二头弯举
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms and avoid swinging.
description: Seated curls, alternating arms, to build the biceps.

name: 哑铃上斜二头弯举 v. 2
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Keep your shoulders against the bench.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Pause and squeeze.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
description: Curling from an incline bench stretches the biceps at the bottom for a deep contraction.

name: 跳跃上台阶
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Place one foot on top.
Drive through it and jump up into the air.
Land softly on the box and step back down.
Switch legs and keep a steady rhythm.
description: A step up with an explosive jump at the top, which builds leg power and raises your heart rate.

name: 哑铃单腿深蹲 v. 2
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand on one leg.
Extend your other leg in front of you.
Lower into a squat as far as you can control.
Push through your heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg squat holding a dumbbell for balance and extra load.

name: 杠杆坐姿水平腿举
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and feet on the platform.
Release the safety and press the platform away.
Stop just before your knees lock.
Lower the weight slowly until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your hips down and your back flat on the pad.
description: A seated leg press on a lever machine that builds the quads and glutes.

name: 屈膝礼深蹲
instructions: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向斜后方跨出一步，跨过身体，交叉在左腿后面。
弯曲双膝，就像行屈膝礼一样，将身体降低到地面。
保持躯干直立，将体重放在前脚上。
推动前脚返回起始位置。
在另一侧重复，用左脚斜向后方跨过身体。
description: A squat where the leg steps diagonally behind and across the body, like a curtsy. It trains the glutes and outer thighs.

name: 弹力带深蹲加单臂划船
english: band squat with single arm row
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and the band under light tension.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat while keeping your chest up.
Stand up and, at the top, pull the handle to your ribs with your elbow close to your body, then let it return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A squat combined with a one-arm band row. It trains your legs and your back together.

name: 弹力带硬拉加单臂划船
english: band deadlift with single arm row
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand with soft knees and the band under light tension.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then row the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A hip hinge paired with a one-arm band row. It works your posterior chain and your upper back.

name: 弹力带高抬膝弓步加单臂划船
english: band high knee lunge with single arm row
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Step back into a lunge and lower until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot and drive the rear knee up to hip height.
Row the handle to your ribs while balancing on one leg.
Return to the start under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A lunge that finishes with a high knee, combined with a one-arm band row. It builds leg strength and balance.

name: 弹力带单腿直腿硬拉加单臂划船
english: band single stiff leg deadlift with single arm row
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand on one leg with a soft knee and the band under light tension.
Hinge forward at the hips while the free leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat, then pull the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle and stand tall again. Finish your reps, then switch sides.
