description: A V-up holding a dumbbell, raising your torso and legs together. It trains the whole abdominal wall.

name: 哑铃直臂扭转仰卧起坐
english: dumbbell straight arm twisting sit up
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell over your chest.
Sit up while keeping your arms straight.
Twist toward one side at the top.
Return to centre and lower slowly.
Alternate sides on each rep.
Keep your feet down and movement controlled.
description: A sit-up with a rotation while holding a dumbbell on straight arms. It works the abs and obliques.

name: 负重卷腹 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a weight against your chest.
Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chin off your chest.
description: A crunch with weight held on your chest or behind your head. The added load makes the abs work harder.

name: 药球卷腹 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a medicine ball against your chest or overhead.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Reach the ball toward your knees.
Lower slowly.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
description: A crunch holding a medicine ball for extra resistance. It targets the abs with a simple, adjustable load.

name: 单腿垂直跳
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Swing your arms back.
Jump straight up as high as you can.
Land softly on the same leg.
Reset your balance.
Finish your reps and switch legs.
description: A vertical jump from one leg to build explosive power and balance. Each side gets its own work.

name: 直腿髋桥
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and heels on the floor.
Place your arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
description: A hip bridge with your legs straight and heels on the floor. It shifts more work to the hamstrings and glutes.

name: 下台阶深蹲
instructions: Stand on a step with one foot hanging off the edge.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down on the standing leg and lower the free heel to the floor.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up to the start.
Finish your reps and switch legs.
description: A single-leg squat that lowers you off a step. It builds quad strength and knee control.

name: 滑步
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than your shoulders and knees bent.
Keep your chest up and your weight on your toes.
Step sideways without crossing your feet.
Move quickly for a few steps.
Change direction and shuffle back.
Stay low throughout.
description: Quick lateral steps in an athletic stance. It builds agility, coordination and leg endurance.

name: 倒退跑
instructions: Find a clear, flat area or treadmill at a low speed.
Stand tall with your arms bent.
Run backwards, landing on the balls of your feet.
Glance over your shoulder from time to time.
Keep a steady, controlled pace.
Slow down gradually to finish.
description: Running backwards at a comfortable pace. It raises your heart rate and strengthens the quads and calves.

name: 椭圆机行走 v. 7
instructions: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles lightly.
Start moving in a smooth, walking-style stride.
Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and core braced.
Choose a moderate resistance and keep a steady pace.
Continue for 10 to 30 minutes, depending on your fitness, then cool down slowly.
description: Steady walking motion on an elliptical trainer. It is a low-impact way to raise your heart rate and build endurance.

name: 绕膝拉伸 v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet together and bend your knees slightly.
Place your hands on your knees for support.
Slowly rotate your knees in a circle in one direction.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Switch to the other direction after 8 to 10 circles.
description: Gentle knee circles with the leg slightly bent that loosen up the knee area and calves. Handy as a warm-up or a loosening drill.

name: 船式拉伸
instructions: Lie on your stomach with your legs together.
Place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up, lifting your chest and straightening your arms.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and relax.
description: A seated stretch that opens up the front of the torso and abs. It leaves your midsection feeling long and loose.

name: 仰望天花板拉伸 v. 2
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach both arms overhead and slightly back.
Tilt your head back to look at the ceiling while pressing your hips forward.
Keep your core engaged so your lower back is not over-arched.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then relax.
description: A standing stretch where you reach up and look toward the ceiling to open the front of the body. It opens the hips and thighs.

name: 足部和脚踝拉伸
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you.
Hold for 15 seconds.
Pull your toes back toward your shin.
Hold for another 15 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.
description: A gentle stretch for the feet and ankles. It helps loosen stiff joints and the muscles around them.

name: 足部和脚踝旋转拉伸
instructions: Sit with one leg extended or crossed over your knee.
Hold your lower leg steady.
Draw slow circles with your foot.
Do 10 circles in one direction.
Switch to the other direction.
Repeat on the other foot.
description: Rotating the foot in slow circles to mobilise the ankle. It warms up the joint and relieves stiffness.

name: 髋部绕圈拉伸
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width.
Place your hands on your hips.
Rotate your hips in a wide circle.
Do 10 circles in one direction.
Reverse and circle the other way.
Keep your shoulders still and your knees soft.
description: Big circles with your hips that loosen the joint and the muscles around it. A good warm-up for leg days.

name: 抬膝
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Lift one knee up toward your chest.
Hold it for a moment.
Lower the foot with control.
Alternate legs.
Keep your standing leg steady and your back straight.
description: Lifting your knee toward your chest to warm up the hips and activate the hip flexors. A simple dynamic drill.

name: 中背部拉伸
instructions: Stand or sit and clasp your hands in front of you.
Straighten your arms and push them forward.
Round your upper back and tuck your chin.
Feel the stretch between your shoulder blades.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly and repeat.
description: A stretch that rounds the middle back and spreads the shoulder blades. It relieves tension from sitting or rowing.

name: 哑铃静态弓步蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand in a long split stance, rear heel lifted.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Bend both knees and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand back up without moving your feet.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A split-stance lunge done in place with dumbbells in hand. It builds strength in the front thigh and glutes without any stepping.

name: 哑铃单腿臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat, and the other leg extended or raised.
Rest a dumbbell across your hips and hold it steady.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glute at the top for a second.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.
description: A one-legged hip bridge with a dumbbell resting on your hips. It hits the glutes hard and challenges hip stability.

name: 哑铃仰卧腿弯举
instructions: Lie face down on a bench and grip the edge for support.
Have a dumbbell gripped between your feet, or placed by a partner, with legs straight.
Bend your knees and curl the weight toward your glutes.
Pause briefly at the top without lifting your hips.
Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.
description: Lying face down, you curl a dumbbell held between your feet toward your glutes. A simple way to train the back of the thighs without a machine.

name: 哑铃直腿硬拉
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight with a soft knee and a flat back.
Push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
description: A hip hinge with nearly straight legs and dumbbells. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.

name: 徒手过头深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and raise both arms straight overhead.
Brace your core and keep your arms in line with your ears.
Sit your hips back and down into a deep squat, chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your arms locked overhead.
description: A deep squat performed with your arms locked out overhead. It trains the legs while testing shoulder and hip mobility.

name: 哑铃行走弓步蹲
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Alternate legs for the desired number of steps.
description: Lunging forward step after step with a dumbbell in each hand. It builds leg and glute strength and balance.

name: 交叉跪姿髋屈肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge, on a mat.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and keep your torso upright.
Reach the arm on the kneeling side up and across toward the opposite side.
Shift your hips gently forward until you feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A kneeling lunge stretch with a cross-body reach to deepen the stretch along the front of the hip.

name: 仰卧股四头肌拉伸
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your head resting on one arm.
Bend the top knee and grab that ankle with your top hand.
Pull your heel toward your glutes while keeping your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A stretch for the front of the thigh done lying on your side or front. It loosens tight quads after leg work.

name: 股四头肌拉伸
instructions: Stand tall, using a wall or support for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab the ankle behind you.
Pull your heel toward your glutes, keeping your knees together and hips square.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A standing stretch for the front of the thigh. Easy to do anywhere to ease tight quads.

name: 坐姿转体(直臂)
instructions: Sit tall on the floor with your legs crossed or extended.
Extend both arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height.
Rotate your torso slowly to one side, keeping your spine long.
Hold for a moment, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 8-10 slow rotations each way.
description: A seated rotation with your arms held straight out, loosening the spine and working the waist gently.

name: 单腿伸展(屈膝)
instructions: Lie on your back, lift your head and shoulders, and bring both knees toward your chest.
Place your hands on one shin and extend the other leg out low.
Switch legs smoothly, drawing the other knee in.
Keep your lower back pressed down and your abs tight.
Continue alternating with a steady breath rhythm.
description: A pilates move where you alternate pulling one knee in while the other leg extends. It builds core control and coordination.

name: 单直腿伸展
instructions: Lie on your back, lift your head and shoulders off the mat.
Extend one leg straight up and the other hovering low.
Hold the raised leg with both hands and pulse twice toward you.
Switch legs and repeat, keeping your torso steady.
Keep your lower back anchored throughout.
description: A pilates exercise where you scissor your straight legs while holding the raised one. It trains the abs and tests hamstring flexibility.

name: 斜向拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead and keep the other hand resting on your hip.
Lean slowly toward the opposite side, lengthening along the raised arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to upright and switch sides.
description: A standing side-leaning stretch that opens up the lats and the side of the torso.

name: 脊柱拉伸(稳定球)
instructions: Kneel in front of a stability ball and place your forearms or hands on top.
Roll the ball forward as you sink your hips back.
Let your head drop between your arms and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply.
Roll the ball back in to come up.
description: A gentle back stretch draped over or kneeling at a stability ball. It lengthens the spine and relaxes the torso.

name: 脊柱前屈拉伸
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Flex your feet and lift your torso up out of your hips.
Curl your chin to your chest and round forward, reaching past your toes.
Hold for a breath, then stack your spine back up slowly.
Repeat for several slow reps.
description: A seated pilates stretch where you round forward over your legs, one vertebra at a time. It mobilizes the spine and stretches the hamstrings.

name: 哑铃地面仰卧上拉
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the weight in an arc behind your head until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your ribs down and core tight throughout.
description: A pullover lying on the floor, which limits the stretch range and keeps the focus on the lats and chest.

name: 站姿侧弯(屈臂) v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and one hand behind your head, elbow bent.
Place your other hand on your hip.
Bend sideways toward the hand on your hip without leaning forward.
Squeeze your side to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A bodyweight side bend with one arm bent behind your head, working the obliques.

name: 哑铃屈臂仰卧上拉
instructions: Lie back on a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep them bent throughout.
Lower the dumbbell back over your head until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Keep your ribs down and your core braced.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest and repeat.
description: A pullover with the elbows kept bent, lying on a bench. It stretches and strengthens the chest and lats.

name: 雪橇垂直腿举
instructions: Lie on your back under the sled and place your feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safety catches and lower the platform until your knees are deeply bent.
Keep your lower back flat on the pad.
Press the platform up without locking your knees.
Lower under control for each rep.
description: A leg press on a sled that moves straight up, pressing the weight vertically. It loads the thighs and glutes heavily.

name: 站姿剪刀腿
instructions: Stand tall with one foot forward and one back, arms ready.
Hop lightly and switch your leg positions in the air.
Swing your arms opposite to your legs for balance.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.
description: A quick jumping drill where your legs swap front and back like scissors. Good for conditioning and coordination.

name: 椅子推撑
instructions: Place a stable chair against a wall and set your hands on the seat edge.
Walk your feet back until your body is straight.
Lower your chest toward the seat, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips level.
description: A push-up variation with hands on a sturdy chair. It makes pressing easier while still training chest and arms.

name: 反向卷腹踢腿
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and knees bent over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Kick your feet up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly and bend your knees again.
Avoid swinging; use your abs to lift.
description: A reverse crunch finished with a leg kick upward, hitting the lower abs.

name: 卷腹单腿抬起
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Extend one leg and lift it a few inches off the floor.
Curl your shoulders up toward your hips.
Lower slowly, then repeat.
Switch legs halfway through or alternate each rep.
description: A crunch where one leg lifts as you curl up. It adds a lower-abs challenge to the basic crunch.

name: 卷腹停顿
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
Hold the top position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Lower down with control.
description: A crunch held at the top to keep the abs under tension. Simple and burns quickly.

name: 凳上反向卷腹画圈
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip behind your head for support.
Bring your knees up over your hips.
Curl your hips up and draw a small circle with your knees.
Reverse the circle on the next rep.
Lower your hips slowly each time.
description: A bench reverse crunch where your knees trace a circle. It works the lower abs and obliques.

name: 侧平板支撑腹斜肌卷腹
instructions: Set up in a side plank on one forearm, feet stacked or staggered.
Put your free hand behind your head.
Bring your top knee and elbow together beneath your torso.
Extend back to the side plank position.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side plank with a knee-to-elbow crunch. It trains the obliques and shoulder stability together.

name: 哑铃侧弯 v. 2
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Place your other hand behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the weighted side, keeping your hips still.
Squeeze the opposite side to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.
description: A weighted side bend using a dumbbell to load the obliques.

name: 杠杆二头弯举
instructions: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine pivot.
Grip the handles with palms up.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
description: A biceps curl on a plate-loaded lever machine that guides the path. It builds the front of the upper arm.

name: 杠铃蜘蛛弯举
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with your arms hanging and a barbell in your hands.
Grip the bar with palms facing up, shoulder-width.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.
description: A barbell curl done chest-down on an incline bench, which removes swinging and isolates the biceps.

name: 杠铃仰卧上拉 v. 2
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a barbell over your chest with a close grip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the bar in an arc behind your head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your core braced and your ribs down.
description: A pullover with a barbell lying on a bench. It stretches and strengthens the lats and chest.

name: 杠铃宽握仰卧上拉
instructions: Lie on a bench with a barbell held wider than shoulder-width above your chest.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Lower the bar behind your head in a smooth arc.
Pull the bar back over your chest.
Maintain a stable core and avoid arching your back.
description: A pullover using a wider grip, which spreads the load across the lats and chest.

name: 哑铃交替前平举
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your torso still.
Raise one arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly as you raise the other arm.
Avoid swinging; keep alternating for your reps.
description: Raising one dumbbell at a time in front of you to shoulder height. It targets the front of the shoulders.

name: 哑铃扭转飞鸟
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing in.
Open your arms wide in an arc with elbows slightly bent.
Rotate your wrists as you lower until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together, twisting them to finish with palms inward.
Control the weight on the way down.
description: A dumbbell fly where you rotate your wrists through the movement for a stronger chest squeeze.

name: 哑铃单臂三头肌伸展
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and press it overhead.
Keep your upper arm close to your head with the elbow pointing up.
Bend the elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend the elbow to press the weight back up.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A single-arm overhead extension with a dumbbell. It isolates the triceps and builds arm strength.

name: 杠铃上斜三头肌伸展(仰卧臂屈伸)
english: barbell incline triceps extension skull crusher
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench holding a barbell above your chest, arms straight.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows and lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms to return to the start.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
description: An incline version of the skull crusher, lowering a barbell behind your head to hit the long head of the triceps.

name: 绳索上斜窄握弯举
instructions: Lean back on an incline bench in front of a low cable with a straight bar.
Grip the bar close together with palms up.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders, upper arms still.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
description: A biceps curl on an incline bench with a cable and a narrow grip. It keeps constant tension and a deep stretch.

name: 徒手站姿军事推举
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and fists at your shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press your arms straight overhead.
Lower back to your shoulders with control.
Avoid leaning back.
description: A standing overhead press without weight, good for learning the pressing path or warming up.

name: 杠杆站姿腿弯举
instructions: Stand facing the machine and set the pad behind your working ankle.
Hold the supports for balance.
Curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.
description: A standing single-leg curl on a lever machine. It targets the hamstrings one side at a time.

name: 腹部四点支撑
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Draw your belly button toward your spine.
Hold for 15-30 seconds while breathing normally.
Relax and repeat.
description: A four-point hold on hands and knees where you engage the abs. A gentle way to learn core bracing.

name: 杠铃单腿深蹲
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand on one leg, other leg lifted in front.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and lower as deep as you control.
Drive through your heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-legged squat with a barbell on your back. It builds leg strength and balance, so use light weight.

name: 绳索仰卧标准握弯举
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and grab the bar with an underhand grip.
Pin your upper arms to the floor beside you.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.
description: A biceps curl performed lying on your back with a cable. The lying position keeps constant tension on the biceps.

name: 绳索上斜仰卧臂屈伸
instructions: Set an incline bench facing away from a low cable and hold the bar overhead.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows and lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms to return.
Keep your elbows from flaring.
description: A skull crusher on an incline bench with cable resistance, giving steady tension on the triceps.

name: 地面凳上臂屈伸 v. 2
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back to a bench and place your hands on its edge.
Lift your hips and extend your legs slightly in front.
Bend your elbows and lower your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
description: A dip where your hands rest on a bench behind you and your feet stay on the floor. It builds the back of the upper arms.

name: 绳索仰卧三头肌伸展(用绳)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your head toward a low pulley and hold the rope above your chest.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows and lower the rope behind your head.
Extend your arms to return.
Spread the rope slightly at the end.
description: A lying triceps extension on a bench using a cable rope. It keeps constant tension on the triceps.

name: 交替腹斜肌卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to center and switch sides.
Move slowly and avoid pulling on your neck.
description: A crunch that alternates elbow-to-knee across the body, hitting the obliques.

name: 绳索三头肌下压(V形把手) v. 2
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley and grip the V bar with elbows at your sides.
Keep your torso upright and slightly forward.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the bar rise slowly, elbows still.
description: A triceps pushdown using a V bar on a high cable, a classic for the back of the arms.

name: 绳索水平帕洛夫推举 v. 2
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable set at chest height, hands holding the handle at your chest.
Step away to load the cable and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out in front of you.
Hold for a second without rotating.
Bring it back to your chest, then switch sides.
description: An anti-rotation press where you push a cable straight out and resist the twist. Great for core stability.

name: 弹力带二头弯举 v. 2
instructions: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends, palms up.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly against the band.
description: A simple biceps curl with a band underfoot. It trains the front of the arms with elastic resistance.

name: 弹力带跪姿高位下拉
instructions: Anchor a band high and kneel facing it, holding the ends.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control.
description: A kneeling pulldown using a band anchored overhead. It builds the lats at home.

name: 弹力带过头三头肌伸展 v. 3
instructions: Stand holding a band behind your head, one hand low and one hand high.
Keep your elbows close to your head.
Extend your top arm straight overhead.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.
description: A triceps extension with a band held overhead. It trains the long head of the triceps.

name: 双腿放凳上凳上臂屈伸
english: bench dip with legs on bench
instructions: Place your hands on one bench behind you and your heels on another in front.
Straighten your legs and lift your hips.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Press back up.
Keep your back close to the bench.
description: A harder bench dip with your feet on a second bench. It places greater load on the triceps.

name: 徒手耸肩
instructions: Stand tall with arms by your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a second.
Lower them slowly.
Avoid rolling your shoulders.
description: A shoulder shrug without weight for warming up or light trap work.

name: 杠铃深蹲2秒停顿
instructions: Set a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and sit down into a deep squat.
Pause for two seconds at the bottom.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up throughout.
description: A barbell back squat with a two second pause at the bottom, removing bounce and building strength.

name: 配重滑冰者深蹲
instructions: Stand on one leg and extend the other behind you.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Bend your standing knee and lower slowly.
Touch lightly with your back knee if needed.
Drive back up and switch legs.
description: A single-leg squat with arms forward as a counterweight. It builds balance and strength.

name: 地面单腿臂屈伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with hands behind you and knees bent.
Lift your hips and extend one leg out.
Bend your elbows to lower.
Press back up.
Switch legs after your reps.
description: A floor dip with one leg raised for extra challenge. It targets the triceps and core balance.

name: 动物休息式瑜伽体式
instructions: Kneel on a mat and sit back toward your heels.
Fold forward and stretch your arms ahead.
Rest your forehead on the floor.
Breathe deeply and hold for 30-60 seconds.
Release slowly.
description: A resting yoga pose that gently stretches the back and hips, similar to child pose.

name: 站姿侧向卷腹
instructions: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee out to the side.
Crunch your elbow down toward it.
Return to standing.
Repeat on both sides.
description: A standing crunch where you lift a knee to the side toward your elbow. It works the obliques.

name: 绳索俯身反握划船
english: cable bent over reverse grip row
instructions: Stand facing a low cable and hinge forward with a flat back.
Grip the bar with palms up.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
description: A bent-over row with a cable using an underhand grip, which emphasizes the lower lats and biceps.

name: 绳索俯身划船(绳索把手)
english: cable bent over row with rope attachment
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hinge forward with a flat back.
Grip the rope with palms facing each other.
Pull the rope toward your lower chest.
Spread the rope as you squeeze your back.
Lower with control.
description: A bent-over row with a cable rope, allowing a neutral grip and a good squeeze at the end.

name: 徒手站姿二头弯举 v. 2
instructions: Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Make fists and curl your hands to your shoulders.
Tense your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your elbows pinned.
description: A light, no-equipment biceps curl using self-resistance, useful for warming up.

name: 史密斯坐姿提踵
instructions: Sit on a bench under the bar with the balls of your feet on a raised block.
Rest the bar across your thighs with a pad.
Lift your heels as high as possible.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly for a full stretch.
description: A seated calf raise with a barbell on a Smith machine, working the lower calf muscle.

name: 杠杆上斜单臂胸部推举(挂片式)
english: lever incline one arm chest press (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit on the machine and grip one handle.
Set your back firmly against the pad.
Press the handle forward and up.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly, then switch arms.
description: A one-armed incline press on a plate-loaded lever machine. It trains the upper chest one side at a time.

name: 鳄鱼式瑜伽体式
instructions: Lie face down with palms under your shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your body.
Lower into a low plank with elbows tucked in.
Keep your body straight and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower to the floor.
description: A low plank-like yoga pose held just above the floor. It strengthens the core and arms.

name: 悬垂死虫式
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Lift your knees to hip height.
Extend one leg while keeping control of your torso.
Return and switch legs.
Avoid swinging.
description: A hanging variation of the dead bug, extending opposite arm and leg. It builds core control.

name: 绳索站姿交替低位飞鸟
instructions: Stand between two low pulleys holding the handles.
Take a small step forward with a slight lean.
Sweep one arm up and across toward the center of your chest.
Return slowly.
Alternate sides.
description: A standing cable fly from a low pulley, sweeping the arms up and across one at a time. It trains the upper chest.

name: 药球绕头旋转
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Brace your core and keep your hips still.
Pass the ball around your head in a smooth circle, keeping it close.
Complete several circles, then reverse the direction.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back as the ball passes behind you.
description: Circle a medicine ball around your head to warm up the shoulders and challenge your core and balance.

name: 倒立行走
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall or with a spotter, hands shoulder-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes and legs together and push tall through your shoulders.
Shift your weight onto one hand and move the other forward a small step.
Alternate hands in short, controlled steps, keeping your core tight.
Come down safely with control, and practise on soft ground.
description: An advanced bodyweight skill where you walk on your hands while inverted. It builds shoulder strength, balance and body control.

name: 哑铃悬垂翻举
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell hanging in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips, then drive them forward and shrug as you pull the dumbbell up.
Drop under it and catch it at your shoulder with a slight knee bend.
Dip a little, then drive up through your legs and press the dumbbell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then to the hang under control.
description: An explosive lift that takes a dumbbell from the hang to your shoulder and then overhead. It builds power through the hips, legs and shoulders.

name: 杠杆反握高位划船(挂片式)
english: lever reverse grip high row (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit at the machine with your chest against the pad and grab the handles underhand.
Set your shoulders back and down.
Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your back at the end of the pull.
Slowly extend your arms without letting your shoulders round forward.
description: A plate-loaded machine row with an underhand grip that trains the lats and upper back while the biceps assist.

name: 弹力带反向划船
instructions: Anchor the band to a sturdy bar or rack and hold it while lying under the anchor point.
Keep your body in a straight line with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.
description: A bodyweight row with a band added for extra load. It builds the upper back and biceps while your core keeps the body straight.

name: 站姿毛巾滑腿
instructions: Stand on a smooth floor with one foot on a towel and hold a support if needed.
Bend the standing knee slightly and keep your chest tall.
Slide the towel foot out to the side or back as far as you can control.
Pull it back to the start using your hip and thigh muscles.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: A standing exercise where one foot slides on a towel to work the hips and thighs while the standing leg balances you.

name: 靠墙倒腿瑜伽体式
english: legs up the wall yoga pose
instructions: Sit sideways next to a wall and lie back as you swing your legs up the wall.
Move your hips close to the wall, with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Keep your knees soft if the hamstrings feel tight.
Breathe slowly and relax your shoulders and jaw.
Hold for 1-5 minutes, then bend your knees and roll to one side to come up.
description: A restful pose where your legs rest up a wall, gently stretching the backs of the legs and easing tension in the lower back.

name: 杠铃前架弓步蹲 v. 2
instructions: Rest the barbell on the front of your shoulders with elbows high.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step forward into a long stride and lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs, keeping your torso upright.
description: A forward lunge with the bar resting on your front shoulders. The front load works the quads and glutes and challenges your core.

name: 药球后撤步旋转投掷
english: medicine ball step behind rotational throw
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall, holding a medicine ball at hip height.
Step your rear foot behind you and load your weight onto it.
Rotate your hips and torso toward the wall.
Throw the ball hard into the wall at chest height.
Catch it, reset, and switch sides after your set.
description: An explosive rotational throw that starts with a step behind. It builds power through the hips and trunk.

name: 身体锯平板支撑
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Shift your body forward so your shoulders move past your elbows.
Rock back to the start in a slow, smooth motion.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
description: A plank variation where you rock your body forward and back in small motions. It heavily challenges the abs and shoulders.

name: 髋部滚动平板支撑
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Brace your abs and keep your shoulders stable.
Rotate your hips to one side, lowering them toward the floor.
Roll back through the middle to the other side.
Keep the movement controlled and breathe steadily.
description: A plank with a rolling twist of the hips from side to side. It works the obliques and deep core muscles.

name: 伸腿平板支撑
instructions: Get into a forearm or high plank with a flat back.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one leg straight behind you without rotating your hips.
Lower it with control.
Repeat on the other leg and alternate.
description: A plank where you lift and extend one leg at a time, testing core stability and strengthening the glutes.

name: 祈祷深蹲瑜伽体式
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down if you can.
Press your palms together at your chest.
Use your elbows to gently press your knees outward.
Hold for 30-60 seconds while breathing slowly.
description: A deep squat with palms together that opens the hips and inner thighs and builds ankle and hip mobility.

name: 抱头起身
instructions: Kneel on the floor, with your hands behind your head.
Keep your chest tall and your core braced.
Step one foot forward and drive up through it to stand.
Lower back down with control to kneeling.
Alternate the leading leg on each rep.
description: A bodyweight get-up with your hands behind your head. It builds leg strength, balance and hip control.

name: 哑铃推举挺
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, feet hip-width apart.
Dip by bending your knees slightly while keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs explosively.
Press the dumbbells overhead as you straighten, then lock out your arms.
Lower them back to your shoulders with control.
description: An explosive overhead lift that uses a leg drive to send dumbbells overhead. It builds power and shoulder strength.

name: 杠铃前架后撤弓步蹲
instructions: Rest the barbell across your front shoulders with elbows high.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back and lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs and keep your torso upright.
description: A reverse lunge with the barbell in a front rack. Stepping back keeps the load on the glutes and quads with less knee stress.

name: 绳索低位划船(绳索把手)
english: cable low row with rope attachment
instructions: Sit at the low pulley with the rope attached, feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the rope ends with a neutral grip and sit tall.
Pull the rope toward your lower stomach, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight without rounding your back.
description: A seated cable row using a rope that lets your hands travel close to your body. It targets the lats and mid back.

name: 划船式瑜伽体式
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and your feet on the floor.
Lean back slightly, keeping your chest lifted and back long.
Lift your feet and extend your legs into a V shape.
Reach your arms forward alongside your legs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
description: A seated V-shaped balance, also called boat pose, that works the abs and hip flexors.

name: 壶铃俄罗斯转体
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back a little.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Lift your feet slightly if you can, and keep your back straight.
Rotate your torso to one side, then the other.
Move with control and keep your chest lifted.
description: A seated twisting exercise with a kettlebell that targets the abs and obliques.

name: 靠墙交替肩屈曲
english: alternate shoulder flexion back to wall
instructions: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall.
Keep your ribs down and your lower back near the wall.
Raise one arm forward and overhead as far as you can without arching.
Lower it with control.
Alternate arms for the set.
description: A wall-supported drill to improve overhead reach, one arm at a time, while keeping the back flat against the wall.

name: 肩部绕圈
instructions: Stand tall with your arms relaxed by your sides.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Roll them back and down in a smooth circle.
Complete several slow circles.
Reverse the direction and repeat.
description: A simple warm-up where you roll the shoulders in circles to loosen the upper back and shoulder joints.

name: 壶铃侧弯 v. 2
instructions: Stand tall, holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Keep your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Bend sideways toward the weighted side without twisting.
Use your obliques to return to upright.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.
description: A standing side bend with a kettlebell that trains the obliques and the muscles along the side of the trunk.

name: 杠铃前架分腿蹲
instructions: Rest the barbell on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Take a split stance with one foot well in front of the other.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A split squat with the bar in a front rack position, building leg strength and core control.

name: 弹力带深蹲
instructions: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the handles at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
description: A squat with a resistance band for added load. It builds strength in the legs and hips.

name: 站姿海豹式瑜伽体式
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and your hands on your lower back.
Lengthen through your spine.
Lift your chest and gently arch backward.
Keep your neck relaxed and your legs strong.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then come back up slowly.
description: A standing back-bending pose that opens the chest and front of the hips and stretches the abdomen.

name: 壶铃上台阶
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench holding a kettlebell at your chest or by your side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Press through that heel to stand tall on top.
Lower back down slowly with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A step-up on a bench or box while holding a kettlebell, working the quads and glutes one leg at a time.

name: 杠铃提膝上台阶
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand facing a box.
Place one foot on the box and press up through that heel.
Drive the other knee up toward your hip at the top.
Lower the knee and step back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: A step-up finished with a knee drive, training the glutes and legs along with balance and hip flexor control.

name: 直角式瑜伽体式
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on your hips and lengthen your spine.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Lower your hands to the floor or to your shins.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rise slowly.
description: A wide-legged forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and inner thighs.

name: 双壶铃相扑硬拉
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, kettlebells on the floor between your feet.
Hinge down and grip the handles with a flat back.
Push through your feet and stand up, squeezing your glutes.
Keep the kettlebells close to your body.
Lower back down by hinging at the hips.
description: A wide-stance deadlift with a kettlebell or two that trains the glutes, inner thighs and legs.

name: 摇摆棕榈树式瑜伽体式
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and arms overhead, palms joined.
Reach up through your fingertips.
Lean gently to one side without twisting.
Breathe and hold for 15-20 seconds.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.
description: A standing side stretch with your arms overhead that lengthens the sides of the body and opens the shoulders.

name: 鹰式瑜伽体式
instructions: Stand tall and bend both knees slightly.
Lift one leg and wrap it across the other thigh.
Cross your arms in front, one elbow over the other, palms together.
Lift your elbows and sink your hips slightly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A balancing pose with wrapped legs and arms. It stretches the hips and shoulders and builds focus.

name: 虎式瑜伽体式
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Round your back and draw one knee toward your nose.
Then extend that leg back and up while lifting your chest.
Move smoothly with your breath.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
description: A hands-and-knees pose where one leg extends back and the spine arches, mobilising the back and hips.

name: 虎尾滚棒三头肌
instructions: Set up facing your anchor or support, with your upper arms close to your body.
Brace your core and keep your elbows still.
Straighten your arms fully to engage the triceps.
Squeeze at the bottom for a moment.
Return slowly to the start.
description: A triceps exercise using a bodyweight or stick-style handle, focused on straightening the elbows against resistance.

name: 壶铃直立划船
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Keep it close to your body.
Pull it up toward your chest, leading with your elbows.
Stop at about chest height.
Lower slowly under control.
description: A vertical pull with a kettlebell that works the shoulders and upper traps.

name: 杠铃前架行走弓步蹲
instructions: Rest the barbell across your front shoulders with elbows high.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg through into the next step.
Keep walking, alternating legs, with an upright torso.
description: A walking lunge with the barbell in a front rack, challenging the legs, balance and core.

name: 战士二式瑜伽体式
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and turn your front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Gaze over your front fingertips and keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A strong standing pose with wide legs and arms outstretched, building leg strength, hip opening and stamina.

name: 杠铃坐姿高位前平举
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an overhand grip, in front of your thighs.
Keep your back straight and your core braced.
Lift the bar forward and up to eye level or higher.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly under control.
description: A seated barbell raise that lifts the bar high in front of you, working the front delts.

name: 弹力带拉开(旋前90度)
instructions: Stand holding a band in front of you at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and your core braced.
Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
description: A band pull-apart with an overhand grip and arms at 90 degrees that hits the rear delts and upper back.

name: 杠铃卧推加弹力带悬挂壶铃
english: barbell bench press with band suspended kettlebell
instructions: Lie on a bench and unrack the barbell with kettlebells hung from bands.
Plant your feet and brace your core.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid chest.
Press it up to full extension while keeping the bar steady.
Rack the bar safely when finished.
description: A bench press with kettlebells hanging from bands on the bar. The swinging load forces your stabilising muscles to work harder.

name: 弹力带阻力反握引体向上
instructions: Attach a band to the bar and loop it around your body or waist.
Hang from the bar with an underhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower with control to a full hang.
description: A chin-up with a band adding resistance, building the lats and biceps.

name: 滑腿鸟狗式
instructions: Start on all fours with a sliding disc or towel under one foot.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Slide that leg straight back as you extend the opposite arm forward.
Return to the start in a controlled way.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
description: A bird dog variation where the leg slides along the floor, improving core stability and coordination.

name: 相扑深蹲触地
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and squat down.
Touch the floor with your fingertips between your feet.
Keep your chest lifted and your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.
description: A wide-stance squat in which you touch the floor between your feet. It trains the glutes, thighs and hip mobility.

name: 仰卧抬腿(改良版)
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until your hips flex to about 90 degrees.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
Stop short of the floor and repeat.
description: An easier lying leg raise that trains the lower abs. Bent knees reduce the strain on the lower back.

name: 原地踏步
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Lift one knee up toward hip height.
Lower it and lift the other knee.
Swing your arms in rhythm with your steps.
Keep a steady pace for 1-3 minutes.
description: A low-impact cardio move where you march in place to raise your heart rate and warm up the legs.

name: 绳索驴子后踢
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and get on all fours facing the machine.
Hook the strap around one ankle.
Keeping the knee bent, drive your heel up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly and repeat, then switch legs.
description: Kicking one leg back from a hands-and-knees position against cable resistance. It isolates the glutes.

name: EZ杠铃拖曳二头弯举
instructions: Stand holding an ez bar with an underhand grip at your thighs.
Keep the bar close to your body.
Curl it up while moving your elbows back behind you.
Let the bar slide up your torso to chest height.
Lower slowly under control.
description: A curl where the bar drags up your torso with elbows pulled back. It keeps tension on the biceps and reduces shoulder help.

name: 杠铃架上仰卧窄握反握划船
english: barbell lying close grip underhand row on rack
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack at about waist height.
Lie underneath and grab it with a close underhand grip.
Keep your body straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower yourself under control.
description: A bodyweight row hanging under a barbell set in a rack, using a close underhand grip to target the lats and biceps.

name: 杠铃架上仰卧窄握正握划船
english: barbell lying close grip overhand row on rack
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack at about waist height.
Lie beneath it and grip the bar overhand with hands close together.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Pull your chest to the bar and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower with control.
description: A bodyweight row under a rack-mounted barbell with a close overhand grip, targeting the upper back and lats.

name: 哑铃架上仰卧窄握平行握划船
english: dumbbell lying close grip parallel row on rack
instructions: Lie face down on a high bench or rack with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row the dumbbells toward your ribs, keeping elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.
description: A chest-supported row lying on a rack with a neutral grip, working the lats and mid back.

name: 哑铃架上仰卧宽握划船
english: dumbbell lying wide grip row on rack
instructions: Lie face down on a high bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the dumbbells up with elbows flaring out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower under control.
description: A chest-supported row with a wide elbow path that emphasises the upper back and rear delts.

name: 动力雪橇推行
instructions: Load the sled and grip the handles at chest or hip height.
Lean forward with a straight body line.
Drive through your legs with powerful steps.
Keep your core tight and push the sled forward.
Maintain a steady pace for the set distance.
description: A heavy sled push that builds leg drive and conditioning.

name: 负重仰卧颈部侧抬
instructions: Lie on your side with your head supported at the edge of the bench.
Place a light weight or plate on the side of your head, held steady.
Lift your head slowly toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides. Use light weight.
description: A gentle neck exercise lying on your side and lifting the head against light resistance to strengthen the side neck muscles.

name: 负重侧卧颈部侧抬
english: weighted side lying side neck raise
instructions: Lie on your side with your head supported at the edge of the bench.
Place a light weight or plate on the side of your head, held steady.
Lift your head slowly toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides. Use light weight.
description: A gentle neck exercise lying on your side and lifting the head against light resistance to strengthen the side neck muscles.

name: 负重仰卧颈部左右摆动
english: weighted lying neck side to side
instructions: Lie face up with a light weight on your forehead.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head toward one side.
Return to the middle and turn the other way.
Use light weight and smooth movement.
description: A lying neck exercise moving the head side to side against light resistance to strengthen the neck.

name: 负重仰卧颈部转头
instructions: Lie face up with a light weight resting on your forehead.
Keep your chin slightly tucked.
Rotate your head slowly to one side.
Return to the middle and rotate to the other side.
Keep the movement small and controlled.
description: A lying neck twist with light resistance to work the muscles that rotate the head.

name: 高抬膝深蹲 v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest lifted.
Stand up explosively and drive one knee up toward your chest.
Land softly and drop into the next squat.
Alternate knees on each rep.
description: A squat followed by a high knee drive, combining leg strength with a bit of cardio.

name: 交替跨步
instructions: Stand with feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step one foot out to the side.
Bring it back and step the other foot out.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.
description: A low-impact move stepping one leg out at a time, raising your heart rate while working the legs.

name: 交替腿弯举加出拳
instructions: Stand tall with your fists in front of your chin.
Curl one heel up toward your glute.
Punch forward as you curl the leg.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm and stay light on your feet.
description: A cardio combination of heel-to-glute kicks and punches that works the hamstrings and arms together.

name: 开合步
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Step one foot out to the side while raising your arms overhead.
Step it back as you lower your arms.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.
description: A low-impact version of the jumping jack where you step out instead of jumping.

name: 哑铃力量翻加挺举
instructions: Stand over dumbbells with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip them with a flat back.
Pull explosively, extend your hips and shrug.
Catch the dumbbells at your shoulders, then dip and drive them overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then the floor with control.
description: An explosive lift pulling dumbbells from the floor to the shoulders and then overhead.

name: 壶铃上台阶 v. 2
instructions: Stand facing a bench or box holding a kettlebell.
Place one foot flat on the box.
Press through that heel to stand up.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A step-up with a kettlebell, held in a different position, to train the quads and glutes unilaterally.

name: 壶铃前架行走弓步蹲
instructions: Clean two kettlebells to the front rack, elbows tucked and close to your ribs.
Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward and lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Keep your torso upright and the bells steady against your chest.
Continue alternating legs for the planned distance.
description: Walking lunges with kettlebells held in the front rack position. Builds leg strength while the core works to keep you upright.

name: 辅助保加利亚分腿蹲
instructions: Stand facing away from a bench and hold a sturdy post or rack with one hand for balance.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.
description: A single-leg squat with the rear foot raised on a bench and a hand lightly holding a support for balance. Trains quads and glutes with less wobble.

name: 哑铃辅助保加利亚分腿蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the other hand on a sturdy support, standing away from a bench.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.
description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat with a dumbbell in one hand and the other hand on a support. Builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.

name: 壶铃辅助保加利亚分腿蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest in one hand and rest the other hand on a sturdy support, standing away from a bench.
Place the top of your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot far enough forward to stay balanced.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through the front heel to stand, then switch legs after your set.
description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat holding a kettlebell, with a free hand on a support. Builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.

name: 弹力带坐姿面拉
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and sit facing it, holding the ends with both hands.
Sit tall with arms extended and the band under light tension.
Pull the band toward your face, flaring your elbows out and high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Pause briefly, then return slowly with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.
description: A seated band pull toward the face that targets the rear delts and upper back. Good for shoulder health and posture.

name: 壶铃半跪姿单臂倒握推举
english: kettlebell half kneeling one arm bottoms up press
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the opposite foot flat in front, back upright.
Hold a kettlebell by the handle with the bell pointing up, at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle tight and brace your core.
Press straight overhead while keeping the bell balanced.
Lower under control back to the shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A one-arm overhead press with the kettlebell held upside down from a half-kneeling stance. Challenges shoulder stability, grip and core.

name: 弹力带垫高臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet on a bench and a band around your thighs just above the knees.
Bend your knees and place your arms by your sides.
Push your knees out against the band and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.
description: A glute bridge with your feet raised and a band adding resistance. Targets the glutes with a deep range of motion.

name: 杠铃弹力带臀推
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench, a padded barbell over your hips and a band above your knees.
Plant your feet hip width apart and push your knees out against the band.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level.
Keep your chin tucked and ribs down.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.
description: A barbell hip thrust with a band around the knees to add outward tension. Strongly works the glutes and hip stabilisers.

name: 哑铃悬垂翻
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your thighs, then push your hips back to lower them to the knees.
Keep your back flat and arms straight.
Drive your hips forward powerfully and shrug.
Pull the dumbbells up close to your body and rotate your elbows under them.
Catch them on your shoulders in a slight quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower them back to your thighs and reset.
description: Explosive lift taking dumbbells from hip level to the shoulders. Builds power through the hips and back.

name: 悬吊带宽握反向划船
instructions: Hold the handles of a suspension trainer with a wide overhand grip and lean back, arms straight.
Walk your feet forward to set the difficulty.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself with control until your arms are straight.
description: A bodyweight row hanging under straps with a wide grip. Works the upper back and lats while the core keeps you rigid.

name: 悬吊带宽握地面反向划船
english: suspension wide grip inverted row on floor
instructions: Hold the handles with a wide, overhand grip and lie back with your body straight.
Keep your heels on the floor and your core tight.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight and repeat.
description: A bodyweight row hanging under suspension straps with a wide grip. It builds the upper back and shoulders.

name: 弹力带俯身宽握划船
english: band bent over wide grip row
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip width apart and grab it with a wide overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull your hands toward your lower ribs, elbows flaring out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your torso still throughout.
description: A bent-over row with a band and a wide grip. Targets the upper back and rear shoulders.

name: 弹力带站姿单臂宽握低位划船
english: band one arm standing wide grip low row
instructions: Anchor a band low and stand facing it, holding the end in one hand.
Step back until the band is taut, feet hip width apart.
Pull your elbow back and out, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Return slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A standing single-arm row from a low anchor, using a band. Trains the lats and mid back one side at a time.

name: 弹力带坐姿宽握划船
instructions: Sit with your legs extended and loop the band around your feet.
Grab the band with a wide grip and sit tall.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control and repeat.
description: Seated rowing with a band and a wide grip. It works the upper back and rear shoulders.

name: 45度背部伸展
instructions: Set the pad at hip level and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest or hold them behind your head.
Lower your torso with a straight spine until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso by squeezing your glutes and lower back.
Stop when your body forms a straight line.
Avoid over-arching at the top.
description: A back extension on an angled bench that strengthens the lower back and glutes. Hinging at the hips keeps the movement safe and smooth.

name: 俯卧腿弯举 v. 2
instructions: Set your feet on the platform with your thighs against the pad and knees just behind it.
Start with your torso hanging down and your body straight.
Curl your body up by bending your knees and squeezing your hamstrings.
Finish with hips extended and torso upright.
Lower slowly with control, keeping your hips locked.
Repeat for reps.
description: A posterior chain exercise on a glute ham bench. Works the hamstrings and glutes through a long range of motion.

name: 哑铃屈腿侧桥
english: dumbbell side bridge with bent leg
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and your forearm under your shoulder.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, resting on your hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from head to knees.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Keep your hips stacked and do not sink.
Lower and switch sides after your set.
description: A side plank on a bent knee holding a dumbbell. Strengthens the obliques and trunk while teaching stability.

name: 直腿侧桥
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your core tight and your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-40 seconds without letting your hips sag.
Lower down and repeat on the other side.
description: A side plank with both legs straight, held on one forearm. It strengthens the obliques and hips.

name: 仰卧腹部推压
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Brace your abs and press your lower back to the floor.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees toward your chest.
Reach your hands to your knees and squeeze.
Return slowly without letting your feet touch down.
Repeat for reps.
description: A lying core move where you press your arms and legs together to crunch the abs. Targets the front of the trunk.

name: 按摩球滚压足部
instructions: Place the ball under your foot sole while seated or standing.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the foot sole. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.

name: 按摩球滚压腓骨肌
instructions: Place the ball under your outer lower leg (peroneus muscles) while sitting on the floor with your leg extended.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the outer lower leg (peroneus muscles). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.

name: 按摩球滚压胫骨前肌
instructions: Place the ball under your shin (tibialis anterior) while kneeling or sitting on the floor.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the shin (tibialis anterior). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.

name: 按摩球滚压小腿
instructions: Place the ball under your calf while seated with your leg extended.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.

name: 徒手全蹲加过头推举
english: bodyweight full squat with overhead press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and hands at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs pass parallel.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Press both arms overhead as you reach the top.
Lower your hands back to your shoulders.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.
description: A deep squat followed by a press overhead. Warms up legs and shoulders together.

name: 徒手正面平板支撑转下犬式
english: bodyweight front plank to downward dog
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Push your hips up and back into an inverted V.
Press your heels toward the floor and lengthen your spine.
Return to plank with control.
Keep moving smoothly for reps.
description: Moves between a plank and downward dog. Builds core strength and opens up the hamstrings and shoulders.

name: 跪姿触肩
instructions: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees slightly into a kneeling plank.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Place it back down without rocking your hips.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
Keep your abs tight throughout.
description: A kneeling plank with alternating shoulder taps. Trains anti-rotation core control and shoulder stability.

name: 下巴贴胸拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Place your hands lightly on the back of your head if you want a deeper stretch.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return slowly to neutral.
description: A gentle neck stretch that lengthens the muscles at the back of the neck. Useful after long periods of sitting.

name: 小腿拉伸
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it.
Step one foot back with the heel on the floor.
Bend your front knee and lean forward.
Feel the stretch in the back calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.
description: A standing wall stretch for the calf muscles. Helps with ankle mobility and tight lower legs.

name: 桥式瑜伽体式(setu bandhasana)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet hip width apart.
Place your arms alongside your body, palms down.
Press through your feet and lift your hips.
Roll your shoulders under and lengthen your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower down slowly.
description: A yoga backbend that strengthens the glutes and opens the chest and hip flexors.

name: 内收肌拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together.
Hold your ankles and sit tall.
Let your knees fall out to the sides.
Gently press your elbows on your thighs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
description: A seated stretch for the inner thighs. Improves hip flexibility.

name: 后侧胸肌拉伸 v. 2
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Clasp your hands together behind your back.
Straighten your arms and lift them gently away from your body.
Open your chest and pull your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release and repeat.
description: A back-clasped chest opener that lengthens the pecs and the front of the shoulders.

name: 弹力带热身肩部拉伸
instructions: Hold a light band with both hands in front of your thighs, hands wide.
Keep your arms straight and your core braced.
Lift the band overhead and continue back behind your head as far as is comfortable.
Return along the same path to the start.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Repeat for 10-15 reps, widening your grip if it feels tight.
description: A light band drill that warms up the shoulder joint and loosens the surrounding muscles before training.

name: 壶铃单臂推举深蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder with one hand in the rack position.
Squat down with your chest up and elbow close.
Drive up through your legs.
Use that momentum to press the kettlebell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder, repeat, then switch arms.
description: A front squat into an overhead press with one kettlebell. It combines legs and shoulders in one flowing move.

name: 壶铃俯卧撑
instructions: Place two kettlebells on the floor shoulder-width apart and grip the handles.
Extend your legs into a plank position.
Lower your chest between the handles with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up until your arms are straight and repeat.
description: A push-up with your hands on kettlebell handles for a deeper range of motion. It builds the chest and arms.

name: 壶铃单腿硬拉
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg.
Hinge forward at the hips while extending the free leg back.
Lower the kettlebell toward the floor with a flat back.
Keep your hips level and your standing knee slightly bent.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch legs.
description: A balance-focused hip hinge on one leg with a kettlebell. It trains the hamstrings and glutes.

name: 壶铃侧向跨步深蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Step out to the side and sit back into a squat.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels and bring your feet together.
Alternate directions or complete all steps on one side before switching.
description: Stepping sideways into a squat while holding a kettlebell at your chest. It works the thighs and hips.

name: 壶铃单臂摆荡
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and the kettlebell in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let the arm stay relaxed; the hips do the work.
Let the bell fall back and hinge again. Switch hands after your set.
description: A hip-driven swing with one hand on a kettlebell. It builds explosive posterior chain power.

name: 壶铃农夫行走
instructions: Pick up a kettlebell in each hand and stand tall.
Pull your shoulders back and brace your core.
Walk forward in controlled steps.
Keep the kettlebells from swinging.
Walk for a set distance or time, then set them down carefully.
description: Walking while carrying a heavy kettlebell in each hand. It builds grip, posture and core stability.

name: 壶铃单臂高翻
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back slightly between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Rotate your hand around so it lands softly in the rack position.
Lower it back down under control, repeat, then switch arms.
description: Pulling a kettlebell from the floor to the shoulder with one arm. It trains explosive hip power and coordination.

name: 壶铃单臂高翻推举
english: kettlebell single arm clean and press
instructions: Hinge and swing the kettlebell back, then clean it to your shoulder.
Settle into a stable rack position with your core tight.
Bend your knees slightly, then press the bell straight overhead.
Lock out your elbow with your biceps near your ear.
Lower it to your shoulder, then to the floor. Switch arms after your set.
description: A clean followed by an overhead press with one kettlebell. It links hip power with shoulder strength.

name: 壶铃抓举
instructions: Stand over the kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Punch your hand through to catch it overhead with a straight arm.
Lower it back under control and repeat, then switch arms.
description: Swinging a kettlebell from between your legs to overhead in one motion. It builds power through the whole body.

name: 壶铃前弓步蹲推举
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your shoulder in the rack position.
Step forward into a lunge.
As you push back up, press the kettlebell overhead.
Lower the bell to your shoulder as you step back.
Alternate legs or finish one side before switching.
description: A forward lunge combined with an overhead press of a kettlebell. It trains legs and shoulders together.

name: 壶铃站姿弹弓绕身
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands.
Pass it behind your back from one hand to the other.
Bring it around to the front and pass it again.
Keep your hips steady and your core tight.
Reverse direction halfway through your set.
description: Passing a kettlebell around your body in circles while standing. It works the shoulders, core and grip.

name: 壶铃单臂仰卧起坐
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a kettlebell held straight up in one hand.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell and your arm locked.
Curl up and sit all the way to standing or upright.
Control your descent back to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A sit-up while holding a kettlebell overhead with one arm. It adds shoulder stability to an abdominal move.

name: 壶铃后三角肌划船
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Let the weights hang below your chest.
Pull your elbows out wide and up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A bent-over row with elbows flared to hit the rear shoulders. It builds upper back and posture muscles.

name: 壶铃屈臂屈膝仰卧上拉
english: kettlebell bent arm pullover with knees bent
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest with elbows slightly bent.
Lower it back over your head, feeling a stretch in your lats.
Keep your lower back close to the floor.
Pull it back over your chest and repeat.
description: A floor pullover with a kettlebell and bent knees. It stretches and works the lats and chest.

name: 钻石推举
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows tracking back close to your ribs.
Pause briefly just above your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight so your hips do not sag.
description: A narrow push-up variation with the hands close together, putting extra load on the triceps and inner chest.

name: 哑铃单臂推举深蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your shoulder with one hand and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your heels.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you sink into the next squat.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A squat into an overhead press with a single dumbbell, training the legs and shoulders together.

name: 壶铃单臂推举深蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your torso upright and elbow close to your body.
Stand up powerfully through your heels.
Press the kettlebell overhead as you rise, finishing with a straight arm.
Lower it back to the rack and go into the next squat.
Switch arms after your set.
description: A kettlebell squat-to-press combo done with one arm that works the legs, shoulders and core in one flow.

name: 壶铃翻举
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge to grab it.
