Keep your shins roughly vertical with the knees kept slightly forward of the hips.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips up until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second at the top without arching your back.
Lower under control and repeat.
description: A glute bridge with a barbell across your hips and a knees-forward setup. Keeps tension on the glutes through the whole rep.

name: 哑铃站姿单臂交叉平举
english: dumbbell standing single arm cross raise
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell by your opposite hip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell diagonally up and across to head height.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: Raise one dumbbell diagonally across your body. Works the chest and front shoulder.

name: 爆发式俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands lift off.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.
Keep your body in a straight line.
description: A push-up pushed fast enough for your hands to leave the floor. Builds upper-body power.

name: 前平板支撑抬臂抬腿(动作检查)
english: front plank with arm and leg lift (form check)
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold for a couple of seconds.
Return and switch sides.
Keep your hips level.
description: A plank where you lift an arm and the opposite leg. Challenges your core stability.

name: 哑铃21下弯举
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl from the bottom to halfway up for 7 reps.
Curl from halfway to the top for 7 reps.
Do 7 full-range curls.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Use a lighter weight than normal.
description: A curl format with seven bottom-half reps, seven top-half reps and seven full reps using dumbbells.

name: 绳索臀中肌后踢
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and clip it to one ankle.
Stand side-on to the stack, hold the frame and keep your torso tall.
Sweep the working leg out and slightly back, leading with the heel.
Pause briefly, then return slowly without leaning.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
description: Standing cable kickback angled out to the side that targets the upper glutes (gluteus medius) and hip stability.

name: 圆背背部伸展
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms on your chest and let your upper back round slightly.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and lift until your body is nearly in line.
Stop before overarching and repeat with control.
description: Hip-extension variation on a back extension bench where you keep a relaxed, rounded upper back to bias the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 仰卧屈腿抬起
instructions: Lie on your back with hands under your hips or by your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the floor.
Curl your hips up slightly as you bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your legs slowly without letting your lower back arch.
Repeat for the target reps.
description: Floor ab exercise where you lift bent knees toward your chest, working the lower abs with less lever length than straight legs.

name: 肩宽中立握引体向上
english: shoulder width neutral grip pull up
instructions: Grab neutral-grip handles about shoulder width apart and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull your chest toward your hands until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly to a full hang.
Avoid swinging or kicking.
description: Pull-up with palms facing each other at shoulder width, a joint-friendly grip that builds the lats and arms.

name: 反握窄距引体向上
instructions: Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands close together.
Hang with arms straight and shoulders pulled down.
Pull your elbows down and in until your chin is above the bar.
Lower under control to full arm extension.
Keep your legs still and avoid swinging.
description: Chin-up style pull-up with a close underhand grip that puts extra work on the biceps along with the lats.

name: 杠铃前后站姿臀推
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a barbell over your hips.
Place one foot slightly ahead of the other.
Drive through your feet to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, keeping your chin tucked.
Lower under control, and swap the foot position on the next set.
description: A hip thrust with one foot set slightly ahead of the other. Shifts more load to one side and challenges hip stability.

name: 垂直抬腿(双杠上) v. 2
english: vertical leg raise (on parallel bars) v. 2
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders pushed down.
Keep your legs together and slightly bent or straight.
Raise your legs until they reach hip height or higher, curling your pelvis.
Lower them slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the target reps.
description: Hanging-style leg raise performed supported on parallel bars, taking the legs high to challenge the lower abs.

name: 波速球高抬膝弓步蹲
english: high knee lunge on bosu ball
instructions: Stand with one foot on the bosu dome and the other behind you.
Lower into a lunge with your torso upright.
Drive through the front foot and bring the back knee up high.
Land softly and balanced, then repeat.
Switch legs after your set.
description: Explosive lunge-and-drive-knee movement off a bosu ball that trains leg power and balance.

name: 窄握引体向上
instructions: Grip the bar with hands a few centimetres apart, palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms and engage your shoulders.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.
description: Pull-up using a narrow overhand grip to emphasise the lower lats and arms.

name: 弹力带坐姿小腿拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and loop the band around the ball of that foot.
Hold the band ends with both hands and sit tall.
Gently pull your toes toward you.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping your knee straight.
Release and switch legs.
description: A seated stretch where you pull the foot toward you with a band. Lengthens the calf and the back of the leg.

name: 坐姿脚滑动
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Keep your heel down and slide the foot forward along the floor.
Pull it back, letting the heel lift slightly toward the end.
Move smoothly through a comfortable range.
Repeat, then switch feet.
description: Gentle seated mobility drill sliding the foot along the floor to warm up the ankle and calf.

name: 单腿跳
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms ready.
Hop up and forward or in place using your ankle and knee.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Stay balanced and keep your hips level.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: Low-impact hopping on one leg to build ankle stiffness, balance and leg power.

name: 负重坐姿提踵 v. 2
instructions: Sit with the balls of your feet on a raised edge and weight resting on your knees.
Lower your heels until you feel a calf stretch.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your knees bent throughout.
description: Seated calf raise with weight on your thighs that targets the soleus muscle under the calf.

name: 负重坐姿单腿提踵 v. 2
english: weighted seated single calf raise v. 2
instructions: Sit with one forefoot on a raised edge and weight on that knee.
Lower the heel for a full stretch.
Press up onto the ball of your foot as high as possible.
Pause, then lower under control.
Finish your reps and switch legs.
description: One-leg seated calf raise with weight on the knee, working the soleus with extra focus on each side.

name: 壶铃垫高高脚杯深蹲
instructions: Stand with heels on a low plate, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Keep your chest tall and elbows pointing down.
Squat down between your knees as deep as comfortable.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
Keep your torso upright throughout.
description: Goblet squat with your heels raised on a plate or wedge so the knees travel forward and the quads work harder.

name: 哑铃平板支撑传递
instructions: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell beside one hand and feet wide.
Brace your core and keep hips level.
Reach the free hand under your body and grab the dumbbell.
Pass it across to the other side and place it down.
Repeat, alternating sides.
description: Plank variation where you pass a dumbbell under your body from hand to hand, challenging core stability.

name: 杠铃片过头行进
instructions: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Stand tall with ribs down and core braced.
Lift one knee toward hip height.
Lower it and lift the other knee in a controlled march.
Keep the plate steady and avoid leaning back.
description: Marching in place while holding a plate overhead, building leg strength, balance and shoulder stability.

name: 稳定球凳上臂屈伸
instructions: Sit on a bench edge with hands beside your hips and heels on a stability ball.
Slide your hips off the bench with arms straight.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees, keeping them close.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders down and the ball steady.
description: Bench dip with your feet on a stability ball for extra instability, hammering the triceps.

name: 扭转卷腹(双腿上抬)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and legs raised.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and repeat to the other side.
Do not pull on your neck.
description: Crunch with legs raised and a rotation at the top that hits the abs and obliques.

name: 下斜仰卧起坐 v. 3
instructions: Hook your feet under the pads on a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
Lower back slowly without dropping.
Keep your neck relaxed.
description: Sit-up on a decline bench that increases the range and load on the abs.

name: 杠杆哈克深蹲
instructions: Set your shoulders under the pads and feet shoulder width on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Press through your whole foot to stand.
Do not lock your knees hard at the top.
description: Plate-loaded hack squat machine that lets you load the quads and glutes with back support.

name: 反握反向划船
instructions: Lie under a bar set at about waist height and grip it with palms facing you.
Hang with your body straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
description: A bodyweight row hanging under a bar with an underhand grip. Builds the back and biceps.

name: 绳索跪姿前倾单臂划船
english: cable kneeling leaning forward one arm row
instructions: Kneel facing a low cable with a handle in one hand.
Lean your torso forward and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Finish reps and switch sides.
description: One-arm cable row from a kneeling position, leaning forward to give a long pull for the lats and mid back.

name: 吊环引体向上
instructions: Grab the rings and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your shoulders down.
Pull until the rings reach your chest or chin passes them.
Turn your palms slightly in as you rise if comfortable.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
description: Pull-up on gymnastic rings, which move freely and demand extra stability from the back and arms.

name: 绳索站姿单臂面拉
english: cable standing one arm face pull
instructions: Set a cable at upper chest height with a single handle.
Stand tall and grab the handle with one hand.
Pull toward your face, elbow high and out.
Rotate your hand back slightly at the end.
Return slowly and switch sides after the set.
description: One-arm face pull on a cable that trains the rear delts and rotator cuff for healthy shoulders.

name: 呼啦圈髋部绕圈
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding the hoop against your lower back.
Give it a push and start swinging your hips in circles.
Keep the motion smooth and steady.
Stay tall with a braced core.
Continue for a set time, then switch direction.
description: Hooping around your waist with a hula hoop for light cardio and core engagement.

name: 杠杆坐姿俯身后三角肌飞鸟
english: lever seated bent over rear delt fly
instructions: Sit on the machine with your chest on the pad and grip the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause, then return slowly.
Do not shrug.
description: Machine rear-delt fly where you lean forward and sweep your arms back.

name: 绳索站姿交叉过头三头肌伸展
english: cable standing crossover overhead tricep extension
instructions: Set two high pulleys with handles and face away from the stack.
Hold the handles overhead with elbows bent.
Cross your hands as you straighten your arms.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
description: Overhead triceps extension on crossed cables for a strong stretch and squeeze.

name: 负重全蹲接过头推举
english: weighted full squat with overhead press
instructions: Hold the weight at your shoulders and stand with feet shoulder width.
Squat down deeply with chest up.
Drive up through your legs.
Use that momentum to press the weight overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulders and repeat.
description: Full-depth squat followed by an overhead press, a thruster-style move that works legs and shoulders together.

name: 高抬膝触碰
instructions: Stand tall with hands out in front at waist height.
Drive one knee up to tap your hand.
Lower it and switch quickly to the other knee.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep a fast, steady pace for time.
description: Fast knee-drive drill where you tap your knees to your hands, great for warming up and raising the heart rate.

name: 绳索坐姿背阔肌划船
instructions: Sit at the cable row with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly.
Pull your elbows down and back toward your hips.
Squeeze your lats, then extend slowly.
Keep your chest up.
description: Seated cable row set up to emphasise the lats with a pull toward the hips.

name: 哑铃卡斯臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, loaded as the exercise requires.
Keep your shins roughly vertical with the knees kept slightly forward of the hips.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips up until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second at the top without arching your back.
Lower under control and repeat.
description: A glute bridge with a dumbbell on your hips and the knees kept slightly forward. Keeps tension on the glutes.

name: 徒手早安式体前屈
instructions: Stand with feet hip width and hands behind your head.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Keep your spine neutral.
description: Hip-hinge pattern with no load that warms up the hamstrings and lower back.

name: 离心俯卧撑
instructions: Start at the top of a push-up with straight arms.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor over 3-5 seconds.
Drop to your knees or reset at the bottom.
Return to the top and repeat.
description: Push-up focusing on the slow lowering phase to build strength for full reps.

name: 站姿靠门框胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand in a doorway with your forearm against the frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step through gently with the opposite foot.
Turn away until you feel a chest stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.
description: Doorway stretch for the chest and front of the shoulders.

name: 杠杆单臂上斜推胸(挂片式)
english: lever one arm incline chest press (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit on the machine and grip one handle.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the handle up and forward until the arm is nearly straight.
Lower slowly with control.
Finish reps, then switch arms.
description: Plate-loaded machine press on an incline, one arm at a time, for upper chest.

name: 杠铃停顿相扑硬拉
instructions: Stand with a wide stance, toes out, and grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace and pull the slack out of the bar.
Lift the bar a few centimetres and pause for 1-2 seconds.
Drive your hips forward and stand tall.
Lower the bar under control.
description: Sumo deadlift with a pause just off the floor to build strength out of the bottom.

name: EZ杠坐姿腕弯举
instructions: Sit on a bench with forearms on your thighs and wrists past your knees.
Hold the EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Lower the bar by opening your fingers slightly.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can.
Keep your forearms still.
description: Seated wrist curl with an EZ bar to build the forearm flexors.

name: 绳索跪姿单侧高位下拉
instructions: Kneel facing a high cable with a single handle in one hand.
Reach up to a full stretch.
Pull your elbow down toward your hip.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Return slowly and switch sides.
description: Kneeling one-arm lat pulldown for a stretch and strong contraction on each side.

name: 垫高后移弓步蹲
instructions: Stand on a low step with feet together.
Step one leg back and down to the floor.
Lower into a lunge with the front knee over the foot.
Push through the front heel to step back up.
Complete reps and switch legs.
description: Lunge stepping backward from a raised surface, which increases the range of motion.

name: 杠杆腹肌滑车卷腹
instructions: Sit on the machine, set the seat and grab the handles.
Place your legs on the pads and keep your back against the support.
Exhale and crunch your torso and knees toward each other.
Pause when your abs are fully squeezed.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
description: A machine crunch on a curved track that lets you curl your trunk and knees together. Builds the abs under load.

name: 尺蠖爬行加登山者
instructions: Stand tall, then hinge forward and walk your hands out to a plank.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Drive your knees to your chest alternately for several reps.
Walk your hands back to your feet.
Stand up and repeat.
description: Combo of an inchworm walk-out followed by mountain climbers for a full-body workout.

name: 哑铃俯卧后三角肌摆动
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Swing the weights out and up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your torso still.
description: Prone swing with dumbbells to target the rear delts.

name: 弹力带面拉
instructions: Anchor a band at head height and hold the ends.
Step back to create tension.
Pull the band toward your face, elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
description: Face pull using a band to train the rear delts and upper back.

name: 弹力带站姿推胸 v. 2
instructions: Anchor a band behind you and hold the ends at chest height.
Stand in a split stance for balance.
Press your hands forward until arms are straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your core braced.
description: Standing chest press against a band anchored behind you.

name: 绳索站姿面拉
instructions: Set a cable at upper chest height with a handle.
Stand tall and pull toward your face.
Spread your hands apart at the end.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
description: Cable face pull to build the rear delts and strengthen the upper back.

name: 二头弯举前踏步
instructions: Stand tall with your elbows at your sides and palms up.
Step one foot forward while curling your hands up to your shoulders.
Step back as you lower your arms.
Alternate legs at a brisk, steady pace.
Keep your elbows pinned and your core tight.
description: A rhythm drill pairing an arm curl with a quick step forward. Raises the heart rate while working the arms and legs.

name: 地雷管哈克深蹲
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep the bar close.
description: Squat with a landmine bar held at your chest, mimicking a hack squat.

name: 徒手窄站距深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet close together.
Extend your arms forward for balance.
Sit down and back, keeping your heels down.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
Press up to stand.
description: Squat with feet close together to emphasise the quads.

name: 哑铃站姿屈臂侧平举
english: dumbbell standing bent arm lateral raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with elbows bent about 90 degrees.
Raise your elbows out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Avoid swinging.
description: Lateral raise with elbows bent to isolate the side delts.

name: 杠铃肩宽握直立划船
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with hands shoulder width.
Pull the bar up along your body.
Lead with your elbows up to chest height.
Lower slowly.
Keep the bar close.
description: Upright row with a shoulder-width grip.

name: 杠铃窄站距深蹲 v. 2
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back with feet close together.
Brace your core.
Squat down with your chest up.
Stand back up through your feet.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
description: Back squat with a narrow stance for more quad focus.

name: 哑铃窄站距深蹲
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides with feet close together.
Brace your core.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up to stand.
Keep your heels down.
description: Narrow stance squat holding dumbbells to build the quads.

name: 哑铃屈臂侧平举
instructions: Stand with dumbbells and elbows bent.
Raise your elbows out to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your torso still.
description: Bent-arm lateral raise that shifts load onto the side delts.

name: 地雷管跪姿单臂肩部推举 v. 2
english: landmine kneeling one arm shoulder press v. 2
instructions: Kneel holding the end of a landmine bar at your shoulder.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after your set.
description: Kneeling one-arm landmine press for shoulder strength with an angled path.

name: 上斜俯卧撑(凳上)
instructions: Place hands on a bench slightly wider than shoulders.
Walk your feet back into a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bench.
Press back up.
Keep your core tight.
description: Push-up with hands elevated on a bench, an easier version of the push-up.

name: 空心摇摆
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your arms and legs into a hollow position.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Rock back and forth like a boat.
Keep your body rigid.
Continue for reps or time.
description: Rocking on your back in a hollow body position to challenge your core.

name: 绳索站姿面拉(用绳)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley.
Grab it with both hands.
Pull toward your face, splitting the rope.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
description: Face pull with a rope attachment to hit the rear delts.

name: 绳索侧弯 v. 2
instructions: Stand side-on to a low cable holding the handle.
Keep your hips still.
Bend sideways away from the cable.
Return to upright.
Switch sides.
description: Side bend using a cable for the obliques.

name: 绳索坐姿面拉(用绳)
instructions: Sit facing a cable with a rope attachment.
Sit tall.
Pull the rope toward your face.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
description: Seated rope face pull for the rear delts.

name: 杠铃安德森深蹲
instructions: Set the bar in safety pins at the bottom of a squat.
Get under it and brace.
Drive up from a dead stop.
Lower back to the pins.
Reset on every rep.
description: Squat starting from the bottom position, pausing each rep to build strength.

name: 杠铃限位架推胸
instructions: Set the pins just above your chest.
Lie under the bar with a firm grip.
Press the bar up.
Lower to the pins and pause.
Repeat.
description: Bench press from pins in the rack, starting from a dead stop at the chest.

name: 哑铃胸部支撑俯身划船
english: dumbbell bent over row with chest support
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells.
Let your arms hang.
Row the weights up toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
description: Chest-supported dumbbell row to reduce lower back stress.

name: 杠铃力量耸肩
instructions: Hold a barbell at mid-thigh.
Dip your knees slightly.
Extend your hips and shrug explosively.
Lower the bar under control.
Keep your arms straight.
description: Explosive shrug with a barbell, using a hip drive to build the traps.

name: 杠铃背后硬拉
instructions: Stand in front of the bar behind your legs.
Squat down and grip the bar behind you.
Stand up by driving your hips forward.
Lower the bar under control.
Keep your back flat.
description: Deadlift with the bar held behind you, a quad-friendly lift.

name: 绳索坐姿腿屈伸
instructions: Sit on a bench with an ankle strap attached to a low cable.
Hold the bench.
Extend your leg until straight.
Lower slowly.
Switch legs.
description: Seated leg extension using a cable for the quads.

name: 哑铃俯身面拉
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let the weights hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Pull the dumbbells toward your face, flaring your elbows out and up.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control and repeat without swinging.
description: Hinge forward and pull two dumbbells toward your face with elbows high. It works the rear delts and upper back and helps shoulder posture.

name: 哑铃高拉
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dumbbells hanging in front of your thighs.
Bend your knees and hips slightly, keeping your chest up.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and pull the weights up with elbows leading.
Stop at about chest height, elbows above your wrists.
Lower the dumbbells under control and reset.
description: An explosive pull that drives dumbbells up to chest height using the legs and hips. It builds the shoulders and traps and trains power.

name: 哑铃z式推举
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and sit tall without leaning back.
Press the weights overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders with control.
description: A seated overhead press done on the floor with legs straight out. With no back support, it trains the shoulders and demands a strong core.

name: 杠铃站姿肩部限位架推举
instructions: Set the bar on safety pins at about shoulder height in a rack.
Step under it and grip just outside shoulder width.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lower the bar to rest on the pins, pause, and repeat.
description: A standing overhead press starting from a dead stop on safety pins. Without the stretch reflex, it builds pressing strength out of the bottom position.

name: 杠铃严格弯举
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and your torso still.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.
description: A barbell curl done with no body swing, so the biceps do all of the work. It is a simple way to build the front of the upper arm.

name: 杠铃泽奇硬拉
instructions: Place the bar on a low rack or the floor and stand over it.
Squat down and hook the bar in the crooks of your elbows.
Lift your chest and brace your core.
Stand up by driving through your legs and extending your hips.
Lower the bar back down under control, keeping your back flat.
description: A deadlift with the bar cradled in the crooks of your elbows. It loads the glutes, legs and back and trains an upright torso.

name: 徒手单腿卡斯臀桥
english: bodyweight single leg kas glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your standing shin close to vertical.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips until in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg glute bridge with the knee kept forward. Works each glute on its own and tests hip balance.

name: 徒手b式站姿早安式体前屈
instructions: Stand with one foot flat and the other slightly behind, toe resting on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstring of the front leg.
Return to standing and switch legs after your set.
description: A hip hinge with one foot staggered slightly behind. It biases one leg to train the hamstrings and glutes and builds balance.

name: 侧向登山者
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee out toward the same-side elbow.
Return that foot and switch quickly to the other leg.
Keep your hips low and your core tight.
Continue at a brisk pace for the set time.
description: A mountain climber where the knees drive toward the elbows on the side. It raises your heart rate and works the obliques and hips.

name: 双臂交叉前踢腿
instructions: Stand tall with your arms crossed over your chest.
Shift your weight onto one leg.
Kick the other leg forward to about hip height with control.
Lower it and repeat for your reps.
Switch legs and keep your torso upright.
description: A standing front kick with your arms crossed over your chest. Warms up the hips and legs while challenging balance.

name: 前倾拉伸
instructions: Stand or sit in a stable position with one leg in front of the other.
Keep your back long and chest open.
Hinge forward from your hips until you feel a stretch in the glutes and hamstrings.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright and switch sides.
description: A forward-leaning stretch that opens the hips and the back of the legs.

name: 借力弯举
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, arms straight.
Lean back slightly and swing your hips to start the lift.
Curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower the bar slowly, resisting its weight.
Reset your posture before the next rep.
description: A heavier biceps curl that uses a small hip swing to get the bar past the sticking point. It lets you overload the biceps on the way up.

name: 哑铃架上仰卧划船
instructions: Lie face down on a raised bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights up toward your ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.
description: A chest-supported row done lying face down on an incline bench or rack. With the body supported, it focuses the work on the upper back.

name: 哑铃行走提踵
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Step forward and stay up on your toes.
Alternate steps, keeping your heels lifted.
Walk for the set distance, then lower your heels.
description: Walk forward while rising high onto your toes with each step, holding dumbbells. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.

name: 45度侧弯
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree bench, lying on your side with your feet anchored.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your upper body toward the floor.
Bend up sideways by contracting your oblique.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A side bend done on a 45 degree bench that trains the obliques through a long range of motion.

name: 徒手行走提踵
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Take a step forward, staying on your toes.
Keep alternating steps without dropping your heels.
Lower your heels when you reach the end of the set.
description: Walk forward staying high on your toes with every step. It builds calf endurance and ankle control without any equipment.

name: 杠铃限位架深蹲
instructions: Set the safety pins at the depth you want and place the bar on them.
Duck under the bar and lift it onto your upper back.
Squat down until the bar rests on the pins.
Pause briefly while staying tight.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.
description: A squat that starts each rep from a dead stop on safety pins. It removes the bounce and builds strength out of the bottom.

name: 杠铃垫高硬拉
instructions: Stand on a low plate or platform with the bar over mid-foot.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Flatten your back and brace your core.
Push the floor away and stand tall.
Lower the bar back under control.
description: A deadlift performed while standing on a low platform. The longer range of motion trains the start of the pull and the legs.

name: 绳索上斜二头弯举
instructions: Set a low cable and lie back on an incline bench facing away from the stack.
Hold the handles with your arms hanging behind you.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Keep your elbows back and still.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A cable curl done leaning back on an incline bench. The arms hang behind the body, which stretches the biceps at the start.

name: 杠铃悬垂力量翻
instructions: Hold the bar at mid-thigh with an overhand grip and a flat back.
Hinge slightly so the bar sits just above your knees.
Jump and shrug explosively, extending hips and knees.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower the bar back to the hang.
description: An explosive lift from the hang position that brings the bar to the shoulders. It trains power through the hips, legs and traps.

name: 杠铃高翻高拉
instructions: Set up over the bar with feet hip-width apart and a flat back.
Lift the bar to your knees with your chest up.
Extend your hips and knees explosively and shrug hard.
Pull the bar up to chest height with elbows high and outside.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.
description: A powerful pull from the floor that sends the bar to chest height. It develops explosive hips, traps and shoulders.

name: 杠铃杰斐逊硬拉
instructions: Stand straddling the bar with one foot forward and one back.
Squat down and grip the bar with one hand in front and one behind.
Brace your core and lift your chest.
Stand up by driving through both legs.
Lower the bar with control and switch your stance on the next set.
description: A deadlift with the bar between your legs and a split stance. It loads the legs and hips and trains the back to stay braced.

name: 悬挂带飞鸟
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with your body in a straight line.
Start with your arms out in front of you, slightly bent.
Open your arms out to the sides, lowering your chest between the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Squeeze your chest to bring your arms back together.
description: A bodyweight chest fly using suspension straps. You open your arms wide while leaning forward to stretch and load the chest.

name: 悬挂带推胸
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with a straight body.
Start with your hands by your chest and elbows bent.
Press yourself away until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and hips in line.
Lower back slowly with control.
description: A push-up style press on suspension straps. The unstable handles make your chest, arms and core work together.

name: 绳索跪姿卷腹 v. 2
instructions: Kneel below a high cable with the rope held beside your head.
Keep your hips still and your back slightly rounded.
Crunch down, bringing your elbows toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without sitting back on your heels.
description: A kneeling cable crunch that curls the spine toward the hips. It loads the abs against steady resistance.

name: 增强式深蹲
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit into a squat with your chest up.
Explode upward and jump as high as you can.
Land softly on bent knees and go straight into the next squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
description: A squat followed by an explosive jump. Builds power and conditioning in the legs.

name: 哑铃臀推 v. 2
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant your feet flat, shoulder-width apart.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top with your chin tucked.
Lower under control and repeat.
description: A hip thrust with a dumbbell resting on your hips. Strong glute builder for the glutes.

name: 单腿臀推
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your arms out for balance.
Drive through your heel to lift your hips until level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control and switch legs after your reps.
description: Hip thrusts done on one leg with your upper back on a support. Builds glute strength and hip stability.

name: 杠杆反向垂直哈克深蹲
instructions: Set the machine and stand with your chest against the pad, feet on the platform.
Grip the handles and brace your core.
Bend your knees and lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your whole foot to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
description: A machine squat facing the pad with a vertical lever path. Hits the thighs and glutes with back-friendly support.

name: 徒手俯卧Y字
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead in a Y.
Turn your thumbs toward the ceiling.
Lift your arms off the floor, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.
description: Lie face down and raise your arms into a Y shape. It strengthens the lower traps and shoulder stabilizers.

name: 弹力带辅助双杠上推
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and place your foot or knee in it.
Hang from the bar with a false or overhand grip.
Pull explosively, bringing your chest to the bar.
Lean over the bar and press yourself up to straight arms.
Lower back down slowly and repeat.
description: A muscle up where a band under your feet or knees takes some of your weight. It lets you learn the pull and transition on the bar.

name: 凳上反向挺身
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and legs hanging.
Hold the bench for support.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs until level with your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
description: Lie face down over a bench and lift your legs behind you. It strengthens the glutes and lower back.

name: 宽距臀桥脉冲
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet wide apart.
Lift your hips to the top of a bridge.
Pulse your hips up and down in small, controlled movements.
Keep your glutes squeezed throughout.
Lower fully after your set.
description: A glute bridge with feet set wide and small pulses at the top. Burns the glutes with constant tension.

name: 屈腿踢
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your core tight and back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent, pressing your foot toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower and repeat, then switch legs.
description: A kneeling glute kick back with the knee bent. It targets the glutes with a controlled squeeze.

name: 45度挺身(双臂在胸前)
english: 45 degree hyperextension (arms in front of chest)
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise yourself until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower slowly.
description: A back extension on a 45 degree bench with arms crossed at the chest. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.

name: 绳索低位推胸
instructions: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance with elbows bent.
Press the handles up and forward in an arc.
Squeeze your chest as your hands meet.
Return slowly to the start.
description: A standing cable press with the handles starting low and moving upward. It works the upper chest and front shoulders.

name: 杠杆单臂侧向推胸
english: lever one arm side chest press
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip one handle at chest level.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your set.
description: A single-arm press on a chest press machine. Training one side at a time helps balance strength between arms.

name: 哑铃单臂侧卧凳上推举
english: dumbbell one arm side lying bench press
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench with a dumbbell in the top hand.
Bring the weight to your chest.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to the chest.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
description: A one-arm press done lying on your side on a bench. It targets the chest while the core resists rolling.

name: 哑铃侧卧外旋(凳上)
english: dumbbell side lying external rotation (on a bench)
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench with a light dumbbell in the top hand.
Keep your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked to your side.
Rotate your forearm upward, keeping your elbow still.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and switch sides after your set.
description: A gentle shoulder rotation lying on your side with a light dumbbell. It strengthens the rotator cuff for joint stability.

name: 负重满罐举
instructions: Hold a light weight in each hand with thumbs pointing up.
Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Raise your arms diagonally forward to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly with control.
description: Raise light weights in front at a diagonal with thumbs up. It trains the shoulder muscles that lift the arm.

name: 哑铃空罐举
instructions: Hold light dumbbells with your thumbs pointing down.
Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Raise your arms diagonally forward to shoulder height.
Hold briefly without shrugging.
Lower slowly with control.
description: Raise light dumbbells with thumbs pointing down, as if emptying a can. It targets the front and side shoulder.

name: 哑铃俯卧满罐举
instructions: Lie face down on a bench or floor with light dumbbells hanging.
Turn your thumbs to the ceiling.
Raise your arms out diagonally into a Y.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly under control.
description: Lying face down, raise light dumbbells out in a Y with thumbs up. It strengthens the rear shoulder and upper back.

name: 绳索跪姿肩外旋推举(外展90度)
english: cable kneeling shoulder 90 degrees external rotation press
instructions: Kneel next to a cable with your elbow at shoulder height and bent 90 degrees.
Hold the handle and brace your core.
Rotate your forearm upward until it points to the ceiling.
Press the handle overhead.
Reverse the movement slowly and switch sides.
description: From a kneeling position, rotate your forearm up and then press overhead on a cable. It trains shoulder rotation and stability.

name: 俯卧Y字上举
instructions: Lie face down with arms stretched overhead in a Y.
Turn your thumbs up.
Lift your arms, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
description: Lie face down and lift your arms overhead in a Y. It builds the lower traps and the muscles that support the shoulder blades.

name: 杠铃行走弓步蹲
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper back and stand tall.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright.
Push through your front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Continue alternating legs for the set distance.
description: Lunge forward step by step with a barbell on your back. It builds the legs and glutes and challenges balance.

name: 史密斯机后撤弓步蹲 v. 2
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand tall.
Step one foot back behind you.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through your front heel to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A reverse lunge using the Smith machine for a fixed bar path. It works the glutes and quads with extra stability.

name: 弹力带穿腿拉
instructions: Anchor the band low and face away from it, holding the band between your legs.
Step forward until you feel tension, feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your arms relaxed and straight.
description: A hip hinge where you pull a band through your legs. Teaches the hinge and strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 杠杆上斜飞鸟
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your upper chest.
Squeeze your chest.
Return slowly to a comfortable stretch.
description: A machine fly with an incline angle that emphasizes the upper chest. The handles move in a fixed arc.

name: 单臂侧向直臂高位下拉
english: single arm side straight arm lat pulldown
instructions: Stand facing a high cable with one handle in your hand.
Keep your arm nearly straight and slightly angled.
Pull the handle down toward your thigh by squeezing your lat.
Hold briefly.
Let it rise slowly and switch sides after your set.
description: A straight-arm cable pulldown from the side, one arm at a time. It isolates the lats without bending the elbow much.

name: 交叉站姿卷腹
instructions: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee and rotate your torso.
Bring the opposite elbow toward that knee.
Return to standing.
Alternate sides for the set.
description: A standing crunch that brings your elbow across to the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.

name: 杠铃上斜后三角肌划船
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a barbell with a wide grip.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the bar up with elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.
description: A row lying chest-down on an incline bench with elbows flared. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: 壶铃站姿提踵
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the balls of your feet on a step if you like.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Rise as high as you can on your toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly.
description: A standing calf raise holding a kettlebell for resistance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.

name: 壶铃高翻推举
instructions: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet and hinge to grip it.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up to your shoulder.
Brace your core and press the bell overhead.
Lock out your arm with the bicep near your ear.
Lower to the shoulder, then back to the floor, and switch sides.
description: Clean a kettlebell to the shoulder and press it overhead. It combines a hip drive with a shoulder press for full-body power.

name: 壶铃集中弯举
instructions: Sit with your legs apart and a kettlebell in one hand.
Rest your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the kettlebell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms.
description: A seated one-arm curl with the elbow braced on your thigh. It isolates the biceps with a strict path.

name: 壶铃二头弯举
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands or one.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the kettlebell toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower with control.
description: A standard curl holding a kettlebell, which pulls the weight slightly forward of the hand. It builds the biceps and grip.

name: 壶铃地板飞鸟
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides until the elbows touch the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back up.
Repeat with control.
description: Lie on the floor and open your arms out with kettlebells, stopping when your elbows touch down. It trains the chest.

name: 壶铃前平举
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell with both hands by the sides of the handle.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the kettlebell to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.
description: Lift a kettlebell straight in front of you to shoulder height. It works the front of the shoulder.

name: 壶铃过头三头肌伸展
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns with both hands overhead.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms until they are straight.
Repeat without flaring your elbows.
description: Hold a kettlebell behind your head and straighten your arms overhead. It isolates the triceps.

name: 壶铃仰卧三头肌伸展(颅骨粉碎者)
english: kettlebell lying triceps extension skull crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell above your chest.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Repeat with control.
description: Lie back and lower a kettlebell toward your forehead, then extend. It builds the triceps with elbows fixed.

name: 壶铃腕弯举
instructions: Sit with your forearm on your thigh, palm up, holding a kettlebell.
Let your wrist extend downward.
Curl your hand up toward you.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms.
description: Curl a kettlebell with only your wrists while your forearm rests on your thigh. It builds forearm strength and grip.

name: 壶铃站姿单臂伸展
instructions: Stand tall with a kettlebell held overhead in one hand.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending the elbow.
Straighten your arm back to the top.
Switch sides after your set.
description: Hold a kettlebell overhead in one hand and lower it behind your head. It isolates one triceps at a time.

name: 徒手摆荡
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms hanging.
Hinge back at your hips and swing your arms between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and stand tall.
Let your arms float up to chest height.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.
description: A hip hinge swing with your arms moving like a kettlebell swing, but with no weight. It teaches the hip drive and warms up the glutes.

name: 宽站距跳跃深蹲转窄站距跳跃深蹲
english: wide stance jump squat to narrow stance jump squat
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and squat down.
Jump up, bringing your feet together mid-air.
Land softly in a narrow stance and squat.
Jump again, landing back in the wide stance.
Keep your chest up and move at a steady pace.
description: Jump squats that alternate between a wide and a narrow stance. It builds explosive leg power and gets your heart rate up.

name: 下斜钻石俯卧撑
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands close together under your chest.
Form a diamond with your thumbs and index fingers.
Lower your chest toward your hands.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Push back up to straight arms.
description: A diamond push-up with your feet raised. It shifts the load toward the triceps and upper chest.

name: 壶铃俯身交替扭转划船
english: kettlebell bent over alternate twist row
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Row one kettlebell toward your hip.
Rotate your torso slightly as you pull.
Lower the weight and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides for the set.
description: A bent over kettlebell row with a rotation as you pull. It trains the back and challenges the core.

name: EZ杠铃仰卧三头肌伸展
instructions: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar above your chest.
Keep your upper arms vertical.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Keep your elbows from flaring.
description: Lie on a bench and lower an EZ bar toward your forehead, then press back up. It builds the triceps with minimal wrist strain.

name: 绳索高位滑轮直杆过头三头肌伸展
english: cable high pulley straight bar overhead triceps extension
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and face away from it.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows bent.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms forward and up.
Return slowly.
description: Face away from a high pulley and extend your arms overhead holding a straight bar. It isolates the triceps.

name: 悬挂带三头肌伸展
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with a straight body.
Start with your arms overhead and elbows bent.
Extend your arms, keeping your upper arms still.
Pause when your arms are straight.
Lower back slowly.
description: Lean into suspension straps and straighten your arms from a bent position. It trains the triceps using your body weight.

name: 壶铃侧平板支撑
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Hold a kettlebell in your top hand pointing up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.
description: A side plank holding a kettlebell above you. It builds core and shoulder stability.

name: 壶铃提踵加前蹲
english: kettlebell calf raise and front squat
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up to standing.
At the top, rise onto your toes for a calf raise.
Lower your heels and repeat with control.
description: A combo move that pairs a goblet-style front squat with a calf raise at the top, working the legs from hips to ankles.

name: 螃蟹步
instructions: Sit on the floor, place your hands behind you and lift your hips off the ground.
Keep your hips high and your core braced.
Step with opposite hand and foot to move forward.
Walk for several steps, then go backward.
Keep your head neutral and your arms steady.
description: Walk on hands and feet with your belly facing up, a playful drill that fires up the glutes, triceps and core.

name: 徒手斜向劈砍深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped above one shoulder.
Squat down while chopping your hands diagonally toward the opposite knee.
Rotate through your trunk and let your back foot pivot.
Stand up as you swing your arms back up.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A squat with a diagonal chopping arm motion that trains the legs and teaches the trunk to rotate with control.

name: 杠铃弯举推举伸展
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip at thigh level.
Curl the bar up to your shoulders without swinging.
Press it overhead until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, keeping your upper arms still.
Extend, bring the bar back to the front and lower it under control.
Use a light weight to keep your form tidy.
description: A three-part arm combo: curl, press overhead, then lower behind the head for a triceps extension. It works the whole arm in one set.

name: 哑铃弯举推举伸展
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights behind your head.
Extend your arms, then bring the dumbbells back to your shoulders and down to your sides.
Keep your torso still and choose a manageable weight.
description: Curl, press and overhead extension chained into one rep with dumbbells, giving the biceps, shoulders and triceps a full workout.

name: 莲花坐呼吸
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and each foot resting on the opposite thigh if comfortable.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Inhale slowly through your nose and fill your belly and chest.
Exhale slowly and fully.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and breathe steadily for 1-2 minutes.
description: A seated cross-legged breathing practice that calms the mind and lengthens the spine while the hips stay open.

name: 壶铃旋转硬拉
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a kettlebell in both hands.
Push your hips back and lower the bell toward the outside of one foot.
Rotate your torso slightly as you reach, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand and unwind.
Repeat to the same side, then switch.
description: A hip hinge with a rotation toward the floor, training the glutes and hamstrings while the trunk learns to twist under load.

name: 三腿下犬式
instructions: Start in downward dog with hands shoulder-width apart.
Press your hands into the floor and lengthen your spine.
Lift one leg straight up behind you, keeping your hips square.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Lower and switch legs.
description: Downward dog with one leg lifted behind you. Stretches the back of the legs while building shoulder and hip stability.

name: 鳄鱼式
instructions: Start in a high plank with your wrists under your shoulders.
Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower to elbow height.
Keep your body in one line and your elbows near your ribs.
Hold briefly, then press back up.
description: A low plank where the elbows are bent back by your ribs. Builds strength in the arms, chest and core.

name: 摊尸式
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and slightly apart.
Let your arms rest by your sides with palms up.
Close your eyes and let your whole body soften.
Breathe slowly for 2-5 minutes.
Roll to your side and sit up gently.
description: The classic resting pose at the end of practice. Lets the body relax fully.

name: 双鸽式
instructions: Sit with your legs crossed and stack one shin on top of the other.
Flex your feet to protect your knees.
Sit tall, then hinge forward over your shins.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Swap which leg is on top and repeat.
description: A seated pose with one shin stacked on the other. Opens the outer hips and glutes.

name: 高弓步
instructions: Step one foot back into a long lunge with your back heel lifted.
Bend your front knee to about 90 degrees over your ankle.
Sweep your arms overhead and stand tall.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Step forward and switch legs.
description: A deep lunge with the back heel lifted and arms overhead. Strengthens the legs and stretches the hips.

name: 蜥蜴式
instructions: Start in a low lunge with your back knee down or lifted.
Walk your front foot to the outer edge of your mat.
Place both hands inside the front foot.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch legs.
description: A low lunge with both hands inside the front foot. Opens the hips and groin.

name: 冥想
instructions: Sit comfortably cross-legged, with hips slightly higher than your knees.
Lengthen your spine and relax your shoulders.
Rest your hands on your knees.
Close your eyes and settle into easy breathing.
Stay for 3-10 minutes.
description: Seated stillness with a tall spine. Calms the mind and trains upright posture.

name: 正念呼吸冥想
instructions: Sit tall in a comfortable position and relax your shoulders.
Rest your hands on your lap.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Breathe out slowly and notice the pause.
Continue for 3-10 minutes.
description: A seated practice of following your breath. Lowers tension and trains focus.

name: 山式
instructions: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart.
Spread your toes and press evenly through both feet.
Lengthen your spine and draw your shoulders back and down.
Let your arms hang with palms forward.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
description: The basic standing pose with a tall, balanced posture. A base for most other poses.

name: 小狗式
instructions: Start on hands and knees with your hips over your knees.
Walk your hands forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep your hips high above your knees.
Rest your forehead down and hold for 5 slow breaths.
Walk your hands back to return.
description: A half child's pose with arms reaching forward and hips high. Opens the shoulders and the back.

name: 金字塔式
instructions: Step one foot back with both feet facing forward.
Keep both legs straight and your hips square.
Hinge forward from your hips with a long back.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Rise slowly and switch legs.
description: A standing forward fold with one leg back. Deeply stretches the back of the front leg.

name: 扭转椅式
instructions: Stand and sink your hips back into a chair pose.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook one elbow outside the opposite knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with your knees together.
Untwist and repeat on the other side.
description: A chair squat with a twist. Strengthens the legs while rotating the spine.

name: 扭转侧角式
instructions: Step into a lunge with your back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook your elbow outside the front knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch sides.
description: A deep lunge with a twist and the arms stretched wide. Builds leg strength and opens the spine.

name: 扭转三角式
instructions: Stand with your feet wide, back foot turned slightly.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Place one hand down and reach the other arm up as you twist.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Come up and switch sides.
description: A standing forward bend with a twist. Stretches the back of the legs and rotates the spine.

name: 站姿四字式
instructions: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one leg.
Cross the other ankle over the standing thigh.
Bend your standing knee and sit your hips back.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with a long spine.
Switch legs.
description: A one-leg balance with the ankle crossed over the opposite knee. Stretches the outer hip.

name: 站姿半前屈
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward from your hips and bring your hands to your shins or thighs.
Lengthen your spine until your back is flat.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Roll up slowly to stand.
description: A halfway forward fold with a flat back. Lengthens the back of the legs.

name: 穿针式
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Slide one arm under your chest and rest your shoulder on the floor.
Keep your hips over your knees.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Return and switch arms.
description: A gentle twist from hands and knees. Loosens the upper back and shoulders.

name: 虎卷式
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a neutral spine.
Extend one leg behind you and look slightly forward.
Round your back and draw the knee toward your nose.
Extend again and repeat for 6-8 reps.
Switch legs.
description: From hands and knees, you extend one leg back and curl the knee toward your nose. Works the abs and mobilizes the spine.

name: 扭腿弓步式
instructions: Step into a low lunge with your back knee down.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist toward the front leg and hook your elbow outside the knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch legs.
description: A lunge with a twist toward the front leg. Opens the hips and spine.

name: 战士三式
instructions: Stand on one leg with your arms overhead.
Hinge forward and lift the back leg behind you.
Bring your torso and back leg level with the floor.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with your hips square.
Lower and switch legs.
description: A one-leg balance with the torso and back leg parallel to the floor. Builds balance and strength.

name: 扭转头触膝式
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and the other foot against your inner thigh.
Rotate your chest toward the extended leg.
Reach one arm overhead and bend over the leg.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Rise and switch sides.
description: A seated side bend and twist over one extended leg. Stretches the side body and hamstrings.

name: 负重锁链相扑硬拉
instructions: Hang chains on a barbell and stand with a wide stance, toes pointed out.
Grip the bar inside your knees with a flat back.
Push the floor away and drive your knees out.
Stand tall as the chains lift and the load increases.
Lock out with your glutes, then lower the bar under control.
description: A sumo deadlift with chains hung on the bar, so the load gets heavier as you stand up. It builds the glutes, inner thighs and back.

name: 安全杠早安式体前屈
instructions: Set the safety bar on your upper back and shoulders and hold the handles.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso until it is near parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
description: A hip hinge with a safety squat bar resting on your shoulders, strengthening the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.

name: 杠铃负重锁链相扑硬拉
instructions: Loop chains over the ends of a barbell and take a wide stance, toes angled out.
Bend down and grip the bar with your hands inside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Push through your feet and stand, with the chains adding load as you rise.
Lock out your hips, then lower the bar with control.
description: Sumo deadlift with chains added to the bar for extra resistance near lockout, hitting the glutes, thighs and back.

name: 反向战士式
instructions: Step into a wide warrior II stance.
Bend your front knee over your ankle.
Reach your front arm up and lean back.
Rest your back hand on your leg.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then switch.
description: A lunge with a back bend and one arm reaching up. Stretches the side body and strengthens the legs.

name: 四肢支撑式
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower.
Keep your body straight like a plank.
Hold briefly, then press back up.
description: A low plank with elbows hugged by your sides. Builds strength in the arms and core.

name: 三腿鳄鱼式
instructions: Start in a high plank and lift one leg behind you.
Keep your hips level.
Bend your elbows back and lower.
Hold briefly with your body in line.
Press up, lower the leg and switch.
description: A low plank with one leg lifted. Adds a balance challenge to the arms and core.

name: 绳索坐姿高位滑轮过头三头肌伸展
english: cable seated high pulley overhead tricep extension
instructions: Sit facing away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and elbows pointing forward.
Straighten your arms to extend the handle up.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
Keep your torso upright and your upper arms still.
description: A seated overhead triceps extension on a high pulley that keeps constant tension on the back of the arms.

name: 快乐婴儿式
instructions: Lie on your back and bend your knees toward your chest.
Hold the outsides of your feet.
Open your knees wide toward your armpits.
Rock gently side to side and hold for 5 slow breaths.
Release your feet and rest.
description: Lying on your back and holding your feet with knees wide. Opens the hips and relaxes the lower back.

name: 哑铃锤式牧师凳弯举
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with palm facing in, thumb up.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until your arm is nearly straight.
Complete your reps, then switch arms or alternate.
description: A preacher curl with a neutral hammer grip that targets the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.

name: 俄罗斯转体劈砍
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands together in front of you.
Twist and chop your arms diagonally across your body.
Return to center and chop the other way.
Keep your chest tall and your core tight.
description: A seated twist with a diagonal chopping arm motion. Works the abs and obliques.

name: 绳索单臂中立握前平举
english: cable single arm neutral grip front raise
instructions: Stand facing away from a low pulley and hold the handle with a neutral grip.
Keep your arm nearly straight and your core braced.
Raise your arm forward to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch arms.
description: A one-arm cable front raise with a palm-in grip, giving steady tension to the front of the shoulder.

name: 哑铃单臂中立握前平举
english: dumbbell single arm neutral grip front raise
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side with palm facing in.
Brace your core and keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Avoid swinging, finish all reps and switch arms.
description: A one-arm dumbbell front raise using a hammer grip, targeting the front deltoid with less wrist strain.

name: 垂直仰卧起坐
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs raised straight toward the ceiling.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up and reach toward your feet.
Pause at the top.
Lower your upper body slowly to the floor.
description: A sit-up performed with the legs raised vertically, which keeps the focus on the abs by taking the hip flexors out of the pull.

name: 1 2 棍棒训练
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with knees slightly bent.
Take quick steps in the set pattern, one then two.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your arms bent and swinging naturally.
Repeat for 20-30 seconds with sharp, light steps.
description: A quick footwork drill that builds agility and coordination with fast, light steps.

name: 跳跃转体
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart in a slight squat.
Jump up and rotate your hips and feet to one side.
Land softly with bent knees.
Jump again and twist to the other side.
Keep your chest up and land quietly.
description: A jump with a midair trunk rotation that trains explosive leg power and core control.

name: 敏捷球训练
instructions: Set up with a ball in front of you in an athletic stance.
Move quickly around or over the ball with short, light steps.
Keep your hips low and eyes up.
Change direction without crossing your feet.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.
description: A footwork and reaction drill with a ball that sharpens agility, balance and quick direction changes.

name: 波比转体
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Perform a push-up if you like.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Explode up, rotating your trunk as you jump, and land softly.
Alternate twist directions each rep.
description: A burpee with a trunk rotation on the jump, raising your heart rate while challenging the whole body.

name: 点位训练
instructions: Mark five dots on the floor like the five on a die.
Stand on the balls of your feet next to the pattern.
Hop quickly from dot to dot in your chosen order.
Keep your hops small and your knees soft.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then rest.
description: A fast foot drill over a pattern of dots that builds foot speed, ankle stability and coordination.

name: 脚跟接脚尖走
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides.
Place your right heel directly in front of your left toes.
Shift your weight forward and step again with the other foot.
Keep your eyes forward and your core gently braced.
Walk 10-15 steps, then turn around and return.
description: A slow line walk with each heel touching the toes of the other foot, which trains balance and steady stride control.

name: L形训练
instructions: Place three cones in an L shape, about 5 yards apart.
Sprint from the start cone to the second and touch it.
Backpedal to the start.
Sprint to the second again, turn around the cone and weave around the third.
Return to the start along the same line.
Stay low through turns.
description: A cone drill run in an L shape that sharpens sprinting, backpedaling and quick cuts.

name: 绳梯训练
instructions: Lay an agility ladder flat on the ground.
Stand at the start in an athletic stance.
Step quickly with both feet into each square, one after another.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms and keep your eyes up.
Jog back and repeat for several rounds.
description: A footwork drill through an agility ladder that builds quick feet, rhythm and coordination.

name: 侧向绳梯训练
instructions: Stand sideways at the start of an agility ladder.
Step both feet into the first square, one at a time.
Move sideways to the next square with quick steps.
Keep your hips low and your feet light.
Finish the ladder, then repeat facing the other way.
description: A sideways run through an agility ladder to build lateral speed and foot coordination.

name: 增强式敏捷训练
instructions: Set out a few markers within a small area.
Stand in an athletic stance on the balls of your feet.
Hop or step quickly between the markers in changing directions.
Land softly with bent knees.
Work for 20-30 seconds, rest, then repeat.
description: A mix of quick hops and direction changes that builds explosive power and agility.

name: 单腿平衡交叉出拳
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and fists up.
Brace your core.
Throw a cross punch, rotating your hips and shoulders.
Pull your fist back to guard.
Keep your standing foot steady.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: Cross punches thrown while balancing on one leg, which trains balance, rotation and core control.

name: T形训练
instructions: Set four cones in a T with the top cones 5 yards apart.
Sprint forward to the center cone and touch it.
Shuffle sideways to the left cone and touch it.
Shuffle across to the right cone, then back to the middle.
Backpedal to the start.
Keep your hips low and feet from crossing.
description: A cone drill in a T shape that trains sprinting, side shuffling and backpedaling.

name: 走钢丝
instructions: Place a line of tape on the floor or imagine one.
Stand at one end with your arms out for balance.
Walk heel to toe along the line.
Keep your gaze ahead and your core braced.
Turn at the end and walk back.
description: Walking along an imaginary or taped line to train balance and foot control.

name: 玩具兵动态拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your arms stretched out in front of you.
Kick one straight leg up toward your hands.
Lower it and step forward.
Kick the other leg up.
Keep your chest upright and walk for about 10 reps per side.
description: A walking stretch where you kick straight legs up toward outstretched hands, warming up the hamstrings and hips.

name: X形训练
instructions: Set four cones in a square, with a center point.
Sprint diagonally from one corner through the center to the opposite corner.
Shuffle sideways along one edge to the next corner.
Backpedal or sprint diagonally again.
Stay low through turns and repeat.
description: A cone drill in an X pattern that mixes sprints, shuffles and backpedals for agility.

name: 拜日式A
instructions: Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward and step back to plank.
Lower, then press into upward dog and downward dog.
Step forward, rise and return to mountain.
Repeat the flow at a steady pace.
description: A flowing sequence linking breath and movement. Warms up the whole body.

name: 拜日式b
instructions: Stand in mountain pose and sit into a chair pose with your arms overhead.
Fold forward, step back to plank and flow through chaturanga.
Press to downward dog.
Step forward into warrior I on each side, then flow again.
Link every move to your breath.
description: A more powerful flow that adds chair pose and warrior I. Builds heat and leg strength.

name: 半拜日式
instructions: Stand in mountain pose and sweep your arms overhead.
Fold forward with a long spine.
Lift halfway up with a flat back.
Fold again and rise up with your arms overhead.
Lower your hands to your heart and repeat.
description: A shortened sun salutation that keeps the upright flow. Gently warms the spine and legs.

name: 流瑜伽
instructions: Start in plank pose.
Lower to chaturanga with your elbows by your ribs.
Roll forward into upward dog with an open chest.
Lift your hips to downward dog.
Hold for a breath or two and repeat.
description: A short flow of plank, chaturanga, upward dog and downward dog. Used to link poses together.

name: 123折返训练
instructions: Set a cone line a few yards apart.
Sprint to the first cone and touch it, then back to the start.
Sprint to the second cone and back.
Go to the third cone and back.
Stay low when turning.
Rest, then repeat.
description: A cone drill with a set number of steps forward and back to sharpen speed and quick direction changes.

name: 气球训练
instructions: Toss a balloon into the air in an open space.
Stay on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Move under the balloon and tap it up.
Use small hops to reach it.
Keep it up for 30-60 seconds.
description: A playful balance and leg drill where you keep a balloon in the air using quick footwork and small jumps.

name: 锥桶训练
instructions: Place several cones in a pattern a few yards apart.
Start in an athletic stance.
Sprint or shuffle around the cones in order.
Plant and cut with your hips low.
Finish the course, rest, then go again.
description: A cone run that builds acceleration, cutting speed and agility.

name: 瓶装负重硬拉
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Lower the bottles along your legs to mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
description: A light deadlift holding a bottle in each hand. A good way to learn the hip hinge.

name: 8字跑
instructions: Set two cones about 5 yards apart.
Start next to one cone in an athletic stance.
Run a figure-eight around both cones.
Lean into the turns and keep your hips low.
Run for 20-30 seconds, then change direction.
description: A run in a figure-eight around two cones, which builds agility, balance and quick turns.

name: 高栏跳接冲刺和变向
english: high hurdle jump to sprint and cut
instructions: Stand facing a high hurdle with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms and jump over it, tucking your knees.
Land softly with bent knees.
Sprint forward right away.
Plant and cut sharply to one side.
Walk back and repeat, alternating cut directions.
description: Jump over a high hurdle, land and sprint into a sharp cut, training explosive power and reactive agility.

name: 搭档滑步
instructions: Face a partner about 2 yards away in an athletic stance.
Have your partner move left or right.
Shuffle sideways to mirror them without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and chest up.
Work for 20-30 seconds, then swap roles.
description: A mirror drill where you shuffle sideways in response to a partner, training lateral quickness and reaction.

name: 趴下俯卧撑
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Push your body up into a straight plank.
Lower yourself all the way down until your chest rests on the floor.
Relax briefly, then push up again.
description: A push-up that starts from lying flat on the floor each rep, so every rep begins from a dead stop and builds pressing strength.

name: 侧卧髋内收(左)
instructions: Lie on your left side with your legs straight.
Bend your right knee and place that foot in front of you.
Raise your left leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
description: A lying leg lift that trains the inner thigh of the left leg.

name: 单腿桥式伸腿(左)
english: single leg bridge with outstretched leg (left)
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your left leg straight out.
Drive through your right heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and switch legs.
description: A bridge on one leg with the other leg stretched out, to strengthen the glutes and hamstrings and test hip stability.

name: 单直腿臀桥保持(左)
english: single straight leg glute bridge hold (left)
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Straighten your left leg in line with your torso.
Press through the right heel to lift your hips.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your hips level.
Lower slowly.
description: A glute bridge held with the left leg extended straight. Builds one-sided glute strength and pelvic control.

name: 仰卧点脚尖
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one foot to tap the floor.
Bring it back to tabletop.
Alternate legs with control.
description: From a tabletop position, alternate lowering a foot to tap the floor while keeping the lower back steady.

name: 仰卧卷腹(直腿)
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.
description: A crunch with straight legs on the floor that trains the upper abs.

name: 半蹲侧伸
instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width.
