Sit into a half squat.
Reach one arm overhead and lean sideways.
Return to center.
Reach to the other side.
Keep your chest up.
description: A half squat with a side bend that trains the obliques and legs while loosening the trunk.

name: 低弓步
instructions: Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower your back knee.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A deep lunge stretch that opens the hip flexors and quads.

name: 低弓步(左)
instructions: Step your right foot forward and lower your left knee to the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Reach your arms overhead if you like.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A deep lunge stretch on the left side that opens the hip flexors and quads.

name: 庆祝式提膝
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up as you raise your arms in a victory pose.
Lower and switch.
Keep a quick, bouncy rhythm.
Land lightly and work for 30 seconds.
description: Fast alternating knee drives with arms pumping overhead, a fun cardio drill.

name: 侧步后三角肌划船
instructions: Stand in a slight squat with your arms out in front.
Step to the side.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return your arms forward as you step back.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
description: A side step paired with a rowing motion that works the rear shoulders and upper back while elevating your pulse.

name: 前踢腿
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Kick one straight leg up in front of you.
Lower it under control.
Switch legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your torso upright.
description: A dynamic kick that warms up the hamstrings and hip flexors and builds coordination.

name: 原地踏步抬臂
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step in place, lifting your knees.
Raise your arms overhead as you step.
Lower them as you continue.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.
description: Stepping in place while raising your arms, a gentle cardio drill.

name: 扭转卷腹 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides for your reps.
description: A crunch with a rotation to bring each elbow toward the opposite knee. Works the abs and obliques.

name: 后撤步下拉
instructions: Stand tall with your arms overhead.
Step one foot back.
Pull your elbows down and in as if doing a pulldown.
Return your arms and foot to start.
Alternate legs at a steady pace.
description: A step back with a downward arm pull that fires up the lats and legs.

name: 仰卧挺身保持
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended.
Lift your chest, arms and legs a few inches.
Keep your neck neutral.
Squeeze your glutes and hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly.
description: A prone hold that lifts the chest and legs, building lower back endurance.

name: 仰卧交替蛙腿
instructions: Lie face down with your arms under your forehead.
Bend one knee to 90 degrees with the sole toward the ceiling.
Lift that thigh off the floor by squeezing the glute.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips on the floor.
description: A prone move where you alternate kicking each bent leg up, to work the glutes.

name: 仰卧蛙腿
instructions: Lie face down, knees bent and heels together.
Let your knees fall slightly out.
Lift both thighs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.
description: A prone move where both knees bend outward like a frog and kick up, to work the glutes.

name: 侧平板支撑拉
instructions: Get into a side plank on your forearm with your body in a straight line.
Reach your top arm overhead.
Pull your elbow down toward your ribs.
Keep your hips lifted.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side plank with a pulling arm motion, to build core stability and shoulder strength.

name: 出拳上步
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with fists up.
Step forward with your lead foot.
Throw a punch as you step.
Return to your stance.
Alternate sides and keep a steady rhythm.
description: A shadow-boxing drill pairing a forward step with a punch for cardio and coordination.

name: 绳索低位坐姿划船(V形把手)
english: cable low seated row with v bar
instructions: Sit at the low pulley, feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, and hold the V bar.
Sit tall with your chest up and arms straight.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, keeping your torso still.
Extend your arms slowly until you feel a stretch in your back.
description: A seated cable row with a V handle and a neutral grip. It builds the mid back and lats.

name: 收腹抱膝
instructions: Sit on the floor and lean back slightly.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your knees to your chest as you bring your torso forward.
Extend again under control.
Keep your core braced.
description: A seated or lying tuck that draws knees and chest together to train the abs.

name: 杠铃垫块硬拉
instructions: Set the bar on blocks or a raised platform.
Stand with the bar over your mid-foot.
Hinge and grip the bar just outside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.
description: A deadlift with the bar raised on blocks, which shortens the range of motion and lets you lift heavier.

name: 绳索后三角肌划船(平行杆)
instructions: Sit facing a low cable with a parallel bar attachment.
Hold the handles with your elbows flared.
Lean back slightly with a straight spine.
Pull the handles toward your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
description: A cable row with a parallel bar that targets the rear delts and upper back.

name: 绳索直臂下拉 v. 2
instructions: Stand facing a high cable and grab the bar with straight arms.
Hinge slightly at the hips.
Pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly to the start.
description: A straight-arm pulldown variation that isolates the lats by keeping the elbows nearly straight.

name: 史密斯机驴子踢腿
instructions: Set the bar of the Smith machine at a low height.
Get on all fours with one foot under the bar.
Press the bar up by extending your hip.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching legs.
description: A kick-back using the Smith machine bar under the foot, to target the glutes.

name: 负重瓶罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bottles along your legs with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your shoulders back and your core braced.
description: A hip hinge holding a weighted bottle in each hand. It trains the hamstrings and glutes with light load.

name: 负重瓶单腿罗马尼亚硬拉
english: bottle weighted single leg romanian deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a bottle in each hand, with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower the bottles toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-legged hip hinge holding weighted bottles. It works the hamstrings and glutes and challenges balance.

name: 负重瓶摆动
instructions: Stand with feet wider than your hips, holding a bottle with both hands.
Hinge back and let the bottle swing between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and let the bottle swing to chest height.
Keep your arms relaxed, the hips do the work.
Let it fall back and hinge into the next rep.
description: A hip-driven swing with a weighted bottle held in both hands. It trains the glutes and hamstrings explosively.

name: 负重瓶前蹲
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand at your shoulders, elbows pointing forward.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.
description: A squat holding weighted bottles at shoulder height. It works the quads and glutes and keeps your torso upright.

name: 负重瓶相扑深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a bottle with both hands in front of you.
Bend your knees and lower your hips straight down.
Keep your knees pushing out over your toes.
Stop when your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes.
description: A wide-stance squat holding a weighted bottle between your legs. It hits the glutes and inner thighs.

name: 负重瓶分腿蹲
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: A stationary lunge holding bottles at your sides. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.

name: 负重瓶前弓步蹲
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs each rep.
description: A walking-style lunge stepping forward with bottles in your hands. It works the quads and glutes one leg at a time.

name: 负重瓶后撤弓步蹲
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand.
Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front shin vertical and your chest up.
Push through the front heel to come back.
Alternate legs, or finish one side then switch.
description: A lunge stepping backward while holding bottles. It is easy on the knees and trains the glutes and quads.

name: 负重瓶直腿硬拉
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight, with a tiny knee bend.
Hinge forward, sliding the bottles down your legs.
Stop when you feel a firm hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand back up.
description: A near-straight-leg deadlift with bottles in your hands. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.

name: 负重瓶臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a bottle across your hips with both hands.
Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A hip bridge with a weighted bottle resting on your hips. It isolates the glutes with light load.

name: 负重瓶跪姿深蹲
instructions: Kneel on a mat with hips over knees, holding a bottle at your chest.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Pause lightly, keeping your back straight.
Drive your hips forward to return to upright.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
description: A squat from a kneeling position holding a bottle. It trains the glutes and hips without loading your feet.

name: 负重瓶过头卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands above your chest.
Extend your arms overhead or keep them over your face.
Curl your ribs toward your hips and lift your shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without dropping your head.
description: A crunch with a bottle held overhead. The extra lever length makes your abs work harder.

name: 负重瓶蛙式卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with soles together, knees open, holding a bottle on your chest.
Curl your upper body up as you pull your knees in.
Bring your chest toward your knees.
Hold for a moment.
Lower with control and repeat.
description: A crunch that draws knees and chest together while holding a bottle. It trains the whole abdominal wall.

name: 负重瓶侧弯
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, a bottle in one hand at your side.
Place the other hand lightly behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the bottle without leaning forward.
Return to upright by squeezing your side.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A standing side bend with a bottle in one hand. It strengthens the obliques.

name: 负重瓶俄罗斯转体
instructions: Sit on the floor, knees bent, and lean back a little with a straight spine.
Hold a bottle with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap the bottle near the floor.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your feet down or lifted for more challenge.
description: A seated rotation holding a bottle. It works the obliques and deep core.

name: 负重瓶深蹲交替波浪
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a bottle in each hand.
Squat down with your hips back.
As you stand, raise one arm up and the other down in a wave motion.
Switch arms on the next squat.
Move at a steady, controlled pace.
description: A squat with arms swinging like waves while holding bottles. It raises your heart rate and works legs and shoulders.

name: 负重瓶仰卧推胸
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle in each hand at chest level.
Press the bottles straight up until your arms are extended.
Keep your wrists straight.
Lower slowly until your elbows touch the floor or reach chest level.
Repeat for your reps.
description: A floor or bench press with a bottle in each hand. It builds the chest and triceps with light load.

name: 负重瓶斯文德推举
instructions: Stand tall and press your palms together around a bottle at your chest.
Squeeze inward the whole time.
Push the bottle straight out in front of you.
Pause with your arms extended.
Bring it back to your chest slowly.
description: A standing press with a bottle squeezed between your palms. It keeps constant tension on the chest.

name: 负重瓶俯身划船
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders.
Pull the bottles toward your hips, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
description: A bent-over row with a bottle in each hand. It trains the mid back and lats.

name: 负重瓶上拉
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a bottle with both hands over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower the bottle in an arc behind your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your sides.
Pull it back over your chest.
description: A lying pullover with a bottle held in both hands. It stretches and works the lats and chest.

name: 负重瓶俯身反向飞鸟
english: bottle weighted bent over reverse fly
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand hanging below you.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
description: A bent-over fly with bottles that targets the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: 负重瓶集中弯举
instructions: Sit with feet wide, a bottle in one hand, and rest your elbow on your inner thigh.
Let your arm hang fully.
Curl the bottle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.
description: A seated one-arm curl with your elbow braced on your thigh. It isolates the biceps.

name: 负重瓶反握集中弯举
english: bottle weighted reverse grip concentration curl
instructions: Sit with feet wide, holding a bottle with an overhand grip, elbow resting on your inner thigh.
Let your arm hang straight.
Curl the bottle up without bending your wrist.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.
description: A seated concentration curl with an overhand grip. It targets the forearms and brachialis.

name: 负重瓶臂后屈伸
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, upper arm parallel to the floor, bottle in hand.
Keep your elbow tight at your side.
Straighten your arm behind you.
Squeeze your triceps.
Bend slowly, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm triceps kickback holding a bottle. It isolates the back of the arm.

name: 负重瓶双臂臂后屈伸
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand, upper arms parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Extend both arms straight behind you.
Squeeze at the top.
Return slowly.
description: A triceps kickback done with both arms together using two bottles.

name: 负重瓶过头三头肌伸展
instructions: Stand or sit tall holding a bottle overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Bend your elbows and lower the bottle behind your head.
Extend your arms to lift it back up.
Keep your upper arms still.
description: An overhead extension with a bottle held in both hands. It stretches and strengthens the triceps.

name: 负重瓶交替二头弯举
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms forward.
Curl one bottle toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly as you curl the other.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Avoid swinging your torso.
description: Alternating curls with a bottle in each hand. It builds the biceps and keeps the pace easy.

name: 负重瓶交替锤式弯举
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms facing your body.
Curl one bottle up without rotating your wrist.
Lower it slowly.
Curl the other arm.
Keep your elbows pinned.
description: Alternating curls with palms facing in. It works the biceps, brachialis and forearms.

name: 负重瓶反握弯举
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle in each hand with palms facing down.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bottles up with straight wrists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
description: A curl with an overhand grip holding bottles. It trains the forearms and brachialis.

name: 负重瓶直立划船
instructions: Stand tall holding bottles in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Pull them up along your body, elbows leading.
Stop at about chest height.
Lower slowly.
Keep the bottles close to your torso.
description: A vertical pull with bottles toward your chest. It works the shoulders and traps.

name: 负重瓶腋下划船
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge slightly forward.
Pull your elbows out and up, bottles moving toward your armpits.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.
description: A high row pulling bottles up toward your armpits. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: 负重瓶前平举
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise both arms straight in front to shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause.
Lower slowly without swinging.
description: A front raise with bottles for the front of the shoulders.

name: 负重瓶侧平举
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
description: A side raise with bottles that builds the shoulder caps.

name: 负重瓶交替前平举
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand.
Raise one arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly as you raise the other.
Keep your torso still.
Breathe steadily.
description: Alternating front raises with a bottle in each hand. It works the front delts.

name: 负重瓶肩部推举
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Press both bottles overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to shoulder height.
Do not arch your lower back.
description: An overhead press with a bottle in each hand. It builds shoulders and triceps.

name: 负重瓶绕头环绕
instructions: Stand tall holding a bottle at chest height with both hands.
Circle it around your head, staying close.
Keep your core braced and ribs down.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Reverse direction on the next set.
description: A circular movement of a bottle around your head. It warms up the shoulders and upper back.

name: 蜘蛛平板支撑
instructions: Start in a high or forearm plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Return to plank.
Alternate sides without letting your hips sag.
description: A plank with alternating knee drives to the elbow, building core strength.

name: 抬前腿触膝下
english: front leg lift under knee tap
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands out in front.
Lift one knee up and forward to hip height.
Reach both hands under that thigh and tap beneath the knee.
Lower the foot with control and switch legs.
Keep your chest up and stay light on your feet.
Alternate sides at a steady, bouncy pace.
description: A standing move where you drive a knee up and tap beneath it with your hands. It warms up the hips and works the abs.

name: 后踢过头推举
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands at shoulder height.
Press both hands straight overhead as you kick one leg back.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Bring the hands and foot back to the start.
Switch legs and repeat at a lively pace.
Keep your core tight throughout.
description: A dynamic combo of a backward leg kick with an overhead arm press. It works the shoulders and glutes together and raises your heart rate.

name: 游泳式腿部画圈
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended in front of you.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw small, controlled circles with that leg.
Reverse the direction after several circles.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips pressed down and your core braced.
description: A lying leg circle drill with a swimming-style rhythm. It loosens the hips and trains the glutes and core control.

name: 徒手跳绳
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step and hop on one foot while driving the opposite knee up.
Swing the opposite arm forward as you hop.
Switch sides in a rhythmic skip.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds.
description: Skipping without a rope, with light hops and big arm swings. It lifts your heart rate and warms up the legs.

name: 折刀式
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Lift both legs up toward the ceiling.
Press your arms into the floor and lift your hips slightly.
Raise your trunk and reach toward your toes.
Roll back down slowly with control.
Keep your movement smooth, without swinging.
description: A Pilates move where you lift your legs and trunk together to fold at the hips. It challenges the abs and balance.

name: 徒手俯卧腿弯举
instructions: Lie on your front with your legs straight.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Bend your knees and bring your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the top.
Lower your feet slowly back to the floor.
Keep your hips pressed down throughout.
description: A floor-based curl where you bend the knees against no added load. It targets the hamstrings in a simple way.

name: 风吹式瑜伽体式
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend your knees and draw them into your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins and hug them in.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Breathe slowly and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and extend your legs.
description: The wind-relieving pose, where you hug your knees to your chest while lying down. It stretches the hips and lower back.

name: 半鱼王式瑜伽体式
instructions: Sit tall with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and place that foot outside the opposite thigh.
Hug the bent knee with the opposite arm.
Place your other hand behind you and twist toward it.
Lengthen the spine and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other side.
description: The half spinal twist, a seated yoga pose. It stretches the spine and outer hip and improves rotation.

name: 哑铃单侧肩胛上提
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep your arm straight and your chest up.
Lift your shoulder blade straight up toward your ear.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A single-arm shrug-style movement that trains the muscles that lift and control the shoulder blade. It helps shoulder stability.

name: 哑铃俯身肩胛划船
instructions: Hold dumbbells and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without bending the elbows.
Hold for a moment.
Release the blades and let the weights drop slightly.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.
description: A bent-over movement where you pull the shoulder blades together with straight arms. It builds the mid-back muscles that stabilize the shoulders.

name: 徒手站姿肩胛划船
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out in front or at your sides.
Keep your arms mostly straight.
Pull your shoulder blades back and together.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Release slowly.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders to your ears.
description: A standing drill where you squeeze your shoulder blades together with no weight. It wakes up the mid back and helps posture.

name: 合掌式瑜伽体式
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than your hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat.
Press your palms together at the chest.
Use your elbows to gently press your knees outward.
Keep your chest lifted and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Stand up slowly.
description: A deep squatting pose with the palms pressed together in front of the chest. It opens the hips and inner thighs.

name: 深蹲活动度扭转
instructions: Lower into a deep squat with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place one hand on the floor or inside your knee.
Rotate your chest and reach the other arm up toward the ceiling.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Return to the center and switch sides.
Keep your heels on the floor.
description: A deep squat paired with a trunk rotation. It opens the hips and upper back and improves rotation.

name: 哑铃坐姿外旋
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a light dumbbell.
Rest your elbow on your thigh or bent at your side at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm upward and outward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A seated rotator cuff exercise using a light dumbbell. It strengthens the small muscles that stabilize the shoulder.

name: 哑铃站姿挥杆
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell at your shoulder.
Bend your knees slightly.
Drive up through your legs and press the dumbbell overhead.
Lock out without leaning back.
Lower the weight to your shoulder.
Switch arms after your set.
description: A standing dumbbell press that uses a drive from the legs and trunk. It builds shoulder strength and power.

name: 哑铃坐姿反向阿诺德推举
instructions: Sit upright holding dumbbells overhead with your palms forward.
Lower the weights while rotating your palms toward you.
Stop with the dumbbells in front of your chest.
Rotate your palms back outward as you press up.
Lock out the arms overhead.
Keep your back against the pad.
description: The Arnold press performed in reverse, rotating the palms inward on the way down. It works all three heads of the shoulder.

name: 哑铃坐姿单臂前平举
english: dumbbell seated single arm front raise
instructions: Sit tall holding a dumbbell at your side.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid leaning back.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A seated front raise done one arm at a time. It targets the front of the shoulder.

name: 哑铃直臂卷腹 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell with straight arms over your chest.
Curl your upper back off the floor, reaching up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
description: A crunch with your arms straight overhead holding a dumbbell. The load increases the demand on the abs.

name: 哑铃凳上反向挺身
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge.
Hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Hold the bench for support.
Raise your legs until they align with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
description: A bench-supported reverse hyper with a dumbbell held between your feet. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 哑铃靠墙俯身划船
english: dumbbell bent over row against wall
instructions: Stand a step from a wall and hinge forward.
Support your forehead or free hand on the wall.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging.
Row the weights toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.
description: A dumbbell row where you lean on a wall for support. It trains the back while sparing the lower back.

name: 哑铃交替严格锤式弯举
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with your palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up without swinging.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your torso still.
description: An alternating hammer curl done with strict form, keeping your body still. It builds the biceps, brachialis and forearms.

name: 哑铃坐姿交替过头三头肌伸展
english: dumbbell seated alternate overhead triceps extension
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in each hand overhead.
Lower one dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Extend the arm back up.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your core braced.
description: A seated overhead extension done one arm after the other. It isolates the triceps through a deep stretch.

name: 哑铃坐姿拖曳弯举
instructions: Sit holding dumbbells with your palms forward.
Keep the weights close to your body.
Pull your elbows back as you curl.
Drag the dumbbells up along your torso.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.
description: A curl where the elbows move back and the dumbbells drag up along your torso. It hits the biceps with less shoulder help.

name: 哑铃坐姿双臂集中弯举
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet wide.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lean forward.
Rest the backs of your upper arms on your inner thighs.
Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
description: A concentration curl done with both arms at once, elbows braced on your thighs. It isolates the biceps.

name: 哑铃反向俯卧撑
instructions: Place two dumbbells on the floor and grip them.
Set up in a plank position.
Lower your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Stop just above the floor.
Press back up to the start.
Keep your body in a straight line.
description: A push-up variation performed with the hands on dumbbells in a reverse hand position. It focuses on the triceps.

name: 哑铃单臂抓举(左)
instructions: Stand over a dumbbell with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip it with your left hand and hinge at the hips.
Drive up with your legs and hips.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body and punch it overhead.
Lock out the arm.
Lower the weight back to the floor with control.
description: A single-arm snatch that takes a dumbbell from the floor to overhead in one motion. This version uses the left arm.

name: 壶铃俯身划船
instructions: Hold a kettlebell and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the kettlebell toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A bent-over row using a kettlebell. It trains the lats and mid back.

name: 哑铃坐姿单臂过头三头肌伸展
english: dumbbell seated single arm overhead triceps extension
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in one hand overhead.
Keep the upper arm close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Extend the arm back to full lockout.
Keep your core braced.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A seated overhead extension with one dumbbell. It isolates the triceps.

name: 哑铃坐姿单臂过头三头肌伸展(左)
english: dumbbell seated single arm overhead triceps extension (left)
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in your left hand overhead.
Keep the upper arm close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbow.
Extend the arm back to full lockout.
Keep your core braced.
Finish your reps, then switch to the right arm.
description: A seated overhead triceps extension with one dumbbell. This version uses the left arm.

name: 哑铃蛙式髋推
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees out.
Rest a dumbbell on your hips.
Drive your hips up by pressing through your feet.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your ribs down.
description: A hip thrust with the soles of your feet together and knees out, holding a dumbbell on your hips. It focuses on the glutes.

name: 哑铃仰卧腿弯举
instructions: Lie face down on a bench.
Grip a dumbbell between your feet.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your hips on the bench.
description: A leg curl lying on your front while holding a dumbbell between your feet. It targets the hamstrings.

name: 哑铃上斜低位飞鸟
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie back.
Hold dumbbells above your chest with a soft elbow bend.
Open your arms out and down in an arc.
Stop at a comfortable chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together.
Keep the elbow bend constant.
description: A fly on an incline bench with the dumbbells traveling low. It stretches and works the chest.

name: 壶铃哥萨克深蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and stand wide.
Shift your weight to one side.
Squat down with the other leg straight.
Keep the bent knee over your toes.
Push back to the center.
Alternate sides.
description: A side-to-side squat holding a kettlebell. It builds hip mobility and leg strength.

name: 壶铃耸肩
instructions: Stand holding kettlebells at your sides.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest tall and neck relaxed.
description: A shrug holding kettlebells at your sides. It builds the upper traps and grip.

name: 弹力带站姿反握弯举
instructions: Stand on a band holding the ends with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your wrists straight.
description: A standing curl with an overhand grip on a band. It strengthens the forearms and brachialis.

name: 侧平板支撑抬腿(左)
instructions: Lie on your left side and prop up on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a side plank.
Raise your top leg slowly.
Lower the leg without dropping your hips.
Repeat for your set.
Switch sides for the right-side version.
description: A side plank with a leg raise on the left side. It works the obliques and outer hip.

name: 侧平板支撑抬腿 v. 2(左)
english: side plank with raised leg v. 2 (left)
instructions: Lie on your left side and prop up on your left forearm, elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips into a straight line.
Raise your top leg to hip height.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and repeat, then switch sides if you like.
description: A side plank on the left side with the top leg lifted. It trains the obliques, hips and shoulder stability.

name: 跪姿直腿后踢 v. 2(左)
instructions: Start on all fours.
Extend your left leg straight behind you.
Lift it to hip height.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your hips level.
description: A kneeling kickback with a straight leg on the left side. It targets the glutes.

name: 肘触膝侧平板卷腹(左)
english: elbow to knee side plank crunch (left)
instructions: Set up in a left side plank on your forearm, top hand behind your head.
Lift your top leg slightly.
Bring your top elbow and knee together in front of you.
Extend back out to the straight position.
Repeat for reps, then do the other side.
description: A side plank on the left with a crunch that brings elbow and knee together. It challenges the obliques.

name: 自行车卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Twist to bring one elbow to the opposite knee.
Extend the other leg.
Switch sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
description: A pedalling crunch where you bring each elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.

name: 仰卧剪刀交叉
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs lifted.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Open your legs wide.
Cross one leg over the other.
Open and cross the other leg on top.
Keep a steady rhythm.
description: A lying scissor kick where the legs cross over each other. It trains the inner thighs and lower abs.

name: 哑铃滚轮前推
instructions: Kneel holding a dumbbell in each hand on the floor.
Brace your core.
Roll the dumbbells forward.
Go as far as you can keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start.
Avoid sagging at the hips.
description: A rollout using dumbbells in place of a wheel. It challenges the abs.

name: 哑铃上斜扭转推举
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells at chest level.
Palms face you.
Press up, rotating your palms forward.
Lock out at the top.
Lower, rotating back.
Keep your shoulders down.
description: An incline press where you rotate the dumbbells during the press. It works the upper chest.

name: 绳索站姿单臂飞鸟
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable with the handle at chest height.
Step forward for balance.
Pull the handle across your body.
Squeeze your chest.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A standing fly on a cable, one arm at a time. It builds the chest.

name: 悬挂带划船
instructions: Hold the straps and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.
description: A bodyweight row on suspension straps. It builds the back and biceps.

name: 哑铃站姿法式推举
instructions: Stand holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your arms back up.
Keep your core braced.
Avoid arching your back.
description: A standing overhead extension with a dumbbell held in both hands. It targets the triceps.

name: 悬挂带深蹲跳
instructions: Hold the straps with your arms extended.
Lower into a squat.
Jump up explosively.
Land softly.
Go straight into the next squat.
Keep your chest tall.
description: A squat jump holding suspension straps for balance. It builds explosive leg power.

name: 跪姿俯卧撑胸前回拉
instructions: Start in a knee push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press back up.
Push your hips back toward your heels.
Return to the start.
Keep your core tight.
description: A knee push-up followed by a pullback of the hips. It trains the chest and adds a mobility element.

name: 悬挂带二头弯举
instructions: Hold the straps and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Curl your hands toward your forehead.
Keep your elbows high.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body straight.
description: A bodyweight biceps curl on suspension straps. It builds the biceps.

name: 吊环手臂弯举
instructions: Hold the rings and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Curl your hands toward your head.
Keep your elbows up.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body in a straight line.
description: A bodyweight curl using gymnastic rings. It builds the biceps.

name: 吊环单臂二头弯举
instructions: Hold one ring and lean back.
Extend your arm.
Curl your hand toward your head.
Keep your elbow up.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm curl on a ring. It builds the biceps with a lot of control.

name: 吊环面拉
instructions: Hold the rings and lean back.
Extend your arms.
Pull the rings toward your face.
Flare your elbows out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
description: A face pull on rings. It builds the rear delts and upper back.

name: 吊环单臂后三角肌划船
english: ring single arm rear delt row
instructions: Hold one ring and lean back.
Extend your arm.
Pull your elbow out and back.
Squeeze the rear delt.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm row on a ring that focuses on the rear delt. It builds shoulder strength.

name: 杠铃站姿腕弯举
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Let your hands hang.
Curl your wrists up.
Squeeze the forearms.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms still.
description: A standing wrist curl holding a barbell behind or in front of you. It builds the forearm flexors.

name: 杠铃站姿反握腕弯举
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
Let your hands hang.
Extend your wrists up.
Squeeze the forearms.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms still.
description: A standing wrist curl with an overhand grip. It builds the forearm extensors.

name: 哑铃俯卧交替锤式弯举
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench.
Hold dumbbells with palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell up.
Lower it slowly.
Alternate arms.
Keep your elbows still.
description: A hammer curl lying face down on an incline bench, alternating arms. It builds the forearms and brachialis.

name: 哑铃站姿交替反握弯举
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms.
Keep your wrists straight.
description: An alternating standing curl with an overhand grip. It builds the forearms.

name: 绳索坐姿过头弯举(曲杆)
instructions: Sit facing the cable machine.
Grip the SZ bar and extend your arms.
Curl the bar toward your head.
Squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly.
Keep your elbows high.
description: A seated cable curl with an SZ bar, with the cable set up overhead. It targets the biceps.

name: 哑铃站姿手臂旋转
instructions: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Bend your elbows to 90 degrees.
Rotate your palms up.
Rotate your palms down.
Repeat smoothly.
Keep your elbows pinned.
description: A standing rotation of the forearms holding dumbbells. It builds forearm strength.

name: 曲杆杠铃站姿单臂中立握腕弯举
english: ez barbell standing single arm neutral wrist curl
instructions: Stand holding one end of an EZ bar.
Keep your arm at your side.
Curl your wrist up.
Squeeze the forearm.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm wrist curl with a neutral grip on an EZ barbell. It targets the forearms.

name: 绳索站姿卷腕
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine.
Hold the handle with straight arms.
Roll your wrists up.
Roll them back down.
Repeat smoothly.
Keep your arms still.
description: A standing wrist roll with a cable handle. It builds forearm strength.

name: 杠铃拉森推举
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip the bar.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Unrack the bar.
Lower it to your chest.
Press back up.
Keep your back flat.
description: A bench press with your feet raised off the floor. It trains the chest with less leg drive.

name: 杠铃窄握拉森推举
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold the bar with a close, shoulder-width grip.
Lift your feet off the floor and stretch your legs out in front of you.
Lower the bar to your lower chest under control.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your back flat on the bench and your core tight throughout.
description: A larsen press with a close grip: you bench with your feet off the floor, which removes leg drive and puts the work on chest and triceps.

name: 哑铃拉森推举
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and lie back.
Press the dumbbells up and lift your feet off the floor, legs extended.
Lower the weights to the sides of your chest with control.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core braced so your lower back does not arch.
description: Dumbbell bench press done with your legs held out in the air, so your chest and triceps do all the work without help from the lower body.

name: 海豚式
instructions: Start on hands and knees, then lower to your forearms.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up high.
Press your forearms into the floor.
Let your head hang between your arms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
description: A yoga inverted V on your forearms. It stretches the shoulders and hamstrings and builds shoulder strength.

name: 四柱支撑式(查图兰加)
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Shift forward slightly.
Bend your elbows straight back to about 90 degrees.
Keep your body in one line, elbows close to your ribs.
Hold briefly, then press back up.
description: A low push-up hold from plank. It builds triceps, chest and core strength.

name: 战士二式
instructions: Stand with feet wide, turn your front foot out and back foot slightly in.
Bend your front knee over the ankle.
Extend both arms parallel to the floor.
Gaze over your front hand.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A wide lunge with arms extended to the sides. It strengthens the legs and opens the hips.

name: 蛙式(曼杜卡)
instructions: Start on hands and knees on a mat.
Slide your knees wide, with feet turned out and inline with knees.
Lower onto your forearms.
Push your hips back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
description: A deep hip opener on all fours with knees wide. It stretches the inner thighs and groin.

name: 孔雀式(马尤拉)
instructions: Kneel and place your hands on the floor with fingers pointing back toward your feet.
Bring your elbows together under your belly.
Lean forward and rest your torso on your upper arms.
Extend your legs back and lift them.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower.
description: An advanced arm balance with your torso held horizontally on your elbows. It builds core and wrist strength.

name: 半蛙式(阿尔达巴凯)
instructions: Lie on your belly, propped on your forearms.
Bend one knee and reach back to hold that foot.
Gently press the foot toward your hip.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: A prone backbend with one foot pulled toward your hip. It stretches the quads and hip flexors.

name: 圣哲马里奇一式
instructions: Sit with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat beside the straight leg.
Wrap your opposite arm around the bent knee.
Sit tall, then twist toward the bent knee.
Keep your spine long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A seated forward fold with a twist and a bent knee. It stretches the back, hips and hamstrings.

name: 天堂鸟式
english: bird of paradise pose svarga dvijasana
instructions: Stand and bind one arm behind your back around your bent knee.
Grab your hand with the other arm.
Step in and stand tall on the grounded leg.
Slowly straighten the lifted leg.
Hold for a few breaths, then switch.
description: A standing bind pose that straightens one leg upward. It demands balance and flexibility in the hamstrings.

name: 轮式(上弓式)
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands beside your head with fingers toward your feet.
Press into hands and feet and lift your hips.
Straighten your arms as you lift the crown of your head off the floor.
Press your chest toward the wall behind.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower slowly.
description: A deep backbend pressing up from the floor. It opens the chest and shoulders and strengthens the back and legs.

name: 单腿上弓式
english: one legged upward bow pose eka pada urdhva dhanurasana
instructions: Come into wheel pose with hands and feet pressing down.
Shift weight onto one foot.
Lift the other leg toward the ceiling.
Keep your hips high and level.
Hold briefly, lower, then switch legs.
description: A wheel pose with one leg lifted into the air. It adds balance and strength demand to the backbend.

name: 蜻蜓式
instructions: Squat with hands on the floor in front of you.
Place your knees high on your upper arms.
Lean forward and lift your feet off the floor.
Extend your legs wide to the sides.
Hold for a few breaths, then release.
description: A seated wide-leg arm balance with legs extended out to the sides. It needs hip flexibility and core strength.

name: 半船式
instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back a little.
Lift your feet so your shins are parallel to the floor.
Extend your arms forward.
Keep your chest open and spine long.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
description: A V-shaped balance on your sit bones. It strengthens the abs and hip flexors.

name: 鹰式
instructions: Stand and bend your knees slightly.
Cross one thigh over the other, hooking the foot behind the calf if you can.
Wrap your arms, one under the other, palms together.
Sit your hips low and lift your elbows.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch.
description: A balancing pose with legs and arms wrapped. It stretches the hips and shoulders and trains balance.

name: 双腿倒手杖式
english: two legged inverted staff pose dwi pada viparita dandasana
instructions: Start in a headstand or lie on your back with elbows on the floor.
Arch your back and bring your feet toward the floor.
Keep your forearms firm.
Stay in the backbend, breathing steadily.
Hold briefly, then come out carefully.
description: A supported deep backbend resting on your forearms. It stretches the chest and spine.

name: 骆驼式
instructions: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward.
Lean back and reach for your heels.
Lift your chest and let your head drop gently if comfortable.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then rise.
description: A kneeling backbend with hands on your heels. It opens the chest and stretches the thighs and hips.

name: 舞王式
instructions: Stand tall and bend one knee, holding that foot behind you.
Kick your foot back into your hand.
Reach your free arm forward.
Tilt your torso forward as the leg lifts.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch.
description: A standing balance with a back-held leg and a forward reach. It stretches the quads and opens the chest.

name: 基础转交叉驴踢
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Lift one leg back with a bent knee, sole toward the ceiling.
Lower it, then kick it across behind your other leg.
Alternate basic and cross kicks.
Keep your hips level, then switch legs.
description: A quadruped kick that goes up behind you, then crosses over. It hits the glutes from two angles.

name: 单侧屈膝礼弓步蹲
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other.
Bend both knees and lower your hips.
Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes.
Push up and return, then switch sides.
description: A lunge stepping one leg back and across behind you. It targets the glutes and outer hips.

name: 徒手低位分腿蹲
instructions: Step one foot forward into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright and your hands on your hips.
Lower your back knee toward the floor as far as you can control.
Drive through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
description: A split squat with a deep, low range that challenges your front thigh and glutes while building balance and hip mobility.

name: 哑铃低位分腿蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
Lower your back knee toward the floor in a controlled way.
Push through your front heel to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
description: A deep split squat holding dumbbells at your sides, great for loading the quads and glutes one leg at a time.

name: 杠铃低位分腿蹲
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step into a long split stance.
Brace your core and keep your torso tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor under control.
Press through your front foot to stand up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A deep split squat with a barbell on your upper back that builds strong quads and glutes and tests your balance.

name: 侧踢穿越
instructions: Start in a high plank, then rotate onto one hand with your chest turned to the side.
Lift your hips and keep your core tight.
Sweep your top leg under your body and through the gap.
Return the leg to the start with control.
Repeat, then switch sides.
description: A floor move where you sweep one leg under your body from a side-facing support, working your obliques, shoulders and coordination.

name: 徒手慢速转爆发深蹲
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat over about three seconds.
Pause briefly at the bottom with your chest up.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.
description: A squat that goes down slowly and then jumps up fast, training control, leg strength and power together.

name: 谦卑战士式
instructions: Step into a wide lunge with the front knee bent.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Fold your torso inside your front thigh.
Let your arms float overhead.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description: A lunge with a forward fold and clasped hands behind you. It stretches the hips, hamstrings and shoulders.

name: 保持深蹲
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down into a squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then stand up.
description: A static squat hold that builds endurance in your thighs and glutes and teaches a solid bottom position.

name: 俯卧Y字上举
instructions: Lie face down with your arms stretched overhead in a Y shape.
Keep your forehead near the floor and your neck long.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower your arms slowly and repeat.
description: Lying face down, you lift your arms into a Y shape to strengthen the muscles that stabilise your shoulder blades.

name: 杠杆式户外坐姿腿举
instructions: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Place your feet on the footplates, shoulder-width apart.
Push the plates away until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees at the top.
Bend your knees to return slowly and repeat.
description: Seated leg press on an outdoor lever machine, pushing the pads away with your legs to train thighs and glutes.

name: 杠杆式户外坐姿推胸
instructions: Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles at chest height.
Keep your shoulders down and back.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Let the handles come back slowly and repeat.
description: A seated chest press on an outdoor lever machine that works your chest, front shoulders and triceps.

name: 杠杆式户外坐姿高位下拉
instructions: Sit down and grab the handles overhead.
Lean back very slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the bottom.
Let your arms rise slowly until fully stretched, then repeat.
description: Pulling the handles down from overhead on an outdoor lever machine to build your lats and upper back.

name: 曲杆杠铃站姿腕弯举
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still and close to your body.
Curl your wrists upward, lifting the bar a short distance.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower the bar slowly and repeat.
description: Wrist curls with an EZ bar held in front of you, targeting the muscles on the underside of your forearms.

name: 哑铃站姿腕弯举
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your arms still at your sides.
Curl your wrists up, bringing the dumbbells toward your forearms.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A standing wrist curl with dumbbells that builds forearm strength and grip.

name: 绳索站姿腕弯举
instructions: Face a low cable pulley and grab the handle with an underhand grip.
Step back and let your arms hang with elbows tucked.
Curl your wrists upward against the cable.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.
description: Wrist curls using a low cable for steady tension through the whole range, working the inside of your forearms.

name: 曲杆杠铃站姿反握腕弯举
english: ez barbell standing wrist reverse curl
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar with an overhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still at your sides.
Extend your wrists to raise the bar upward.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: Reverse wrist curls with an EZ bar, an overhand movement that trains the top of your forearms.

name: 哑铃站姿反握腕弯举
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
Keep your upper arms still.
Lift the backs of your hands up by extending your wrists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: Standing reverse wrist curls with dumbbells to strengthen the extensor muscles on top of your forearms.

name: 绳索站姿反握腕弯举
instructions: Face a low cable and grab the handle with an overhand grip.
Step back and let your arms hang with elbows close to your sides.
Extend your wrists to pull the handle upward.
Hold for a second.
Lower under control and repeat.
description: An overhand wrist curl on a low cable that works the top of your forearms with constant tension.

name: 曲杆杠铃坐姿反握腕弯举
english: ez barbell seated wrist reverse curl
instructions: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, holding an EZ bar overhand.
Let your wrists hang past your knees.
Extend your wrists to lift the bar.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: Seated reverse wrist curl with your forearms supported on your thighs, isolating the top of your forearms.

name: 曲杆杠铃站姿背后腕弯举
english: ez barbell standing back wrist curl
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar behind your back with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows still and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to raise the bar slightly.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.
description: A wrist curl with the EZ bar held behind your back, training your forearms and grip.

name: 哑铃站姿背后腕弯举
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand behind your back, palms facing back.
Keep your arms still and your chest tall.
Curl your wrists upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: Holding dumbbells behind your body, you curl your wrists to train your forearms and grip.

name: 绳索站姿背后腕弯举 v. 2
english: cable standing back wrist curl v. 2
instructions: Stand with your back to a low cable and hold the handle behind you.
Keep your elbows tucked and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to pull the handle upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.
description: A standing wrist curl with a low cable behind you, giving steady tension on your forearm flexors.

name: 绳索磁力握把高位下拉
english: cable lateral pulldown with mag grip
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and grab the grip overhead.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the grip down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the bar rise slowly to a full stretch and repeat.
description: A lat pulldown using a magnetic grip handle that builds the wide muscles of your back.

name: 曲杆杠铃牧师凳弯举
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight and repeat.
description: Curling an EZ bar over a preacher pad, which keeps your upper arms still so your biceps do the work.

name: 弹力带反向卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with a band anchored and held in your hands.
Bend your knees and bring them over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without letting your lower back arch.
description: A reverse crunch with a band for added resistance, curling your hips up to hit the lower abs.

name: 弹力带反向卷腹 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back and hold the band firmly with both hands.
Lift your bent knees over your hips.
Curl your pelvis upward, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.
description: A variation of the band reverse crunch that uses a different setup to challenge your lower abs.

name: 徒手平板支撑位三头肌伸展
english: bodyweight triceps extension from plank position
instructions: Start in a forearm-height plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lean forward and bend your elbows to lower your head toward your hands.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your core tight and repeat.
description: From a plank, you bend and straighten your elbows to hinge forward and press back, a tough bodyweight move for the triceps.

name: 哑铃早安式体前屈
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding one dumbbell against your chest.
Soften your knees slightly.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
description: A hip hinge holding a dumbbell at your chest, training hamstrings, glutes and lower back.

name: 壶铃早安式体前屈 v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and tip your torso forward, back flat.
Lower until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to return upright.
description: Holding a kettlebell at your chest, you hinge at the hips to train hamstrings, glutes and your lower back.

name: 90度触脚跟 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor.
Reach your right hand toward your right heel.
Switch and reach your left hand to your left heel.
Keep your core tight and continue alternating.
description: Lying on your back with your knees bent, you reach side to side to tap your heels, working your obliques.

name: 脚跟臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, toes lifted.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and raise your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
description: A bridge with heels pushed into the floor and toes lifted. It biases the glutes and hamstrings.

name: 弹力带肩内收
instructions: Anchor a band overhead and hold the handle with your arm raised.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull your arm down toward your side.
Keep your elbow straight or slightly bent.
Return slowly, then switch arms.
description: A band pulldown pulling the arm from out to your side down to your body. It trains the lats and shoulder control.

name: 俯身肩部钟摆
instructions: Stand beside a bench and rest one hand on it, hinging forward at the hips.
Let the other arm hang straight down, relaxed.
Swing the arm gently forward and back in a small arc using your body's motion.
Then swing it side to side and in small circles.
Keep the shoulder loose and the movement easy.
Do equal time on both sides.
description: A gentle pendulum swing for the shoulder joint. It loosens the shoulder and warms it up without any load.

name: 弹力带站姿单臂肩屈曲
english: resistance band standing single arm shoulder flexion
instructions: Stand on the band with one foot and hold the handle at your thigh, palm down.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Raise the arm forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly against the band tension.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: Raising one arm forward against band tension. It trains the front of the shoulder with smooth control.

name: 弹力带站姿单臂肩侧向伸展
english: resistance band standing single arm lateral shoulder extension
instructions: Anchor the band at about waist height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, arm across your body.
Keep your chest tall and core braced.
Sweep the arm out and slightly back to the side with a soft elbow.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap.
Complete all reps, then turn around and switch arms.
description: A one-arm band move that pulls the arm out and back to the side. It works the shoulder and the muscles behind it.

name: 弹力带站姿外旋
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Rotate the forearm outward, keeping the elbow pinned.
Pause when your hand points forward or slightly out.
Return slowly under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: Rotating the forearm outward against a band, elbow at your side. It strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles that steady the shoulder.

name: 熊爬平板后踢
instructions: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your back flat and core braced.
Extend one leg back and up, squeezing your glute.
Bring the knee back in without touching down.
Repeat, then switch legs.
description: From a hovering bear plank position, you kick one leg back to fire up your glutes while your core stays steady.

name: 半坐姿腿部画圈
instructions: Sit on the floor leaning back slightly on your hands.
Lift one leg a little off the floor.
Draw slow circles in the air with that foot.
Keep your core engaged and your torso steady.
Switch directions, then switch legs.
description: Seated leg circles that loosen up your hips and gently work the muscles around them.

name: 金刚坐瑜伽体式
instructions: Kneel on the floor with your knees together.
Point your toes back and sit on your heels.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Lengthen your spine and breathe slowly.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.
description: Sitting back on your heels in a kneeling pose that stretches your thighs, shins and ankles while keeping your spine tall.

name: 徒手蛙式髋推
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your feet close to your hips.
Push through your feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A glute bridge with the soles of your feet together and knees open, which shifts the focus onto your glutes.

name: 史密斯蛙式髋推
instructions: Sit with your upper back on a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Put the soles of your feet together, knees open.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower under control and repeat.
description: A loaded hip thrust on a Smith machine with the soles of your feet together, strongly targeting the glutes.

name: 侧平板屈腿抬腿
instructions: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Bend your top knee and lift it upward.
Lower it without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side plank with a bent top leg that you lift, challenging your obliques and outer hips.

name: 杠铃片站姿侧平举
instructions: Stand tall holding a plate in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: Holding a weight plate in each hand, you raise your arms out to the sides to build the middle shoulders.

name: 弹力带俯身后三角肌侧平举 v. 2
english: band bent over rear lateral raise v. 2
instructions: Stand on a band and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold the band ends in each hand.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: Bent over with a band, you raise your arms out wide to work the back of your shoulders and upper back.

name: 绳索单臂高位划船
instructions: Set a cable to a high position and hold the handle with one hand.
Brace your core and stand or kneel tall.
Pull the handle toward your torso, driving your elbow back.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm row from a high cable, pulling toward your torso to train the upper back and lats.

name: 绳索单臂高位肩胛划船
english: cable single arm high scapular row
instructions: Set a cable high and hold the handle with one hand.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull your shoulder blade back and down, bending the elbow slightly.
Squeeze at the end.
Release slowly, then switch arms.
description: A high cable row focused on moving your shoulder blade, building control in your upper back.

name: 绳索单臂低位肩胛划船
english: cable single arm low scapular row
instructions: Set a cable low and hold the handle with one hand.
Hinge slightly forward with a flat back.
Pull your shoulder blade back toward your spine.
Squeeze for a second.
Return slowly, then switch arms.
description: A low cable row that emphasises the shoulder blade, training the muscles between and around it.

name: 杠杆式俯身划船(胸部支撑)
english: lever bent over row (with chest support)
instructions: Lean your chest against the pad and grab the handles.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Pull the handles toward your body, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A chest-supported lever row that lets you pull heavy while your lower back stays out of the way.

name: 杠杆式俯身中立握划船(胸部支撑)
english: lever bent over neutral grip row (with chest support)
instructions: Lean your chest on the pad and take a neutral grip on the handles.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze at the end.
Return slowly and repeat.
description: A chest-supported row with palms facing each other, building your mid-back and lats.

name: 杠杆式俯身单臂中立握划船(胸部支撑)
english: lever bent over single arm neutral grip row (with chest support)
instructions: Lean your chest against the pad and grip one handle, palm in.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle back, driving your elbow past your torso.
Squeeze your back at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm chest-supported row with a neutral grip, letting you focus on each side of your back.

name: 杠杆式俯身宽握划船(胸部支撑)
english: lever bent over wide grip row (with chest support)
instructions: Lean your chest on the pad and take the wide handles.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the handles back with your elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and repeat.
description: A chest-supported row with a wide grip that shifts more work to the upper back and rear shoulders.

name: 杠杆式俯身单臂宽握划船(胸部支撑)
english: lever bent over single arm wide grip row (with chest support)
instructions: Lean your chest on the pad and grip one wide handle.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle back with your elbow flaring out.
Squeeze at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm chest-supported row on a wide handle, hitting the upper back and rear shoulder on one side.

name: 杠杆式直线哈克深蹲
instructions: Stand on the platform with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your feet to stand.
Keep your back against the pad throughout.
description: A hack squat on a linear lever machine that loads your thighs and glutes along a fixed path.

name: 俯卧撑拉
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor in a push-up.
Press back up to the top.
Drag one hand across the floor as if pulling yourself forward.
Alternate sides and keep your core tight.
description: A push-up combined with a pulling motion, adding upper-back work to a classic chest exercise.

name: 无臂祈祷式拉伸
instructions: Kneel on the floor and sit your hips back toward your heels.
Reach your arms forward and lower your chest.
Let your forehead rest near the floor.
Relax your shoulders and breathe deeply.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
description: A kneeling stretch that opens up your shoulders and lats as you sink your chest toward the floor.

name: 大幅转体背部拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms out in front.
Slowly rotate your upper body to one side, leading with the arms.
Keep your hips facing forward as much as you can.
Turn until you feel a comfortable stretch through the back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.
description: A standing or seated rotation that opens the back and the side of the trunk. Good for easing stiffness through the spine.

name: 徒手凳上深蹲
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower.
Lightly touch the bench with your glutes without dropping onto it.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
description: A squat down to a bench and back up. The bench gives you a depth target and builds leg strength with control.

name: 绳索跪姿高位到低位飞鸟
english: cable kneeling high to low fly
instructions: Set the cables high and kneel between them, holding a handle in each hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms down and together in front of your hips.
Squeeze your chest at the bottom.
Return slowly and repeat.
description: A kneeling cable fly pulling from high to low across your body, working the lower chest.

name: 绳索前平举(绳索把手)
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope ends and let your arms hang with the cable between your legs.
Raise your arms forward to shoulder height with soft elbows.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the stack rest.
Keep your torso still, no swinging.
description: A front raise using a rope on a low cable. The cable keeps tension on the front shoulder through the whole lift.

name: 绳索高脚杯深蹲
instructions: Attach a handle or rope to a low pulley and hold it against your chest.
Step back until there is tension and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your feet to stand up.
Keep your elbows pointing down throughout.
description: A squat holding a low cable at your chest. The front load helps you stay upright and drives the thighs and glutes.

name: 靠墙倒立保持
instructions: Place your hands on the floor a short distance from a wall.
Kick up carefully until your heels rest on the wall.
Push the floor away and keep your arms straight.
Tighten your core and glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then come down with control.
description: A wall-supported handstand held in place, building shoulder strength, balance and body control.

name: 地雷管单腿髋推
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with a padded landmine bar across your hips.
Plant one foot on the floor and extend the other leg or hold it up.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top with your torso level.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg hip thrust with a landmine bar across the hips. It hits each glute separately and challenges balance.

name: 悬垂空心保持
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and hang with straight arms.
Brace your abs and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Lift your legs forward a little so your body forms a gentle hollow shape.
Keep your shoulders active and avoid swinging.
Hold the position for as long as you can with good form.
Lower down under control.
description: A hold hanging from a bar with the body in a slight hollow curve. It builds deep abdominal tension and grip.

name: 下斜屈膝抬腿
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and grip the top behind your head.
Extend your legs with a slight knee bend.
Pull your knees up toward your chest, curling the pelvis off the bench.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without letting the hips drop hard.
Keep the movement smooth, not jerky.
description: Knee raises on a decline bench. The slope adds difficulty and focuses on the lower abs.

name: 杠铃片站姿绕身环绕
english: weighted plate standing around the world
instructions: Stand tall and hold a weight plate with both hands at your waist.
Brace your core and keep your feet planted.
Raise the plate up and over to one side in a wide circle, then around your head.
Bring it back down on the other side.
Keep your hips still as the plate travels.
Do half the reps in each direction.
description: Passing a plate in a circle around the body while standing. It works the shoulders and trunk through many angles.

name: 史密斯杠上斜俯卧撑
english: incline push up on a smith bar
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about waist height and rack it securely.
Place your hands on the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Push back up to straight arms.
description: A push-up with your hands on a Smith bar, making it easier than a floor push-up while still training your chest.

name: 徒手后撤弓步蹲过头伸展
english: bodyweight reverse lunge with overhead reach
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge.
Reach both arms overhead as you lower.
Push through your front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.
description: A reverse lunge with an overhead reach that works your legs and stretches your torso.

name: 绳索罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and face the machine.
Hold the bar, step back and stand tall with soft knees.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs.
Keep your back flat and shoulders pulled back.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand up.
description: A hip hinge using a low cable. It trains the hamstrings and glutes with steady tension.

name: 地雷管单腿罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest and stand on one leg.
Keep a soft bend in the standing knee.
Hinge at the hip and send the free leg back for balance.
Lower the bar toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute and return to standing.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg hip hinge holding a landmine bar. It builds hamstring and glute strength along with balance.

name: 臀腿机仰卧起坐
instructions: Set your feet under the pads of a glute ham bench, hips on the support.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back to a comfortable depth.
Brace your abs and curl up until your torso is upright.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
Keep your lower back from over-arching at the bottom.
description: A sit-up on a glute ham bench. The extra range of motion works the abs and hip flexors hard.

name: 腹肌垫仰卧起坐
instructions: Lie back on an ab mat with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Avoid pulling on your neck.
description: A sit-up on a shaped ab mat that supports the lower back and allows a fuller range of motion.

name: 哑铃弹力带靠墙静蹲
instructions: Put a band around your thighs and stand with your back against a wall.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel.
Hold a dumbbell in both hands in front of you.
Push your knees out against the band.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
description: A wall sit with a band around the knees and a dumbbell held in your lap, adding glute work to the hold.

name: 杠铃片胫骨前肌弯举
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest a plate on your forefoot.
Keep your heel on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shin.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: Lifting your toes up against the weight of a plate to strengthen the muscle on the front of your shin.

name: 90度到90度拉伸
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front and the other bent out to the side, both at about 90 degrees.
Sit tall with your hands on the floor.
Hinge forward over the front shin until you feel a stretch in the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Come back up slowly.
Switch sides.
description: A seated hip stretch with both legs bent at right angles. It loosens the hip rotators and the glutes.

name: 杠杆式腹部摆动
instructions: Sit in the machine and secure yourself with the pads.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Swing your legs to one side using your abs.
Return to the centre with control.
Repeat on the other side.
description: A rotating ab machine movement where you swing your legs and trunk to work the abs.

name: 臀桥行走
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a glute bridge.
Keep the hips high and walk your feet out a few small steps.
Then walk them back in toward your body.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Lower with control when finished.
description: A glute bridge held high while stepping the feet out and back. It adds a dynamic challenge for glutes and hamstrings.

name: 杠铃双脚平放卧推
instructions: Lie on a bench and place your feet flat on it, knees bent.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back flat and your core tight.
