description: A bench press with your feet flat on the bench or surface instead of the floor, limiting leg drive and focusing on the chest.

name: 熊爬低髋
instructions: Start on hands and feet with your knees slightly off the floor.
Keep your hips low and your back flat.
Crawl forward with opposite hand and foot.
Stay controlled and quiet.
Crawl for 20-30 seconds.
description: A low bear crawl with your hips kept down, which challenges your shoulders, legs and core.

name: 徒手支撑深蹲
instructions: Hold on to a sturdy support at chest height.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Keep your chest up and your heels down.
Stand back up by pushing through your feet.
description: A squat where you hold on to a support to stay balanced, ideal for learning depth and form.

name: 杠杆式臀部推举
instructions: Position yourself on the machine and set your feet on the platform.
Brace your core.
Press the platform away by driving through your heels.
Squeeze your glutes at the end.
Return slowly and repeat.
description: A glute press on a lever machine that targets your glutes by pushing your hips and legs back against resistance.

name: 史密斯屈膝礼弓步蹲
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and unrack it, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back and diagonally behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel, chest tall.
Press through the front heel to return to standing.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A curtsey lunge on the smith machine that steps one leg behind and across the other. It hits the glutes and outer hips with a stable bar path.

name: 弹力带侧向行走
instructions: Put a loop band around your legs just above the knees or ankles.
Stand in a quarter squat with feet hip-width apart.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Walk several steps one way, then return the other way.
description: Side stepping with a loop band around the legs. It fires up the hip abductors and glutes.

name: 低位弓步瑜伽体式(安嘉内亚一式)
english: low lunge yoga pose anjaneyasana i
instructions: Start in a lunge with the front knee over the ankle.
Lower the back knee to the floor and untuck the toes.
Sink your hips forward and down.
Raise both arms overhead and lift your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Step back and switch legs.
description: A yoga low lunge with the back knee down and arms overhead. It opens the hips and stretches the front of the thigh.

name: 椅上对角伸展
instructions: Sit tall on the front edge of a chair with feet flat.
Extend your arms out in front of you.
Reach one hand diagonally down toward the opposite foot, rotating your torso.
Return to upright with control.
Reach to the other side and keep alternating.
description: A seated reach across the body toward the opposite foot. It loosens the trunk and works the obliques gently.

name: 绳索高位拉(绳索把手)
english: cable high pull with rope attachment
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip an end in each hand.
Step back until the cable is taut, with a slight lean back.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let the rope return slowly to the start.
description: A rope pull toward the face from a high pulley. It builds the rear delts and upper back.

name: 杠铃硬拉(侧视)
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it just outside your legs.
Brace your core, flatten your back and pull the slack out of the bar.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out the hips without leaning back.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar under control.
description: The classic barbell deadlift shown from the side to check form. It trains the whole posterior chain.

name: 绳索跪姿侧向卷腹
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel beside the stack.
Hold the rope at the side of your head.
Crunch sideways, bringing your elbow toward your hip.
Pause and squeeze your side.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.
description: A kneeling crunch to the side against a high cable. It targets the obliques with steady resistance.

name: 杠铃片站姿二头弯举
instructions: Stand tall holding a plate at its sides with both hands, arms down.
Keep your elbows tucked against your ribs.
Curl the plate up toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the plate slowly to full arm extension.
description: A standing curl holding a single plate. The plate grip also challenges your hands and forearms.

name: 仰卧雨刷
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides, palms down.
Lift your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side without touching the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Lower to the other side and keep alternating.
description: Lying on your back, you swing the legs side to side like wipers. It strengthens the obliques and trunk control.

name: 杠杆式哈克深蹲机早安式体前屈
english: lever good morning on the hack squat machine
instructions: Set up under the shoulder pads with feet shoulder-width apart.
Unlock the machine and stand tall.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Keep your knees slightly bent throughout.
description: A good morning done on a hack squat machine. The machine supports your back while you hinge at the hips.

name: 雪橇斜角单腿腿举
instructions: Sit in the angled sled and place one foot in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety and lower the sled by bending the knee.
Go as deep as you can with your back against the pad.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking out.
Keep your hips flat on the seat.
Finish the reps and switch legs.
description: A one-leg press on an angled sled. It loads each leg separately for strength and balance.

name: 哑铃弹力带髋推
instructions: Put a band around your thighs and rest your upper back on a bench.
Place a dumbbell across your hips and hold it steady.
Plant your feet and push your knees out against the band.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
description: A hip thrust with a dumbbell on the hips and a band around the thighs. The band keeps the glutes working to hold the knees out.

name: 弹力带侧平板臀部上抬
english: resistance band side plank glute raise
instructions: Put a band around your thighs or ankles and get into a side plank on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise the top leg up against the band.
Pause briefly.
Lower the leg with control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: A side plank with a band around the legs while raising the top leg. It works the outer hip and the side of the trunk.

name: 弹力带稳定球平凳反向挺身
english: resistance band reverse hyper with stability ball on flat bench
instructions: Lie face down with your hips over a stability ball on a flat bench.
Loop a band around your feet and anchor it low in front.
Hold the bench for stability.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly against the band.
description: A reverse hyper with your torso on a stability ball and a band adding resistance. It trains glutes and hamstrings while sparing the spine.

name: 绳索跪姿髋外展
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Kneel on all fours with the cuffed leg on the outside.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Lift the knee out to the side against the cable.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control, then switch legs after your reps.
description: A kneeling cable move that lifts the leg out to the side. It targets the outer hip muscles.

name: 弹力带凳上跪姿腿部半圆
english: resistance band kneeling leg half circle on bench
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and kneel on a bench with hands on its edge.
Keep your back flat and hips level.
Lift one leg out behind you.
Sweep it in a half circle out to the side.
Return along the same path under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A kneeling band move on a bench, sweeping the leg in a half circle. It works the glutes from several angles.

name: 绳索驴踢对角后踢
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Get on all fours facing the machine.
Keep your core braced and back flat.
Kick the leg back and slightly out on a diagonal.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.
description: A donkey kickback on a cable that sends the leg back and slightly out. It focuses on the glutes.

name: 弹力带侧向行走深蹲
instructions: Put a band around your thighs or just above the knees.
Drop into a quarter squat with chest up.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Take several steps one way, then return the other way.
Keep your knees pushed out.
description: A squat position with side steps against a band. It strengthens the outer hips and thighs.

name: 绳索坐姿足外翻
instructions: Sit with your leg extended and a cable cuff on your foot.
Position the cable so it pulls the foot inward.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot outward against the cable.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish the reps and switch feet.
description: A seated ankle move turning the foot outward against a cable. It strengthens the outer ankle and lower leg.

name: 绳索坐姿足内翻
instructions: Sit with your leg extended and a cable cuff on your foot.
Position the cable so it pulls the foot outward.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot inward against the cable.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish the reps and switch feet.
description: A seated ankle move turning the foot inward against a cable. It strengthens the inner ankle and lower leg.

name: 跪姿臀部推举
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Press one foot back and up, leading with the heel.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower with control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A kneeling move pressing one leg back to fire the glute. Great for learning to feel the glutes work.

name: 跪姿单腿腿弯举
instructions: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Bend one knee and curl your heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the hamstring at the top.
Lower the foot slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A hamstring curl done from a kneeling position, one leg at a time. It works the back of the thigh.

name: 坐姿髋外旋
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with feet flat.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your knee still and rotate the lower leg inward so the thigh turns outward.
Pause when you feel the hip working.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A seated rotation turning the thigh outward. It improves hip mobility and activates the deep rotators.

name: 站姿平衡髋旋转
instructions: Stand tall on one leg with a soft knee, holding a wall if needed.
Lift the other knee to hip height.
Rotate the lifted knee out to the side, then back to the front.
Keep your torso steady.
Move slowly and smoothly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg balance with controlled hip rotation. It works hip mobility and stability together.

name: 侧卧对角后抬腿
english: side lying diagonal backward leg raise
instructions: Lie on your side with legs stacked and your bottom arm supporting your head.
Brace your core and keep your hips stacked.
Lift the top leg up and slightly back on a diagonal.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: A side-lying leg lift that goes back on a diagonal. It focuses on the glutes and outer hip.

name: 仰卧腹直肌激活卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly on your abs or behind your head.
Exhale and curl your shoulders off the floor.
Feel the abs tighten at the top.
Lower back slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.
description: A small, focused crunch from lying down. It helps you feel the front abdominal muscle working.

name: 仰卧斜角肌激活
instructions: Lie on your back with your head resting on the floor.
Relax your shoulders away from your ears.
Gently tilt your head to one side without lifting your shoulder.
Feel a light engagement along the side of your neck.
Return to the middle slowly.
Alternate sides for several reps.
description: A gentle lying exercise that wakes up the scalene muscles at the side of the neck. It supports neck control.

name: 徒手侧卧肩外旋
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your waist.
Rest your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm upward, keeping the elbow in.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: A side-lying rotation that turns the forearm upward. It strengthens the rotator cuff without weights.

name: 绳索跪姿肩外旋
instructions: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.
description: A light rotation drill with a cable that turns the arm outward. It strengthens the rotator cuff.

name: 绳索跪姿肩内旋
instructions: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the near hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm inward across your belly.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.
description: A light rotation drill with a cable that turns the arm inward. It builds rotator cuff strength and shoulder stability.

name: 哑铃站姿单臂二头弯举
english: dumbbell standing single arm biceps curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side, palm facing forward.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm standing curl. It builds the biceps and lets you focus on each arm separately.

name: 哑铃凳上旋后
instructions: Sit by a bench and rest your forearm on it with your hand past the edge.
Hold a dumbbell with a hammer grip.
Keep your forearm still.
Rotate your palm up as far as you can.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: A forearm rotation holding a dumbbell with the arm over the end of a bench. It trains the muscles that turn the palm up.

name: 坐姿胫骨前肌推
instructions: Sit tall with your heels on the floor.
Lift the toes of one foot as high as you can.
Press them up against light resistance such as the other foot.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.
description: A seated press with the front of the foot to train the shin muscle. It helps balance the lower leg.

name: 绳索跪姿转体
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and kneel sideways to it.
Hold the handle with both hands in front of your chest.
Brace your abs and keep your hips square.
Rotate your torso away from the machine.
Return slowly under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: A kneeling trunk rotation on a cable. It trains the obliques while the base stays stable.

name: 半鸽式髋部拉伸
instructions: Start on all fours and bring one knee forward behind your wrist.
Slide the other leg straight back.
Square your hips to the floor.
Fold forward gently over the front leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides.
description: A floor stretch with one shin folded in front. It opens the outer hip and glutes.

name: 对角弯腰保持
instructions: Stand with feet wider than your hips.
Reach one arm overhead and toward the opposite foot.
Bend diagonally, keeping your hips facing forward.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Return to standing and switch sides.
description: A standing diagonal bend held for a stretch through the back and side of the body.

name: 坐姿前臂拉伸
instructions: Sit tall and extend one arm in front of you, palm up.
With the other hand, gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep the elbow straight and shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Turn the palm down to stretch the other side, then switch arms.
description: A seated stretch for the muscles of the forearm. It eases tight wrists after typing or gripping.

name: 前屈背部拉伸
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Let your arms and head hang down.
Relax your neck and shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Roll up slowly to stand.
description: A standing forward fold that lengthens the back and the backs of the legs.

name: 手辅助颈部拉伸
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Place one hand on the side of your head.
Gently tilt your head toward the shoulder, using light pressure.
Keep the opposite shoulder down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Release slowly and switch sides.
description: A neck stretch where your hand adds gentle pressure. It eases the side and back of the neck.

name: 侧卧地板滚球后胫骨肌(单腿)
english: roll ball posterior tibialis (single leg) side lying on floor
instructions: Lie on your side with a small ball under the inside of your lower leg.
Support yourself with your hands and the other leg.
Slowly roll the leg along the ball from calf toward ankle.
Pause on tender spots with light pressure.
Breathe and relax the leg.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.
description: Rolling a ball under the inner lower leg while lying on your side. It releases the deep calf muscle that supports the arch.

name: 侧卧滚球斜角肌激活
english: roll ball side lying scalene muscles activation
instructions: Lie on your side with a small ball under the side of your neck.
Support your head with a pillow or your hand.
Relax your shoulder.
Gently press or nod to roll over the ball.
Keep the pressure light.
Do 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.
description: Lying on your side with a ball at the neck to ease the scalene muscles. Use light pressure.

name: 侧卧滚球斜角肌激活(侧视)
english: roll ball side lying scalene muscles activation (side pov)
instructions: Lie on your side with a small ball under the side of your neck.
Support your head so your neck stays neutral.
Relax your shoulder.
Gently move your head to roll over the ball.
Keep the pressure light.
Do 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.
description: The same side-lying scalene release as seen from the side. A ball at the neck eases the muscles with light pressure.

name: 仰卧滚球头半棘肌激活
english: roll ball lying semispinalis capitis muscle activation
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a small ball under the base of your skull.
Relax your head onto the ball.
Make small nods or turns to roll over the muscle.
Keep the pressure gentle.
Breathe slowly.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.
description: Lying on your back with a ball under the base of the skull. It releases the deep muscles at the back of the neck.

name: 跪姿缝匠肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel on one knee in a half-kneeling position.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips forward slightly.
Lean slightly to the side of the back leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.
description: A kneeling stretch for the long strap muscle across the front of the thigh and hip.

name: 跪姿髂腰肌拉伸
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Tuck your pelvis and brace your abs.
Shift your weight forward until you feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Raise the arm on the kneeling side overhead.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.
description: A kneeling lunge stretch for the deep hip flexor. It helps loosen the front of the hip.

name: 站姿腓骨肌拉伸
instructions: Stand near a wall for balance.
Cross one foot behind and turn the sole so the outer edge presses into the floor.
Gently shift your weight onto that foot.
Feel the stretch along the outside of the lower leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch feet.
description: A standing stretch for the muscles on the outside of the lower leg. It helps ankle mobility.

name: 站姿胫骨前肌拉伸
instructions: Stand near a wall for balance.
Place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with toes curled under.
Gently bend the standing knee to press forward.
Feel the stretch along the shin.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch feet.
description: A standing stretch for the muscle at the front of the shin. Useful after running or lots of walking.

name: 坐姿菱形肌拉伸
instructions: Sit tall and clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Push your arms forward and round your upper back.
Tuck your chin slightly and spread the shoulder blades apart.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat.
description: A seated stretch that opens the space between the shoulder blades. It relieves tightness in the upper back.

name: 站姿足部肌肉激活
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Spread your toes wide and press all of them into the floor.
Lift your toes while keeping the ball of the foot down.
Lower them one by one.
Keep your arch lifted.
Repeat for 10-15 slow reps.
description: A standing drill that wakes up the small muscles of the feet. It builds foot control and balance.

name: 绳索站姿单侧三角肌划船
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and grab the handle with one hand.
Stand with feet staggered and your torso slightly braced.
Pull the handle toward you with your elbow flared out.
Squeeze the rear shoulder at the end.
Extend slowly, then switch arms after your reps.
description: A one-arm cable row with a high elbow. It focuses on the rear delts and upper back.

name: 弹力带坐姿髋外展 v. 2
instructions: Sit tall on a bench with a band around your thighs above the knees.
Keep your feet flat and planted.
Press your knees apart against the band.
Hold for a second at the widest point.
Bring the knees back together slowly.
description: A seated move pushing the knees outward against a band. It strengthens the outer hips and glutes.

name: faber测试
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Place one foot on the opposite knee.
Let the bent knee drop out to the side.
Relax and notice how far it goes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
Switch legs.
description: A gentle hip check where the ankle rests on the opposite knee and the knee drops out. It shows how mobile the hip is.

name: 髋外旋测试
instructions: Sit or lie with the knee bent 90 degrees.
Keep the thigh still.
Swing the lower leg inward so the hip rotates outward.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other leg.
description: A simple check of how far the hip turns outward. You do it gently to see your range.

name: 髋内旋测试
instructions: Sit or lie with the knee bent 90 degrees.
Keep the thigh still.
Swing the lower leg outward so the hip rotates inward.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other leg.
description: A simple check of how far the hip turns inward. You do it gently to see your range.

name: 腿长测试
instructions: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and feet together.
Relax your hips and arms.
Compare the position of your heels or ankles.
Bend your knees and lift your hips, then lower and straighten again.
Check again for any difference.
Stay relaxed throughout.
description: A lying check comparing the length of both legs. It is done gently and with a relaxed body.

name: 肩外旋测试
instructions: Stand or lie with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your elbow against your body.
Rotate your forearm outward slowly.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other arm.
description: A simple check of how far the shoulder turns outward. Move slowly and stay in a pain-free range.

name: 肩内旋测试
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach one arm behind your back with the palm facing out.
Slide your hand slowly up your spine as far as is comfortable.
Note how high your thumb reaches, keeping your chest open.
Lower the arm, then repeat with the other side to compare.
description: A simple check of how far your shoulder turns inward, handy for spotting tightness before you train.

name: 肩水平测试
instructions: Stand relaxed with your feet hip-width apart and arms hanging loose.
Look straight ahead and let your shoulders settle naturally.
Check in a mirror, or ask a friend, whether both shoulders are at the same height.
Roll the shoulders once and re-check without shrugging.
Note any difference and repeat now and then to track it.
description: A quick posture check to see whether one shoulder sits higher than the other.

name: 后链柔韧性测试
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your knees straight.
Hinge at the hips and slowly reach down toward your toes.
Let your head and arms hang relaxed without bouncing.
Note how far your fingertips reach.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Rise slowly, rolling up one vertebra at a time.
description: A forward-fold style check of how flexible the back of your body is, from calves up to your lower back.

name: 托马斯测试
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench, then lie back and hug one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang off the edge with the thigh relaxed.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.
Notice whether the hanging thigh rises above the bench or the knee straightens.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs and compare.
description: A hip flexor length test where you lie on the edge of a bench and see how freely the thigh hangs.

name: 托马斯正面测试
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench and lie back, pulling one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang down off the edge, fully relaxed.
Keep your lower back pressed down and your pelvis still.
Watch whether the hanging leg drifts outward or the thigh lifts.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs and compare.
description: The frontal-view version of the Thomas test, checking for tight hip flexors and inner thighs while you lie on a bench.

name: 史密斯相扑椅上深蹲
instructions: Place a chair behind you and set the bar on your upper back.
Take a wide stance with toes turned out.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the chair.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand up.
description: A wide-stance squat on the smith machine down to a chair. The seat gives a consistent depth.

name: 杠铃凳上侧向上台阶
instructions: Place the bar on your upper back and stand beside a bench.
Put the inside foot flat on the bench.
Press through that heel and stand up on the bench.
Lower the other foot back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
description: A sideways step up onto a bench with a barbell on the back. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.

name: 弹力带站姿平衡臀部后踢
english: resistance band standing balance glute kickback
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or hold it under your standing foot.
Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee and brace your abs.
Kick the other leg straight back against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Return slowly with control.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A standing band kickback that builds the glutes while challenging your balance on one leg.

name: 哑铃侧卧腹斜肌V字起
instructions: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lift your legs and torso together, angling toward one side.
Reach the dumbbell toward your feet.
Lower back down slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.
description: A lying V-up to the side while holding a dumbbell. It works the abs and obliques hard.

name: 哑铃军事推举俄罗斯转体(双腿离地)
english: dumbbell military press russian twist with legs floor off
instructions: Sit leaning back slightly with knees bent and feet off the floor.
Hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press both dumbbells overhead.
Lower them, then twist your torso to one side.
Twist to the other side and repeat the sequence.
description: A seated combo that pairs an overhead press with a Russian twist, feet off the floor. It challenges the trunk and shoulders together.

name: 哑铃坐姿军事推举地面收放腿
english: dumbbell seated military press in out leg raise on floor
instructions: Sit on the floor leaning back slightly, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press the dumbbells overhead.
Pull your knees in, then extend the legs out as the weights stay up.
Lower the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Repeat, keeping your back long and core braced.
description: A seated overhead press combined with in and out leg movements. It works the shoulders and the lower abs together.

name: 哑铃坐姿军事推举保持交替地面抬腿
english: dumbbell seated military hold alternate leg raise on floor
instructions: Sit on the floor leaning back a little and press the dumbbells overhead.
Keep your arms locked and steady.
Raise one leg off the floor.
Lower it and raise the other leg.
Keep alternating, then lower the weights.
description: You hold dumbbells overhead while raising the legs alternately. It trains the lower abs and shoulder stability.

name: 侧向与前向进出
instructions: Sit on the floor leaning back, hands behind you for support.
Lift your feet off the floor with knees bent.
Extend your legs out to one side and pull them back in.
Extend them straight in front and pull back in.
Repeat the pattern on the other side.
description: A seated in and out leg drill that goes to the side and then to the front. It works the abs and obliques.

name: 平板支撑交替反重力引体
english: plank alternate anti gravity pull up
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Pull one arm up and back toward your ribs.
Return it to the floor under control.
Alternate arms without rocking your hips.
description: From a plank you alternately pull one arm up toward your chest as if climbing. It builds core stability and shoulder control.

name: 哑铃交替V字起
instructions: Lie on your back with a dumbbell in each hand, arms overhead.
Lift your torso and one leg at the same time.
Reach the weights toward your raised foot.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Alternate legs each rep.
description: A V-up where one arm and the opposite leg meet, holding a dumbbell. It trains the abs through a big range.

name: 哑铃军事推举俄罗斯转体(双腿离地) v. 2
english: dumbbell military press russian twist with legs floor off v. 2
instructions: Sit leaning back slightly with knees bent and feet off the floor.
Hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press both dumbbells overhead and lower them.
Twist your torso to one side, then the other.
Keep your chest tall and breathe steadily.
description: A variation of the seated overhead press and Russian twist combo with feet off the floor. It works the trunk and shoulders.

name: 哑铃过头仰卧起坐(双腿放凳上)
english: dumbbell overhead sit up with legs on bench
instructions: Lie on the floor with calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest or overhead.
Curl up into a sit-up, keeping your arms extended.
Reach toward your knees at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
description: A sit-up holding a dumbbell overhead with the legs resting on a bench. The extra reach makes the abs work harder.

name: 弹力带仰卧屈膝抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with a band looped around your feet or anchored.
Place your hands by your sides and brace your core.
Bring your knees toward your chest against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your feet slowly without arching your back.
description: A lying knee raise against band resistance. It builds the lower abs and hip flexors.

name: 木棒肩胛下肌放松
instructions: Hold a stick in one hand and bend your elbow to 90 degrees.
Place the other hand on the stick and rotate the arm outward.
Gently push into a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other arm.
description: A gentle release for the muscle under the shoulder blade using a stick for leverage. It helps the shoulder feel looser.

name: 坐姿滚球耻骨肌激活
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with a ball between your knees.
Place your feet flat and keep your back straight.
Squeeze the ball gently with your thighs.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and repeat several times.
description: A seated move using a ball to wake up the inner upper thigh. It works the pectineus and the nearby adductors.

name: 杠铃卧推(侧视)
instructions: Lie on a bench with your eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Touch lightly and press back up over your shoulders.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched throughout.
description: The barbell bench press seen from the side to check bar path and form. It builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: 壶铃上斜飞鸟
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Squeeze the chest to bring the weights back together.
Control the weights and keep your wrists stable.
description: A fly on an incline bench using kettlebells. It stretches and works the upper chest.

name: 壶铃坐姿侧平举
instructions: Sit upright on a bench holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
description: A seated side raise using kettlebells. It isolates the side delts without leg drive.

name: 简易坐瑜伽体式
instructions: Sit on the floor and bend your knees.
Place one heel against your inner thigh and the other foot in front of it.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Relax your shoulders and look straight ahead.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch the cross of your legs and repeat.
description: A calm cross-legged seat that opens the hips and teaches you to sit tall.

name: 支撑头倒立瑜伽体式
instructions: Kneel and place your forearms on the mat with your fingers interlaced.
Set the crown of your head lightly on the floor against your hands.
Lift your knees and walk your feet toward your face.
Lift your legs slowly, using your core, until they point to the ceiling.
Keep most of the weight in your forearms and shoulders.
Hold briefly, then lower with control and rest in child's pose.
description: An inversion where your forearms and head share the load, building shoulder strength and balance.

name: 前臂倒立瑜伽体式
english: forearms stand yoga pose pincha mayurasana
instructions: Start on your forearms and knees with your elbows under your shoulders.
Press your forearms into the floor and tuck your toes.
Lift your hips high and walk your feet toward your elbows.
Swing or float one leg up, then bring the other to meet it.
Keep your ribs in and your gaze between your hands.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.
description: A forearm balance that builds strong shoulders and core, also known as feathered peacock pose.

name: 杠杆式交叉高位下拉
instructions: Adjust the seat and thigh pad, then grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down and across toward your torso.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Return slowly to a full stretch.
description: A machine pulldown where the arms cross the body path. It builds the lats and upper back.

name: 哑铃z式推举 v. 2
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back tall.
Press both dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them to your shoulders under control.
Avoid leaning back during the press.
description: An overhead press done seated on the floor with legs straight. The position removes leg drive and demands a strong core.

name: 哑铃交替z式推举
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and sit tall.
Press one dumbbell overhead.
Lower it and press the other arm.
Keep alternating without tilting your torso.
description: A seated floor press that alternates arms, which adds anti-lean trunk work. It trains the shoulders and the core.

name: 牛式瑜伽体式
instructions: Start on hands and knees, with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and let your belly drop toward the floor.
Lift your chest and tailbone while your gaze goes slightly forward.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for 3-5 breaths.
Return to a neutral spine.
description: A gentle spinal extension from all fours that wakes up the back and often pairs with cat pose.

name: 牛面式瑜伽体式
instructions: Sit with one knee stacked over the other and your feet beside your hips.
Reach one arm up and bend the elbow, hand down your back.
Sweep the other arm behind you and try to clasp your fingers.
Keep your spine tall and your chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: A seated pose that stretches the shoulders, triceps and hips together.

name: 双杠深俯卧撑
english: deep push up on parallel bars
instructions: Grip two parallel bars and hold a straight plank position.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Lower your chest below the level of your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body in one line throughout.
description: A push-up between parallel bars that lets you sink deeper than the floor allows. It gives the chest a greater stretch.

name: 坐姿肩胛内收
instructions: Sit tall with arms relaxed at your sides or held in front.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Pull your shoulder blades together and slightly down.
Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds.
Release slowly and repeat.
description: A seated drill squeezing the shoulder blades together. It strengthens the muscles that support good posture.

name: 坐姿肩胛内收 v. 2
instructions: Sit tall with elbows bent and hands by your ribs.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your elbows back and pinch your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 2-3 seconds.
Return slowly and repeat.
description: A variation of the seated shoulder blade squeeze with the arms held out. It strengthens the upper back and posture muscles.

name: 自由泳
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing one arm forward and over in a crawl stroke.
Alternate arms in a smooth, continuous rhythm.
Rotate your torso slightly with each stroke.
Keep going at a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.
description: A standing or floor drill that copies the front crawl arm stroke. It raises your heart rate and warms the shoulders.

name: 侧向跨栏跳
instructions: Stand beside a low hurdle with feet together.
Swing your arms and jump sideways over it.
Land softly on both feet with knees bent.
Jump straight back over the other way.
Keep your ground contact quick and controlled.
description: A side-to-side jump over a low hurdle. It builds explosive power and quick landings.

name: 弹力带辅助俯卧撑
instructions: Anchor a band across a rack or set of bars at chest height.
Rest your torso on the band in a plank position.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at 45 degrees.
Press up using the bounce of the band as help.
Keep your body in a straight line.
description: A push-up with a band supporting the body to make the rep easier. It helps you build toward full push-ups.

name: 不等高引体向上
instructions: Hang from the bar with one hand higher or on a towel and the other lower.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Lead with the working arm and pull your chin toward the bar.
Lower yourself under control.
Switch the hand positions on the next set.
description: A pull-up with the hands at different heights or one hand doing more work. It gently trains one-arm pulling strength.

name: 哑铃站姿胸椎推举
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and lift your chest tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead while gently extending your upper back.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.
Lower to your shoulders with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A standing dumbbell press that adds upper back extension, training shoulder strength and posture together.

name: 腕部全幅俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Spread your fingers and keep your wrists stacked.
Lower your chest to the floor under control.
Press back to the top.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
description: A full push-up focusing on wrist position and control. It builds the chest while preparing the wrists for load.

name: 靠墙下犬式俯卧撑
english: downward dog push up against wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it with hips back.
Lower your head toward the wall, bending the elbows.
Push explosively away from the wall.
Land softly back into the start position.
Keep your core braced and back flat.
description: A wall-assisted version of a downward dog push-up with a push off at the top. It trains the shoulders in a bent-hip position.

name: 稳定球跪姿滚轮前推
instructions: Kneel facing a stability ball with your forearms resting on top.
Brace your abs and keep your hips in line with your back.
Roll the ball forward, extending your body.
Stop before your lower back sags.
Pull the ball back in using your abs.
description: A kneeling rollout with the forearms on a stability ball. It builds deep core strength.

name: 哑铃站姿双手扭转
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell by its handle in front of you.
Keep your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Rotate your forearms and wrists inward and outward.
Move slowly through the full range.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
description: A standing twisting move holding a dumbbell that works the forearm rotators. It builds wrist and grip strength.

name: 杠铃片站姿双手扭转
instructions: Stand holding a plate at its sides in front of you.
Keep your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Rotate the plate left and right using your wrists and forearms.
Move slowly and under control.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
description: A standing twisting move holding a plate that works the forearm rotators. It builds wrist and grip strength.

name: 哑铃站姿反握弯举旋转
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with an overhand grip at your thighs.
Curl the weights up while keeping your elbows tucked.
At the top, rotate your forearms so the palms turn up.
Rotate back and lower slowly.
Keep your wrists strong and avoid swinging.
description: A standing reverse curl that ends with a forearm rotation. It targets the forearms and brachialis.

name: 杠杆式坐姿单腿腿举 v. 2
english: lever seated single leg press v. 2
instructions: Sit in the machine and put one foot on the platform.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the platform away until your leg is almost straight.
Lower slowly until your knee bends to about 90 degrees.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A machine press done with one leg at a time. It helps fix strength imbalances between legs.

name: 杠杆式坐姿腿伸展 v. 3
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and shins behind the roller.
Align your knees with the machine pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
Lower with control.
description: A machine leg extension that isolates the front of the thigh. It builds quad size and strength.

name: 哑铃直臂上拉 v. 2
instructions: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell above your chest with straight arms.
Keep a slight softness in your elbows and brace your core.
Lower the weight in an arc back over your head until you feel a stretch.
Keep your ribs down and your hips on the bench.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest.
Repeat with a smooth tempo.
description: A pullover variation with straight arms that stretches and works the chest and lats through a long arc.

name: 曲杆杠铃站姿直立划船
instructions: Stand tall holding the EZ bar with a shoulder-width grip.
Let the bar hang in front of your thighs.
Pull it up along your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop around chest height without shrugging hard.
Lower the bar slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright throughout.
description: A vertical pull with an EZ bar that builds the side shoulders and upper traps.

name: 徒手仰卧交替腿弯举
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Bend one knee and bring the heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the back of your thigh at the top.
Lower the leg slowly.
Repeat with the other leg.
Alternate for the planned reps.
description: A floor hamstring curl using your own weight, alternating legs to keep it easy on the joints.

name: 侧滑步高抬腿
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Shuffle sideways for a few steps.
Lift your knees high with each step.
Stay light on your feet and pump your arms.
Change direction and continue for 30-60 seconds.
description: A lateral shuffle where each step brings the knee high. It raises your heart rate and builds agility.

name: 绳索坐姿反向耸肩
instructions: Sit with a low cable behind you, holding the handle behind your back.
Keep your arms straight and chest tall.
Shrug your shoulders up and slightly back.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly to the start.
description: A seated shrug with the cable pulling from behind the body. It trains the traps and the upper back.

name: 直排轮滑
instructions: Put on skates, helmet and pads, and stand with your knees slightly bent.
Push one skate out to the side and glide on the other.
Alternate pushes with a relaxed arm swing.
Keep your chest up and your weight over the skates.
Skate at a steady pace for 10-30 minutes.
Slow down gradually to stop.
description: Gliding on inline skates for steady cardio that also works the legs and balance.

name: 杠杆式坐姿小腿推举 v. 2
instructions: Sit in the machine and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
Extend your knees almost fully.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly for a good stretch.
description: A seated machine calf press that pushes through the balls of the feet. It builds the calf muscles.

name: 杠杆式坐姿单腿小腿推举
instructions: Sit in the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Rest the other foot on the floor or the support.
Press up through your toes as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calf.
Lower your heel slowly for a full stretch.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A seated machine press working one calf at a time to build lower leg strength.

name: 交叉后撤跳
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your knees soft.
Hop and cross one foot in front of the other.
Hop back out, then step one foot back behind you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet each time.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.
Alternate sides for the planned time.
description: A quick hopping drill that crosses the feet and steps back, building agility and leg power.

name: 弹力带臀桥外展
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the band just above your knees.
Press through your heels to lift your hips.
At the top, push your knees apart against the band.
Bring the knees back together.
Lower your hips slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A glute bridge with a band around the knees, pressing out to light up the side glutes.

name: 弹力带仰卧屈膝髋外展
english: resistance band lying bent knee hip abduction
instructions: Lie on your side with the band above your knees and your knees bent.
Stack your hips and rest your head on your arm.
Lift your top knee up against the band without rolling back.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your feet together like a clamshell.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A lying hip abduction with bent knees that targets the outer hip and glutes.

name: 弹力带坐姿屈膝外展
english: resistance band seated bent knee abduction
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with the band just above your knees.
Plant your feet flat and hip-width apart.
Press your knees out against the band.
Hold briefly at the widest point.
Bring the knees back slowly.
Keep your back straight throughout.
description: A seated band move pressing the knees apart to work the outer hips.

name: 弹力带仰卧抬腿 v. 2
english: resistance band lying leg raise v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back with the band around your feet or anchored behind your head.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs together toward the ceiling.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
Stop just above the floor.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A leg raise with band tension that challenges the lower abs and hip flexors.

name: 弹力带侧弓步蹲
instructions: Stand with the band under your feet or around your thighs, feet together.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and your heel down.
Push back to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A side lunge with band tension that works the legs and hips from a different angle.

name: 弹力带深蹲跨步
instructions: Place the band around your thighs and stand with feet hip-width.
Sit into a squat and stay low.
Step one foot out to the side against the band.
Bring the other foot in to follow.
Take several steps, then return the other way.
Keep your knees pushed out.
description: A squat that steps sideways against a band, firing up the glutes and hips.

name: 弹力带站姿平衡臀部后踢 v. 2
english: resistance band standing balance glute kickback v. 2
instructions: Place the band around your ankles and stand tall on one leg.
Hold a wall or rail for balance if needed.
Keep a slight bend in your standing knee.
Kick the other leg back, squeezing the glute.
Return slowly without leaning forward.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A second take on the band glute kickback, balancing on one leg while the other presses back.

name: 弹力带深蹲跳
instructions: Place the band above your knees and stand with feet shoulder-width.
Squat down with your chest up.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly, absorbing into the next squat.
Keep your knees pressing out against the band.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A squat jump with a band around the thighs to keep the knees driving outward.

name: 弹力带侧向跨步深蹲
english: resistance band lateral step and squat
instructions: Put the band around your thighs and stand tall.
Step one foot out to the side.
Sit down into a squat.
Stand up and bring your feet together.
Keep the knees from caving in.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A sideways step into a squat with band tension to train the glutes and legs.

name: 弹力带保加利亚分腿蹲
instructions: Stand in front of a bench, band under your front foot and held at your shoulders.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Keep your torso tall.
Press through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A single-leg squat with the rear foot elevated and a band adding resistance.

name: 弹力带跪姿后踢腿
instructions: Start on hands and knees with the band around your foot and hands.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A kneeling donkey-kick style move with band resistance for the glutes.

name: 弹力带跪姿腿部半圆
english: resistance band kneeling leg half circle
instructions: Start on hands and knees with the band around your thighs or foot.
Lift one leg out to the side with a bent knee.
Sweep it in a half circle, back and up.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Reverse the circle to return.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A kneeling leg sweep against a band that works the glutes and outer hips.

name: 弹力带平板开合跳
instructions: Place the band above your knees and get into a high plank.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Jump your feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Repeat at a steady pace.
description: A plank with jumping feet and a band around the legs, working your core while the hips resist.

name: 弹力带俯卧挺身外展
instructions: Lie face down with the band around your ankles.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Lift both legs slightly off the floor.
Open your legs out against the band.
Bring them back together and lower slowly.
Keep the movement small and controlled.
description: A face-down hip extension combined with outward leg movement against a band.

name: 弹力带空中自行车 v. 2
instructions: Lie on your back, hands behind your head, band around your feet.
Lift your shoulders and bring one knee toward your chest.
Rotate your opposite elbow toward that knee.
Extend the other leg against the band.
Alternate in a pedalling motion.
Keep a steady rhythm.
description: An air bike crunch with band tension for extra work on the abs and hips.

name: 侧卧内旋
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked to your ribs.
Rest the forearm on the floor in front of you.
Rotate your forearm up toward your belly.
Lower it slowly back to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A light rotation exercise lying on your side that turns the arm inward. It strengthens the rotator cuff gently.

name: 靠墙对侧手臂与腿抬起
english: opposite arm and leg raise against wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall in a bent over position with your hands on it.
Brace your core.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold for a second without twisting.
Lower and repeat on the other side.
description: A wall-supported raise of the opposite arm and leg. It trains balance and lower back stability.

name: 地面T字上举 v. 2
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor and neck neutral.
Lift your arms off the floor by pinching your shoulder blades.
Hold for a second at the top.
Lower with control.
description: A face-down raise with the arms out to form a T. It strengthens the muscles between the shoulder blades.

name: 吊环宽握引体向上
instructions: Grab the rings with a wide overhand grip and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest toward the rings, driving elbows down and out.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
description: A pull-up on rings with a wide grip. The unstable rings make the lats and stabilizers work harder.

name: 壶铃平板支撑传递
instructions: Start in a high plank with a kettlebell beside one hand.
Spread your feet wide for balance.
Grab the kettlebell and slide it across under your body.
Place it down on the other side.
Keep your hips level and repeat in the other direction.
description: From a plank you slide a kettlebell under your body from one hand to the other. It works the core and shoulder stability.

name: 壶铃大猩猩划船
instructions: Place two kettlebells on the floor between your wide stance.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and grab both handles.
Row one kettlebell to your hip while the other stays down.
Lower it and row the other side.
Keep your hips and shoulders square.
description: A wide-stance row between two kettlebells, alternating arms. It trains the lats and the core.

name: 哑铃上斜单臂Y字上举
english: dumbbell incline single arm y raise
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight down.
Raise your arm forward and up in a Y shape, thumb up.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your reps.
description: A chest-supported raise on an incline bench to a Y position with one arm. It builds the lower traps and rear delts.

name: 站姿肩胛旋转
instructions: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Roll them back, then down.
Bring them forward and up again in a circle.
Reverse the direction after several reps.
description: A standing drill that moves the shoulder blades in circles. It improves shoulder mobility and control.

name: 站姿肩胛旋转(正视)
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Lift your shoulders gently up.
Roll them back and down in a smooth circle.
Reverse the direction.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A standing shoulder blade rotation that warms up the upper back and improves control of the scapulae.

name: 哑铃站姿肩胛外旋
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your upper arm still and your shoulder blade pulled back and down.
Rotate your forearm outward as far as you comfortably can.
Pause briefly, then slowly return to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
description: Light dumbbell rotation that strengthens the small muscles behind the shoulder and between the shoulder blades.

name: 哑铃站姿肩胛外旋(正视)
english: dumbbell standing scapular external rotation (front pov)
instructions: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow tucked and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your upper arm against your side.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A light dumbbell rotation that trains the rear shoulder and rotator cuff.

name: 杠铃勾握硬拉
instructions: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it with your thumbs under your fingers.
Hinge down, brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out with hips and knees extended.
Lower the bar under control by hinging at the hips first.
description: Deadlift using a hook grip, where the thumb is trapped under the fingers, for a secure hold on heavy pulls.

name: 悬垂前水平抬起
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Pull your shoulders down and tighten your core.
Raise your straight body up toward horizontal, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the top position for a moment.
Lower slowly without swinging.
description: Hanging straight-body raise toward a front lever position that challenges your abs and lats.

name: 哑铃上斜鲍威尔上举
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a light dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight below your shoulder.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, leading with your elbow, up to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Complete your reps and switch sides.
description: Raise performed lying face down on an incline bench, hitting the rear delts and the small rotator muscles.

name: 坐姿蛙式半起到全起仰卧起坐
english: seated frog half to full sit up
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out.
Lower your back halfway to the floor under control.
Pause, then lower fully to lie flat.
Curl your torso back up to sitting, using your abs.
Keep your feet together and avoid yanking on your neck.
description: Sit-up started from a seated frog position, with knees out and soles together, to work the abs and open the hips.

name: 椅上坐姿上勾拳
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your fists up by your chin.
Brace your core.
Rotate your torso and punch one fist upward in an uppercut.
Snap it back and punch with the other hand.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.
description: Seated punching move that fires the abs and shoulders with quick uppercut punches.

name: 悬挂训练带屈体
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and get into a plank with hands on the floor.
Keep your arms straight and body in a line.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling, pulling your feet in.
Pause at the top with legs fairly straight.
Lower back to plank with control.
description: Plank with feet in suspension straps, piking the hips up to work the abs and shoulders.

name: 悬挂训练带前平板支撑
instructions: Set your feet in the straps and place your forearms or hands on the floor.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Hold without letting your hips sag or rise.
Keep breathing steadily for the whole hold.
description: Front plank with feet in straps, making the hold wobbly and demanding for the whole core.

name: 负重瓶大猩猩划船
instructions: Stand wide with a bottle on the floor between your feet and hinge forward.
Keep your back flat and grip a bottle in each hand.
Row one bottle up to your hip while the other stays down.
Lower it, then row with the other side.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides.
description: Gorilla row using a weighted bottle in each hand, a handy way to train the back at home.

name: 弹力带跪姿髋推
english: resistance band hip thrusts on knees
instructions: Kneel with a band anchored low in front and looped around your hips.
Start with your hips back and chest up.
Drive your hips forward, squeezing your glutes hard.
Pause at full hip extension.
Return slowly and repeat.
description: Kneeling hip thrust against a band that targets the glutes without any bench.

name: 悬挂训练带背阔肌拉伸
instructions: Hold the straps and lean back with straight arms.
Sit your hips back and drop your chest between your arms.
Feel the stretch along the sides of your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return slowly to standing.
description: Hanging stretch using straps that opens the sides of your back and your shoulders.

name: 悬挂训练带深蹲爆发拉
instructions: Hold the straps with arms extended and sink into a squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
Drive up through your legs.
As you rise, pull the straps toward your chest.
Lower your arms and sit back into the next squat.
description: Squat paired with an explosive pull on the straps, linking legs and back in one move.

name: 弹力带腿后踢
instructions: Loop a band around your ankles or anchor it low and loop it on one foot.
Stand tall holding something for balance.
Kick the working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly, then switch legs.
description: Standing band kickback that isolates the glutes.

name: 弹力带行走
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles.
Sit into a slight squat with feet hip width apart.
Step sideways, keeping tension in the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the band go slack.
Walk back the other way to even it out.
description: Walking with a band around the legs to fire up the outer hips and glutes.

name: 六角杠过头推举
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar and hold it at shoulder height with a neutral grip.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead until your arms lock out.
Pause, then lower to your shoulders.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.
description: Overhead press using a trap bar, giving a neutral grip that can be easier on the shoulders.

name: 仰卧骨盆倾斜
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Take a breath in with a neutral spine.
Exhale, tilting your pelvis so your lower back presses into the floor.
Hold for a moment.
Release back to neutral.
Repeat slowly.
description: A small floor movement that teaches you to control the tilt of your pelvis and relax the lower back.

name: 站姿颈侧拉伸
instructions: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head toward one shoulder.
Rest a hand lightly on your head for slight pressure.
Keep the opposite shoulder low.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides.
description: A gentle side stretch for the neck and upper traps, useful after desk work.

name: 椅子辅助坐姿腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Sit on the front edge of a chair.
Straighten one leg with the heel on the floor and toes up.
Keep the other foot flat and your back long.
Hinge forward at the hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.
description: A seated stretch using a chair to lengthen the back of the thigh without a deep fold.

name: 哑铃垫高后撤弓步蹲
instructions: Stand with your front foot on a low platform, holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee steady.
Push through the front heel to return.
Finish reps and switch legs.
description: Reverse lunge with the front foot raised for a deeper range, hitting the glutes and quads.

name: 杠杆式腿伸展(脚尖内扣)
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pad on your lower shins.
Turn your toes slightly inward.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight.
Squeeze your quads for a second.
Lower the weight slowly.
description: Leg extension with toes angled in to shift the emphasis on the quads.

name: 哑铃挺身
instructions: Set up on a hyperextension bench with the pads at your hips.
Hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise up until your body forms a straight line.
Avoid overarching at the top.
description: Hyperextension with a dumbbell held to your chest to load the lower back and glutes.

name: 哑铃杰斐逊弯举
instructions: Stand on a low step holding a light dumbbell in front of you.
Tuck your chin and slowly roll down one vertebra at a time.
Let the dumbbell hang near your shins.
Pause at the bottom, then roll up slowly.
Keep the weight light and the movement smooth.
description: Slow, light-loaded spinal roll down and up that builds control and flexibility in the back and hamstrings.

name: 跳跃钟摆
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways to land on the other foot.
Swing the free leg across behind you for balance.
Land softly and stay controlled.
Keep alternating at a steady pace.
description: Side to side hopping that swings your legs like a pendulum, training balance and leg power.

name: 宽距平板侧点地
instructions: Start in a high plank with feet wider than your hips.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one hand and tap your opposite hip or thigh.
Return the hand and tap with the other side.
Move slowly without rocking.
description: Wide-stance plank with alternating side taps that challenge core stability.

name: 史密斯相扑硬拉
instructions: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, and grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Push your feet into the floor and stand tall.
Lock out your hips at the top.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back.
description: Wide-stance deadlift on the smith machine that trains glutes and inner thighs.

name: 杠杆式髋推(插片式)
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and belt secured over your hips.
Plant your feet flat, shoulder width apart.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.
description: Plate-loaded machine hip thrust for heavy glute work.

name: 引体向上(离心)
instructions: Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower yourself slowly over 3-5 seconds.
Stop at a full hang with straight arms.
Step back up and repeat.
description: Slow lowering phase of a pull-up that builds strength for full pull-ups.

name: 靠墙平板支撑
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your forearms or hands on it.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a slanted line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your head neutral.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Step in to finish.
description: A standing plank against a wall, an easy way to learn core bracing.

name: 垫高负重全蹲
instructions: Stand with your heels on a low plate or platform, holding a weight at your chest.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Squat as deep as comfortable.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up to standing.
description: Deep weighted squat with heels raised to increase depth and quad work.

name: 后撤弓步高抬膝接前弓步
english: reverse lunge high knee forward lunge
instructions: Stand tall with hands on hips.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
Drive that back leg forward into a high knee.
Step the same leg forward into a forward lunge.
Push back to standing and switch legs after your reps.
description: Combo lunge: step back, drive the knee up, then step forward into a lunge.

name: 垫高双腿髋推
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A hip thrust with your upper back on a bench, driving both hips up to train the glutes.

name: 靠墙卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet and calves resting on a wall, knees bent about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A crunch with your legs against a wall that keeps your hips steady and works the abs.

name: 双杠平板撑臂屈伸
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Lean forward and shift your weight over your hands.
Bend your elbows to lower your body under control.
Keep your core tight and elbows close.
Press back up to straight arms.
description: Dip with a leaning body angle that loads the shoulders and triceps hard.

name: 绳索站姿中立握飞鸟
instructions: Set the pulleys at chest height and grab the handles.
Step forward with a staggered stance and a slight elbow bend.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs for a moment.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.
description: Standing cable fly with palms facing each other to squeeze the chest.

name: 过头仰卧起坐(双腿放凳上)
english: overhead sit up with legs on bench
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Extend your arms overhead.
Curl your torso up, keeping your arms by your ears.
Reach toward your knees.
Lower slowly.
description: Sit-up with arms overhead and calves on a bench for a longer lever on the abs.

name: 错位腿臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, one foot forward of the other.
Press through both heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your hips level.
Lower slowly.
Switch the foot position halfway through.
description: A glute bridge with one foot placed forward to shift more load to one side.

name: 直腿臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your heels on the floor.
Press your heels down and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your ribs down.
Lower slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A bridge with straight legs that shifts more work to the hamstrings and glutes.

name: 哑铃站姿前平举与侧平举
english: dumbbell standing front and lateral raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise both arms to the front up to shoulder height.
Lower them back down.
Raise them out to your sides to shoulder height.
Lower with control and repeat.
description: Combined raise that hits the front and side delts in one rep.

name: 单腿侧向跳
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways a short distance.
Land softly on the same foot and hold your balance.
Hop back the other way.
Complete reps, then switch legs.
description: One-legged sideways hop that builds power and ankle stability.

name: 蜘蛛登山者
instructions: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward the outside of your elbow.
Return that foot and switch legs.
Keep your hips low and your core braced.
Move at a quick, controlled pace.
description: Mountain climber where each knee drives toward the same-side elbow, adding side work for the core.

name: 哑铃高脚杯深蹲加提踵
english: dumbbell goblet squat with calf raise
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up to standing.
Rise onto your toes at the top.
Lower your heels and go into the next squat.
description: Goblet squat finished with a calf raise as you stand.

name: 双平板开合跳接四次登山者
english: double plank jack to 4 mountain climber
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Jump your feet wide and together twice.
Do four mountain climbers, driving your knees alternately.
Keep your hips level.
Flow through the sequence at a steady pace.
description: Conditioning combo of two plank jacks followed by four mountain climbers.

name: 吊环射箭式引体向上
instructions: Hang from rings with a wide grip.
Pull up toward one hand, leaving the other arm straight.
Reach the top with your chin by that hand.
Lower under control.
Alternate sides each rep.
description: Pull-up on rings where you pull toward one hand with the other arm extended.

name: 吊环单臂引体向上
instructions: Hang from one ring with a firm grip.
Brace your core and keep your legs together.
Pull your chin up toward the ring.
Lower with control to a full hang.
Complete reps, then switch arms.
description: Advanced single-arm pull on a ring that demands serious back and arm strength.

name: 仰卧地面滑行
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms in a goalpost position.
Keep your back and wrists on the floor.
Slide your arms up overhead.
Return slowly to the start.
Move within your comfortable range.
description: Floor slide that improves shoulder mobility and activates the upper back.

name: 前后跳
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Hop forward a short distance on the balls of your feet.
Hop back to the start.
Land softly with your knees slightly bent.
Keep a quick tempo.
Repeat for the planned time.
description: A light hop forward and back that builds ankle spring and coordination.

name: 哑铃高脚杯相扑深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes out, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down between your legs.
Keep your knees pointing over your toes.
Drive up and squeeze your glutes.
description: Wide-stance goblet squat that targets the glutes and inner thighs.

name: 壶铃摆动接高脚杯深蹲
instructions: Swing the kettlebell up to chest height from a hip hinge.
Catch it at your chest in a goblet hold.
Sit into a deep squat.
Stand up and lower the bell back between your legs.
Hinge and swing again.
description: Kettlebell swing flowing into a goblet squat for hips, legs and grip.

name: 哑铃高脚杯保加利亚分腿蹲
instructions: Place your rear foot on a bench and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step the front foot forward.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Push through the front heel and switch legs after your reps.
description: Rear-foot elevated split squat with a dumbbell held at the chest.

name: 哑铃垫高保加利亚分腿蹲
english: dumbbell bulgarian split squat from deficit
instructions: Stand with your front foot on a low platform and your rear foot on a bench.
Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lower until your back knee is near the floor.
Keep your front knee steady.
Drive up and switch legs.
description: Rear-foot elevated split squat with the front foot raised for greater depth.

name: 徒手脚跟垫高保加利亚分腿蹲
english: bodyweight heel elevated bulgarian split squat
instructions: Place your rear foot on a bench and front heel on a small plate.
Hold your hands at your chest.
Lower straight down.
Keep your front knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.
description: Split squat with the front heel raised, loading the quads more directly.

name: 杠铃泽奇保加利亚分腿蹲
instructions: Rest the barbell in the crooks of your elbows.
Put your rear foot on a bench.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your chest up.
Drive up and switch legs.
description: Rear-foot elevated split squat with the barbell in your elbow crooks.

name: 门框胸部拉伸
instructions: Stand in a doorway with forearms on the frame, elbows at 90 degrees.
Step one foot forward.
Lean gently through the door until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly and step back.
description: Doorway stretch that opens up the chest and the fronts of your shoulders.

name: 平行杠屈膝反向划船
english: parallel bars bent knee inverted row
instructions: Lie under parallel bars and grab them.
Bend your knees with feet on the floor.
Keep your body straight from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest to the bars.
Lower slowly.
description: Easier bodyweight row under parallel bars with knees bent.

name: 开合跳高抬腿
instructions: Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out and raise your arms overhead.
Jump back in and bring one knee high.
Alternate knees each rep.
Stay light on your feet.
description: Jumping jack paired with a high knee for a lively cardio drill.

name: 深蹲开合跳
instructions: Start in a squat with hands at your chest.
Jump your feet out wide.
Hop back to the narrow squat stance.
Stay low the whole time.
Land softly and keep your chest up.
description: Jumping jack variation that stays in a squat for a leg-burning cardio move.

name: 靠墙静蹲(窄站距)
instructions: Lean your back on a wall with feet close together.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep knees over ankles.
Hold for 20-60 seconds.
Slide back up slowly.
description: Wall sit with feet close together to focus on the quads.

name: 垫高靠墙静蹲
instructions: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your back on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your back flat.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Slide up carefully.
description: Wall sit with heels raised for a tougher quad hold.

name: 哑铃高脚杯靠墙静蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and lean on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your knees above your ankles.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Stand up slowly.
description: Wall sit holding a dumbbell at the chest for extra load.

name: 徒手单腿深蹲
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other lifted in front.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower down with control.
Keep your knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.
description: Squat on one leg, building strength and balance.

name: 徒手单腿深蹲(带支撑)
english: bodyweight single leg squat with support
instructions: Hold a stable support with one hand.
Stand on one leg with the other lifted.
Lower down as far as you can with control.
Use the support only as much as needed.
Push up and switch legs.
description: Supported single leg squat that helps you progress toward the full version.

name: 坐姿股四头肌拉伸 v. 2
instructions: Sit sideways on a bench or chair edge.
Bend one knee, tucking your foot behind you.
Hold your ankle and gently pull it toward your glutes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.
description: Seated stretch for the front of your thigh.

name: 壶铃摆动高翻握法前蹲
english: kettlebell swing clean grip front squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
Keep your back flat throughout.
description: A combo that swings the kettlebell into a clean grip and finishes with a front squat for legs and hips.

name: 绳索分腿站姿单臂划船
english: cable split stance single arm row
instructions: Stand in a split stance facing a low cable.
Grab the handle with one hand.
Row to your hip, squeezing the shoulder blade.
Keep your torso steady.
Return slowly and switch sides.
description: Single-arm cable row in a split stance for stable pulling.

name: 杠铃屈臂上拉 v. 2
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a barbell above your chest.
Keep a slight elbow bend.
Lower the bar behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your ribs down.
description: Pullover with slightly bent arms using a barbell for lats and chest.

name: 哑铃哈克深蹲
instructions: Hold dumbbells behind you with your heels slightly raised.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down.
Stay tall.
Drive up through your feet.
description: Hack squat with dumbbells held behind the legs.

name: 徒手脚跟垫高深蹲
instructions: Stand with your heels on a small plate.
Extend your arms in front.
Squat deep with your chest up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Stand back up.
description: Squat with heels raised to emphasize the quads.

name: 绳索V形把手前蹲
english: cable front squat with v bar
instructions: Hold a V bar at chest height.
Stand a step back from the cable.
Squat down with your elbows up.
Keep your chest tall.
Stand up.
description: Front squat holding a V bar on a low cable.

name: 壶铃对侧后撤弓步蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Step back with the opposite leg.
Lower until the back knee nears the floor.
Push through the front foot.
Finish reps and switch sides.
description: Reverse lunge with the kettlebell in the opposite hand to the working leg.

name: 壶铃同侧后撤弓步蹲
