instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Step back with the leg on the same side.
Lower under control.
Keep your torso upright.
Push back up and switch sides.
description: Reverse lunge with the kettlebell on the same side as the working leg.

name: 绳索中立握高位下拉
instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown station, thighs secured, and grab the neutral-grip handle.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arms are fully extended.
description: Pull a neutral-grip handle down to your upper chest on a cable stack. It builds the lats and the muscles between your shoulder blades.

name: 绳索跪姿高低位抗旋转劈砍
english: cable kneeling high low anti rotation chop
instructions: Kneel side-on to a high cable and hold the handle with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Chop the handle diagonally down across your body, arms mostly straight.
Do not let your torso rotate; the arms and shoulders do the travel.
Return slowly under control, finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A kneeling cable chop that moves from high to low while your torso resists twisting. It trains the deep core and obliques to stay stable.

name: 扭转转身上举
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and arms extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor.
Twist your torso and bring your knees toward one side.
Turn back through the centre and lift again.
Repeat to the other side, keeping the movement smooth and controlled.
description: A floor core move that combines a twist with a leg or torso lift. It works the abs and obliques through rotation.

name: 绳索同侧臀部主导上台阶
english: cable ipsilateral glute dominant step up
instructions: Stand in front of a box with a cable handle in the hand on your working side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Drive through the heel to stand up.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A step-up with a cable held on the same side as the working leg, leaning forward to bias the glutes.

name: 绳索单臂高位划船(胸部支撑)
english: cable single arm high row with chest support
instructions: Set a handle on a high pulley and lean your chest against the support.
Grab the handle with one hand and let your arm extend.
Pull your elbow back and down toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end of the pull.
Return slowly to full extension, finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm cable row from a high pulley while your chest rests on a pad. The support lets you focus on the upper back without cheating.

name: 负重前平举保持
instructions: Stand tall holding a weight plate with both hands at your thighs.
Raise it straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Keep your arms nearly straight and your ribs down.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, for 20-40 seconds.
Lower the plate slowly with control.
description: Hold a weight plate out in front of you at shoulder height. It builds endurance in the front delts.

name: 绳索跪姿臀部后踢
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and kneel on hands and knees facing it.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Kick the cuffed leg back and up.
Squeeze at the top.
Return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A kneeling cable kickback that isolates the glutes.

name: 哑铃臀部主导保加利亚分腿蹲
english: dumbbell glute dominant bulgarian split squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your back foot on a bench.
Step the front foot out far enough for your shin to stay near vertical.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the thigh is parallel.
Drive through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat with a forward lean, loading the glutes.

name: 绳索仰卧面拉
instructions: Lie on your back with the cable set low behind your head and hold the rope ends.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring out and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
description: A face pull performed lying on your back with a cable. It hits the rear delts and upper back with little help from momentum.

name: 绳索上斜后三角肌飞鸟(背部支撑)
english: cable incline rear delt fly with back support
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench between two cable stations.
Grab the opposite handles, arms hanging with a slight bend.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder level.
Pause and squeeze your rear delts.
Lower slowly without swinging.
description: A rear delt fly with cables while your chest rests on an incline bench. It isolates the back of the shoulders.

name: 雪橇臀部主导腿举
instructions: Sit in the sled and place your feet high and wide on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the sled until your knees reach about 90 degrees.
Keep your lower back pressed into the seat.
Push through your heels to extend your legs without locking the knees.
Lower under control for each rep.
description: A sled leg press with a foot position that puts more load on the glutes. It also works the quads and hamstrings.

name: 绳索高位划船(胸部支撑)
english: cable high row with chest support
instructions: Set the cable high and lean your chest against the support pad.
Grab the handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back and slightly down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let your arms extend slowly to the start.
description: A two-handed cable row from a high pulley with your chest braced on a pad. It trains the upper back and rear shoulders.

name: 哑铃对侧臀部主导保加利亚分腿蹲
english: dumbbell contralateral glute dominant bulgarian split squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell in the hand opposite your front leg.
Put your back foot on a bench and step the front foot forward.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the front thigh is parallel.
Drive up through the front heel.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A Bulgarian split squat with one dumbbell held in the opposite hand to the front leg.

name: 开合跳波比 v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor and push up, or skip the push-up if you prefer.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Jump up, spreading your arms and legs like a jumping jack, then repeat.
description: A burpee that finishes with a jumping jack. It raises your heart rate and works the whole body.

name: 杠铃弹力带卧推
instructions: Set bands on the bar and lie on a flat bench with your feet planted.
Unrack the bar over your chest with a firm grip.
Lower it to your mid chest under control.
Press up and out until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet down.
description: A bench press with bands attached to the bar, so resistance rises toward lockout. It builds pressing power across the chest and triceps.

name: 杠铃固定销卧推常规握法
english: barbell pin bench press conventional grip
instructions: Set the pins at a height just above your chest and lie on the bench.
Grab the bar at about shoulder-width plus a little.
Pause the bar on the pins to remove momentum.
Press the bar straight up until your arms lock out.
Lower back to the pins with control and reset for each rep.
description: A bench press started from a dead stop on safety pins, using a standard grip. It builds strength off the chest without any bounce.

name: 靠墙仰卧单腿腘绳肌拉伸
english: lying single leg hamstring stretch against wall
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest one heel on the wall with your leg as straight as feels comfortable.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Relax and breathe, letting the hamstring lengthen.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
description: Lie by a wall and rest one leg up against it to stretch the hamstring. Easy to relax into and good after leg days.

name: 靠墙单臂背阔肌拉伸
english: single arm lat stretch against wall
instructions: Stand beside a wall and place one hand on it above head height.
Step your feet back slightly.
Press your hips away and lean your chest down toward the floor.
Feel the stretch along your side and under the armpit.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
description: Stretch one side of your back by reaching an arm overhead against a wall. It lengthens the lat and side of the torso.

name: 飞蜥式瑜伽体式
english: flying lizard yoga pose utthan pristhasana
instructions: Start in a low lunge with your front foot between your hands.
Lower your forearms to the floor or blocks.
Drop your back knee or keep it lifted.
Let your hips sink.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Step back and switch sides.
description: A deep lunge-based hip opener with a twist and reach, stretching the hips and inner thighs.

name: 哑铃俯身弯举
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders, elbows fixed.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
description: A biceps curl performed while hinged forward at the hips. The position removes swing and keeps tension on the biceps.

name: 地雷管深蹲
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
description: A squat holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest. The angled bar helps you stay upright and load the legs.

name: 地雷管过头后撤弓步蹲
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your shoulder.
Step one foot back into a lunge.
As you rise, press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulder while you lunge back again.
Complete your reps and switch legs.
description: A reverse lunge while pressing a landmine bar overhead. It trains the legs, glutes and shoulders together.

name: 哑铃同侧单腿直腿硬拉
english: dumbbell ipsilateral single leg stiff leg deadlift
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in the hand on the same side as your standing leg.
Shift your weight to that leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach the weight toward the floor.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing your glute.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A one-leg deadlift holding the dumbbell on the same side as the standing leg, for hamstrings and balance.

name: 坐姿交替膝触肘扭转
english: sitting alternate knee to elbow twist
instructions: Sit tall on the floor, leaning back slightly with your hands behind your head.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
description: From a seated position, twist to bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.

name: 绳索半跪面拉
instructions: Set a rope at head height and half kneel facing the stack.
Hold the rope ends with your palms facing in.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly. Switch the leading knee after your set.
description: A face pull from a half-kneeling stance. The stable position keeps the focus on your rear delts and upper back.

name: 绳索站姿旋后面拉(绳索)
english: cable standing supinated face pull (with rope)
instructions: Set the rope at face height and grip it with your palms facing up.
Step back and stand tall.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows leading.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
description: A standing face pull using a rope with an underhand grip. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back, and is gentle on the wrists.

name: 站姿旋后面拉(毛巾)
instructions: Loop a towel around a sturdy anchor and hold both ends, palms up.
Lean back with your arms extended.
Pull your hands toward your face, elbows wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly. Walk your feet in to make it harder.
description: A face pull using a towel looped around a fixed anchor and an underhand grip. A simple way to train the rear delts without a cable.

name: 北欧腘绳肌弯举
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your ankles held down firmly.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands at the bottom.
Push back up and repeat.
description: Kneel with your feet anchored and lower your body forward slowly. It is a demanding hamstring strengthener.

name: 哑铃俯卧W字上举
instructions: Lie face down on a bench or the floor with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Lift your arms out and up into a W shape.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: Lying face down, you raise light dumbbells while bending the elbows into a W shape. It works the rear delts and the upper back.

name: 壶铃摆动高翻握法前蹲 v. 2
english: kettlebell swing clean grip front squat v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
Keep your back flat throughout.
description: A combo that swings the kettlebell into a clean grip and finishes with a front squat for legs and hips.

name: 死虫式 v. 3
instructions: Lie on your back with arms straight above you and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides with a slow tempo.
Keep your ribs down.
description: A back-lying core drill that moves opposite arms and legs while keeping the lower back flat.

name: 反向空中蹬车
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your hips slightly with hands under your glutes.
Raise your legs.
Pedal backward in a smooth circle.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set time or reps.
description: Lie on your back with your hips raised, pedalling the legs in a backward motion. It targets the lower abs.

name: 侧平板扭转手臂三角肌上举
english: side plank twist arm delt raise
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm.
Raise your top arm up toward the ceiling.
Rotate and thread your arm under your torso.
Open back up and raise the arm again.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side plank with a twist that ends in an arm raise. It challenges your obliques and shoulders.

name: 爆发式动态平板支撑
instructions: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Move quickly, hopping or shifting your hands and feet.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Rest when your form slips.
description: A plank with fast, powerful movements from the hands or feet. It builds core strength and shoulder stability.

name: 杠杆式过头三头肌伸展
instructions: Adjust the seat and sit with your back supported.
Grip the handles overhead with your elbows pointing up.
Extend your arms until they are almost straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly behind your head.
description: A machine overhead triceps extension. The lever path keeps the movement smooth and the focus on the triceps.

name: 哑铃上斜三头肌臂后屈伸
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Pin your upper arms to your sides.
Straighten your elbows to kick the weights back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly.
Keep your upper arms still.
description: A chest-supported kickback on an incline bench that isolates the triceps.

name: 哑铃跪姿三头肌臂后屈伸
instructions: Kneel beside a bench with one hand and the same-side knee on it.
Hold a dumbbell in the free hand with your upper arm against your side.
Extend your elbow to kick the weight back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A kickback done in a kneeling position, with one hand on a bench for support.

name: 杠铃片推
instructions: Stand with a weight plate held at your chest, elbows bent.
Brace your abs and bend your knees slightly.
Push the plate out explosively with both arms.
Fully extend your arms.
Pull the plate back to your chest with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: An explosive push of a weight plate out from your chest for upper-body power.

name: 地雷管硬拉
instructions: Load one end of the barbell in a landmine and stand facing it, feet hip-width.
Hinge back and grip the bar end with both hands.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Lower the bar under control.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A deadlift with the end of a landmine bar, easier on the back and good for hips and hamstrings.

name: 杠杆式毛巾俯卧撑
instructions: Place your hands on towels on the floor in a plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A push-up with your hands on towels, adding instability for the chest and shoulders.

name: 哑铃坐姿三头肌伸展 v. 2
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back up.
Keep your core tight.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: A seated overhead extension with a dumbbell that builds the triceps.

name: 跪姿躯干旋转后飞鸟穿线
english: kneeling rotation torso rear fly to thread through
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your torso open, elbow to the ceiling.
Return and thread that arm under your chest.
Let your shoulder reach toward the floor.
Keep your hips still.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
description: A kneeling thoracic mobility move combining a rear fly and a thread-the-needle reach.

name: 绳索坐姿单侧二头弯举
instructions: Sit facing a low cable and hold the handle with one hand.
Rest your elbow near your side.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your set.
description: A seated biceps curl with a cable, working one arm at a time. It gives constant tension throughout the movement.

name: 绳索坐姿单臂单侧二头弯举
english: cable seated single arm unilateral bicep curl
instructions: Sit upright with a low cable handle in one hand.
Keep your elbow tucked in.
Curl up toward your shoulder without leaning back.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower under control, then switch arms.
description: A seated one-arm cable curl that keeps tension on the biceps. Good for fixing strength gaps between arms.

name: 哑铃臀桥推胸
instructions: Lie on your back holding dumbbells at chest level, knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower with control while holding your hips high.
Finish your reps, then lower your hips.
description: A dumbbell chest press done lying in a glute bridge. It works the chest and triceps while the glutes hold your hips up.

name: 哑铃俯身Y字上举
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Raise both arms forward and up at about 45 degrees to form a Y.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower the weights slowly under control.
Keep your neck long and avoid swinging your torso.
description: Hinge forward and raise light dumbbells out and up into a Y shape. It trains the shoulders and the muscles between the shoulder blades.

name: 弹力带45度髋伸展(臀部专注)
english: resistance band 45 degree hip extension glute focused
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree hip extension bench with the band anchored under your feet and held across your upper back.
Cross your arms or hold the band at your shoulders.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to come back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Do not over-arch your lower back at the top.
description: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench with a band added for extra glute load. It builds the glutes and the back of the thighs.

name: 弹力带宽站距抗旋转劈砍
english: resistance band wide stance anti rotation chop
instructions: Anchor the band at one side and stand sideways with your feet wide.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Brace your core.
Press or chop diagonally while keeping your torso square.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.
description: A band chop in a wide stance where you resist twisting. It strengthens the abs and obliques.

name: 壶铃伐木
instructions: Hold a kettlebell with both hands and stand with your feet wide.
Start with it high beside one shoulder.
Rotate and chop down to the opposite knee.
Pivot your back foot as you turn.
Return with control and switch sides.
description: A rotational chop holding a kettlebell from high to low across the body. It trains the obliques and builds rotational power.

name: 跪姿胸椎旋转
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your upper body and point that elbow toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes and keep your hips square.
Return and touch the elbow toward the opposite arm.
Do your reps, then switch sides.
description: A kneeling rotation that opens up the mid back. Good for loosening your upper spine before training or after sitting.

name: 哑铃单腿髋推 v. 2
english: dumbbell single leg hip thrust v. 2
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-leg hip thrust with a dumbbell across your hips. It hits the glutes hard and shows up strength imbalances.

name: 杠铃片俯卧撑
instructions: Have a partner place a plate on your upper back, or set it carefully yourself.
Get into a high plank.
Lower your chest to the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.
description: A push-up with a weight plate on your upper back. The added load makes it harder once regular push-ups feel easy.

name: 绳索直腿对角后踢
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable pulley and strap it to one ankle.
Face the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Keep your leg straight and kick it back and slightly out to the side.
Squeeze your glute at the top without leaning forward.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A standing cable kickback with a straight leg, driven back and slightly out to the side. It isolates the glutes.

name: 二头肌腿部集中弯举(离心)
instructions: Sit with your legs apart and hold a weight in one hand.
Rest the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh.
Curl the weight up with help from your other hand if needed.
Lower it very slowly over about 3 to 4 seconds.
Keep your upper arm still against your leg.
Do your reps, then switch arms.
description: A seated concentration curl braced against the thigh with a slow lowering phase. It emphasises the biceps through the negative.

name: 弹力带站姿平衡髋外展
english: resistance band standing balance hip abduction
instructions: Put a band around your ankles and stand on one leg.
Hold something for balance if needed.
Lift the free leg out to the side.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower slowly and switch legs after your set.
description: A standing hip abduction with a band that also challenges your balance. It targets the outer hips.

name: 移动婴儿式
instructions: Start on all fours with your knees slightly wider than your hips.
Sit your hips back toward your heels and reach your arms forward.
Let your chest sink toward the floor.
Rock forward and back slowly, then walk your hands to each side.
Breathe deeply and relax your neck.
Move gently for 30 to 60 seconds.
description: A flowing version of child's pose that rocks the body to stretch the back, hips and shoulders.

name: 绳索站姿交叉夹胸
instructions: Set the pulleys at a high position and grab a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a slight lean.
Bring your hands together in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest as your hands cross.
Return slowly to a stretch.
description: A standing cable fly where your hands cross in front of the chest. It focuses on squeezing the pecs.

name: 弹力带仰卧腿举
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a band around your feet, holding the ends.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Press your feet away until your legs are almost straight.
Control the band as it pulls you back.
Repeat for your reps.
description: A leg press performed lying on your back using a band around your feet. It works the quads and glutes.

name: 高双杠三头肌臂屈伸
english: triceps dip on high parallel bars
instructions: Grip the bars and lift yourself with straight arms.
Keep your body upright and elbows close.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.
description: A dip on high parallel bars with an upright torso. It builds the triceps and chest.

name: 仰卧盆底放松与深呼吸
english: lying pelvic floor relaxation and deep breathing
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Rest your hands on your lower belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose and let your belly rise.
Let your pelvic floor and hips soften as you inhale.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes at a relaxed pace.
description: A gentle lying breathing drill that lets the pelvic floor and belly relax. It helps you learn calm, deep breathing.

name: 深弓步接腘绳肌拉伸
instructions: Step into a deep lunge with both hands on the floor.
Hold for a breath and feel the front of the back hip open.
Shift your hips back and straighten the front leg.
Flex your front foot and fold gently over it.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Return to the lunge and switch legs.
description: A flowing stretch from a deep lunge into a straight front leg. It opens the hip flexors and stretches the hamstrings.

name: 站姿踝关节画圈 v. 2
instructions: Stand tall and hold a wall or chair for balance.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Draw slow circles with your toes.
Do about 10 circles in one direction.
Switch to the other direction.
Change feet and repeat.
description: A standing mobility drill that rotates the ankle through its full range. It warms up the ankle joints.

name: 宽握反手引体向上
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip wider than shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull until your chin is over the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
description: A chin-up with a wider underhand grip. It hits the lats and biceps.

name: 绳索站姿屈髋
instructions: Attach an ankle strap and face away from a low cable.
Hold a support for balance.
Lift your knee in front of you.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly. Switch legs after your set.
description: A standing leg raise to the front against cable resistance. It trains the hip flexors and front thigh.

name: 哑铃相扑硬拉
instructions: Stand with a wide stance, toes turned out, and a dumbbell between your feet.
Hinge down and grab it with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the weight under control.
description: A deadlift with a wide stance holding a dumbbell between your legs. It works the glutes, inner thighs and back.

name: 绳索反向伐木
instructions: Set the cable low and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Pull it diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and rotate your torso.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.
description: A cable chop that travels from low to high across your body. It trains the obliques and builds rotational power.

name: 仰卧屈膝抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Draw your knees up toward your chest.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without arching.
description: From lying on your back, you draw your knees toward your chest. It works the lower abs.

name: 椅上坐姿侧弯
english: sitting side bend on a chair
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Place one hand behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the floor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
Repeat on the other side.
description: A gentle seated side bend that works the obliques and loosens the sides. Easy to do at a desk.

name: 椅上坐姿游泳式
instructions: Sit upright near the edge of a chair.
Lean forward slightly with a flat back.
Reach one arm forward and the other back, then alternate.
Move in a steady rhythm.
Keep your core braced.
description: A seated move where your arms alternate in a swimming motion. A gentle shoulder warm-up for any time.

name: 椅上坐姿伐木
instructions: Sit tall on a chair and clasp your hands together.
Raise your arms diagonally up to one side.
Chop down across your body to the opposite knee.
Rotate through your torso.
Alternate sides at an easy pace.
description: A seated woodchop with the hands clasped. It works the obliques with no equipment.

name: 椅上坐姿祈祷式夹胸
english: sitting prayer chest squeeze on a chair
instructions: Sit tall on a chair.
Bring your palms together in front of your chest.
Press your palms firmly into each other.
Hold for 10-15 seconds.
Release and repeat.
description: Seated, you press your palms together in front of your chest. It trains the chest with no equipment.

name: 椅上坐姿交替外展扭转
english: sitting alternate abduction twist on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the edge of a chair.
Lift one leg and open it out to the side.
Twist your torso toward that leg.
Return to centre.
Alternate sides.
description: A seated move combining a leg out to the side with a twist. It gently works the hips and waist.

name: 椅上坐姿俄罗斯转体
english: sitting russian twist on a chair
instructions: Sit near the edge of a chair and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest tall.
description: A Russian twist done seated on a chair. It works the obliques with low impact.

name: 深屈膝
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down as deep as you can.
Keep your heels down and chest up.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up to standing.
description: A full-depth bodyweight squat. It builds leg strength and works the mobility of hips and ankles.

name: 哑铃侧平举平板支撑
instructions: Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells.
Brace your core and widen your feet.
Lift one dumbbell out to the side.
Avoid twisting your hips.
Lower and alternate arms.
description: In a plank, you raise a dumbbell out to the side. It challenges the core and shoulders together.

name: 哑铃反握反式划船
instructions: Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells, palms facing forward.
Widen your feet for balance.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.
description: A renegade row with an underhand grip on the dumbbells. It builds core stability and works the lats and biceps.

name: 哑铃稳定球反式划船
english: dumbbell renegade row on stability ball
instructions: Place your feet on a stability ball and your hands on dumbbells.
Brace into a strong plank.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.
description: A renegade row with your feet on a stability ball. The unstable base makes the core work harder.

name: 弹力带反式划船
instructions: Anchor a band and get into a plank facing it.
Hold the band in one hand.
Row your elbow back to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Return slowly and alternate arms.
description: A renegade row using a resistance band. It trains the core while the lats and back do the pulling.

name: 哑铃反式划船行走
instructions: Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand.
Row one dumbbell up.
Place it down and step the hands forward.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your hips level.
description: A renegade row combined with walking forward in plank. It is a demanding move for core and shoulder stability.

name: 桌下二头弯举
instructions: Lie under a strong table and grip its edge with an underhand grip.
Keep your body straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the table by bending the elbows.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly.
description: Lie under a sturdy table and curl your body up by gripping the edge. A bodyweight biceps exercise.

name: 侧卧胸部拉伸
instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and arms in front of you.
Lift your top arm and open it back like a book.
Let your chest rotate open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return and switch sides.
description: Lying on your side, you open one arm backward to stretch the chest. It loosens tight pecs.

name: 绳索直臂下拉(绳索把手)
english: cable straight arm pulldown (with rope attachment)
instructions: Set a rope on a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hinge forward slightly with arms extended.
Pull the rope down to your thighs.
Spread the rope at the bottom.
Return slowly.
description: A straight-arm pulldown using a rope. It isolates the lats with no help from the arms.

name: 绳索半跪单臂划船 v. 2
english: cable half kneeling single arm row v. 2
instructions: Half kneel facing the cable with the handle in one hand.
Keep your torso tall.
Row your elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.
description: A one-arm cable row from a half-kneeling stance. It works the lats and challenges your core stability.

name: 椅上坐姿直立扭转
english: seated upright twists on a chair
instructions: Sit tall with feet flat and arms crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Pause briefly.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your hips still.
description: A seated trunk twist done tall on a chair. It loosens the spine and works the obliques gently.

name: 椅上坐姿侧弯
english: seated side bend on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one arm overhead and lean slowly to the opposite side without twisting.
Pause briefly, then return to upright.
Repeat on the other side and keep alternating.
description: A gentle seated side bend that works the obliques and loosens the sides of the trunk.

name: 弹力带拖曳弯举
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hold the handles at your thighs.
Keep your chest up and core braced.
Curl by dragging your hands up your body while the elbows move behind you.
Squeeze at the top for a moment.
Lower under control until your arms are straight.
description: A curl variation where the elbows travel back as you pull, putting the biceps under steady band tension.

name: 壶铃半跪绕头环绕
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold the kettlebell upside down at chest height.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.
Circle the bell around your head slowly, keeping it close.
Complete the reps, then reverse the direction.
Switch the kneeling leg and repeat.
description: A kettlebell circle around the head from a half kneeling stance that mobilises the shoulders and challenges core stability.

name: 徒手站姿肩胛外旋
instructions: Stand tall with your elbows bent at your sides.
Keep your palms facing forward.
Rotate your forearms outward and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.
description: A standing drill that rotates the arms outward while drawing the shoulder blades back. It wakes up the rotator cuff and upper back.

name: 徒手站姿胸椎推举
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Press your arms up and slightly back while lifting your chest.
Extend through your upper back without flaring your ribs.
Return to the start under control.
Repeat for smooth, slow reps.
description: A standing movement that presses the arms overhead to open up the thoracic spine. It improves upper back extension.

name: 腘绳肌臂桥
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels placed a bit farther from your hips.
Press your heels into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A bridge with the heels placed farther away so the hamstrings and glutes do more of the lifting.

name: 弹力带站姿肩内旋
english: resistance band standing shoulder internal rotation
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm across your belly, keeping the elbow fixed.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: A light band drill that strengthens the internal rotators of the shoulder, handy for joint health.

name: 弹力带站姿肩外旋
english: resistance band standing shoulder external rotation
instructions: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the elbow tucked at your side, bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your belly, keeping the elbow fixed.
Pause, then return slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.
description: A band drill that strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles on the back of the shoulder.

name: 弹力带站姿单臂侧平举
english: resistance band standing single arm lateral raise
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the handle in one hand at your side.
Keep a slight bend in the elbow and your torso still.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the band.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm side raise using band tension to train the middle part of the shoulder.

name: 弹力带站姿90度肩外旋
english: resistance band standing 90 degrees shoulder external rotation
instructions: Anchor the band at shoulder height and hold the handle with your elbow raised to shoulder level, bent 90 degrees.
Keep the upper arm still.
Rotate your hand up and back until the forearm points to the ceiling.
Return slowly to the start.
Do all reps, then switch arms.
description: A band rotation with the upper arm raised to shoulder height, building rotator cuff strength for overhead positions.

name: 弹力带过头肩部推举 v. 2
english: resistance band overhead shoulder press v. 2
instructions: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep ribs down.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders under control.
Repeat without leaning back.
description: An overhead press with a band, training the shoulders and triceps with tension that rises toward the top.

name: 弹力带过头穿越
instructions: Hold the band in front of your thighs with a wide grip and straight arms.
Stand tall.
Raise the band overhead and keep going back behind your body.
Reverse the path to return to the front.
Widen your grip if it feels too tight.
description: A band stretch that moves overhead and behind you, opening up the shoulders and chest.

name: 壶铃侧摆 v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold a kettlebell with both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and swing it up and across to one side.
Let it fall back through your legs and swing to the other side.
Keep your back flat throughout.
description: A swing performed to the side of the body that hits the obliques and hips while the legs drive the kettlebell.

name: 坐姿过头直臂拉伸
english: seated over head straight arm stretch
instructions: Sit tall on a chair or bench.
Interlace your fingers and straighten your arms.
Raise them overhead with palms facing up.
Lift your chest and reach slightly back.
Breathe normally and hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Release slowly.
description: A seated overhead reach that stretches the chest and shoulders. It helps open up the upper body after desk time.

name: 壶铃负重俄罗斯转体
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a kettlebell with both hands at your chest.
Keep your back straight and rotate your torso to one side.
Touch the kettlebell lightly near the floor.
Rotate to the other side in a controlled way.
Keep your feet down or lifted if you can stay stable.
description: A seated twist holding a kettlebell. It builds the obliques and trunk rotation strength.

name: 深蹲跨步
instructions: Stand with your feet together.
Squat down by pushing your hips back.
Stand up while stepping one foot out to the side.
Bring that foot back in and squat again.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
description: A squat that steps one leg out to the side before returning. It works the legs and hips with a bit of lateral movement.

name: 杠杆式斜角腿举
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back flat on the pad and feet on the platform shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your whole foot until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees out.
description: A plate-loaded angled press that works the thighs and glutes with a stable seated position.

name: 侧向点地平板支撑
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and feet wide.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Reach one hand out to tap the floor at the side without twisting your hips.
Return it and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady and controlled.
description: A plank where you tap a hand to the floor at the side, challenging the obliques and anti-rotation control.

name: 椅上坐姿后仰
english: seated lean back on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lean back slowly while keeping your back straight.
Stop where you can still hold your form, then return to upright using your abs.
description: A seated lean back that wakes up the abs by holding the torso against gravity.

name: 椅上坐姿交叉出拳
english: seated cross body punch on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists to guard position.
Punch one arm across your body, rotating the trunk slightly.
Pull it back and punch with the other arm.
Keep a quick, smooth rhythm.
description: A seated punching drill that raises your heart rate and works the chest, shoulders and trunk.

name: 椅上坐姿过头拉伸
english: seated overhead stretch on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Interlace your fingers and raise your arms overhead.
Turn your palms to the ceiling and reach up tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
description: A simple seated stretch that opens up the sides of your back and shoulders.

name: 椅上坐姿前屈拉伸
english: seated forward bend stretch on a chair
instructions: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair and extend one leg with the heel on the floor.
Keep your back long.
Hinge forward from the hips and reach toward your toes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.
description: A seated forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and lower back.

name: 椅上坐姿前卷起
english: seated forward roll up on a chair
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your arms crossed or reaching forward.
Tuck your chin and round your lower back.
Roll your spine forward one segment at a time.
Reach toward your knees and pause.
Roll back up slowly to a tall position.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.
description: A seated roll-up that curls the spine forward one segment at a time. It trains the abs and spinal control.

name: 波速球平衡配重滑冰深蹲
english: bosu ball balance counterbalanced skater squat
instructions: Stand on one foot on the bosu ball and hold your arms in front for balance.
Reach the free leg back behind you.
Sit your hips back and lower into a single-leg squat.
Drive through the standing foot to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A single-leg squat on a bosu ball with the free leg reaching back for balance, challenging the legs and stability.

name: 哑铃跪姿对侧肩部推举
instructions: Kneel on one knee and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in the hand opposite the raised knee.
Keep your torso tall and glutes tight.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: A kneeling one-arm press where the opposite knee is down, adding core and hip stability to the shoulder work.

name: 哑铃跪姿扭转下上举
english: dumbbell kneeling twist down up raise
instructions: Kneel on both knees and hold one dumbbell with both hands beside one hip.
Keep your hips square.
Twist and lift the dumbbell diagonally up across your body.
Reverse the path back down to the hip.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: A diagonal chopping and lifting pattern from a kneeling position that trains the obliques and shoulders.

name: 跪姿到站姿深蹲
instructions: Kneel on both knees with your torso upright.
Step one foot forward and then the other so both feet are flat.
Press up to stand, then sit back into a squat.
Return to kneeling under control.
Alternate which foot steps first.
description: A flowing move from kneeling up into a squat, working the legs, glutes and balance.

name: 徒手靠墙提胫骨
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a bit in front of you.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes toward your shins as high as you can.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Keep the movement smooth and repeat.
description: A wall-supported toe raise that strengthens the muscles at the front of the shins.

name: 俯卧Y到T到W
english: lying prone y to t to w
instructions: Lie face down with your forehead near the floor and arms extended overhead in a Y.
Lift your arms slightly and hold.
Move them out to a T, then bend the elbows into a W.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Reverse the order and repeat.
description: A prone sequence of arm positions that strengthens the upper back and shoulder blade muscles.

name: 中背部夹肘
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your hands by your head or elbows bent in front.
Pull your elbows back and down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your neck relaxed.
description: A simple drill that squeezes the elbows back to engage the mid back. It trains the muscles between the shoulder blades.

name: 杠杆式坐姿腿弯举(插片式)
instructions: Sit in the machine and adjust the pad above your ankles.
Keep your back against the support.
Curl your heels down and back as far as you can.
Squeeze your hamstrings briefly.
Return slowly without letting the weight crash.
description: A plate-loaded seated curl that isolates the hamstrings.

name: 弹力带相扑深蹲
instructions: Stand on the band with feet wider than shoulders and toes angled out.
Hold the band at your chest or shoulders.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest up.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes.
description: A wide-stance squat with a band adding resistance to the glutes and inner thighs.

name: 中式平板支撑
instructions: Set up in a plank on your forearms with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your body in one straight line.
Breathe steadily and hold for 20-40 seconds.
Lower down to rest.
description: A plank variation held with a modified base that challenges core stability.

name: 弹力带坐姿足外翻
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and loop the band around the forefoot, anchored on the inside.
Keep your leg still.
Turn your foot outward against the band.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.
description: A seated ankle drill that works the muscles on the outside of the lower leg.

name: 弹力带坐姿足内翻
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and loop the band around the forefoot, anchored on the outside.
Keep your leg still.
Turn your foot inward against the band.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.
description: A seated ankle drill that works the muscles on the inside of the lower leg.

name: 哑铃牧师凳摆动弯举
instructions: Rest your upper arms on a preacher pad and hold dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Keep your shoulders down.
Curl the weights up with a small drive from the bottom.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
description: A preacher curl with a little controlled swing to push past the sticking point.

name: 绳索站姿单臂水平三头肌伸展
english: cable standing single arm horizontal triceps extension
instructions: Set the cable at chest height and stand facing away holding the handle by your shoulder.
Take a split stance for balance.
Extend your arm forward until it is straight.
Return slowly while keeping the elbow still.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm cable pushdown in a horizontal path, isolating the triceps.

name: 椅上坐姿交替动态胸部拉伸
english: seated alternate dynamic chest stretch on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Open one arm out to the side and rotate the trunk slightly.
Feel the stretch across your chest.
Return and switch arms in a smooth rhythm.
description: A seated dynamic stretch that opens the chest by alternating arms.

name: 椅上坐姿肘部夹胸飞鸟
english: seated elbow chest fly on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your elbows to chest height with forearms up.
Squeeze your elbows together in front of you.
Open them out again under control.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
description: A seated chest fly with bent elbows that squeezes the pecs by pressing the arms together.

name: 椅上坐姿外旋
english: seated external rotation on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Tuck your elbows at your sides bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearms outward, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly and repeat.
description: A seated rotation drill for the back of the shoulders and rotator cuff.

name: 椅上坐姿推胸
english: seated chest press on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Bring your hands to chest height and press your palms together.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Draw them back to your chest slowly.
description: A seated pressing motion done with bodyweight tension to work the chest and triceps.

name: 椅上坐姿手臂交叉
english: seated arm crossover on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Open your arms wide to the sides at shoulder height.
Sweep them together so they cross in front of your chest.
Open back out and alternate which arm is on top.
description: A seated arm crossover that works the chest and warms up the shoulders.

name: 椅上坐姿下斜推胸
english: seated decline chest press on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands at chest height.
Press them diagonally down and forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly to the chest and repeat.
description: A seated press angled downward to bias the lower chest.

name: 椅上坐姿蝴蝶机夹胸
english: seated pec dec on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your forearms in front of you with elbows bent at shoulder height.
Squeeze your forearms together.
Open them back to the sides under control.
description: A seated pec dec motion without a machine, squeezing the chest by bringing the forearms together.

name: 椅上坐姿上斜推胸
english: seated incline chest press on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Start with your hands near your chest.
Press them diagonally up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.
description: A seated press angled upward to emphasise the upper chest.

name: 椅上坐姿肩部推举
english: seated shoulder press on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your hands to shoulder height with elbows bent.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to your shoulders under control.
description: A seated overhead press without equipment that trains the shoulders and triceps.

name: 椅上坐姿旋转拳击滚动
english: seated rotating boxing rolls on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists in a boxing guard.
Roll your arms in circles while rotating your trunk side to side.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.
description: A seated drill of circular arm rolls and trunk rotation that lifts your heart rate.

name: 椅上坐姿点肩
english: seated shoulder tap on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one hand across to tap the opposite shoulder.
Return and tap with the other hand.
Keep the pace steady.
description: A seated drill where you tap each shoulder with the opposite hand, adding light coordination and shoulder work.

name: 椅上坐姿展开与下摆
english: seated open up and under swing on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Swing both arms open to the sides.
Rotate and sweep them under and across your body.
Open back out and alternate directions with a smooth rhythm.
description: A seated swing that opens the chest and then sweeps the arms underneath, warming up the trunk and shoulders.

name: 椅上坐姿过头三头肌伸展
english: seated overhead triceps extension on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your arms overhead and bend your elbows so your hands drop behind your head.
Extend your arms back up until straight.
Lower slowly and keep your elbows pointing forward.
description: A seated overhead extension that works the triceps using your own arm resistance.

name: 椅上坐姿反握手臂画圈
english: seated underhand arm circle on a chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Extend your arms out to the sides with palms facing up.
Draw small circles, then gradually bigger.
Reverse the direction after a set.
description: A seated arm circle with palms up to warm up the shoulder joints.

name: 雪橇侧向腿举
instructions: Position yourself on the sled in a side-facing posture with one foot on the platform.
Brace your core and keep your hips stable.
Push the platform away with the working leg.
Return slowly under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: A sideways leg press on a sled that targets the glutes and outer hips.

name: 绳索上斜Y字上举(背部支撑)
english: cable incline y raise with back support
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a cable handle in each hand.
Keep your neck neutral.
Raise your arms forward and up in a Y shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly with straight arms.
description: A Y-shaped raise with cables while supported on an incline bench, working the shoulders and upper back.

name: 绳索上斜窄握肩部推举(V形把手)
english: cable incline close grip shoulder press with v bar
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a cable and V bar anchored low behind you.
Hold the bar at chest height with a narrow grip.
Press upward until your arms are straight.
Lower back to the chest slowly.
Keep your back against the pad.
description: A close-grip incline cable press using a V bar that trains the shoulders and triceps.

name: 绳索上斜Y字上举腕带(背部支撑)
english: cable incline y raise wrist straps with back support
instructions: Fasten the wrist straps to the cables and lie chest-down on an incline bench.
Keep your neck neutral.
Raise your arms forward and up into a Y shape.
Squeeze your shoulders at the top.
Lower slowly.
description: A cable Y raise using wrist straps to reduce grip demand, supported on an incline bench.

name: 哑铃屈膝礼弓步蹲 v. 2
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and across behind the other leg.
Lower until the front thigh is nearly parallel to the floor.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs or finish one side before switching.
description: A lunge where one leg crosses behind you, working the glutes and outer hips with added load.

name: 负重包行走弓步蹲
instructions: Hold the bag at your chest or on your shoulders.
Stand tall.
Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward.
Continue, alternating legs.
description: A walking lunge carrying a weighted bag, building the legs, glutes and core.

name: 扭矩坦克推
instructions: Grip the handles of the tank and lean forward.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Drive with short, powerful steps.
Keep your hips low and push over the distance.
Rest and repeat.
description: A hard push of a torque tank sled across the floor that fires up the legs and the heart.

name: 战绳拉
instructions: Anchor the rope and hold the ends in a staggered stance.
Lean back slightly with your core tight.
Pull the rope toward you hand over hand.
Keep your chest tall and drive with your legs.
Return smoothly and repeat.
description: A rope pull that brings the rope toward you, working the back, arms and grip with a conditioning effect.

name: 波比跳上箱
instructions: Stand facing a box.
Drop into a squat, kick your feet back and lower into a push-up.
Jump your feet back in.
Explode up and jump onto the box.
Step down carefully and repeat.
description: A burpee that finishes with a jump onto a box, great for full-body conditioning.

name: 杠杆式罗马尼亚硬拉(插片式)
instructions: Stand in the machine and grip the handles with a flat back.
Keep a soft bend in your knees.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as you lower.
Stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
description: A hip hinge on a plate-loaded machine that trains the hamstrings and glutes.

name: 椅上坐姿交替伸膝
english: seated alternate knee extension on chair
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Straighten one knee by lifting the foot until the leg is level.
Squeeze your thigh, then lower slowly.
Switch legs and keep alternating.
description: A seated leg extension done by alternating legs, working the thighs without equipment.

name: 吊环上拉
instructions: Hang from the rings with an overhand grip.
Pull your hips up and bring your knees to your chest.
Rotate backward, pulling the body over the rings.
Lower under control.
Keep the movement smooth.
description: An advanced ring move that sweeps the body over the rings, working the lats and core.

name: 分腿蹲提踵
instructions: Stand in a split stance with one foot well forward.
Lower into a split squat with an upright torso.
Push up through your front foot to stand.
Rise onto the toes of your back foot or both feet.
Lower your heel and repeat.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A split squat with a heel raise added at the top. It works the quads, glutes and calves together.

name: 杠铃架上海豹划船
english: barbell lying seal row on rack
instructions: Lie face down on a raised bench so the bar hangs below you.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Row the bar up toward your chest by pulling elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
description: A chest-supported barbell row lying on a raised bench or rack, removing the lower back from the lift.

name: 杠杆式单腿硬拉(哈克深蹲机)
english: leverage single leg deadlift on hack squat machine
instructions: Step onto the machine platform and set your back against the pad.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Hinge at the hip and lower with control.
Drive through the standing foot to come back up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single leg deadlift performed on a hack squat machine. It trains the glutes and hamstrings with extra stability.

name: 史密斯错位站姿罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions: Stand under the smith bar with one foot slightly behind the other.
Grip the bar and unrack it.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and the bar close to your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Switch which foot is forward after your set.
description: A Romanian deadlift in a staggered stance on the smith machine. It focuses on the hamstrings and glutes of the front leg.

name: 杠杆式站姿侧平举
instructions: Stand in the machine with pads against your arms.
Keep your torso upright.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
description: A standing machine lateral raise that isolates the side shoulders.

name: 负重哑铃仰卧屈膝抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with a dumbbell secured between your feet.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your feet slowly without touching the floor.
Repeat for controlled reps.
description: A lying knee raise holding a dumbbell between your feet or legs, challenging the lower abs.

name: 弹力带快速踏步
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles.
Stand in a quarter squat.
Take quick small steps to the side.
Keep tension on the band and your chest up.
Move in both directions.
description: A quick lateral stepping drill with a band around the legs to speed up the feet and fire the glutes.

name: 绳索仰卧单腿屈髋
english: cable lying single leg hip flexion
instructions: Lie on your back with the ankle strap attached to the low cable and one foot in it.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Pull the knee up toward your chest with control.
Pause briefly, then lower the leg slowly against the cable.
Keep the other leg relaxed and your hips still.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
description: Lying on your back with a cable strapped to one ankle, you pull the knee toward your chest. It builds hip flexor strength.

name: 绳索仰卧屈髋(反向深蹲)
instructions: Lie on your back with the cable attached to both ankles or a strap around your feet.
Start with your legs extended and your core braced.
Pull your knees toward your chest in a smooth curl.
Pause at the top without lifting your head.
Lower your legs slowly until they are almost straight.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor throughout.
description: Lying on your back, you pull both knees toward your chest against cable resistance, like a squat in reverse. It works the hip flexors and lower abs.

name: 弹力带手指伸展
instructions: Loop a light band around your fingers and thumb of one hand.
Rest your forearm on a table or your thigh.
Start with the fingers curled in a relaxed fist.
Spread your fingers open against the band's pull.
Close them back slowly with control.
Do all reps, then switch hands.
description: Opening your fingers against a band strengthens the small extensor muscles of the hand and forearm. It is a good balance for all the gripping you do.

name: 绳索45度反向飞鸟
instructions: Set two cable handles at a low or mid height and grab them crossed over.
Hinge forward at the hips to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the handles out and back in a wide arc until your arms are in line with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades gently at the end.
Return slowly and keep your torso still.
description: Hinged forward at about 45 degrees, you pull the cable handles apart in a wide arc. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.

name: 绳索半跪外旋推举
english: cable half kneeling external rotation press
instructions: Kneel on one knee side-on to the cable with the handle at chest height.
Hold the handle near your shoulder with your elbow bent.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Rotate your forearm outward, then press the handle overhead.
Return along the same path with control.
Finish your reps and switch sides.
description: From a half kneeling stance you rotate the arm outward and press the cable overhead. It trains shoulder stability along with the press.

name: 绳索站姿直拳
instructions: Stand facing away from the cable with the handle at chest height in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and keep your core tight.
Punch the handle forward quickly, rotating your hips a little.
Stop just before your elbow locks out.
Return the hand with control to your chin.
Do all reps, then switch arms.
description: A quick punch thrown against cable resistance builds fast, explosive pushing power. It also trains the trunk to resist twisting.

name: 绳索前臂旋前
instructions: Sit beside a low cable and hold the handle with your forearm resting on your thigh.
Start with your palm facing up and your wrist neutral.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns down.
Pause, then rotate back slowly against the cable.
Keep your elbow still and move only the forearm.
Complete your reps and switch arms.
description: You rotate the forearm so the palm turns down against cable resistance. It strengthens the pronator muscles of the forearm.

name: 中立握腕力器
instructions: Hold the wrist roller with a neutral, thumbs-up grip and your arms out in front.
Let the weight hang from the rope with the rope unwound.
Roll the bar with your wrists to wind the rope up.
Keep your arms steady and your shoulders relaxed.
When the weight reaches the bar, lower it slowly by unwinding.
Stop if your forearms burn too much to keep control.
description: You wind a rope with a weight on it by turning a bar with a neutral grip. It builds forearm and grip endurance.

name: 负重包早安式体前屈
instructions: Place the weighted bag across your upper back and hold it in place.
Stand with your feet hip width and your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
Keep your neck neutral all the way.
description: Hinging forward with a weighted bag on your back trains the hamstrings, glutes and lower back. It teaches a strong hip hinge.

name: 壶铃错位站姿硬拉
instructions: Stand with one foot slightly behind the other.
Hold a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bell toward the floor.
Keep your back flat and weight mostly on the front foot.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Switch stances after your set.
description: A deadlift with a staggered stance holding a kettlebell. It loads one leg more than the other.

name: 屈膝收腿俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Return the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips level.
description: A push-up with a knee tuck toward the chest at the top. It combines upper body pressing with an ab crunch.

name: 45度背部伸展肩胛内收
instructions: Set up on the 45 degree bench with your hips on the pad and your feet locked in.
Cross your arms or hold them out wide.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back down slowly without rounding.
Do not overarch at the top.
description: On a 45 degree bench you lift your torso and pull your shoulder blades together. It works the lower back and upper back at once.

name: 俯身背部伸展肩胛内收
english: bent over back extension scapular adduction
instructions: Stand and hinge forward with a flat back and your arms hanging.
Keep your knees softly bent.
Raise your torso toward upright.
At the top, pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower back to the bent over position slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
description: From a bent over position you raise your torso and squeeze the shoulder blades together. It strengthens the whole back chain.

name: 绳索站姿Y字上举 v. 2
instructions: Stand facing the low cable with a handle in each hand or one handle at a time.
Start with your arms low and a slight bend in your elbows.
Lift your arms up and out to form a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and your ribs down.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Avoid shrugging toward your ears.
description: Raising the arms in a Y shape against cable tension works the lower traps and shoulders. It supports healthy overhead movement.

name: 绳索站姿直拳 v. 2
instructions: Stand facing away from the cable and hold the handle at chest height.
Step into a staggered stance and brace your core.
Punch forward fast and rotate your torso slightly.
Stop short of locking out your elbow.
Pull the hand back under control.
Repeat, then switch arms.
description: A second variation of the cable punch, built for quick power in the pushing muscles. Your trunk works to stay stable.

name: 绳索单臂侧平举 v. 2
english: cable single arm lateral raise v. 2
instructions: Stand side-on to the low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly against the cable.
Avoid leaning or swinging, then switch arms.
description: Lifting one arm out to the side against a cable keeps constant tension on the side delt. It builds shoulder width.

name: 左右跳 v. 2
instructions: Stand on two feet with your knees slightly bent.
Hop sideways to one side, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop back to the other side.
Keep your chest up and your hips low.
Use your arms for balance and rhythm.
Go for a set time or a set number of reps.
description: You hop from one side to the other over an imaginary line. It builds lateral agility, leg power and conditioning.

name: 坐姿单腿抬起
instructions: Sit tall on the edge of a bench with your hands beside you.
Extend one leg straight out in front.
Lift the leg a few inches higher while keeping the knee straight.
Pause and lower it slowly.
Keep your back straight and your core tight.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
description: Seated on a bench or floor, you lift one straight leg to train the hip flexors and thigh. It is a simple core and leg exercise.

name: 脚跟靠墙深蹲滑行
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet a little forward.
Press your heels into the floor.
Slide down the wall until your thighs are near parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to slide back up.
Keep your back in contact with the wall.
description: Sliding down a wall into a squat with your heels planted teaches good squat depth and control. It trains the quads and glutes.

name: 侧弓步拉伸 v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat or toes up.
Sit your hips back and feel the stretch on the inner thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Sinking into a wide side lunge stretches the inner thigh and groin. A good opener before lower body work.

name: 半跪侧弓步蹲
instructions: Start in a half kneeling position with one knee down and the other foot forward.
Turn your front foot out to the side.
Shift your hips sideways toward the straight leg.
Keep your chest up and feel the inner thigh open.
Return to the center with control.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
description: From a half kneeling position you shift your weight sideways to open the hips and inner thigh. It builds hip mobility.

name: 杠杆式侧坐单臂后三角肌飞鸟
english: lever side seated single arm rear delt fly
instructions: Sit sideways on the machine with your chest against the pad.
Grab the handle with the outside hand.
Start with your arm in front of you and a soft bend in your elbow.
Pull the handle out and back until your arm is in line with your shoulder.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.
description: Seated sideways on a machine, you pull one arm back in a wide arc. It isolates the rear delt.

name: 杠铃泽奇背部伸展
instructions: Hold the barbell in the crook of your elbows against your chest.
Set up on a back extension bench with your hips on the pad.
Lower your torso with a flat back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Avoid hyperextending at the top.
Use a light weight and control the bar.
description: Holding a barbell in the crook of your elbows, you hinge and extend the back. It loads the lower back, glutes and core.

name: 鸟狗平板支撑
instructions: Get into a plank on your hands or forearms with your body in a line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and do not twist.
Hold for a few seconds.
Return and switch sides.
description: A plank where you extend an opposite arm and leg to challenge balance. It builds trunk stability.

name: 稳定球反向挺身
instructions: Lie face down over the ball with your hands on the floor.
Let your legs hang down with your toes light on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep your hands planted and your core tight.
description: Lying face down over a ball, you lift your legs behind you to work the glutes and lower back.

name: 稳定球药球卷腹
english: medicine ball crunch on stability ball
instructions: Sit on the ball and roll down until your lower back is supported.
Hold the medicine ball against your chest or overhead.
Brace your core and crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Pause at the top.
Lower back over the ball with control.
Keep your feet firmly on the floor.
description: Crunching on a stability ball while holding a medicine ball adds range and load to the abs.

name: 仰卧腹部剪刀卷腹
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and your legs slightly off the floor.
Scissor your legs up and down in alternating motion.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set count of reps.
description: Lying on your back, you crunch up while scissoring your legs. It works the upper and lower abs together.

name: 稳定球坐姿伐木
instructions: Sit tall on the ball with your feet wide.
Hold the weight or handle high on one side.
Rotate and chop diagonally down to the opposite hip.
Keep your arms mostly straight and your hips steady.
Return along the same path.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
description: Seated on a ball, you chop diagonally across your body. It trains the obliques and trunk control.

name: 靠墙冲刺
instructions: Place your hands on a wall and lean forward with a straight body line.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee up while the other leg stays extended.
Switch legs quickly in a running rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Go hard for 10-20 seconds, then rest.
description: Leaning into a wall, you drive your knees in a fast running pattern. It practises sprint posture and builds speed.

name: 史密斯前腿垫高分腿蹲
english: smith front leg elevated split squat
instructions: Set a low platform under the smith bar and put your front foot on it.
Place the bar across your upper back and unrack it.
Step the back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Do all reps, then switch legs.
description: With the front foot raised on a step and the bar on your back, you sink into a deep split squat. It loads the quads and glutes.

name: 史密斯垫高分腿蹲
instructions: Place a bench behind the smith machine and rest your back foot on it.
Position the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
Step the front foot forward.
Lower your hips until the front thigh is near parallel.
Drive up through the front foot.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
description: A split squat with the rear foot raised on a bench, done on a smith machine. It targets the quads and glutes with extra stability.

name: 悬垂团身前水平保持
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tuck your knees to your chest.
Lean back and raise your hips until your back is horizontal.
Keep your arms straight.
Hold for 5-15 seconds.
Lower back down with control.
description: Hanging from a bar, you hold your body horizontal with your knees tucked. It builds lats and core strength.

name: 悬垂进阶团身前水平保持
english: hanging advanced tucked front lever hold
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Lift your body to horizontal in a tucked position.
Open your hips slightly so your back is flat.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled down.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down slowly.
description: A harder front lever hold with the knees tucked but the hips open. It demands strong lats and core.

name: 悬垂前水平保持
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tighten your core.
Raise your whole body to horizontal with your legs straight.
Keep your arms locked and your body in one line.
Hold for as long as you can with good form.
Lower down slowly.
description: The full front lever: a straight horizontal body hold under a bar. It is an advanced test of back and core strength.

name: 稳定球直髋单腿腿弯举
english: straight hip single leg curl on stability ball
instructions: Lie on your back with one heel on the ball and the other leg raised.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Curl the ball toward your glutes with the one leg.
Keep your hips high.
Extend the leg slowly back out.
Finish the reps and switch legs.
description: With your heels on a ball and hips lifted, you curl it in with one leg. It hits the hamstrings and glutes hard.

name: 登山者交叉踢
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee across your body toward the opposite elbow.
Return the foot and switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
Keep up a steady pace for a set time.
description: A mountain climber variation where you bring each knee across toward the opposite elbow. It raises your heart rate and works the obliques.

name: 上斜抬髋
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and hold the top edge behind your head.
Bring your legs up so your knees are over your hips.
Curl your pelvis up to lift your hips off the bench.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement small and controlled.
description: Lying on an incline bench, you lift your hips off the pad by curling the pelvis. It targets the lower abs.

name: 四向单腿跳
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop forward and land softly.
Hop back to the start, then hop to each side.
Hold each landing for a moment.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your foot.
Repeat the pattern, then switch legs.
description: Hopping on one leg forward, back and side to side trains balance, ankle stability and power.

name: 跳箱落下双脚着地
instructions: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off without jumping.
Land on both feet at the same time.
Bend your hips and knees to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second.
Step back up and repeat.
description: You step off a box and land on both feet to practise soft landings. It builds impact control.

name: 弹跳双脚
