instructions: Stand tall with your knees nearly straight.
Hop off the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels off the ground.
Bounce quickly with minimal knee bend.
Stay light and quiet on landing.
Go for a set time or number of hops.
description: Small, quick hops off the balls of both feet. It builds calf and ankle stiffness and bounce.

name: 木棒站姿肩部后伸活动度练习
english: stick standing shoulder mobilization in extension
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift the stick back and away from your body.
Stay tall and avoid leaning forward.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: Holding a stick behind your back, you lift it away to open the front of the shoulders. It improves shoulder extension.

name: 木棒站姿肩部外旋活动度练习
english: stick standing shoulder mobilization in external rotation
instructions: Stand holding a stick with both hands, elbows tucked at your sides and bent.
Push the stick with the stronger hand to rotate the other arm outward.
Keep your elbow glued to your side.
Move only as far as is comfortable.
Return to the start slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: Using a stick to guide the arm, you rotate the shoulder outward. It improves external rotation range.

name: 木棒肩部外展活动度练习
instructions: Hold a stick with both hands in front of you.
Keep one arm relaxed and guide it with the other.
Raise the stick sideways and up.
Keep your torso upright.
Pause at the top.
Lower and switch sides.
description: Using a stick, you guide one arm out and up to the side. It opens up shoulder range overhead.

name: 绳索站姿交替肩屈曲
english: standing alternating shoulder flexion with rope
instructions: Stand tall holding a rope in one hand at your side.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height or above.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower it slowly.
Alternate arms each rep.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders relaxed.
description: A standing drill that lifts one arm at a time in front of you while holding a rope. It warms the shoulders and improves control.

name: 木棒站姿前平举
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the stick in front of you to shoulder height or above.
Keep your ribs down and your core tight.
Lower slowly to the start.
Repeat for smooth reps.
description: Raising a stick in front of you with straight arms warms up the shoulders. It is a light, controlled drill.

name: 哑铃地面仰卧直臂推
english: dumbbell lying straight arm press on floor
instructions: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep your arms straight and your wrists strong.
Lower your arms slightly and then press back up.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Keep your feet planted and core tight.
Control the weights through each rep.
description: A floor press with the arms kept straight. It trains the chest and shoulders without a big range of motion.

name: 宽站距胸椎旋转
instructions: Stand with your feet wide and your knees slightly bent.
Hinge slightly forward with your hands behind your head.
Rotate your chest to one side as far as you can.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Return to the center.
Rotate to the other side and repeat.
description: In a wide stance you rotate your upper back to loosen the thoracic spine. It helps with trunk twisting.

name: 前后滑步
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance with soft knees.
Shuffle forward a few steps on the balls of your feet.
Shuffle back to the start without crossing your feet.
Keep your hips low and your chest up.
Move quickly but stay balanced.
Repeat for a set time.
description: Quick shuffling steps forward and back build footwork and conditioning. It keeps your heart rate up.

name: 坐姿地面提胫骨
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and your hands behind you.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins.
Hold for a moment.
Lower the toes slowly.
Repeat for the set.
description: Sitting on the floor, you pull your toes toward your shins to work the muscles at the front of the lower leg.

name: 绳索中立握宽距下拉 v. 3
english: cable neutral grip wide pulldown v. 3
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs under the pads.
Grab the wide neutral grip handles.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handles rise slowly with control.
description: A wide, neutral grip pulldown on a cable machine that builds the lats and upper back.

name: 站姿等长保持提踵
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hold the top position for 20 to 30 seconds.
Keep your ankles straight and stable.
Lower your heels slowly.
Rest briefly between holds.
description: A standing calf raise held at the top. It builds calf endurance.

name: 等长保持宽距俯卧撑
english: isometric hold wide hand push up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest until your elbows are bent.
Hold this position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Press back up to the start.
Rest and repeat.
description: A wide-grip push-up held halfway down. It builds chest strength under tension.

name: 高杠上斜俯卧撑
instructions: Set a bar at about waist or chest height.
Place your hands on it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back so your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core and glutes tight.
description: With your hands on a high bar, you do an easier incline push up. A great stepping stone toward floor push ups.

name: 吊环等长保持反向腹轮滚动
english: ring isometric hold reverse ab rollout
instructions: Hang or set yourself up with the rings under your forearms.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis.
Move into the rollout position and stop.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Hold for 10-20 seconds.
Return slowly.
description: Holding a reverse rollout position on rings challenges the abs and shoulders. A tough anti-extension hold.

name: 45度髋伸展(臀部专注) v. 2
english: 45 degree hip extension glute focused v. 2
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and lock your heels in.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Hinge forward at the hips with a straight back.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Lower slowly each rep.
description: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench that emphasises the glutes. It strengthens the posterior chain.

name: 垫高分腿蹲
instructions: Stand a stride length in front of a bench and rest your back foot on it.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Drive through the front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A split squat with the rear foot on a bench builds leg strength and balance, one leg at a time.

name: 吊环垫高屈体俯卧撑(深度)
english: ring elevated pike push up from deficit
instructions: Set the rings low and put your hands on them with your feet on a box.
Raise your hips into a pike shape.
Lower your head between the rings.
Keep the rings steady and close to your body.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
description: A pike push up with feet elevated and hands on rings, so you go deeper. It builds strong overhead pressing.

name: 坐姿等长保持引体向上
instructions: Set up a bar so you can sit under it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Hold the top position.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down slowly.
description: Holding the top of a pull up while seated helps you build pulling strength. It works the lats and arms.

name: 仰卧地面离心龙旗
instructions: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line on your upper back.
Brace your core.
Lower your body slowly keeping it straight.
Stop just above the floor.
Bring your legs back up and reset.
description: Lying on the floor, you lower your straight body slowly for the dragon flag. A tough ab and core strengthener.

name: 仰卧地面离心半龙旗
english: lying floor negative half dragon flag
instructions: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Lift your hips and tuck your knees.
Brace your core.
Lower your body slowly with bent knees.
Stop just above the floor.
Reset and repeat.
description: A gentler dragon flag lowering with your knees bent. It builds the strength needed for the full move.

name: 等长保持窄握反手引体向上
english: isometric hold close grip chin up
instructions: Grip the bar with palms facing you and hands close together.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Hold for 5 to 15 seconds.
Keep your shoulders down and core tight.
Lower slowly under control.
Rest and repeat.
description: A close grip chin-up held at the top or halfway. It builds pulling strength and grip.

name: 仰卧地面水平打水腿
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Lift your feet a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20 to 40 seconds.
description: Small alternating kicks while lying down. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.

name: 仰卧地面单腿离心龙旗
english: lying floor single leg negative dragon flag
instructions: Lie on a mat and hold something fixed behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight line with one leg tucked.
Extend the other leg straight.
Lower slowly while keeping your hips level.
Stop just above the floor.
Reset and switch legs.
description: A dragon flag lowering with one leg extended and one tucked. It's a step between the half and full versions.

name: 宽凳空气深蹲
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and lower down.
Lightly touch the bench.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.
description: An air squat with a wide stance, touching a bench to guide your depth. It works the glutes and inner thighs.

name: 长杠杆站姿髋伸展
instructions: Stand tall holding a support if needed.
Keep your leg straight.
Lift it back behind you.
Stop when your hips begin to tilt.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.
description: Standing on one leg, you extend the straight leg behind you. It strengthens the glutes and trains balance.

name: 等长保持俯卧撑
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower halfway down until your elbows are bent.
Hold the position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Press back up.
Rest and repeat.
description: A push-up held in place at the top or bottom. It builds chest, arm and core strength.

name: 单腿腘绳肌臀桥
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg raised.
Press your heel into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: A one-legged bridge with your heel planted that works the hamstrings and glutes.

name: 史密斯jm卧推
instructions: Lie on a bench under the smith bar with a shoulder width grip.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chin or upper chest by bending your elbows.
Keep your elbows slightly in.
Press the bar back up.
Use a light weight and control the path.
description: A hybrid of a close grip bench press and skull crusher done on a smith machine. It loads the triceps.

name: 杠杆式斜角单腿腿举
instructions: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to push it back.
Do not lock your knee at the top.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
description: Pressing with one leg on an angled leg press machine focuses the work on the quads and glutes.

name: 杠杆式站姿蝴蝶机夹胸
instructions: Stand in the machine with your hands on the handles.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.
Keep your chest tall and your back still.
description: Standing at a machine, you bring your arms together in front of your chest. It isolates the chest.

name: 连续小跳
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Hop up a few centimetres by pushing through the balls of your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and rebound straight away.
Keep your knees almost straight and your chest tall.
Continue for 20-30 seconds at a quick, steady rhythm.
description: Quick, low hops on the spot that keep your feet barely off the floor. They warm up the calves and ankles and build bouncy reactive strength.

name: 椅子支撑站姿屈膝提踵
english: standing bent knee calf raise with a chair support
instructions: Stand behind a chair and hold it for balance.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise your heels as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly.
Keep your knees bent throughout.
description: A calf raise with the knees slightly bent while holding a chair. It targets the deeper soleus muscle.

name: 杠铃站姿屈膝垫高提踵
english: barbell standing bent knee calf raise from deficit
instructions: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand with the balls of your feet on a low platform.
Soften your knees into a slight bend and keep that angle throughout.
Lower your heels below the platform until you feel a stretch in your calves.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly with control.
description: A standing calf raise with a bent knee and the balls of your feet on a raised edge, which shifts work toward the soleus. The deficit gives a deeper stretch at the bottom.

name: 椅子支撑站姿屈膝交替提踵
english: standing bent knee alternating calf raise with a chair support
instructions: Stand behind a chair and hold it with both hands.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise one heel as high as possible.
Lower it slowly.
Raise the other heel.
Keep alternating without locking your knees.
description: An alternating calf raise with the knees bent, using a chair for balance. It works the soleus one side at a time.

name: 仰卧地面6英寸保持
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Lift your heels and shoulders about 15 cm off the floor.
Keep your lower back flat and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower and rest.
description: A floor hold where you lie on your back with your legs and shoulders lifted about six inches. It trains deep abdominal tension and endurance.

name: 哑铃罗马尼亚硬拉接深蹲
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs with a flat back.
Feel the hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Bend your knees and sit down into a squat with your chest up.
Stand back up and repeat the sequence.
description: A combo that links a Romanian deadlift with a squat in one fluid rep. It works the hamstrings, glutes and quads together.

name: 壶铃罗马尼亚硬拉接深蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bell down your legs with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
Bend your knees and lower into a squat, keeping the bell close to your chest.
Stand up and repeat for the planned reps.
description: A Romanian deadlift flowing straight into a squat while holding a kettlebell. It trains the hips and thighs with a nice rhythm.

name: 碗式保持
instructions: Lie on your back with arms overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor and tighten your abs.
Lift your arms, shoulders and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your body in a shallow dish shape and breathe.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.
description: A gymnastics-style hollow position on your back with arms and legs reaching away. It builds strong, braced abs.

name: 坐姿地面抬腿
instructions: Sit on the floor with your hands planted behind your hips and legs extended.
Lean back slightly and brace your abs.
Raise both legs together a short way off the floor.
Lower them slowly without letting your heels drop to the ground.
Repeat for the planned reps.
description: From a seated position with hands behind you, you lift your legs to train the lower abs and hip flexors.

name: 屈体站立
instructions: Start on all fours and walk your feet in while lifting your hips high.
Form an upside-down V with straight arms and legs.
Press the floor away and let your head hang between your arms.
Keep your heels reaching toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
description: A folded stance with hips high and head down, shifting weight over your hands. It opens the hamstrings and loads the shoulders.

name: 悬垂侧倾
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and legs together.
Brace your abs and keep your arms straight.
Lean your legs and hips toward one side, bending through the waist.
Return to centre under control.
Lean to the other side and alternate for the planned reps.
description: While hanging from a bar, you lean your body to each side to work the obliques and grip.

name: 登箱
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench at a comfortable height.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Press through that heel and stand up on the box.
Step back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A simple step onto a box that trains the thighs and glutes one leg at a time.

name: 绳索侧卧单臂侧平举
english: cable side lying single arm lateral raise
instructions: Set a low pulley and lie on your side with the handle in your top hand.
Keep your arm straight or slightly bent.
Raise the handle in an arc up to about shoulder height or a bit higher.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: Lying on your side, you raise a cable handle out and up to isolate the side delts with constant tension.

name: 绳索仰卧直立划船(曲杆)
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and grip the SZ bar.
Start with arms extended over your thighs.
Pull the bar up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause when your elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower the bar slowly to the start.
description: An upright row done lying on your back with a cambered bar on a low cable. It hits the delts and traps with steady tension.

name: 杠杆式腰带相扑深蹲
instructions: Attach the belt around your hips and stand with a wide stance, toes out.
Keep your chest tall and brace your core.
Bend your knees and sit down between your legs.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
description: A wide-stance squat on a belt squat machine where the load hangs from your hips, sparing your spine. It works the glutes and inner thighs.

name: 杠杆式腰带罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions: Wear the belt and stand tall with soft knees.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand.
Repeat with smooth control.
description: A hip hinge using a belt machine so the weight hangs from your hips. It trains the hamstrings and glutes without loading the back.

name: 悬挂带后三角肌划船
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body in a line.
Brace your core and glutes.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows flared out wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
description: A suspension-strap row with wide elbows that targets the rear delts and upper back.

name: 杠杆式坐姿脚尖抬起
instructions: Sit at the machine with the pads over your thighs and balls of your feet on the platform.
Lower your heels for a calf stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: A seated machine raise where your knees stay bent, which emphasises the soleus under the calf.

name: 搭档辅助引体向上
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Have your partner hold your legs or hips.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Pause at the top.
Lower yourself slowly.
Ask your partner to give just enough help.
description: A pull-up where a partner supports your legs or hips. It lets you build pulling strength while you work toward full reps.

name: 箱子辅助引体向上
instructions: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one or both feet on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Use your legs as little as possible.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.
description: A pull-up with your feet on a box for light assistance. It helps you build up to full pull-ups.

name: 箱子单腿辅助引体向上
english: box single leg assisted pull up
instructions: Place a box under a pull-up bar.
Grip the bar and rest one foot on the box.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Push lightly with the foot on the box.
Lower slowly.
Switch the assisting leg on the next set.
description: A pull-up with only one foot on a box for assistance. It is a step closer to a full pull-up.

name: 反向动作跳摆臂
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms back.
Dip quickly into a quarter squat while swinging your arms down and back.
Swing your arms forward and up as you explode off the floor.
Extend fully through hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly with bent knees and reset.
description: A vertical jump with a quick dip and an arm swing that adds momentum. It builds explosive leg power.

name: 反向动作跳双手叉腰
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Dip quickly into a quarter squat.
Explode upward, extending hips, knees and ankles.
Reach for maximum height without using your arms.
Land softly on bent knees and reset.
description: A vertical jump with hands on your hips so the legs do all the work. It develops explosive leg power.

name: 哑铃坐姿早安式体前屈
instructions: Sit on a bench with feet flat and hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is about halfway down.
Squeeze your back and glutes to sit tall again.
description: A seated good morning with a dumbbell held at your chest, bowing forward to train the lower back with less leg involvement.

name: 杠铃垫高脚跟高翻握法深蹲
english: barbell elevated heel clean grip squat
instructions: Place your heels on small plates and hold a bar across your upper back with a clean-width grip.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit down into a deep squat with knees tracking over toes.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up through your feet to stand.
description: A squat with your heels raised and a clean-width grip, which keeps the torso upright and loads the quads.

name: 负重壶铃死虫式
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell above your chest with straight arms.
Raise your knees to a tabletop position.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend one leg out while keeping your back flat.
Return it and alternate sides.
description: A dead bug done while holding a kettlebell overhead, adding load to the core challenge.

name: 壶铃上拉死虫式
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell above your chest and knees at tabletop.
Brace your core and keep your lower back down.
Lower the kettlebell overhead while extending the opposite leg.
Return to the start under control.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: A dead bug combined with a kettlebell pullover, where arms and legs extend in opposite directions.

name: 徒手帕特里克步
instructions: Stand on a low step on one leg.
Slowly bend the knee and lower the other heel to the floor.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Tap the floor lightly.
Push through the standing leg to rise.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
description: A step-down drill that builds knee and hip control. It strengthens the quads and glutes.

name: 徒手箱上帕特里克步
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Touch the floor lightly.
Push up through the standing leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
description: A step-down from a box that strengthens the quads and teaches knee control.

name: 徒手波利金步
instructions: Stand with one foot on a low step.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Touch the floor lightly.
Drive back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
description: A controlled step-up and down drill often used for knee strength. It trains the quads and glutes.

name: 徒手箱上波利金步
instructions: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot toward the floor with control.
Keep your torso upright.
Lightly tap the floor.
Press up through your working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
description: A box step-down drill that builds knee strength and control in the quads and glutes.

name: 徒手彼得森步(箱上)
instructions: Stand on a step box on one leg.
Lower the other foot slowly toward the floor.
Keep your knee stable and your torso tall.
Touch the floor lightly.
Rise back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
description: A step-down drill with a slow, controlled lowering. It builds quad strength and knee stability.

name: 跳箱落地跳
instructions: Stand on the edge of a low box with feet hip-width apart.
Step off, do not jump, and land on both feet.
Absorb the landing by bending your knees and hips.
Immediately explode upward into a jump.
Land softly and reset.
description: A plyometric where you step off a box, land, and jump up immediately. It trains reactive strength in the legs.

name: 等长大腿中段拉
instructions: Set a bar in a rack at mid-thigh height and grip it just outside your legs.
Stand with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Brace your core and chest up.
Pull up on the bar as hard as you can without it moving.
Hold for 5 seconds, then release gradually.
description: A max-effort pull against a fixed bar at mid-thigh height. It builds force production through the hips and back.

name: 跑步机倒退走
instructions: Set the treadmill to a very slow speed and hold the handrails.
Turn to face away from the direction of the belt.
Step back gently, landing on the toes first.
Keep your chest tall and take small steps.
Continue for several minutes at a comfortable pace.
description: Walking backwards at a gentle pace on a treadmill. It works the quads and gets your heart rate up in a joint-friendly way.

name: 壶铃硬拉 v. 2
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the handle with a flat back.
Brace your core and push the floor away.
Stand fully tall, squeezing your glutes.
Lower the bell back to the floor with control.
description: A hip hinge lifting a kettlebell from the floor. It teaches solid deadlift mechanics and builds the posterior chain.

name: 杠铃片过头前弓步蹲
instructions: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and the plate steady.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.
description: A forward lunge holding a plate overhead. It trains the legs while challenging shoulder stability and the core.

name: 徒手过头前弓步蹲
instructions: Stand tall with your arms extended overhead.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your ribs down and arms in line with your ears.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.
description: A forward lunge with your arms stretched overhead, adding a core and shoulder challenge to the leg work.

name: 哑铃跨箱
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand beside a box.
Step one foot up onto the box.
Press through it and bring your other foot up.
Step down to the far side one foot at a time.
Repeat, alternating the leading leg.
description: Stepping across a box with dumbbells in your hands. It builds single-leg strength and balance.

name: 站姿躯干扭转甩臂
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed.
Rotate your torso to one side, letting your arms swing around.
Let your back heel lift slightly if needed.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Continue at an easy rhythm for 30 seconds.
description: A dynamic standing twist where your arms swing with the rotation. It loosens up the spine and obliques.

name: 杠杆式仰卧屈膝
instructions: Lie face down on the machine with the pad above your heels.
Grip the handles and keep your hips down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
description: The classic lying leg curl on a machine, isolating the hamstrings.

name: 平板支撑侧跳
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Jump both feet a short way to one side.
Jump them back through the centre to the other side.
Keep a steady rhythm for 20-30 seconds.
description: From a plank, you hop your feet side to side. It challenges the core and gets your heart rate up.

name: 跳跃高抬膝触碰
instructions: Stand tall with one hand held out in front at waist height.
Hop on one leg while driving the opposite knee up to tap your hand.
Land softly and quickly switch legs.
Keep your chest upright.
Continue at a lively pace for 20-30 seconds.
description: A hopping drill where you drive a knee up and tap it with your hand. It raises the heart rate and builds coordination.

name: 哑铃脚跟垫高前蹲
instructions: Place your heels on small plates and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Brace your core and keep your elbows up.
Sit down into a deep squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
Drive up to stand.
description: A front squat with a dumbbell and raised heels, which keeps your torso upright and puts the work on the quads.

name: 徒手脚跟垫高前蹲
instructions: Place your heels on a low plate or wedge.
Hold your hands in front of your chest.
Sit down into a deep squat with your chest tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press up to stand and repeat.
description: A bodyweight squat with your heels raised. It shifts the work to the quads and allows a deeper position.

name: 壶铃交替单臂推举深蹲
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive up and press one kettlebell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you squat again.
Press the other arm on the next rep.
description: A squat into a press with kettlebells, alternating arms. It is a full-body conditioning move.

name: 哑铃交替单臂推举深蹲
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive up and press one dumbbell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you squat again.
Alternate arms each rep.
description: A squat into an overhead press, alternating arms with dumbbells. It works legs and shoulders together.

name: 杠铃半跪肩部推举
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a barbell at your shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower under control to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: An overhead press from a half-kneeling stance, which demands core and hip stability.

name: 地雷管半跪肩部推举
instructions: Kneel on one knee and hold the end of the landmine at your shoulder.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the end up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower slowly to your shoulder.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
description: A one-arm landmine press from a half-kneeling position, easy on the shoulder and tough on the core.

name: 杠铃蛙式站姿硬拉
instructions: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, and a bar over mid-foot.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the bar.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar with control.
description: A deadlift with a wide, toes-out stance. It shortens the range and loads the glutes and inner thighs.

name: 壶铃倒握单臂过头负重行走
english: kettlebell bottoms up single arm overhead carry
instructions: Clean a kettlebell so it is upside down with the bell above your fist.
Press it overhead with a firm wrist.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Walk slowly in a straight line.
Lower it safely and switch arms.
description: Carrying a kettlebell upside down overhead with one arm. It builds shoulder stability and a strong grip.

name: 哑铃胸部支撑划船
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.
description: A two-arm dumbbell row with your chest on an incline bench. It isolates the back without strain on the lower spine.

name: 哑铃单臂胸部支撑划船
english: dumbbell single arm chest supported row
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm row with your chest braced on an incline bench. It lets you focus on each side of the back.

name: 徒手行走低位弓步蹲
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee close to the floor.
Push through your front foot and step the back leg forward.
Continue walking forward, alternating legs.
description: A walking lunge with a deep, low position that opens the hips and works the glutes and thighs.

name: 长距离弓步蹲(低位弓步)
instructions: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Take a very long step forward.
Sink down until your back knee hovers above the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.
description: A lunge with an extra-long stride into a low position. It stretches the hips while working the glutes and thighs.

name: 徒手脉冲高脚杯深蹲
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped at your chest.
Squat down to a deep position.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres at the bottom.
Keep your chest tall and heels down.
Stand up after the planned pulses.
description: A squat held low with small pulses, with your hands clasped at your chest as if holding a weight. It builds thigh endurance.

name: 壶铃z式推举
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and hold a kettlebell at your shoulder.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
description: An overhead press done seated on the floor with legs straight. It removes leg drive and challenges the core.

name: 悬挂带头倒立
instructions: Set the straps at a low height.
Place your forearms or hands on the floor.
Lift your hips and place your feet in the straps.
Press your body up into a stable position.
Hold for 10 to 20 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.
description: A headstand variation using suspension straps for support. It builds balance and shoulder strength.

name: 绳索仰卧地面前平举
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and hold the handle.
Start with your arm by your thigh.
Raise your arm up over your chest with a slight elbow bend.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch arms.
description: Lying on the floor, you lift a cable handle up in front of you to isolate the front delts.

name: 站姿靠墙提胫骨
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet a little forward.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes as high as you can, keeping your heels down.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: Leaning against a wall, you lift your toes toward your shins to train the muscle at the front of your lower leg.

name: 悬垂屈膝抬腿
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
Brace your abs and avoid swinging.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Tilt your pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.
description: From a hang, you bring your knees up toward your chest to work the lower abs.

name: 平板支撑抬腿登山者
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg straight back.
Bring that knee in toward your chest.
Return and switch legs.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
description: A plank with a leg lift into a mountain climber. It trains the core and raises the heart rate.

name: 杠杆式站姿髋推
instructions: Adjust the machine so the pad sits across your hips.
Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Lower your hips back slightly.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down.
description: A standing hip thrust on a lever machine. It targets the glutes with a smooth, guided path.

name: 侧平板蚌式开合
instructions: Lie on your side in a side plank, supported on your forearm with knees bent.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line.
Keep your feet together and open your top knee upward.
Close it under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side plank where you open and close your top knee. It works the outer hips and the obliques.

name: 杠杆式单臂牧师凳弯举(插片式)
english: lever single arm preacher curl (plate loaded)
instructions: Sit at the machine with your upper arm resting on the pad and grip the handle.
Start with your arm almost straight.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.
description: A one-arm curl on a plate-loaded preacher machine, isolating the biceps.

name: 绳索侧卧地面单腿后踢
english: cable side lying floor single leg kickback
instructions: Lie on your side with a cuff on your top ankle.
Position the cable behind you.
Kick your top leg back and slightly up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly.
Do your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side-lying leg kickback with a cable. It isolates the glutes.

name: 杠杆式腰带硬拉(V形杠)
instructions: Stand on the platform with the belt around your hips and grip the V bar.
Bend your knees and hinge with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Drive your feet down and stand tall.
Lower with control.
description: A belt-machine deadlift using a V handle, so the load hangs from your hips.

name: 杠杆式腰带硬拉(直杠)
instructions: Stand on the platform with the belt around your hips and grip the straight bar.
Bend your knees and hinge with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Drive your feet down and stand tall.
Lower with control.
description: A belt-machine deadlift using a straight bar, so the load hangs from your hips.

name: 绳索45度反握反向飞鸟
english: cable 45 degrees reverse grip reverse fly
instructions: Stand at a cable station and grab the handles with palms up.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
description: A cable reverse fly with a palms-up grip, angled at 45 degrees to hit the rear delts and upper back.

name: 绳索45度单臂反向飞鸟
english: cable 45 degrees single arm reverse fly
instructions: Stand at a cable station and take one handle.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arm out and back in an arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.
description: A one-arm cable reverse fly, hinged at 45 degrees to target the rear delt.

name: 绳索45度单臂反握反向飞鸟
english: cable 45 degrees single arm reverse grip reverse fly
instructions: Stand at a cable station and take one handle with your palm up.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arm out and back in an arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.
description: A one-arm cable reverse fly with a palm-up grip, hinged at 45 degrees.

name: 绳索上斜单臂Y字上举(背部支撑)
english: cable incline single arm y raise with back support
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a cable handle in one hand.
Let your arm hang down.
Raise it up and out in a Y shape.
Pause with your thumb up.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.
description: A single-arm Y raise while supported on an incline bench, working the shoulders and upper back.

name: 绳索上斜单臂Y字上举(腕带,背部支撑)
english: cable incline single arm y raise wrist straps with back support
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with the strap on one wrist.
Let your arm hang down.
Raise it up and out in a Y shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.
description: A single-arm cable Y raise using wrist straps, so your grip does not limit the shoulder work.

name: 绳索卧凳交叉侧平举
english: cable lying bench cross lateral raise
instructions: Lie on a flat bench between two low cable pulleys and grab each handle with the opposite hand.
Start with your arms crossed over your body and a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise both arms out and up in a wide arc until your hands are about shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to the crossed position.
Keep your back flat on the bench and avoid swinging.
description: A lying lateral raise where each hand grips the opposite cable handle and the arms sweep up and across. It hits the side delts with constant tension.

name: 绳索卧凳单臂交叉侧平举
english: cable lying bench single arm cross lateral raise
instructions: Lie on a flat bench next to a low pulley and take the handle with the far hand.
Start with your arm across your body and a soft bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up in an arc until it reaches about shoulder height.
Hold for a moment, then lower with control.
Keep your torso still and your shoulder away from your ear.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
description: A one-armed lying lateral raise across the body with a low cable. It isolates a single side delt and lets you fix imbalances.

name: 绳索仰卧单臂交叉侧平举
english: cable lying single arm cross lateral raise
instructions: Lie on the floor next to a low pulley and grip the handle with the far hand.
Begin with your arm across your body and the elbow slightly bent.
Raise your arm out and up in a smooth arc to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back across your body without letting the weight stack rest.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
description: A single-arm lateral raise done lying on your side or back on the floor with a low cable crossing the body. It trains the side delt under steady tension.

name: 绳索坐凳单臂转体划船
english: cable sitting bench single arm twisting row
instructions: Sit on a bench facing a low cable with your feet braced and take the handle in one hand.
Sit tall with your arm extended and your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Pull the handle back while rotating your torso and wrist toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine at the end.
Return slowly with your arm extended and your torso rotating back.
Keep your chest up, then switch sides after your reps.
description: A seated one-arm cable row where you rotate the torso and wrist as you pull. It works the lats and mid back through a longer range.

name: 杠杆腰带罗马尼亚硬拉(直杆)
instructions: Step into the machine, set the belt securely and hold the straight bar with an overhand grip.
Stand tall with your knees slightly bent and your chest up.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down along your thighs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch while your back stays flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without leaning back.
description: A Romanian deadlift on a belt-loaded lever machine using a straight bar. It builds the hamstrings and glutes while sparing the grip and spine from heavy free weight.

name: 杠杆腰带罗马尼亚硬拉(V型杆)
instructions: Step into the machine, secure the belt and take the V bar with both hands.
Stand tall with soft knees and your shoulders back.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as the bar slides down your thighs.
Lower until your hamstrings are well stretched, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and stand up straight.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
description: A belt-loaded lever machine Romanian deadlift using a V bar for a neutral grip. It targets the hamstrings and glutes with a comfortable hand position.

name: 绳索泽奇深蹲
instructions: Attach a bar or handle to a low cable and hook it in the bends of your elbows, close to your chest.
Stand facing away from the stack with your feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core and sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest tall and your knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your elbows tucked and the load close to your body.
description: A squat holding a low cable in the crook of your elbows in front of you. The front load keeps you upright and works the quads, glutes and core.

name: 站姿骨盆抬升
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Soften your knees slightly.
Tuck your tailbone under and lift the front of your pelvis by squeezing your glutes and lower abs.
Hold for 2 seconds.
Release slowly to a neutral pelvis.
Keep your upper body still and breathe normally.
description: A gentle standing move where you tilt and lift the pelvis by squeezing the glutes and abs. It teaches pelvic control and activates the hips.

name: 绳索仰卧上斜侧抬腿
english: cable lying incline side leg raise
instructions: Lie on your side on an incline surface.
Attach the cuff to your top ankle.
Raise your top leg out to the side.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Do your reps, then switch sides.
description: A side-lying leg raise with a cable on an incline. It works the outer hip and glutes.

name: 绳索仰卧上斜单腿后踢
english: cable lying incline single leg kickback
instructions: Lie on an incline surface with the cuff on one ankle.
Hold the support for stability.
Kick your leg back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single leg kickback lying on an incline with a cable. It focuses on the glutes.

name: 哈克深蹲机单腿深蹲(杠杆)
english: leverage single leg squat on hack squat machine
instructions: Set your back against the pad and step onto the platform.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Lower into a squat with control.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
description: A single leg squat on a hack squat machine. It adds stability while loading one leg at a time.

name: 杠铃加州推举
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell above your chest with a shoulder width grip.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead like a skull crusher.
As it nears your head, let the elbows travel down so the bar moves toward the upper chest.
Press the bar up and slightly back over your shoulders.
Lower again along the same path and repeat.
Use a lighter weight and keep your wrists straight.
description: A hybrid of a skull crusher and a bench press where the bar lowers toward the forehead then presses up and back over the chest. It hits the chest and triceps together.

name: 哑铃蜘蛛弯举
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging straight down.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Keep your chest on the pad and avoid swinging.
description: A curl performed chest-down on an incline bench so the arms hang straight. It removes swing and puts the stress on the biceps.

name: 杠铃弹力带负重杠铃片卧推
english: barbell banded weighted plate bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench and make sure the bands and plates are secured on the barbell.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest with your arms extended.
Lower the bar to your mid chest under control.
Press it back up, fighting the rising band tension.
Lock out your elbows without losing shoulder position.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched together.
description: A bench press with resistance bands and plates added to the bar so the load gets heavier as you lock out. It builds chest and triceps strength through the top range.

name: 哑铃坐姿交替侧平举
instructions: Sit upright on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, then raise the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid shrugging.
Alternate sides for your reps.
description: A seated lateral raise lifting one dumbbell at a time. Sitting reduces body swing so the side delts do the work.

name: 动力雪橇拉
instructions: Attach a rope or strap to a loaded sled and grip it with both hands.
Face the sled, hinge slightly and set your feet.
Pull the rope hand over hand while walking backward.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Drive through your legs as the sled comes toward you.
Stop when the sled reaches you and reset.
description: A drag-style move where you pull a loaded sled toward you with a rope or strap, walking backward. It trains the back, arms and legs together.

name: 负重沙袋前弓步
instructions: Hold a sandbag against your chest or across your shoulders and stand tall.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are about 90 degrees with your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat with the other leg.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and the bag tight to your body.
description: A forward lunge holding a sandbag at your chest or on your shoulders. The awkward load challenges your legs and core.

name: 站姿交叉腿核心拉伸
instructions: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Raise the arm on the same side as the back leg overhead.
Reach and lean gently toward the opposite side.
Feel the stretch along your side and abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
description: A standing stretch with your legs crossed that lengthens the sides of the trunk. It loosens the obliques and waist.

name: 仰卧足跟滑动
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Slowly slide one heel along the floor toward your buttocks.
Bend the knee as far as feels comfortable.
Pause for a second.
Slide the heel back out until the leg is straight.
Repeat for your reps, then switch legs.
description: A gentle floor move where you slide your heel toward your hips and back. It restores knee and hip bend with low strain.

name: 仰卧直膝抬腿
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
Tighten the thigh of the straight leg so the knee is locked.
Lift the leg to the height of your bent knee.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
description: A lying straight-leg raise that lifts the leg with the knee locked. It wakes up the quads and hip flexors in a gentle way.

name: 仰卧腹式呼吸
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands on your belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Feel your belly rise under your hands.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Let your belly lower gently.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes.
description: A calm lying breathing drill that focuses on belly breathing. It helps you relax and learn core control.

name: 木棍辅助站姿肩前屈
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick with both hands at hip level, palms down.
Keep the working arm relaxed and let the other hand lead.
Raise the stick forward and overhead as far as is comfortable.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.
description: A shoulder mobility drill where a stick helps one arm lift forward and overhead. The other hand guides the movement.

name: 站姿毛巾足部卷腹
instructions: Stand with one foot flat on a towel laid on a smooth floor.
Keep your heel down.
Curl your toes to pull the towel toward you.
Release and repeat until the towel is bunched under your foot.
Hold on to a support if you need balance.
Do your reps, then switch feet.
description: A foot exercise where you scrunch a towel on the floor with your toes. It strengthens the muscles of the foot and arch.

name: 弹力带跪姿西西深蹲
instructions: Set the band at a stable anchor and kneel with it around your body or hands.
Keep your hips forward and your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Lean back slowly, keeping your hips extended.
Go as far as you can control.
Use your quads to pull yourself back up.
Keep your core braced and your movement smooth.
description: A kneeling sissy squat with a resistance band for assistance or load. It places a big stretch on the quads.

name: 木棍辅助站姿肩内旋
english: stick assisted standing shoulder internal rotation
instructions: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back, one hand low and the other high.
Let the lower hand grip the stick as the working arm.
With the top hand, gently pull the stick up so the lower hand rises along your back.
Go until you feel a mild stretch.
Hold for 2 seconds, then release.
Keep your shoulders level, then switch sides.
description: A mobility drill where you use a stick behind your back to help rotate the shoulder inward. It improves reach and range.

name: 站姿靠墙肩内旋等长收缩
english: standing isometric shoulder internal rotation against wall
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Place the inside of your fist or forearm against the wall.
Press into the wall as if rotating your arm inward.
Hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and rest briefly.
Keep your elbow at your side, then switch arms.
description: An isometric hold pressing the inner forearm into a wall to work the shoulder rotators. There is no movement, only steady tension.

name: 球辅助仰卧屈膝髋内收等长收缩
english: ball assisted lying bent knee isometric hip adduction
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Place a ball between your knees.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
Hold for 5 to 10 seconds.
Release slowly.
Repeat for several reps.
description: A lying hip adduction hold squeezing a ball between the knees. It trains the inner thighs.

name: 腕伸展等长收缩
instructions: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down and wrist at the edge.
Place your other hand on top of the working hand.
Try to lift the hand up while the top hand resists.
Hold for 5-10 seconds with no movement.
Relax slowly.
Repeat, then switch arms.
description: A static hold where you press the back of your hand upward against resistance. It strengthens the wrist extensors without moving the joint.

name: 弹力带拇指伸展等长收缩
instructions: Loop a light resistance band around your thumb and the base of your fingers.
Rest your hand on a table or your thigh.
Push your thumb out against the band.
Hold the tension for 5-10 seconds without moving.
Release slowly.
Repeat, then switch hands.
description: A thumb hold against a band that builds strength in the muscles that extend the thumb. It is small and controlled.

name: 平板支撑触膝
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank.
Brace your core.
Lower one knee gently toward the floor.
Return it and switch sides.
Keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
description: A plank with alternating knee taps to the floor. It trains the abs and anti-rotation control.
